2610.20786.result_en: Minecraft and DiscoveryWorld evaluations report improved open-world success and generalization.
2610.20786.boundary_en: Skill-library evolution is external adaptation; the abstract promises public code at camera-ready, not an already verified release.

2610.20926.title: SkillNEO: Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization of Agent Skills
2610.20926.authors: Enze Ma , Chunyu Miao , Yankai Chen , Jie Yang , Liancheng Fang , Kening Zheng , Hanrong Zhang , Muyao Xu , Xinle Yu , Chengze Li , Wei-Chieh Huang , Ziwei Ren , Yunhao Du , Zhixiang Shen , Xue Liu , Philip S. Yu , Zhen Wang
2610.20926.abstract_en: Agent skills turn procedural knowledge into reusable artifacts, allowing LLM agents to accumulate and refine expertise through experience. Building on this, skill evolution iteratively improves skills using execution feedback. However, improvement may require several interdependent edits, so low-reward versions can still be worth developing. Requiring immediate reward gains can discard useful partial repairs before their benefits emerge. Non-elitist evolution allows new versions to receive further edits despite scoring below earlier ones. For agent skills, this calls for evidence of what to preserve and repair next. We introduce SkillNEO (Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization for Agent Skills), which separately selects a version to use and versions to keep improving. Comparing how related versions perform the same task reveals working steps to preserve and remaining failures to fix. It can also revisit and revise earlier versions using later evidence. Across 86 SkillsBench tasks in eight domains, including software engineering and office work, SkillNEO raises GPT-5.4 Mini's average reward from 49.1% to 66.4%, within GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Luna's original-skill range. Mini executes tasks, proposes revisions, and edits skills; final evaluation uses the same task instances. Gains span all eight domains. The same skills improve stronger models without further editing. On the 41 tasks with modified skills, reuse improves Luna by 10.5 percentage points and places GPT-5.5 10.6 points above its published original-skill reference. Execution records show these skills can benefit stronger models even when Mini still fails some task requirements. Search histories also show lower-scoring versions leading to skills ultimately selected for use. Together, these findings show that skill evolution can turn a weaker model's partial progress into reusable procedural knowledge for improving more capable agents.
2610.20926.affiliation: University of Illinois at Chicago / Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence / University of California San Diego / University of California Los Angeles / Independent Researcher / University of Texas at Arlington
2610.20926.abstract_zh: 智能体技能将程序知识转为可复用产物，使大语言模型智能体从经验中积累并细化专长。技能进化据此使用执行反馈迭代改进技能。但改进可能需要多个相互依赖的编辑，因此低奖励版本仍可能值得继续发展。要求即时奖励提高，会在收益出现前丢弃有用的局部修复。非精英式进化允许新版本即使分数低于先前版本，仍获得进一步编辑机会；对智能体技能而言，这需要证据说明保留什么以及下一步修复什么。我们提出 SkillNEO，分别选择用于执行的版本与继续改进的版本。比较相关版本在同一任务上的表现，可发现应保留的有效步骤和待修复失败；它也能用后来的证据回访并修改早期版本。在覆盖软件工程、办公等八个领域的 86 项 SkillsBench 任务上，SkillNEO 将 GPT-5.4 Mini 平均奖励从 49.1% 提高到 66.4%，进入 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6 Luna 使用原始技能时的范围。Mini 同时执行任务、提议修改和编辑技能，最终评估使用相同任务实例。收益覆盖全部八个领域。同一技能无需再编辑即可改进更强模型。在 41 项技能被修改的任务上，复用使 Luna 提高 10.5 个百分点，使 GPT-5.5 比其公开原始技能参考高 10.6 分。执行记录表明，即使 Mini 仍未满足某些任务要求，这些技能也能帮助更强模型；搜索历史也显示，较低分版本能够通向最终被选用的技能。结果表明，技能进化能够将弱模型的局部进展转成可复用程序知识，改进更强智能体。
2610.20926.update_target: Skill versions and non-elitist revision history
2610.20926.mechanism_en: Keep execution choice separate from versions selected for further editing; related-version comparisons and later evidence guide repairs.
2610.20926.result_en: 86 SkillsBench tasks raise Mini reward 49.1%→66.4%; edited skills also benefit stronger models without further editing.
2610.20926.boundary_en: Final evaluation uses the same task instances; model transfer is not held-out-task generalization, and low-score ancestors incur search cost.

2610.21016.title: CausalEvo: Causal Skill Self-Evolution for Health LLM Agents
2610.21016.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents for health can accumulate reusable textual skills from task feedback, such as calculation criteria, measurement time points, and formula units. Deciding which skills to retain is consequential: useful rules improve later answers, while faulty generalizations propagate errors. We propose CausalEvo, a method for causal skill self-evolution that estimates the relative effects of deliberately changed skill sets while holding the model weights, feedback cases, and rule count fixed. At each evolution step, a frozen LLM proposes candidate rules, which are pooled with the incumbent skills so that the current skill set remains a feasible choice. Paired skill replacements against shared background rules are scored on the same feedback cases; least squares converts the score differences into relative skill values, and the top-ranked rules are retained, favoring incumbents on ties. A decision-loss bound separates candidate support, approximation, and estimation errors. On six MedCalc-Bench-Verified tasks with 120 held-out cases, CausalEvo achieves 60.00% accuracy, compared with 55.83% for SkillOpt and 51.67% without skills. Across the recorded training configurations, which use different optimization budgets, it consumes 55.6% fewer training tokens than SkillOpt. Gains concentrate in particular calculations alongside regressions on others, and paired accuracy intervals include zero. CausalEvo turns task feedback into controlled decisions about skill retention and replacement. Project repository: this https URL
2610.21016.affiliation: University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
2610.21016.abstract_zh: 健康领域大语言模型智能体能够从任务反馈中积累可复用文本技能，例如计算标准、测量时间点和公式单位。决定保留哪些技能至关重要：有用规则改进后续答案，错误泛化则传播错误。我们提出因果技能自进化方法 CausalEvo，在模型权重、反馈案例和规则数量固定时，估计刻意改变技能集合所产生的相对效果。每个进化步骤中，冻结模型提出候选规则，将其与现有技能合并，使当前技能集合始终是可行选择。针对共同背景规则的配对技能替换，在相同反馈案例上评分；最小二乘将分数差异转为相对技能价值，保留排名最高的规则，同分时优先现有规则。决策损失界区分候选支持、近似和估计误差。在六项 MedCalc-Bench-Verified 任务、120 个留出案例上，CausalEvo 准确率为 60.00%，SkillOpt 为 55.83%，无技能为 51.67%。在优化预算不同的已记录训练配置中，它比 SkillOpt 少消耗 55.6% 训练词元。收益集中于部分计算，其他计算出现退化，且配对准确率区间包含零。CausalEvo 将任务反馈转为受控的技能保留和替换决策。项目仓库见原文链接。
2610.21016.mechanism_en: Shared-background paired replacements estimate relative rule values; least squares ranks a fixed-size bank with incumbent tie preference.
2610.21016.result_en: Accuracy is 60.00% vs 55.83% SkillOpt and 51.67% no skills on 120 held-out cases.
2610.21016.boundary_en: Paired accuracy intervals include zero; regressions occur, and the 55.6% token saving compares different optimization budgets.

2610.21218.title: AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents
2610.21218.abstract_en: Agentic large language models have been documented to lose reasoning capability when placed inside a harness, the software that mediates their observations and actions. To reconcile these losses, we introduce AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that adapts an agent to a task the way a trainer onboards a new employee. It places the agent under the supervision of an intelligent ``Onboarder'' coding agent, which iteratively tailors its foundation model, prompt, and harness source code to simultaneously improve performance and decrease cost. Like a real onboarding process, the Onboarder is only given tens of examples, and all evaluation data is isolated on a separate virtual machine to prevent leakage. We report the lessons learned from building and testing AutoOnboarder on genomic-sequencing prior authorization form submission. Autonomously onboarded agents are able to match or exceed the performance of a Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline at up to 29$\times$ lower costs. However, these agents remain imperfect, and the Onboarding process varies greatly in terms of final performance. We conclude that future Onboarding systems require a robust environment for the Onboarder, including a structured thought interface, (controlled) internet access, and a wide model search space.
2610.21218.affiliation: Research Science Institute, MIT / CliGenAILab, Boston Children's Hospital
2610.21218.abstract_zh: 智能体大语言模型进入运行框架——调节其观测和动作的软件——后，可能损失推理能力。为弥补这种损失，我们提出 AutoOnboarder，像培训者为新员工做入职培训一样，让智能体自主适配任务。它让智能体接受智能编码“Onboarder”的监督，迭代调整基础模型、提示和框架源代码，以同时提高性能、降低成本。类似真实入职流程，Onboarder 只获得数十个示例，所有评估数据隔离在独立虚拟机上，防止泄漏。我们报告在基因组测序事先授权表提交任务上构建和测试 AutoOnboarder 的经验。自主适配的智能体能够达到或超过 Gemini 3.5 Flash 基线表现，成本最高降低至约二十九分之一。但这些智能体仍不完美，入职过程的最终表现差异很大。我们认为，未来 Onboarding 系统需要为 Onboarder 提供可靠环境，包括结构化思考接口、受控互联网访问和广泛的模型搜索空间。
2610.21218.update_target: Selected foundation model, prompts and harness source
2610.21218.mechanism_en: An Onboarder iteratively adapts the agent using tens of examples; isolated-VM evaluation protects assessment data.
2610.21218.result_en: Prior-authorization form agents match/exceed the reported Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline at up to 29x lower cost.
2610.21218.boundary_en: Final results vary substantially; model selection is not necessarily weight training, and healthcare administration is not clinical validation.

2610.21281.title: Diviner: Agentic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure
2610.21281.authors: Pradipta Ghosh , Gaurav Mitra , Shripad Nadgowda , Akshil Shah , Junyu Liu , Canturk Isci , Syamla Bandla , Xinyao Hu , Onkar Deshpande , Anik Dasgupta
2610.21281.abstract_en: Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use. We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. Encode combines a large corpus of reviewed incidents with service-owner expertise to produce scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph. Execute uses an adaptive Lead and context-isolated workers to apply relevant knowledge to point-in-time evidence and maintain evidence-linked hypotheses. Evaluate compares saved investigation trajectories with responder-reviewed outcomes to measure exact cause, useful direction, and Groundedness. Adapt uses recurring gaps and on-call feedback to derive focused operational- knowledge updates, admitting them only after replay, quality checks, and owner approval.
2610.21281.abstract_zh: 大规模分布式系统的根因分析（RCA）十分困难，因为单个症状可能跨越服务、数据、配置、计算和组织边界。响应者必须汇集不完整证据，协调分别掌握因果路径片段的专家。通用语言模型智能体仅有工具访问并不能解决这些问题：它们可能使用陈旧或时机不当的上下文，将查询失败误解为症状不存在，报告无证据的系统状态，并使原本为人类节奏设计的可观测服务过载。我们提出在 Meta 运行的 Diviner（通过证据与审查开展领域知情、可验证事件导航），围绕四阶段可靠性生命周期组织。Encode 将大量已审阅事件与服务所有者经验结合，形成有作用域、带版本的技能、工作流、类型化工具和事件知识图。Execute 使用自适应 Lead 和上下文隔离的工作者，将相关知识应用到特定时间点证据，并维护证据关联假设。Evaluate 将保存的调查轨迹与响应者审阅的结果比较，测量精确原因、有用方向和证据扎实度。Adapt 利用反复出现的缺口和轮值反馈，形成聚焦的操作知识更新，仅在通过回放、质量检查和所有者批准后接纳。
2610.21281.update_target: Versioned operational skills, workflows and incident knowledge
2610.21281.mechanism_en: Incident trajectories and responder-reviewed outcomes expose recurring gaps; replay, checks and owner approval gate updates.
2610.21281.result_en: The paper describes deployment at Meta and a four-stage evidence/review lifecycle.
2610.21281.boundary_en: Adaptation is explicitly human-governed; the reviewed abstract gives no numerical autonomous-improvement gain.

2610.21453.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
2610.21453.authors: Zixuan Wang , Yuqi Liu , Yuxin Chen , Sengqiao Yang , Jinhui Ye , Pengguang Chen , Changsheng Lu , Shu Liu , Bei Yu , Jiaya Jia
2610.21453.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.21453.abstract_en: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.
2610.21453.abstract_zh: 通用视觉语言动作（VLA）模型已支持多种开放世界操作，但真实机器人辅助仍需要两种当前不足的能力：个性化和可靠执行。首先，“给我做一个三明治”这样的指令，需要根据持久用户偏好分解子任务，而不是使用单一通用方案；其次，可靠部署需要可解释安全保障，主动防止危险，并从偶发物理失败中平稳恢复。我们提出 CarryOn，为冻结 VLA 策略增加双循环运行框架。规划循环维护持久的用户级和场景级上下文，不断以新观测为依据、通过交互修正，从而跨对话和变化场景实现个性化任务选择与执行落地。执行循环主动监督策略执行，屏蔽预计会导致危险接触的动作。执行失败时，系统调用可复用的控制型恢复技能恢复任务进展，并根据此前失败反思细化技能。在真实机器人和仿真中，CarryOn 跨用户与场景分派符合偏好的子任务，将已经过安全微调的 VLA 的违规率从 52.6% 降到 6.1%，在复用改进技能时将恢复成功率从 13% 提高到 80%。
2610.21453.update_target: Persistent user/scene context and reusable recovery skills
2610.21453.mechanism_en: Planning context is grounded against observations; action shielding handles predicted hazards and reflection refines recovery skills for reuse.
2610.21453.result_en: Reported violation rate falls 52.6%→6.1%; recovery success rises 13%→80% in physical/simulated studies.
2610.21453.boundary_en: The VLA stays frozen and begins safety-finetuned; personalization, shielding and learned recovery are different contributions.

2610.21739.title: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
2610.21739.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.21739.abstract_en: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with Evidence-based Knowledge Admission, which uses source evidence and subsequent experience to govern which claims enter the task agent's context, without additional validation tasks. Across six task streams from Continual Learning Bench and four model backbones, RIKA achieves the highest aggregate score on every backbone.
2610.21739.affiliation: University of California Davis / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
2610.21739.abstract_zh: 随着基础模型智能体进入开放式环境，从经验持续学习变得重要。对于参数固定的模型，这种学习需要在上下文中复用先前任务经验，提高未来任务表现与效率。现有记忆和经验学习系统往往聚焦保留事实或程序中的一种，缺少机制来确定从持续任务流中提取断言的可靠性。我们发现，代表性系统产生的条目中，约 12%—33% 在复用时会损害未来任务表现。为此，我们提出 RIKA（可靠知识获取），将事实、概念、程序和元认知知识的分层提取，与基于证据的知识准入结合。准入利用来源证据和后续经验，控制哪些断言进入任务智能体上下文，无需额外验证任务。在 Continual Learning Bench 的六个任务流、四个骨干上，RIKA 在每个骨干上均获得最高汇总分数。
2610.21739.mechanism_en: Source evidence and subsequent experience govern claim admission to context without extra validation tasks.
2610.21739.result_en: RIKA leads aggregates across six streams/four backbones; approximately 12–33% of prior-system entries harm reuse.
2610.21739.boundary_en: Absence of extra validation tasks does not make extracted claims infallible; provenance and later-task effects remain the relevant controls.

2610.22322.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
2610.22322.authors: Guowei Xu , Zhenting Qi , Amani Kiruga , Himabindu Lakkaraju , Yilun Du
2610.22322.categories_text: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.22322.abstract_en: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at this https URL .
2610.22322.abstract_zh: 智能体群能力同时取决于各成员能力和协调方式。但现有多智能体系统通常在固定编排结构中训练，将个体能力学习与集体行为组织分离。我们提出基于市场的后训练（MPT），联合学习去中心化智能体群的动作策略和自编排。智能体用出价表达参与意愿，出价决定谁行动，以及集体结果如何提供局部训练信用。共同学习动作与出价，使个体能力和参与模式无需中央协调智能体即可一起适应。我们在具身合成、机器人导航和深度研究上评估 MPT。结果表明，它优于单体后训练，智能体参与方式确实随学习进化。在相同后训练动作策略下，所学自编排优于其他协调策略。消融显示，动作与出价都受益于学习，而所学出价提供更有效的动作训练信号。在原训练目标之外，受训智能体群更快适应相关任务，推理时扩大群体也获得更好表现。更大群体在成员退出时损失更小，说明所学自编排支持去中心化群体的复用、扩展和鲁棒性。代码和训练模型见原文链接。
2610.22322.update_target: Decentralized action and bidding policy weights
2610.22322.mechanism_en: Collective outcomes provide local credit through participation bids; actions and self-orchestration learn together.
2610.22322.result_en: Embodied crafting/navigation/deep research improve; fixed-action-policy controls favor learned coordination and larger swarms tolerate dropout better.
2610.22322.boundary_en: Population scaling and policy learning require separate budget controls; joint adaptation is not proof of self-authored learning algorithms.

2610.22344.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
2610.22344.authors: Shangheng Du , Jinxin Shi , Shuaiyu Zhang , Yiming Wu , Junpeng Zhao , Shiyang Feng , Xin Li , Liang He , Xiangchao Yan , Bo Zhang
2610.22344.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.22344.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.
2610.22344.affiliation: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / East China Normal University
2610.22344.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正在从辅助科研和工程扩展到自主开发与改进人工智能系统，将 AI for AI（AI4AI）推进为通向递归自我改进（RSI）的路径。流程驱动的机器学习工程（MLE）系统通过复杂编排管理长时程实验，为这一目标提供实践方式；近期系统采用模型主导交互，让模型自主组织实验、依据执行反馈调整优化策略。但每次实验的反馈涉及此前多个决策，而长 MLE 执行又包含许多昂贵实验，因此训练必须从长交互轨迹选择有用监督，并从中间结果学习。我们提出自主长时程 MLE 优化的后训练方法，用其训练 35B 混合专家智能体模型 MLExpert。我们设计 Kaggle-MLE Factory，构建可执行任务和模型主导实验的交互框架。分层智能体 SFT 通过结果引导监督，将通用工具和代码能力迁移到 MLE。窗口交互强化学习（WIRL）将连续实验结果之间的多轮决策视为执行窗口，赋予共享的结果奖励。异步采集和策略校正支持在轨迹结束前更新策略。在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，MLExpert 将基础模型平均获奖牌率从 37.9% 提高到 72.7%，达到 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 等更大前沿模型的相近水平。进一步实验显示，它还提高 NatureBench Lite、智能体支架优化和算法优化的表现，表明所学优化能力可泛化到其他任务。
2610.22344.mechanism_en: Outcome-guided SFT and windowed RL assign intermediate experiment credit; asynchronous correction permits updates before trajectory completion.
2610.22344.result_en: A 35B MoE raises MLE-Bench Lite medal rate 37.9%→72.7%, with transfer to scaffold/algorithm optimization.
2610.22344.boundary_en: A trained research capability is a mechanism toward AI4AI, not evidence that the model recursively improves its own trainer without bounds.

2610.22368.title: Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies
2610.22368.authors: Wenye Yu , Yijin Chen , Kaiyi Xiong , Wenbo Han , Wendi Chen , Yang Jin , Han Xue , Jun Lv , Cewu Lu , Chuan Wen
2610.22368.abstract_en: Real-world post-training of generalist robot policies faces two challenges: partial observability makes action selection ambiguous, while offline post-training methods delay feedback from deployment experience. We present Value as Memory (VaM), a framework that addresses these challenges through value caching and online real-world reinforcement learning (RL). Value caching conditions actions on recent value predictions as task-progress memory, while online updates enable timely policy improvement by combining offline demonstrations, off-policy interventions, and on-policy rollouts for sample-efficient adaptation. As a result, VaM transitions from offline RL warmup to online autonomous learning with sparse rewards. Across long-horizon tasks involving deformable objects and contact-rich manipulation, VaM yields a mean absolute success-rate gain of $29.4\%$ with value caching, while achieving a $32.8\%$ gain with online autonomous learning over matched offline training. The evaluated online schedule performs $8\times$ as many policy iterations under the same gradient-step budget, with more than $2\times$ lower recorded time per gradient step with concurrent data collection and training.
2610.22368.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Noematrix Ltd.
2610.22368.abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略的真实世界后训练面临两个挑战：部分可观测性使动作选择有歧义，离线后训练又延迟了部署经验的反馈。我们提出 Value as Memory（VaM），通过价值缓存和在线真实世界强化学习解决两者。价值缓存以近期价值预测作为任务进度记忆来条件化动作；在线更新结合离线演示、离策略干预和同策略执行，及时改进策略并实现样本高效适应。因此，VaM 从离线 RL 预热过渡到稀疏奖励下的在线自主学习。在涉及可变形物体与接触密集操作的长时程任务中，价值缓存带来平均 29.4 个百分点的绝对成功率收益，在线自主学习相对匹配离线训练带来 32.8% 的收益。评估的在线调度在相同梯度步预算下进行八倍策略迭代；数据采集和训练并行时，每个梯度步的记录用时降低超过两倍。
2610.22368.update_target: Robot-policy weights and recent value-prediction context
2610.22368.mechanism_en: Value caching supplies progress memory; online real-world RL combines demonstrations, interventions and on-policy rollouts.
2610.22368.result_en: Value caching gains 29.4 points absolutely; online learning gains 32.8% over matched offline training; schedule runs 8x policy iterations per gradient-step budget.
2610.22368.boundary_en: Real-world adaptation uses external sparse rewards and intervention data; iteration counts, gradient steps and elapsed time are different budgets.

2610.20673.title: HPCAgent-Bench: A Framework for Sound Benchmarking of Code-Optimizing Agents, Harnesses, and Skills
2610.20673.authors: Yakup Koray Budanaz , Lorenzo Paleari , Marcin Copik , Alexandru Calotoiu , Timo Schneider , Benjamin Chen Ming Choong , Shriram Chandran , Lars Hulsbergen , Levi Widmer , Torsten Hoefler
2610.20673.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly used to optimize code, but existing benchmarks fix one accelerator, programming model or harness, so they cannot isolate what each component contributes or show whether added skills and tools repay their cost. We present HPCAgent-Bench with 689 kernels in three tracks: loop-level optimization challenges, kernels extracted from HPC codes, and machine-learning models. The framework specifies each kernel once in NumPy, derives C and Fortran references, accepts submissions through a common C ABI or Python interface, and runs them on CPUs or GPUs, on one or multiple nodes. An external judge checks correctness on hidden fuzzed inputs and times each submission, closing paths agents use to exploit the testing system. We introduce two metrics for reporting results: \textit{intervention efficacy} measures an intervention, such as adding a tool, through paired runs on speedup, success rate and cost, and \textit{weighted token cost} reports input, cached-input and output tokens under explicit weights. Agents reach up to $4.2\times$ speedup over automatic parallelizers, and their optimizations transfer to another machine: $93$--$99\%$ of answers without device-specific code remain correct, and per-kernel speedups keep a rank correlation of $r_s\ge0.84$. Across 40 matched setups, interventions significantly change speedup only twice but token cost by up to $3.0\times$. Because token weighting decides whether a saving is significant, we state the weights and release every token count as a standard for cost reporting. We provide the first comprehensive, broad and hardened benchmark for the sound evaluation of agentic optimization, with transparent cost metrics.
2610.20673.affiliation: ETH Zurich / Institute of High Performance Computing, A*STAR
2610.20673.abstract_zh: 编码智能体越来越多地被用于优化代码，但现有基准往往固定一种加速器、编程模型或运行框架，无法分离各组件贡献，也不能说明新增技能和工具的收益是否抵偿成本。我们提出 HPCAgent-Bench，包含 689 个内核，分为循环级优化挑战、从高性能计算代码提取的内核，以及机器学习模型三个赛道。框架用 NumPy 只定义一次内核，派生 C 和 Fortran 参考，通过通用 C ABI 或 Python 接口接收提交，并在单节点或多节点的 CPU/GPU 上运行。外部裁判用隐藏模糊输入检查正确性、测量耗时，关闭智能体利用测试系统的途径。我们引入两个结果指标：干预效能通过配对运行，衡量增加工具等干预对加速比、成功率和成本的影响；加权词元成本在明确权重下报告输入、缓存输入和输出词元。智能体相对自动并行化器达到最高 4.2 倍加速，优化也能迁移到其他机器：不含设备特定代码的答案有 93%—99% 仍正确，逐内核加速比秩相关为 $r_s\ge0.84$。在 40 个匹配设置中，干预仅两次显著改变加速比，却能使词元成本变化最高三倍。由于词元权重决定节省是否显著，我们明确给出权重并公开每项词元计数，作为成本报告标准。我们提供全面、广泛且加固的智能体优化评估基准，以及透明成本指标。
2610.20673.update_target: Soundness and costs of code-optimization harness/skill interventions
2610.20673.mechanism_en: Hidden fuzz tests and external timing assess paired runs; explicit token weights prevent cost claims from depending on unstated accounting.
2610.20673.result_en: 689 kernels; only two of 40 matched interventions significantly change speedup, while token cost changes up to 3x.
2610.20673.boundary_en: Up to 4.2x optimizer speedup is separate from intervention benefit; hardware transfer is not unbounded agent improvement.

2610.20675.title: AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
2610.20675.authors: Zhanke Zhou , Zongze Li , Weikai Huang , Xuan Li , Chentao Cao , Xiao Feng , Xiangyu Lu , Jinbo Hu , Yi Xie , Nico Pelleriti , Shiyang Liu , Menghan Lu , Max Zimmer , Brando Miranda , Jiangchao Yao , Bo Liu , Sanmi Koyejo , Sebastian Pokutta , Bo Han
2610.20675.abstract_en: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on questions it answers correctly without tools. This inconsistency extends to component interventions: neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably improves accuracy. Behavior and output-token use must be assessed with correctness: low token entropy can accompany wrong answers, and less output per execution can mean more output tokens per correct answer when accuracy falls. AlphaDiana links answer correctness and execution status to traces and resource records for comparing agents and diagnosing failures under shared task and resource policies.
2610.20675.affiliation: Hong Kong Baptist University / University of Arizona / Zuse Institute Berlin / Technical University of Berlin / Stanford University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2610.20675.abstract_zh: 智能体将推理模型与运行框架结合，由框架组织模型调用、执行工具、加载技能指令并在记忆中保留历史。理解智能体表现需要将执行条件与结果、行为、资源使用联系起来。我们提出 AlphaDiana，为数据集、智能体、环境和评分器提供模块化接口的测量系统。它保留框架原生控制循环，同时分别控制文件复用和记忆保留。AlphaDiana 支持完整智能体的宏观分析，也支持在匹配条件下对工具、技能、记忆等组件进行微观干预。我们研究三个开源模型、三个开源框架在五个答案型基准上的表现，其中两个模型还接受两个交互基准测试。我们发现，框架并不总能提高推理准确率：对模型独自无法解决的问题取得的收益，可能被原本不用工具就能正确回答的问题上的损失抵消。这种不一致也延伸到组件干预：技能指导和历史保留都不能可靠提高准确率。行为和输出词元使用必须与正确性共同评估：低词元熵可以伴随错误答案；当准确率下降时，每次执行输出更少，也可能意味着每个正确答案需要更多输出词元。AlphaDiana 将答案正确性、执行状态与轨迹和资源记录连接起来，以在共享任务及资源策略下比较智能体、诊断失败。
2610.20675.update_target: Evaluation of tools, skill guidance and retained memory
2610.20675.mechanism_en: Harness-native control is preserved while file reuse/memory and component interventions are controlled; correctness links to traces and cost.
2610.20675.result_en: Three models/harnesses across five answer benchmarks show no consistent accuracy benefit from harnesses, skill guidance or retained history.
2610.20675.boundary_en: Less output per run may mean more per correct answer; behavior proxies cannot replace matched correctness checks.

2610.20845.title: Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents
2610.20845.authors: Yujie Feng , Xiaobin Wang , Jinluan Yang , Xiaonan Shi , Pengjun Xie , Philip S. Yu , Xiaoming Wu , Jieping Ye
2610.20845.abstract_en: Skill-policy co-evolution, in which an agent's policy model and its skill bank improve each other during training, is a promising paradigm for self-improving agents. Current evaluations score the co-evolved policy on the final bank it trained with (the delivered bank). After deployment, however, skills may be rewritten, added or removed more frequently than the policy model is retrained, leaving the policy to operate on a drifted skill bank that neither the training objective nor existing evaluation protocols address. In this paper, we first establish, through theoretical and empirical analysis, that the fragility hidden by this blind spot is not incidental. The acceptance rule these methods share (cooperative acceptance) ties a policy's competence to the bank it co-evolved with, leaving it fragile once skills drift, regardless of the implementation; empirically, sensitivity to skill drift grows as co-evolution training proceeds. We therefore introduce the CO-evolution Drift Audit (CODA), a deployment-oriented evaluation protocol that simulates skill drift and, alongside success rate under worst-case drift, introduces two new metrics: a consistency rate under meaning-preserving edits and a resistance rate to corrupted skills. Across four co-evolution methods and five benchmarks (six settings), worst-case success is 5-13 points below the peak measured for each delivered pair, erasing 52-93% of the delivered bank's gain over the no-skill baseline. CODA thus reframes the target of co-evolution, from peak performance on the co-evolved bank to the ability to harness skills however they evolve, and provides a shared standard against which future methods can be audited.
2610.20845.affiliation: Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group / Hong Kong Polytechnic University / University of Illinois at Chicago
2610.20845.abstract_zh: 技能—策略协同进化使智能体策略模型与技能库在训练中相互改进，是自改进智能体的一种有前景范式。当前评估使用策略训练时最终得到的技能库，即交付库，对协同进化后的策略评分。但部署后，技能重写、增删的频率可能高于模型重新训练，策略于是面对漂移后的技能库，而训练目标和现有评估协议都没有覆盖这种情况。我们首先通过理论和实证分析说明，这一盲区掩盖的脆弱性并非偶然。这些方法共享的合作准入规则，将策略能力绑定到共同进化的技能库，使其在技能漂移时无论具体实现如何都很脆弱；实验中，技能漂移敏感性随协同进化训练推进而增长。我们提出面向部署的协同进化漂移审计（CODA），模拟技能漂移，除最坏漂移下的成功率外，还引入语义保持编辑下的一致率和抵抗受损技能的抗性率。在四种协同进化方法、五个基准的六种设置中，最坏成功率比各交付组合测得的峰值低 5—13 分，抹去交付技能库相对无技能基线收益的 52%—93%。CODA 因而将协同进化目标从共同进化库上的峰值表现，转向无论技能如何变化都能使用技能的能力，并为审计未来方法提供统一标准。
2610.20845.mechanism_en: CODA perturbs delivered banks and measures worst-case success, meaning-preserving consistency and corrupted-skill resistance.
2610.20845.result_en: Four methods/five benchmarks: drift removes 5–13 points and 52–93% of delivered-bank gain.
2610.20845.boundary_en: Theoretical fragility follows stated acceptance assumptions; do not confuse this CODA audit with the distinct CoDA robotics framework.

2610.21404.title: Multi-Reward Hacking: From Aggregation-Induced Drift to Trust-Anchored Defense
2610.21404.authors: Yushu Li , Jiin Woo , Xiaoxiao Li , Youngsuk Park
2610.21404.abstract_en: To improve task performance while encouraging desirable response properties, LLM post-training often combines a primary reward (e.g., correctness) with auxiliary rewards (e.g., brevity or efficiency). However, how these rewards are aggregated can critically affect training outcomes. We show that symmetric aggregation, which treats reward channels equally, can induce a failure where aggregate reward improves while primary-task performance degrades, even when individual rewards are meaningful. We investigate this aggregation-induced failure through a one-step multi-reward decision formulation, characterizing when it constitutes multi-reward hacking. We prove that, under symmetric aggregation, deterministic conditional-mean GRPO converges to auxiliary-favoring behavior when auxiliary rewards are more reliably obtained, regardless of initialization. We propose Trust-Anchored Gating (TAG), which first elects an anchor channel based on the policy drift induced by optimizing each channel alone, then gates auxiliary credit on anchor satisfaction. Unlike calibration-sensitive static reweighting, TAG structurally eliminates credit for auxiliary-only outcomes while preserving additional credit for joint success. In the same analytical setting, TAG provably reverses this selection, converging to the primary-favoring action from any initialization when the primary channel is anchored. Experiments across Qwen and Llama models on mathematics and program synthesis reveal substantial degradation under symmetric, constrained, and normalized aggregation, whereas TAG mitigates this failure. On Qwen3-4B with a brevity reward, TAG achieves 0.581 pass@4 versus 0.220 for additive aggregation, while shortening responses by 44% relative to correctness-only training.
2610.21404.affiliation: University of British Columbia / Amazon Annapurna Labs
2610.21404.abstract_zh: 大语言模型后训练常将主要奖励（如正确性）与辅助奖励（如简短或高效）结合，以提升任务表现并鼓励期望属性。但聚合方式会显著影响训练结果。我们表明，即使各奖励都有意义，平等对待奖励通道的对称聚合也可能导致汇总奖励提高、主要任务表现下降。我们用单步多奖励决策形式研究这种聚合诱发失败，刻画它何时构成多奖励投机。我们证明，在对称聚合下，确定性条件均值 GRPO 会在辅助奖励更易可靠获得时，收敛到偏向辅助目标的行为，与初始化无关。我们提出信任锚定门控（TAG），先依据单独优化每个通道引起的策略漂移选出锚通道，再以锚目标满足为条件授予辅助信用。不同于依赖校准的静态重加权，TAG 从结构上取消仅辅助成功的得分，同时保留联合成功的额外信用。在相同分析设置下，当主要通道为锚时，TAG 被证明从任意初始化收敛到偏向主要目标的动作，逆转此前选择。在 Qwen、Llama 的数学和程序合成实验中，对称、约束和归一化聚合均出现明显退化，TAG 缓解该失败。Qwen3-4B 使用简短奖励时，TAG 的 pass@4 为 0.581，加法聚合为 0.220，同时回复比仅正确性训练缩短 44%。
2610.21404.update_target: Aggregation of primary and auxiliary training rewards
2610.21404.mechanism_en: TAG chooses an anchor using isolated-channel policy drift, then denies auxiliary-only credit while retaining joint-success credit.
2610.21404.result_en: Qwen3-4B pass@4 is 0.581 vs 0.220 additive, with 44% shorter responses than correctness-only training.
2610.21404.boundary_en: Convergence claims are for a one-step conditional-mean analytical setting; anchor selection must actually identify the desired primary objective.

2610.21458.title: What Survives Self-Evolution: Provenance Marks in Copied Agent Harnesses
2610.21458.authors: Jieyu Li , Jingya Li , Sheng Li , Xinpeng Zhang , Zhenxing Qian
2610.21458.abstract_en: Agent harnesses, the prompt and tool code around a base model, leak. Claude Code's 512,000 lines were mirrored within hours of a packaging error. A plagiarist can pass a leaked harness through a published self-evolver and ship the result as its own. We define this as a covert rewriting attack. No one targets a provenance mark, yet a large language model (LLM) proposer rewrites the file that carries it and a score keeps the better rewrites. We give the first measurement of marks under this attack, with three evolvers, five proposers and two environments. Published marks fail. KGW in the prompt survives GEPA's rewrites in 0 of 12 copies, AgentMark as released in 5 of 12. The proposer's habits decide survival, by two orders of magnitude across models, and selection protects a mark only when each decision sees enough games. We then build a mark for this attack. Its key is the order of near-tied entries of a table of where objects are found, built from public games, so deleting the table costs success, rewrites that keep its rows keep the order, and a customer reads the key from the agent's actions alone. On held-out games it is detected in 62 of 76 copies whose lineage rewrote its file. A scheme-aware plagiarist reshuffles the ties at no measurable cost, and a plagiarist who asks the proposer for more general code removes the key in 75-100% of rewrites.
2610.21458.abstract_zh: 基础模型周围的提示和工具代码，即智能体运行框架，会发生泄漏；Claude Code 的 512,000 行代码在打包错误数小时内被镜像。抄袭者可以用公开自进化器改写泄漏框架，再作为自己的产品发布。我们将其定义为隐蔽重写攻击：没人直接针对来源标记，但大语言模型提议者重写承载标记的文件，评分选择较好的改写。我们首次在三种进化器、五种提议者、两个环境中测量这种攻击下的标记存续。现有公开标记失效：提示中的 KGW 在 GEPA 重写后 12 份中存续零份，发布版 AgentMark 存续 5 份。不同提议模型习惯使存续相差两个数量级，只有每次选择看到足够游戏时，选择机制才保护标记。我们随后为这种攻击构建标记：密钥是基于公开游戏生成的物体位置表中近似并列条目的顺序。删除表会损害成功率，保留表行的改写会保留顺序，客户仅从动作就能读出密钥。在留出游戏中，76 份谱系重写过标记文件的副本中有 62 份被检测到。但了解方案的抄袭者能够以不可测成本重新排列并列项；要求提议者生成更通用代码的抄袭者，能在 75%—100% 的改写中去除密钥。
2610.21458.mechanism_en: Three evolvers/five proposers test incidental rewriting; behavior-readable table ordering is checked on held-out games and aware attacks.
2610.21458.result_en: Proposed mark survives detection in 62/76 lineage-rewritten copies; general-code requests remove it in 75–100% of rewrites.
2610.21458.boundary_en: Incidental survival is not resistance to an informed adversary; the code-leak anecdote is author context, not independently verified here.

2610.21553.title: Writability and the Pathway: A Controlled Study of Knowledge Injection into Addressed Memory
2610.21553.authors: Wei Gao (1), Cheng Tian (1), Duan Yang (2), Jianqing Yin (1) ((1) Shibei Qiyuan AI Technology, (2) Xi'an Jiaotong University)
2610.21553.abstract_en: Addressed conditional memory provides a local surface for post-hoc knowledge injection, but a successful write need not transfer to a new question or preserve untargeted behavior. This study combines a controlled GPT-2 comparison with production-memory experiments on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Newly initialized modules attached to frozen GPT-2 are tested in a 2 x 2 design: row-only versus row-plus-projection updates, each with or without fixed module-residual anchoring. All arms reproduce 50 trained completions in each of three sampling seeds. Natural-question target-string hits average 5.3% for both row-only arms, 28.7% for unanchored projection updates, and 22.0% with anchoring, while strict answer scores remain zero. Anchoring lowers measured drift; lexical hits do not establish entity-specific retrieval. In the archived Qwen experiments, gradient writes make the designated first answer token top-ranked for 132 independently reset targets, comprising 93 new promotions and 39 already top-ranked targets. A separate matched 24-target comparison gives 13 new promotions with Adam versus two with SPSA at equal iteration counts but unequal computational procedures. An 80-row case includes saved continuations and a replay record, while reformulations bound its scope. Six DeepSeek zero-order cases yield one new target-token promotion and one regression. These results support bounded writing feasibility and separate trained expression, question-form behavior, and preservation; first-token rankings do not establish complete-answer success or universal conditions for writable memory.
2610.21553.affiliation: Shibei Qiyuan AI Technology / Xi'an Jiaotong University
2610.21553.abstract_zh: 按地址访问的条件记忆为事后知识写入提供局部接口，但成功写入未必迁移到新问题，也未必保留非目标行为。本研究结合 GPT-2 受控比较与 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的生产记忆实验。在冻结 GPT-2 上附加新初始化模块，采用二乘二设计：仅行更新或行加投影更新，各自有无固定模块残差锚定。所有实验组在三个采样种子下都复现 50 条训练补全。自然问题的目标字符串命中率，两个仅行更新组均为平均 5.3%，无锚投影更新为 28.7%，有锚为 22.0%，但严格答案分数均为零。锚定降低测得漂移；词面命中并不建立实体特定检索。在存档 Qwen 实验中，梯度写入使 132 个独立重置目标的指定首答案词元排名第一，其中 93 个为新提升、39 个原已第一。另一个匹配的 24 目标比较中，相同迭代次数下 Adam 有 13 个新提升，SPSA 有两个，但计算过程并不相同。一个 80 行案例保存了后续生成和回放记录，改写问题限制其适用范围。六个 DeepSeek 零阶案例产生一个新目标词元提升及一个退化。结果支持有界写入可行性，并区分训练表达、问题形式行为和保留；首词元排名不能建立完整答案成功或可写记忆的普遍条件。
2610.21553.mechanism_en: Factorial GPT-2 row/projection controls and archived model experiments separate trained completions, reformulated questions and preservation.
2610.21553.result_en: All GPT-2 arms reproduce 50 trained completions, but strict natural-question answer scores remain zero.
2610.21553.boundary_en: Target first-token promotions are not complete correct answers; Adam/SPSA iteration matching does not equate computation.

2610.21646.title: The Self-Improvement Problem
2610.21646.authors: Brian B. Moser , Stanislav Frolov , Tobias C. Nauen , Federico Raue , Andreas Dengel
2610.21646.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.21646.abstract_en: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a genuine semantic improvement, depends on potentially unbounded program behavior. We formalize this mismatch by modeling agents as programs and defining improvement in terms of a semantic score that need not be computable. We study two evaluation abstractions. The first is a certifier that approves or rejects an update. The second is a search procedure that, given access to a proposal generator, attempts to output some improving candidate if one exists. We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees. We also show the limit of this recovery: a chain of accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls. Our results draw a boundary between unbounded, universal settings where correctness guarantees collapse and bounded settings where they can be recovered by design.
2610.21646.affiliation: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence / RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau
2610.21646.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型兴起，智能体系统越来越自主，会编写代码、调用工具、修改提示并提议改变自身组件。这带来安全自改进的根本问题：奖励模型或自动审核者等自动门控，能否可靠判断是否应接受更新？困难是结构性的。门控必须是会终止、可计算的程序，但我们真正关心的更新是否构成语义改进，取决于潜在无界的程序行为。我们将智能体建模为程序，以未必可计算的语义分数定义改进，研究两种评估抽象：批准或拒绝更新的认证器，以及能够访问提议生成器、在存在改进候选时尝试输出其中一个的搜索过程。我们证明，在完全一般的设置下，任何终止过程都不能同时保证可靠性（从不接受非改进）和非保守性（从不错过可用改进）：自指构造可以迫使任何此类门控或搜索器失败。有界错误的随机门控面临相同限制。随后，我们指出实践常用的可判定区域，即有界评估和有限提议预算，此时穷举仿真能够给出具有所需保证的终止搜索过程。我们还展示这种恢复的边界：一条获准更新链可以每轮提高有界分数，真实分数却下降。结果区分无界普适情形中正确性保证崩溃，与可通过设计恢复保证的有界情形。
2610.21646.update_target: Formal limits of update certifiers and searchers
2610.21646.mechanism_en: Self-referential constructions separate unbounded semantic improvement from computable terminating gates; finite simulation supplies a decidable regime.
2610.21646.result_en: General reliable/non-conservative certification is impossible under the stated model, including bounded-error randomized gates.
2610.21646.boundary_en: This does not forbid useful bounded improvement; increasing bounded scores can still lower the intended true semantic score.

2610.22209.title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
2610.22209.authors: Sebastian-Antonio Toma , Jean de Kernier , Mike Ply , Oliviu Matei
2610.22209.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.22209.abstract_en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
2610.22209.affiliation: Amazon Web Services / Technical University of Cluj-Napoca
2610.22209.abstract_zh: 智能体记忆基准通常评估回复是否反映正确知识，用下游问答准确率替代记忆质量。我们表明这一范式不完整：它混淆记忆正确性、检索质量和生成质量，既会产生正确回复掩盖损坏记忆的假阳性，也会产生错误回复将检索失败归咎于正确记忆的假阴性。我们提出 FEB-30，包含六类诊断、三种难度的 30 条事实进化轨迹，通过范式反转构建：由已知事实轨迹生成文档，无需人工标注就有确定性真实答案。每条轨迹定义事实应如何跨多作者产物（文档、邮件、对话）演化，使每步摄入后都能直接检查记忆库。将 FEB-30 应用于一个代表性记忆系统，内在与外在评估平均相差 16 个百分点，44% 的轨迹超过有实际意义的差异阈值。诊断分解显示，系统对创建、更新、强化、替代等记忆操作正确分类的比例仅 20%，这一失败在外在评估中完全不可见；失败模式还随类别和难度系统变化。我们发布基准、文档生成流程和评分框架，以支持可复现的智能体记忆评估。
2610.22209.update_target: Direct memory-state quality versus downstream QA
2610.22209.mechanism_en: Known fact-evolution trajectories generate documents; store inspection after ingestion separates update correctness from retrieval/generation effects.
2610.22209.result_en: FEB-30 has 30 trajectories; intrinsic/extrinsic scores differ 16 points on average, and operation classification is correct only 20%.
2610.22209.boundary_en: The reported failure concerns a representative tested system and synthetic trajectories, not all deployed memory architectures.

2610.22740.title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
2610.22740.authors: Mingda Zhang , Yun Huang , Qiang Huang , Yanjin Li , Rui Qian , Qichao Zhao , Tiesunlong Shen , Na Zhao , Jian Wang , Xiaoying Tang
2610.22740.abstract_en: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R$^2$Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves. To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability, a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn. Built on this objective, we further propose Skill Withdrawal, in which the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it. Moreover, the two loops form one cycle: failures are distilled into skills, skills into parameters, and withdrawals lead the Proposer to new failures, so the orchestrator moves toward zero-skill deployment. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that R$^2$Orch consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, math, code, and interactive tasks.
2610.22740.affiliation: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Fudan University / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Tsinghua University / National University of Singapore
2610.22740.abstract_zh: 近年来，智能体编排被广泛用于解决复杂人类任务，但现有编排学习仍面临手工设计课程、某任务所有执行结果相同时的优势坍缩，以及用单个噪声分数判断技能的不可靠评估信号等挑战。为此，我们提出 R$^2$Orch，即递归自博弈编排：内循环通过自选任务上的自博弈改进编排器，外循环改进内循环的改进方式。为支持这一范式，我们提出递归可学习性训练目标，在技能逐步撤除时，奖励提议者选择仍能使执行结果保持差异的任务。基于该目标，我们进一步提出技能撤除：一旦自博弈内的受控评估表明编排器没有某技能也同样表现良好，外循环就撤除它。两个循环构成统一周期：失败被提炼为技能，技能被内化到参数，撤除又引导提议者发现新失败，使编排器逐步走向零技能部署。在十二个数据集上的实验显示，R$^2$Orch 在问答、数学、代码和交互任务中持续优于基线。
2610.22740.update_target: Orchestrator/proposer weights and removable external skills
2610.22740.mechanism_en: Self-play chooses tasks with varying outcomes under skill withdrawal; failures become skills, skills enter parameters and controlled equivalence tests remove them.
2610.22740.result_en: Twelve datasets show reported improvements across QA, math, code and interaction.
2610.22740.boundary_en: Zero-skill deployment is a training objective, not absence of prior supervision; evaluate internalization and the learned improvement mechanism separately.

2610.22791.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
2610.22791.authors: Zhepei Wei , Wenlin Yao , Baolin Peng , Danqing Wang , Qianhui Wu , Hao Cheng , Yu Meng , Jianfeng Gao
2610.22791.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.
2610.22791.affiliation: Microsoft Research / University of Virginia / Carnegie Mellon University
2610.22791.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在代码任务上展现潜力，其表现由策略模型与调节环境交互的运行框架共同决定。两者相互促进，因此仅进化单个组件并不最优：针对某检查点调优的框架，可能无法处理更新后策略的失败模式；策略学习又受限于固定框架所诱发的轨迹。我们提出 Self-HPO，交替优化框架与策略、并让不断进化的策略充当自身框架提议者的递归自改进方法。每轮中，当前策略先分析自己的失败，提出新框架候选（H 步）；随后在选中框架下通过强化学习更新策略（P 步），训练中发现的困难任务构成下一轮框架搜索集合，使优化持续针对策略变化中的失败模式。在三个代码基准上，Self-HPO 稳定优于仅框架或仅策略优化，将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 平均问题解决率从 57.8% 提高到 64.8%，收益可泛化至分布外设置。分析发现，两个优化组件即使分别与原始对应组件配对仍保留收益，联合收益还超过单独收益之和。Self-HPO 同时提高基础智能体的可靠性（Pass@1）和能力前沿（Pass@k）。采用更强外部模型（如 Opus 4.8）作为框架提议者时，该框架还带来进一步提升。
2610.22791.update_target: Coding-agent policy weights and executable harness
2610.22791.mechanism_en: The current policy diagnoses failures and proposes harnesses; selected-harness RL produces the next checkpoint and hard-task search set.
2610.22791.result_en: Three benchmarks raise average resolve rate 57.8%→64.8%; component swaps and OOD tests support complementary gains.
2610.22791.boundary_en: Self-proposal and the optional stronger external proposer are different settings; include harness search and policy training costs.

2610.23098.title: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
2610.23098.authors: Haoyang Luo , Junhao Qin , Jingyan Cao , Yi Huang , Guangjie Yang , Xiaoyu Chen , Haotao Lu , Tianxiang Gui , Ye Shi , Jingya Wang
2610.23098.abstract_en: Heterogeneous robot teams enable complex, long-horizon tasks by combining complementary sensing, mobility, and manipulation capabilities across multiple embodiments. Yet existing systems struggle to retain execution-time corrections as reusable experience, maintain task-relevant context memory across space and time for reliable handoffs, and explicitly represent the inter-robot dependencies required for structured collaboration. In order to address these challenges, we present InstAgent, a recursively self-improving (RSI) Agent Operating System for heterogeneous robot collaboration. InstAgent organizes team behaviors as agentic behavior trees (BTs) that explicitly model capability assignment, inter-robot dependencies and handoff checks. The RSI mechanism updates these collaboration programs from execution feedback and preserves successful revisions for reuse in future tasks, while shared multimodal spatio-temporal memory provides context for planning and handoff validation. Experiments on 20 real-world multi-robot tasks with three high-level models show consistent gains in task success, first-attempt completion, and execution efficiency.
2610.23098.abstract_zh: 异构机器人团队结合不同机体的感知、移动和操作能力，能够完成复杂长时程任务。但现有系统难以将执行时修正保留为可复用经验，难以跨空间与时间维护任务相关上下文以可靠交接，也难以显式表示结构化协作所需的机器人间依赖。为此，我们提出面向异构机器人协作、具备递归自我改进（RSI）的智能体操作系统 InstAgent。它用智能体式行为树（BT）组织团队行为，显式建模能力分配、机器人间依赖与交接检查。RSI 机制依据执行反馈更新这些协作程序，将成功修改保留供未来任务复用；共享多模态时空记忆为规划和交接验证提供上下文。在 20 项真实世界多机器人任务、三个高层模型上的实验显示，任务成功率、首次尝试完成率和执行效率均持续改善。
2610.23098.mechanism_en: Behavior trees encode assignments, dependencies and handoff checks; execution feedback revises programs and successful changes persist across tasks.
2610.23098.result_en: Twenty real-world multi-robot tasks with three high-level models show consistent success and efficiency gains.
2610.23098.boundary_en: This is external collaboration-code evolution; the abstract gives no numerical headline and does not establish unlimited physical improvement.

2610.23134.title: MetaCurate: Evolving Curation Filters for High-Quality Agentic Coding Data
2610.23134.authors: Donghoon Kim , Seunghyuk Oh , Kevin Galim , Minseo Kim , Minjae Lee , Younghyun Kim , Wooseok Seo , Hyung Il Koo , Wonjun Kang
2610.23134.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories is an effective way to improve coding agents, but selecting useful training examples requires more than identifying successful runs. A resolved patch may follow inefficient reasoning or unnecessary tool use, while a failed run may still contain useful intermediate steps. Training pipelines therefore rely on rules and qualitative assessments to filter trajectories, yet designing these filters typically requires substantial human expertise, and validating improvements through repeated training and evaluation is expensive. We introduce MetaCurate, a training-free framework that evolves executable trajectory curation filters using pairwise LLM judgments. Disagreements between the filter's rankings and the judge's preferences provide targeted feedback for jointly revising its rules, rubric, and aggregation policy. The resulting filter scores trajectories independently, so pairwise comparisons are required only during search. Starting from a blank filter, MetaCurate autonomously discovers a curation strategy that achieves competitive downstream performance without task-specific handwritten criteria. We validate downstream utility through controlled SFT experiments on our uncurated trajectory pool and the Nemotron v3 SWE dataset, with random selection and hand-authored filtering as baselines. In our experiments, MetaCurate achieves the highest mean SWE-Verified score among the compared methods, including hand-authored rule-based filtering and a training-loop baseline whose search costs 3.5x as much.
2610.23134.abstract_zh: 在智能体轨迹上监督微调能够有效改进编码智能体，但选择有用训练样本不只是识别成功执行。解决问题的补丁可能伴随低效推理或多余工具调用，失败执行也可能包含有用中间步骤。因此，训练流程依赖规则和定性判断来过滤轨迹，而设计过滤器通常需要大量人工专业知识，通过反复训练评估验证改进也很昂贵。我们提出无需训练的 MetaCurate，以大语言模型配对判断进化可执行轨迹筛选器。过滤器排序与裁判偏好的分歧提供定向反馈，联合修改规则、评分准则和聚合策略。得到的过滤器独立评分每条轨迹，因此配对比较只在搜索期需要。从空白过滤器开始，MetaCurate 无需任务特定手写标准，自主发现具有竞争力下游表现的筛选策略。我们在未筛选轨迹池和 Nemotron v3 SWE 数据集上，通过受控 SFT 实验验证下游效用，以随机选择和人工过滤为基线。实验中，MetaCurate 在比较方法中取得最高平均 SWE-Verified 分数，包括人工规则过滤及搜索成本为其 3.5 倍的训练循环基线。
2610.23134.update_target: Executable data-curation rules, rubrics and aggregation
2610.23134.mechanism_en: Pairwise LLM disagreements guide filter revisions; the final independent trajectory scorer is evaluated through separate controlled SFT experiments.
2610.23134.result_en: Highest mean SWE-Verified score among compared methods; a training-loop search baseline costs 3.5x as much.
2610.23134.boundary_en: Training-free refers to filter search, not downstream SFT; judge agreement alone is not measured policy-training utility.

2610.23344.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
2610.23344.authors: Minhua Lin , Zijun Wang , Zewen Liu , Zhaotian Weng , Bing He , Zhan Shi , Benoit Dumoulin , Xiang Zhang , Suhang Wang , Hanqing Lu
2610.23344.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate AI research, including language-model (LM) development, offering a potential path toward recursive self-improvement. However, turning experimental feedback into a learned ability to propose effective improvements across models faces two challenges. First, training such an ability with real feedback is expensive: reinforcement learning (RL) requires evaluating tens of thousands of proposals, each potentially requiring a full model-training run. Even at ten GPU-hours per run, reward collection alone would consume hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours, motivating a cheaper surrogate. Second, surrogate feedback can become unreliable as policy optimization favors overestimated proposals when the proposal distribution shifts. To address these challenges, we propose LM2LM, which trains LLMs with RL to generate effective LM improvement proposals. To provide scalable feedback, we use a research world model (RWM), a frozen LLM that predicts proposal gains from real experimental records provided in context, as the reward model for RL. To maintain feedback reliability, we periodically execute current-policy proposals ranked highly by the RWM and add their measured outcomes to its context. Across eight autoregressive and diffusion LM development environments, real-execution evaluations on held-out tasks show that LM2LM enables Qwen3.8-27B to outperform GPT-6-sol, even when GPT-6-sol is given 300 real experimental records in context, while requiring 33% lower data-generation cost. LM2LM also generalizes to a model family unseen during training.
2610.23344.affiliation: Pennsylvania State University / University of California, Santa Cruz / Emory University / University of California, Santa Barbara / Amazon
2610.23344.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于自动化人工智能研究，包括语言模型（LM）开发，为递归自我改进提供潜在路径。但将实验反馈转为跨模型提出有效改进的学习能力，面临两个挑战。第一，真实反馈训练昂贵：强化学习需评估数万项提议，每项可能需完整模型训练；即使每次十 GPU 小时，仅奖励采集也需数十万 GPU 小时，因此需要更廉价代理。第二，当策略优化偏好被高估的提议、提议分布发生变化时，代理反馈会失去可靠性。为此，我们提出 LM2LM，通过强化学习训练大语言模型生成有效的语言模型改进提议。为提供可扩展反馈，我们使用研究世界模型（RWM）：一个冻结大语言模型，依据上下文中的真实实验记录预测提议收益，作为强化学习奖励模型。为维持反馈可靠性，我们周期性执行当前策略提出、被 RWM 排名较高的提议，并将测得结果加入其上下文。在八个自回归及扩散语言模型开发环境中，留出任务的真实执行评估显示，LM2LM 使 Qwen3.8-27B 优于 GPT-6-sol，即使后者上下文中提供了 300 条真实实验记录，同时数据生成成本降低 33%。LM2LM 也泛化到训练未见的模型家族。
2610.23344.update_target: LM-improvement proposer weights and world-model context
2610.23344.mechanism_en: RL uses a frozen research world model as reward; periodic real execution of highly ranked current-policy proposals refreshes its evidence context.
2610.23344.result_en: Eight LM development environments show held-out execution gains over GPT-6-sol with 33% lower data-generation cost.
2610.23344.boundary_en: The reward model weights stay frozen while context changes; periodic execution controls surrogate optimism, not universal prediction accuracy.

2610.23839.title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
2610.23839.authors: Jianyuan Zhong , Chenwei Wu , Zhaochen Yu , Xixian Jiang , Xuewei Li , Hao Xiao , Xilin Dai , Junyang Wang , Jiaru Zou , Zhiqing Cui , Boyuan Zheng , Jing Xiong , Zhen Zhang , Qiang Gao , Michael Morley , Luis Nakayama , Qiang Xu , Liyue Shen , Tao Gui , Leo Anthony Celi , James Zou , Zhenfei Yin , Yingcheng Wu , Ling Yang
2610.23839.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.
2610.23839.affiliation: PhAI Labs / Chinese University of Hong Kong / University of Michigan / National University of Singapore / Fudan University / Peking University People’s Hospital / Peking University / Stanford University / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / University of California, Santa Barbara / Southeast University / Harvard Medical School / Federal University of São Paulo / Massachusetts Institute of Technology / University of Oxford / Princeton University
2610.23839.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要将有价值的假设发展为可执行研究，但如何从不断变化的研究过程中学习仍有挑战。我们为有价值且可检验的研究假设给出操作性定义：针对重要不确定性的证据支撑断言，配有可行调查、明确决策标准和替代解释。DiscoveryRSI 通过多智能体进化搜索发展假设树，将选中研究编译为可执行 Harbor 任务，并通过三个机制递归学习：假设信用优化将科学评估归因到有记录的研究贡献；框架回放识别有效策略和重复失败，细化研究流程；再发现将获准改进用于新调查，产生后续学习经验。我们还提出 DFM-Bench，在假设、修改、发展路径和研究执行等层面全面评估假设质量及累积研究进展。四个生命科学领域的自动评估表明，两轮自改进后假设质量由基础模型的 4.86 升至 5.39，收益主要来自可证伪性与数据可判定性。我们进一步通过专家审阅，将 DiscoveryRSI-27B 与其他研究智能体比较。初步人工评估表明，它在假设重要性、断言合理性及证据边界方面高于 GPT-6 Luna。其假设与模型知识截止时间后发表研究的对应率为 6.3%，显著高于 GPT-6 的 2.5% 和 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%，沿研究路径的人类评分改进也更大。
2610.23839.update_target: Hypotheses, research workflows and learned research capability
2610.23839.mechanism_en: Credit optimization, workflow replay and rediscovery transfer accepted changes to new investigations and generate further experience.
2610.23839.result_en: Two rounds raise automated hypothesis quality 4.86→5.39; preliminary expert review and post-cutoff research correspondence are reported.
2610.23839.boundary_en: Correspondence with later publications is not independent proof of novel discovery; preliminary ratings and automated scores require distinct interpretation.

2610.22732.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
2610.22732.authors: Aaron J. Li , Weijia Xu , Chandan Singh , Zixiao Chen , Jeevana Priya Inala , Charlotte Siska , Acar Tamersoy , Bin Yu , Ion Stoica , Michel Galley , Jianfeng Gao
2610.22732.abstract_en: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
2610.22732.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / Microsoft Research / Microsoft Security
2610.22732.abstract_zh: 前沿编码智能体的进展显著提高了人工智能辅助软件工程的词元成本。效率通常在孤立任务上评估，但真实开发者持续构建、更新和维护大型项目。因此，我们按现实代码任务序列评估，发现智能体存在重复的环境相关词元开销，现有方法难以减少。我们提出外部控制器 TokenEconomizer，跨任务序列削减环境特定成本，通过决定：（i）注入哪些操作微技能；（ii）剪除哪些持续无关的工具；（iii）何时干预无效失败循环。在 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot CLI 与前沿模型配对的设置中，它在任务成功率相近时，将平均词元成本降低 18.4%—30.9%。每个被测智能体—模型设置的每个仓库都保留节省；收益还泛化到顺序网页开发和安全审计等不同领域，成本随任务结构降低 6.4%—21.2%。研究将自适应黑盒成本控制确立为降低真实编码智能体词元成本的潜在方向。
2610.22732.update_target: External operational micro-skills, tool exposure and intervention policy
2610.22732.mechanism_en: Repeated environment costs guide skill injection, persistent tool pruning and interruption of unproductive loops across task sequences.
2610.22732.result_en: Average token costs fall 18.4–30.9% at comparable success across coding systems; transfer domains show 6.4–21.2% savings.
2610.22732.boundary_en: Token savings are not necessarily monetary or wall-clock savings; report controller overhead and success under matched task sequences.

2610.22915.title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
2610.22915.authors: Litong Feng , Ji Qi , Yiran Cheng , Shaowu Pan , Xinyu Zhang , Qijun Li
2610.22915.abstract_en: Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy's failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, the constructed reward largely agrees with the benchmark graders, not reversing their ordering on 82.3\% and 80.5\% of candidate pairs. Used to revise executions, it raises three-run consistency ($\mathrm{Pass}^{3}$) over Baseline from 45.0\% to 54.0\% and from 78.4\% to 83.7\%.
2610.22915.abstract_zh: 开放式工具智能体可以通过不同工具路径完成同一目标，质量共同取决于交互轨迹、环境状态和最终产物，因此很少存在可执行的真实奖励。核心挑战是从现有经验构建奖励，使其揭示当前策略失败，同时在优化期间保持稳定。我们提出 Reward Engine，像主动学习的学生一样，先确定成功条件，再朝其优化。它依据任务和初始轨迹构建 RewardPack，包含检查必要正确性的测试案例和评估渐进质量的准则，每项都作为返回判断及证据的检查执行。冻结的 RewardPack 随后指导智能体修改和选择输出，也能用作强化学习奖励。在 WorkBuddy Bench Office 和 Claw-Eval 上，构建奖励与基准评分大体一致，分别在 82.3% 和 80.5% 的候选对上不反转排序。用来细化执行时，相对基线，三次运行一致性（$\mathrm{Pass}^{3}$）分别从 45.0% 升到 54.0%，从 78.4% 升到 83.7%。
2610.22915.update_target: Evidence-returning RewardPack and revised task outputs
2610.22915.mechanism_en: Initial experience yields correctness tests and graded rubrics; the pack freezes during candidate revision/selection and may also supply RL rewards.
2610.22915.result_en: Pair ordering is not reversed in 82.3%/80.5% of comparisons; Pass^3 rises 45.0%→54.0% and 78.4%→83.7%.
2610.22915.boundary_en: The quoted gains concern execution refinement; optional use for RL must not be reported as a demonstrated policy-training gain.

2610.23048.title: Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL
2610.23048.abstract_en: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. The post-error suffix is optimized exclusively by GRPO, retaining outcome-based learning without extending potentially mismatched hindsight supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive task performance and support effective fine-grained credit allocation.
2610.23048.abstract_zh: 长时程交互要求智能体在变化环境中连续决策。基于结果的 GRPO 缺乏对中间决策的细粒度指导。近期方法将完整轨迹提炼为可复用技能，并使用后见条件化同策略蒸馏（OPD）提供稠密词元级信用。但技能引起的概率变化未必对应奖励一致的信用，尤其当错误动作改变后续交互状态后，技能条件监督可能与当前状态不匹配。为解决这一问题，我们提出 \methodname{}，依据轨迹结果和错误边界路由两种互补后见技能：正向技能捕获成功流程，以强化成功轨迹和错误前决策；负向技能捕获针对失败的修正，以处理决定性错误。错误后的后缀仅由 GRPO 优化，保留基于结果的学习，而不延伸可能错配的后见监督。大量实验展示具有竞争力的任务表现，并支持有效的细粒度信用分配。
2610.23048.update_target: Agent policy weights and outcome/error-specific hindsight credit
2610.23048.mechanism_en: Positive skills supervise success/pre-error decisions; negative skills target decisive errors and only GRPO trains the post-error suffix.
2610.23048.result_en: The abstract reports competitive task results and effective fine-grained credit allocation without numerical headline values.
2610.23048.boundary_en: This is training-time credit assignment, not necessarily a persistent external skill bank; the listing retains an unresolved method-name macro.
2610.23048.abstract_metadata_note: Official listing contains unresolved \methodname{}; original text retained. Figure names the method ETRO; no silent replacement in abstracts.

2610.23288.title: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots
2610.23288.authors: Zicheng Liu , Haochen Wu , Jiawei He , Suyun Zhao , Huan Yang , Cheng Chi , Hao Tang
2610.23288.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.
2610.23288.affiliation: Peking University / Renmin University of China / Beijing XYZ Embodied AI / Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
2610.23288.abstract_zh: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）的进展拓展了单个机器人的操作和全身能力，但单个机器人仍受机体限制，许多真实任务需要协作才可能具备的能力。现有多机器人框架主要强调任务分解、分配和重规划，对物理执行偏离预期时如何适配可执行协调支持有限。我们提出 CoEvolve，在固定机器人运动技能上用可执行代码表示团队协调。验证器引导的协调进化利用多模态基础模型，以动作原语、语义目标、临时机器人角色和有界执行参数实例化协调策略。物理验证评估每次已执行转换，拒绝行为触发从获准检查点开始的结构化协调修改；已验证经验被保留，指导后续决策。我们使用两个模拟 Unitree G1 人形机器人，搬运自由支撑的刚性载荷穿过受限走廊。跨三个多模态骨干家族的 15 次基础任务执行中，CoEvolve 完成 8 项，每个骨干均有端到端成功。额外评估在两个新走廊布局以及同骨干、跨骨干经验初始化后均得到验证过的放置，同时暴露动作精度和接触稳定性方面的持续限制。结果支持将可执行协调作为适配共享物理约束下长时程多机器人协作的实践接口。
2610.23288.update_target: Executable coordination code over fixed motor skills
2610.23288.mechanism_en: Transition verification rejects invalid behavior; accepted checkpoints support structured revision and verified experience guides later coordination.
2610.23288.result_en: Two simulated G1 robots complete 8/15 base runs; added layouts and transferred experience show verified placement.
2610.23288.boundary_en: These are simulation results, despite physical constraints in the verifier; contact precision/stability remain limits. Latest HTML is v2.
2610.23288.source_version_note: Original New-listing abstract retained; official HTML used for header/figure inspection resolves to v2. No substantive replacement comparison performed.

2610.23479.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
2610.23479.authors: Hongcheng Gao , Alex Zhou , Jay Zhu , Zelin Zheng , Shijia Ge , Xiping Li , Di Wu , Yazhe Wang , Jianshu Zeng , Xuan Shangguan , Yongli Wang , Yexing Wan , Lingyu He , Zhiqi Jia , Sihang Wu , Xiao He
2610.23479.abstract_en: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet.
