If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at this https URL .
2610.23479.abstract_zh: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体已能在机器人操作排行榜上与学习策略竞争。我们研究编码智能体控制机器人而非计算机时能走多远，又在哪里受限。HexaShell 保持轻量框架，仅将智能体命令转换为机器人运动。智能体通过一个命令行控制双臂机器人，看到三个 RGB 相机并知道标定信息。每次失败后，它阅读日志、寻找原因，并编写或修复称为工具的小程序；像编码智能体修复失败测试一样，将所学保留为代码。工具只能使用机器人观测到的信息，通过三角测量确定物体彼此及其相对夹爪的位置。两个相机看到同一点时，该点位于两条相机射线交会处；某点位于桌面或积木顶部等已知平面时，其位置是射线与平面的交点。头部相机不足时，机器人移动腕部相机获得第二视角。我们仅用每个任务一个种子的十个布局构建工具，随后冻结，在相同种子的十个新布局上测试。使用 Codex、GPT-6-Astra 和中等推理强度。在全部 42 项 RoboDojo 任务上，按排行榜相同方式平均，HexaShell 成功率为 39.7%，进度分数为 48.0，达到新的最先进水平。限制在接触而非推理：推动成功率 92.5%，记忆任务 65.0%，紧密插入仅 8.3%。失败时，智能体通常看到了失败，却无法使动作成功。已进化工具在原文链接处开源。
2610.23479.update_target: Robot tools written by a frozen coding model
2610.23479.mechanism_en: Failure logs guide geometric tool repairs on development layouts; frozen tools are then tested on new layouts of the same task seed.
2610.23479.result_en: 42 RoboDojo tasks yield 39.7% success/48.0 progress; pushing reaches 92.5%, tight insertion 8.3%.
2610.23479.boundary_en: New-layout testing shares the seed and is distinct from new-task transfer; contact limitations cannot be reduced to reasoning accuracy.
2610.23479.affiliation_verification_note: Paper header and first PDF page inspected; no explicit institutional affiliation confirmed.

2610.23574.title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
2610.23574.authors: Mingze Yin , Xiaohan Wang , Dian Li , Longfei Luo , Jiahong Yan , Yiheng Zhu , Chang-Yu Hsieh
2610.23574.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.
2610.23574.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体在复杂任务中能力突出，但主要在孤立会话中运行，难以持续从历史交互学习或适应用户特定环境。现有自进化范式常将原始交互轨迹不加区分地注入记忆或技能模块，使行为模式模糊、更新可控性受损。随着基础模型推理增强，进化瓶颈也从积累通用知识转为有效管理情境经验。我们提出环境自适应自进化框架 Darwin-Claw，系统提炼情景经验，驱动操作技能和持久记忆的综合进化。理论上，它以迭代智能体 actor 与进化器 critic 协同适应为基础，提出分层经验巩固系统，提取细粒度错误归因，并泛化为动态更新的原型向量。这些结构化情境经验既作为上下文感知的交互补丁，也作为技能细化的显式优化信号。实践上，Darwin-Claw 可直接部署、兼容主流智能体系统，无需人工整理。WildClawBench 上的大量实验显示，它取得显著性能改进，为自主智能体在真实生态中持续适应用户提供可控且稳定的路径。
2610.23574.update_target: Operational skills, durable memory and situational prototypes
2610.23574.mechanism_en: Actor/evolver feedback extracts fine error attributions, updates prototypes and uses them as context patches and skill-refinement signals.
2610.23574.result_en: WildClawBench experiments report substantial performance gains with mainstream agent compatibility.
2610.23574.boundary_en: Controllability/stability are author claims; the reviewed abstract supplies no numeric gain or general convergence guarantee.

2610.23599.title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
2610.23599.authors: Yewei Zhao , Derong Xu , Wei Chen , Yin Xu , Peilun Zhou , Xiaohan Wang , Guojun Yin , Wei Lin , Mingjun Xiao
2610.23599.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. CDSE extracts evidence-grounded semantic gradients from successful and failed trajectories, consolidates them by functional role, and applies component-specific updates and validation with cross-component coordination and adaptive invocation. An analysis of 500 top-ranked skill packages shows that 96.8% contain knowledge spanning at least two functional roles. Across six benchmarks, three agent models, and two execution harnesses, CDSE achieves the highest scores in all 36 settings, improving over the Base agent by 7.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method in each setting by 2.6 points on average. Ablation studies further support the importance of functional differentiation and adaptive invocation.
2610.23599.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / Meituan / City University of Hong Kong
2610.23599.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体通过推理和环境交互处理复杂任务。智能体技能提供持久、可迁移能力，指导规划、上下文决策、工具使用和可执行流程。但现有技能进化主要围绕技能产物组织知识，忽略单个技能内部的功能异质性及其对知识维护和使用的影响。受认知科学启发，我们提出技能进化中的认知分化（CDSE），将统一技能进化为功能不同但协调的四个组件：Meta、Experience、Tool 和 Script。CDSE 从成功及失败轨迹提取有证据支撑的语义梯度，按功能角色巩固，执行组件特定更新与验证，并进行跨组件协调和自适应调用。对 500 个高排名技能包的分析显示，96.8% 包含跨至少两种功能角色的知识。在六个基准、三个智能体模型、两个执行框架组成的 36 个设置中，CDSE 均取得最高分，平均比基础智能体高 7.6 个百分点，比各设置最强竞争方法高 2.6 分。消融进一步支持功能分化和自适应调用的重要性。
2610.23599.update_target: Meta, Experience, Tool and Script skill components
2610.23599.mechanism_en: Success/failure trajectories yield evidence-grounded semantic gradients; role-specific updates and validation coordinate adaptive invocation.
2610.23599.result_en: Across 36 settings, average gains are 7.6 points over base and 2.6 over the strongest competitor.
2610.23599.boundary_en: A 500-package survey finds mixed roles in 96.8%; descriptive prevalence is separate from causal evidence supplied by ablations.

2610.23709.title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
2610.23709.authors: Hyunseo Kim , Suil Choe , Sukkyoung So , Daeyeon Yi
2610.23709.abstract_en: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.
2610.23709.affiliation: AI Lab, CTO Division, LG Electronics
2610.23709.abstract_zh: 面向生成式搜索优化产品信息，要求语言智能体不仅能有效重写，还能通过跨类别保留成功策略持续自我改进。但现有方法经常把结构化产品信息当作自由文本，有效策略隐含在提示、搜索轨迹或重写输出中，而未积累为可复用智能体记忆。我们提出 GLOBE，将优化知识存为不断进化、按字段限定作用域的显式行为手册，以推动持续改进。每个回合，Editor 应用相关行为、获得排名反馈，Reflector 将其转换为行为更新。为保证真实设置中的可靠执行，Moderator 删除冗余提议，Curator 提交获准变化，持续有害的行为被停用。这一循环把回合反馈转为持久、字段限定的优化记忆。实验显示，结构化行为优于整块提示优化，反馈驱动进化及审核进一步提升有效性并降低下行风险。所学行为在未见产品类别上仍有效，表明记忆进化支持可解释、可迁移的产品优化。
2610.23709.mechanism_en: Rank feedback drives behavior proposals; moderation removes redundancy, curation commits changes and consistently harmful behaviors deactivate.
2610.23709.result_en: Structured behaviors beat monolithic prompt optimization and remain effective on unseen product categories.
2610.23709.boundary_en: Generative-search rankings are the task objective, not universal listing quality; frozen-category transfer and online adaptation should be separated.

2610.23791.title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
2610.23791.authors: Yuxing Chen , Zhisheng Zhang , Cheng Tang , Wei Li , Minghui Zhang , Ziyan Huang , Shaocong Wei , Jiawei Chen , Junru Hu , Hongze Zhu , Jianghan Shen , Min Cen , Xinyuan Zhu , Yaxue Zhao , Jubo Wang , Yuqiang Li , Chun-Mei Feng , Zongyuan Ge , Rui Su , Jie Xu , Yirong Chen , Xi Xu , Ming Hu
2610.23791.abstract_en: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen's affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.
2610.23791.affiliation: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / China Pharmaceutical University / University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Westlake University / Nanjing University / Ant Group / Tongji University / Monash University / Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
2610.23791.abstract_zh: 计算药物发现要求智能体组合科学操作，并适应变化的证据与约束。我们提出 DrugHarness，将可组合科学执行与条件技能归纳耦合的可进化框架。环境整合超过 80 种科学操作、生物医学资源和任务特定代码，保留候选、结果和产物的关联。依据执行轨迹与结果反馈，DrugHarness 归纳具有可观察适用条件、推荐动作和支持证据的动作假设。独立审查智能体通过来源验证、必要时的定向执行试验，评估由假设形成的候选技能。获准技能指导后续任务，并依据反馈修改。MolBench 和 SMDD-Bench 评估显示分子筛选、优化与约束设计能力。未进行进化时，在 MolBench 上，它相对公开 MolClaw-CC 结果的亲和力比较准确率高 10.8 个百分点，前三活性命中平均数高 55%。技能开发任务上的回顾评估显示，进化将 Qwen 亲和力比较准确率从 62.2% 提高到 81.1%，优化成功率从 79.5% 提高到 87.2%。前瞻 HPK1 研究中，在各系统特定候选之间，DrugHarness 的中位对接分数比 Biomni 更有利。合成的一种化合物细胞 IC50 为 14.19 nM，比最佳输入参考效力提高 2.64 倍，与两种经验丰富药物化学家设计的选中化合物活性相当。结果支持科学智能体的条件技能进化，并展示连接计算药物设计与实验验证的流程。
2610.23791.update_target: Conditional scientific skills and evidence-linked artifacts
2610.23791.mechanism_en: Execution hypotheses specify observable applicability; independent source review and targeted trials gate admission and later feedback revises skills.
2610.23791.result_en: Retrospective affinity accuracy rises 62.2%→81.1%; one synthesized HPK1 compound has cellular IC50 14.19 nM.
2610.23791.boundary_en: Retrospective skill-task gains, system-specific docking candidates and cellular experiments are different evidence; potency is not clinical efficacy.

2610.23826.title: Self-Building Labs
2610.23826.authors: Jiaru Bai , Yuchi Zhao , Han Hao , Miroslav Bogdanovic , Yang Cao , Varinia Bernales , Alán Aspuru-Guzik
2610.23826.abstract_en: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate SBL's end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting the role of human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, SBL makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable. Project website: this https URL
2610.23826.affiliation: University of Toronto / Vector Institute / Institute of Medical Science / Acceleration Consortium / CIFAR / NVIDIA
2610.23826.abstract_zh: 自驱动实验室（SDL）通过自动化实验执行和优化加速科学发现。人工智能智能体越来越能提出新实验，但现有 SDL 只能执行预先为其构建的程序；适配新实验仍需大量人工工程，使实验室灵活性成为扩展发现的瓶颈。我们提出自构建实验室（SBL），根据高层科学目标自行设计、配置并运行实验室。SBL 从已有条件出发，可以是空房间，也可以是运行中的 SDL，构建缺少的能力：实验室布局、数字孪生、机器人技能和实验流程。我们展示它适用于不同机器人与设置，从单工作站扩展到多机器人协作实验室，并通过真实世界量子点合成实验验证端到端能力。SBL 将研究者角色从人工配置和编程设备自动化，转为指定科学目标，使科学自动化更易获得、更灵活且更可扩展。项目网站见原文链接。
2610.23826.update_target: Laboratory layouts, digital twins, robot skills and workflows
2610.23826.mechanism_en: A high-level goal drives configuration of missing capabilities and execution across available robot/lab setups.
2610.23826.result_en: End-to-end capability is demonstrated with a real quantum-dot synthesis experiment and multiple robot configurations.
2610.23826.boundary_en: Self-building automation is related enabling machinery; the abstract does not establish a measured recursive learning chain or indefinite laboratory self-improvement.

2610.22445.title: Null Controls Are Necessary but Not Sufficient: Evaluating Acceptance Guards for Scientific Discovery and Interpretability
2610.22445.abstract_en: Automated discovery systems propose scientific explanations and test which to accept. Does passing a test establish the intended claim? We develop four executable operations for changing physical descriptions: identifying redundancies (L1), coarse-graining dynamics (L2), transferring structure (L3), and inferring missing quantities from conservation imbalances (L4). We evaluate these operations and three interpretability settings through null acceptance (NAR), positive acceptance (PAR), and consequence agreement (CAR). A reduction mapping every state to zero predicts its own future perfectly. It passes closure on 96% of 129 public chaotic systems despite retaining no dynamical variation. An independent observable-preservation test rejects it throughout. On controlled benchmarks, the combined criteria accept 24/24 genuine reductions and reject 72/72 nulls. The other operations distinguish symmetries from redundancies, validate transfers, and reject spurious conservation imbalances. In language and ESM-2 protein models, linear CKA remains unchanged when a proposed correspondence is randomly rotated, whereas localized interventions distinguish genuine mappings from tested nulls. In sparse autoencoders, enrichment rejects all 16 tested nulls, yet independent ablation supports 45% of evaluable enriched features, compared with 0.5% of matched controls. These results reveal two acceptance gaps: descriptive tests can accept scientifically empty candidates, and accepted candidates can lack independently verified consequences. Reliable automated discovery requires evaluating both what a test accepts and the scientific consequences it establishes. Code and data: this https URL .
2610.22445.abstract_zh: 自动发现系统提出科学解释并检验哪些可以接纳，但通过检验能否建立预期断言？我们提出四种改变物理描述的可执行操作：识别冗余（L1）、动力学粗粒化（L2）、结构迁移（L3）和从守恒不平衡推断缺失量（L4）。我们通过空值接纳率（NAR）、正例接纳率（PAR）和后果一致性（CAR），评估这些操作及三类可解释性设置。将所有状态映射到零的约化能完美预测自身未来，虽未保留任何动力学变化，却在 129 个公开混沌系统中的 96% 上通过闭合性检验。独立的可观测量保留检验在所有情况下拒绝它。在受控基准上，组合标准接纳全部 24 个真实约化、拒绝全部 72 个空值。其他操作区分对称性与冗余、验证迁移，并拒绝虚假守恒不平衡。在语言模型与 ESM-2 蛋白模型中，随机旋转所提对应关系时线性 CKA 不变，但局部干预能区分真实映射与所测空值。在稀疏自编码器中，富集检验拒绝全部 16 个空值，但独立消融只支持 45% 可评估的富集特征，匹配对照为 0.5%。结果揭示两种准入缺口：描述性检验会接纳科学上空洞的候选，获准候选也可能缺乏独立验证的后果。可靠自动发现需要同时评估检验接纳什么，以及其建立了什么科学后果。代码和数据见原文链接。
2610.22445.update_target: Acceptance criteria for discovery and interpretability
2610.22445.mechanism_en: Null/positive acceptance and consequence agreement combine descriptive tests with independent observable preservation or interventions.
2610.22445.result_en: A zero reduction passes closure on 96% of 129 systems; combined controls accept 24/24 genuine reductions and reject 72/72 nulls.
2610.22445.boundary_en: Rejecting nulls does not establish intended scientific consequences; only 45% of evaluable enriched SAE features have independent ablation support.
2610.22445.affiliation_verification_note: Paper header and first PDF page inspected; no explicit institutional affiliation confirmed.

2610.22466.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
2610.22466.authors: Wenxuan Ding , Qin Lu , Changlong Yu , Sha Li , Shuowei Jin , Xin Liu , Zhenyu Shi , Greg Durrett
2610.22466.abstract_en: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. But how much of this gain reflects benchmark-specific overfitting or additional inference-time compute, and how much may generalize beyond the search set? In this work, we introduce Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that dissects an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and the remainder, which gives an upper bound on residual generalizable improvement. We apply HDA to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks. In 21 of these settings that show statistically significant search-set gains, we find that a large share of the improvement is explained by overfitting or test-time scaling. Specifically, among these 21 settings, overfitting and test-time scaling account for 54% and 14% of the gain on average; their combined share exceeds 50% in 14 settings. The residual and held-out transfer vary substantially across tasks, models, and frameworks. Importantly, search-set gains often fail to transfer to held-out tasks, and provide limited evidence that they will persist under practical distribution shifts. Moreover, validation-based signals are insufficient to prevent overfitting. These results motivate attribution-aware evaluation in future harness evolution research.
2610.22466.abstract_zh: 运行框架进化自动优化固定权重模型周围的提示、技能、工具和编排代码，无需更新权重即可提高智能体系统表现。框架为提高搜索集性能而迭代优化，但收益中有多少是基准特定过拟合或额外推理计算，又有多少可能泛化？我们提出框架增量归因（HDA），将进化收益分为产物导致的过拟合、测试时扩展可解释收益和剩余部分，后者给出残余可泛化改进的上界。我们在数学、代码、创造性和智能体任务中，对 11 个执行模型、三种框架进化方法应用 HDA。在搜索集收益统计显著的 21 个设置中，大量改进可由过拟合或测试时扩展解释：两者平均分别占收益的 54% 和 14%，组合占比在 14 个设置中超过一半。剩余部分和留出迁移在任务、模型和框架间差异显著。搜索集收益经常无法迁移到留出任务，只能为其在实际分布偏移下持续提供有限证据；基于验证的信号也不足以防止过拟合。结果支持未来框架进化采用具有归因意识的评估。
2610.22466.mechanism_en: HDA separates artifact overfitting, test-time scaling and residual gain; held-out transfer evaluates what survives search.
2610.22466.result_en: Across 21 settings with significant search gains, average shares are 54% overfitting and 14% test-time scaling.
2610.22466.boundary_en: The remainder is an upper bound on generalizable improvement, not a certified causal gain; validation signals do not reliably prevent overfitting.

2610.22467.title: Progressive Misalignment Can Emerge from Benign Recursive Self-Distillation
2610.22467.authors: Karim Abdel Sadek , Federico Di Gennaro , Fanny Yang
2610.22467.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.22467.abstract_en: Training models on their own outputs has attracted widespread attention as a possible route to advance AI capabilities. One prominent approach is self-distillation, where a model is trained to match the token-level predictions it would have produced when given access to additional context, such as a cue, feedback, or instruction. However, the safety properties of this training procedure are poorly understood. In this paper, we present a surprising safety failure of recursive self-distillation, where each self-distilled model becomes the teacher for the next round of training. We observe that when a safe model is recursively self-distilled on its own (safe) generations while receiving an additional non-harmful cue, it becomes increasingly misaligned across a diverse set of harmful queries; we call this Progressive Misalignment. We show this failure mode in both the Qwen3 and Phi-4 model families on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT. Progressive misalignment also occurs in a more realistic setup, where the fixed cue is replaced by feedback from a simulated user with benign intent. Using a gradient-based method, we are also able to find benign prompts that lead to progressive misalignment when applying recursive self-distillation, showing that harmful training prompts are not necessary for this failure mode to emerge. We hope our work encourages future investigations of the safety properties of AI systems recursively trained on their own data.
2610.22467.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / ETH Zurich
2610.22467.abstract_zh: 在模型自身输出上训练，被广泛关注为提升人工智能能力的潜在途径。常见的自蒸馏让模型匹配它在获得线索、反馈或指令等额外上下文时会产生的词元级预测，但该训练程序的安全性质仍不清楚。我们报告递归自蒸馏中的意外安全失败：每个自蒸馏模型成为下一轮教师。一个安全模型在获得额外无害线索、递归学习自身安全生成时，会在多种有害查询上逐步失配，我们称之为渐进失配。在 Qwen3 和 Phi-4 家族、SORRY-Bench 与 StrongREJECT 上均观察到该失败。更现实的设置中，用善意模拟用户反馈替代固定线索，也出现渐进失配。我们还用基于梯度的方法找到会在递归自蒸馏下导致失配的良性提示，说明不需要有害训练提示也能产生这种失败。我们希望推动进一步研究在自身数据上递归训练的人工智能系统的安全性质。
2610.22467.update_target: Safety drift across recursively self-distilled model weights
2610.22467.mechanism_en: Each distilled checkpoint teaches the next under benign cues or simulated-user feedback; independent harmful-query suites measure resulting misalignment.
2610.22467.result_en: Qwen3/Phi-4 tests on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT show progressive misalignment despite safe generations and benign prompts.
2610.22467.boundary_en: Safe training examples alone do not certify recursively trained safety; no independent reproduction or numeric effect size is supplied here.

2610.22599.title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
2610.22599.authors: Ayush Bansal , Aldo Pareja , Sean Klein , Serge Didenko , Artem Lukoianov
2610.22599.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.22599.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible. Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments. However, the space of possible design choices in ML is vast. An LLM that proposes an experiment needs a reliable intuition of whether it is worth running given the timing constraints of long training runs. In this work, we measure such intuition in current frontier LLMs by evaluating how accurately they predict the impact of self-generated ML experiment ideas before these are put into training runs. To this end, we construct a dataset of 288 LLM-proposed ideas on eight MLE-bench tasks. We then prompt five frontier LLMs (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3) to predict the impact of each idea and compare their predictions with the actual outcomes after training. We report four main findings. First, LLM predictions are substantially better than random chance but far from accurate: even the best model, Claude Opus 5.5, explains only half of the variance in outcomes (R^2 = 0.49). Second, we notice that all tested models systematically underestimate the magnitude of the changes. Third, prediction quality varies widely across tasks. Finally, the choice of the coding harness that actually implements the ideas has little effect on outcomes, and we find no evidence of self-preference. Higher reasoning settings and additional context lead to modest gains. Overall, our results show that current LLMs have useful but limited intuition about which ML ideas will work. We release our dataset to support further study.
2610.22599.affiliation: Autolab AI / Institute of Foundation Models / Massachusetts Institute of Technology
2610.22599.abstract_zh: 人工智能进展使递归自我改进（RSI）越来越可行。大语言模型已能提出、选择和运行机器学习实验，但可能设计选择的空间巨大，提议实验的模型需要可靠直觉，判断长训练时间约束下某实验是否值得运行。我们评估当前前沿模型在提议投入训练前，预测自生成机器学习实验想法效果的准确性。为此，构建八项 MLE-bench 任务、288 个模型提议想法的数据集，再让五个前沿模型（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Fable 5.1、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3）预测每个想法的影响，并与真实训练结果比较。主要发现有四点：预测显著优于随机但远不准确，即使最佳 Claude Opus 5.5 也只解释约一半结果方差（R^2=0.49）；所有模型系统性低估变化幅度；预测质量跨任务差异很大；实际实现想法所用编码框架影响较小，且没有发现自我偏好证据。更高推理设置及额外上下文带来适度收益。总体上，模型对哪些机器学习想法有效具有有用但有限的直觉。我们公开数据集支持进一步研究。
2610.22599.mechanism_en: 288 proposed ideas over eight MLE-bench tasks are actually trained; five frontier models forecast outcomes before execution.
2610.22599.result_en: Best reported outcome R^2 is 0.49; models underestimate change magnitudes, with large task variation and modest reasoning/context gains.
2610.22599.boundary_en: Prediction is useful but far from reliable acceptance evidence; no detected self-preference is not a universal absence claim.

2610.22698.title: Repair, Retry, and the Cost of Hindsight: Verifier Feedback in Formal Theorem Proving
2610.22698.abstract_en: Verifier-guided self-repair conditions a model on feedback from failed attempts before it tries again, without weight updates. Yet two findings in prior work are in tension: verifier feedback can improve repair of failures, but self-repair itself can provide little-to-no advantage over independent resampling. We reconcile these findings in Lean theorem proving through controlled one-step experiments that hold the preceding failure fixed while varying whether the failed proof is shown, whether the compiler error corresponds to that failure, and the retry instruction. We test frozen Qwen3.6-27B, a general-purpose model, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, a specialized prover, on difficult MiniF2F problems. We find two opposing effects. Showing the model its failed predecessor reduces success and sharply increases copying of it, while on Qwen adding that attempt's compiler error recovers the loss, to the level of the diagnostic alone. Replacing the predecessor with another theorem's failed proof largely removes the degradation on both models; on Qwen, replacing the diagnostic with another problem's error substantially reduces the recovery. Without the failed proof, correct diagnostics show no resolved advantage over wrong-diagnostic controls on either model. The failed-proof penalty persists with and without the retry instruction, whereas Qwen's diagnostic recovery is weaker without it. In 11-problem sequential experiments through 64 attempts, Qwen retains a correct-diagnostic benefit within failed-proof histories, while DeepSeek-Prover shows no resolved recovery. However, no tested one-step feedback condition establishes an advantage over instruction-only resampling, nor does 64-attempt sequential repair with failed proofs and correct diagnostics at equal token budgets. Verifier feedback can thus improve repair without overcoming the performance loss from conditioning on a failed attempt.
2610.22698.abstract_zh: 验证器引导的自修复让模型在不更新权重的情况下，依据失败反馈再尝试。但已有工作中两种发现似乎冲突：验证反馈可以提高失败修复，自修复本身却可能比独立重采样没有或只有很小优势。我们在 Lean 定理证明中用受控单步实验协调两者，固定前一次失败，改变是否展示失败证明、编译错误是否对应该失败，以及重试指令。在困难 MiniF2F 问题上测试冻结通用模型 Qwen3.6-27B 和专用证明器 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B。发现两种相反作用：展示失败前驱降低成功率并显著增加复制；对 Qwen，加入对应编译错误可恢复损失，达到只看诊断的水平。将前驱换成其他定理的失败证明，基本消除两模型的退化；对 Qwen，将诊断换为其他问题的错误会显著降低恢复。不展示失败证明时，两模型均未显示正确诊断相对错误诊断对照的明确优势。无论有无重试指令，失败证明惩罚都存在，而没有指令时 Qwen 的诊断恢复更弱。在 11 个问题、最多 64 次尝试的顺序实验中，Qwen 在失败证明历史内仍保留正确诊断收益，DeepSeek-Prover 则没有明确恢复。然而，无论所测单步反馈条件，还是相同词元预算下带失败证明与正确诊断的 64 次顺序修复，都未建立优于仅指令重采样的优势。因此，验证反馈能改进修复，却未必克服条件化于失败尝试造成的性能损失。
2610.22698.mechanism_en: Matched failed proofs, correct/wrong diagnostics and retry instructions isolate copying penalties and feedback recovery under equal token budgets.
2610.22698.result_en: Qwen diagnostics recover failed-proof conditioning losses; no tested condition establishes superiority over instruction-only resampling.
2610.22698.boundary_en: Conditional repair benefit is not net search improvement; frozen-model retry evidence is distinct from durable cross-task learning.

2610.22779.title: When Can You Trust an Agent's Own Verifier? Stress-Testing Counterfactual Rationale Verification Under Search Pressure and Oracle Access
2610.22779.authors: Jonghyun Lee , Moonsu Kim , Sunghwan Park
2610.22779.abstract_en: Automated agent design increasingly trusts a single score to decide whether a change is an improvement -- but a score optimized aggressively enough ceases to measure what it was meant to. When an agent also explains its design, that explanation is a second signal we can check without human labels: negate each stated claim, re-run, and observe whether performance drops. We ask whether such a verifier stays reliable once an agent optimizes against it. Our contribution is not a new verifier but a way to stress-test one: a pressure ratio $\rho$ measuring how much the verifier steers the agent's search, and four falsifiable probes covering four failure modes -- giving no signal, being too weak to matter, being gamed by stating fewer claims, and being queried before the agent commits. We apply the test to our own verifier, the Rationale Consistency Score (RCS), inside an LLM agent that designs machine-learning pipelines, with one generator model, six tasks, and three seeds. First, in our prior configuration the verifier barely affects the search objective ($\rho \ll 1$), partly because of an accuracy gate, so its robustness had not been tested; it still shapes the reported artifact through a final-selection tie-break that $\rho$ does not register. Second, a capability control shows the agent shortens its claim lists when instructed, yet search does not, even at $\rho$ over 100 times the prior level; since feedback omits claim volume and horizons are short, this null result is largely structural rather than evidence of robustness. Third, when the agent can probe the verifier before committing, it keeps claims that pass while held-out faithfulness falls -- a decline invisible to in-loop metrics, though partly confounded by how RCS scores small pipelines. We offer these as preliminary evidence and propose a reporting standard: audit a verifier with $\rho$ and these probes before trusting it.
2610.22779.abstract_zh: 自动智能体设计越来越依赖单个分数决定变化是否改进，但被激烈优化的分数会不再衡量原本目标。当智能体也解释其设计时，这种解释提供无需人工标签即可检查的第二信号：否定每条断言、重新执行，观察性能是否下降。我们研究该验证器在智能体针对它优化后是否仍可靠。贡献不是新验证器，而是压力测试方法：用压力比 $\rho$ 衡量验证器对搜索的引导程度，并用四个可证伪探测覆盖无信号、影响太弱、少列断言投机，以及提交前查询四种失败模式。我们在设计机器学习流程的大语言模型智能体中，对自身的理由一致性分数（RCS）应用测试，使用一个生成模型、六项任务、三个种子。首先，先前配置中验证器对搜索目标影响很小（$\rho\ll1$），部分由于准确率门控，所以其鲁棒性并未被测试；但它通过最终选择的平局裁决影响报告产物，这不被 $\rho$ 捕捉。其次，能力对照显示，按指令智能体会缩短断言列表，但搜索不会，即使压力比超过原水平一百倍；由于反馈不含断言数量且时间跨度短，这种空结果主要是结构性的，并非鲁棒性证据。第三，允许提交前探测验证器时，智能体保留可通过断言，留出忠实度却下降，循环内指标看不到这种下降，但 RCS 对小型流程的评分方式构成部分混杂。我们将其作为初步证据，建议在信任验证器前，用压力比和这些探测进行审计。
2610.22779.update_target: Reliability of an agent-design rationale verifier
2610.22779.mechanism_en: Pressure ratio and four falsifiable probes test influence, gaming and pre-commit oracle access across six tasks/three seeds.
2610.22779.result_en: The old verifier barely steers search; pre-commit probing can preserve in-loop scores while held-out faithfulness declines.
2610.22779.boundary_en: Null gaming results are partly structural, not proof of robustness; small-pipeline scoring confounds are explicitly acknowledged.

2610.22984.title: Self-Evolving Agents Can Repair Failures but Struggle to Generalize from Them
2610.22984.authors: Weixiang Zhao , Yichen Zhang , Yanyan Zhao , Jinming Bai , Bin Liang , Ruifeng Xu , Bing Qin , Ting Liu
2610.22984.abstract_en: Experience-driven self-evolution offers a promising path for large language model (LLM) agents to continually improve through interaction. Yet existing approaches often rely on successful trajectories or external evaluation signals, leaving unclear whether agents can evolve when such positive anchors are unavailable. We study this question through Cold-Start Failure-Only Evolution (CFOE), where agents start without accumulated experience and learn only from failed interactions without privileged guidance. Across three self-evolving paradigms, multiple LLM backbones, and four interactive environments, we uncover a consistent repair-generalization gap: failure-derived experience can help repair previously failed tasks, but rarely yields sustained improvements on unseen tasks. Further analysis shows that agents often misinterpret failures, while even verified-correct experience remains difficult to transfer. Relaxing CFOE reveals that verifier feedback and additional interaction provide limited gains, whereas successful trajectories substantially improve transfer. These findings suggest that current self-evolving agents are better at repairing observed failures than building generalizable capabilities from failure.
2610.22984.affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology (Harbin and Shenzhen) / Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.22984.abstract_zh: 经验驱动自进化为大语言模型智能体通过交互持续改进提供潜在路径，但现有方法常依赖成功轨迹或外部评估信号，缺少这些正向锚点时能否进化尚不清楚。我们通过冷启动仅失败进化（CFOE）研究这一问题：智能体从无累积经验开始，仅从失败交互学习，不使用特权指导。跨三种自进化范式、多个骨干和四个交互环境，我们发现一致的修复—泛化缺口：失败经验有助于修复曾失败任务，但很少持续提高未见任务表现。分析显示，智能体经常误解失败，即使验证为正确的经验也难迁移。放宽 CFOE 后，验证器反馈和额外交互仅带来有限收益，成功轨迹却显著改善迁移。结果表明，当前自进化智能体更擅长修复已见失败，而非从失败建立可泛化能力。
2610.22984.mechanism_en: Three evolution paradigms, multiple backbones and four environments compare observed-failure repair with unseen-task gains and relaxed-feedback variants.
2610.22984.result_en: Failure experience repairs old tasks but rarely yields sustained transfer; successful trajectories improve transfer more than added verifier feedback.
2610.22984.boundary_en: Verified-correct experience is not automatically reusable; study restrictions bound the negative conclusion.

2610.23362.title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries
2610.23362.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.23362.abstract_en: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. Applying the protocol to public framework repairs, we confirm 18 evidence-path failures across 11 LLM or agent safety project groups and four implementation ecosystems. Nine are established-boundary repairs, eight are new-surface policy-coverage gaps, and one is a boundary-only evidence case. Fourteen reach E1 enforcement boundaries: seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence. The remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. The cases form carrier, adapter, authority, and surface families and show how ordinary application behavior can remain intact while a safety-specific evidence path misses its decision. Exact revisions, deterministic outcomes, negative controls, and a frozen prospective audit document the confirmation rule. Monitor assumptions therefore need regression tests at the schemas, streams, tools, and adapters that frameworks evolve.
2610.23362.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型应用依赖运行时监控器检查工具调用、轨迹、流、检测输出和验证器输入，由此产生接口可靠性问题：框架路径可能正常运行，但策略相关证据从未到达决策点。一个代表案例中，正则检测器已返回阳性匹配，框架却将结果滞留在阻断决策之前。这不同于越狱和检测错误，因为证据已被识别，只是与执行断开。我们用金丝雀契约研究这种修复边界特征：父版本与修复版本的确认单元，仅把已知载荷放在变化的证据表面，记录监控可见性，并对动作边界案例记录下游决策。对公开框架修复应用该协议，我们在 11 个语言模型或智能体安全项目组、四种实现生态中确认 18 个证据路径失败，其中九个是既有边界修复，八个是新表面的策略覆盖缺口，一个是仅边界证据案例。十四个达到 E1 执行边界：七个原生动作结果、六个配置的执行边界、一个合成消费者后果。其余影响验证器、安全提示或可观测通道。案例归为载体、适配器、权限与表面四类，显示普通应用行为可保持正常，安全证据路径却错过决策点。精确版本、确定性结果、负对照和冻结的前瞻审计记录确认规则。因此，监控假设需要在框架不断变化的模式、流、工具和适配器处进行回归测试。
2610.23362.update_target: Safety-monitor evidence paths across framework changes
2610.23362.mechanism_en: Parent/fixed canary contracts, exact revisions and negative controls trace recognized evidence to downstream enforcement.
2610.23362.result_en: 18 failures across 11 project groups/four ecosystems include 14 E1 enforcement-boundary cases with distinct consequence types.
2610.23362.boundary_en: Recognized evidence stranded before a decision differs from detector error; synthetic/configured/native outcomes must not be merged as identical exploit evidence.
2610.23362.affiliation_verification_note: Paper header and first PDF page inspected; no explicit institutional affiliation confirmed.

2610.23372.title: Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision-Language-Action Systems
2610.23372.authors: Keyuan Luo , Yi Xie , Wanyun Ling , Yuanzhe Li , Ziyue Li , Zhuoqi Zeng
2610.23372.abstract_en: When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit? (2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.
2610.23372.affiliation: Hainan Bielefeld University of Applied Sciences (BiUH) / Technical University of Munich / Technische Universität Berlin
2610.23372.abstract_zh: 当我们说机器人使用记忆时，记忆真的起作用吗？仅成功率消融不能建立任务相关事实的使用，因为它同时改变信息和计算，汇总率还可能掩盖相互抵消的收益与损失。我们提出 VLA 系统的干预式记忆评估协议（IMEP），回答四个问题：（1）记忆是否有净收益；（2）何时有帮助；（3）改变记忆是否改变任务结果；（4）影响是否特定于任务相关事实。我们在检索接口比较目标事实替换、事实保持替换、最小数值扰动和精确副本，并将决策正确性与运动执行成功分开评估。研究覆盖回合内、跨回合和智能体式记忆。在跨回合学习记忆库实验中，一个末位单位（ULP）干预及其安装程序改变 11.9% 的种子配对结果，但改变关键事实相对事实保持替换没有明确额外影响。为研究何时记忆有用，我们提出 ChainBench，要求正确决策使用当前观测不可获得的历史信息。完整记忆将任务成功率从 39.1% 提高到 74.3%，在共享记录执行下与预言机决策条件匹配。结果表明，正确历史可以支持机器人决策，但要确认某记忆系统是否实现此收益，需要超出汇总成功率的事实特定证据。
2610.23372.update_target: Causal contribution of VLA memory content
2610.23372.mechanism_en: Target-fact interventions are compared with replicas, fact-preserving replacements and ULP changes; decision and motor outcomes are separated.
2610.23372.result_en: ChainBench success rises 39.1%→74.3%; ULP installation changes 11.9% of paired cross-episode outcomes.
2610.23372.boundary_en: No clear extra target-fact effect appears over fact-preserving controls in that experiment; gross ablations cannot establish fact-specific memory use.

2610.23726.title: RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLMs
2610.23726.authors: Zhouyuan Ma , Yutao Wu , Hanxun Huang , Xiang Zheng , Yi Liu , Xingjun Ma
2610.23726.categories_text: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.23726.abstract_en: Red teaming must continually adapt as frontier LLM safeguards evolve, yet existing approaches largely search for adversarial prompts or optimize within fixed attack procedures. We observe that even when an attack becomes ineffective, its underlying mechanisms can remain useful and can be revised or recombined to construct stronger attacks. Based on this insight, we introduce RedDarwin, an agentic framework that shifts the unit of jailbreak evolution from prompts and fixed attacks to executable attack skills. RedDarwin consists of 47 reusable base skills and autonomously revises, composes, executes, and selects them using target-model feedback, allowing successful discoveries to become building blocks for subsequent evolution. RedDarwin produces 65 evolved skills, improving 44 of 47 base attacks and increasing their mean attack success rate (ASR) on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%. These evolved skills consistently outperform baselines on the held-out StrongREJECT and frontier LLMs unseen during evolution; with only 10 target-model queries, RedDarwin achieves 100% ASR on GPT-5.6-Sol, 92% on Claude-Sonnet-5, and 80% on Gemini-3.8-Flash. Analysis of the evolution trajectories further shows that strong attacks often emerge from novel combinations of reusable mechanisms rather than from individually dominant ones. We believe this paradigm can accelerate adaptive red teaming and inform stronger safeguards, creating complementary value for both safety evaluation and defense.
2610.23726.affiliation: Fudan University / Deakin University / University of Melbourne / City University of Hong Kong / Griffith University
2610.23726.abstract_zh: 红队测试必须随前沿模型保障措施持续适应，但现有方法主要搜索对抗提示或在固定攻击程序中优化。我们观察到，即使攻击失效，其底层机制仍可能有用，可经修改或重组构成更强攻击。基于此，RedDarwin 将越狱进化单位从提示和固定攻击转为可执行攻击技能。它包含 47 个可复用基础技能，依据目标模型反馈自主修改、组合、执行和选择，使成功发现成为后续进化的组件。RedDarwin 产生 65 个进化技能，改进 47 个基础攻击中的 44 个，将 AdvBench 平均攻击成功率从 18.8% 提高到 47.3%。技能在留出 StrongREJECT 及进化未见前沿模型上持续优于基线；仅十次目标模型查询，报告在 GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude-Sonnet-5 和 Gemini-3.8-Flash 上分别达到 100%、92% 和 80% 攻击成功率。轨迹分析显示，强攻击经常来自可复用机制的新组合，而非单个主导机制。我们认为，该范式可加速自适应红队测试并支持更强保障措施，为安全评估和防御提供互补价值。
2610.23726.update_target: Risks from evolving executable red-team skills
2610.23726.mechanism_en: Target feedback selects and recombines reusable skills; held-out benchmarks and unseen target models assess transfer.
2610.23726.result_en: 65 skills improve 44/47 base attacks; mean AdvBench ASR rises 18.8%→47.3%.
2610.23726.boundary_en: ASR is attack/evaluator/budget specific and author-reported; this digest summarizes safety evidence without reproducing attacks or treating it as universal model failure.

2610.23904.title: LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory
2610.23904.authors: Liwei Che , Benlin Liu , Dai Li , Xiangyan Li , Zijian Wu , Changjiang Li , Minghao Guo , Chengzhi Mao , Vladimir Pavlovic , Ranjay Krishna
2610.23904.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.23904.abstract_en: Long-video agents must map hours or days of multimodal evidence into a bounded context while respecting token and latency budgets, making memory design a context-management challenge. Existing memory systems largely rely on hand-designed policies, leaving open how to jointly optimize memory design for performance and efficiency. We propose Long Video Meta-memory Harness (LVMH), an automated multi-agent framework that formulates memory-policy development as multi-objective code search around a fixed answer model. To guard against self-certification and development-set overfitting, LVMH separates implementation from independent review and enforces protected observation boundaries. Persistent meta-memory records past proposals, traces, costs, and failures to guide subsequent policy revisions. Through this harness, we discover Self-Evolving Evidence Memory (SEEM), a "text-first, vision-second" policy that answers from compact structured event memory and evidence specialists, consulting localized frames through a selective visual gate. The policy evolved on EgoLifeQA generalizes to unseen benchmarks, outperforming Meta-Harness on both Ego-R1 Bench and Video-MME (L) with GPT-5 mini. Across the three benchmarks, SEEM with GPT-5 achieves 65.7% average accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 7.7 percentage points with approximately 32x lower average evaluation token use and 91x shorter average response time.
2610.23904.affiliation: Rutgers University / University of Washington / Meta / National University of Singapore / Palo Alto Networks
2610.23904.abstract_zh: 长视频智能体必须在词元和延迟预算内，将数小时或数天的多模态证据映射到有限上下文，因此记忆设计成为上下文管理挑战。现有系统主要依赖人工策略，如何联合优化记忆的性能和效率仍待解决。我们提出长视频元记忆框架 LVMH，在固定回答模型周围将记忆策略开发表述为多目标代码搜索。为防止自我认证和开发集过拟合，LVMH 分离实现与独立审查，并强制保护观测边界。持久元记忆记录过去的提议、轨迹、成本和失败，指导后续策略修改。借助该框架，我们发现自进化证据记忆 SEEM：一种“文本优先、视觉其次”的策略，从紧凑结构化事件记忆与证据专家中回答，通过选择性视觉门控查询局部帧。在 EgoLifeQA 上进化的策略泛化到未见基准，使用 GPT-5 mini 时在 Ego-R1 Bench 和 Video-MME（L）均优于 Meta-Harness。在三个基准上，使用 GPT-5 的 SEEM 平均准确率为 65.7%，比此前最优高 7.7 个百分点，平均评估词元使用量约降低 32 倍，平均响应时间约缩短 91 倍。
2610.23904.update_target: Memory-policy code and persistent search meta-memory
2610.23904.mechanism_en: Independent review and protected observation boundaries constrain code search; proposal/cost/failure records guide subsequent revisions around a frozen answer model.
2610.23904.result_en: SEEM reports 65.7% mean accuracy, 7.7 points above the previous comparator, with about 32x fewer tokens and 91x shorter responses.
2610.23904.boundary_en: These ratios are evaluation-setting specific; frozen answer weights and searched memory code are separate components, and transfer is not unbounded RSI.

2610.23942.title: ReTTT: Reflection-Driven Test-Time Training via Experience-Based Parametric Memory
2610.23942.authors: Kangcong Li , Hangfan Zhang , Shuyue Hu , Shengji Tang , Tao Chen
2610.23942.abstract_en: LLM agents accumulate valuable task-specific information through their actions, observations, and environmental feedback during multi-turn task execution. When effectively used, this information can help agents refine subsequent decisions and improve task performance. However, the learning value of an interaction depends on its context and subsequent feedback, making it challenging to extract reliable, actionable lessons and revise them as the task unfolds. In this paper, we introduce ReTTT, which enables experience-driven self-adaptation through test-time training on lessons constructed and continually revised within an episode. ReTTT lets the agent reflect on interaction feedback, maintain the resulting lessons in an explicit memory, and learn from them by updating an episode-local LoRA adapter while keeping the backbone frozen. The adapted model then performs both subsequent actions and reflection, coupling policy adaptation with the construction of future learning experience. We evaluate ReTTT on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SWE-bench Lite using two model families. ReTTT outperforms trajectory-based test-time training across all six model--benchmark settings, improving task success by up to 12.14 percentage points. A frozen-reflection comparison further shows a 7.14-point benefit from adapting the reflection policy, while trajectory analysis illustrates how adapted reflection derives more task-specific guidance from failed attempts. These findings suggest that learning to reflect on its own behavior can boost agents' performance on long-horizon tasks.
2610.23942.affiliation: Fudan University / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / CUHK
2610.23942.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体在多轮任务中，通过动作、观测和环境反馈积累有价值的任务特定信息。有效使用这些信息可细化后续决策、提高表现，但交互的学习价值依赖上下文与后续反馈，难以提取可靠可用的教训，并随任务推进修改。我们提出 ReTTT，通过在回合内持续构建和修订的教训上进行测试时训练，实现经验驱动自适应。智能体反思交互反馈，在显式记忆中维护教训，在冻结主干的同时更新回合局部 LoRA 适配器以学习教训。适配后的模型同时执行后续动作和反思，将策略适配与未来学习经验构建耦合。我们使用两个模型家族，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 SWE-bench Lite 上评估。ReTTT 在全部六个模型—基准设置中优于基于轨迹的测试时训练，任务成功率最多提高 12.14 个百分点。冻结反思的对照进一步显示，适配反思策略带来 7.14 个百分点收益；轨迹分析展示适配反思如何从失败中提取更贴合任务的指导。这表明，学习反思自身行为能够改善长时程任务表现。
2610.23942.update_target: Episode-local LoRA weights and explicit reflection lessons
2610.23942.mechanism_en: Interaction feedback revises lessons; the adapted model performs both actions and later reflection while its backbone stays frozen.
2610.23942.result_en: Six settings improve over trajectory TTT by up to 12.14 points; adapting reflection adds 7.14 points in the frozen-reflection comparison.
2610.23942.boundary_en: The adapter is episode-local; improved within-episode learning is not demonstrated persistent cross-task evolution.

2610.24454.title: MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery
2610.24454.authors: Sizhe Tang , Zuyuan Zhang , Zeyu Fang , Tian Lan
2610.24454.abstract_en: Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop hypotheses and execution plans implemented by a shared frozen Executor. Both levels receive alternating GRPO-style parameter updates under a shared smooth best-of-budget objective, allowing team organization and individual research behavior to co-evolve in a recursive self-improvement loop. Our analysis establishes objective alignment for the hierarchy, characterizes conditions for coordination gains over independent parallel discovery and the first-order benefit of private adaptation, and derives a finite-budget regret bound for adapted models. On 22 MLGym and MLE-bench tasks, MELD is best on 20 of them and achieves the highest aggregate normalized scores on MLGym, using a 4B backbone for coordination and research. Most baselines use proprietary Scientists, and all systems share one frozen Executor.
2610.24454.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体科学发现存在耦合学习问题：研究分工既决定追求哪些实验，也决定智能体从何种经验中适配。我们提出 MELD，统一的分层测试时训练框架，在单次发现过程中联合适配团队层面的协调者策略和智能体层面的科学家策略。协调者在共享推导树上生成搜索分支和研究指令的联合组合，科学家发展假设和执行计划，由共享冻结执行器实现。两层在共享的平滑化预算内最佳结果目标下交替进行 GRPO 式参数更新，使团队组织与个体研究行为在递归自我改进循环中共同进化。分析建立层级目标一致性，刻画协调优于独立并行发现及私有适配一阶收益的条件，并推导适配模型的有限预算遗憾界。在 22 项 MLGym 和 MLE-bench 任务上，MELD 在其中 20 项表现最佳，并在 MLGym 取得最高归一化汇总分数，协调和研究均采用 4B 主干。多数基线使用专有科学家模型，所有系统共享同一个冻结执行器。
2610.24454.mechanism_en: Alternating GRPO-style updates use a shared best-of-budget objective and derivation tree; a common Executor remains frozen.
2610.24454.result_en: A 4B backbone leads on 20/22 research tasks and aggregate normalized MLGym scores.
2610.24454.boundary_en: Theory requires stated alignment/regret assumptions; comparisons often use proprietary Scientists, so isolate coordination and model effects.

2610.24464.title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
2610.24464.authors: Yangzhi Chen , Feiran Liu , Zishuo Wang , Zijian Jin , Xin Zhu , Lecheng Ruan , Wenjuan Han
2610.24464.abstract_en: Individually competent robot skills can fail when composed: tools may lack a required capability, completion signals may misrepresent physical progress, and one skill may leave a state that violates its successor's prerequisites. We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement. The stack integrates tools, skills with execution contracts, handoffs, and verifiers. Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components. Generality checks, mechanism tests, and paired selection and regression gates determine which changes become the next parent. The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair. Experiments cover LIBERO-Pro Long simulation and a physical Franka FR3 equipped with a Franka Hand. In simulation, Recursia improves success over ASPIRE by 5.8 percentage points under Pos perturbations and 15.1 points under Task perturbations. Across three physical compositional target tasks, it improves mean success over the Skill Document Only baseline by 40 percentage points. Analyses of constituent execution, candidate rejection, and inference drivers distinguish local mechanism improvements from complete task success and characterize the cost of feedback-conditioned orchestration. These results examine shared executable interfaces as a concrete mechanism for compositional transfer in robot programming.
2610.24464.affiliation: Beijing Jiaotong University / New York University / University of Southern California / PKU-HEC Joint Lab for Industrial Intelligence, Peking University / LingXing Tech
2610.24464.abstract_zh: 单项能力足够的机器人技能组合后仍可能失败：工具缺少所需能力，完成信号不反映物理进度，或前一技能留下不满足后一技能前提的状态。我们提出递归自我改进框架 Recursia，将共享可执行栈而非单项任务程序作为持久改进单位。该栈整合工具、带执行契约的技能、交接与验证器。源任务执行轨迹指导失败归因，生成缺失工具或修复现有共享组件。通用性检查、机制测试和配对选择及回归门控，决定哪些变化成为下一代父版本。所得栈冻结后通过声明式任务适配器复用，让源任务改进支持新组合，而无需目标任务代码修复。实验覆盖 LIBERO-Pro Long 仿真，以及配备 Franka Hand 的实体 Franka FR3。在仿真中，相对 ASPIRE，Pos 扰动下成功率提高 5.8 个百分点，Task 扰动下提高 15.1 个百分点。在三个实体组合目标任务中，相对 Skill Document Only 基线，平均成功率提高 40 个百分点。对组成技能执行、候选拒绝和推理驱动因素的分析，区分局部机制改善与完整任务成功，并刻画反馈条件化编排的成本。结果考察共享可执行接口作为机器人编程中组合迁移的具体机制。
2610.24464.update_target: Shared executable tools, contracted skills, handoffs and verifiers
2610.24464.mechanism_en: Source traces drive attribution and patches; generality/mechanism checks plus paired selection and regression gates admit the next parent, then freeze it for target reuse.
2610.24464.result_en: Reported gains are 5.8/15.1 points under simulation Pos/Task perturbations and 40 points across three physical target tasks.
2610.24464.boundary_en: Separate simulation, three physical tasks and constituent checks; target transfer uses frozen stacks without target-side code repair.

2610.24944.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
2610.24944.authors: Yue Huang , Zhangchen Xu , Xiaonan Luo , Zheyuan Liu , Lichi Li , Yiping Wang , Peiyang Song , Eric Gabriel Ramos , Enze Xie , Olexandr Isayev , Paul Liang , Nouha Dziri , Huan Sun , Jianfeng Gao , Ying Liu , Misha Sra , Xiangliang Zhang , Alex Pentland , Zichen Chen
2610.24944.abstract_en: We present Épi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. Épi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. Épi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, Épi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. We extend this research process to algorithmic coding with Épi-turbo, a lightweight configuration that develops executable solvers for tasks including vehicle routing, scheduling and production planning. On 30 FrontierOR tasks, Épi-turbo achieves a 5.4% higher total benchmark score than Codex at 64% of its model cost, using the same underlying model and reasoning effort. Épi is designed to support human understanding by connecting computational results to explicit methods and mathematical arguments that researchers can examine and build upon.
2610.24944.affiliation: Bake AI / University of Notre Dame / University of Washington / Stevens Institute of Technology / Scale AI / NVIDIA / Carnegie Mellon University / MIT / Cohere Labs / Ohio State University / Microsoft / UC Santa Barbara / Stanford University
2610.24944.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Épi，一个跨模型会话持续研究、通过累积经验进化方法的自主研究智能体。Épi 结合持久研究历史、层级记忆、分支和独立审查，维持研究连续性、从实验学习，并探索和重新访问替代方法。实验跨会话运行，由固定验证器评估输出。Épi 产生 120 项刷新纪录的结果，包括 12 个类别的 20 项数值界纪录，以及八个类别的 100 项构造纪录。其中，$n$ 皇后常数区间约缩窄 84 倍，四次 Feigenbaum 吸引子维数的严格区间缩窄超过 360 万倍。精确对偶证书证明，Cohn-Elkies 线性规划界在 10 和 11 维无法达到紧界。除数值改进外，Épi 给出计算机辅助证明：Tuza 猜想在团部分含八个顶点、至多三类三角形活跃邻域且重数任意的分裂图上成立。我们将该研究过程扩展到算法编程，提出轻量配置 Épi-turbo，为车辆路径、调度和生产规划等任务开发可执行求解器。在 30 项 FrontierOR 任务上，使用相同基础模型与推理强度时，Épi-turbo 总基准分数比 Codex 高 5.4%，模型成本为其 64%。Épi 将计算结果关联到研究者可以检验和发展的明确方法与数学论证，以支持人类理解。
2610.24944.update_target: Persistent research history, methods and executable solvers
2610.24944.mechanism_en: Hierarchical memory, branching and independent review retain experimental experience across sessions; a fixed verifier assesses outputs.
2610.24944.result_en: Authors report 120 records and explicit certificates; Epi-turbo scores 5.4% above Codex on 30 FrontierOR tasks at 64% model cost.
2610.24944.boundary_en: Record status and mathematical proofs are author reports here; numerical interval narrowing is not universal capability growth or independent replication.
2610.24944.resource_metadata_note: Results repository currently describes 106 constructions and 15 mathematical results, differing from the original abstract count. Preserve the original abstract; no reconciliation of artifact counting performed.

2610.25078.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
2610.25078.authors: Jiaqi Su , Guibin Zhang , Jie-Jing Shao , Cong Pang , Tiankuo Yao , Ivor Tsang , Haiyan Yin , Shuicheng Yan
2610.25078.abstract_en: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.
2610.25078.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) / SenseTime Group Inc.
2610.25078.abstract_zh: 模型与运行框架共同进化是递归自我改进（RSI）智能体的重要范式，联合进化执行支架和内在能力。我们研究其中持续存在却常被忽略的“脑—身体失配”：进化中的框架要求模型尚未学会的行为，或限制已有能力。我们提出 CoEvo-RSI，通过智能体驱动、双向历史继承推进模型—框架共同进化。元智能体依据共享进化档案和执行反馈，协调从历史设计开发框架、选择或合并模型检查点，以及在所选框架下进一步适配，使继承能力与变化的执行需求一致，减轻失配。仅使用自身拒绝采样轨迹上的监督微调（SFT），CoEvo-RSI 便使 Qwen3.5-9B 在多智能体失败归因、角色感知文本到 SQL、智能家居指令跟随等垂直应用中与更大模型竞争。在 TraceElephant 上比 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的智能体准确率高 14.16，在 HomeBench VM 上比 GLM-5.3 的成功率高 4.90，强调脑—身体对齐的重要性，以及双向历史继承推进共同进化的潜力。
2610.25078.update_target: Historical harness designs and model checkpoint selection/merging plus SFT
2610.25078.mechanism_en: A meta-agent uses an evolutionary archive and execution feedback to align inherited model capabilities with selected harness requirements.
2610.25078.result_en: Self-generated rejection-sampled SFT makes 9B competitive in vertical tasks, with reported +14.16 agent accuracy and +4.90 success rate versus named larger models.
2610.25078.boundary_en: Checkpoint selection, merging and actual training are different operations; cross-model task scores do not establish matched-compute superiority.

2610.26426.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
2610.26426.authors: Xiaoqiang Wang , Ting-En Lin , Yuchuan Wu , Pinyi Zhang , Caixin Kang , Ling Li , Bingxue Qiu , Jieping Ye , Yongbin Li , Bang Liu
2610.26426.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at this https URL .
2610.26426.affiliation: Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group / Université de Montréal / Mila - Quebec AI Institute
2610.26426.abstract_zh: 基于评分准则的强化学习用自然语言标准奖励开放式生成，但训练推进时奖励可能失效。我们识别两类失败：非区分性奖励因探索不足或难度与策略能力不匹配，坍缩为一致低分或高分；虚假奖励则表现为高分不对应更好回答。两者都反映出策略变化时，任务采样、探索和评估仍固定。我们提出 HarnessRL，通过任务采样、执行引导和评分标准三个接口，让训练时框架与策略共同进化。框架维护训练记忆，进化器从中检索同任务历史及跨任务证据，将奖励失败归因到可解决它的接口。随后运行提议者和即时评论者循环，评论者仅在测量候选更新对当前冻结策略的影响后接纳，拒绝候选则返回修订。我们还整理 Rubric-Mix-10k，覆盖医学、科学、写作、角色扮演及指令跟随五个领域的开放式强化学习训练与评估。在该套件上，HarnessRL 在 4B 和 9B 规模上比最强基线高 2.8—3.1 分，到达最佳检查点的训练步数接近减半。代码和数据见原文链接。
2610.26426.update_target: RL policy weights and training task/guidance/rubric interfaces
2610.26426.mechanism_en: Memory supports reward-failure attribution; an immediate critic measures candidate updates on the current frozen policy before accepting them.
2610.26426.result_en: On five-domain Rubric-Mix-10k, 4B/9B variants exceed strongest baselines by 2.8–3.1 points and nearly halve steps to the best checkpoint.
2610.26426.boundary_en: Fewer training steps are not automatically less total compute; include evolver/critic work and independently assess rubric quality.

2610.26554.title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
2610.26554.authors: Mai Liu , He Sun , Siru Zhong , Kerun Chen , Hao Yan , Xiaohui Lv , Shuai Tao , Wulong Liu
2610.26554.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.
2610.26554.affiliation: Beta Infinity / Peking University / Beihang University / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2610.26554.abstract_zh: 长时程具身智能体面临时间混淆、记录不完整或失真、固定记忆规则引起的重复错误，以及存储检索成本增长。我们提出 BetaMem，通过工作、空间、实体、情景、经验和程序六个相连层次，构建和进化可追踪长期记忆。双层写入契约约束操作可执行性和内容来源支持：监督微调学习合规记忆操作，强化学习结合重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证，奖励完整准确记录，惩罚遗漏、失真和无依据内容。我们通过沿记忆操作因果序列诊断，以及由独立回放门控的局部规则修复，建立失败驱动的策略递归自改进。原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘表述为存储与读取预算下的成本效用分配。使用开源 Qwen3.5-9B 生成记忆时，在 M3-Bench-robot、LoCoMo、OpenEQA EM-EQA 和 EgoLifeQA 上总体分数分别为 48.08%、92.08%、72.6% 和 62.4%，在各自协议下高于所列记忆方法。训练记忆生成模型将契约通过率从 50.9% 提高到 86.2%，每个存储动作输出词元减少 47.3%。另用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 EMem-Bench 评估，平均成功率为 38.4%，平均错误复发率为 24.9%。在使用相近规模开源模型的方法中，我们表现最佳。分类结果显示其优势在于跨观测整合信息、长历史事件回忆和个人习惯推断。
2610.26554.update_target: Memory-generation weights, six-layer memory and local operational rules
2610.26554.mechanism_en: SFT/RL enforce source-supported write contracts; causal operation diagnosis proposes local rule repairs gated by independent replay.
2610.26554.result_en: Contract pass rises 50.9%→86.2%, stored-action output tokens fall 47.3%; separate benchmarks and an EMem-Bench evaluation are reported.
2610.26554.boundary_en: Scores use different benchmark protocols and model backbones; do not merge memory-generation training gains with the separate recursive rule-repair result.

2610.26770.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
2610.26770.authors: Zhuoshi Pan , ZhiYuan Feng , Yukuo Cen , Honglin Lin , Junru Lu , Zhongxia Chen , Shuo Yang , H. Vicky Zhao , Jie Tang
2610.26770.abstract_en: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at this https URL
2610.26770.affiliation: Tsinghua University / Z.AI / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / University of Warwick / Kling AI
2610.26770.abstract_zh: 运行框架开发对构建强大人工智能智能体至关重要。近期方法通过递归自我改进（RSI）优化框架，但性能收益往往伴随执行成本增加。我们提出无标签框架进化方法 HarnessPro，在提高任务表现的同时降低成本。候选框架用大语言模型生成的测试评估，不访问真实答案或官方测试。专门智能体诊断执行轨迹、按不同性能—成本优先级规划更新，并实现候选框架。HarnessPro 不只返回单个框架，而使用归一化加权平方距离选择，提供成本优先 lite、平衡 medium 和性能优先 heavy 三类框架。选中框架进入下一轮，由执行反馈指导进一步更新。实验覆盖 Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro 和 ProgramBench，使用配合 Codex 的 GPT-5.5 以及配合 Claude Code 的 GLM-5.2。在上述基准上，使用 GPT-5.5 与 Codex 时，heavy 模式相对 RHO 平均通过率提高 2.0 个百分点，平均单任务成本降低 26.1%；使用 GLM-5.2 与 Claude Code 时优势也成立。代码见原文链接。
2610.26770.update_target: External harness variants along a performance/cost frontier
2610.26770.mechanism_en: Generated tests score candidate patches; specialized agents diagnose/plan/implement and weighted-distance selection chooses lite/medium/heavy parents for later rounds.
2610.26770.result_en: GPT-5.5/Codex heavy mode averages +2.0 pass-rate points and 26.1% lower per-task cost versus RHO across three coding benchmarks.
2610.26770.boundary_en: Label-free search still relies on generated tests; measured benchmark success and search-test acceptance differ, and all search costs matter.

2610.23886.title: EvoAD: Self-Evolving Autonomous Driving via Latent World-Model Guided Post-hoc Reflection
2610.23886.authors: Junjie Yang , Qiming Zhang , Yuyan Li , Shuqi Shen , Yusong Huang , Yanggang Sheng , Wenpeng Xu , Ziyi Shi , Tianshun Li , Yijie Chen , Yujia Wang , Jun Ma , Xinhu Zheng , Hongliang Lu , Hai Yang
2610.23886.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have achieved rapid progress by learning unified policies that map sensor observations directly to driving trajectories. However, once deployed, these systems typically remain frozen: they may repeat similar decisions in similar scenes, and failures can only be addressed through costly data collection and retraining. This sharply contrasts with human drivers, who improve lifelong through experience, memory, and reflection. In this work, we ask whether autonomous driving systems can achieve similar post-deployment self-evolution to human drivers. We propose EvoAD, a self-evolving autonomous driving framework via latent world-model guided post-hoc reflection. EvoAD stores driving experiences in a bird's-eye-view feature memory pool, retrieves scene-relevant precedents according to geometric and semantic similarity, and uses a latent world model to evaluate the future consequences of candidate trajectories in a compact planning-oriented space. Instead of treating memory as external textual contexts or using world models only for pre-action simulation, EvoAD transforms executed driving outcomes into reusable improvement signals for future decisions. This enables the system to diagnose how prior trajectories could have been improved and to refine behavior in similar future scenarios without retraining the base driving policy. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 show consistent improvements across reflection rounds and state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the potential of world models as reflective mechanisms for post-deployment self-evolution in autonomous driving.
2610.23886.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Victoria University of Wellington / Southern University of Science and Technology
2610.23886.abstract_zh: 端到端自动驾驶通过学习从传感器观测直接映射到驾驶轨迹的统一策略取得快速进步，但部署后通常冻结：相似场景可能重复相似决策，失败只能通过昂贵的数据采集和重训练处理。这与人类通过经验、记忆和反思终身改进形成对比。我们研究自动驾驶能否实现类似人类的部署后自进化，提出潜在世界模型引导事后反思的 EvoAD。它将驾驶经验存入鸟瞰图特征记忆池，按几何和语义相似度检索场景相关先例，在紧凑、面向规划的空间中用潜在世界模型评估候选轨迹的未来后果。与将记忆当作外部文字上下文或仅在动作前模拟不同，EvoAD 将已执行驾驶结果转为未来决策可复用的改进信号，使系统诊断先前轨迹如何能更好，并在不重训练基础驾驶策略的情况下改进相似未来场景。在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 上，各反思轮次持续改进并达到最先进性能，展示世界模型作为部署后自进化反思机制的潜力。
2610.23886.update_target: Driving-experience memory and reflected trajectory decisions
2610.23886.mechanism_en: Geometric/semantic retrieval supplies precedents; latent-world-model consequence evaluation turns executed outcomes into guidance for later similar scenes.
2610.23886.result_en: NAVSIM v1/v2 show improvement across reflection rounds and claimed leading performance.
2610.23886.boundary_en: The base driving policy is not retrained; NAVSIM benchmark evidence does not establish safe deployment on public roads.

2610.24177.title: Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models
2610.24177.authors: Hyunwoo Ryu , Eric Ming Chen , Max Wilcoxson , Vincent Sitzmann
2610.24177.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.24177.abstract_en: Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or "inverse dynamics" model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.
2610.24177.affiliation: Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
2610.24177.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型可充当具身智能体的可扩展视觉规划器，生成完成未见任务的视频，但执行通常需要在大量人工采集视频—动作数据上训练视频到动作或逆动力学模型，严重限制可扩展性。我们提出 Mirror，通过环境交互自监督学习视频—动作映射，无需先验动作数据或手工奖励。Mirror 用当前对潜在动作的最佳猜测执行，尝试跟随视觉计划，再在所得视频—动作对上训练，逐步自我改进并更好地跟随规划器。在 Atari、OGBench 和 DeepMind Control 上，使用学习视频计划时优于领先的观测学习方法，使用预言机计划时达到接近专家表现。在 Minecraft BASALT 上，优于可访问专家动作或人工任务知识的方法。在 Minecraft 生存模式中，成为首个仅通过自我改进、无需奖励或专家动作标签获得铁镐的方法。在有专家动作标签但无环境交互的离线设置中，获取钻石达到新最优。结果表明，视频模型进展可转化为更强智能体，而不必相应增加手工奖励或大量专家动作数据。
2610.24177.mechanism_en: The agent follows a visual plan with current actions and trains on its resulting video/action pairs to improve subsequent execution.
2610.24177.result_en: Mirror reports gains across games/control; Minecraft survival iron-pickaxe acquisition uses no reward or expert action labels.
2610.24177.boundary_en: The offline diamond result does use expert action labels; learned and oracle visual plans provide different supervision conditions.

2610.24453.title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
2610.24453.authors: Yutong Song , Jiang Wu , Yuxuan Ren , Tony Qin , Baoyuan Wang
2610.24453.abstract_en: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline.
