2610.31125.abstract_zh: 此前分析发现，原生哈希 N-gram 表适合低干扰持续更新，但需反传并改变预训练表。Delta N-gram 提供仅前向写入，预训练 T⁰ 不变，只在证据指向行写稀疏补丁 Δ。4.1M 参数写入器为每个位置、哈希头事件输出目标及门控，分块平均 delta 规则使每行是旧值和门控目标的凸组合。写入器离线按预训练目标学原始文本，使用时仅前向，清空 Δ 恢复原模型。0.6B 问答原型第二次写后保留 16/16 事实，在线梯度写仅 2—4/16。普通写入器用 T⁰ 模型编码，delta 写入器边读当前记忆边编码。Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上，64 留出新闻中普通记忆相对空记忆降低延续 NLL 0.068 nats/词元，相对他文记忆降 0.024；插入十六文后降 0.063、0.013。delta 记忆更文档特定，干扰后保留 70% 对 54%。此前七任务链 35,000 次写入中均稳定，delta 漂移更少，第二层数学漂移 176% 对 188%；后续准确率变 -0.26/-0.52 个百分点，梯度更新 -7.29，small-k_i 漂移 17.9/17.5%，梯度 39.2%。获得新知识为负，通用输入漂移达到 32.8%（20.75%），所有样例读取的格式行长至原范数 4—12 倍。清零八行消除超 98% 数学第二层漂移，同时消除 NLL 收益。
2610.31125.update_target: Sparse reversible test-time memory delta; frozen base model
2610.31125.mechanism_en: DeltaNgram uses a separately trained 4.1M-parameter writer to make forward-only sparse writes, while the base model stays fixed. Clearing selected rows tests whether benefit and drift share a mechanism.
2610.31125.result_en: Sixteen-fact tests show strong retention but negative acquisition. General drift is 32.8% in the reported setting; resetting eight rows removes 98% of drift and also the NLL benefit.
2610.31125.boundary_en: This is a diagnostic prototype, not a solution to continual learning. Offline writer training, format-row norm growth and the acquisition failure must remain visible alongside retention.

2610.31427.title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
2610.31427.authors: Tao Lin , Yuxin Du , Haoxiao Wang , Zile Zhong , Bo Zhao
2610.31427.abstract_en: Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a {\pi}0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy ({\pi}0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.
2610.31427.abstract_zh: 机器人智能体结合语言推理和策略监督、恢复，但每动作块审查开销大。FastHarness 用经验自适应调度 GPT-6 Astra 对 π0.5 的监督：快速路径用阶段记忆和已审结果减少熟悉情况审查，恢复路径聚焦纠错，验证后恢复常规执行，保留失败经验指导未来。策略冻结，按当前观测生成新动作。四个仿真操作任务中，最终五回合平均审查词元相对首次评估平均少 57.2%，回合时间从 85.5 降至 52.0 分钟；相同任务成功率从 GPT-as-Policy 的 80% 升至 97.19%。无需额外模型训练，自适应监督可提高效率。
2610.31427.update_target: External review/recovery harness and stage experience memory
2610.31427.mechanism_en: FastHarness surrounds a frozen π0.5 backbone with stage-aware review memory, adaptive GPT review and verified recovery reuse.
2610.31427.result_en: Across four simulated tasks, reported review tokens fall 57.2%, time falls from 85.5 to 52 minutes, and success increases from 80% to 97.19%.
2610.31427.boundary_en: These are simulation results, not physical robot evidence. Compare early/late experience, review budgets and matched task protocols before attributing gains to faster accumulated experience.
2610.31427.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Zhejiang University

2610.28763.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
2610.28763.authors: Ming Zhong , Stacy Li , Nicholas Carlini , Matthew Jagielski
2610.28763.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.28763.abstract_en: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub ( this https URL ) and Hugging Face ( this https URL ).
2610.28763.abstract_zh: 前沿编码智能体被视为端到端研究者，科学机器学习需要超越常规工程的领域洞见，是严格检验。Agent4Sci 测二十基准、十一领域中，智能体能将已发表最佳模型改善多远，重在真实条件的进展类型和不足，而非排行榜。全部基准的已发表最优均被推进，Claude Opus 平均相对提高 10.4%，无运行被标学术不端，但收益几乎全来自工程技巧而非研究洞见。轨迹显示创新误校准、资源利用不足、快速陷局部调参三限制。研究构思、实验管理和定时检查轻量技能，将 Opus 从 10.4% 提至 20.1%，Codex 从 4.4% 提至 8.1%，干预更丰富、更领域相关。试验床帮助推动从工程到洞见，代码数据见 GitHub、Hugging Face 原文链接。
2610.28763.mechanism_en: Agent4Sci evaluates scientific hill climbing across twenty benchmarks in eleven domains, measuring whether agents advance published best results and whether supplied skills improve search.
2610.28763.result_en: Reported relative gains rise from 10.4% to 20.1% for Opus with skills and from 4.4% to 8.1% for Codex.
2610.28763.boundary_en: Better benchmark engineering is not automatically scientific novelty. Lack of flagged misconduct does not certify novelty, and task/environment budgets matter for comparing agents.

2610.28798.title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
2610.28798.authors: Kehui Yao , Chuanbo Hu , Jiao Chen , Ramin Giahi , Reza Yousefi Maragheh , Lalitesh Morishetti , Ziwei Hong , Yiyun Su , Jianpeng Xu , Evren Korpeoglu , Kannan Achan
2610.28798.abstract_en: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported 0.0033. On both real tasks the contract narrows the validation-test gap, and test performance is slightly higher rather than lower. The largest difference is in when the agents stop. Exact feedback used its entire budget of thirty submissions on two of the three tasks, including the one where nothing can be learned, while the contract halted after four to twelve. A run that exhausts its budget is usually read as diligence. It is better read as a symptom: when the feedback channel is unbounded, noise keeps supplying improvements to chase.
2610.28798.abstract_zh: 迭代机器学习智能体改代码、运行实验、读验证分数再决定下一步，精确反馈使验证集暴露于自适应选择。我们提出明确反馈契约，规定可见内容、何时停止和何时访问测试集；只有提交超过按配对标准误算的噪声阈值才释放验证分，无需调边际。在点击预测、排序及无信号控制任务实验。零真实收益的控制中，精确分智能体报告收益 0.0157，契约为 0.0033。真实任务验证—测试差距缩小，测试略高。停止差异最大：精确反馈在三任务中的两个用完三十提交，包括无信号任务；契约四至十二次停止。预算耗尽常被视为勤奋，但无界反馈让噪声不断供应可追逐“改进”，更像症状。
2610.28798.update_target: Evaluator feedback-release policy and stopping behavior
2610.28798.mechanism_en: The feedback contract releases a new score only when paired standard-error evidence clears a noise threshold. Restricting score access changes what an adaptive agent can chase and when it stops.
2610.28798.result_en: On a zero-signal control, reported gain falls from 0.0157 under exact scores to 0.0033; the contract stops after four to twelve submissions instead of exhausting thirty.
2610.28798.boundary_en: Reduced adaptive noise chasing is not a universal statistical guarantee. Repeated use of the same paired validation set and the held-out test boundary still require audit.
2610.28798.affiliation: Walmart Global Tech / Lehigh University / Rutgers University

2610.29357.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
2610.29357.authors: Dongfang Li , Zhuoen Chen , Bonian Jia , Zixuan Liu , Zhengxuan Lu , Can Deng , Yukun Shi , Yuhang Meng , Xin Zhang , Jiahe Huang , Fuhao Li , Junmai Wang , Shunyao Wen , Jingjun Sun , Jiaxu Tian , Jiangling Zhang , Zihan Wang , Liangyou Li , Yitong Yao , Shuangyong Song , Beilun Wang , Pengxu Wei , Hanlin Xu , Chang Liu , Yongxiang Li , Baotian Hu , Xiangyang Ji , Min Zhang
2610.29357.abstract_en: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.
2610.29357.abstract_zh: 基础模型智能体可推理规划用工具，但冻结权重及上下文限制长期经验学习。外部记忆多是按回忆事实能力评估的被动缓存，能否真正持续学习未明。本文提出以记忆为中心的持续学习（Memory-Centric Continual Learning，MCCL），认为应按改善未来动作评记忆，含三部分：以存储基底、资产形式、管理策略三轴分类，定义内循环更新状态、外循环按任务反馈细化策略；评估干扰保持、变化适配和任务迁移，以区分真实行为收益与单纯扩上下文；记忆缩放框架刻画经验、容量、计算对参数和非参数记忆表现的影响。框架把记忆从查询重述为持续学习，为自改进提供原则路径。
2610.29357.update_target: Conceptual memory substrates, assets and management policies
2610.29357.mechanism_en: MCCL defines an inner memory-state loop and an outer policy-refinement loop, with evaluation of interference, adaptation and transfer plus an experience/storage/compute scaling framework.
2610.29357.result_en: The contribution is a taxonomy, evaluation protocol and conceptual scaling framework, rather than a newly validated end-to-end algorithm with a headline benchmark gain.
2610.29357.boundary_en: Future behavior should determine memory value. A proposed outer learning loop is not evidence that an implemented system already improves its own learning procedure.
2610.29357.affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen) / Shenzhen Loop Area Institute / Tsinghua University / Southeast University / Xingchen AGI Lab, China Telecom / Huawei Technologies

2610.29379.title: Where AI Vulnerability Discovery Harnesses Go Quiet: Structural False Negatives and Hidden Vulnerabilities
2610.29379.abstract_en: LLM-based vulnerability discovery harnesses can miss real, reachable vulnerabilities because of how the harness around the model is built. Steps that select code, filter it, and store and merge findings can drop a vulnerability before or after the model runs, independently of the model's capability, and the report usually gives no sign that this happened. These drops come from engineering choices, and errors. They leave vulnerabilities undetected, and an attacker who knows the harness's rules can also use them to hide a vulnerability on purpose. Understanding these drops shows how to build harnesses that fix or disclose them and are harder to evade. Starting from the two harnesses we maintain, Knostic's OpenAnt and raptor, and then examining 10 additional open-source harnesses, we mapped 13 points where such drops occur and organized them into a taxonomy. Using each harness's own code, we show a single file that six harnesses dropped before their model saw its code, five of them without notice. We propose engineering failure patterns mapped to these drops, and relate them to Ptacek and Newsham's work on intrusion detection evasion. The paper also covers content-steered verdicts and prompt injection, and gives design principles and tests for harnesses that report accurately what they analyzed. The reliability findings likely apply to other LLM harnesses, beyond vulnerability research and application security, and the evasion findings apply wherever an attacker can write or influence the code being checked. We also argue that harnesses built to be descriptive can, in effect, be prescriptive. Rules written to describe typical code and typical model replies end up deciding what is analyzed, and anything that does not conform is treated as absent or as "no vulnerability."
2610.29379.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的漏洞发现框架可在模型前后因代码选择、过滤、结果存储合并而丢失可达真漏洞，与模型能力无关，报告常不提示。工程选择和错误导致漏检，知道规则的攻击者也可故意利用。我们从维护的 Knostic OpenAnt、raptor 及十个额外开源框架，定位十三个丢失点、归类。用自身代码展示一个文件被六框架在模型看到前丢弃，其中五个无提示。提出对应工程失败模式，关联经典入侵检测规避研究，并讨论内容驱动判定、提示注入，给准确披露分析范围的设计原则与测试。可靠性问题可能不限安全研究，规避则适于攻击者可影响被检代码的情境。描述典型代码与回复的规则可实质成为规定，非匹配内容被当不存在或“无漏洞”。
2610.29379.update_target: Harness coverage accounting and structural failure detection
2610.29379.mechanism_en: The audit traces selection, filtering and finding-merge stages across two maintained and ten additional vulnerability-discovery harnesses, mapping thirteen places where evidence can disappear.
2610.29379.result_en: One source file is dropped by six harnesses before model inspection, five without notice.
2610.29379.boundary_en: The results concern engineering false negatives, not only model capability. Generalization beyond the audited harness versions is an inference; no evasion or exploit procedures are reproduced here.

2610.29677.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
2610.29677.authors: Meng Luo , Zechen Bai , Shanqing Xu , Yanlin Li , Kaixin Li , Mengchen Qian , Weifeng Lu , Ran Zhang , Yingtian Zou , Ziyang Luo , Wei Chen , Hongzhan Lin
2610.29677.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.
2610.29677.abstract_zh: 递归自改进不仅改善行为，也改善改进过程。数字智能体通过改源码、可执行测试研究此机制，物理世界则需从局部观测、昂贵试验学习，面对条件变化及潜在不可逆后果。我们定位 RSI 与机器人学习关系，梳理从能力改善到产生能力的过程改善，考察物理经验何时强化机制、收益何时进一步支持机制自身改进。收益传递要求反馈针对剩余学习需求、接收组件能利用变化、价值跨任务硬件变化保留，且实践安全可负担。现有工作集中操作，支持行为改善、后续学习收益和程序改善；部分改变改进者知识或工具，但所综述物理研究尚未隔离可归因于递归的收益。我们综合为评估原则与方向，指向逐次试验安全改善改进方式的机器。
2610.29677.mechanism_en: The survey separates behavioral gains, improvements to later learning and changes to the improvement procedure, asking whether gains survive task/hardware shifts and remain affordable and safe.
2610.29677.result_en: Reviewed physical studies support several forms of improvement but have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion.
2610.29677.boundary_en: This is a survey of existing studies, not a new physical experiment or proof that physical RSI is impossible. Finite digital harness evidence cannot substitute for physical validation.
2610.29677.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Nanyang Technological University / Hong Kong Baptist University

2610.29823.title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
2610.29823.abstract_en: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.
2610.29823.abstract_zh: Mem0、Zep 等在问题出现前决定保留内容，编码智能体则保留原始历史、自己用工具搜索。模型强到可自搜时，设计记忆是否仍有用？在一段 LoCoMo 对话（419 轮、152 问）上，四记忆方法（全上下文、BM25、Mem0、Zep）和三编码智能体（Pi、Codex、Claude Code），各配 GPT-4o-mini、GPT-6 Luna、Opus 5.5，记录每运行成本。仅一段对话、每格一次，是小研究。Mem0 只在弱 GPT-4o-mini 优于全上下文，建库本身却更贵；弱写入遗漏的信息强读取者也恢复不了。Opus 5.5 下 Pi 以不到一半全上下文成本得 99%，唯一错因答案键错误。但领先部分来自仅智能体能读的照片说明，在 88 个无照片证据问题中，Pi 与全上下文仅差一题。
2610.29823.update_target: Memory-system evaluation and raw-history access controls
2610.29823.mechanism_en: MemoryTax compares four memory methods and three coding agents across three models while recording rollout cost; it checks photo-free questions to examine unequal evidence access.
2610.29823.result_en: On one 419-turn LoCoMo conversation with 152 questions and one run per cell, Pi with Opus scores 99% at less than half full-context cost; on 88 photo-free questions Pi and full context differ by one answer.
2610.29823.boundary_en: One conversation and one run per cell cannot support a general memory-system ranking. Only agents could read photo captions, so the headline result includes an evidence-access confound.

2610.30405.title: VisCurate: Evaluating Behavioral Equivalence of Visual Skills
2610.30405.authors: Md Farhan Ishraq , Md Farhan Ishmam , Reaz Hassan Joarder , Md Hasanul Kabir
2610.30405.abstract_en: Modern vision-based agents have shifted toward skill-based problem-solving, where a skill is an executable image-to-image operation, e.g., cropping, thresholding, or edge detection. As these skill libraries grow, they accumulate duplicated, mislabeled, and defective skills. The signals normally used to curate them (a skill's name, description, or source code) say little about how the skill visually changes the image. We present VisCurate, a framework and benchmark that curates visual skill libraries from observed execution rather than from text. VisCurate runs each candidate skill pair on a shared probe battery and assigns one of six behavioral relations, each tied to a library edit that is safe to make. The benchmark injects seven defect types into a clean library at controlled rates, producing 300 reproducible instances with ground-truth relations and repairs. While text baselines accept up to five of six false merges on hard negatives, our verifier accepts none and recovers 51.2% of the pairs that are truly mergeable. On two real, uncurated libraries, VisCurate finds that 92% of the skills a package shares with its downstream copy are redundant, while execution confirms only 10 of 17 published equivalence claims. The curation problem also remains open, as the strongest of the nine automated curators recovers only about half of the repairs. We emphasize that visual skill libraries should be curated by behavior, not by description.
2610.30405.abstract_zh: 视觉智能体技能是裁剪、阈值、边缘检测等可执行图像操作，库增长会有重复、误标、缺陷，名字描述源码未必反映视觉行为。VisCurate 从共同探测集执行而非文本整理，给每技能对六种行为关系，分别关联安全库编辑。基准在干净库注入七缺陷，生成 300 可复现实例及真实关系修复。文字基线在困难负例可错误合并六对中的五对，验证器零误合并，恢复 51.2% 真可合并对。两真实未整理库中，下游共享技能 92% 冗余，执行仅确认 17 项发表等价断言中的十项。九自动整理器最强仍只恢复约一半修复，问题未解，应按行为而非描述整理。
2610.30405.update_target: Visual skill-library equivalence and repair decisions
2610.30405.mechanism_en: VisCurate executes skill pairs on shared probes, predicts six behavioral relations and ties each relation to a library edit; seven injected defect types create 300 controlled instances.
2610.30405.result_en: The verifier accepts no false merges on the tested hard negatives and recovers 51.2% of truly mergeable pairs; only 10 of 17 published equivalence claims survive execution checks.
2610.30405.boundary_en: Probe agreement is not universal semantic equivalence. The strongest of nine curators recovers only about half of repairs, so safe curation remains incomplete.
2610.30405.affiliation: Islamic University of Technology / University of Utah

2610.30478.title: Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live
2610.30478.abstract_en: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.
2610.30478.abstract_zh: 具身经验应入权重还是外部检索？记忆教师从自身尝试检索带图像教训，在视觉到达任务产生轨迹；同轨迹蒸馏 LoRA 学生，匹配协议并测试给固定学生重新挂教师冻结检索库。训练及任何 p 值前预注册假说、实验臂、测试分析。入权重比仅动作控制高一个百分点、不显著，注册检验对其最小效应功效不足，因此撤回而非否定权重记忆断言。固定权重加检索高 34 个百分点（z=5.15），达教师汇总参照 49.3%；注册协议对比高 23 点（z=3.36），自动重置敏感计数高 36、29 点。带预注册分臂预测的探索行为探测，符合蒸馏转移边际修正却未转移情境条件修正。后续事前注册控制中，同库使无适配基础模型达 48%（敏感 48%），另三适配器从 19%—26% 到 53%—55%（敏感 17%—21% 到 50%—55%），挂库后适配器无可检测增益。第二更难任务方向一致但不显著，高六点，95% 区间 -4.5 至 16.4，探索诊断关联记忆覆盖。
2610.30478.update_target: External episode-image memory versus LoRA student weights
2610.30478.mechanism_en: A preregistered study distills matched teacher trajectories and then reattaches a frozen retrieval buffer to fixed student weights, separating parametric transfer from inference-time memory.
2610.30478.result_en: Weight distillation gains +1 percentage point, not significant and underpowered, so that claim is withdrawn. Retrieval adds +34 points and reaches the 49.3% pooled teacher reference; a second task gains +6 points with CI [−4.5, 16.4].
2610.30478.boundary_en: An underpowered result withdraws rather than refutes the memory-in-weights claim. Protocol and auto-reset sensitivity contrasts differ; this computational reach-task evidence does not establish physical deployment.

2610.30499.title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
2610.30499.abstract_en: A generally intelligent system acquires new skills efficiently without requiring humans to redesign its software scaffold for every new task. Yet language models rarely act alone. A harness is a symbolic program that orchestrates calls to the model, handling perception, memory, tool use, recovery, and inference allocation on the model's behalf. ARC-AGI-3 is an interactive benchmark in which agents must explore unfamiliar environments, figure out their goals on the fly, and keep learning as they go. On it, human-steered systems already report ceiling scores across the public games, so we know effective designs exist. We ask whether frontier models can build and improve such a harness on their own. Through a fixed coding bootstrap, each model constructs a complete task harness, acts through that harness on five development games, and revises the entire codebase twice. Every version is evaluated on twenty games that never influence adaptation. We measure task performance with Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), which combines level completion with action efficiency relative to human baselines, and record dollar-denominated inference cost as a practical resource measure. Across 27 lineages, harness performance ranges from zero to near-ceiling scores. Two revisions raise mean held-out RHAE by only 2.80 points (95% interval [-1.44,7.35]). Development gains overstate held-out improvement, and reductions in inference cost can come at the expense of task performance. Human-steered systems demonstrate further headroom. These findings reveal a gap between autonomous harness construction and reliable adaptation under this two-revision protocol: even strong task performance does not ensure that subsequent revisions generalize or preserve existing capabilities.
2610.30499.abstract_zh: 通用智能应高效获得技能而非每任务由人重写支架，但模型往往依赖符号框架管理感知记忆、工具、恢复及计算。ARC-AGI-3 要在陌生交互环境自发现目标、持续学习，人工引导公开游戏已有满分，说明有好设计。我们测试前沿模型能否自主构建改善框架：固定编程启动后，每模型建完整框架，在五开发游戏执行，整体代码修订两次；每版在不影响适配的二十游戏评估，以相对人类动作效率 RHAE 综合完成和效率，记录美元成本。27 谱系从零到近满分，两修订留出平均仅升 2.80 分，95% 区间 -1.44 至 7.35。开发收益高估留出，省推理钱可能损表现，人工系统仍有空间。该两次修订协议下，自主构建与可靠适配有差距，强任务表现不保证修改泛化或保留能力。
2610.30499.update_target: Autonomously constructed and revised ARC-AGI-3 harnesses
2610.30499.mechanism_en: Twenty-seven lineages bootstrap a full harness, revise it twice using five development games and evaluate each version on twenty games that never influence adaptation.
2610.30499.result_en: Mean held-out RHAE rises 2.80 points with 95% interval [−1.44, 7.35]; development gains overstate held-out improvement and lower inference cost can reduce performance.
2610.30499.boundary_en: The study tests a two-revision protocol, not all possible RSI. Strong initial task performance and available human-designed headroom do not establish reliable autonomous adaptation.
2610.30499.affiliation: Amazon / Technische Universität Dresden / Universität Hannover / TIB – Leibniz Information Centre for Science and Technology and University Library

2610.30755.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
2610.30755.authors: Zhengye Bao , Shengtao Zhang , Haokai Zhang , Shiqi Lou , Muning Wen , Minnan Luo
2610.30755.abstract_en: LLM memory is widely used in long-term conversation understanding. Agentic memory systems often use mutation, structural organization, learned retrieval strategies, or other complex operations. Is this complexity always necessary? We study Raw-RAG, a naive RAG baseline using dense retrieval and reranking over raw history to supply evidence to a reader LLM. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench, Raw-RAG ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark-model settings, outperforming the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13-5.53 points. We investigate why raw-history retrieval remains competitive. Evidence analysis shows that its higher coverage of necessary evidence can offset lower utilization. Useful evidence includes both answer values and the relations and dependency paths needed to derive them. Even complete access to transformed memory stores leaves an accuracy gap relative to raw evidence, highlighting the importance of preserving raw information. These findings challenge the necessity of complex agentic memory for the evaluated conversation tasks and establish naive RAG as an essential baseline.
2610.30755.abstract_zh: 语言模型记忆广泛用于长期对话理解。智能体记忆系统常使用变异、结构化组织、学习得到的检索策略或其他复杂操作。这种复杂性是否总是必要？我们研究 Raw-RAG：一个朴素 RAG 基线，通过对原始历史进行稠密检索与重排，向读取语言模型提供证据。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、MEME、MemoryAgentBench 七个模型—基准设置中六个排名第一，比最强被比较智能体记忆高 0.13—5.53 分。证据分析显示更高必要证据覆盖可弥补利用较低；有效内容包括答案值及推导关系、依赖路径。即使完整访问转换后记忆库，与原始证据仍有差距，强调保留原信息。结果挑战所评估对话任务中复杂记忆必要性，确立朴素 RAG 为必要基线。
2610.30755.update_target: Memory evaluation baselines and preservation of raw evidence
2610.30755.mechanism_en: Raw-RAG retrieves and reranks raw history for a reader, comparing evidence coverage, utilization and dependency preservation against transformed agentic memory stores.
2610.30755.result_en: Across four conversation benchmarks, Raw-RAG ranks first in six of seven benchmark/model settings, beating the strongest compared agentic memory by 0.13–5.53 points.
2610.30755.boundary_en: These conversation-task results motivate a baseline, not a claim that every memory mechanism is unnecessary. Match reader, information access and total indexing/retrieval cost.
2610.30755.affiliation: Xi’an Jiaotong University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Zhejiang University / The Chinese University of Hong Kong

2610.30867.title: Separate Field Scoring Protects Unused Tools When Agents Pool Tool-Use Experience
2610.30867.abstract_en: Agents that call tools from a shared catalog can pool what they learn about which tool serves which request. We measure what pooled usage examples do to tool retrieval, reporting separately the held-out tools, for which no agent has usage, and all other tools. Adding usage examples to the index as extra entries for used tools raises Hit@5 (whether a gold tool is in the top five) for those tools and lowers it for held-out tools, by a large margin on two of three catalogs and with both embedders we tested. Giving used tools the same number of equally long entries filled with other tools' text lowers held-out Hit@5 about as much, but gives little or none of the gain. We call our method of scoring usage as its own field SYNAPSE. On StableToolBench, the held-out gold tool appears in its top five more often than with a router that reserves slots for usage (0.785 against 0.683), and this held-out lead holds on all three catalogs with both embedders. This protection persisted when we replaced each tool's usage with other tools' text, and a constant score offset for tools with usage gives similar held-out Hit@5 in most settings. The gain for tools with usage, in contrast, needs usage about the right tool. The router keeps more of the gain on labeled queries on TOUCAN with both embedders and on ToolRet with one, so the better choice depends on the workload. Splitting the usage among ten simulated agents shows that pooling helps exactly as much as giving one agent the same records.
2610.30867.abstract_zh: 共享工具目录的智能体可汇集使用经验。我们分别测无任何使用的留出工具及其余工具：把已用工具例子作为额外索引项，提升其 Hit@5，却在三目录中两个、两嵌入器下明显损留出工具。用其他工具文字填等数量、等长度条目，留出下降相近，却几乎无已用收益。SYNAPSE 将使用记录作独立字段评分，StableToolBench 留出 Hit@5 为 0.785，保留使用槽路由为 0.683，此领先跨三目录两嵌入器成立。错工具文字替换也保留保护，多数设置对有经验工具加常量偏移可达相近留出效果；已用收益却需正确工具经验。路由器在 TOUCAN 两嵌入器、ToolRet 一个上保留更多有标签查询收益，选择依工作负载。分给十模拟智能体后，池化与单智能体同记录收益相同。
2610.30867.update_target: Tool-retrieval usage fields and pooled experience
2610.30867.mechanism_en: SYNAPSE scores usage separately from catalog descriptions. Wrong-tool-text and constant-offset controls distinguish index crowding from genuine tool-specific information, including tools with no prior usage.
2610.30867.result_en: StableToolBench held-out Hit@5 is 0.785 versus 0.683 for a slot-reserving router. Ten simulated agents gain exactly as much from pooling as one agent given the same records.
2610.30867.boundary_en: Used-tool benefits require correct usage content, while unused-tool protection partly follows score allocation. Pooling records is not proof of emergent multi-agent collaboration.

2610.31130.title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
2610.31130.abstract_en: Offline tests can fail to reveal whether an agent update will remain safe after deployment. We operationalize this post-audit mirage using matched safe and harmful lifecycles that expose identical verifier-visible evidence while an isolated scorer records opposite deployment truth. Our theorem applies standard observational-equivalence and indistinguishability ideas to this executable audit boundary and states the resulting error-abstention tradeoff. The Post-Audit Mirage benchmark makes that boundary executable across authorization, scheduling, and shared-capacity environments. IdentifiedRangeMonitor uses fresh group-labelled harm outcomes to return deploy, hold, cannot determine, or unsupported. Experiments show that monitoring can recover the missing distinction in favorable settings but may remain undecided for rare groups, small effects, or missing observations. Verifier-agent evaluation must therefore test both calculation validity and whether the available evidence supports the deployment decision.
2610.31130.abstract_zh: 离线测试未必揭示更新部署后是否安全。Post-Audit Mirage 用安全、有害生命周期配对，验证器可见证据相同，隔离评分器记录相反部署真相。定理将标准观测等价及不可区分思想用于可执行审计边界，给错误—弃权权衡。基准覆盖授权、调度、共享容量。IdentifiedRangeMonitor 用新鲜、群组标注的伤害结果返回部署、搁置、无法判断或不支持。实验显示有利设置可恢复缺失区别，但稀有群、小效应或缺观测仍可能未决。评估应同时测试计算有效与证据能否支持部署决定。
2610.31130.update_target: Offline update-verification evidence and post-deployment monitoring
2610.31130.mechanism_en: Matched safe and harmful lifecycles expose identical offline evidence but opposite deployment truth. A conditional indistinguishability theorem motivates monitoring fresh group-labelled outcomes with an abstention option.
2610.31130.result_en: Experiments recover the missing distinction in favorable settings but remain undecided with rare groups, small effects or missing observations.
2610.31130.boundary_en: The theorem is conditional on the verifier-visible evidence boundary; it does not forbid every offline guarantee. Valid calculations alone do not establish decision identifiability.

2610.31303.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
2610.31303.authors: Zehao Lin , Erenkai Zhu , Helan Hu , Xixuan Hao , Chunyu Li , Kai Chen
2610.31303.abstract_en: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.
2610.31303.abstract_zh: 记忆把过去有用区别带到未来决策，价值取决于什么保留、有限智能体能否使用、需求变化时能恢复修订什么。我们提出决策论框架，从原始历史、持久状态、操作使用到有成本恢复修订追踪价值，以避免的任务损失计原始及保留价值，风险—成本前沿表示跨用途可达恢复保留。未知需求产生价值谱，交互反馈改变未来任务分布。成本感知模拟条件及五最小反例揭示信息时间、检索访问、组件交互、反馈和需求不确定性；与答案互信息为零的指针仍可降低精确恢复成本。LoCoMo、双项目更新、纵向案例诊断显示保留、使用和测量失败：固定检索证据时账本改变答案，固定输出时评估器修改改变分数。框架关联操作风险界与可检验原则，用于分配记忆、保留恢复选项及修订证据依赖。
2610.31303.update_target: Decision-theoretic value of retained memory and recovery options
2610.31303.mechanism_en: The framework measures avoided task loss from history through storage, use and costly recovery/revision, incorporating demand uncertainty and feedback-dependent future work.
2610.31303.result_en: Five minimal counterexamples and diagnostics show distinct preservation, use and measurement failures; a zero-mutual-information pointer can still lower exact-recovery cost.
2610.31303.boundary_en: This is a framework with diagnostics rather than one empirical state-of-the-art agent. Distinguish changed answers at fixed evidence from changed evaluation scores at fixed outputs.
2610.31303.affiliation: MemTensor / Shanghai Jiaotong University / The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

2610.31446.title: When Is a Memory Safe Enough to Act On? Action-Conditioned Verification for Long-Lived Agents
2610.31446.authors: Yiqi Wang , Yifei Wang , Jiaqi Zhang , Zhangkai Wu , Yiqun Duan , Taotao Cai , Mingkai Zheng
2610.31446.abstract_en: Long-lived agents act on memory carried across sessions, and many of their actions are irreversible, so a stale memory can turn directly into harm. Existing work improves the memory itself --- retrieving, refreshing, or reconciling entries --- yet whether an entry must be re-checked before acting is not a property of the entry: the same remembered address can be used unchecked for a routine shipment but should be re-confirmed before a valuable one. We therefore study \emph{action-conditioned memory verification}: given a candidate action, decide which of its memory premises to re-verify and when to proceed or abstain, balancing execution risk, abstention, and verification cost. We formulate this as a sequential stopping problem, in which a verification is worth its cost only if it can change what the agent does next; under suitable verifier reliability and cost conditions, increasing action consequence can move the same memory through proceed, verify, and direct-abstention regimes. Building on this formulation, \textsc{AMV-Guard} is a practical verification gate that extracts the premises a candidate action rests on, calibrates beliefs about whether they are wrong, and selects checks by bounded value of information (VOI). On ToolSandbox, relative to a static policy given the same inputs, it lowers mean verification cost by 33.9\% while keeping 100\% safe-proceed recall and 0\% Gate harmful, and raises Proceed coverage from 38.83\% to 44.17\%; in a gate-core transfer to AppWorld, which carries over the stopping/VOI core but not the full structured pipeline, it lowers verification cost by 21.3\% at a small cost in safe-proceed recall and task success. These results suggest that verification effort should be set by what an agent is about to do, not only by how reliable a memory appears.
2610.31446.abstract_zh: 长期智能体跨会话依记忆行动，过时值可直接造成不可逆伤害。已有工作通过检索、刷新或协调条目来改进记忆本身，但行动前是否必须重查一个条目，并非记忆本身的性质：同地址常规发货可直用，贵重发货应确认。我们研究行动条件化验证，选择重查前提、执行或弃权，平衡风险、弃权和成本，形式化为顺序停止：只有检查可改变下一动作才值得。合适可靠性及成本条件下，后果增大可让同记忆从执行转为验证再转直接弃权。AMV-Guard 提取候选动作前提，校准错误信念，按有界信息价值选择检查。ToolSandbox 相同输入对静态策略，平均验证成本低 33.9%，安全执行召回 100%、门控有害 0%，执行覆盖从 38.83% 到 44.17%；迁移 AppWorld 仅停止/信息价值核心而非全结构管线，成本低 21.3%，安全召回与任务成功略损。验证工作应由将做什么而非仅记忆可靠性决定。
2610.31446.update_target: Action-conditioned memory verification and abstention gate
2610.31446.mechanism_en: AMV-Guard extracts action premises, calibrates error beliefs and uses bounded value of information to choose checks and stopping, balancing action consequence, verification cost and abstention.
2610.31446.result_en: ToolSandbox verification cost falls 33.9%, with 100% safe-proceed recall, zero observed Gate harmful and coverage 38.83% to 44.17%; core-only AppWorld transfer cuts cost 21.3% with recall/success tradeoffs.
2610.31446.boundary_en: Zero observed harm is not a guarantee. AppWorld transfers only the stopping/VOI core, not the full structured pipeline; reliability and cost assumptions determine the decision regimes.
2610.31446.affiliation: University of Southern Queensland / Southern University of Science and Technology / Jiangsu University / The University of Sydney / Uploading Inc.

2610.31743.title: Not Every Agent Needs the Strongest Model: Unified Prompt-Model Optimization for Heterogeneous LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
2610.31743.authors: Mingxiu Cai , Haoyang Xian , Xinyu Ma , Yutong Wang , Zhenxi Song , Jing Li , Xuebo Liu
2610.31743.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on role-specific prompts and execution models to solve complex tasks collaboratively. However, prompt optimization typically keeps model assignments fixed, leaving differences in role requirements and their associated inference costs outside the search. We present UniMASO, a Unified framework for heterogeneous Multi-Agent System Optimization through the joint adaptation of prompts and model assignments. UniMASO evaluates candidate updates through local, downstream, and global feedback, using cost-aware Pareto search to retain useful quality-cost trade-offs. Topology-aware co-evolution then coordinates these updates according to agent roles and dependencies. Cross-level trajectory memory further supplies historical successes and failures to guide subsequent optimization. Experiments on five benchmarks and five execution topologies show that UniMASO achieves competitive task performance at substantially lower deployment cost than the strongest homogeneous configurations. Under centralized execution, it improves the average score from 69.79 to 70.40 while reducing token-weighted deployment cost by 85.2% relative to DeepSeek-V4-Pro with MASPO. These results support joint prompt-model adaptation as an effective approach to efficient multi-agent collaboration. The code is available at this https URL .
2610.31743.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统依靠角色专属提示和执行模型协同解决复杂任务。然而，提示优化通常固定模型分配，使角色需求差异及相应推理成本处于搜索范围之外。我们提出 UniMASO，通过联合适配提示和模型分配，统一优化异构多智能体系统。UniMASO 利用局部、下游和全局反馈评估候选更新，通过成本感知的帕累托搜索保留有价值的质量—成本折中。拓扑感知的共同进化进一步依据角色和依赖关系协调这些更新。跨层级轨迹记忆提供历史成功与失败，指导后续优化。五个基准、五种执行拓扑上的实验显示，相比最强同构配置，UniMASO 以显著较低的部署成本取得有竞争力的任务表现。在集中执行下，相比使用 MASPO 的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，平均得分从 69.79 提高到 70.40，按词元加权的部署成本降低 85.2%。结果支持将提示与模型联合适配作为高效多智能体协作的方法。代码可通过原文中的链接获取。
2610.31743.update_target: Role prompts, execution-model assignments and optimization memory
2610.31743.mechanism_en: UniMASO evaluates local, downstream and global effects, retains quality/cost Pareto candidates and co-evolves dependent roles. Historical successes and failures guide subsequent prompt/model updates.
2610.31743.result_en: Across five benchmarks and five topologies, centralized average score rises from 69.79 to 70.40 while token-weighted deployment cost falls 85.2% relative to DeepSeek-V4-Pro with MASPO.
2610.31743.boundary_en: Deployment savings exclude the full search budget. Joint prompt/model adaptation changes the configuration, not the model weights; rankings and cost trade-offs depend on roles and topology.

2610.31789.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
2610.31789.authors: Hariharan Devarajan , Neeraj Rajesh , Aniruddha Marathe , Nikoli Dryden , Kin Ng , Michela Taufer
2610.31789.abstract_en: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. Third, warm-start runs consume only 0.38-0.40 million tokens per task, which is three to four times less than a single baseline attempt, while a cold-start costs no more than the baseline. On the 1000 Genome Pegasus workflow, instrumenting a production application for I/O performance analysis, Phronix passes all 11 correctness checks against six for the baseline harness, and also lifts the task solving rates of two cheaper models from 29% and 27% of SWE-bench tasks solved to 91% and 87%, respectively, matching the performance of the most expensive evaluated model.
2610.31789.abstract_zh: 科学计算越来越依赖大语言模型智能体完成插桩、分析和工作流移植等性能工程任务。然而，智能体的有效性高度依赖周围的运行框架，而框架通常依靠人工编写的技能和整理的记忆。这限制了自主学习，使智能体反复重新发现解决办法，无法保留和复用此前执行获得的知识。我们提出 Phronix，一种以能力为中心的学习范式，使智能体框架能够从自身执行中获得、验证并细化可复用能力。Phronix 运行预测器—验证器—纠正器闭环：MCP 工具及相应技能提出解决方案，工具执行验证方案，观测结果细化保存的能力。它将每次观测到的交互蒸馏进能力库，并对失败任务继续研究，而非放弃。首先，在所有模型上，已学习能力均能在 93%—95% 的重复任务中首次尝试即解决问题，显著降低求解的不确定性并提高可靠性。其次，无需用户指示，Phronix 将自身执行转化为每任务 7.6—30.8 项持久能力；所需能力已存在时，新建数量降至两项以下。第三，热启动每任务仅消耗 0.38—0.40 百万词元，比单次基线尝试少三至四倍，冷启动成本也不高于基线。在为生产应用插桩、进行输入输出性能分析的 1000 Genome Pegasus 工作流上，Phronix 通过全部 11 项正确性检查，基线通过六项；它还将两种廉价模型的 SWE-bench 任务解决率从 29%、27% 提高到 91%、87%，与所评估最昂贵模型相当。
2610.31789.update_target: Reusable tool/skill capabilities stored in the agent harness
2610.31789.mechanism_en: Phronix predicts with MCP tools and skills, validates through execution and corrects stored capabilities from outcomes. Recurring tasks reuse the resulting capability store rather than repeatedly rediscovering solutions.
2610.31789.result_en: Reported first-attempt recurring-task success is 93–95%; warm starts use 0.38–0.40M tokens per task. The workflow passes 11 checks versus six, and two cheaper models rise from 29%/27% to 91%/87% on the studied SWE-bench tasks.
2610.31789.boundary_en: Warm recurring-task reuse and generalization to unseen tasks are different claims. Include capability creation, validation and storage costs, and do not read the reported task subset as a universal SWE-bench score.
2610.31789.affiliation: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / Illinois Institute of Technology / University of Tennessee, Knoxville

2610.31846.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
2610.31846.authors: Yuval Kansal , Karen Ullrich , Polina Kirichenko , Ilia Kulikov , Niraj K. Jha , Mohammad Pezeshki , Mark Ibrahim
2610.31846.abstract_en: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later. Experiments with agents based on open-weight models from the Qwen family across open-ended research (GAIA), tool-use workflows (Claw-Eval), and terminal tasks (Terminal-Bench 2.1) show that our method improves overall success rates by 8.9 to 17.0 percentage points and performs competitively with frontier systems. We find that Self-Direction reduces repeated mistakes across future encounters of a task, nearly doubling the reliability of an agent's corrections. Learned lessons also transfer: a handful of adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks without additional training. Ultimately, this self-directed repair transforms everyday mistakes into lasting lessons.
2610.31846.abstract_zh: 智能体应从错误中学习，使经验带来持续改进。然而，现有智能体往往只能暂时恢复：上下文中的反思容易跨会话遗忘，还要竞争有限上下文；全参数微调则昂贵，并可能干扰已有能力。我们提出 Self-Direction，将临时上下文重试与策略更新的优点结合，使智能体能够从错误中学习。任务失败后，智能体反思自身轨迹，提炼教训，并立即将其蒸馏进轻量低秩适配器。原始权重保持冻结，因此适配器训练不会覆盖基础模型参数；每个适配器所训练的额外参数约为基础模型参数量的 0.02%。智能体把适配器保存为持久教训库，之后自动路由并用于相关问题。以 Qwen 系列开放权重模型为基础，在开放式研究 GAIA、工具流程 Claw-Eval 和终端任务 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的实验显示，总体成功率提高 8.9—17.0 个百分点，并与前沿系统有竞争力。Self-Direction 减少了以后再次遇到任务时的重复错误，使智能体纠正的可靠性接近翻倍。教训也能迁移：少量适配器无需额外训练即可泛化到数十个新任务。这种自我引导修复最终将日常错误转化为持久教训。
2610.31846.update_target: Persistent low-rank lesson adapters and their routing library
2610.31846.mechanism_en: On failure, Self-Direction reflects on the trajectory, distills the lesson into an adapter and saves it for automatic reuse on related tasks. Original model parameters stay fixed while extra adapter weights are trained.
2610.31846.result_en: Qwen-family agents improve overall success by 8.9–17.0 percentage points across GAIA, Claw-Eval and Terminal-Bench 2.1; each adapter adds about 0.02% of base parameters, with reported transfer to new tasks.
2610.31846.boundary_en: Frozen base weights do not mean training-free adaptation: adapters require optimization and routing. Count per-lesson training and library growth, and separate repeated-task reliability from unseen-task transfer.

2610.32026.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
2610.32026.authors: Binghang Lu , Yige Sun , Guang Lin
2610.32026.abstract_en: Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. RSI-Opt substantially improves optimizer-agent performance, with representative raw-space summary $z$-scores increasing from $+10.48$ to $+14.33$ on the evolution suite with Opus 5.5 and from $-0.36$ to $+3.11$ on held-out tasks with GPT-5.5 through cross-model policy transfer. On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning.
2610.32026.abstract_zh: 常规神经网络训练通常遵循预设优化方案，因此可以考虑让 LLM 智能体监测训练动态、随训练调整优化器设置，但固定的智能体策略不能跨运行积累经验。我们提出即插即用的 RSI-Opt，进化指导优化过程的知识，包括提示、程序手册、经过测试的优化器代码库及决策频率。元智能体根据此前运行的证据重写策略，档案保留已评估策略，支持继续进化。在三个训练任务、五代进化中，元智能体形成可复用流程与代码，并自行开展 CPU 代理实验。RSI-Opt 显著改善优化器智能体表现：使用 Opus 5.5 时，进化任务集上具有代表性的原始空间汇总 z 分数从 +10.48 升至 +14.33；通过跨模型策略迁移，GPT-5.5 在留出任务上从 −0.36 升至 +3.11。在 Burgers 偏微分方程上，相比固定提示智能体，Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 的平均相对 L2 误差分别约降低 2.7 倍、8.8 倍，但 PDE 迁移效果随模型和任务而变化。受控比较显示，进化策略兼顾可复用优化知识与逐任务适配：初始决策解释已见任务上的大部分收益，持续适配则改善未见任务结果。研究说明，跨训练运行积累的流程及可执行工具能够提升优化器智能体，并支持向科学机器学习迁移。
2610.32026.update_target: Optimizer-agent prompt, playbook, tested code library and decision cadence
2610.32026.mechanism_en: RSI-Opt monitors training, while a meta-agent uses previous runs and CPU proxy experiments to rewrite the optimizer policy. Evaluated policies enter an archive for later evolution and transfer.
2610.32026.result_en: Across five generations, representative summary z-scores rise from +10.48 to +14.33 on the evolution suite and −0.36 to +3.11 on held-out transfer. Burgers PDE relative L2 error falls about 2.7-fold or 8.8-fold, depending on the LLM.
2610.32026.boundary_en: The updated outer policy differs from the neural model being trained. Initial decisions explain most seen-task gains; continuing adaptation helps unseen tasks, but PDE transfer varies and all proxy/search cost belongs in the budget.

2610.32120.title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
2610.32120.authors: Shuo Han , Zhilin Wang , Peng Ling , Wenjia Gong , Yang Liu , Guanjun Jiang , Yukun Cao , Xike Xie
2610.32120.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.32120.abstract_en: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.
2610.32120.abstract_zh: 复杂的文本到图像请求仍难以可靠满足。验证和修复图像能够修正单次输出，但成功修复未必能迁移到其他请求。我们提出 ImageRSI，保持图像生成器冻结，结合三部分：每项任务内部的五维验证与修复、跨任务共享的经验库，以及判别器的离线更新。候选经验只有通过配对 A/B 验证才能进入经验库；判别器基于累积的图像判断记录进行监督微调和 GRPO 更新，并在复用前评估。我们还提出 ImageReq-Bench，包含围绕真实图像生成难例构建的 961 项请求，每项配有评估检查清单。以 Nano Banana Pro 为生成器时，ImageRSI 在 MindBench 的检查清单严格准确率（CSA）为 52.6%，在 ImageReq-Bench 为 65.66%；我们同时比较不同判别器训练配置下的系统结果。
2610.32120.update_target: Cross-task image-repair experience and judge weights; frozen image generator
2610.32120.mechanism_en: ImageRSI combines task-local verification/repair, paired A/B admission into a shared experience library and offline judge updates by supervised fine-tuning plus GRPO. The judge is evaluated before reuse.
2610.32120.result_en: Checklist Strict Accuracy reaches 52.6% on MindBench with Nano Banana Pro and 65.66% on the 961-request ImageReq-Bench; outcomes are compared across judge-training configurations.
2610.32120.boundary_en: Repairing one image, transferring experience and improving the judge are distinct effects. Paired validation and judge evaluation do not establish unlimited recursion, independent visual quality or immunity to evaluator overfitting.
2610.32120.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / Qwen Business Unit of Alibaba, Alibaba Token Hub / Xidian University

2610.32253.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
2610.32253.authors: Zimu Wang , Xiaobo Wang , Siyu Ye , Jiaqi Li , Silin Chen , Yuling Shi , Ruobing Wang , Jingjing Zhang , Chaofan Wang , Kai Wu , Mengnan Qi , Kai Cai , Xiaodong Gu , Zilong Zheng
2610.32253.abstract_en: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and $\tau^3$ Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.
2610.32253.abstract_zh: 智能体进化方法利用执行反馈改进提示、技能、工具和编排，但其实现往往重复构建相同实验基础设施。我们提出开源 RSIHub，在共享基础设施上构建、比较和扩展这些方法。配方组合可复用算子并声明可变资源，RSIHub 则提供执行、评估、恢复和谱系管理。研究者能够专注于进化策略，评估保持在可变范围之外，结果始终关联具体候选及评估条件。我们无需改动框架核心即可实例化 AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA，方法专属逻辑保留在配方与算子中。在固定模型和评估器配置下，使用 MiniSWE、Codex，在 Terminal Bench 2 和 τ³ Banking 上评估。观察到的最大总体 pass@1 收益为 13.5 个百分点，但方法排序随设置变化，优化收益也不总能迁移到留出任务。RSIHub 提供进化策略的共同比较协议、可检查的候选历史，以及开发新方法所需的可复用组件。
2610.32253.update_target: Composable evolution recipes and declared mutable agent resources
2610.32253.mechanism_en: RSIHub supplies reusable operators, execution, recovery and lineage while keeping evaluation outside the mutable surface. AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve and GEPA run as recipes under shared model/evaluator settings.
2610.32253.result_en: With MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ³ Banking, the largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points; method rankings vary and optimization gains do not always transfer.
2610.32253.boundary_en: Shared infrastructure improves comparability, not automatic fairness under every budget. Keep evaluator conditions, candidate lineage and held-out transfer visible; infrastructure reuse alone is not improved improvement ability.
2610.32253.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / University of Science and Technology of China / Douyin Group / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Tongji University / Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence / Simple Agent Lab

2610.32295.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
2610.32295.abstract_en: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17% success, compared with 59.83% for memory-only and 50.50% for skill-only serving. Code is available at this https URL
2610.32295.abstract_zh: 终身 LLM 智能体必须从不断增长的交互历史学习，同时在有限上下文窗口中决策。记忆使过去经验可用，但智能体仍可能需要从检索记录推断如何解决新任务；技能提供可复用流程，却可能缺少应用流程所需的任务特定事实。记忆和技能塑造行为，也影响未来学习可获得的经验。我们提出 MemCryst，在语言模型冻结时，通过记忆与技能的双向学习实现终身上下文适配。记忆中的重复情节支持技能创建和修订，技能引导的交互又为后续学习提供新记忆。检索事实与已学技能共同构成上下文，任务结果则调整实际被提供记录在未来检索中的影响，而不改写记录内容。在具身控制、长文阅读、对话、数学和代码的十种设置中，MemCryst 领先七项报告比较。ALFWorld 上联合提供记忆与技能的成功率为 63.17%，仅记忆为 59.83%，仅技能为 50.50%。代码可通过原文链接获取。
2610.32295.update_target: External memory, reusable skills and retrieval influence; frozen LLM
2610.32295.mechanism_en: MemCryst forms/revises skills from recurring episodes, then uses skill-guided interaction to generate later memory. Outcomes adjust retrieval influence for records actually served without rewriting those records.
2610.32295.result_en: The framework leads seven of ten reported comparisons across diverse domains. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17%, versus 59.83% for memory-only and 50.50% for skill-only.
2610.32295.boundary_en: Bidirectional external learning is distinct from weight learning. Compare skill formation, memory storage and retrieval updates under matched context and cost, including interference and transfer beyond the tested streams.

2610.32326.title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
2610.32326.authors: Junlin He , Junzhang Zhu , Yudong Li , Yihong Tang , Xuefeng Jiang , Wei Ma , Chengxiang Zhuo , Zang Li
2610.32326.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR).
2610.32326.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体支持通过自动代码进化发现算法，但顺序推荐的递归自改进研究面临两难：通用框架缺少领域反馈，推荐专用框架又依赖线性进化。二者直接结合在生成式推荐（GR）中会失败。与端到端模型不同，GR 依赖分词、预训练和对齐的模块级联流程，现有方法因此存在成本盲视，忽略阶段不对称重训开销并浪费预算，以及短视评估，在下游尚未适配、指标暂时下降时丢弃有潜力的上游创新。我们提出面向 GR 的多智能体代码进化框架 TGR-EvoDAG，以有向无环图保存多个分支并合并互补创新，将高级搜索与丰富诊断反馈统一。阶段感知成本规划优化 GPU 小时预算，主动下游共同适配跨越暂时退化、释放跨阶段收益。在公开 Amazon 数据集上，系统实现完整 GR 流水线的自主进化，离线指标比最强基线最多提高 37.4%，Agent4Rec 模拟用户满意度提高 19.7%。在腾讯大型商业媒体平台的工业部署中，进化 GR 的离线 Hit@1 相对提高 12.16%，在线点击率提高 0.40%，且达到统计显著。
2610.32326.update_target: Generative-recommendation pipeline code across tokenization, pretraining and alignment
2610.32326.mechanism_en: TGR-EvoDAG preserves and merges branches, plans stage-specific GPU-hour costs and actively co-adapts downstream stages so a temporarily worse upstream edit can be tested after adaptation.
2610.32326.result_en: Amazon-data offline metrics improve by up to 37.4% and simulated Agent4Rec satisfaction by 19.7%; Tencent deployment reports 12.16% relative offline Hit@1 improvement and a statistically significant 0.40% online CTR increase.
2610.32326.boundary_en: Simulation, offline metrics and industrial online results have different evidence. Retain the authors’ CTR percentage wording rather than assuming percentage points, and include retraining plus branch/search costs.
2610.32326.affiliation: Tencent / The Hong Kong Polytechnic University / McGill University / Independent Researcher

2610.32433.title: Tempo-Zero: Recursive Self-Play in Executable Worlds for Video Reasoning
2610.32433.authors: Jingmin Zhu , Yanyan Zou , Xiuyu Li , James Bailey , Dinh Phung , Tao Yu , Yunyun Hou , Jun Liu , Jun Zhou , Sirui Wang , Nan Duan , Jiachen Liu , Qiuhong Ke
2610.32433.abstract_en: Video reasoning requires understanding how events unfold over time, yet videos with accurate temporal annotations are expensive to collect. Self-play offers an alternative by letting a model generate and solve its own tasks without manual annotation. However, existing video self-play methods train on fixed sets of recorded videos, so they cannot alter the underlying event dynamics and rely on noisy pseudo-labels derived from the model's own outputs, such as majority voting, that risk reinforcing shared model errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Tempo-Zero, a self-improvement framework that closes a loop of executable environments, execution-verified self-play, and environment evolution, where executing a program renders a video with the ground-truth option and interval of every question. A single policy plays both Questioner and Solver, proposing questions and answering them with timestamped evidence lines, and is trained on execution-grounded rewards instead of model consensus. The Solver's performance steers a curriculum over tasks and difficulty levels, and the policy selects rule changes that enrich the event dynamics of later rounds. Despite being trained solely on simple programs, without supervised fine-tuning or external video data which prior methods typically require, Tempo-Zero outperforms the base models and recent self-play baselines on average across twelve real-world video benchmarks at different model scales, with particularly strong gains on temporal grounding tasks. Project page: this https URL
2610.32433.abstract_zh: 视频推理需要理解事件随时间展开，但带精确时间标注的视频收集昂贵。自博弈让模型生成并求解自身任务，提供无需人工标注的替代路径。然而，现有视频自博弈在固定录制视频集上训练，无法改变事件动力学，并依赖多数投票等模型输出产生的噪声伪标签，可能强化共同错误。我们提出 Tempo-Zero，将可执行环境、执行验证的自博弈和环境进化闭合成自改进环路：执行程序即可渲染视频，同时得到每道题的真实选项与时间区间。同一策略同时担任提问者和求解者，提出问题并用带时间戳的证据行回答，依靠执行落地的奖励而非模型共识训练。求解表现引导任务及难度课程，策略选择规则变化，丰富后续轮次的事件动力学。尽管只用简单程序训练，没有既有方法通常依赖的监督微调或外部视频数据，Tempo-Zero 在不同模型规模、十二个真实视频基准上的平均表现均优于基础模型及近期自博弈基线，时间定位任务收益尤其突出。项目页可通过原文链接访问。
2610.32433.update_target: Questioner/solver policy, executable task curriculum and environment rules
2610.32433.mechanism_en: Tempo-Zero uses one policy for proposing and solving program-rendered video questions, trains on execution-grounded rewards and lets solver performance and selected rule changes shape later tasks and event dynamics.
2610.32433.result_en: Training on simple programs without supervised fine-tuning or external video data improves average performance over base/self-play baselines across twelve real-world video benchmarks, especially temporal grounding.
2610.32433.boundary_en: Program execution supplies labels only within the modeled worlds. Transfer to real videos and environment-rule evolution should be ablated separately; no physical environment adaptation or unbounded capability growth is demonstrated.
2610.32433.affiliation: JD.com / Monash University / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Communication University of China / Lancaster University / Griffith University

2610.32813.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
2610.32813.authors: Yuhua Jiang , Chang Xu , Feifei Gao , Li Zhao
2610.32813.abstract_en: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.
2610.32813.abstract_zh: 智能体框架常在工具反馈后再次调用推理，即使此前调用已确定下一动作。我们提出 HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minus），通过受防护的决策复用与递归自改进提升词元效率。RSI 从训练反馈迭代细化配套框架配置，由验证选择部署版本。模型—工具边界控制器在执行者权重固定时，复用已解决决策以替代后续推理回调。可执行决策图保存精确动作、字面参数、因果依赖和公开防护条件。受防护决策复用根据观测到的回执激活持久决策，经认证的回调替换通过原生接口执行，并记录已注册慢回调的移除。遇到新语义决策、无支持证据或选择器弃权时，再次调用原执行者。表示约束反馈可以改变什么，完整任务测量确定质量和成本。HumanEval 上，Codex 成功率保持 90.82%，每任务千词元从 66.72 降至 47.02，节省 29.54%；DeepSeek Harness 成功率从 71.43% 升至 85.71%，每任务千词元从 96.28 降至 11.62，节省 87.93%。独立 MBPP 消融中，相比单次使用图和保留回调，成本分别低 26.91%、19.52%。结果说明受防护决策复用可实际减少既有框架的重复推理。
2610.32813.update_target: Companion harness configurations and persistent guarded decision graphs
2610.32813.mechanism_en: HarnessMM evolves configurations from training feedback and selects by validation. With fixed actor weights, exact actions/dependencies/public guards permit callback substitution after observed receipts; unresolved semantics return to the actor.
2610.32813.result_en: Codex HumanEval success stays 90.82% while tokens/task fall 29.54%; DeepSeek success rises 71.43% to 85.71% and tokens fall 87.93%. MBPP ablations report 26.91% and 19.52% lower cost than two reuse/callback controls.
2610.32813.boundary_en: The work reuses resolved decisions, not arbitrary new reasoning. Guard semantics, abstention and complete-task quality determine validity; the named certification mechanism is not a blanket guarantee for unseen tool effects.

2610.31685.title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
2610.31685.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multimedia (cs.MM); Image and Video Processing (eess.IV)
2610.31685.abstract_en: LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to verify that cited evidence and references are valid, and an entailment check to determine whether the final claims are supported by that evidence. Detected failures are then grouped by the responsible component and failure type, converted into targeted prompt patches, and accepted only after validation on a held-out set. This adapts the agent prompts without updating model weights. On the MER2025 dataset, targeted prompt adaptation outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs, ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, and matches or outperforms undifferentiated reflection baselines on each of them: VideoLLaMA3-2B, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and InternVL2.5-38B. It improves F-score by 0.6--2.2 points depending on the backbone, including an increase from 52.3 to 54.5 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
2610.31685.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的多模态对话情感推理在标准基准上表现良好，但通过指令微调改进成本较高。冻结模型组成的智能体流水线可避免此成本，却带来另一问题：预测出错时，如何识别负责的智能体或阶段。我们提出支持可追踪情感推理与提示空间适配的智能体框架。各模态感知智能体分析视觉、声学和词汇输入，将带证据引用的观测发布到共享板；集成智能体结合这些观测与检索的多模态示例，产生情感描述、标签集及引用；MLLM 评论者可在最终输出前要求一次修订。对错误预测，独立的证据落地验证阶段先用确定性检查验证证据与引用有效，再用蕴含检查判断最终断言是否受证据支持。检测到的失败按责任组件和类型分组，转化为定向提示补丁，仅通过留出集验证后接受，从而不更新权重就适配智能体提示。在 MER2025 上，定向适配在 2B 至 38B 的四个 MLLM 上均优于冻结静态流水线，并在 VideoLLaMA3-2B、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、InternVL2.5-38B 上分别匹配或超过无差别反思基线。F 分数依主干提高 0.6—2.2 点，其中 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 从 52.3 升至 54.5。
2610.31685.update_target: Reusable component-specific prompt patches; frozen multimodal models
2610.31685.mechanism_en: Evidence-cited observations feed an integration agent and a one-revision critic. Separate deterministic/reference and entailment checks attribute failures; targeted prompt patches are accepted only after held-out validation.
2610.31685.result_en: On MER2025 and four 2B–38B backbones, targeted adaptation improves F-score by 0.6–2.2 points, including 52.3 to 54.5 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and matches or exceeds undifferentiated reflection.
2610.31685.boundary_en: The critic’s within-output revision differs from retained prompt adaptation. Held-out validation and evidence entailment remain imperfect; no backbone weight update or independently replicated effect is claimed.

2610.31709.title: Mining the Design Space of Multi-Agent Workflows
2610.31709.authors: Xavier Cadet , Junyan Cheng , Peter Chin , Kyle Richardson
2610.31709.abstract_en: Designing large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) still relies on trial and error and informal "folk wisdom." Manual studies test only a few communication structures or topologies (e.g., sequential, parallel, shared-memory, or debate), while automated optimizers discard search trajectories after selecting a task-specific workflow. We present a two-phase pipeline for mining reproducible design principles from workflow code and execution traces. We repurpose AFlow's MCTS optimizer across six composable operators and 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks, retaining all intermediate rounds to build a corpus of 28,568 executable workflows. A sandboxed AutoResearch loop then mines orchestration code and prompt templates under an $L_0$-penalized validation objective and tests candidate principles on held-out searches. Across 300 feature-mining trials, we identify effects that persist on held-out searches across three levels of workflow design: workflows beginning with independent solvers and one-shot aggregation (Star-first) perform worse ($\Delta = -0.045$); persistent shared documents (SharedMemory) outperform debate ($\Delta = +0.135$); and prompt specificity and placeholder-based context routing yield gains comparable to communication-structure selection ($\Delta = +0.118$). More broadly, our pipeline and results show the feasibility of turning discarded search trajectories into a statistical testbed for discovering and validating multi-agent workflow design principles.
2610.31709.abstract_zh: 设计 LLM 多智能体系统仍依赖试错和非正式经验。人工研究只测试少量顺序、并行、共享记忆或辩论结构，自动优化器则通常选出任务专用工作流后丢弃搜索轨迹。我们提出两阶段流水线，从工作流代码和执行轨迹挖掘可复现设计原则。我们将 AFlow 的 MCTS 优化器用于六个可组合算子、26 项确定性验证的 Enigmata 任务，保留全部中间轮次，建立含 28,568 个可执行工作流的语料。沙箱中的 AutoResearch 闭环在带 L0 惩罚的验证目标下挖掘编排代码与提示模板，并在留出搜索中测试候选原则。300 次特征挖掘试验识别了三个设计层次上在留出搜索中持续存在的效应：以独立求解者和一次性聚合开头的 Star-first 更差，Δ=−0.045；持久共享文档 SharedMemory 优于辩论，Δ=+0.135；提示具体性与基于占位符的上下文路由带来与通信结构选择相当的收益，Δ=+0.118。总体上，这条流水线及结果表明，可将被丢弃的搜索轨迹转化为发现、验证多智能体工作流原则的统计试验床。
2610.31709.update_target: Reusable workflow-design principles mined from optimizer traces
