2610.37434.title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
2610.37434.authors: Yunlong Wang , Alyssa Wu , Cuiyun Gao , Jia Feng , Songyuanyi Lu , Zhichao Hu
2610.37434.abstract_en: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent's family of large language models.
2610.37434.affiliation: Hunyuan Team, Tencent; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.37434.update_target: Evaluation of successive feature edits on the agent’s own persistent code
2610.37434.mechanism_en: History-derived stage contracts and executable F2P/P2P checks test new behavior and preservation. One session/workspace continues without external test feedback or rollback.
2610.37434.result_en: Across 73 reviewed tasks and ten agents, pooled success falls 62.7%→28.5% from first stage to final whole-feature correctness; inherited defects appear in 72.9% of failed later stages.
2610.37434.boundary_en: Feature/code evolution is not itself agent learning. The no-feedback/no-rollback protocol and persistent errors explain a specific evaluation boundary, not every software-development workflow.
2610.37434.abstract_zh: 软件功能通常随时间演变：开发者随着新用例和需求出现，扩展其首个版本，每次扩展都基于此前写出的代码。多数功能基准在固定代码库上评估单个请求。功能演化需要在智能体自己的早期代码上评估连续扩展，并检查功能是否保持正确。我们提出 FeatureArc 来评估编码智能体处理持续演化功能的能力，并提供从仓库历史构建任务的流水线。基准结合了同一功能连续阶段间的依赖、显式要求与接口契约，以及跨四种编程语言的可执行检查。流水线在参考代码每个阶段前后，验证新行为的失败到通过（F2P）测试，以及既有行为的通过到通过（P2P）测试。我们在 73 个人工审阅任务上评估 10 个编码智能体，每项任务含 2—10 个阶段。每个智能体都在单个持久会话和工作区中工作，没有外部测试反馈或回滚。评估揭示首阶段与完整功能成功率之间的差距：汇总成功率从首阶段的 62.7%，降至在最终代码上测试完整功能时的 28.5%。轨迹分析识别出继承缺陷这一常见失败机制，存在于 72.9% 的失败后续阶段。这些早期错误往往未被发现：在失败之后的阶段，智能体约 95% 的时候未注意到先前错误，自测也很少回查早期阶段。因此，在阶段间无人类检查的情况下自主演化功能，对当前编码智能体仍是重大挑战。在腾讯，该流水线将内部评估扩展到这一设置，并指导腾讯大语言模型家族混元的开发。

2610.37624.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
2610.37624.authors: Anouar Imel , Imad Charradi , Abderrahman Sghir , Khalil El Khammar
2610.37624.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
2610.37624.abstract_en: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
2610.37624.affiliation: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; Xidian University; Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics; Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
2610.37624.update_target: Memory selection and attribution effects on group decisions
2610.37624.mechanism_en: CrossProfile crosses ownership of fixed supporting/decoy/irrelevant facts with verified answers. Attribution removal/randomization holds text and line order fixed to test social-proof effects.
2610.37624.result_en: Across 480 tasks, relevance selection can lose 23–31 points to rarest-first in the classic configuration; rarest-first is no better than random on average. Removing attribution raises accuracy 13–24 points.
2610.37624.boundary_en: Rare or relevant is not equivalent to decision-supporting. Controlled hidden-profile tasks and natural discussion have different loss mechanisms; a memory heuristic cannot recover evidence never expressed.
2610.37624.abstract_zh: 当 LLM 群体讨论被压缩为供最终决策者使用的短记忆时，应保留什么？两种自然启发式分别保留最稀有主张，或与决策标准相关的主张。在隐藏画像任务上，两者看起来都很有吸引力，因为事实被多少人持有，与它是否有帮助相混杂。我们提出 CrossProfile，一个诊断基准，包含 60 个模板和自动验证答案；在事实文本固定的情况下，交叉改变支持、诱饵和无关事实的持有归属，形成 480 个任务。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 及两个 DeepSeek 模型上，两种启发式都在可预测的位置失败。按相关性选择会重新引入诱饵，因为诱饵也切合主题：即使完美相关性过滤器，在经典隐藏画像配置中，也比最稀有优先选择低 23—31 个点。最稀有优先平均不比随机选择好，只在稀有事实恰巧有用时获胜。两种情况下，准确率都随记忆保留的证据平衡而变化，而不是随保留策略变化。决策模型还增加第三种失败，即一种社会认同效应：它给被归属于许多智能体的事实额外权重。删除归属标签，或在行序固定时随机重分配标签，可将经典配置的准确率提高 13—24 个点。在自然讨论中，证据在任何记忆发挥作用前就已丢失：完整讨论文本的准确率比完全没有笔记还低。

2610.37649.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
2610.37649.authors: Zhen Yang , Wen Wang , Xander Xu , Ying-Cong Chen
2610.37649.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.37649.abstract_en: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
2610.37649.affiliation: HKUST (Guangzhou); ZJU; Alibaba Group; HKUST (as listed)
2610.37649.update_target: Evaluation of free scientific exploration and evidence-guided scene evolution
2610.37649.mechanism_en: Explorers manipulate altered-physics worlds and design tools without a research question or hints. Separate model agents generate/review scenes and assess reports using the hidden laws and execution records.
2610.37649.result_en: Of twelve evaluated LLMs, GPT-6-Astra reaches 16.7% discovery while the other eleven score 0%; logs reveal unexplored anomalies and partial law identification.
2610.37649.boundary_en: These are authored simulated laws with model-based review, not discoveries of unknown real-world physics. Autonomous environment evolution does not alone prove that the explorer becomes a better scientist.
2610.37649.abstract_zh: 科学发现通常始于意外观测，由此提出新的研究问题。在物理规律被改变的世界里，大语言模型（LLM）能否在没有被告知应研究什么的情况下，注意到重物下落更慢等意外现象，并通过实验发现规律？为评估这种能力，我们提出 LongChang，一个创建改变物理规律的模拟世界的自动框架，其中一条或多条规律不同于普通物理。被评估 LLM 充当探索者，操控物体、构建工具，研究自己提出的问题，不提供研究任务或有关规律的提示。独立 LLM 智能体生成和审查场景、审查工具设计，并利用改变后的物理规律及探索记录，评估报告的正确性和实验支持。这些记录指导场景演化，以供进一步探索，使完整循环无需人工干预运行。在 12 个 LLM 中，GPT-6-Astra 的发现率为 16.7%，另外 11 个为 0%。探索记录揭示，存在未被研究的异常，对改变后的物理规律也仅有部分识别。

2610.37649.evidence_note: Title and complete official abstract reviewed; author header, figure and selected method passages inspected. No independent reproduction.

2610.37905.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
2610.37905.authors: Wentao Zhang , Yilei Zhao , Guangyan Gan , Shuo Sun , Lin William Cong
2610.37905.abstract_en: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.
2610.37905.affiliation: Nanyang Technological University / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2610.37905.update_target: Role-specific procedural guidance; frozen model weights
2610.37905.mechanism_en: Requirement-level feedback becomes guidance for later cases; the current scored case is not retried.
2610.37905.result_en: Requirement fulfillment rises from 24.28% to 27.96%; full resolution from 16.90% to 20.75%, at 5.8% additional cost.
2610.37905.boundary_en: A separate evaluator is used, but the reported stream does not establish independent replication or indefinite procedural gain.
2610.37905.abstract_zh: SEC EDGAR 等公开披露资料库通过提供企业申报文件的网络访问来支持知情投资。语言模型智能体若要协助审阅这些文件，就必须发现相关文档中未明说的缺陷、获取缺失的公司事实，并核验所要求的修订是否满足有证据支持的要求。现有金融问答评测对这些交互能力提供的证据有限。我们提出 FilingLoop，一个面向企业披露审阅与修订的交互式基准和自进化智能体框架。FilingLoop 以美国证券交易委员会的历史往来函件为基础，在不同信息约束下重建了来自 96 家公司的 380 项审阅任务，其中以 IPO 审阅为主。独立于行动智能体的评估器，依据 6,099 项符合条件的要求对最终文件及回复评分，并审计缺乏依据的主张和有害修订。框架将每个案例内的迭代审阅与修订同跨案例的程序性学习相结合，将要求层面的评估反馈转化为针对不同角色的指导，而不更新模型权重。更新只影响后续案例，因此无需重试已评分任务，就能评估程序性适应。在所评估的任务流中，相比固定策略版本，进化使要求满足率从 24.28% 升至 27.96%，完整意见解决率从 16.90% 升至 20.75%，总成本增加 5.8%。FilingLoop 将智能体发现的问题、取得的公司事实和落实的修订联系起来，为后续审阅任务使用的程序提供要求层面的反馈。

2610.38329.title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
2610.38329.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Programming Languages (cs.PL)
2610.38329.abstract_en: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at this https URL .
2610.38329.update_target: Kernel code and persistent accelerator knowledge
2610.38329.mechanism_en: Documentation checks, microbenchmarks and compiler rules guide Design Tree search; repeated device comparisons gate late-stage edits.
2610.38329.result_en: Three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels reach a 9.293x geometric-mean speedup over the official baseline after 12 days.
2610.38329.boundary_en: One accelerator, three kernels and scarce shared hardware; measured local optimization does not establish general autonomous hardware mastery.
2610.38329.abstract_zh: 前沿大语言模型能为大多数单算子基准任务编写正确的 CUDA 内核，但在架构与编程语言很少出现在其经验中的加速器上，准确率会骤降。我们报告一个为此类加速器构建的 LLM 智能体循环案例。实例是采用一种较新、文档稀少的 Rust DSL 编程的 FuriosaAI RNGD NPU；该循环在一台共享且稀缺的设备上，历时 12 天优化了三个 Gemma-4-12B 解码内核。循环自行构建目标知识：编写并检查 DSL 文档摘要，通过微基准测量芯片，记录源自编译器的合法性规则，并在工具链变化时重新审视这些知识，在可行处复核规则与测量。基于角色、围绕各内核设计树进行的搜索探索完整内核设计，并在每个内核的最佳版本中累积被接受的小改动。由于设备时间稀缺且读数有噪声，新设计在设备运行前先经过廉价检查；在运行后期，只有在设备上与最佳内核反复比较后才接受改动。最终内核相对官方基线的几何平均加速比达到 9.293 倍，各内核周期数与仅搬运其权重所需周期数相差均不超过 1.25 倍。我们的提示、分析器及验收测试见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.38546.title: Implicit Minor Detection from Multi-Turn Dialogue in High-Risk AI Interactions: A Constrained Self-Evolving LLM Harness
2610.38546.authors: Xiaohan Zhang , Ying Zhao , Ruilin Guo , Xuanyuan Yu , Kaibo Huang , Yukun Wei , Zhongliang Yang , Linna Zhou
2610.38546.abstract_en: In high-risk text interactions, a system may need to estimate whether the current speaker is likely to be a minor before applying age-conditioned safeguards. Many text-based dialogue systems lack strong identity signals such as account information, verified identity, facial data, or device data, and must rely on weak cues that emerge across multiple turns. We formulate implicit minor detection under weak identity information as a high-risk user-attribute inference task and propose a constrained framework comprising a large language model, a Harness, and a Maker-Checker protocol. The framework controls when inference is invoked, requires structured dialogue-linked evidence, and subjects validation-selected Harness revisions to version-level review. On a controlled Chinese benchmark comprising 8,328 multi-turn dialogues, our method improves average precision and minor-class F1 by 7.60 and 6.37 percentage points, respectively, over direct inference using the same LLM family.
2610.38546.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
2610.38546.update_target: Versioned detection harness; fixed LLM family
2610.38546.mechanism_en: Dialogue-linked evidence and a Maker-Checker protocol constrain validation-selected harness revisions.
2610.38546.result_en: On 8,328 controlled Chinese dialogues, average precision and minor-class F1 improve by 7.60 and 6.37 percentage points.
2610.38546.boundary_en: Weak text cues and a controlled benchmark do not establish reliable identity verification or open-world deployment validity.
2610.38546.abstract_zh: 在高风险文本交互中，系统可能需要先估计当前说话者是否可能为未成年人，再应用与年龄相关的防护。许多文本对话系统缺乏账号信息、已验证身份、面部数据或设备数据等强身份信号，只能依赖多轮交互中逐渐出现的弱线索。我们将弱身份信息条件下的隐式未成年人检测表述为高风险用户属性推断任务，并提出由大语言模型、Harness 和 Maker-Checker 协议组成的受约束框架。该框架控制何时调用推断，要求提供与对话关联的结构化证据，并对经验证集选择的 Harness 修订进行版本级审查。在包含 8,328 段多轮对话的受控中文基准上，与使用相同 LLM 系列进行直接推断相比，我们的方法将平均精确率和未成年人类别 F1 分别提高 7.60 和 6.37 个百分点。

2610.38566.title: Co-Evolving Policy and Rubric via Capability Awareness for Open-Ended Generation
2610.38566.authors: Chengsheng Zhang , Wenshen Xu , Yuchuan Wu , Zhiyuan Yu , Junfeng Fang , Tianlong Wang , Bingxue Qiu , Yongbin Li , Xiang Wang
2610.38566.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) offers interpretable, fine-grained supervision for aligning large language models (LLMs) on open-ended generation tasks. However, static rubric criteria may become saturated or remain beyond the policy's exploration, rendering the reward signals insufficiently discriminative. While recent efforts seek to guide sampling exploration or evolve rubrics, they fail to explicitly factor in how rubric difficulty should track the evolving policy's capabilities, resulting in a persistent mismatch between the optimization objective and the policy's current capability frontier. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving Policy and Rubric via \textbf{C}apability \textbf{A}wareness (\textbf{CoCA}), a closed-loop framework that jointly adapts the rubric and policy through criterion-level diagnosis. Specifically, CoCA contrasts query-only and rubric-guided rollouts to characterize each criterion relative to the current policy, recalibrates criteria with mismatched difficulty, and identifies guidance-revealed capability gaps for frontier-based learning. Based on this insight, CoCA either expands rubric-conditioned frontiers through guided optimization or transfers qualified gains through on-policy self-distillation. As the policy updates, CoCA improves the capability diagnosis and enables more reliable distillation, thereby completing the co-evolution loop. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and LLMs demonstrate that CoCA consistently improves performance over rubric-based RL methods. Moreover, CoCA promotes the internalization of guidance-revealed capabilities into query-only behavior while mitigating capability degradation.
2610.38566.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / Alibaba Token Hub / Nanjing University / National University of Singapore
2610.38566.mechanism_en: Query-only versus rubric-guided rollouts diagnose criterion difficulty; optimization or qualified self-distillation feeds back into the next diagnosis.
2610.38566.result_en: The authors report consistent gains across benchmarks and reduced capability degradation; the abstract gives no single aggregate effect size.
2610.38566.boundary_en: Criterion diagnosis and model-based rubrics can share errors; internalization requires query-only tests rather than guided scores alone.
2610.38566.abstract_zh: 基于评分细则的强化学习为大语言模型在开放式生成任务上的对齐提供了可解释、细粒度的监督。然而，静态细则中的标准可能已经饱和，也可能超出策略的探索能力，使奖励信号缺乏区分度。近期工作虽然尝试引导采样探索或演化评分细则，却没有显式考虑细则难度应如何跟随策略能力变化，导致优化目标与策略当前能力边界持续错配。本文提出具备能力感知的策略与细则共同演化方法 CoCA，一个通过标准级诊断联合适应评分细则和策略的闭环框架。具体而言，CoCA 对比仅给定问题和由细则引导的轨迹，刻画每项标准相对于当前策略的状态，重新校准难度不匹配的标准，并识别由指导揭示的能力缺口，以进行边界学习。基于这一认识，CoCA 要么通过引导式优化扩展由细则条件化的能力边界，要么通过同策略自蒸馏迁移符合条件的增益。随着策略更新，CoCA 改善能力诊断并实现更可靠的蒸馏，从而完成共同演化闭环。在多样基准和 LLM 上的大量实验表明，CoCA 相对基于评分细则的强化学习方法持续改善性能。此外，CoCA 促进将指导揭示的能力内化为仅给定问题时的行为，同时减轻能力退化。

2610.38946.title: MAS-Loop: Beyond One-Shot Orchestration towards Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
2610.38946.authors: Hehai Lin , Qi Yang , Chengwei Qin
2610.38946.abstract_en: Training-time multi-agent system (MAS) design seeks to learn reusable orchestration policies, yet prevailing approaches remain largely one-shot: an Orchestrator generates a system but only observes and learns from its terminal outcome. This paradigm discards execution trajectories that expose system-level failures and contain fine-grained information beyond the terminal outcome, leaving no direct basis for revising the source MAS, evaluating the updated MAS, or learning from the resulting contrast. To this end, we introduce MAS-Loop, an execution-grounded framework that closes this feedback loop by coupling an Orchestrator with a trajectory-conditioned Refiner. For each task, the Orchestrator constructs and executes a source MAS to obtain an outcome score and an intermediate trajectory. Conditioned on the trajectory, the Refiner localizes an actionable failure, formulates a trajectory-grounded diagnosis, and proposes a bounded patch to the agents, information flow, or execution configuration. The executable updated MAS is re-executed on the same task to measure its realized outcome under stochastic execution. This pair-MAS comparison provides complementary learning signals: the Orchestrator learns to generate strong systems with fewer recoverable failures, whereas the Refiner learns to expose and repair observed weaknesses, thereby driving policy-level co-evolution across training iterations. Experiments show that MAS-Loop achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated baselines, with consistent gains from refinement across all evaluated benchmarks. The co-evolution process also yields MAS-JudgeCorpus, a dataset of execution-grounded source-updated pairs with orchestration- and trajectory-level supervision, which can provide the community with support for MAS reward modeling and trajectory-aware investigation.
2610.38946.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) / Ant Group
2610.38946.update_target: MAS orchestration and trajectory-conditioned refinement policies
2610.38946.mechanism_en: A refiner diagnoses one execution failure, patches agents or information flow, and re-executes the system; paired outcomes train both policies.
2610.38946.result_en: The authors report the strongest overall results among tested baselines and release execution-grounded source/updated supervision.
2610.38946.boundary_en: Same-task stochastic re-execution needs budget and selection-noise controls; joint training is not independent evaluator improvement.
2610.38946.abstract_zh: 训练期多智能体系统设计旨在学习可复用的编排策略，但主流方法仍主要是一次性的：编排器生成一个系统，却只观察并学习其最终结果。这一范式丢弃了能揭示系统级失败、包含比最终结果更细粒度信息的执行轨迹，因此缺乏直接依据来修订原始系统、评估更新后的系统，或从二者的对比中学习。为此，我们提出 MAS-Loop，一个将编排器与轨迹条件化修订器耦合起来、以执行为基础闭合反馈循环的框架。对每个任务，编排器构建并执行原始多智能体系统，获得结果分数和中间轨迹。修订器依据轨迹定位可采取行动的失败，形成由轨迹支撑的诊断，并对智能体、信息流或执行配置提出有界补丁。更新后的可执行系统会在同一任务上再次执行，以测量随机执行条件下的实际结果。成对系统比较提供互补学习信号：编排器学习生成具有更少可修复失败的强系统，修订器则学习暴露和修复已观察到的弱点，从而在训练迭代中推动策略层面的共同演化。实验显示，MAS-Loop 在所评估基线中取得最强的总体表现，且在所有评估基准上修订均带来一致收益。共同演化过程还产生 MAS-JudgeCorpus，一个由执行支撑的原始—更新系统对数据集，提供编排级与轨迹级监督，可支持社区开展多智能体系统奖励建模和轨迹感知研究。

2610.39158.title: VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation
2610.39158.authors: Yuan Wang , Yuhang Yu , Mengting Chen , Tianrun Xu , Zihao Pan , Xuetao Feng , Wei Li
2610.39158.abstract_en: The central bottleneck in visual generation and editing has migrated from achieving pixel-level fidelity to satisfying densely constrained user specifications through increasingly agentic workflows. Prevailing agentic generation pipelines remain shallow generate-verify-rewrite loops treating VLM judgments as coarse visual feedback, either discarding repair experience or admitting ungated updates that poison skill library. With memorize and govern periods left open, they degrade into ungoverned iterators of repeated trial-and-error rather than continual self-evolving harness. Towards this issue, we present \textbf{VEvo-Harness}, the first causally-guarded continual self-evolving harness system for agentic visual generation. VEvo-Harness introduces four coupled innovations: (1) \textit{a visual traceback} that densifies sparse judgments into root-cause attributions with a hierarchical verification tree; (2) \textit{a visual continual governance} that admits only causally valid skill patches through counterfactual dual-arm image generation replay; (3) \textit{a lifecycle-managed harness state} that hierarchically distills root-cause-anchored episodes across working, experience, and pattern tiers into a persistent skill library of routable and causally verified capabilities; (4) \textit{a heterogeneous sandbox policy} that orchestrates a diverse action space of repair primitives, dynamically routing cost-aware interventions based on root causes to select the most effective strategy. VEvo-Harness surpasses state-of-the-art agentic methods and rivals proprietary generators (\textit{e.g.}, GPT-Image, Nano-Pro) while maintaining the continual harness evolution and generalization.
2610.39158.affiliation: Taobao & Tmall Group, Alibaba / Tsinghua University
2610.39158.update_target: Persistent visual-generation skill library and repair harness
2610.39158.mechanism_en: Root-cause traceback proposes skill patches; counterfactual two-arm image replay gates admission into a lifecycle-managed library.
2610.39158.result_en: The authors report superiority to tested agentic methods and competitive proprietary-generator results; no aggregate number appears in the abstract.
2610.39158.boundary_en: Causal validity is a reported design objective; replay quality and verifier independence need inspection before accepting broad generalization.
2610.39158.abstract_zh: 视觉生成与编辑的主要瓶颈，已从实现像素级保真转向通过日益智能体化的工作流满足密集约束的用户需求。现有智能体生成流水线通常只是浅层的生成—验证—重写循环，把视觉语言模型判断当作粗略视觉反馈，要么丢弃修复经验，要么允许未经把关的更新污染技能库。由于记忆和治理环节未闭合，它们会退化为无治理的反复试错迭代器，而非持续自进化的 harness。为解决这一问题，我们提出 VEvo-Harness，首个以因果约束把关、面向智能体视觉生成的持续自进化 harness 系统。VEvo-Harness 引入四项耦合创新：（1）视觉溯源，通过分层验证树将稀疏判断转化为根因归因；（2）视觉持续治理，通过反事实双臂图像生成重放，只接纳具有因果有效性的技能补丁；（3）具备生命周期管理的 harness 状态，将以根因为锚的片段在工作、经验和模式层级间分层蒸馏，形成可路由、经因果验证的持久技能库；（4）异构沙箱策略，组织多样化修复原语动作空间，依据根因动态路由考虑成本的干预，以选择最有效的策略。VEvo-Harness 超过最先进的智能体方法，并可与 GPT-Image、Nano-Pro 等专有生成器竞争，同时保持持续的 harness 演化和泛化能力。

2610.39276.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
2610.39276.authors: Jie Huang , Cuiling Lan , Qize Yu , Xiulian Peng , Yan Lu
2610.39276.abstract_en: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and context construction without updating model parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show that this supervision is competitive with official-QA-guided optimization. Relative to Base-BM25, MemSteer-Opt improves ATM-Bench Question Score by 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy by 4.1 and 6.6 points without and with external data, respectively. The supervision also benefits two existing optimizers on ATM-Bench, while new-user experiments demonstrate continued design optimization using supervision generated from the target histories.
2610.39276.update_target: Memory store, retrieval and context-construction design; frozen weights
2610.39276.mechanism_en: History-derived QA plans undergo source audits and blind recovery; evidence-based diagnosis revises the memory design.
2610.39276.result_en: Over Base-BM25, ATM-Bench gains 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy gains 4.1/6.6 points without/with external data.
2610.39276.boundary_en: Generated supervision may encode history-specific biases; target-history optimization needs separation from held-out evaluation.
2610.39276.abstract_zh: 有效的智能体记忆系统应适应用户历史与任务需求。人工标注监督可通过反馈来评估和改善记忆设计，从而指导这种适应。然而，新的用户历史往往缺乏合适标签，手工构造问答对及支持证据的成本也很高。我们提出 MemSteer，将无标签用户历史转化为附有支持证据的问答监督，用于优化记忆设计。MemSteer 构建以证据为基础的答案计划，明确相关记录中的事实如何共同支持参考答案。该计划引导问题生成，并通过来源支撑的审计和盲答案恢复检查所生成标注。为研究这种监督的效用，我们开发 MemSteer-Opt，将基于问答的设计评估与证据引导的失败诊断相结合，在不更新模型参数的情况下修订记忆存储、检索及上下文构建。在 ATM-Bench 和 RHELM 上的实验显示，这种监督可与官方问答指导的优化相竞争。相对 Base-BM25，MemSteer-Opt 将 ATM-Bench 的问题分数提高 13.4 分，并在无外部数据和有外部数据时分别将 RHELM 准确率提高 4.1 和 6.6 个百分点。该监督也使 ATM-Bench 上两个已有优化器受益，而新用户实验表明，可使用从目标历史生成的监督继续优化设计。

2610.39352.title: Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems
2610.39352.authors: Xu Huang , Jiawei Feng , Jiancan Wu
2610.39352.abstract_en: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.
2610.39352.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China
2610.39352.update_target: Recommender training recipes and subsequent learned recommenders
2610.39352.mechanism_en: Diverse edits get short training trials scored by held-out full-ranking NDCG@10 before one candidate receives full retraining.
2610.39352.result_en: With equal full-retraining counts, RecRSI beats tested agents in all six settings; on both Amazon datasets its first round exceeds their five-round best.
2610.39352.boundary_en: Equal full retraining is not equal total compute: candidate-trial and probe-user costs must also be counted.
2610.39352.abstract_zh: 电商、音乐流媒体等网络平台上的推荐系统需要针对每个数据集重新调节训练配方。大语言模型智能体如今能够重写这些配方，从而实现推荐系统的递归自我改进。已有智能体每轮提出一次修改，完整重训推荐器，并只在排序质量提高时保留修改。与可通过执行评分的程序或补丁不同，推荐器修改会改变模型的训练方式，由此带来两个挑战。第一，排序反馈滞后：只有完整重训后才能知道修改的排序质量，因此大量重训预算花在最终被丢弃的修改上。第二，重训前可获得的信号不可靠：采样训练损失可能看似已解决，而全量排序性能仍很差；当修改改变损失函数或采样器时，这些信号也不可比较。我们提出 RecRSI，依据对当前模型的诊断生成多样候选修改，再通过早期排序反馈选择一个进行完整重训：每个候选接受一段短试验，即其完整训练运行的最初若干步，并以留出探测用户上的全量排序 NDCG@10 评分。使用两个序列推荐器、三个数据集，并保持完整重训次数一致时，RecRSI 在所有设置中都显著超过已有自进化智能体；在两个 Amazon 数据集上，它第一轮达到的排序质量就超过这些方法五轮内的最佳水平。

2610.39508.title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
2610.39508.authors: Chengyu Yang , Yunxiang Zheng , Zongzheng Li , Jiamei Li , Boxun Lan , Xiaoyu Liu , Xiaoyu Zhang , Xiaohong Chen , Ming Hu
2610.39508.abstract_en: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs hybrid skill skeletons that retain LLM reasoning for context-dependent operations while compiling well-specified ones into validated programs. To avoid redundant program synthesis and enable executable knowledge to accumulate across evolving skills, we further design a program asset reuse mechanism that organizes validated programs as reusable assets, retrieves existing implementations whenever applicable, and synthesizes and verifies new programs only when necessary. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks and six model families demonstrate that SkillCompiler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 32.33\% improvement in task performance.
2610.39508.affiliation: East China Normal University / China University of Geoscience (as printed)
2610.39508.update_target: Hybrid textual/programmatic skills and validated program assets
2610.39508.mechanism_en: Executability analysis compiles deterministic operations, validates programs, and reuses existing assets before synthesizing new ones.
2610.39508.result_en: Across five benchmarks and six model families, the authors report up to 32.33% task-performance improvement.
2610.39508.boundary_en: Compilation verifies specified operations, not the correctness of every contextual decision or an unlimited improvement process.
2610.39508.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体技能使 AI 智能体能在不更新模型参数的情况下，从交互经验中累积和完善可复用的程序性知识。然而，这些技能通常以文本文件表示，并通过 LLM 推理执行，因此即使是已经学会的程序也必须被反复解释与重新生成，为每次执行引入可避免的不确定性。相比之下，程序执行具有确定性，并可独立验证。直观上，将明确规定的操作转化为可执行程序，可以减少对 LLM 推理的依赖，从而降低执行不确定性。基于这一认识，我们提出 SkillCompiler，一个把程序化编译融入技能演化过程的自进化技能框架。具体而言，SkillCompiler 采用可执行性感知的技能编译策略，将技能分解为细粒度操作、分析其可执行性，并构建混合技能骨架：对依赖上下文的操作保留 LLM 推理，对规定明确的操作则编译为经过验证的程序。为避免重复程序合成，并使可执行知识在演化技能间累积，我们进一步设计程序资产复用机制，将已验证程序组织为可复用资产，在适用时检索已有实现，只在必要时合成并验证新程序。在五个基准与六个模型系列上的大量实验表明，SkillCompiler 持续超过最先进方法，任务性能提升最高达 32.33%。

2610.39682.title: Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels
2610.39682.authors: Qin-Wen Luo , Sheng Ren , Xiang Chen , Rui Liu , Jun Fang , Naiqiang Tan , Jun Wang , Hua Chai , Sheng-Jun Huang
2610.39682.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
2610.39682.abstract_en: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. To jointly optimize task difficulty and search efficiency, \textsc{ZEST-Search} employs an intermediate-difficulty reward for the proposer and a task-local tool-aware reward for the solver, encouraging informative tasks and correct answers with fewer redundant searches. Experiments on seven general-domain and multi-hop question answering benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ZEST-Search} consistently improves search-agent performance while achieving higher tool efficiency without labeled search-training data or expert search trajectories. Further analyses show that heterogeneous generation, adaptive difficulty control, and tool-aware optimization enable more effective search-agent training.
2610.39682.affiliation: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics / Didichuxing
2610.39682.update_target: Search-agent solver policy and task proposer
2610.39682.mechanism_en: Answer-first evidence paths validate generated tasks; proposer difficulty and solver tool-efficiency rewards jointly adapt training.
2610.39682.result_en: Seven QA benchmarks show reported gains in both search-agent accuracy and tool efficiency without labeled search trajectories.
2610.39682.boundary_en: Zero labels still uses reference questions, evidence and validation machinery; tool-aware rewards may have evaluator blind spots.
2610.39682.abstract_zh: 深度搜索智能体通过交替进行推理与外部检索来扩展语言模型。然而，有效的搜索智能体训练除了优化最终答案，还需解决两个挑战。第一，智能体能力边界在很大程度上由训练问题决定，而固定或带标签任务集无法随智能体进步而适应。第二，只看结果的强化学习将所有成功轨迹同等对待，即使一些正确答案依赖冗余搜索，这使答案准确率与工具效率之间存在内在张力。为此，我们提出 ZEST-Search，一个通过异构共同演化实现零标签、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架。从无标签参考问题出发，ZEST-Search 采用答案优先、证据路径引导的生成过程，在线构建经过验证的搜索任务。异构提议者围绕求解器不断变化的能力边界自适应构建训练任务，求解器则通过强化学习学习搜索增强推理。为联合优化任务难度与搜索效率，ZEST-Search 为提议者采用中等难度奖励，为求解器采用任务局部的工具感知奖励，鼓励生成有信息量的任务，并以更少冗余搜索取得正确答案。在七个通用领域和多跳问答基准上的实验表明，ZEST-Search 在不使用带标签搜索训练数据或专家搜索轨迹的情况下，持续提高搜索智能体性能，同时实现更高工具效率。进一步分析表明，异构生成、自适应难度控制与工具感知优化支持更有效的搜索智能体训练。

2610.39714.title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
2610.39714.authors: Yikun Zhang , Xiwei Cheng , Mingze Yuan , Yu Zhang , Brian Shim , Aarti Krishnan , Daniel Rosen , Kunyang Sun , Yingze Wang , Zhenfeng Deng , Botao Yu , Bingxu Liu , David Liu , Tianyu Liu , Yuanqi Du , Nir Hacohen , James J. Collins , Wengong Jin
2610.39714.abstract_en: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.
2610.39714.affiliation: Northeastern University / Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard / Harvard University / MIT / collaborating institutions (14 source affiliation entries)
2610.39714.update_target: Molecular workflows, model architectures and cross-task search memory
2610.39714.mechanism_en: Performance, refinement outcomes and execution feedback alter later workflow searches and the strategy that constructs them.
2610.39714.result_en: Reported wet-lab results include 15.9% antibiotic hits versus 8.7% for the matched expert workflow, plus eight validated peptide-MHC hits.
2610.39714.boundary_en: Experimental hits are bounded by the tested library, targets and off-targets; they are not clinical efficacy or an independent reproduction.
2610.39714.abstract_zh: 分子发现需要在巨大的组合搜索空间中导航，同时平衡相互竞争的生物学目标。AI 智能体能够自动执行专家定义的分子设计流程，但自动化本身不能解决如何针对新任务优化工作流，或如何通过经验改善其开发过程。我们提出 MoLRSI，一个结合工作流与模型架构的系统优化、持久跨任务记忆的 AI 智能体，以递归改进其分子发现搜索策略。工作流性能、完善结果和执行反馈指导后续搜索，使智能体既能改善工作流，也能改善开发工作流的策略。我们在两个需要平衡竞争属性的高难度分子发现设置中评估 MoLRSI。在抗生素发现中，MoLRSI 开发了兼顾抗菌活性、细胞毒性和结构新颖性的筛选流程，实验命中率为 15.9%；使用相同训练数据和筛选库的先前专家主导流程为 8.7%。在从头肽—MHC 结合物设计中，MoLRSI 开发的流程联合考虑靶标结合和特异性，针对 MART-1 与 SARS-CoV-1 pMHC 产生八个经实验验证的命中物，相对所测试的脱靶对象具有优先结合，而 Claude Science 完全失败。这些结果表明，经验引导的工作流优化可以应对相互竞争的发现目标，同时改善后续研究活动使用的搜索策略。

2610.39813.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
2610.39813.authors: Qinuo Cao , Xin He , Dianxuan Fu , Lizhi Zhang , Zhaoqing Xing , Jiapu Wang , Xin Wang , Na Zou , Yi Chang , Qinggang Zhang
2610.39813.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. It maintains a library of reusable teams, selecting or creating agent teams and guiding collaboration through team-specific interaction rules. Collaboration experience accumulates within compatible team contexts, while individual skills remain reusable across teams. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness. Our code is available at this https URL .
2610.39813.affiliation: Jilin University / Nanjing University of Science and Technology / Shanghai AI Lab
2610.39813.update_target: Reusable teams, team-specific interaction rules and individual skills
2610.39813.mechanism_en: Execution experience updates compatible team contexts while permitting skill reuse across distinct teams.
2610.39813.result_en: Four benchmarks support the reported collaboration gains; the abstract supplies no common numerical effect size.
2610.39813.boundary_en: Joint organization and skill changes require ablations to attribute improvement; team libraries do not imply self-modifying backbone weights.
2610.39813.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统依靠专门化智能体之间的协作解决复杂任务。已有方法根据任务反馈，完善单个智能体的提示、技能与执行策略，从而改善系统。然而，改善个体并不必然带来更好的团队协作。因此，近期研究将演化扩展到协作层面，使用集体执行经验调整团队组织和智能体间交互。不过，在异构任务间演化协作仍具有挑战，因为已有方法往往将团队重组限制在共享结构中，并在不兼容的团队上下文间复用交互规则。本文提出 EvoTeam，一个以协作为中心的演化框架，通过执行经验联合演化团队组织、交互规则及个体智能体技能。它维护可复用的团队库，选择或创建智能体团队，并通过团队专属交互规则指导协作。协作经验在兼容的团队上下文中累积，而个体技能仍可跨团队复用。四个基准上的实验验证了其有效性。我们的代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.40023.title: HEMO: Harness Self-Evolution for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
2610.40023.authors: Jianghan Zhu , Cong Zhang , Ni Zhang , Yifan Yang , Yew Soon Ong , Zhiguang Cao
2610.40023.categories: Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.40023.abstract_en: Automatic operator design (AOD) has increasingly adopted large language models (LLMs) to generate problem-specific search and variation operators for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO). Yet most methods evolve the operators while leaving the process that discovers them fixed. This limits adaptation as new Pareto trade-offs and operator interactions change where and how the search should proceed. We introduce HEMO, which makes the AOD harness itself a self-evolving optimization target. HEMO maintains a persistent harness state and updates one module at a time, revising the logic that determines which experience to retrieve, which operators to improve, which parents to select, and how to formulate the orchestration of search steps. Downstream solution quality and runtime guide these updates, while a discounted UCB scheduler directs adaptation toward promising modules as their utility changes. A persistent memory filesystem preserves candidate outcomes and diagnostic feedback across harness states, enabling successive states to build on accumulated optimization experience. Experiments across eight MOCO tasks and two structurally distinct evolutionary backbones demonstrate strong performance against conventional evolutionary, neural, and LLM-based AOD baselines, together with effective transfer to related tasks. HEMO extends automatic operator design beyond evolving individual operators to improving the search process that discovers them.
2610.40023.affiliation: Singapore Management University / Nanyang Technological University / Independent researcher
2610.40023.mechanism_en: One-module-at-a-time edits change retrieval, parent/operator selection and search orchestration; quality/runtime feedback and discounted UCB guide later edits.
2610.40023.result_en: Eight multi-objective combinatorial-optimization tasks and two evolutionary backbones show reported gains and related-task transfer.
2610.40023.boundary_en: This directly targets the improver, but finite task suites and the scheduler do not establish unbounded recursion or global Pareto dominance.
2610.40023.abstract_zh: 自动算子设计越来越多地采用大语言模型，为多目标组合优化生成问题专属的搜索与变异算子。然而，大多数方法只演化算子，却保持发现算子的过程不变。这限制了随着新 Pareto 权衡和算子相互作用出现，对搜索位置和搜索方式的适应。我们提出 HEMO，将自动算子设计的 harness 本身设为自进化优化目标。HEMO 维护持久 harness 状态，每次更新一个模块，修订决定检索哪些经验、改善哪些算子、选择哪些父代，以及如何组织搜索步骤的逻辑。下游解质量与运行时间指导这些更新，折扣 UCB 调度器则随着模块效用变化，将适应引向有前景的模块。持久记忆文件系统在不同 harness 状态间保存候选结果与诊断反馈，使后续状态能建立在累积优化经验之上。在八个多目标组合优化任务及两种结构不同的进化骨干上的实验表明，HEMO 相对传统进化、神经和基于 LLM 的自动算子设计基线表现强劲，并能有效迁移到相关任务。HEMO 将自动算子设计从演化单个算子，扩展为改进发现算子的搜索过程。

2610.40096.title: Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric
2610.40096.authors: Yizhu Chen , Jianguang Jiang , Jiameng Huang , Chuyu Fang , Bojun Zhang , Zhenyu Jiao , Xing Yuan , Tong Lin
2610.40096.abstract_en: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. Rubric phases train the generator on cached pairs using a frozen judge and a scale-normalized pairwise-margin reward. Across both levels, online threshold adaptation adjusts routing and switching thresholds through proportional control. Under a unified evaluation protocol, RACE achieves the highest average performance and outperforms the strongest fixed-alternation baseline on all eight tasks, while improving rubric discrimination.
2610.40096.affiliation: Peking University / Baidu / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.40096.update_target: Policy, rubric generator and adaptive training-signal routing
2610.40096.mechanism_en: Informative groups train policy; cached rubric failures trigger generator optimization with a frozen judge and proportional-control thresholds.
2610.40096.result_en: RACE reports the best average and gains over the strongest fixed-alternation baseline on all eight tasks.
2610.40096.boundary_en: A frozen judge anchors consistency but may limit the evolving rubric; controller adaptation is not evidence of independent truth verification.
2610.40096.abstract_zh: 基于评分细则的奖励为开放式强化学习提供细粒度、可解释的监督，弥补整体标量奖励难以捕捉回答质量多个维度的不足。随着策略分布演化，静态细则可能丧失区分能力，而现有策略—细则共同演化方法依赖全局预设更新日程，忽视奖励信息量的异质性。我们提出奖励自适应共同演化框架 RACE。在组级，每个轨迹组的训练信号路由将其分为有信息量、多样性坍缩或细则失效三类，只使用有信息量的组更新策略，同时缓存细则失败。在阶段级，事件触发的阶段切换会在奖励持续饱和时进入细则优化，并在细则奖励改善进入平台期时返回。细则阶段使用冻结评判器与按尺度归一化的成对间隔奖励，在缓存样本对上训练生成器。在这两个层级中，在线阈值适应均通过比例控制调整路由与切换阈值。在统一评测协议下，RACE 取得最高平均性能，并在全部八个任务上超过最强固定交替基线，同时改善细则区分度。

2610.37680.title: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
2610.37680.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.37680.abstract_en: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Claude Haiku 4.5 outperform unaided Claude Sonnet 4.5 on spatial reasoning (0.707 vs. 0.647) at 60% of its cost, and reach Sonnet 4.5's level on table joining at 89% of its cost. The same raw bank raises Qwen3.5-27B's pooled score from 0.730 to 0.800, showing that transfer is not confined to the teacher's model family.
2610.37680.update_target: External procedural artifact bank; no student gradient updates
2610.37680.mechanism_en: A frontier teacher solves training instances and externalizes procedures that a smaller student retrieves on later problems.
2610.37680.result_en: On spatial reasoning, Haiku reaches 0.707 versus Sonnet 0.647 at 60% cost; the bank also raises Qwen3.5-27B from 0.730 to 0.800.
2610.37680.boundary_en: Reusable transfer is demonstrated; the bank is not shown recursively improving its own construction or the frozen student weights.
2610.37680.abstract_zh: 缩小前沿语言模型与小模型的差距，通常采用蒸馏：在前沿模型（教师）的输出上微调小模型（学生）。这使迁移依赖训练算力，也让迁移知识在很大程度上不透明。我们提出 Artifact Distillation：教师解决训练实例，并将其解题程序外化为工件库，学生在推理时查询该库，无需梯度更新。在四个 LiveBench 任务上，Claude Opus 4.5 编写的工件库使 Claude Haiku 4.5 在空间推理上超过未获辅助的 Claude Sonnet 4.5（0.707 对 0.647），成本为其 60%；在表连接任务上，以 89% 的成本达到 Sonnet 4.5 的水平。同一原始工件库还将 Qwen3.5-27B 的汇总分数从 0.730 提高到 0.800，表明迁移并不限于教师模型所属系列。

2610.37926.title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
2610.37926.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
2610.37926.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.
2610.37926.update_target: Reusable reward programs; fixed learning algorithm and final-selection rule
2610.37926.mechanism_en: An LLM investigates environment code, training records and behavior, then tests reward drafts with trial learning runs.
2610.37926.result_en: Held-out Overcooked returns improve by 58.2%/52.5%; SMAX mean win rate rises from 51.0% to 89.9%.
2610.37926.boundary_en: The transferred reward is fixed on unseen scenarios; reward engineering does not itself show the engineer or selection procedure improving.
2610.37926.abstract_zh: 合作式多智能体强化学习使机器人、自动驾驶车辆等智能体团队学习协调行为，但团队学到什么，很大程度上由奖励函数决定。由于任务成功本身为学习提供的指导太少，中间奖励通常需要手工设计，而且环境或团队变化时往往要重新投入这项工作。大语言模型可以通过编写奖励函数代码来自动完成这项工作，但产生的奖励通常只在单一设置中设计和测试。为实现跨设置复用，我们提出 GARDEN，即通过证据导航实现通用自主奖励设计：为一组相关场景开发一个奖励程序，再将其不作修改地迁移到设计时未见的场景。在开发期间，LLM 奖励工程师调查环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为，并在试验训练中测试奖励草案，同时保持学习算法与最终奖励选择规则不变。在 Overcooked 和 SMAX 基准的未见场景中，两个厨房布局的任务回报比默认奖励分别提高 58.2% 和 52.5%，两个战斗场景的平均胜率从 51.0% 提高到 89.9%。在候选与探测预算匹配时，这超过了固定诊断反馈与受 Eureka 启发的奖励反思所达到的 84.2% 和 79.2%。这些结果表明，单个自主设计的奖励能够在相关合作场景间有效复用。

2610.37935.title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
2610.37935.authors: Yuxuan Zhu , Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri , Pin-Yu Chen , Keerthiram Murugesan
2610.37935.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.37935.abstract_en: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.
2610.37935.update_target: Small external latent skill memories and a shared reader; frozen backbone
2610.37935.mechanism_en: Successful/failed trajectory pairs yield text skills; behavioral distillation compiles their token effects into reusable latent memories.
2610.37935.result_en: Each skill uses 9.6 KB; a 100-skill library reduces storage by over 38x and inference gains reach 4.23x.
2610.37935.boundary_en: The memory and reader are trained even though the backbone is frozen; compression and reuse are not recursive improver gains.
2610.37935.abstract_zh: 潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理与智能体间通信保留在连续表示中，降低推理成本。然而，可复用技能通常以文本提供，或存储为逐层键值状态、技能专属模型参数，带来重复处理或较大的逐技能存储开销。我们提出 SkillMem，将每个可复用技能表示为一个小型外部潜在记忆，并在潜在多智能体推理时直接提供。具备角色条件的交叉注意力读取器使同一记忆能根据不同智能体的角色和当前隐藏状态提供指导。我们通过行为蒸馏训练技能记忆与共享读取器，在保持骨干冻结的同时，匹配文本技能引起的词元预测变化。实验中的文本技能来自成对的成功与失败多智能体轨迹，也可以直接编译已有技能。在六个基准及参数量从 4B 到 14B 的 Qwen3 模型上，SkillMem 为较小骨干带来显著增益，并在不同模型规模下保持高效潜在多智能体推理。我们在所有评估规模上使用相同的 8×256 记忆配置，计入检索嵌入后，每个技能仅需 9.6 KB 专属存储。对于含 100 个技能的库，SkillMem 相比其他技能表示将总存储降低超过 38 倍，并实现最高 4.23 倍端到端推理加速。这些结果表明，紧凑程序性记忆可以在不牺牲潜在多智能体推理效率的情况下复用。

2610.38332.title: MUSE: Multi-Level Memory with Selective Runtime Injection for Scientific Coding Agents
2610.38332.authors: Haoran Jin , Defu Lian , Xiting Wang , Hong Xie
2610.38332.abstract_en: Historical experience can guide scientific coding at multiple levels, but task-level retrieval may miss implementation lessons that become relevant during execution. We introduce MUSE, a memory management framework combining multi-level memory with selective runtime injection for scientific coding agents. MUSE builds global, approach-level, and implementation-level memory from historical trajectories. At initialization, the agent receives global memory and problem-matched approach-level memory. During execution, current interactions are used to retrieve implementation-level memory. An LLM gate selects relevant experience and generates specific review advice, or skips injection. Across four benchmarks spanning numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair, MUSE outperforms retrieval and memory baselines on all evaluation metrics. Ablations support the multi-level design and gated injection, while transfer experiments show that memory remains useful across kernel benchmarks. These results show that multi-level memory and selective runtime injection enable effective reuse of experience in scientific coding. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.38332.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence / Renmin University of China
2610.38332.update_target: Global, approach-level and implementation-level experience memories
2610.38332.mechanism_en: Historical trajectories populate three levels; interaction-conditioned retrieval and an LLM gate inject relevant implementation advice or abstain.
2610.38332.result_en: Four scientific-coding benchmarks show reported improvements over memory/retrieval baselines, with cross-kernel transfer evidence.
2610.38332.boundary_en: Historical experience reuse is explicit; the abstract does not establish online self-revision of the memory-construction procedure.
2610.38332.abstract_zh: 历史经验可以在多个层面指导科学编程，但任务级检索可能遗漏在执行过程中才变得相关的实现经验。我们提出 MUSE，一个面向科学编程智能体、结合多层记忆与选择性运行时注入的记忆管理框架。MUSE 从历史轨迹中构建全局、方法级和实现级记忆。在初始化时，智能体接收全局记忆以及与问题匹配的方法级记忆。在执行期间，使用当前交互检索实现级记忆。LLM 门控选择相关经验并生成具体审查建议，或跳过注入。在覆盖数值问题求解、内核优化和科学软件修复的四个基准上，MUSE 在所有评测指标上均超过检索与记忆基线。消融支持多层设计与门控注入，迁移实验则表明，记忆在不同内核基准间仍然有用。这些结果表明，多层记忆与选择性运行时注入能够有效复用科学编程经验。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.38388.title: ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation
2610.38388.authors: Shiqi Liu , Radu Corcodel , Ding Zhao
2610.38388.abstract_en: Quadrupedal manipulators can extend their workspace through whole-body interaction, but task-planning agents' capabilities remain limited by their available controllers. We present ELEVATE, a framework that uses persistent failures during task-program refinement to identify and acquire missing whole-body control capabilities. When these failures suggest a missing physical capability, a coding agent formulates and iteratively refines a reinforcement-learning problem, specifying behavior-specific rewards, curricula, and termination conditions. Validated controllers are added to the capability library and composed with existing controllers to retry the task. Starting from a single pretrained loco-manipulation controller, ELEVATE autonomously acquires controllers for wall-supported elevation, supported manipulation, and wall descent across a sequence of seven simulation tasks. These controllers are reused in subsequent reaching and object-manipulation tasks. On the five tasks beyond the initial controller's workspace, ELEVATE achieves mean success rates of 98.4%-100% across five independent runs, while coding-agent baselines with a fixed controller library fail to complete these tasks. The synthesized task programs, together with the acquired controllers, also transfer to a physical quadrupedal manipulator without real-robot training or fine-tuning, achieving 18/20 successes in rack retrieval and 16/20 in floor-to-rack placement. Videos and demonstrations are available at this https URL .
2610.38388.affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University / Mitsubishi Electric Research Labs
2610.38388.update_target: Reusable whole-body controllers, RL problem definitions and task programs
2610.38388.mechanism_en: Persistent task-refinement failures trigger reward/curriculum synthesis; validated learned controllers enter the library and solve later tasks.
2610.38388.result_en: Five difficult simulation tasks reach 98.4%-100% mean success; hardware transfer reports 18/20 rack retrieval and 16/20 placement successes.
2610.38388.boundary_en: The acquired controllers are trained in simulation; physical transfer uses no real-robot training, and the sequence contains only seven tasks.
2610.38388.abstract_zh: 四足机械臂可以通过全身交互扩展工作空间，但任务规划智能体的能力仍受限于可用控制器。我们提出 ELEVATE，一个利用任务程序完善过程中的持续失败来识别并获取缺失全身控制能力的框架。当这些失败暗示缺少某项物理能力时，编程智能体制定并迭代完善一个强化学习问题，规定行为专属的奖励、课程与终止条件。经过验证的控制器被加入能力库，并与已有控制器组合，以重试任务。从单个预训练移动操作控制器出发，ELEVATE 在七个仿真任务的序列中，自主获得支墙抬升、支撑操作和沿墙下降控制器。这些控制器在后续伸取与物体操作任务中得到复用。在超出初始控制器工作空间的五个任务上，ELEVATE 在五次独立运行中的平均成功率达到 98.4%—100%，而使用固定控制器库的编程智能体基线无法完成这些任务。合成的任务程序连同获取的控制器，还能在不进行真实机器人训练或微调的情况下迁移到实体四足机械臂，在货架取物中取得 18/20 次成功，在地面到货架放置中取得 16/20 次成功。视频和演示见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.38391.title: SCOPE: Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.38391.authors: Qirui Liu , Wei Cao , Yu Mi , Yichen Sun , Xuekun Zhang , Lei Liu , Yue Shen , Zhixuan Chu
2610.38391.abstract_en: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides coarse supervision for long-horizon LLM agents: failed trajectories may contain correct steps, while successful trajectories can contain errors. Trajectory-level skills can also shift teacher preferences at unrelated steps, introducing off-target distillation signals. We introduce SCOPE, a framework for Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation. After a supervised warm-up, the policy analyzes its own trajectories, generates step-specific hindsight skills, and distills their guidance only at selected error steps. A bounded signed teacher-student coefficient stabilizes auxiliary updates while preserving positive reinforcement and negative correction. A success-relative pairwise length reward further encourages efficient task completion. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple model backbones. With Qwen2.5-3B, SCOPE achieves 97.7% success on ALFWorld and 85.2% on WebShop, outperforming SEED by 5.9 and 6.3 percentage points, respectively. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, SCOPE reaches 89.6% success, improving over GRPO by 23.2 percentage points with 46.7% fewer interactions. Scaling to Qwen3-32B, SCOPE achieves 99.2% success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 94.0% on unseen tasks.
2610.38391.update_target: Agent policy weights with selected hindsight-skill distillation
2610.38391.mechanism_en: The policy localizes errors, generates step-specific skills and distills only selected steps, with signed coefficients and length rewards.
2610.38391.result_en: Qwen2.5-3B reaches 97.7% ALFWorld and 85.2% WebShop; unseen ALFWorld reaches 89.6% with 46.7% fewer interactions than GRPO.
2610.38391.boundary_en: This is agentic RL plus self-distillation. The HTML abstract differs from the saved New abstract; numerical statements here follow the listing.
2610.38391.abstract_zh: 基于结果的强化学习为长程 LLM 智能体提供粗粒度监督：失败轨迹可能包含正确步骤，成功轨迹也可能包含错误。轨迹级技能还可能改变教师在无关步骤上的偏好，引入偏离目标的蒸馏信号。我们提出 SCOPE，即选择性关键步骤同策略自蒸馏框架。经过监督预热后，策略分析自身轨迹，生成针对特定步骤的事后技能，并只在选定错误步骤上蒸馏其指导。一个有界、有符号的师生系数稳定辅助更新，同时保留正向强化与负向纠正。相对于成功轨迹的成对长度奖励进一步鼓励高效完成任务。ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验在多个模型骨干间展示一致改进。使用 Qwen2.5-3B 时，SCOPE 在 ALFWorld 达到 97.7% 成功率，在 WebShop 达到 85.2%，分别超过 SEED 5.9 和 6.3 个百分点。在未见 ALFWorld 任务上，SCOPE 达到 89.6% 成功率，比 GRPO 提高 23.2 个百分点，同时减少 46.7% 交互。扩展到 Qwen3-32B 时，SCOPE 在已见 ALFWorld 任务上达到 99.2%，在未见任务上达到 94.0%。

2610.38450.title: CoSTA: Co-Evolving Self-Play Timeline Agents for Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
2610.38450.authors: Haikun Liu , Zhichao Yan , Shaoru Guo , Jiawei Gu , Victor Gutierrez Basulto , Jiapu Wang , Ru Li
2610.38450.abstract_en: Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) involves more than retrieving facts: the timestamp or validity interval of one fact can constrain the search for another, while multiple intervals may jointly determine the answer. Existing single-agent TKGQA methods typically investigate these facts within a single reasoning context, where evidence from different event histories can become interleaved and distractors can misdirect subsequent retrieval. Distributing investigations across agents can separate event-specific evidence into distinct contexts, but effective collaboration must still be learned because question decomposition, subtask investigation, and evidence synthesis are interdependent. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving \textbf{S}elf-Play \textbf{T}imeline \textbf{A}gents (CoSTA), which organizes facts into navigable timelines, delegates investigations to workers, and uses a coordinator to synthesize their original timestamped observations. CoSTA initializes a shared policy through role-conditioned distillation and jointly optimizes both roles through co-evolving self-play with final-answer rewards. Across three benchmarks, CoSTA achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with particularly strong gains on complex multi-fact questions, while its compact variants outperform the evaluated closed-source LLM agents.
2610.38450.affiliation: Shanxi University / Singapore University of Technology and Design / Cardiff University / Nanjing University of Science and Technology
2610.38450.mechanism_en: Role-conditioned distillation initializes agents; joint self-play uses final-answer rewards to improve investigation and synthesis.
2610.38450.result_en: The authors report state-of-the-art overall results on three temporal-KG benchmarks, especially multi-fact questions.
2610.38450.boundary_en: Belief/context organization and joint policy training do not alone show that the self-play algorithm is revised.
2610.38450.abstract_zh: 复杂时间知识图谱问答不仅是检索事实：一个事实的时间戳或有效区间可能约束另一个事实的搜索，多个区间也可能共同决定答案。已有单智能体方法通常在同一推理上下文中调查这些事实，不同事件历史的证据可能交织，干扰信息也可能误导后续检索。把调查分配给多个智能体，可以在不同上下文中分离事件专属证据，但由于问题分解、子任务调查和证据整合彼此依赖，有效协作仍需学习。为此，我们提出共同演化自博弈时间线智能体 CoSTA，将事实组织为可导航时间线，把调查委派给工作者，并使用协调者整合他们原始的、带时间戳的观察。CoSTA 通过角色条件化蒸馏初始化共享策略，再通过使用最终答案奖励的共同演化自博弈，联合优化两个角色。在三个基准上，CoSTA 取得最先进的总体性能，在复杂多事实问题上增益尤其明显；其紧凑版本也超过所评估的闭源 LLM 智能体。

2610.38568.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
2610.38568.authors: Yu Liu , Youxing Li , Yuedong Tan , Zhiwei Yang , Zihan Su , Hanqi Feng , Shaojie Zhang , Libin Liao , Zihao Wan , Chenxu Wu , Cong Cao , Fangfang Yuan , Yanbing Liu , Ziheng Chen , Pei Fu , Radu Timofte , Zongwei Wu , Nicu Sebe , Barnabas Poczos , Jian Luan
2610.38568.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: training dynamics determine when to acquire new experience, while the answers to new tasks remain independently checkable. A-RSI monitors reward variation and accuracy in training logs to refresh a task pool when its learning signal declines, without consulting validation or test scores. A static library of model-authored programs produces multimodal questions and derives their reference answers; we specify the task-generation contract, automatically verify chosen properties of the reward and refresh rules, and separately audit the generated answers. The training loop uses no external training examples or human-written answer labels. On the primary eleven-benchmark suite, A-RSI raises the performance average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks.
2610.38568.affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, CAS / Chinese University of Hong Kong / University of Wurzburg / Xiaomi / Harvard University / Carnegie Mellon University / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / University of Trento / Xi'an Jiaotong University
2610.38568.image_replacement_note: Automatic raster extraction selected a logo or auxiliary icon; replaced after visual inspection with the actual Figure 1.
2610.38568.update_target: Multimodal model weights and refreshed task pool; static program library
2610.38568.mechanism_en: Training-log reward variation and accuracy trigger refresh; program-derived answers and separate answer audits provide checkable supervision.
2610.38568.result_en: The eleven-benchmark average rises from 57.77 to 61.05 using 800 fresh tasks.
2610.38568.boundary_en: The generator library is static and refresh rules are fixed: adaptive data acquisition is not verified recursive improver gain.
2610.38568.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进不仅要求模型获取有用的训练经验，也要求决定当前经验何时已不再有用。已有方法通常关注接下来生成什么经验，却较少关注何时引入新经验。许多方法还通过自一致性或多数投票构建训练目标，使监督依赖模型自身不确定的预测。我们分别处理这两个问题：由训练动态决定何时获取新经验，而新任务的答案保持可独立检查。A-RSI 监测训练日志中的奖励变化和准确率，在学习信号减弱时刷新任务池，不查阅验证或测试分数。由模型编写程序组成的静态库生成多模态问题并推导参考答案；我们明确任务生成契约，自动验证奖励与刷新规则的选定性质，并单独审计生成答案。训练循环不使用外部训练样本或人工编写的答案标签。在主要的十一个基准套件上，A-RSI 用 800 个新任务将性能平均值从 57.77 提高到 61.05。

2610.38573.title: CALM: Conflict-Aware Lifecycle Memory Governance for Long-Horizon Language Agents
2610.38573.authors: Chang Li , Xianhao Ou , Xinyan Ma , Hao Li , Haoyuan Xu , Jiafeng Liang , Xiaohan Wang , Jiajun Chai , Guojun Yin , Ming Liu
2610.38573.abstract_en: A memory can be outdated for present-day reasoning yet indispensable for reconstructing the past. Relevance-based retrieval overlooks this tension: semantic relevance, evidence-grounded validity, and query-specific eligibility are distinct. We propose CALM, a conflict-aware lifecycle memory governance framework that decouples persistent memory preservation from query-time admission. CALM converts heterogeneous records into evidence-grounded memory cells, updates validity and lifecycle states using support, conflict, and dependency signals, and admits query-appropriate evidence through training-free or learned gating informed by temporal applicability. Across LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with Qwen and GPT backbones, CALM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the best overall accuracy. Compared with simple filtering and reranking, query-conditioned admission further improves evidence selection. Conflict-blocking and robustness analyses show CALM suppresses erroneous retrieved memories while retaining useful evidence. Historical-reconstruction experiments demonstrate that preserving superseded records supports accurate earlier-state reasoning without compromising current-state answers.
2610.38573.update_target: Memory validity/lifecycle state and query-conditioned admission
2610.38573.mechanism_en: Support, conflict and dependency signals update memory cells while gating separates current eligibility from historical preservation.
2610.38573.result_en: LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo results show reported accuracy gains and better historical reconstruction with retained superseded evidence.
2610.38573.boundary_en: Preserving and admitting memory are different operations; a better retrieval policy is not automatic revision of the learning procedure.
2610.38573.abstract_zh: 一段记忆可能对当前推理已经过时，却对重建过去不可或缺。基于相关性的检索忽视了这一张力：语义相关性、有证据支撑的有效性和特定查询下的适用资格是不同概念。我们提出 CALM，一个具备冲突感知的生命周期记忆治理框架，将持久记忆保存与查询时准入解耦。CALM 把异构记录转化为以证据为基础的记忆单元，根据支持、冲突和依赖信号更新有效性与生命周期状态，并通过由时间适用性指导的免训练或学习式门控，接纳适合查询的证据。在 LongMemEval-S 和 LoCoMo 上，使用 Qwen 和 GPT 骨干时，CALM 超过最先进基线，取得最佳总体准确率。相较简单过滤与重排序，查询条件化准入进一步改善证据选择。冲突阻断与鲁棒性分析表明，CALM 能抑制错误检索记忆，同时保留有用证据。历史重建实验显示，保存已被取代的记录支持准确推断早期状态，而不会损害当前状态答案。

2610.38637.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
2610.38637.authors: Shufan Shen , Zhongni Hou , Chao Bi , Yufei Zhang , Guojun Yin , Shuhui Wang
2610.38637.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.
2610.38637.affiliation: Institute of Computing Technology, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Meituan
2610.38637.update_target: Self-teacher and student weights plus reliability weighting
2610.38637.mechanism_en: Teacher rollouts receive correctness and context-independence feedback; teacher optimization and reliability-weighted student updates improve supervision.
2610.38637.result_en: Across multiple datasets and scales, TESD reportedly beats representative token- and sequence-level methods.
2610.38637.boundary_en: The shared model can carry shared mistakes; correctness feedback and context-independence tests bound what the loop verifies.
2610.38637.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏通过将学生模型的词元级分布与获得特权上下文提示的自教师分布对齐，已成为缓解序列级后训练中奖励稀疏性的一条有前景方向。然而，同策略自蒸馏往往无法在训练期间持续取得性能增益。本文发现，模型有限的自教学能力是这一现象的原因，因为它会在某些样本上产生不可靠指导。为此，我们提出教师演化自蒸馏 TESD，使自教师能够生成轨迹，并根据任务正确性与上下文独立性获得环境反馈。首先，以这些奖励为训练目标，进行面向教师的优化，在蒸馏过程中持续增强模型自教学能力。其次，根据这些奖励估计教师指导可靠性，并采用面向学生的自适应优化，降低指导不可靠样本的权重。在多个数据集和模型规模上的大量实验显示，TESD 持续超过具有代表性的词元级与序列级方法，凸显在同策略自蒸馏中改善监督质量的必要性。

2610.39180.title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
2610.39180.authors: Zhifeng Gu , Ying Chen , Rui Jiang , Lei Yi , Bing Wang
2610.39180.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.39180.abstract_en: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.
2610.39180.affiliation: Hong Kong Polytechnic University / XPENG Robotics
2610.39180.image_replacement_note: Automatic raster extraction selected a logo or auxiliary icon; replaced after visual inspection with the actual Figure 1.
2610.39180.update_target: Outcome-grounded subgoal experience bank; frozen banks at evaluation
2610.39180.mechanism_en: Applicability conditions and verified local outcomes support composition and extraction of useful successes from failed trajectories.
2610.39180.result_en: Multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol support experience-transfer effectiveness.
2610.39180.boundary_en: The evaluation freezes experience banks; online composition must not be described as continuous evaluation-time memory learning.
2610.39180.abstract_zh: 经验可以帮助具身智能体把高层计划转化为落地动作，但跨任务迁移仍具有挑战：过去有效的策略可能不适用于当前状态，或无法产生预期结果。我们提出 EmbodiExp，一个构建可迁移经验、并在具身任务执行中在线组合这些经验的框架。我们的关键观察是，任务通常共享一些子目标，而其完成情况可独立于总体任务成功来评估。因此，我们引入以结果为基础的子目标经验，明确子目标、适用条件、可适应策略和可验证结果。执行时，适用经验指导动作生成，而经过验证的结果可以建立后续经验所需的条件，从而实现在线组合。子目标级结果归因进一步支持利用失败：失败轨迹仍可贡献经过验证的局部成功，以及针对特定条件、说明哪些动作应避免的指导。在多个具身基准上，使用基于折叠划分且经验库冻结的协议开展实验，验证了 EmbodiExp 的有效性。
