2610.39417.title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
2610.39417.authors: Zhonghao Jiang , Xuyang Zheng , Yanfu Yan , Zhongxin Liu , Lingfeng Bao , Shuiguang Deng
2610.39417.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.39417.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.
2610.39417.affiliation: Zhejiang University / Hangzhou High-Tech Zone (Binjiang) Institute of Blockchain and Data Security
2610.39417.mechanism_en: Cross-instance experience is distilled into adaptive clarity/coverage criteria and reused to assess new software tasks.
2610.39417.result_en: ExLabel reports strong F1 gains; a model trained on its filtered data resolves 66.2% of SWE-bench Verified issues.
2610.39417.boundary_en: Judgment F1 and downstream coding success are distinct outcomes; quality filtering is not proof of self-improving benchmark truth.
2610.39417.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在软件工程任务上表现突出，推动了对可靠训练与评测所需高质量数据集的需求。SWE-bench 风格数据集广泛用于在真实软件问题上评估基于 LLM 的编程智能体，其中任务清晰度和测试覆盖率直接影响实例是否可求解、可验证。然而，已有数据集仍存在质量问题，而人工标注成本高、劳动密集，因此需要基于 LLM 的标注。现有方法通常依赖静态、过于通用的评分细则，难以处理多样且细微的情境，往往导致较高假阳性率。相比之下，人工标注者会借助累积经验作出上下文感知判断。受此启发，我们提出 ExLabel，一个基于 LLM、自进化且由经验指导的助手，用于评估 SWE 数据集的任务清晰度和测试覆盖率。ExLabel 维护不断演化的经验库，将跨实例知识蒸馏为稳定且可适应的判断标准，并复用相关经验指导新实例评估。为系统评测，我们清理 SWE-bench 和 Multi-SWE-bench 的人工标注，构建覆盖八种编程语言的新基准 SWE-TQ。三个骨干 LLM 上的实验显示，ExLabel 在所有设置中获得最佳 F1：在 Python/多语言子集上，相对最佳基线，任务清晰度评估分别改善 44.2%/49.9%，测试覆盖率评估分别改善 24.0%/18.4%。此外，在 ExLabel 过滤的 SWE-rebench 数据上微调的编程模型，在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决 66.2% 的问题，相对使用最佳基线过滤数据训练的模型提高 14.5%。

2610.39446.title: Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory
2610.39446.authors: Kai Sheng , Liuyi Wang , Jinlong Li , Haojie Dai , Chengju Liu , Qijun Chen
2610.39446.abstract_en: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.
2610.39446.update_target: Persistent spatial experience and interactive navigation harness
2610.39446.mechanism_en: Observations/dialogue bind to places; proactive clarification and retained memory guide later visits without a claimed weight update.
2610.39446.result_en: Reports include 98% complete-sequence LHPR-VLN success, 94% GOAT-Bench success, and R2R revisit SPL 82.23% to 93.31%.
2610.39446.boundary_en: Help-seeking, revisit memory and partial task credit must be separated; experience accumulation does not prove an improved learning algorithm.
2610.39446.abstract_zh: 让具身智能体能够自主行动、主动发起交互，并通过经验理解环境，是使其在物理世界中具有活力的一步。实现这一愿景，需要行动、交互与记忆共同工作，使每次相遇既能帮助当前决策，也能为未来任务贡献经验。我们提出 EvoLife，一个统一导航 harness，使多模态具身智能体能够选择如何移动、何时提问，以及将哪些经验带入未来。其混合动作空间支持航点导航、局部离散调整、基于像素的导航和面向物体的导航。主动交互使智能体在遇到歧义或困难时寻求澄清或帮助，持久空间记忆则将观察与对话绑定到地点，保留有用经验以指导后续访问。我们在四类任务的八个基准上评估：视觉语言导航、物体导航、交互式实例导航和连续多任务导航。每回合平均仅需 1.87 次主动交互，方法在覆盖视觉语言导航与物体导航的四组各 100 回合测试中，首次访问成功率达到 100%。在 50 条 LHPR-VLN 序列上，完整序列成功率达到 98%；在 50 条 GOAT-Bench 序列上达到 94%。在 R2R 重访设置中，保留经验使路径长度加权成功率从 82.23% 提高到 93.31%。多日实体导航进一步展示了探索、主动求助和重访记忆地点。总体而言，这些结果通过自主行动、主动交互以及经验累积复用，推进了让具身智能体具有活力的愿景。

2610.39775.title: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
2610.39775.authors: Kristian Ceder , Kilian Freitag , Knut Åkesson
2610.39775.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
2610.39775.update_target: Decision-tree supervisor and retained recovery rules
2610.39775.mechanism_en: An LLM labels new anomalies; counterfactual replay validates recovery need and retires unnecessary or harmful rules after episodes.
2610.39775.result_en: On 20 unseen simulated layouts, at least 18 are handled correctly across seeds, with no LLM queries at test time.
2610.39775.boundary_en: Correct handling includes calling for help when no path exists; simulation recovery is not a physical-robot demonstration.
2610.39775.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人通常将全局规划器与局部模型预测控制器结合，但非凸避障和有限时域可能使机器人在复杂布局中停滞。决定重新规划、等待还是求助，是一项监督层决策。近期工作在每次异常时查询大语言模型监督器，既慢又昂贵。我们改为在线将 LLM 蒸馏成决策树。每个训练回合之后，反事实重放将恢复标记为必要、不必要或有害，并用这些标签淘汰无益规则。在仿真中，面对 20 个仅用 MPC 会停滞的未见布局，决策树在所有种子下至少能正确处理 18 个：有可行路径时到达目标，无可行路径时求助。决策树与始终查询的 LLM 监督器及专家设计规则表现相当，而测试时不发起任何 LLM 查询。手写规则无法预见实体机器人将遇到的长尾情境。在线蒸馏是一种有前景的补救：树处理熟悉案例，只在新案例上咨询 LLM，并将经过验证的恢复转为新规则。因此，语言模型也可以充当监督器的设计者，而非仅充当运行时监督器。

2610.39884.title: KARMA: Training-Free Knowledge-Atomic Harness Evolution for Industrial Advertising Agents
2610.39884.authors: Xinhua Miao , Yuanzhen Rong , Weiru Zhang , Xiaoyi Zeng
2610.39884.abstract_en: Industrial advertising agents must continually adapt their decision knowledge to changing product offerings, traffic patterns, and operating policies. We present KARMA (Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation), a training-free framework that evolves six typed knowledge modules while keeping model weights and executable harness code frozen. During our evolution, a deterministic Trace Verifier maps observed errors to candidate modules, and a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories to guide a tool-constrained Evolver. The Evolver applies atomic knowledge edits, which a fixed validation gate retains only when their measured gain reaches a threshold; otherwise, the previous knowledge state is restored. We evaluate KARMA with three LLM families on cases sampled from a corpus of approximately half a million real-world operation logs across six e-commerce domains. Across 18 domain--model settings, KARMA raises the average hold-out score from 30.19 to 39.15 (+8.96 points, +29.7%). Ablations show that removing either successful or failed trajectories more than halves the average hold-out gain. Evolved knowledge also transfers across domains without further adaptation, yielding an average hold-out gain of 8.54 points across all source--target pairs. By linking retained patches to their diagnostic evidence and validation outcomes, KARMA supports inspectable, reversible knowledge adaptation for agents in Web marketplaces.
2610.39884.update_target: Six typed knowledge modules; frozen weights and executable harness
2610.39884.mechanism_en: Trace-based diagnosis and success/failure contrast propose atomic edits; a fixed score threshold retains gains or rolls back.
2610.39884.result_en: Across 18 settings, mean hold-out score rises 30.19 to 39.15; cross-domain gain averages 8.54 points.
2610.39884.boundary_en: Despite the harness-evolution title, executable code stays frozen: knowledge adaptation and improver-code modification must remain distinct.
2610.39884.abstract_zh: 工业广告智能体必须不断调整决策知识，以适应产品供给、流量模式与运营政策变化。我们提出 KARMA，即知识原子化、回归门控的模块适应框架；它无需训练，在保持模型权重和可执行 harness 代码冻结的同时，演化六种带类型的知识模块。在演化过程中，确定性的 Trace Verifier 将已观察错误映射到候选模块，Critic 比较成功与失败轨迹，为受工具约束的 Evolver 提供指导。Evolver 应用原子知识修改，固定验证门只在测量增益达到阈值时保留修改，否则恢复此前知识状态。我们在三个 LLM 系列上评估 KARMA，案例采样自覆盖六个电商领域、约五十万条真实操作日志的语料。在 18 个领域—模型设置中，KARMA 将平均留出分数从 30.19 提高到 39.15，增加 8.96 分，即 29.7%。消融表明，移除成功轨迹或失败轨迹，都会使平均留出增益减少一半以上。演化后的知识无需进一步适应也能跨领域迁移，在全部来源—目标组合上取得平均 8.54 分留出增益。通过将保留补丁与其诊断证据、验证结果关联，KARMA 支持网络市场智能体可检查、可逆的知识适应。

2610.40115.title: SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts
2610.40115.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at this https URL .
2610.40115.update_target: Unified model generator and understanding weights
2610.40115.mechanism_en: A frozen understanding pathway scores generated visual thoughts; selected thoughts train the generator and provide privileged self-distillation context.
2610.40115.result_en: ThinkMorph-7B seven-benchmark mean rises 52.7 to 64.0; perturbation probes show reported gains up to 40.4 points.
2610.40115.boundary_en: Frozen verification does not demonstrate verifier improvement; training uses small synthetic tasks and inference omits generated helper images.
2610.40115.abstract_zh: 统一多模态模型可以在同一组权重中同时生成和理解图像，为利用图像合成作为视觉理解训练监督提供了机会。然而，现有视觉思维链方法在训练期间依赖人工标注的辅助图像，并在测试时需要缓慢的图像生成。我们提出 SelfThinker，首个将统一模型自生成的视觉思维转化为更强理解能力、且无需人工图像标注的自进化框架。对于一个视觉问题，SelfThinker 从生成路径采样候选辅助图像，并使用冻结的理解路径，通过条件逐点互信息对每个候选评分。高效用视觉思维随后通过流匹配完善生成器，并作为同策略自蒸馏中的特权教师上下文。推理时，SelfThinker 直接从原始图像出发以文本推理，不生成中间图像。虽然只在小型合成视觉搜索与导航数据集上训练，SelfThinker 仍能广泛迁移到自然图像与空间基准，将 ThinkMorph-7B 的七基准平均分从 52.7 提高到 64.0，增加 11.3 分。受控图像扰动探测进一步显示，在细粒度与空间感知任务上，SelfThinker 比 ThinkMorph-7B 最高提高 40.4 分，比其预训练 BAGEL-7B 骨干最高提高 23.2 分。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.40565.title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
2610.40565.abstract_en: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $\pi_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at this https URL
2610.40565.update_target: Simulation/task code and embodied learner experience
2610.40565.mechanism_en: An adversarial creation-audit loop checks agent-authored simulations; repeated attempts, privileged teaching and demonstration code support learning.
2610.40565.result_en: RoboWorld contains 25 test and 175 training RL environments; frontier baselines fail all test tasks with mean reward 0.06.
2610.40565.boundary_en: This is simulated physical work; improved simulations and demonstrated learning routes do not establish broad real-world transfer.
2610.40565.abstract_zh: 真实且快速的机器人仿真能够支持大规模训练可迁移到现实世界的具身 AI 模型。然而，尽管经历数十年进展，可用仿真仍只覆盖现实任务和物理现象的一小部分。核心瓶颈是，创造更好的仿真需要大量专家劳动，因此难以扩展。为此，我们提出 Gym-Anything for Robotics，一个由编程智能体创建真实机器人仿真的框架。核心认识是，仿真创建本身是一项编程智能体任务，因此编程智能体的进步可以直接转化为更丰富、更忠实的仿真。我们依据美国 GDP 数据选择仿真，以覆盖具有经济价值的物理工作，定义什么是好的仿真与任务，并开发对抗式创建—审计循环，依据这些定义检查每个仿真和任务。借助该流水线，我们构建 RoboWorld，包含 25 个仿真，以及 25 个测试和 175 个不同难度的训练强化学习环境。即使最强前沿模型也无法完成任何 RoboWorld 测试任务，平均奖励仅为 0.06。在 RoboWorld 基础上，我们提出多种改善前沿模型的方法，包括跨重复尝试的上下文学习、读取仿真器状态并在上下文中教导学生的特权教师、利用模型自身特权经验的自辅助学习，以及在不同场景生成演示以训练 π₀.₅ 等视觉语言动作模型的代码策略。这些方法均显著改善性能。我们发布流水线、强化学习环境和基准，以促进后续研究。代码和数据见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.40589.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
2610.40589.authors: El Mustapha Mansouri , Eikichi Kimura , Masato Koga , Keigo Arai
2610.40589.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
2610.40589.abstract_en: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.
2610.40589.update_target: Experimental plans and measurement protocols; no model-weight claim
2610.40589.mechanism_en: Agents challenge one another, require theory checks, detect reference-measurement drift and revise the protocol while keeping acceptance criteria fixed.
2610.40589.result_en: A revised diamond-spin experiment meets predefined criteria after the initial drift-affected experiment is judged inconclusive.
2610.40589.boundary_en: This is a concrete autonomous laboratory study; it does not demonstrate a persistent cross-campaign improver or unrestricted discovery.
2610.40589.abstract_zh: 自主研究实验室可以执行从提出问题到准备论文的完整研究。人工智能为这一目标提供了一条路径。近期 AI 系统能承担多种研究角色，但可能得出证据不支持的结论。本文介绍一个自主研究实验室，其中基于大语言模型的智能体评估彼此的工作，并能够停止调查或改变其方向。它们能够生成和否决研究问题，要求单独的理论检查，并开展旨在挑战自身主张的实验。我们通过研究金刚石中的量子自旋系综展示这些能力。智能体推导出预测一类明确微波脉冲序列响应所需的最少校准设置数，在计算上检查该结果，并设计区分竞争预测的实验。初始实验与理论预测一致，但反复参考测量表明，信号在数据采集期间发生漂移。因此，智能体将该结果视为不确定，并在不放宽验收标准的情况下修订测量协议。修订后的实验满足标准，支持理论预测。本研究展示了协作 AI 智能体能够选择研究问题、推导理论结果并通过实验检验其预测。

2610.38266.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
2610.38266.authors: Xiaofeng Han , Kaize Luo , Zenghuang Fu , Zichong Zhu , Zhe Feng , Changwei Wang , Rongtao Xu , Weiliang Meng , Xiaopeng Zhang
2610.38266.abstract_en: Embodied systems can update policies, world models, skills, and executable programs from deployment experience, allowing one interaction to benefit later tasks. When a system also revises and reuses its data-acquisition, feedback, or learning procedures, experience changes the process that produces capability, introducing recursive self-improvement. This paper surveys research in physical AI through the connection between persistent capability and its improvement process. We first explain the functional distinction between learner updates and improvers, then compare policy learning, imagined experience, memory and skill accumulation, and executable harnesses. These approaches connect to revisions of curricula, rewards, and research programs in different ways. Contact validity, recovery, retention, and resource costs determine whether the resulting gains accumulate during continued deployment. An L0-L3 rubric distinguishes task-local adaptation, persistent capability gain, inherited process revision, and verified improver gain. Representative benchmarks and within-study contrasts relate these distinctions to existing results. We further propose common-data and interactive comparisons that evaluate reference and revised improvers from shared learner starts, separating the use of experience from its acquisition. This perspective connects the diverse methods, physical operating conditions, and evaluation evidence, underpinning embodied RSI. A comprehensive list of studies in this survey is available at this https URL .
2610.38266.affiliation: Institute of Automation, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Southern University of Science and Technology / Qilu University of Technology (Shandong Academy of Sciences) / Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, CAS
2610.38266.update_target: Evaluation taxonomy for persistent learners and revised improvers
2610.38266.mechanism_en: An L0-L3 rubric separates task-local adaptation, capability retention, inherited process revision and verified improver gain.
2610.38266.result_en: This survey proposes common-data and interactive comparisons, rather than reporting a new independently replicated RSI system.
2610.38266.boundary_en: The rubric is an analytical framework; cited within-study contrasts are not evidence that every embodied learning loop is RSI.
2610.38266.abstract_zh: 具身系统可以从部署经验中更新策略、世界模型、技能和可执行程序，使一次交互有益于后续任务。当系统还修订并复用其数据获取、反馈或学习程序时，经验就会改变产生能力的过程，从而引入递归自我改进。本文通过持久能力及其改进过程之间的联系，综述物理 AI 研究。我们首先解释学习器更新与改进器之间的功能区别，再比较策略学习、想象经验、记忆与技能累积，以及可执行 harness。这些方法以不同方式联系课程、奖励和研究程序的修订。接触有效性、恢复、保持与资源成本决定了产生的收益能否在持续部署中累积。L0—L3 评估准则区分任务局部适应、持久能力增益、被继承的过程修订，以及经过验证的改进器增益。代表性基准和同一研究内的对照，将这些区分与已有结果联系起来。我们进一步提出共同数据和交互式比较，从共享的学习器初始状态出发评估原始与修订后的改进器，将经验使用与经验获取分开。这一视角联系多样方法、物理运行条件和评估证据，为具身 RSI 奠定基础。本综述研究的完整列表见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.38392.title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents
2610.38392.authors: Hau-Sing So , Daixian Liu , Weicai Long
2610.38392.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents edit their own harness, the prompts and rules around a fixed model, and keep an edit only if an acceptance gate scores it higher on a batch of tasks. Such a gate sees what the harness does under the current model, not what it would still prevent if one safeguard failed. When safeguards overlap, deleting one is masked: the others still block the harm, so the gate decides on task success alone and redundancy erodes unseen. We measure harm for every subset of four written safeguards in two agent environments and run 411 improvement loops under ten gate rules, mostly as controlled deletion experiments, plus three runs of the GEPA optimizer. A deletion behind another working safeguard adds almost no observable harm. A paired significance test blocks deletions that pass by chance but not deletions that genuinely raise task success, and a larger evaluation batch lets it delete cheaper safeguards: at the same cost, 20-task batches kept every harness protected while 40-task batches lost all six. Large harm audits prevent exposure but not the loss of depth, which turns into harm when the harness is reused with a weaker model. GEPA kept every safety rule verbatim, yet two of its three final harnesses misused credentials under a weaker model. A statistical model frozen before the runs predicts where each gate's protection breaks as safeguard cost and batch size change, and freezing safety text or auditing one-layer ablations preserves depth.
2610.38392.update_target: Acceptance-gated harness edits and redundant safety layers
2610.38392.mechanism_en: Subset harm audits and controlled deletion loops expose safeguards whose removal remains masked by overlapping protections.
2610.38392.result_en: 411 loops across ten gates show hidden redundancy loss; two of three GEPA harnesses misuse credentials after weaker-model transfer despite retained safety text.
2610.38392.boundary_en: Mostly controlled deletion experiments plus three GEPA runs; layer-ablation findings should not be generalized to all optimizers without testing.
2610.38392.abstract_zh: 自改进 LLM 智能体编辑围绕固定模型的提示与规则，即自身 harness，并只在验收门对一批任务评分更高时保留修改。这种门看到的是 harness 在当前模型下的行为，而不是当一层防护失效时它仍能阻止什么。当防护相互重叠时，删除某一层会被掩盖：其他层仍阻止危害，因此验收门仅依据任务成功率作决定，冗余深度便在不可见中侵蚀。我们在两个智能体环境中，测量四层书面防护所有子集的危害，并在十种门规则下运行 411 个改进循环，主要为受控删除实验，另有三次 GEPA 优化器运行。在另一层有效防护背后删除一层，几乎不增加可观察危害。成对显著性检验能阻止碰巧通过的删除，却不能阻止确实提高任务成功率的删除；更大的评估批次还允许删除成本更低的防护：在相同成本下，20 任务批次使所有 harness 保持保护，而 40 任务批次使六个全部失去保护。大规模危害审计能防止暴露，却不能防止深度丧失；当 harness 被复用于更弱模型时，这种丧失会转化为危害。GEPA 原样保留了每条安全规则，但三个最终 harness 中有两个在更弱模型下滥用凭据。运行前冻结的统计模型预测了防护成本与批次大小变化时，各类门的保护在哪里失效；冻结安全文本或审计单层消融可以保留防护深度。

2610.38882.title: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
2610.38882.authors: Tianjian Li , Chuanyang Jin , Seungone Kim , Tong Chen , John Hoffman , Yoram Bachrach amd Pedro Rodriguez , Ping Yu , Eryk Helenowski , Swarnadeep Saha , Jack Lanchantin , Weizhe Yuan , Ilia Kulikov , Jason Weston
2610.38882.abstract_en: Autoresearch agents can now attempt long-horizon AI research end-to-end, i.e., self-improvement. However, best results are still obtained by research agents interacting with human researchers, and improving AI's ability to perform this co-research will only reinforce this effect---a process termed co-improvement (Weston and Foerster, 2025). Further, aligning with human expectations is likely a safer path for research agents, especially given recent agent reward hacking phenomena (OpenAI, 2026b). In this work we address these issues in four ways: (i) we empirically study the role of humans in directing autoresearch agents, focusing on the domain of benchmark creation, and find humans still play a pivotal role particularly in the ideation phase; (ii) we also develop a benchmark, HackBench, that shows current autoresearch agents are not aligned and are unable to achieve hack localization sufficiently; (iii) we present a method to train agents for improved human interaction by using human simulators as a proxy during reinforcement learning (RL); and finally (iv) we develop a method to improve model text generation, and hence agent communication, by RL with rubrics aligned with human experts. Together, our training and evaluation recipes provide a path toward more capable and aligned (co-)research agents.
2610.38882.affiliation: FAIR at Meta / Johns Hopkins University / Carnegie Mellon University / University of Washington
2610.38882.update_target: Autoresearch interaction policies and human-aligned supervision
2610.38882.mechanism_en: Human benchmark ideation, hack localization tests, simulator-based interaction RL and expert-aligned rubric training are studied together.
2610.38882.result_en: The authors find a pivotal human ideation role and inadequate hack localization, and propose training recipes for co-research.
2610.38882.boundary_en: Human simulators proxy human feedback; an alignment recipe does not itself prove reliable autonomous research or independently verified safety.
2610.38882.abstract_zh: 自主研究智能体现在能够从头到尾尝试长程 AI 研究，即自我改进。然而，最佳结果仍来自研究智能体与人类研究者的交互，而提升 AI 的这种共同研究能力，只会进一步强化这一效应；这一过程被称为共同改进（Weston 和 Foerster，2025）。此外，与人类期待对齐可能是研究智能体更安全的发展路径，尤其考虑到近期智能体奖励投机现象（OpenAI，2026b）。本工作从四个方面处理这些问题：（i）以基准创建为重点，实证研究人类指导自主研究智能体的作用，发现人类尤其在构思阶段仍发挥关键作用；（ii）开发 HackBench 基准，表明当前自主研究智能体尚未对齐，也无法充分实现投机位置定位；（iii）提出在强化学习中以人类模拟器作为代理，训练智能体改善人类交互的方法；（iv）通过与人类专家对齐的评分细则进行强化学习，改善模型文本生成，进而改善智能体通信。这些训练与评估方案共同为更强、更对齐的共同研究智能体提供了一条路径。

2610.39122.title: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Degrades the Robustness of Personal Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
2610.39122.authors: Xinyan Wang , Xiaogeng Liu , Jun Shao , Chaowei Xiao
2610.39122.abstract_en: Self-evolving personal agents act for users and learn from user feedback. However, if an agent obeys an instruction that an untrusted third party hides in content, the third party gains control of the agent. Such indirect prompt injection (IPI) poses severe risks. We investigate whether self-evolution degrades the robustness of personal agents to IPI. To study this question, we design a controlled two-phase methodology. In the adaptation phase, the user asks the agent to read external content and complete the task described in it, a common request in daily use. The agent then learns from the user's feedback and improves itself as designed. In the test phase, a third party writes a similar task into new external content, but the user's test request does not authorize the injected task. Using this methodology, we build multiple tasks with diverse test instances in different domains for a real personal agent. Our extensive experiments reveal that self-evolution substantially degrades robustness to IPI. Specifically, compared with the base agent, which does not evolve from user feedback, the average attack success rate rises by 14.0--48.8 percentage points under skill evolution and by 3.0--39.3 percentage points under reinforcement learning, posing safety risks. The code is available at this https URL
2610.39122.affiliation: University of Wisconsin-Madison / Johns Hopkins University
2610.39122.update_target: Personal-agent skill or weight adaptation and authorization robustness
2610.39122.mechanism_en: A controlled adaptation/test split reuses similar external-content tasks with different authorization; skill evolution and RL are evaluated separately.
2610.39122.result_en: Indirect-injection success rises 14.0-48.8 percentage points for skill evolution and 3.0-39.3 for RL relative to a non-evolving agent.
2610.39122.boundary_en: The result concerns tested real-agent tasks and feedback conditions; it does not imply every feedback update weakens every safeguard.
2610.39122.abstract_zh: 自进化个人智能体代表用户行动，并从用户反馈中学习。但如果智能体服从不可信第三方隐藏在内容中的指令，第三方就会取得对智能体的控制。这类间接提示注入具有严重风险。我们研究自进化是否会削弱个人智能体对间接提示注入的鲁棒性。为此，我们设计受控的两阶段方法。在适应阶段，用户要求智能体阅读外部内容并完成其中描述的任务，这是日常常见请求。智能体随后按设计从用户反馈中学习并自我改进。在测试阶段，第三方在新的外部内容中写入相似任务，但用户测试请求并未授权被注入的任务。使用这一方法，我们为一个真实个人智能体构建多个领域的多项任务和多样测试实例。大量实验表明，自进化会显著削弱对间接提示注入的鲁棒性。具体而言，相比不从用户反馈演化的基础智能体，技能演化使平均攻击成功率上升 14.0—48.8 个百分点，强化学习使其上升 3.0—39.3 个百分点，形成安全风险。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.39358.title: Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates
2610.39358.authors: Yifan Wang , Zhenyi Gai , Yiwen Zhao , Mingxuan Jiang , Keyang Chen , Zeping Li , Hongfeng Chai , Yixin Cao
2610.39358.abstract_en: Skill-evolution methods typically analyze execution trajectories to guide agent skill refinement. However, policy updates can change the behavioral effects and marginal utility of an unchanged skill. Attribution based on earlier trajectories may therefore no longer reflect the skill's contribution under the updated policy. Moreover, trajectory failures can arise from multiple factors, making individual skill contributions difficult to isolate. We evaluate whether policy-update signals contain predictive information about changes in skill marginal utility. At fixed contexts from pre-update training rollouts, we measure how policy updates change the contrast in token preferences between skill and control conditions. Combining these interaction shifts with advantage estimates yields reward-directed readouts for diagnosing utility changes. The readouts reuse existing training rollouts and require only forward passes for single-step action scoring, without additional post-update rollout evaluation. Our experiments show that policy updates can alter skill marginal utility and that policy-update readouts carry diagnostic information for identifying skills with declining utility. Integrating readout-guided prioritization into skill evolution improves downstream performance while reducing policy and editor token consumption.
2610.39358.update_target: Skill-maintenance priority under changing policy weights
2610.39358.mechanism_en: Pre-update contexts measure skill/control token-preference shifts and combine them with advantages to predict utility decline before new rollouts.
2610.39358.result_en: Readout-guided evolution reportedly improves task performance while reducing policy and editor tokens.
2610.39358.boundary_en: Forward-pass diagnostics predict marginal utility rather than prove causality; evolving-policy validation still requires held-out outcome checks.
2610.39358.abstract_zh: 技能演化方法通常分析执行轨迹，以指导智能体技能完善。然而，策略更新可能改变一个未被修改技能的行为效果与边际效用。因此，基于早期轨迹的归因可能不再反映技能在更新策略下的贡献。此外，轨迹失败可能来自多种因素，难以隔离单个技能的作用。我们评估策略更新信号是否包含关于技能边际效用变化的预测信息。在更新前训练轨迹的固定上下文处，我们测量策略更新如何改变技能条件与对照条件间的词元偏好差异。将这些交互变化与优势估计结合，得到用于诊断效用变化、由奖励方向指导的读出。读出复用已有训练轨迹，只需对单步动作评分进行前向传播，无需额外的更新后轨迹评估。实验表明，策略更新能够改变技能边际效用，策略更新读出也包含识别效用下降技能的诊断信息。将读出指导的优先级分配融入技能演化，可改善下游性能，同时减少策略与编辑器词元消耗。

2610.39840.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
2610.39840.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
2610.39840.abstract_en: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.
2610.39840.update_target: LoRA knowledge updates and evidence-conditioned acceptance
2610.39840.mechanism_en: Surprise, prior conflict, judge approval and regression checks answer distinct questions; source routing trades learning coverage against poisoning.
2610.39840.result_en: Prior signals separate known-fact lies from true new facts at AUC 0.78-0.83, but legitimate updates at 0.53; source planting can reverse the benefit.
2610.39840.boundary_en: Tests cover controlled claim streams and small students; no acceptance signal alone establishes truth, especially with attacker-controlled evidence.
2610.39840.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的持续学习方法越来越多地依据惊讶度决定学习内容，保留模型觉得最难预测的输入。当数据流包含谎言时，这一规则并不安全。关于模型已知事物的植入假话，在模型信念下概率很低，因此天然具有很高惊讶度；以惊讶度驱动的学习器几乎会吸收每一条这样的谎言，其比例与预算相同的随机选择相近。我们使用经 LoRA 适应的学生模型 Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B 和 Llama-3.2-3B，研究它们从关于虚构人物及真实 CounterFact 事实的真假主张流中学习的情况。我们报告四项发现。（1）要求评判器批准每条主张的验证器关卡，能在其验证器准确的程度上去除谎言；真实 LLM 评判器较谨慎，会拒绝无来源真话，甚至拒绝有来源支持的更新。（2）对无关知识进行校准回归测试会减慢学习，却不能过滤谎言。（3）原模型自身的先验无需评判器就能标记与已知内容矛盾的主张。它能将关于已知事实的谎言与真实新事实区分开，三个模型的 AUC 为 0.78—0.83；但无法区分同类事实的合法更新，AUC 为 0.53。它节省 43% 的评判器调用，但能访问模型的攻击者可挑选能通过的谎言。（4）若存在攻击者无法植入内容的可信来源，将矛盾主张路由到证据可恢复合法更新，组合系统在已学习主张中的投毒率最低；当攻击者为 30% 的谎言植入匹配来源时，系统最终比仅用评判器更差。这些接纳信号回答不同问题，没有一个能独自决定主张是否为真。

2610.37734.title: When Skills Tell Agents Not to Ask: A Large-Scale Study of Oversight Directives in Agent Skills
2610.37734.categories: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.37734.abstract_en: Agent skills, reusable instruction packages centred on a this http URL file, extend AI agents on demand, and a single line in a widely copied skill reaches every agent that loads it. Some lines are oversight-loosening directives: they tell the agent to proceed without approval, to bypass checks with --no-verify, or to keep working without checking in. Although such directives can remove a checkpoint from every agent that loads them, no prior work has examined them. We present the first large-scale study of oversight-loosening directives, analyzing 1.53 million English skills from GitSkills. We split skills into units (sentences, bullets, table cells, and code lines), develop a codebook that labels oversight directives by polarity, mechanism, and scope, label 2,097 units by hand, and train a detector to scale the analysis. Our results show that about one in seventeen skills (about 88,000 skills) contains a loosening directive. These directives most often loosen oversight through permission flags, and most of them (70.1%) apply unconditionally rather than only in specific contexts such as CI. Compared with skills that have the same amount of oversight language, skills that run shell code, install packages, or use sudo have 1.7-1.8 times the odds of containing a loosening directive, an association that holds across all our robustness checks, and they do not compensate with more tightening. Loosening spreads through a few upstream skills rather than through edits by their adopters: 2.4% of the skill families that carry loosening account for half of all copies of loosening-carrying skills, and 1.1% of distinct loosening units for half of all loosening occurrences. Open-source skill scanners catch at most 46% of loosening directives, with a precision below 0.4, while the LLM behind them, prompted with our codebook instead, catches 61% at a precision of 0.71.
2610.37734.update_target: Oversight directives distributed through reusable skill files
2610.37734.mechanism_en: Human codebooks and a trained detector trace the prevalence, scope and copying of checkpoint-loosening instructions.
2610.37734.result_en: About 88,000 of 1.53 million English skills contain loosening; 70.1% are unconditional, and scanners miss much of the content.
2610.37734.boundary_en: Corpus associations and detector estimates do not measure realized attacks or prove that every autonomy directive is inappropriate.
2610.37734.abstract_zh: 智能体技能是以原文链接的 HTTP 文件为中心、可按需扩展 AI 智能体的可复用指令包；一个广泛复制的技能中的单行内容，就能影响所有加载它的智能体。有些行是放松监督的指令：要求智能体无需批准继续执行、用 --no-verify 绕过检查，或持续工作而不再确认。尽管这些指令可能从每个加载它们的智能体中移除一个检查点，此前尚无研究考察。我们首次大规模研究这类放松监督指令，分析来自 GitSkills 的 153 万个英文技能。我们将技能分成句子、项目符号、表格单元格和代码行等单元，开发按极性、机制与作用范围标注监督指令的编码手册，人工标注 2,097 个单元，并训练检测器扩大分析规模。结果显示，约每十七个技能中就有一个含放松指令，约为 88,000 个。这些指令最常通过权限标志放松监督，其中大多数即 70.1% 无条件适用，而非仅适用于 CI 等特定情境。相较监督语言数量相同的技能，运行 shell 代码、安装包或使用 sudo 的技能，含放松指令的优势比为 1.7—1.8；这一关联通过所有鲁棒性检查，且没有更多收紧指令作为补偿。放松主要由少数上游技能传播，而非由采用者编辑产生：携带放松指令的技能家族中，2.4% 贡献了所有相关副本的一半；1.1% 的不同放松单元贡献全部出现次数的一半。开源技能扫描器最多检出 46% 的放松指令，精确率低于 0.4；若改以我们的编码手册提示其背后的 LLM，则能以 0.71 的精确率检出 61%。

2610.37739.title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
2610.37739.authors: Jiarui Yao , Ruida Wang , Tong Zhang
2610.37739.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.37739.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in this https URL .
2610.37739.update_target: Research-rediscovery evaluation and formally checked problem corpus
2610.37739.mechanism_en: Two checkers grade proofs in isolated closed-book, frozen-retrieval and live-web conditions to separate discovery from retrieval.
2610.37739.result_en: The corpus has 12,151 problems; seven agents recover at most 7 of 40 solved HQ-50 problems closed-book, while web gains mainly retrieve solutions.
2610.37739.boundary_en: The corpus is broader than the evaluated subset; formal proof grading does not resolve every source-contamination or novelty question.
2610.37739.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在研究级问题求解上展现越来越多潜力，但仍缺乏全面的问题集合，研究级评估也具有挑战。我们提出 OpenFrontiers，一个跨学科资源，结合结构化开放研究问题语料与近期已解决数学问题的回顾式基准。语料记录 12,151 个问题的陈述、背景、进展和其他信息。基准包含 200 个问题，其中 110 个于 2026 年解决，90 个仍未解决，每个问题都有经过自动探测和两次独立审查的 Lean 4 陈述；HQ-50 子集进一步依据质量评分等条件筛选。评估协议在封闭书本、冻结检索和实时网络条件下，在隔离沙箱中使用两个独立检查器为形式化证明评分。在统一预算下，对 HQ-50 子集上的七个 LLM 智能体进行评估发现，封闭书本重新发现很少，40 个已解决问题中最多解决 7 个，而实时网络条件下的成功主要反映对已发表解答的检索。通过将广泛的研究问题语料与具有已记录解答、可形式化评分的评估子集关联，OpenFrontiers 为测量研究级重新发现，以及研究解决当前开放科学问题的进展提供基础。数据集与基准见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.37859.title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
2610.37859.authors: Thomson Yen , Gilbert Yang , Naimeng Ye , Minghui Chen , Dong Xia , Tianyi Shen , Yechan Jeon , Yaqin Chen , Daksh Mittal , Fangyu Wu , Hongseok Namkoong
2610.37859.abstract_en: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.
2610.37859.affiliation: Columbia Business School / University of California, Santa Barbara / Northwestern University
2610.37859.update_target: Evaluation of task-local feedback refinement; no persistent update implied
2610.37859.mechanism_en: Seq@K supplies feedback after each failed sequential attempt and measures whether a model resolves the task within K attempts.
2610.37859.result_en: Across seven benchmarks and sixteen frontier models, rankings and cost-performance frontiers differ from Pass@K.
2610.37859.boundary_en: In-context refinement on one problem is distinct from retained cross-task learning and recursive improver revision.
2610.37859.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体与以往智能系统的根本区别，在于能够在上下文中从自然语言学习。这种能力让智能体能依据反馈迭代完善答案，是现代智能体工作流中的常见运作方式。然而，社区主要依据 Pass@1 或 Pass@K 等指标排列模型，无法捕捉模型如何利用先前尝试的反馈。我们提出 Seq@K，一种自然评估协议：每次失败后提供反馈，测量模型能否在 K 次顺序尝试内解决问题。不同于考察长程规划的多轮智能体基准，Seq@K 隔离并形式化了从反馈中完善的核心能力。我们在七个基准和十六个前沿模型上评估，发现 Seq@K 揭示了明显不同的模型选择格局：（1）模型排名往往不同；（2）Pareto 前沿允许更高效配置；（3）相对于 Pass@K，选择最优模型配置的收益可能扩大或缩小。我们还表明，分析 Seq@K 下的模型轨迹，有助于刻画迭代完善行为，例如模型处理反馈所指出问题的速率，以及固守自身答案的程度。最后，我们研究反馈性质如何影响迭代完善，表明实践者必须认真设计和评测迭代智能体系统的反馈循环。这些结果确立了 Seq@K 对通常运行于反馈循环中的智能系统更为忠实的衡量价值，以及评估此类系统模型时考虑 Seq@K 的必要性。

2610.38610.title: Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents
2610.38610.abstract_en: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.
2610.38610.affiliation: Independent researcher / South China University of Technology
2610.38610.mechanism_en: Candidate repairs and failed logs are fixed; independent deployed-policy rollouts estimate which evaluator choices actually help.
2610.38610.result_en: Greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 net success in ALFWorld; equal-budget 14B selection for a 7B executor loses 0.25.
2610.38610.boundary_en: These are bounded repair studies in ALFWorld/WebShop, not a universal claim that stronger evaluators are worse.
2610.38610.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体失败后，修复方法需要选择替换哪个动作以及替换成什么。它们常用贪心重放、更强模型、环境预言机或阅读失败日志的评判器，为候选修复评分。我们研究这些评估器是否选出了真正有助于实际执行智能体的修复。保持失败轨迹与候选单步修复固定，我们用部署策略的独立轨迹标记每个候选，测量各评估器选择损失的部署价值。在未按修复价值筛选的失败样本上，预先规定的测试显示，相较由部署智能体自身轨迹选择修复，贪心重放在 ALFWorld 上损失 0.08—0.13 的期望净成功增益，在 WebShop 上损失 0.06—0.13 的净奖励。在轨迹预算相同时，用 Qwen2.5-14B 轨迹为 Qwen2.5-7B 选择修复，在 ALFWorld 上损失 0.25，在 WebShop 上损失 0.07；每个候选二十次 14B 轨迹的价值，不超过 7B 智能体自身两次轨迹。新的轨迹还证实，在选定的分歧案例上，两模型偏好相反修复。对于不同系列但规模相近的模型，两个环境中、两个方向都出现损失，范围为 0.07—0.17。用于评分的执行者还会改变修复位置标签与方法排名。修复应由将执行它们的执行者验证，修复标签也应注明其执行者。

2610.40364.title: Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
2610.40364.authors: Jakub Gilewicz , Dominik Galus , Piotr Wojdas
2610.40364.abstract_en: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.
2610.40364.affiliation: Wroclaw University of Science and Technology / Kolo Naukowe Solvro
2610.40364.update_target: Evaluation of adaptive environment curricula under a fixed PPO student
2610.40364.mechanism_en: Fourteen curricula share matched environment-step budgets across five quadrupeds, with random and structured held-out terrains.
2610.40364.result_en: No method leads across every robot/level set; in-distribution leaders fail to lead held-out terrains on three robots.
2610.40364.boundary_en: Matched steps are not necessarily matched wall-clock cost; easy-start effects and robot morphology complicate broad curriculum claims.
2610.40364.abstract_zh: PLR、ACCEL、SFL、PAIRED 等无监督环境设计方法，主要在二维迷宫、网格世界和 BipedalWalker 上比较；而腿式机器人地形课程通常由人工设计，只与少量基线评估。我们提出一个基准，在 MuJoCo MJX 中，对五种三维四足机器人使用统一协议运行十四种无监督环境设计、领域随机化与机器人课程方法：闭链 W01-TEK，以及开链 Unitree Go1、Go2、Google Barkour vB 和 Boston Dynamics Spot。关卡由八个可解释地形参数构成的向量表示，所有课程都以匹配的环境步数预算驱动同一 PPO 学生。评测报告随机地形与留出结构化地形上的成功率、带分层自助法区间的四分位均值、能力包络，以及逐关卡支配比较。我们在每种机器人内部比较方法，并对每组关卡报告统计上不显著低于最佳者的领先方法组。没有任何方法在每种机器人和关卡组中都处于领先组。对于 Go1、Barkour 以及除 PAIRED+BiBC 之外的 W01-TEK，包含简单或低难度训练关卡的方法，无论是否经过策划，均占据分布内随机关卡的领先组。腿式机器人实践中的成功驱动地形课程进入领先组的次数最多；均匀关卡领域随机化一次也没有；PAIRED 除 Spot 外也没有，而在 Spot 难度 0.25 的随机关卡上，十四种方法相差不超过 3.8 分。在三种机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者不是留出地形的领先者。我们将结果整理为针对每种机器人的课程选择指南。

2610.40488.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
2610.40488.abstract_en: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at this https URL .
2610.40488.update_target: Early experiment ranking and research-outcome forecasts
2610.40488.mechanism_en: Every proposed minimum viable experiment is attempted by a separate executor, including low-ranked proposals, then model auditors assess outcomes.
2610.40488.result_en: Of 415 proposals, 194 are judged sound/valuable/new and 73 also beyond the seed and nonobvious; team cost increases without clear quality gains.
2610.40488.boundary_en: First-choice rankings beat random but not demonstrably first-written selection; auditor judgments are model assessments, not human novelty certification.
2610.40488.abstract_zh: 研究智能体是否具有品味，即在结果未知前判断哪些实验值得开展的能力？我们向六个前沿模型提供七篇近期 NLP 论文。每个模型以独立研究智能体或团队形式提出最小可行实验，预测各实验能否通过其自行设置的阈值，并进行排序。独立执行者随后尝试每个实验，包括排名最后的实验，再由三个模型审计员判断结果。415 个最小可行实验中，有 194 个被判为可靠、有价值且新颖，但其中不到一半，即 73 个，同时被判为超出种子论文且非显而易见。智能体的首选与审计员最看重实验的一致率高于随机选择，但并未显示超过直接选择最先写出的实验。其预测优于基础发生率，但与仅获得论文和注册信息的同模型新实例相比，准确率没有可测量的提升。团队成本更高，却没有明确的提案总体质量改善。智能体能产生许多值得开展的实验，但其排序能改善实验选择的证据仍然有限。评估 harness 和全部 415 个最小可行实验及其预测与审计结果的数据集，见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.40535.title: Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
2610.40535.authors: Ziyi Guan , Yael Tauman Kalai , Ron Rothblum , Zoe Xi
2610.40535.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computational Complexity (cs.CC); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
2610.40535.abstract_en: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost. In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later restore it. We construct a relativizing RIP for computations whose outputs are robust to changing a small fraction of oracle answers. Our construction is more efficient than prior relativizing proofs that do not assume a truthful prover, and it uses no cryptography. In our construction the honest prover runs in time linear in that of the original computation, and the verifier, after a one-time preprocessing step, runs in time nearly linear in the input length (which can be much smaller than the computation itself). We implement our protocol, report a preliminary MNIST experiment, and show that an RIP can be faster than a state-of-the-art deployed proof system. RIPs may be of independent interest. Rewinding is possible whenever the verifier controls the prover's machine, for example when the prover runs on trusted hardware or in a virtual machine whose state can be checkpointed.
2610.40535.update_target: Rewindable verification protocol; theoretical oversight model
2610.40535.mechanism_en: A verifier checkpoints and rewinds provers; a relativizing protocol verifies computations robust to a limited fraction of changed oracle answers.
2610.40535.result_en: The construction gives linear honest-prover time and nearly input-linear verifier time after preprocessing, plus a preliminary MNIST experiment.
2610.40535.boundary_en: The theorem assumes robust oracle-aided computations and control of prover state; it is not a general empirical guarantee for arbitrary LLM reasoning.
2610.40535.abstract_zh: 可扩展监督研究弱验证器如何检查更强 AI 系统所执行计算的输出。一种思路使用相对化交互证明：弱验证器通过与一个或多个强证明者交互，检查复杂的预言机辅助计算输出。辩论是一个突出例子，效率很高，但假设两个强 AI 模型即证明者中至少有一个诚实。对于某些预言机辅助计算类别，可以去掉这一假设，但计算成本显著上升。本工作提出可回溯交互证明 RIP，一种面向可扩展监督的新相对化交互证明模型。在 RIP 中，验证器可以将证明者回溯到交互的更早状态，并从那里继续。当证明者是 AI 模型时，这可通过保存模型状态快照并随后恢复实现。我们针对输出能够抵抗少量预言机答案变化的计算，构建相对化 RIP。该构造比此前无需诚实证明者假设的相对化证明更高效，且不使用密码学。在我们的构造中，诚实证明者的运行时间与原计算时间线性相关；验证器经过一次性预处理后，以接近输入长度线性的时间运行，而输入长度可能远小于计算本身。我们实现协议，报告初步 MNIST 实验，并展示 RIP 可以快于最先进的已部署证明系统。RIP 也可能具有独立研究价值。只要验证器控制证明者的机器，例如证明者运行于可信硬件或可对状态设置检查点的虚拟机，回溯就可实现。

2610.40721.title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
2610.40721.authors: Ira Ceka , Arnav Garg , Ryan Lutz , Ting Zhang , Ratnadira Widyasari , Gail Kaiser , Baishakhi Ray
2610.40721.categories: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.40721.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly used to automate vulnerability detection, but reliable detection is challenging because agents must distinguish subtle, security-relevant fixes from benign code variation. While underlying LLM capability has improved significantly, the accuracy of the agent still depends heavily on the harness: the code that defines the scaffolding around the LLM. Harnesses are typically fixed, and largely hand-written, limiting adaptation to evaluator feedback. Additionally, when harnesses are static, improvements on one dataset or model may not transfer to others. To address these challenges, we introduce MetaVul, a self-improving framework for harness discovery in vulnerability detection. Starting from a seed structured reasoning scaffold, MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, while preserving the structured reasoning and verdict format. At each iteration, it searches over the history of prior harnesses, with access to their trajectories, logs, and metrics, and it returns a set of Pareto-optimal harnesses. We apply MetaVul to discover agent harnesses for various architectures. A validation set (202 pairs) is used for optimization, while an unseen dataset (430 pairs) is kept as the held-out set. We test whether harnesses learned from one model transfer to others not seen during optimization. Results on both frontier and small LLMs show that the optimized harnesses improve pairwise vulnerability detection up to 23.3 percentage points on the validation set and up to 25.8 points on the held-out set with a Pareto-frontier harness. Harnesses learned with one model also transfer to others. We show that harnesses optimized with one model transfer to another, improving held-out pairwise accuracy by 14.7 points without further optimization.
2610.40721.affiliation: Columbia University / The Citadel / Monash University / University of Victoria
2610.40721.mechanism_en: Paired vulnerable/patched feedback, trajectories and metrics guide history-based scaffold revisions; structured verdict format is preserved.
2610.40721.result_en: Reports up to +25.8 percentage points on 430 held-out function pairs and +14.7 points in cross-model transfer without further optimization.
2610.40721.boundary_en: The 202-pair optimization set and Pareto selection must remain separate from held-out evaluation; finite harness search does not establish unlimited RSI.
2610.40721.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体日益被用于自动化漏洞检测，但可靠检测仍具有挑战，因为智能体必须将细微且与安全相关的修复同无害代码变化区分开。尽管底层 LLM 能力显著提高，智能体准确率仍高度依赖 harness，即定义 LLM 周围支撑结构的代码。Harness 通常固定且主要手工编写，限制了其适应评估器反馈的能力。此外，harness 静态不变时，在某个数据集或模型上的改进可能无法迁移。为此，我们提出 MetaVul，一个用于漏洞检测 harness 发现的自改进框架。从初始结构化推理支架出发，MetaVul 使用基于工作流的优化循环，依据成对的有漏洞函数与已修补函数反馈，迭代完善 harness，同时保持结构化推理和裁决格式。每次迭代都会搜索历史 harness，并访问其轨迹、日志和指标，最终返回一组 Pareto 最优 harness。我们将 MetaVul 用于发现不同架构的智能体 harness。优化使用包含 202 对函数的验证集，另将未见的 430 对函数保留作留出集，并测试从一种模型学得的 harness 能否迁移到优化时未见的其他模型。在前沿及小型 LLM 上，优化后的 harness 将验证集成对漏洞检测提高最高 23.3 个百分点，Pareto 前沿 harness 在留出集最高提高 25.8 个百分点。使用一种模型学得的 harness 还可迁移至其他模型。我们表明，使用一种模型优化的 harness 无需进一步优化即可使另一模型的留出成对准确率提高 14.7 个百分点。

2610.40751.title: Safin-1.5: Safety-Native Architecture and Verifiable Reasoning for Recursive Safety Improvement
2610.40751.authors: Jingnan Zheng , Cheng Jin , Ming Zhang , Huan Sun , Zhongtian Ma , Kaisen Yang , Ziyuan Zhou , Tong Wu , Dongcheng Zhang , Yi Zhang , Xiao Wang , Han Qi , Shu Yu , Ermo Hua , Zongji Yu , Chaozhuo Li , Xiaoyu Wen , Zhekai Chen , Jiawei Zhou , Sirui Chen , Ning Ding , An Zhang , Tat-Seng Chua , Xiangnan He , Xia Hu , Bowen Zhou , Qiaosheng Zhang , Youbang Sun , Xiang Wang , Zhongyu Huang , Chaochao Lu
2610.40751.categories: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.40751.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables large language models to advance their capabilities through successive updates, but these updates can also introduce new risks and weaken existing safeguards. In line with the AI-45° Law, we pursue Safety RSI, in which safety develops as an intrinsic capability alongside general model capabilities through continual risk discovery and repair, while preserving utility and limiting over-refusal. We introduce Safin-1.5, a model built on a safety architecture and trained through recursive safety improvement, with an inference-time harness that extends its capabilities to formal reasoning. Our approach comprises three components: i) The safety architecture combines persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement. The former retains and selectively invokes safety knowledge, while the latter relocates targeted hazardous knowledge into removable experts, enabling its removal with minimal impact on general capabilities. ii) Recursive safety improvement establishes a discovery-evaluation-repair loop. The loop identifies new vulnerabilities and uses experimental feedback to develop repair strategies. It accepts updates only when they improve safety while preserving general capabilities and limiting over-refusal. iii) The formal reasoning harness combines the model's language understanding with symbolic inference and verification. Proof-obligation-guided semantic bridging recovers missing relations in formal representations, enabling symbolic solvers to construct checkable proofs under formalized premises and accepted semantic bridges. Experimental results demonstrate that Safin-1.5 achieves safety and reasoning performance, outperforming frontier models.
2610.40751.update_target: Safety states, hazardous-knowledge experts and repair updates
2610.40751.mechanism_en: Risk discovery and experimental evaluation propose repairs; acceptance requires safety improvement, utility retention and limited over-refusal.
2610.40751.result_en: The abstract claims improved safety and reasoning against frontier models but provides no aggregate numerical effect size.
2610.40751.boundary_en: Symbolic proofs cover formalized premises and accepted semantic bridges; broad safety superiority is an author claim, not independently established.
2610.40751.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进使大语言模型能够通过连续更新提升能力，但这些更新也可能引入新风险、削弱现有防护。遵循 AI-45° Law，我们追求 Safety RSI，使安全通过持续风险发现与修复，与通用模型能力一起发展为内在能力，同时保持效用并限制过度拒绝。我们提出 Safin-1.5，一个基于安全架构、通过递归安全改进训练的模型，并以推理时 harness 将能力扩展至形式化推理。方法包含三部分：（i）安全架构结合持久安全状态与危险知识解耦。前者保留并选择性调用安全知识，后者将目标危险知识迁至可移除专家，使其能够以最小通用能力损失被移除。（ii）递归安全改进建立发现—评估—修复循环。循环识别新漏洞，并利用实验反馈开发修复策略；仅在更新改善安全、保持通用能力且限制过度拒绝时接受。（iii）形式化推理 harness 将模型语言理解与符号推理、验证相结合。证明义务引导的语义桥接恢复形式表示中缺失的关系，使符号求解器能够在形式化前提和已接受语义桥接下构建可检查证明。实验结果表明，Safin-1.5 取得了超过前沿模型的安全和推理表现。

2610.40901.title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
2610.40901.authors: ChengAo Shen , Yanjun Zhao , Haoxin Liu , Bonnie Chen , Miles Ma , Dongjin Song , Hanghang Tong , Qingsong Wen , Jingrui He , Jingchao Ni
2610.40901.abstract_en: As publications and products on time series forecasting (TSF) proliferate, researchers face a growing burden of analyzing existing work. First, not all publications release code. For instance, only about 20% of arXiv TSF papers have a code link in the surveyed period. Second, released code also requires manual maintenance. Thus, TSF researchers must constantly adapt or implement existing works. However, independent implementations can differ in experimental settings and are difficult to maintain. We therefore propose to use AI agents for benchmarking TSF research and even supporting autoresearch, e.g., developing new TSF models. Yet directly applying existing coding agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, is suboptimal: prohibitive costs, limited scalability to large research projects (e.g., benchmarking), and lack of self-maintenance. To address these challenges, we propose TSFLab, a self-improving agent-agnostic "workbench" that equips compatible coding agents with shared resources and tools for low-cost TSF research and continuous maintenance of research resources. Our experiments cover reproduction, benchmarking, and new method development. In reproduction and benchmarking, TSFLab improves task completion by 20-163% and cuts fresh tokens per completed task by 11-66% across baselines. A pilot study of agent-driven method development also shows improved forecasting accuracy via TSFLab, with 32.8-73.6% fewer fresh tokens and 9.2-68.8% less development time than the other settings.
2610.40901.update_target: Shared forecasting-research resources and workbench maintenance
2610.40901.mechanism_en: Research-session failures revise shared guidance and runner checks; usability, complexity and consistency checks trigger revision/rechecking before later sessions inherit integrated resources and workflows.
2610.40901.result_en: Task completion improves 20-163%, with 11-66% fewer fresh tokens per completed task; method-development gains are a pilot study.
2610.40901.boundary_en: Self-maintenance and reported efficiency do not establish autonomous scientific validity; compare matched tasks, cached tokens and total costs.
2610.40901.abstract_zh: 随着时间序列预测领域论文与产品增多，研究者分析现有工作的负担越来越重。首先，并非所有论文都发布代码，例如在调查时段内，只有约 20% 的 arXiv 时间序列预测论文提供代码链接。其次，已发布代码仍需手工维护。因此，研究者必须不断适配或实现已有工作，但独立实现可能在实验设置上不同，也难以维护。我们因而提出使用 AI 智能体为时间序列预测研究构建基准，甚至支持自主研究，例如开发新的预测模型。然而，直接使用 Claude Code、Codex 等已有编程智能体并不理想：成本高、难以扩展至基准构建等大型研究项目，也缺乏自维护。为此，我们提出 TSFLab，一个自改进、与智能体无关的工作台，为兼容编程智能体提供共享资源和工具，以低成本开展预测研究并持续维护研究资源。实验覆盖复现、基准评测和新方法开发。在复现与基准评测中，相比不同基线，TSFLab 将任务完成提高 20%—163%，将每个已完成任务消耗的新词元减少 11%—66%。智能体驱动方法开发的试点研究也显示，通过 TSFLab 可改善预测准确率，相比其他设置减少 32.8%—73.6% 新词元和 9.2%—68.8% 开发时间。

2610.41216.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
2610.41216.authors: Kehong Gong , Xiaoxu Zheng , Guanli Hou , Seunghun Lee , Mengqi Guo , Runjia Tan , Zhengyu Wen , Qi Wang , Xiaoyu He , Mingyuan Zhang , Michael Bi Mi
2610.41216.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.41216.abstract_en: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raises the teacher's success from 33.4% to 63.6%; the final 4B student reaches 62.8%. Across four harness versions, distilled 4B students score close to their corresponding teachers, and later versions yield stronger students, showing that harness evolution gains carry into compact models. The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining. On identical episodes, the final 4B student outperforms open 4B agents, the open 27B harness-RSI model SenseNova-RoboRSI, and our own teacher model placed in three competitors' harnesses. It stays close to its teacher on all three training benchmarks, and on three benchmarks never used for RSI or training it scores close to a 552B planner running the same harness. On the measured deployment episodes, it uses about one fifth of its teacher's accelerator time.
2610.41216.affiliation: Huawei Technologies / Huawei Noah Research Institute / Independent researcher
2610.41216.update_target: Teacher harness, then distilled student weights within a frozen final harness
2610.41216.mechanism_en: Frontier editors propose rollout-grounded changes gated by paired statistical tests; the final harness supplies teacher trajectories for student distillation.
2610.41216.result_en: RoboTwin teacher success rises 33.4% to 63.6%; the 4B student reaches 62.8% using roughly one fifth of measured teacher accelerator time.
2610.41216.boundary_en: Harness evolution and student training are separate stages; results on benchmark episodes do not establish universal real-robot transfer.
2610.41216.abstract_zh: 基于视觉语言模型的机器人智能体既依赖规划器，也依赖围绕规划器的工具、反馈、记忆和恢复逻辑，即 harness。大型教师 harness 的改进，能否迁移到推理算力成本更低的紧凑智能体？我们提出两阶段方法 TinyAstral。首先冻结开放权重教师，通过递归自我改进完善其 harness：前沿 LLM 智能体阅读教师轨迹并提出 harness 修改，每次修改只有通过成对统计检验才被接受。随后冻结最终 harness，收集带有推理和失败恢复的教师轨迹，并蒸馏小型学生，使其在相同 harness 中替代教师。在 RoboTwin 上，harness 演化将教师成功率从 33.4% 提高到 63.6%，最终 4B 学生达到 62.8%。在四个 harness 版本中，蒸馏后的 4B 学生得分均接近对应教师，较晚版本产生更强学生，表明 harness 演化增益可以迁入紧凑模型。Harness 增益也无需重训即可迁移到其他冻结规划器。在相同回合上，最终 4B 学生超过开放 4B 智能体、开放 27B harness-RSI 模型 SenseNova-RoboRSI，以及置于三个竞争方法 harness 中的我们自己的教师模型。它在三个训练基准上均接近教师，并在三个从未用于 RSI 或训练的基准上，得分接近运行相同 harness 的 552B 规划器。在测量的部署回合上，它使用约为教师五分之一的加速器时间。

2610.41479.title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
2610.41479.authors: Xuanang Gao , Kepeng Lin , Xinyan Shi , Yong Deng , Shuheng Shen , Changhua Meng , Xiaofeng Wu , Jie Yang , Wei Liu
2610.41479.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. To provide reliable and efficient demonstrations for these tasks, trajectory evolution uses reusable skills to recover failed teacher rollouts and refine successful ones. The resulting task--trajectory pairs are used to fine-tune the student, while accepted tasks seed subsequent evolution. To close the loop, we re-evaluate the updated student and use its feedback to guide the next round of data evolution. Experiments on Toolathlon, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas demonstrate consistent improvements over the initial student, yielding absolute gains of 16.5\%, 10.2\%, and 12.6\%, respectively. Project page: this https URL .
2610.41479.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Ant Group / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
2610.41479.update_target: MCP task states/instructions, reusable teacher skills and student weights
2610.41479.mechanism_en: Student gap diagnosis drives verifier-aligned task and trajectory evolution; accepted tasks seed the next loop after supervised fine-tuning and re-evaluation.
2610.41479.result_en: Reports absolute gains of 16.5%, 10.2% and 12.6% on Toolathlon, MCPMark and MCP-Atlas.
2610.41479.boundary_en: Executable seed tasks and aligned verifiers remain supervision assumptions; the original abstract contains an unresolved method macro, resolved as EvoMCP only in editorial text.
2610.41479.abstract_zh: Model Context Protocol（MCP）智能体的监督微调通常在静态数据分布上进行，无法适应学生不断演化的能力，也不能充分处理新暴露的弱点。为此，我们提出原文以 \method 标记的智能体—数据共同演化框架，使 MCP 智能体通过任务演化、轨迹演化与监督微调组成的闭环改善。具体而言，该方法从轨迹反馈评估学生已建立的能力及能力缺口，识别学习目标。任务演化随后通过调整兼容且已验证种子任务的指令与可观察环境状态，将这些目标转化为可执行任务，同时保持验证器对齐。为这些任务提供可靠且高效的演示，轨迹演化使用可复用技能恢复失败教师轨迹，并完善成功轨迹。得到的任务—轨迹对用于微调学生，而被接受任务成为后续演化的种子。为闭合循环，我们重新评估更新后的学生，并用其反馈指导下一轮数据演化。在 Toolathlon、MCPMark 和 MCP-Atlas 上的实验显示，相比初始学生，性能持续改善，绝对增益分别为 16.5%、10.2% 和 12.6%。项目页见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.41865.title: Learning to Interact and Direct: Co-Evolving Video Director Agents
2610.41865.authors: Yingzhao Jian , Zhongan Wang , Yuxuan Hou , Hehe Fan
2610.41865.abstract_en: Video director agents orchestrate multistage production to realize users' creative visions. Emerging research on their self-evolution advances screenplay planning effectively. However, the mutual reinforcement between directing and user interaction remains largely overlooked. Improved interaction clarifies user intent and informs workflow refinement, while more reliable execution shifts collaboration from troubleshooting to creative decisions. To this end, we introduce LIT (Learning to Interact and DirecT), a framework comprises a director agent, a simulated user, and a meta engineer. Simulated user assigns creative tasks to probe the director's weaknesses, while the meta engineer uses the task traces to revise the director's interaction and production strategy. Although this approach can address discovered interaction and production issues, it still relies on passive attribution by the meta agent. This limits its ability to adapt to broader user interaction patterns and production techniques. To solve this problem, we equip LIT with a co-evolution paradigm. The meta agent proactively learns external knowledge, thereby improving its ability to discover problems and propose solutions. The meta agent, simulated user, and director together form an evolutionary closed loop, collaboratively enhances the system's directing and interaction capabilities. Across the Test and OOD Test splits, LIT improves production and Interaction scores by 19.1% and 32.0%, respectively, relative to the initial pipeline. Controlled ablations reveal the correlation between improvements in production and interaction, where the co-evolution mechanism further encourage directing skill and interaction mode exploration.
2610.41865.update_target: Director interaction/production strategy and meta-engineer knowledge
2610.41865.mechanism_en: A simulated user probes weaknesses; trace-based edits and proactive external-knowledge acquisition co-evolve the director, user and meta-engineer.
2610.41865.result_en: Reports 19.1% production and 32.0% interaction-score improvements across Test/OOD Test relative to the initial pipeline.
2610.41865.boundary_en: Simulated-user feedback and scoring may share blind spots; finite co-evolution does not establish reliable adaptation to arbitrary real users.
2610.41865.abstract_zh: 视频导演智能体组织多阶段制作，以实现用户的创作愿景。新兴自进化研究有效推进了剧本规划，但导演与用户交互之间的相互促进仍大多被忽视。更好的交互可以澄清用户意图、指导工作流完善，而更可靠的执行会使协作从排障转向创作决策。为此，我们提出 LIT，即学习交互与导演框架，由导演智能体、模拟用户与元工程师组成。模拟用户分配创作任务以探测导演弱点，元工程师则利用任务轨迹修订导演的交互与制作策略。虽然这一方法能解决已发现的交互和制作问题，它仍依赖元智能体被动归因，限制了对更广泛用户交互模式与制作技术的适应。为解决该问题，我们为 LIT 配备共同演化范式。元智能体主动学习外部知识，从而改善发现问题和提出解决方案的能力。元智能体、模拟用户和导演共同形成演化闭环，协同提升系统的导演与交互能力。在 Test 和 OOD Test 划分上，相比初始流水线，LIT 的制作和交互分数分别改善 19.1% 和 32.0%。受控消融揭示制作与交互改进之间的相关性，而共同演化机制进一步促进导演技能和交互模式探索。
