2610.42141.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
2610.42141.authors: Shengguang Wu , Suning Huang , Cherie Ho , Ria Doshi , Hao Zhu , Serena Yeung-Levy
2610.42141.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.42141.abstract_en: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.
2610.42141.update_target: Robot control harness and persistent memory; frozen policy weights
2610.42141.mechanism_en: A coding model diagnoses rollouts and retains iterative harness/memory changes, optimized on separate episodes before held-out scene/task tests.
2610.42141.result_en: Mean unseen-scene success rises 9.7% to 43.3%; unseen-task success rises 12.7% to 40.2%.
2610.42141.boundary_en: Benchmark and policy-specific gains do not imply general optimal control; the artifact is an evolved wrapper, not a fine-tuned robot policy.
2610.42141.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，冻结机器人策略置于智能体 harness 中会表现好得多，其中控制代码决定何时查询策略、调用视觉工具或直接命令机械臂。但现有 harness 仍由人工构建，并针对每种新机器人或基准重新设计。我们表明，harness 设计可以自动化，为新设置上的微调提供有力替代。在 RoboArchitect 中，编程模型观察机器人轨迹、诊断失败，并迭代修订冻结策略周围的 harness。Harness 在用于优化的一组回合上演化，再在留出场景与任务上评估。无需更新任何模型权重，RoboArchitect 在多个基准和策略上，将未见场景平均成功率从 9.7% 提高到 43.3%，即 4.5 倍；将未见任务成功率从 12.7% 提高到 40.2%，即 3.2 倍。增益在基准远离策略训练数据时最大：包装一个通用策略后，演化 harness 产生的专用系统往往甚至超过微调版本。系统自动设计直观控制策略，例如将卡住的机械臂抬离障碍，或在上方路径被阻挡时水平伸入。Harness 还演化自身持久记忆，将有效抓取深度等学得经验带入后续决策。这些结果提示，机器人操作的大量提升空间位于智能体 harness，其设计可在不更新权重的情况下有效自动化与优化。

2610.40747.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
2610.40747.authors: Xiaoyi Zhang , Haoqing Wang , Xinjie Zhang , Xiang Ming , Xing Wang , Senqiao Yang , Kaichen Zhang , Zhaoyang Jia , Andong Tan , Xinjiang Wang , Jinghao Guo , Yifei Shen , Xiao Li , Peng Zhang , Xun Guo , Jiahao Li , Shicheng Zheng , Jinglu Wang , Zongyu Guo , Wenxuan Xie , Bin Li , Yan Lu
2610.40747.abstract_en: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.
2610.40747.update_target: Teacher harness and compact hybrid computer-use policy weights
2610.40747.mechanism_en: Reusable task-generation workflows and evolved specialized teacher harnesses provide stage-specific trajectories for midtraining, SFT and RL.
2610.40747.result_en: The 4B model reaches 66.0% OSWorld-Verified; 293,806 tasks span 6,915 skills with 82.6% lower recurring per-task expenditure.
2610.40747.boundary_en: Harness evolution, task synthesis and five-stage training are coupled; size-specific benchmark claims are not evidence of cheap reproduction.
2610.40747.abstract_zh: 有效的计算机使用智能体应在单一策略内无缝结合视觉 GUI 交互、代码和终端执行。我们提出 Mage-VL-Cowork，一个 4B 混合计算机使用智能体，从通用多模态对齐检查点出发，通过覆盖中期训练、监督微调和强化学习的端到端递进五阶段课程进行训练。为大规模支持该课程，Mage-CUA-Forge 用可复用、以技能为条件的生成工作流和应用专属准备器替代逐任务智能体构建，围绕 6,915 项技能合成 293,806 个桌面与网络任务，同时将经常性的逐任务开支降低 82.6%。我们并非直接蒸馏默认教师，而是演化教师 harness 并实例化专门化计算机使用 harness，以产生高质量轨迹及阶段专属监督。Mage-VL-Cowork-4B 最终通过不同训练阶段在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 66.0%，推理成本更高效，在其参数规模下取得最先进表现，推进端侧智能前沿。

2610.40757.title: AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn
2610.40757.authors: Daniel Levine , David van Dijk , Kenneth Kay
2610.40757.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
2610.40757.abstract_en: Humans and animals have a unique capacity to generalize and learn in novel circumstances, including "0-shot" inference (ZI) and continual learning (CL) -- two powerful cognitive abilities. Despite this importance, efforts to model ZI and CL are seriously limited in several ways. First, existing models typically lack components critical to ZI and CL in the brain, namely, strong inductive biases (for ZI) and autonomous control of learning (for CL). Second, models can be less tractable to analysis if model components are overly complex (lacking simplicity), or too task-restricted if model components are overly bespoke (lacking expressivity). Here we introduce autonomous Hebbian networks ("AutoHebb"), a class of online learning feedforward neural networks that realize strong inductive biases and autonomously controlled learning, and are both simple and expressive. Unlike standard models that learn via externally controlled optimization (e.g. gradient descent), AutoHebb networks combine external feedback with internally generated activity to produce a global learning signal ('neuromodulator') fed back to the network. The neuromodulator in turn gates a biologically grounded local learning rule (3-factor Hebbian rule) that updates networks' plastic weights. Using meta-learning to search for fixed (non-plastic) weights, we find that AutoHebb networks (1) succeed on ZI tasks, (2) show emergent (untrained) ZI/CL abilities, (3) admit reverse-engineering into explicit algorithms, and (4) outperform modern learning models on ZI/CL tasks. Lastly, performance comparisons to related models implied an essential role for three model components: meta-learning, Hebbian plasticity, and autonomous control of learning. These findings indicate that AutoHebb may be useful in hypothesis generation, analysis, and discovery of biologically grounded forms of learning and generalization.
2610.40757.affiliation: Yale University / Howard Hughes Medical Institute, UCSF / University of Rochester
2610.40757.update_target: Online plastic neural weights and meta-learned fixed weights
2610.40757.mechanism_en: External feedback and internally generated activity create a neuromodulator that gates a local three-factor Hebbian learning rule.
2610.40757.result_en: Reports zero-shot and emergent continual-learning abilities, algorithmic reverse engineering and gains over tested learning models.
2610.40757.boundary_en: Meta-learning searches fixed weights externally; autonomous online plasticity is distinct from revising the meta-learning algorithm itself.
2610.40757.abstract_zh: 人类和动物具有在新情境中泛化和学习的独特能力，包括零样本推断与持续学习这两项强大认知能力。尽管很重要，对二者的建模仍受到多方面限制。首先，已有模型通常缺乏大脑中对零样本推断和持续学习至关重要的组成部分，即支持前者的强归纳偏置与支持后者的自主学习控制。其次，组件过于复杂会降低分析可处理性，即缺乏简单性；组件过于定制则可能使模型局限于特定任务，即缺乏表达力。我们提出自主赫布网络 AutoHebb，一类在线学习前馈神经网络，实现强归纳偏置和自主控制学习，同时兼具简单性与表达力。不同于通过梯度下降等外部控制优化学习的标准模型，AutoHebb 将外部反馈与内部生成活动结合，产生反馈给网络的全局学习信号，即神经调制器。神经调制器继而对有生物学基础的局部学习规则，即三因子赫布规则进行门控，更新网络可塑权重。通过元学习搜索固定的非可塑权重，我们发现 AutoHebb 网络：（1）能完成零样本推断任务；（2）展现未经训练而涌现的零样本推断和持续学习能力；（3）可被逆向分析为显式算法；（4）在相关任务上超过现代学习模型。最后，与相关模型的性能比较暗示，元学习、赫布可塑性和自主学习控制三个组成部分均发挥关键作用。这些发现表明，AutoHebb 可能有助于提出假设、分析和发现具有生物学基础的学习与泛化形式。

2610.40992.title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
2610.40992.authors: Junwei Wu , Runze Yan , Yuzhang Xie , Hanqi Luo , Ziwei Dong , Jiaying Lu , Xiao Hu , Carl Yang
2610.40992.abstract_en: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. During planning, the specification grounds foods, optimizes portions, checks the complete multi-day plan, and guides revision. Our key insight is that a specification that rejects a plan can also determine what to learn from it. Noura turns executed plans and contextually credited revisions into supervision for compact models, recovering targets even from trajectories that never achieve complete success. The same specification supplies supervised targets, preferences, and rewards for post-training. On 4,993 held-out participants, Noura-SFT raises Qwen3-14B's complete-plan pass rate from 24.0% to 72.5% within the same execution loop, cuts rule violations by 97.5% with no observed critical failures, and improves dietary quality. The locally hosted 14B planner incurs fewer rule violations than its GPT-6 Luna teacher. A matched comparison shows that executed targets reduce rule violations by 41% over model-written proposals. Across four Qwen, Phi, and Llama backbones, self-training alone reduces rule violations by 41-61% on a 1,249-person population subset.
2610.40992.update_target: Executable personal specifications and compact planner weights
2610.40992.mechanism_en: Executed plans and contextually credited revisions yield targets, preferences and rewards, including from globally unsuccessful trajectories.
2610.40992.result_en: On 4,993 held-out participants, Qwen3-14B complete-plan pass rate rises 24.0% to 72.5%; self-training reduces violations 41-61% on a subset.
2610.40992.boundary_en: Specification compliance is not clinical outcome validation; clinical guidance, personal constraints and execution-loop effects must be kept separate.
2610.40992.abstract_zh: 通过饮食管理多种慢性病，需要在多餐和多日间共同满足疾病与药物专属要求，同时保持已有饮食习惯。这些要求公开存在于临床指南和药物标签中，但将它们转化为适合个人的可行计划，对语言模型智能体仍很困难。在由 NHANES 构建、经营养师批准的周计划评估中，从医学微调 8B 模型到 GPT-6.1 Sol 的十三个模型，通过直接生成得到完整合格计划的比例均低于 3%。显式规则、更高推理投入或模型主导工具，也只能使 GPT-6.1 Sol 达到不超过 8%。我们提出 Noura，将 LLM 规划与根据公共临床指导及个人健康、饮食资料实例化的可执行个人规范配对。规划期间，规范对食物提供依据、优化份量、检查完整多日计划，并指导修订。关键认识是，拒绝某个计划的规范，也能决定应从中学什么。Noura 将已执行计划和按上下文归因的修订转化为小模型监督，即使轨迹从未完全成功也能恢复训练目标。同一规范提供后训练所需的监督目标、偏好和奖励。在 4,993 名留出参与者上，Noura-SFT 在相同执行循环内，将 Qwen3-14B 完整计划通过率从 24.0% 提高到 72.5%，将规则违反减少 97.5%，未观察到关键失败，并改善饮食质量。本地托管的 14B 规划器比其 GPT-6 Luna 教师产生更少违规。匹配比较显示，相比模型编写提案，已执行目标使违规减少 41%。在 Qwen、Phi 和 Llama 的四个骨干上，仅自训练就在包含 1,249 人的子集中减少 41%—61% 违规。

2610.41210.title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
2610.41210.authors: Jun He , Canmiao Fu , Ying Zhang , Zhipeng Huang , Chenyu Mu , Yazhen Xie , Chen Li , Jing Lyu , Weijia Li , Xiang Zhang
2610.41210.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.41210.abstract_en: Real-world image editing requires coordinating multiple visual transformations with content preservation and reference constraints, yet aggregate scores can readily obscure unmet local requirements. Effective evaluation must therefore identify local failures and translate them into priorities for subsequent model improvement. We introduce WeGenEditBench, comprising 2,740 evaluation instances and 148 task types across single-image, text-intensive, and multi-reference editing. Pre-generated checklists shared across models decompose each request into atomic requirements; item-level deductions and visual evidence are established first and then summarized into scores for edit execution, preservation, visual quality, and task-specific correctness. To support the experience-acquisition component of recursive self-improvement (RSI), we develop WeGenEvoStudio, a unified multi-agent harness for RSI-oriented learning that integrates model-conditioned failure diagnosis, retrieval-grounded data construction, supervised adaptation, and re-evaluation. Among 15 evaluated configurations, GPT-Image-2 leads single-image editing with an Overall score of 4.076, while Seedream-5.0-Pro leads text-intensive editing at 4.291. Evolution experiments across four generation and editing benchmarks demonstrate substantial targeted gains: on their report-selected Top-5 single-image targets, FLUX.2 [dev] improves Overall from 1.083 to 3.517, while Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 gains 13.2%. Together, our benchmark and harness provide a foundation for developing more reliable image models through interpretable evaluation and feedback-driven learning.
2610.41210.affiliation: Sun Yat-sen University / WeChat Vision, Tencent / Xidian University / Fudan University / Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
2610.41210.update_target: Editing-model weights informed by item-level evaluation and failure-targeted data
2610.41210.mechanism_en: Shared atomic checklists produce evidence-grounded diagnosis; retrieval-based training data, supervised adaptation and re-evaluation close the local loop.
2610.41210.result_en: Reports selected Top-5 FLUX.2 targets improving 1.083 to 3.517 and a 13.2% Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 gain.
2610.41210.boundary_en: Top-5 report-selected targets are not the full benchmark; targeted improvements need held-out breadth and preservation checks.
2610.41210.abstract_zh: 现实图像编辑需要协调多种视觉变换、内容保留与参考约束，但汇总分数很容易掩盖未满足的局部要求。因此，有效评估必须识别局部失败，并将其转化为后续模型改进的优先事项。我们提出 WeGenEditBench，包含 2,740 个评估实例与 148 类任务，覆盖单图、文本密集和多参考编辑。各模型共享的预生成检查清单将每项请求分解为原子要求；先建立逐项扣分及视觉证据，再汇总为编辑执行、内容保留、视觉质量与任务专属正确性分数。为支持递归自我改进的经验获取环节，我们开发 WeGenEvoStudio，一个面向 RSI 学习的统一多智能体 harness，整合模型条件化失败诊断、有检索依据的数据构建、监督适应与重新评估。在十五个评估配置中，GPT-Image-2 以 4.076 的 Overall 分数领先单图编辑，Seedream-5.0-Pro 以 4.291 领先文本密集编辑。在四个生成与编辑基准上的演化实验展示显著针对性增益：对于报告所选择的前五个单图目标，FLUX.2 [dev] 的 Overall 从 1.083 升至 3.517，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 增益为 13.2%。基准与 harness 共同为通过可解释评估和反馈驱动学习开发更可靠图像模型提供基础。

2610.41245.title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
2610.41245.authors: Yunhui Jang , Zach Wang , Jai Doshi , Kangway Chuang , Sidney Lisanza , Taylor Joren
2610.41245.abstract_en: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.
2610.41245.update_target: Indexed quantitative intervention memory and epistasis structure
2610.41245.mechanism_en: Domain-grounded identifiers accumulate oracle-measured effects; exact lookup and evaluated intervention sets support local memory updates.
2610.41245.result_en: The authors report gains in most tested in-silico antibody-optimization settings.
2610.41245.boundary_en: Property-oracle estimates and simulated optimization are not wet-lab affinity or clinical validation; no numerical overall effect is given in the abstract.
2610.41245.abstract_zh: 记忆已成为自进化 LLM 智能体的核心，系统存储和检索过去轨迹的经验，以指导未来决策。现有系统用自由形式自然语言表示经验，并通过重写维护，适合经验可叙述的任务。然而，在科学发现与优化中，经验往往是在特定情境下由预言机测得的量。将其重写成文本，会使记录缺少应在何处的索引、把测量替换为描述，也无法表达干预之间的相互作用。因此，我们主张生物分子优化中的智能体记忆应可索引、定量且结构化，并提出 MEMIG。该记忆构建框架实现这三种性质。具体而言，MEMIG 用具备领域依据的标识符对应每条见解，并累积属性预言机测得的定量效应，使更新保持局部、检索成为精确查找。随后，MEMIG 连接干预会被共同应用的见解，并通过分解每个已评估干预集合来测量其上位性。结果表明，MEMIG 在计算机模拟抗体优化任务的大多数设置中改善性能。

2610.41296.title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
2610.41296.abstract_en: Answer-level rewards cannot distinguish reasoning traces with equally correct outcomes. We study whether auxiliary trajectory preferences improve small-language-model self-improvement and transfer under limited supervision. We compare confidence-based (SC) and entropy-based metrics (UID-Conj.), which combines global entropy variation and local smoothness, through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. Online experiments adapt Qwen3-1.7B on 30 AIME problems without reference answers; offline experiments use historical AIME problems. UID-Conj. improves the online macro-average across the adaptation benchmark and three transfer benchmarks by 2.08 percentage points over unmodified TTRL. The strongest evidence comes from offline weighted SFT: UID-Conj. exceeds uniform weighting on the same response pool by 1.93 points, with a paired prompt-bootstrap 95\% CI of [0.44, 3.44]. Benefits are task-dependent: SC rewards judged trace quality and instruction following, while UID-Conj. rewards yield stronger training outcomes in several settings. We find that auxiliary preferences can expose learning value among equally correct traces not captured during inference time, motivating their evaluation through downstream gains.
2610.41296.update_target: Small-model weights and auxiliary trace preferences
2610.41296.mechanism_en: Confidence or entropy-based rewards augment online training and weight offline verified response pools, with downstream transfer used for evaluation.
2610.41296.result_en: UID-Conj. gains 2.08 points online macro-average; weighted offline SFT gains 1.93 points, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.44,3.44].
2610.41296.boundary_en: Online adaptation uses only 30 AIME problems without reference answers; benefits are task-dependent and trace preference is not proof of reasoning validity.
2610.41296.abstract_zh: 答案级奖励无法区分结果同样正确的推理轨迹。我们研究在有限监督下，辅助轨迹偏好能否改善小语言模型的自改进与迁移。我们比较基于置信度的 SC 与基于熵的 UID-Conj. 指标；后者结合全局熵变化与局部平滑性。比较通过在线奖励增强和在正确回答上的离线训练进行。在线实验在没有参考答案的三十个 AIME 问题上适应 Qwen3-1.7B，离线实验使用历史 AIME 问题。相比未修改的 TTRL，UID-Conj. 使适应基准及三个迁移基准上的在线宏平均提高 2.08 个百分点。最强证据来自离线加权监督微调：在相同回答池上，UID-Conj. 超过均匀加权 1.93 个百分点，成对问题自助法 95% 置信区间为 [0.44, 3.44]。收益依赖任务：SC 奖励改善被评判的轨迹质量与指令遵循，而 UID-Conj. 奖励在若干设置中产生更强训练结果。我们发现，辅助偏好能够揭示同样正确轨迹之间、推理时未捕捉到的学习价值，因此有必要通过下游增益评估这类偏好。

2610.41320.title: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
2610.41320.authors: Yihan Zeng , Yisu Li , Kaixin Huang , Marc WuDunn , Amelia Kovacs , Mikael Harseno , Kimmy Lin , Porter Hunley , Fred Shentu , Philipp Wu , Zhongyu Li , Zike Yan
2610.41320.abstract_en: Recent multimodal foundation models exhibit strong perception, reasoning, and in-context learning capabilities, but translating these capabilities into physical action remains challenging. Through real-world experiments across diverse manipulation tasks, we find that ChatGPT-6-Astra, a state-of-the-art general-purpose reasoner, can serve as a physically actionable, context-responsive manipulation policy, demonstrating effective fine manipulation and spatial reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce LEXP, a harness for learning from physical experience through context-space adaptation. LEXP combines task-level planning with an experience module that interprets execution evidence, extracts and retains lessons with applicability conditions, and reuses relevant lessons to generate contextual feedback for subsequent actions. Model weights and the action interface remain fixed throughout. Across 12 real-world manipulation tasks, LEXP achieves $23/36$ successful trials (63.9\%), compared with $19/36$ (52.8\%) with memory alone and $2/36$ (5.6\%) for vanilla Astra. On three tasks, bread transfer, sort trash and toiletries, and retrieve drawer, removing planning reduces success from $7/9$ to $4/9$, while removing retained experience reduces it to $3/9$. Execution traces illustrate feedback-guided corrections and cross-episode reuse of an inspection strategy. Execution analyses illustrate how task structure and experience-derived feedback guide task progression, action correction, and experience reuse. These results support context-space adaptation as a practical mechanism for turning physical interaction into reusable guidance for robotic manipulation.
2610.41320.affiliation: Chinese University of Hong Kong / xdof.ai / University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
2610.41320.update_target: Persistent experience lessons and contextual feedback; frozen weights/interface
2610.41320.mechanism_en: Execution evidence yields lessons with applicability conditions; relevant lessons guide subsequent actions and episodes.
2610.41320.result_en: Twelve real-world tasks report 23/36 successes versus 19/36 memory-only and 2/36 vanilla; limited ablations separate planning and retention.
2610.41320.boundary_en: Small physical-trial counts and task-specific demonstrations limit generality; context-space adaptation does not imply model-weight learning.
2610.41320.abstract_zh: 近期多模态基础模型展现强感知、推理和上下文学习能力，但将这些能力转化为物理动作仍具挑战。通过多样操作任务上的现实实验，我们发现最先进通用推理器 ChatGPT-6-Astra 可以充当能进行物理操作、响应上下文的操作策略，表现出有效的精细操作与空间推理。在此基础上，我们提出 LEXP，一个通过上下文空间适应从物理经验学习的 harness。LEXP 将任务级规划与经验模块结合，后者解释执行证据、提取并保留附带适用条件的经验，再复用相关经验，为后续动作生成上下文反馈。模型权重与动作接口全程固定。在十二个现实操作任务上，LEXP 取得 23/36 次成功，即 63.9%；仅用记忆为 19/36，即 52.8%；原始 Astra 为 2/36，即 5.6%。在面包转移、分类垃圾和洗漱用品、抽屉取物三个任务上，移除规划使成功从 7/9 降至 4/9，移除保留经验使其降至 3/9。执行轨迹展示反馈引导的修正，以及检查策略的跨回合复用。执行分析展示任务结构与经验生成反馈如何引导任务推进、动作纠正和经验复用。这些结果支持将上下文空间适应作为把物理交互转化为机器人操作可复用指导的实用机制。

2610.41383.title: BioAgent: Self-Directed Skill Acquisition and Capability Growth for Long-Horizon Laboratory Protocols
2610.41383.authors: Gaojing Zhang , Changwen Chen , Zichen Luo , Jialiang Li , Yuhan Wang , Yifei Xie , Wenzhao Lian
2610.41383.abstract_en: Executing an unfamiliar laboratory protocol requires a robot to identify missing capabilities and determine whether each operation remains valid as the experiment progresses. This letter presents BioAgent, an embodied agent that addresses these coupled challenges of capability sufficiency and experimental validity. It matches human-reviewed requirements to validated skills and task packages, selects tool-based implementations for missing behaviors, and requests human teaching when needed during learning. Learned skills undergo sequential task-package validation to check outcomes and compatibility between successive operations. During execution, precondition, outcome, and experimental-state checks govern progression, autonomous recovery, or termination. Execution evidence guides tool selection, while accepted experience supports offline policy updates and task packaging. On the second task, BioAgent reuses 17 skill types unchanged, revises two existing implementations, and acquires five new types. On two dual-arm laboratory tasks with 20 and 31 ordered skill invocations, BioAgent achieves complete-task success rates of 66\% and 58\% with autonomous recovery over 50 runs per task. Across 25 atomic skills evaluated over 50 autonomous trials each with recovery disabled, success rates range from 84\% to 100\%, with 17 skills achieving 50/50.
2610.41383.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / University of Sussex
2610.41383.update_target: Validated laboratory skills, task packages and offline policy updates
2610.41383.mechanism_en: Requirement matching exposes missing behaviors; human teaching, sequential validation and experimental-state checks gate acquisition, reuse and recovery.
2610.41383.result_en: Two dual-arm tasks report 66%/58% complete-task success over 50 runs each; 25 atomic skills range 84-100% without recovery.
2610.41383.boundary_en: Human-reviewed requirements and teaching remain part of learning; atomic success, task completion and recovery-enabled results use different protocols.
2610.41383.abstract_zh: 执行不熟悉的实验室规程，需要机器人识别缺失能力，并判断实验推进过程中每项操作是否仍然有效。本文提出 BioAgent，一个处理能力充分性与实验有效性这两个耦合挑战的具身智能体。它将经人工审查的要求匹配到已验证技能与任务包，为缺失行为选择基于工具的实现，并在学习时按需请求人类教学。学得技能经过顺序任务包验证，以检查结果及相邻操作间兼容性。执行期间，前提条件、结果和实验状态检查控制推进、自主恢复或终止。执行证据指导工具选择，被接受经验支持离线策略更新与任务打包。在第二个任务上，BioAgent 原样复用十七类技能，修订两个已有实现，并获取五个新类型。在两个分别包含二十次和三十一次有序技能调用的双臂实验室任务上，BioAgent 在每任务五十次运行中，带自主恢复的完整任务成功率为 66% 和 58%。对二十五个原子技能分别进行五十次关闭恢复的自主试验，成功率范围为 84%—100%，其中十七个技能达到 50/50。

2610.40740.title: Certified Behavioral Retention for Continual Adaptation with Held-Out Anchors
2610.40740.abstract_en: Continual adaptation requires deciding not only how to update a model, but whether to commit an update without exceeding a declared budget for changes to protected behavior. We introduce Certified Anchor-Based Adaptation (CABA), a candidate-agnostic post-update gate that reserves historical observations from candidate optimization, compares old and candidate policies on frozen representations, and selects the largest tested interpolation coefficient whose worst-anchor forward KL divergence remains within budget. The finite check requires neither action labels nor complete trajectories. We develop a theory-led certification framework that separates measured anchor retention from conditional off-anchor guarantees. Under explicit representation-coverage and Lipschitz assumptions, an accepted update satisfies a uniform behavioral-divergence bound on protected support. The analysis gives regularity bounds for affine softmax heads, probabilistic coverage and compression guarantees, interpolation monotonicity conditions, grid-resolution bounds, and trajectory-level and sequential-composition guarantees. In a controlled UCI Human Activity Recognition study used as a non-stationary sensor-policy proxy, CABA reduces mean forgetting from 1.01 percent for unconstrained adaptation to 0.00 percent at budget epsilon = 0.05, while reducing final average accuracy from 93.04 percent to 88.48 percent. The experiment illustrates a retention-plasticity trade-off and does not establish foundation-model or robotic performance. CABA provides an auditable retention check for candidate generators exposing comparable policy distributions and a declared update path, while deployment also requires separate evidence of current-task utility.
2610.40740.affiliation: Ideal School and College / Notre Dame College
2610.40740.update_target: Post-update acceptance and interpolation of comparable policy distributions
2610.40740.mechanism_en: Held-out anchors on frozen representations bound forward KL; the gate selects the largest tested interpolation within a declared retention budget.
2610.40740.result_en: The UCI-HAR proxy reduces mean forgetting from 1.01 to 0.00 percentage points at epsilon 0.05, while final accuracy falls from 93.04% to 88.48%; the original abstract calls forgetting percent.
2610.40740.boundary_en: Off-anchor certificates require coverage and Lipschitz assumptions; sensor-proxy results establish neither foundation-model nor robot performance.
2610.40740.abstract_zh: 持续适应不仅需要决定如何更新模型，也需要决定是否提交更新，以免超过对受保护行为变化所声明的预算。我们提出经认证的锚点适应 CABA，一种与候选生成方式无关的更新后门控。它将历史观察保留在候选优化之外，在冻结表示上比较旧策略与候选策略，并选择使最差锚点前向 KL 散度仍处于预算内的最大已测试插值系数。该有限检查不需要动作标签或完整轨迹。我们建立以理论为主的认证框架，将测得的锚点保持性与有条件的非锚点保证分开。在明确的表示覆盖和 Lipschitz 假设下，被接受更新满足受保护支持集上的一致行为散度界。分析给出仿射 softmax 头的正则性界、概率覆盖与压缩保证、插值单调性条件、网格分辨率界，以及轨迹级与顺序组合保证。在作为非平稳传感器策略代理的受控 UCI Human Activity Recognition 研究中，预算 epsilon 为 0.05 时，CABA 将平均遗忘从无约束适应的 1.01% 降至 0.00%，同时将最终平均准确率从 93.04% 降至 88.48%。实验展示保持性与可塑性的权衡，并不建立基础模型或机器人性能。CABA 为可暴露可比较策略分布及已声明更新路径的候选生成器提供可审计保持性检查，而部署还需要单独证明当前任务效用。
2610.40740.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and unresolved method macros are preserved in English.

2610.40758.title: More Rules, Longer Lists? Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on a Hidden-Rule Curriculum
2610.40758.authors: Chenjie Qiu , Boyan Xu , Shaobin Shi , Bingfeng Chen , Ruichu Cai , Dongsheng Luo
2610.40758.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents rewrite a persistent state from feedback, but it is largely untested whether this lets them learn a rule nobody told them. An agent can also pass by writing down each correction as an exception, and its list then grows with every new rule. We introduce CLR-Bench, a Curriculum of Latent Rules benchmark. Each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones. A rule acts on an opaque label that stands for a named grouping published on the Web, such as the founding members of an airline alliance. The task gives one example value, practice feedback reveals one more member and one non-member, and the test checks unseen members and similar non-members. Probes certify that the base model knows the members of each grouping and does not guess it without feedback, and that the evidence identifies the grouping once labels are read as named groupings. An automated pipeline builds chains from a new data domain, and we release 20 chains over 10 domains. We evaluate six recent self-evolution methods. With the certifying model they barely learn. The best gain at most 5 points over a frozen agent and exclude only 6-12% of the unseen members from the count, fewer than the 20% reached by simply keeping the raw practice history. A fixed lesson that states the named-grouping convention lifts the same methods by 14.5 to 16.5 points. Their states hold the revealed member in 75-98% of cases and almost never the class name, and when practice exposes a member the list misses, they add that member to the list. With the stronger GPT-6-Sol, ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet learn from feedback alone. They reach 78% accuracy and solve 59-60% of the single cells, against 53% and 8% with the certifying model, and they surpass the raw history. CLR-Bench therefore measures how well an agent learns, and this ability differs across models.
2610.40758.affiliation: Singapore Management University / Guangdong University of Technology
2610.40758.update_target: Evaluation of persistent-state rule learning versus exception memorization
2610.40758.mechanism_en: Hidden grouping curricula test unseen members after sparse feedback, with knowledge/identifiability probes and raw-history controls.
2610.40758.result_en: On the certifying model, gains are at most 5 points; stronger GPT-6-Sol with ACE/Dynamic Cheatsheet reaches 78% accuracy.
2610.40758.boundary_en: The model dependence is central; retaining revealed examples is not evidence of abstract-rule induction or recursive improver gain.
2610.40758.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体根据反馈重写持久状态，但这种做法能否让其学会无人明确告知的规则，基本尚未经检验。智能体也可能仅将每次纠正记为例外，从而过关，其列表随新规则不断增长。我们提出潜在规则课程基准 CLR-Bench。每条链每一级都在先前规则之上增加一条隐藏规则。规则作用于一个不透明标签，该标签代表网上公开的有名称分组，例如某航空联盟的创始成员。任务提供一个示例值，练习反馈再揭示一个成员和一个非成员，测试检查未见成员及相似非成员。探测确认基础模型知道每个分组成员、在无反馈时不会猜出分组，并确认将标签理解为有名称分组后，证据能识别该分组。自动流水线可从新数据领域构建链，我们发布覆盖十个领域的二十条链。我们评估六种近期自进化方法。在用于认证的模型上，它们几乎学不会：相较冻结智能体，最佳增益最多五分，只从计数中排除 6%—12% 的未见成员，低于直接保留原始练习历史达到的 20%。一条明确说明命名分组惯例的固定经验，可使相同方法提高 14.5—16.5 分。其状态在 75%—98% 的情况下记录已揭示成员，却几乎不记录类名；练习暴露列表遗漏成员时，它们就把该成员加入列表。换成更强 GPT-6-Sol 后，ACE 与 Dynamic Cheatsheet 能仅凭反馈学习，达到 78% 准确率，解决 59%—60% 的单元，而认证模型为 53% 和 8%，并超过原始历史。CLR-Bench 因而测量智能体学习能力，而这种能力因模型而异。

2610.40906.title: Does Recursive Knowledge Construction Help Agents Verify Consensus Claims in Science?
2610.40906.authors: Lun Ai , Yu-Heng Wu , Jonathan Schaul , Leonie Küchenhoff , Denes Turei , Francesco Carli , Fabio Petroni , Aurelien Dugourd , Julio Saez-Rodriguez
2610.40906.abstract_en: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. Here, we examined two design axes: (1) what the recursion builds (the state of evidence) and (2) what controls it (the judge that decides when to stop). To measure them, we defined consensus scientific claim verification and measured these effects on this task, where a system must establish a claim's consensus stance from the open literature. We built a new consensus claim dataset, ProClaim-eval, including 718 claims with SUPPORT and REFUTE gold labels from five expert-curated databases spanning molecular biology, nuclear physics, and astronomy. Our instrument, ProClaim, persists an evidence state outside the model's context, so each axis can be studied with the other held fixed. Against verification systems and general-purpose agent harnesses, ProClaim ranks among the top three, with a significant advantage over the harnesses. We found that the evidence state improves performance over in-context accumulation, and it also matters what is stored in it. In addition, a trained judge that reads the evidence state performs better than fixed-round stopping. A judge trained separately and never exposed to ProClaim-eval achieves the highest agreement with the gold labels on three of five subsets, where it matches the off-the-shelf Claude Sonnet~4.6 judge and outperforms Claude Haiku~4.5. Our results support recursively maintaining a structured evidence state outside the model's context as an effective design for verifying claims in scientific agents.
2610.40906.affiliation: EMBL-EBI / Heidelberg University and Heidelberg University Hospital / EMBL Rome
2610.40906.update_target: External evidence state and learned stopping judge for scientific claim verification
2610.40906.mechanism_en: State content and stopping control are varied separately; a separately trained judge is tested on expert-curated gold claims.
2610.40906.result_en: ProClaim-eval contains 718 claims across five databases; the trained judge leads gold agreement on three of five subsets.
2610.40906.boundary_en: Recursive evidence construction is an inference process, not recursive improvement of model weights or the evidence-building algorithm.
2610.40906.abstract_zh: 近期科学智能体通过检索证据、构建中间状态并判断信息是否充分，递归构建知识。这些智能体通常在没有真实标签的情况下端到端评估，因此各设计选择的作用未知。我们考察两个设计轴：（1）递归构建什么，即证据状态；（2）什么控制递归，即决定何时停止的评判器。为测量其作用，我们定义科学共识主张验证任务，系统必须从公开文献确定主张的共识立场。我们构建 ProClaim-eval，包含来自五个专家整理数据库、覆盖分子生物学、核物理和天文学的 718 条主张，具有支持与反驳真实标签。研究工具 ProClaim 将证据状态持久化于模型上下文之外，使一个轴能在另一个固定时单独研究。相较验证系统及通用智能体 harness，ProClaim 排名前三，并显著优于 harness。我们发现，外部证据状态相较上下文内累积改善性能，状态存储内容也很重要。此外，读取证据状态的训练评判器优于固定轮次停止。单独训练且从未接触 ProClaim-eval 的评判器，在五个子集中的三个上取得最高真实标签一致性，在这些子集上与现成 Claude Sonnet 4.6 评判器相当，并超过 Claude Haiku 4.5。结果支持在模型上下文之外递归维护结构化证据状态，作为科学智能体验证主张的有效设计。

2610.41015.title: Do Language Models Know What Compelling Scientific Evidence Looks Like?
2610.41015.authors: Conor Igoe , Gabriel Grand , Zane Koch , Albert Bou , Eli Moss , Michaela M. Hinks , Samuel G. Rodriques , Andrew White , Siddharth Narayanan
2610.41015.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.41015.abstract_en: Expert scientists excel at weighing empirical findings from multiple sources that vary in both statistical reliability and epistemic relevance. To what extent are language models, which are increasingly driving autonomous discovery systems, capable of such evidence deliberation? We introduce EDB-Bio, a scientific reasoning benchmark curated from real-world data in three biological domains: drug-perturbation transcriptomics, CRISPR screens, and human genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Each of EDB-Bio's 96k episodes presents a sequence of experimental results from published studies and asks the model to predict the probability that a target hypothesis is true. Out-of-the-box, open-weight and frontier models alike demonstrate systematic underconfidence and attain Brier scores comparable to a trivial base-rate forecaster. Post-training against strictly proper scoring rules significantly improves both calibration and discrimination. This calibration pays off downstream: in a sequential experiment selection task, our Ibis0 model is 2.5 times more efficient than the best frontier model. Throughout, quantifying evidence weights as Bayes factors reveals how models update their beliefs over time, whether they agree with expert biologists on relevance, and where they exhibit inconsistencies and biases. Our work extends calibration training and uncertainty analysis to a realistic scientific forecasting setting with applications to human cancer biology. We release all code, data, and trained models.
2610.41015.update_target: Scientific probability forecasts and calibration-trained model weights
2610.41015.mechanism_en: Sequential published experimental evidence is scored with proper scoring rules; downstream experiment selection tests utility of calibrated beliefs.
2610.41015.result_en: EDB-Bio has 96k episodes; the trained Ibis0 is reported 2.5x more efficient than the best frontier model in sequential selection.
2610.41015.boundary_en: The task is evidence deliberation on three biological domains; calibration and retrospective selection do not establish autonomous wet-lab discovery.
2610.41015.abstract_zh: 专家科学家擅长权衡来自多个来源、统计可靠性和认识相关性各不相同的实证发现。越来越多地驱动自主发现系统的语言模型，在多大程度上能进行这种证据审议？我们提出 EDB-Bio，一个从三个生物领域真实数据整理的科学推理基准：药物扰动转录组学、CRISPR 筛选与人类全基因组关联研究。EDB-Bio 的 9.6 万个片段分别提供已发表研究的一系列实验结果，要求模型预测目标假设为真的概率。未经额外训练时，开放权重与前沿模型均表现出系统性置信不足，Brier 分数与平凡基础发生率预测器相当。针对严格适当评分规则的后训练，显著改善校准与区分能力。这种校准带来下游收益：在顺序实验选择任务中，我们的 Ibis0 比最佳前沿模型高效 2.5 倍。贯穿研究，使用 Bayes 因子量化证据权重，揭示模型如何随时间更新信念、其相关性判断是否与专家生物学家一致，以及存在何种不一致和偏差。工作将校准训练与不确定性分析扩展至真实科学预测设置，并可应用于人类癌症生物学。我们发布全部代码、数据和训练模型。

2610.41041.title: Before We Adapt: The Zero-Shot Generalization Bottleneck in Continual World Models
2610.41041.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires agents to operate under environmental changes while reusing prior knowledge whenever possible. We argue that model-based reinforcement learning provides a promising framework for this setting because learned world models (WMs) can, in principle, support change detection, knowledge reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. However, such benefits depend heavily on whether the learned model can generalize beyond the contexts in which it was trained. In this work, we propose to formulate this problem with a contextual Markov decision process in which context is decomposed into behavioral and physical components. This view organizes continual WM learning into reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. As a first step, we study direct reuse when behavioral rules remain unchanged. Using Dyna-Q and TD-MPC in controlled FourRooms tasks, we find that zero-shot reuse can degrade substantially under physical-context changes and that this behavior depends strongly on the observation representation used by the WM. Additional ablation studies and latent-space diagnostics suggest that learned representations do not automatically provide the invariances needed for reuse. These results identify representation generalization as an important bottleneck for reliable world-model reuse in CRL.
2610.41041.affiliation: Concordia University / McGill University / Independent researcher
2610.41041.update_target: Evaluation of zero-shot reuse before continual world-model adaptation
2610.41041.mechanism_en: A contextual-MDP decomposition holds behavioral rules fixed while changing physical context and observation representation in FourRooms.
2610.41041.result_en: Dyna-Q and TD-MPC can degrade substantially under physical-context shifts; representation diagnostics expose missing invariances.
2610.41041.boundary_en: These controlled simulations test reuse, not a completed continual learner or universal failure of model-based adaptation.
2610.41041.abstract_zh: 持续强化学习要求智能体在环境变化下运行，同时尽可能复用先前知识。我们认为，基于模型的强化学习为此提供有前景的框架，因为学得世界模型原则上可以支持变化检测、知识复用、适应和新知识获取。但这些收益高度取决于模型能否泛化到训练情境之外。本文提出以将上下文分为行为与物理成分的上下文马尔可夫决策过程来表述问题。这一视角将持续世界模型学习组织为复用、适应与新知识获取。作为第一步，我们研究行为规则不变时的直接复用。在受控 FourRooms 任务中使用 Dyna-Q 和 TD-MPC，发现物理上下文变化可能使零样本复用显著退化，且这种行为强烈依赖世界模型使用的观察表示。额外消融与潜在空间诊断提示，学得表示不会自动提供复用所需的不变性。这些结果将表示泛化识别为持续强化学习中可靠世界模型复用的重要瓶颈。

2610.41130.title: One Verdict Is Not Enough: Regression Testing Learned World Models and Their Test Harnesses
2610.41130.authors: Junyu Huo , Zihao Wan , Ziqi Mao , Gouri Ginde
2610.41130.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.41130.abstract_en: Learned world models ship as software components whose model versions, preprocessing, and test harnesses change between releases. Work on model updates already counts per-sample regressions, or negative flips, that an accuracy check hides. Two problems remain: a test can pass under one configuration and fail under another, and a harness fault can produce erroneous scores and wrong verdicts without a crash. We present TetraState, a regression-testing protocol for paired possible/impossible video tests. Each test runs under four fixed model-native configurations; its number of correct verdicts assigns one of four outcome classes. Inconclusive tests and failed executions are reported separately alongside the verdict rate. Revisions are compared by per-test outcome transitions, and the harness is versioned as part of the system under test. On all 506 IntPhys 2 Main tests and two heterogeneous systems, Cosmos 3 Nano and V-JEPA 2, two V-JEPA 2 harness revisions move modal accuracy by only 0.2 and 2.6 points yet change 11 and 214 test labels; in the second, accuracy rises although fewer tests are judged correctly, and 43 regressions keep the modal verdict, so a modal-verdict flip check misses them. These results outline a research agenda on configuration-level regression oracles for learned components.
2610.41130.update_target: Versioned world-model test harness and configuration-level regression labels
2610.41130.mechanism_en: Each paired possible/impossible video test runs under four fixed native configurations; outcome transitions, inconclusive cases and execution failures are tracked separately.
2610.41130.result_en: Across 506 IntPhys 2 tests, two harness revisions change 11/214 labels despite modal-accuracy changes of only 0.2/2.6 points; 43 regressions retain the modal verdict.
2610.41130.boundary_en: The evidence covers two heterogeneous systems and specific harness revisions; configuration-level correctness is not reducible to a single score.
2610.41130.abstract_zh: 学得世界模型作为软件组件发布，其模型版本、预处理和测试 harness 会随版本变化。模型更新研究已统计准确率检查掩盖的逐样本回归，即负向翻转。但仍存在两个问题：某测试可能在一种配置下通过、另一种下失败；harness 故障也可能在不崩溃的情况下产生错误分数和错误裁决。我们提出 TetraState，一个面向成对可能与不可能视频测试的回归测试协议。每项测试在四种固定、模型原生配置下运行，正确裁决数量将其划为四种结果类别。不确定测试与执行失败和裁决率一起单独报告。通过逐测试结果转移比较修订，并将 harness 作为被测系统的一部分进行版本管理。在全部 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试和 Cosmos 3 Nano、V-JEPA 2 两种异构系统上，V-JEPA 2 的两次 harness 修订仅使众数准确率变化 0.2 和 2.6 分，却改变 11 和 214 个测试标签；第二次修订中，虽然被正确判断的测试更少，准确率却上升，且 43 个回归仍保持众数裁决，因此众数裁决翻转检查会漏掉它们。这些结果提出了面向学得组件的配置级回归预言机研究议程。

2610.41157.title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
2610.41157.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.41157.abstract_en: Iterative language-model optimizers refine prompts and programs by evaluating a candidate, showing a proposer model a sample of failing cases, and keeping revisions that improve performance. Recent work attributes the limits of this loop to narrow single-round reflection, introducing full-set error clustering, targeted minibatches, or larger proposer models so the optimizer sees more failure modes per step. Yet every existing evaluation tests these mechanisms exclusively inside lineage-preserving search, where each revision edits a surviving parent, leaving the contribution of parent inheritance confounded with the breadth of per-round feedback. Across 1,750 pre-registered runs spanning nine prompt and program synthesis benchmarks, we separate parent inheritance from feedback disclosure under matched evaluation budgets. We find that greedy parent inheritance drives the vast majority of optimization progress, outperforming seed-reset resampling even when seed-reset proposals receive a clustered summary of all failures in every round or use a larger proposer model. While full-set error clustering and diverse failure selection improve single-step rewrites from the seed and accelerate the opening rounds of search, sequential parent inheritance rapidly closes this gap as solved error modes are retained in the candidate and filtered from subsequent failure lists. Moreover, decomposing token expenditure in GEPA reveals that proposer reflection accounts for only a small fraction of total cost whereas validation and minibatch gating consume nearly the entire budget, showing that greedy parent inheritance over raw failures captures the gains of complex reflective loops at a fraction of their compute.
2610.41157.update_target: Controlled attribution of optimization gains to lineage versus reflection
2610.41157.mechanism_en: Pre-registered matched-budget runs separate inherited parents from seed-reset proposals and failure-feedback disclosure breadth.
2610.41157.result_en: Across 1,750 runs and nine benchmarks, greedy inheritance drives most gains; validation and minibatch gating dominate GEPA token cost.
2610.41157.boundary_en: The claim is about short-budget tested searches; it does not prove reflection is useless in every optimizer or budget regime.
2610.41157.abstract_zh: 迭代语言模型优化器通过评估候选、向提议模型展示失败案例样本，并保留改善性能的修订，来完善提示和程序。近期工作将该循环的限制归因于狭窄的单轮反思，因而引入全量错误聚类、定向小批次或更大提议模型，让每步看到更多失败模式。但现有评估只在保持谱系的搜索内测试这些机制，每次修订都编辑一个存活父代，使父代继承作用与逐轮反馈广度混淆。我们在九个提示与程序合成基准的 1,750 次预注册运行中，以匹配评估预算分离父代继承与反馈披露。结果发现，贪心父代继承驱动绝大多数优化进展；即使重置为初始候选的提案每轮都收到全部失败的聚类摘要，或使用更大提议模型，继承仍优于初始重置重采样。全量错误聚类与多样失败选择虽改善从初始候选出发的单步重写、加速最初几轮搜索，但顺序父代继承很快弥合差距，因为已解决错误模式保留在候选中，并从后续失败列表中过滤。此外，分解 GEPA 词元支出发现，提议者反思仅占总成本很小一部分，验证与小批次门控几乎消耗全部预算。这表明，对原始失败采用贪心父代继承，可用复杂反思循环的一小部分算力取得其收益。
2610.41157.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and unresolved method macros are preserved in English.

2610.41272.title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
2610.41272.authors: Yini Huang , Aiwen LU , Zhen Sun , Yi Han , Yuzhi Zhao , Jiaheng Wei
2610.41272.abstract_en: Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution framework for red-teaming. Rather than evaluating a fixed attack set, ANGLER uses outcomes from prior rollouts to guide LLM-based attack mutation and candidate selection, prioritizing near-miss seeds during refinement. Across 8 VLM-based web agents, ANGLER achieves an end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) of 20.36%, compared with 15.24% for the non-adaptive setting. Compared with attack-free execution on the same benign tasks, attacks generated by ANGLER reduce benign task success rate (BSR) from 61.9% to 44.4%.
2610.41272.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) / Huazhong University of Science and Technology
2610.41272.update_target: Adaptive adversarial candidate pool and web-agent security evaluation
2610.41272.mechanism_en: State-based verifiers score executable objectives; near-miss seeds guide attack mutation and candidate retention.
2610.41272.result_en: Across eight web agents, adaptive ASR is 20.36% versus 15.24%; benign success drops from 61.9% to 44.4% under generated attacks.
2610.41272.boundary_en: This measures bounded adaptive red-teaming in nine controlled sites; it does not establish deployed-agent compromise or defense robustness.
2610.41272.abstract_zh: 网络智能体日益被部署为在真实网站上自主完成任务，但对抗性注入内容可能诱导它们执行未授权动作。现有评估主要采用固定攻击，或仅关注一种攻击类型，并在文本层面而非真实状态变化层面评估，因此低估了智能体对多样攻击的脆弱性。为弥补缺口，我们提出 REEF，一个具备忠实验证的可执行环境红队基准，用于测量网络智能体安全弱点。REEF 覆盖旅游、商业、生产力、媒体和通信等领域的九个验证器支撑网站，将每项真实良性任务与恶意目标配对，通过用户层和环境层的五类攻击递送。REEF 基于状态的验证器提供执行反馈，驱动 ANGLER，一个自适应、由接近成功案例指导的诱导攻击演化框架。ANGLER 不评估固定攻击集合，而是利用先前轨迹结果指导基于 LLM 的攻击变异与候选选择，在完善时优先采用近失种子。在八个基于 VLM 的网络智能体上，ANGLER 的端到端攻击成功率为 20.36%，非自适应设置为 15.24%。相比相同良性任务上的无攻击执行，ANGLER 生成的攻击将良性任务成功率从 61.9% 降至 44.4%。
2610.41272.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and unresolved method macros are preserved in English.

2610.41482.title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2610.41482.authors: Jinkyeong Choi , Chaebin Jeong , Junsung Jeon , Donghyeon Park
2610.41482.abstract_en: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.
2610.41482.update_target: Recursive textual memory and auxiliary training objectives
2610.41482.mechanism_en: A shared recursive interface compares information-content and update-sensitivity supervision; claim-level checks examine persistence of false incoming memories.
2610.41482.result_en: Reward-prediction supervision performs best among tested conditions before/after offline RL; one baseline trajectory documents persistent error.
2610.41482.boundary_en: A single claim-level case is exploratory, not a population estimate of memory reliability; task gains do not certify retained-information correctness.
2610.41482.abstract_zh: 递归文本记忆可能将早期错误带入后续更新，但仅有任务性能并不能建立记忆可靠性。我们将自一致性偏差定义为，传入记忆中已存在的错误主张持续保留。我们提出 KEEPER，在共享递归接口下，沿信息内容与更新敏感性两个轴比较四种辅助目标，研究监督目标与智能体性能的关系。在所评估条件中，与奖励相关的预测在离线强化学习之前和之后均取得最高任务性能，超过联合监督。对一个基线轨迹的主张级分析记录了即使出现纠正观察，错误仍持续存在。总体而言，这些分析说明，有必要在任务结果之外评估错误持续性与有效信息保持。

2610.41809.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
2610.41809.authors: Nis Meinert , Jakob Gawlikowski , Edward Grant , Max Cyprys , Nathan Schurr , Neil Boston , Alfredo Ibias , Milind Tambe , Janusz Marecki
2610.41809.abstract_en: This paper presents an opinionated set of ten desiderata intended to inform the design and evaluation of reinforcement-learning agents that learn continually throughout a continuing lifetime. We use these desiderata to examine a representative selection of existing approaches. Progress on individual desiderata is valuable, but the longer-term aim should be to integrate all ten within a single agent. To our knowledge, no published evaluation has yet provided evidence for such an integration. Likewise, the representative benchmarks we review probe different parts of this target, but separate evaluations do not establish that the corresponding properties coexist within one agent throughout a continuing lifetime. As a secondary contribution, we therefore present a compact persistent-world scenario as a playable companion to the desiderata and outline a proposed benchmark that examines a broad range of associated behavioral capabilities together within one such lifetime.
2610.41809.affiliation: FractalBrain / University College London / Harvard University / Independent researchers
2610.41809.update_target: Integrated evaluation criteria for lifelong continual RL
2610.41809.mechanism_en: Ten desiderata are used to audit existing approaches and motivate a shared persistent-world scenario.
2610.41809.result_en: The paper reports no published evaluation known to establish all ten properties together in one continuing agent; the benchmark remains proposed.
2610.41809.boundary_en: This is an opinionated framework and playable companion, not a completed demonstration of integrated lifelong RSI.
2610.41809.abstract_zh: 本文提出十项带有立场的期望性质，旨在指导设计和评估在持续一生中不断学习的强化学习智能体。我们使用这些性质审视一组选定的代表性现有方法。单项性质上的进展有价值，但长期目标应是在单个智能体中整合全部十项。据我们所知，尚无已发表评估提供这种整合的证据。同样，所审视的代表性基准探测该目标的不同部分，但分开评估并不能建立这些性质在同一智能体持续一生中共存。作为次要贡献，我们提出一个紧凑持久世界情境，作为这些性质的可游玩配套，并概述拟议基准，以在同一持续一生中共同检查广泛相关行为能力。

2610.41025.title: ReplayRCA: Measuring Post-hoc Diagnosis and Live Oversight of Agent Failures by Counterfactual Replay
2610.41025.abstract_en: When a language-model agent fails a multi-step task, can another model find the decisive mistake and fix it with a single action? We introduce ReplayRCA, a benchmark that scores such diagnoses by intervention rather than by agreement with annotations: the environment is restored to the state preceding the chosen step, the proposed action replaces the agent's own, and the same agent continues. The score, causal repair, is the continuation success rate minus that of a paired placebo that replays the agent's original action through the same mechanism. Two tracks share this protocol: a post-hoc autopsy, where the diagnoser sees the whole failed run and is told that it failed, and live oversight, where a supervisor watches the run unfold and may intervene once, before an irreversible action, without knowing whether the run will fail. Tasks come from OpsWorld, a deterministic, procedurally generated back-office environment with six difficulty levels, the last of which is multimodal (QR codes, handwriting). On 62 calibrated systematic failures, the best of 13 frontier models (Grok 4.7) reaches a causal repair of +51.3 points; the top eight models are statistically indistinguishable, the flagship models of the two largest vendors rank 8th and 12th, and 5 items are repaired by no model. Forcing a strong model to intervene at the last step costs it 17.1 points, so the last-step shortcut of annotation-based attribution benchmarks does not transfer. On 87 runs, the two best live supervisors are statistically tied and one of them is a small open-weight model (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash); the supervisor that is among the best post-hoc diagnosers (GPT-6.1 Sol) is the weakest live one (-14.5 points on the same runs, p = 0.002), so post-hoc diagnostic performance can be a poor proxy for live oversight. The environment and the evaluation code are released at this https URL .
2610.41025.mechanism_en: Restore the pre-action state, substitute one action, continue with the same executor, and subtract a paired original-action placebo.
2610.41025.result_en: Best post-hoc causal repair is +51.3 points on 62 failures; a strong post-hoc model is weakest live supervisor at -14.5 points on 87 runs.
2610.41025.boundary_en: Observed model ranks are uncertain; post-hoc and live tracks reveal different capabilities, and claims follow the saved listing rather than later HTML rewording.
2610.41025.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体在多步任务中失败时，另一个模型能否找出决定性错误，并仅用一个动作修复？我们提出 ReplayRCA，通过干预而非与标注的一致性为诊断评分：环境恢复到所选步骤前状态，提议动作替代智能体原动作，再由同一智能体继续。其分数“因果修复”是继续执行成功率减去成对安慰剂成功率，后者通过相同机制重放原始动作。两个轨道共享协议：事后剖析让诊断者看到完整失败运行并获知失败；实时监督则在运行展开时观察，可在不可逆动作前干预一次，却不知道运行是否会失败。任务来自 OpsWorld，一个确定性、程序生成的后台办公环境，具有六个难度等级，最后一级含二维码和手写等多模态内容。在 62 个经校准的系统性失败上，十三个前沿模型中最佳者 Grok 4.7 的因果修复达到 +51.3 分；前八模型统计上无法区分，两家最大厂商的旗舰模型排第八和第十二，五项任务无模型能修复。强制一个强模型在最后一步干预，使其损失 17.1 分，说明基于标注归因基准中的末步捷径无法迁移。在 87 次运行上，两个最佳实时监督器统计上并列，其中一个是小型开放权重模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash；事后诊断最佳者之一 GPT-6.1 Sol，却是最弱实时监督器，在同组运行上为 −14.5 分，p=0.002。因此，事后诊断性能可能很难代表实时监督。环境与评估代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2610.41056.title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
2610.41056.authors: Runze Zhao , Dongruo Zhou , Sumit Kumar Jha , Nathaniel D. Bastian , Ankit Shah
2610.41056.abstract_en: Since large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory, what they store now shapes what they do later. A memory manager decides how each input changes this memory and which records the agent acts on. It can fail in two ways: keeping a fact that has since changed (outdated memory), or storing a planted passage or injected instruction (memory poisoning). Most prior work studies them separately, yet they call for opposite write decisions, so no fixed write rule handles both. We therefore formalize memory robustness as handling both without doing worse on other inputs. Since accuracy checks only the answer, we measure robustness with evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA), which also checks that the records the manager selects include all the evidence the answer needs, updated and free of attacks. However, existing memory systems and defenses are not more robust than an untuned manager on our test sets. We improve robustness with a simple one-shot recipe that fine-tunes the manager on episodes synthesized around a single conversation with inserted changes and attacks. On three backbones, it improves every category score on our test sets and more than doubles the untuned manager's overall ECA, though robustness remains incomplete.
2610.41056.affiliation: Indiana University Bloomington / University of Florida / United States Military Academy
2610.41056.mechanism_en: A one-shot fine-tuning recipe uses synthetic changes and attacks; evidence-conditioned accuracy checks both the answer and the selected support records.
2610.41056.result_en: Across three backbones, every category improves and overall ECA more than doubles, while robustness remains incomplete.
2610.41056.boundary_en: One-shot manager training is not an ongoing recursive-learning loop; refusing all writes is not a sufficient robustness baseline.
2610.41056.abstract_zh: 由于 LLM 智能体依赖长期记忆，它们现在存储什么会影响以后做什么。记忆管理器决定每条输入如何改变记忆，以及智能体依据哪些记录行动。它可能以两种方式失败：保留已经变化的事实，即过时记忆；或存储植入段落和注入指令，即记忆投毒。多数先前工作分开研究二者，但它们要求相反的写入决策，因此没有固定写入规则能同时处理。我们将记忆鲁棒性形式化为同时处理二者且不使其他输入表现更差。准确率仅检查答案，因此我们采用证据条件化准确率 ECA 衡量鲁棒性，还检查被管理器选中的记录是否包含答案所需全部证据、是否已更新且不含攻击。但在我们的测试集上，已有记忆系统及防御并不比未经调优的管理器更鲁棒。我们用一个简单的一次性方案改善鲁棒性：围绕单段对话合成插入变化与攻击的片段，并据此微调管理器。在三个骨干上，该方案提高每个类别分数，并使总体 ECA 超过未经调优管理器的两倍，尽管鲁棒性仍不完整。
2610.41056.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and unresolved method macros are preserved in English.

2610.41433.title: What Does a Repair Agent Gain from Remembering Its Failure? An Exploratory Study on Real Python Bugs
2610.41433.authors: Wenbo Ye , Yongxi Zhou , Junwei Yao , Jiahui Ge
2610.41433.abstract_en: When a coding agent fails a repair task, it is often retried with a record of the failure: the transcript, a self-written lesson, or extracted test signals. We ask what such failure memory changes in the retry. On 75 BugsInPy bugs, we retried each of 181 failed attempts of gpt-5.4-mini under five conditions, with a predeclared analysis whose deviations we report. Two predeclared follow-ups repeated the plain-retry, transcript and lesson conditions with the larger gpt-5.4 and added a notice-only control. On the bug-revealing tests, every memory condition gained over a plain retry in point estimate (+5.5 to +9.9 points over 29.8%), but none significantly. Five further findings stand out. First, a model-written lesson showed no advantage over the transcript it summarises (-1.7 points, 95% CI [-8.7, +4.9]; -3.5 for gpt-5.4), although it costs an extra model call. Second, the transcript may do more than tell the agent that it failed: a notice alone produced no significant change, while the transcript resolved 12.2 points more failures than the notice for gpt-5.4-mini (CI [+4.2, +20.0], partial run of 156 failures; the only significant one of twelve predeclared contrasts, and not significant for gpt-5.4). Third, post hoc, fewer retries with memory ended without modifying any Python file, while the share of editing retries that touched a file the fix changes was near ceiling. Fourth, in a post hoc full-test-suite check, retries that had also seen the previous attempt's test results more often failed other tests that the reference fix passes, which shrinks their apparent gains. Fifth, outcomes varied far more between failures than between conditions, and we give the sample sizes a confirmatory study would need.
2610.41433.update_target: Controlled comparison of transcript, lesson and test-signal failure memory
2610.41433.mechanism_en: Fixed failed repair attempts are retried under predeclared conditions, with notice controls and later full-suite checks.
2610.41433.result_en: Memory gains of +5.5 to +9.9 points over 29.8% are not significant; model-written lessons show no advantage over transcripts.
2610.41433.boundary_en: Partial follow-up runs, reported deviations, multiple contrasts and post-hoc analyses constrain conclusions; point estimates are not confirmed gains.
2610.41433.abstract_zh: 编程智能体修复任务失败后，常会带着失败记录重试，例如完整转录、自写经验或提取的测试信号。我们研究这种失败记忆如何改变重试。在 75 个 BugsInPy 错误上，我们对 gpt-5.4-mini 的 181 次失败尝试，在五种条件下分别重试，使用事先声明的分析并报告偏离。两项预先声明的后续研究，用更大的 gpt-5.4 重复普通重试、转录和经验条件，并增加仅通知失败的对照。在揭示错误的测试上，每种记忆条件的点估计都高于普通重试，在 29.8% 基础上提高 5.5—9.9 分，但均不显著。另有五项发现。第一，模型编写经验相较被总结的转录没有优势：差值 −1.7 分，95% 置信区间 [−8.7,+4.9]；gpt-5.4 为 −3.5 分，却增加一次模型调用。第二，转录的作用可能不只是告知失败：仅通知无显著变化，而在 gpt-5.4-mini 上，转录比通知多解决 12.2 分的失败，置信区间 [+4.2,+20.0]；该部分运行包含 156 次失败，是十二项预先声明对比中唯一显著者，且在 gpt-5.4 上不显著。第三，事后分析中，带记忆的重试更少在未修改任何 Python 文件的情况下结束，而发生编辑的重试中，触及参考修复所改文件的比例已接近上限。第四，事后完整测试套件检查显示，还看过先前测试结果的重试，更常在参考修复能通过的其他测试上失败，使表面增益缩小。第五，不同失败间结果变异远大于不同条件间变异，我们给出确认性研究所需样本量。

2610.42043.title: Proof-Carrying Evolution: Black-Box Search, White-Box Flight
2610.42043.authors: Amit Jain , Sergio Sanchez-Hurtado , Victor Rodriguez-Fernandez , Richard Linares
2610.42043.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
2610.42043.abstract_en: We study whether a language model can help design controllers whose behavior can be formally checked. In proof-carrying evolution (PCE), a search proposes controllers together with their certificates. Their mathematical forms are fixed; a proposer chooses their numerical parameters together. Certificate checks guide selection, and only a certified candidate can be returned. The deployed artifact is a control law and its certificate; the language model is used only during design. We compare four language models with classical search and synthesis on docking under a speed limit, pursuit of a maneuvering target, and attitude control on SO(3), using paired runs and shared proposal allowances. Certificates are checked in exact rational arithmetic during search on the linear problems. On SO(3), the search uses floating-point checks, followed by exact re-verification of every reported champion. The best run of each method also receives Lean 4 proofs of its stated control properties. On the linear problems, the strongest models beat the standard classical baselines on every run, but a classical optimizer that chooses certificates for the same objective closes most of that lead. Among the cited pursuit champions, the ranking does not survive a change from Euler to zero-order-hold dynamics. On SO(3), no model detectably outperforms CMA-ES when mixed with classical mutation. When models write every proposal, one tested model improves on CMA-ES and the other performs worse than its mixed variant. All search medians remain below the hand-tuned law. In a docking control with the objective and mutation operator held fixed, retaining certified candidates yields new certified designs in every run; removing this rule yields none.
2610.42043.affiliation: Massachusetts Institute of Technology / Universidad Politecnica de Madrid
2610.42043.update_target: Certified controller/certificate parameter pairs and bounded evolutionary selection
2610.42043.mechanism_en: Exact rational checks guide linear-task search; SO(3) champions receive exact re-verification and selected best runs receive Lean proofs.
2610.42043.result_en: Certificate-aware classical optimization closes most linear-task LLM gains; all search medians remain below a hand-tuned law.
2610.42043.boundary_en: Proofs cover stated forms, assumptions and dynamics; pursuit ranking changes under Euler versus zero-order-hold dynamics.
2610.42043.abstract_zh: 我们研究语言模型能否辅助设计行为可形式检查的控制器。在携证演化 PCE 中，搜索同时提出控制器和证书。二者数学形式固定，提议者共同选择数值参数。证书检查指导选择，只有经认证候选才能返回。部署产物是控制律及其证书，语言模型只用于设计期间。我们在有限速对接、追逐机动目标以及 SO(3) 姿态控制任务上，使用成对运行和共享提案额度，将四个语言模型与经典搜索、综合方法比较。在线性问题中，搜索期间采用精确有理数运算检查证书。在 SO(3) 上，搜索采用浮点检查，随后对每个报告冠军进行精确复核。每种方法的最佳运行还获得所声明控制性质的 Lean 4 证明。在线性问题上，最强模型每次运行均超过标准经典基线，但针对相同目标选择证书的经典优化器弥合了大部分差距。在所引用的追逐冠军中，将动力学从 Euler 改为零阶保持后，排名不再成立。在 SO(3) 上，与经典变异混合时，没有模型可检测地超过 CMA-ES。当模型编写全部提案时，一种测试模型优于 CMA-ES，另一种则差于其混合版本。所有搜索中位数均低于手调控制律。在目标与变异算子固定的对接对照中，保留认证候选在每次运行中都产生新认证设计，而移除该规则后一次也没有。
2610.42043.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and unresolved method macros are preserved in English.

2611.00463.title: Exo: An Architecture for Self-Improving Systems at Runtime
2611.00463.authors: Alexander Krentsel , Sylvia Ratnasamy , Ion Stoica , Martin Casado , Ankur Goyal
2611.00463.abstract_en: Agent harnesses govern how language models act in an environment; designing their policies by hand is difficult, while automated techniques require representative datasets and costly executions. We present Exo, an agent runtime architecture for safe learning during ongoing work that collapses the optimization loop into task execution, allowing agents to revise both their harness and their strategies for further improvement. A minimal protected mechanism layer preserves execution history and governs policy activation while the harness evolves through inspectable code changes. On long-running objectives in an open-world game, Exo reduces model cost by 12-53% relative to Codex and Pi in standalone runs and 45-82% in transfer runs, while matching task completion rates. Compared with the same starting policy without the ability to edit policy, Exo reduces held-out model cost by 35-61% on AppWorld and SREGym with comparable correctness, cutting AppWorld's mean task time by 13% and SREGym's median diagnosis time by 35%. On Continual Learning Bench coding tasks, model cost including learning falls by 14%, with both policies resolving every issue.
2611.00463.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / Andreessen Horowitz / Braintrust
2611.00463.update_target: Executable harness policies and strategies for further improvement
2611.00463.mechanism_en: Agents edit inspectable policy code while working; a protected mechanism preserves execution history and controls activation. Retained policies guide later work and further edits.
2611.00463.result_en: Model cost falls 12–53% in standalone game runs and 45–82% in transfer runs; held-out AppWorld/SREGym cost falls 35–61% with comparable correctness. Continual Learning Bench cost including learning falls 14%.
2611.00463.boundary_en: An explicit runtime self-modification loop; model-weight learning is not the stated update. Protected activation and finite transfer tests do not establish unrestricted safe improvement.
2611.00463.abstract_zh: Agent 运行框架决定语言模型如何在环境中行动；手工设计其策略很困难，而自动化技术又需要有代表性的数据集和昂贵的执行。我们提出 Exo，一种支持在持续工作过程中安全学习的 Agent 运行时架构，它把优化循环融入任务执行，使 Agent 能同时修订自身运行框架及进一步改进的策略。当运行框架通过可检查的代码变更演化时，一个最小化的受保护机制层保留执行历史并管理策略激活。在开放世界游戏的长期目标上，与 Codex 和 Pi 相比，Exo 在独立运行中将模型成本降低 12–53%，在迁移运行中降低 45–82%，同时保持相当的任务完成率。与无法编辑策略的相同初始策略相比，Exo 在 AppWorld 和 SREGym 的留出测试上将模型成本降低 35–61%，正确性相当，并将 AppWorld 平均任务时间缩短 13%、SREGym 诊断时间中位数缩短 35%。在 Continual Learning Bench 编码任务上，包含学习在内的模型成本下降 14%，两种策略均解决了全部问题。

2611.01113.title: CogRSI: Evolving and Auditing Cognitive Reasoning Strategies
2611.01113.authors: Yandan zheng , Haoran Luo , Xinliang Zhou , Anhtuan Luu
2611.01113.abstract_en: Can a language model learn better ways to reason about other people's minds by improving its own strategies, and are the strategies it learns actually right? We study this with cogrsi. A grounded reader marks who saw each event in a story and uses a short written principle to settle disagreements between its readings. With a principle written by experts, it beats self-consistency at the same token cost. A self-improvement loop then writes the principle itself. It keeps an update only if accuracy rises by a calibrated margin, and in one variant only if it also passes counterfactual test pairs. The learned principles transfer: on 800 BigToM pairs that no system had seen, each of them scores higher than the expert principle. We then check what the learned rules actually say. Each rule is translated into code and run on thousands of small stories with known answers. Most of them give a wrong answer in at least one situation they claim to cover, for example by treating a character who is in the room as knowing what happened even while asleep. Accuracy does not reveal which rules are wrong, and the counterfactual test does not fix this. A strategy can help in practice and still be wrong as a rule, so both need checking. Our code and data are publicly available.
2611.01113.affiliation: Nanyang Technological University / Stanford University / VinUniversity
2611.01113.mechanism_en: A grounded reader tracks event witnesses; the loop writes principles and retains changes only after calibrated accuracy gains, optionally also counterfactual-pair tests. An executable small-story audit separately checks rule validity.
2611.01113.result_en: Learned principles outperform an expert principle on 800 unseen BigToM pairs; most rules nevertheless fail within their claimed scope on exhaustive small-story tests.
2611.01113.boundary_en: Empirical transfer and rule validity diverge. Counterfactual gating does not eliminate false rules; translating principles into code introduces an audit representation that must itself be checked.
2611.01113.abstract_zh: 语言模型能否通过改进自身策略，学会更好地推理他人的心理？它学到的策略真的正确吗？我们用 cogrsi 研究这一问题。一个有依据的阅读器标记故事中谁目睹了每个事件，并用一条简短的书面原则解决不同阅读结果之间的分歧。使用专家撰写的原则时，它在相同 token 成本下优于自一致性方法。随后，自改进循环自己撰写这条原则。只有当准确率提高超过校准后的幅度时，系统才保留更新；其中一个变体还要求更新通过反事实测试对。所学原则能够迁移：在所有系统均未见过的 800 对 BigToM 样例上，每条所学原则的得分都高于专家原则。接着，我们检查所学规则实际上表达了什么。每条规则都被翻译成代码，并在数千个答案已知的小故事上运行。大多数规则在其声称覆盖的至少一种情形下给出了错误答案，例如将身处房间但正在睡觉的人物视为知道发生了什么。准确率无法揭示哪些规则有错，反事实测试也未解决这一问题。策略可以在实践中有帮助，却仍然是一条错误的规则，因此两者都需要检查。我们的代码与数据已公开。

2611.01695.title: SPAR: Experience-Driven Strategy Evolution in Multi-Session B2B Sales
2611.01695.authors: Hangming Zhang , Yao Zhao , Haotian Kuang , C. L. Philip Chen , Tong Zhang , Tengyue Ma
2611.01695.abstract_en: B2B outbound sales involves high transaction values and relationship-based trust, so closing a deal typically requires multiple rounds of outreach building on prior context. Existing LLM-based sales agents operate within single sessions and cannot carry forward context or refine strategies from experience. Methods that do learn from experience store lessons as unstructured text and treat all outcomes as equally informative, with no mechanism to distinguish a flawed strategy from an external factor. We propose SPAR, a self-evolving framework that models selling strategies as testable hypotheses and refines them without parameter updates. A double-loop architecture lets an inner loop adapt to individual merchants through episodic memory while an outer loop evolves a shared strategy playbook through causal attribution and hypothesis-driven evolution. In a live A/B test on the 1688 platform with over 200,000 merchants, SPAR achieves +15.8% conversion lift and +35.8% high-intent merchant growth. Human evaluation by domain experts rates SPAR at 4.62 out of 5 on overall sales quality, the highest among all methods.
2611.01695.affiliation: South China University of Technology / Alibaba Group
2611.01695.update_target: Merchant episodic memory and a shared sales-strategy playbook
2611.01695.mechanism_en: An inner loop adapts to each merchant; an outer loop attributes outcomes and evolves testable strategy hypotheses, retaining the shared playbook for later sessions without parameter updates.
2611.01695.result_en: A live 1688 A/B test involving over 200,000 merchants reports 15.8% conversion lift and 35.8% high-intent merchant growth; expert quality rating is 4.62/5.
2611.01695.boundary_en: These are author-reported industrial results. Causal attribution is a mechanism claim, not independent proof that every retained strategy caused the measured lift.
2611.01695.abstract_zh: B2B 外呼销售涉及高交易价值和基于关系的信任，因此成交通常需要基于先前上下文开展多轮沟通。现有基于 LLM 的销售 Agent 在单次会话内运行，无法延续上下文或从经验中优化策略。能够从经验中学习的方法也将经验教训保存为非结构化文本，把所有结果视为具有相同信息量，没有机制区分有缺陷的策略和外部因素。我们提出 SPAR，一种将销售策略建模为可检验假设、并在不更新参数的情况下优化策略的自演化框架。双循环架构使内循环通过情景记忆适应单个商家，而外循环通过因果归因和假设驱动的演化更新共享策略手册。在 1688 平台覆盖超过 20 万商家的在线 A/B 测试中，SPAR 实现了 +15.8% 的转化提升和 +35.8% 的高意向商家增长。领域专家的人类评估给 SPAR 的整体销售质量打出 4.62 分（满分 5 分），在所有方法中最高。
2611.01695.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01695.image_caption: Figure 1: Single-session agents repeat generic pitches across isolated calls without addressing the merchant’s core objection, leading to repeated rejections. Multi-session human salespeople follow up on specific concerns, build on prior context, and achieve conversion. S 1 , S 2 , … S_{1},S_{2},\ldots denote session 1, session 2, and so on.

2611.01736.title: RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents
2611.01736.authors: Wanying Qu , Zhiyuan Fan , Jiyao Liu , Jiang Zhou , Jianghan Shen , Yanwei Fu , Dongrui Liu
2611.01736.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions agent systems that autonomously improve their own models and harnesses, with each updated system continuing to improve itself. Existing approaches typically restrict optimization objectives, editable components, or evaluation procedures, limiting open-ended exploration and continuity across generations. We introduce RSI-Env, a persistent environment for coordinated model-harness improvement, supporting autonomous training, harness modification, and retention of research state. An independent Host Controller manages services, evaluation, and versioning. Under Self, each accepted model-harness version takes over the next improvement round. We define three settings that vary goal specificity and access to benchmark feedback: Open-General, Capability-Directed, and Benchmark-Guided. Across these three settings, we compare Self with two fixed external Teachers on seven tasks, starting from Qwen3.8-27B with a minimal harness. Without benchmark feedback, Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond accuracy from 65.2% to 73.2% and AIME 2026 accuracy from 53.3% to 56.7%. All three Capability-Directed Self runs achieve target-aligned gains. Knowledge Self demonstrates continued improvement across system updates, with SimpleQA accuracy rising from 82.0% to 85.0% and then 88.0%. Benchmark guidance and Teacher benefits vary by task. These results demonstrate RSI-Env's support for open-ended exploration and sustained recursive improvement within the studied runs, while highlighting challenges in preserving gains across capabilities.
2611.01736.affiliation: Fudan University / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Georgia Institute of Technology / Nanjing University / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / Shanghai Innovation Institute
2611.01736.update_target: Model weights, executable harness and persistent research state
2611.01736.mechanism_en: An independent Host Controller manages evaluation and versioning; in Self, each accepted model–harness version becomes the system conducting the next improvement round. Settings separate benchmark access from broader goals.
2611.01736.result_en: Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond 65.2%→73.2% and AIME 2026 53.3%→56.7% without benchmark feedback; Knowledge Self progresses 82%→85%→88% on SimpleQA.
2611.01736.boundary_en: This directly tests successor-driven improvement in finite runs. Teacher benefit varies and gains across capabilities are not automatically preserved; no unlimited trajectory is demonstrated.
2611.01736.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）设想 Agent 系统自主改进自身模型与运行框架，并由每个更新后的系统继续改进自身。现有方法通常限制优化目标、可编辑组件或评估过程，因而限制了开放式探索和跨代连续性。我们提出 RSI-Env，一个支持模型与运行框架协同改进的持久环境，可开展自主训练、运行框架修改并保留研究状态。独立的 Host Controller 管理服务、评估和版本控制。在 Self 模式下，每个被接受的模型—运行框架版本接管下一轮改进。我们定义三种设置，改变目标具体程度和对基准反馈的访问：Open-General、Capability-Directed 和 Benchmark-Guided。在这三种设置下，我们以配备最小运行框架的 Qwen3.8-27B 为起点，在七项任务上比较 Self 与两个固定的外部 Teacher。在没有基准反馈的情况下，Open-General Self 将 GPQA Diamond 准确率从 65.2% 提高到 73.2%，将 AIME 2026 准确率从 53.3% 提高到 56.7%。三个 Capability-Directed Self 运行均取得与目标一致的改进。Knowledge Self 展示了跨系统更新的持续改进，SimpleQA 准确率从 82.0% 升至 85.0%，再升至 88.0%。基准指导和 Teacher 的收益因任务而异。这些结果展示了 RSI-Env 在所研究运行中支持开放式探索及持续递归改进的能力，同时凸显了跨能力保留收益的挑战。
