2611.01747.title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
2611.01747.authors: Zeyuan Zhao , Yuanyuan Shi , Peng Yu , Lingyue Fu , Shao Zhang , Ying Wen
2611.01747.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.01747.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first-attempt success by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline, while reducing per-task token use by a factor of 5.7 to 62.5 relative to ACE with GPT-5.2. Controlled ablations further support the benefits of learned routing and continued routing policy adaptation.
2611.01747.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
2611.01747.update_target: Experience memory and an online contextual-bandit routing policy
2611.01747.mechanism_en: Task feedback updates both memory and the controller selecting DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE or DISTILL. Routing determines whether to retrieve, which representation to use and when to consolidate guidance for future tasks.
2611.01747.result_en: Across four benchmarks and four backbones, first-attempt success improves by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline; GPT-5.2 token use is 5.7–62.5 times lower than ACE.
2611.01747.boundary_en: The meta-controller learns even though this is not stated as backbone-weight training. Token comparisons are baseline/model-specific; online task feedback availability is an assumption.
2611.01747.abstract_zh: 自演化 Agent 从任务流中积累经验，但现有框架通常依赖固定流水线检索和使用这些经验，忽略了何时以及如何部署经验。我们提出经验在线元控制（Online Meta-Control of Experience，OMCE），它在测试时适应过程中，根据任务反馈更新经验记忆并学习元控制策略。OMCE 使用轻量级上下文赌博机元控制器，根据紧凑的检索信号在四种认知动作间选择：DIRECT、EPISODE、GUIDE 和 DISTILL。这种路由机制实现三个相互关联的决策：是否调用经验、使用何种记忆格式、何时整合新指导。OMCE 在线演化，利用任务反馈更新记忆库，并通过上下文赌博机更新优化路由策略。在四个在线适应基准和四种骨干模型上的实验表明，相较于最强对比基线，OMCE 将首次尝试成功率最多提高 20.5 个百分点；相较于使用 GPT-5.2 的 ACE，每任务 token 使用量减少至其 1/5.7 到 1/62.5。受控消融进一步支持了学习路由及持续适应路由策略的益处。
2611.01747.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01747.image_caption: Figure 1: From Fixed Pipelines to Learned Meta-Control. Up: Existing methods typically follow a fixed routine for using and consolidating experience, even when the retrieved experience does not help the current task. Down: OMCE learns from task feedback when to use experience, whether to draw on past cases or general guidance, and when to distill new guidance.

2611.01870.title: Automated Stateful Specialization for Adaptive Agent Systems
2611.01870.authors: Myan Vu , Harrish Ayyanar , Jiang Pang , Anwiketh Reddy , Mayank Goel
2611.01870.abstract_en: Current automated agent design frameworks produce either static workflows that lack adaptability or per-query optimizers that prevent the accumulation of deep, agent-level task expertise. We propose a new direction that reconciles these paradigms: creating stateful teams of specialist agents that accumulate knowledge over time and can be reconfigured for novel tasks entirely without human intervention. To this end, we introduce ASpec, a framework that manages this full agent lifecycle by first autonomously discovering specialist archetypes via evolutionary search and then cultivating their expertise through experience, mirroring how human experts learn through practice and reflection. We further introduce a lightweight hierarchical control policy, "retain-then-escalate," which governs when to leverage the established agent system versus when to adapt its structure. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that this approach leads to significant performance gains on expert-level scientific benchmarks like GPQA while matching the state-of-the-art on broader domain tasks, demonstrating a promising path toward agent systems that are simultaneously expert, adaptive, and efficient. We will release the code at this https URL .
2611.01870.affiliation: University College London / Algoverse / Northeastern University / Lossfunk / University of Auckland
2611.01870.update_target: Stateful specialist expertise and team structure
2611.01870.mechanism_en: Evolutionary search discovers specialist archetypes, experience cultivates their persistent expertise, and retain-then-escalate control decides when to reuse the team or restructure it.
2611.01870.result_en: The abstract reports GPQA gains and competitive broader-domain performance, without an aggregate numerical effect size.
2611.01870.boundary_en: A plausible retained system-design loop; the abstract leaves detailed acceptance tests unspecified. Its code statement is a future release promise, not proof of an available repository.
2611.01870.abstract_zh: 当前自动化 Agent 设计框架要么产生缺乏适应性的静态工作流，要么采用逐查询优化器，无法积累深厚的 Agent 级任务专长。我们提出一个协调两种范式的新方向：创建有状态的专家 Agent 团队，使其随时间积累知识，并能完全无需人工干预地针对新任务重新配置。为此，我们提出 ASpec，它管理完整的 Agent 生命周期，先通过演化搜索自主发现专家原型，再通过经验培养其专长，类似人类专家通过实践与反思学习。我们进一步提出轻量级分层控制策略“retain-then-escalate”，决定何时利用已建立的 Agent 系统、何时调整其结构。通过全面实验，我们证明这种方法在 GPQA 等专家级科学基准上带来显著性能提升，同时在更广领域任务上达到当前最先进水平，展示了一条通向兼具专长、适应性和效率的 Agent 系统的有前景路径。我们将在原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址发布代码。
2611.01870.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01870.image_caption: Figure 1: The three main components of ASpec .

2611.01977.title: EvoRec: A Unified Self-Evolving Agentic Recommender with Dynamic Reflection Trees
2611.01977.authors: Mengting Li , Long Zhang , Hao Jiang , Sheng Yu , Fei Pan , Peng Jiang
2611.01977.abstract_en: Conventional recommender systems rely on fixed cascaded pipelines, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving user needs and feedback. Existing agentic recommenders introduce reasoning and tool use but often lack end-to-end decision control and systematic failure reflection. We propose EvoRec, a unified agentic recommendation framework that combines autonomous decision-making with reflection-driven self-evolution. A Need Agent infers user needs from long-term, short-term, and working memory. A Planning Agent adaptively allocates retrieval budgets between Behavior Continuation and Need Satisfaction, selects retrieval tools, and sets ranking-fusion weights. An Acting Executor executes the plan and records decision traces. Following user feedback, a Dynamic Reflection Tree identifies failures in need inference, planning, or previous repairs, proposes personalized corrections, and validates them through replay. Verified repairs update working memory and are distilled into reusable cross-user strategies, enabling continual improvement without parameter updates. Experiments on a Kuaishou local-services advertising dataset show a 15.7% Hit@50 improvement over the strongest baseline. Hierarchical reflection further improves Hit@50 by 13.1% among users with prior repairs. In a seven-day online A/B test, nearline EvoRec increases advertising revenue by 4.6% and CTCVR by 3.5%, with a 14.5% revenue gain for high-intent users. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of reflection-driven self-evolution in industrial-scale recommendation.
2611.01977.update_target: Personalized working-memory repairs and reusable cross-user strategies
2611.01977.mechanism_en: A Dynamic Reflection Tree diagnoses need/planning/repair failures, proposes corrections and validates them by replay. Verified repairs enter memory and are distilled into strategies for later users; weights stay fixed.
2611.01977.result_en: Hit@50 improves 15.7% over the strongest baseline; a seven-day Kuaishou A/B test reports revenue +4.6%, CTCVR +3.5%, and high-intent-user revenue +14.5%.
2611.01977.boundary_en: Replay acceptance and online business outcomes are different evidence layers. Industrial results are author reports, with no independent reproduction here.
2611.01977.abstract_zh: 传统推荐系统依赖固定的级联流水线，限制了其适应用户需求和反馈变化的能力。现有 Agent 推荐系统引入推理与工具使用，却往往缺乏端到端决策控制和系统性的失败反思。我们提出 EvoRec，一个将自主决策与反思驱动自演化结合的统一 Agent 推荐框架。Need Agent 从长期、短期和工作记忆推断用户需求。Planning Agent 在行为延续与需求满足之间自适应分配检索预算，选择检索工具，并设置排序融合权重。Acting Executor 执行计划并记录决策轨迹。收到用户反馈后，Dynamic Reflection Tree 识别需求推断、规划或先前修复中的失败，提出个性化修正，并通过回放验证。经过验证的修复更新工作记忆，再提炼成可跨用户复用的策略，从而无需参数更新即可持续改进。在快手本地服务广告数据集上的实验显示，Hit@50 相较最强基线提高 15.7%。分层反思进一步将有先前修复记录用户的 Hit@50 提高 13.1%。在为期七天的在线 A/B 测试中，近线 EvoRec 将广告收入提高 4.6%、CTCVR 提高 3.5%，并使高意向用户收入提高 14.5%。这些结果展示了反思驱动自演化在工业级推荐中的有效性。
2611.01977.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01977.image_caption: Figure 1 . Conventional cascaded recommendation vs. EvoRec. (a) Conventional recommenders rely on predefined pipelines and offline parameter updates. (b) EvoRec integrates autonomous recommendation with reflection-driven self-evolution, using a Dynamic Reflection Tree to diagnose errors and provide personalized repair strategies without updating agent parameters.

2611.02079.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
2611.02079.authors: Xingzhi Qian , Sungho Park , Rongyuan Tan , Jianbo Yu , Jue Zhang , Lorenzo Cavallaro , Menglin Xia , Yanzhi Chen , Xinnuo Xu , Yu Kang , Xinran Zheng , Gagan Somashekar , Xuchao Zhang , Chetan Bansal , Qingwei Lin , Victor Rühle
2611.02079.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2611.02079.abstract_en: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.
2611.02079.affiliation: University College London / Pohang University of Science and Technology / Southern University of Science and Technology / Southeast University / Microsoft / Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2611.02079.update_target: Parent harness code and the pool of reusable optimization candidates
2611.02079.mechanism_en: Repeated parent/candidate executions feed Bayesian-bootstrap Pareto support. Promotion preserves credible quality or cost progress and retains candidates as future parents; deployment selection uses a separate preference.
2611.02079.result_en: ClawMark quality rises 70.86%→81.35% as cost falls $1.17→$1.01; GAIA2 rises 56.22%→62.89% with $0.78→$0.45 cost on domain-disjoint splits.
2611.02079.boundary_en: Intermediate retention differs from deployment acceptance. Bootstrap evidence depends on repeated-run coverage; final inference savings alone do not establish total search-cost savings.
2611.02079.abstract_zh: 运行框架优化无需修改模型权重，就能显著提升 LLM Agent，但现有方法主要优化响应质量。将其扩展到质量—成本联合优化会带来一个挑战：在中间更新中应用部署偏好，可能过早拒绝对后续改进有价值的候选。我们提出 ParetoSaddler，通过分离中间候选晋升和最终部署选择来解决这一不匹配。每次迭代中，优化器更新一个父运行框架以生成候选，随后通过重复执行比较两者，并利用贝叶斯自助法的帕累托支持度，晋升在质量或成本任一维度上表现出可信进展的候选。被晋升的候选接受更广泛的开发集评估，并保留为后续优化步骤的可选父代。我们采用领域不相交划分，在 ClawMark 和 GAIA2 上评估 ParetoSaddler。在 ClawMark 上，质量从 70.86% 提高到 81.35%，每任务成本从 1.17 美元降至 1.01 美元；在 GAIA2 上，质量从 56.22% 提高到 62.89%，每任务成本从 0.78 美元降至 0.45 美元。帕累托选择的运行框架也比仅优化质量的运行框架实现更高质量和更低成本。分析表明，帕累托感知优化保留了会被部署偏好抛弃、但能支持后续改进的中间候选，而贝叶斯自助法筛选会滤除跨运行支持较弱的收益。
2611.02079.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.02079.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of ParetoSaddler. Repeated execution and statistical Pareto promotion identify candidates for development evaluation. The updated candidate pool and Pareto archive support continued optimization, with final harness selection governed by the deployment preference.

2611.02391.title: Late Autumn: LLM Agents Specialize a General Multi-Robot Planner for One Warehouse
2611.02391.authors: Yimin Tang , Han Zhang , Shao-Hung Chan , Erdem Bıyık , Sven Koenig , Jingkai Chen
2611.02391.abstract_en: No algorithm is best on all problems, but a real warehouse is a narrow problem: its layout and processes rarely change. Operators still run one general multi-robot planner at many sites, because experts cannot tune it for each one. In this work, which we call Late Autumn, we explore whether LLM coding agents running autonomous research can specialize a general planner for one site, trading generality for throughput, much as post-training adapts a pretrained LLM to one task. We study six campaigns on a lifelong planner that combines task assignment with multi-agent path finding, on a floor modeled on an existing automated warehouse. We find that (1) the agents raise throughput by 22--60%, and the gains hold on unseen seeds; (2) they rediscover known MAPF mechanisms, such as corridor-exit priorities, local guidance, and rollouts, and independent campaigns find the same bottleneck; (3) the gains largely carry over to another layout, a larger fleet, and other service times, shrink with a smaller fleet, and mostly vanish under an outbound-heavy demand mix; and (4) each final patch (0.7k--2.4k lines) is a chain of scored commits with a median step of 27 lines, so experts can review it, and review finds problems that the score misses; some patches multiply planner compute by over 100x. LLM agents can therefore turn each site's bias into extra throughput at little engineering cost, with reviewable patches; we expect experts to shift toward designing insightful metrics and fast simulators that mirror the real problem.
2611.02391.affiliation: University of Southern California / Symbotic / University of California, Irvine
2611.02391.image_caption: Figure 2: (a) The agent edits a general planner for one site, self-tests on public seeds with traces, and is scored only on hidden seeds; experts review the diffs. (b) The tuned site: aisles and station lanes are one-wide corridors, and one cell links the two halves.
2611.02391.mechanism_en: Six autonomous research campaigns score successive code commits in a warehouse-floor simulation; final patches retain earlier changes. Unseen seeds and changed layouts/fleets test transfer, with expert code review supplementing throughput scores.
2611.02391.result_en: Throughput rises 22–60%, but gains mostly vanish for outbound-heavy demand and some patches multiply planner compute by over 100 times.
2611.02391.boundary_en: A floor modeled on an existing warehouse is not a live-fleet deployment experiment. More throughput can conceal much more compute and defects missed by the score.
2611.02391.abstract_zh: 没有算法能在所有问题上最优，但真实仓库是一个狭窄的问题：布局和流程很少变化。运营者仍在许多场地运行同一个通用多机器人规划器，因为专家无法逐一调优。在这项名为 Late Autumn 的工作中，我们探索开展自主研究的 LLM 编码 Agent 能否针对单一场地专门化通用规划器，以通用性换取吞吐量，类似于后训练把预训练 LLM 适配到单一任务。我们研究了六次实验活动，使用一个结合任务分配与多 Agent 路径寻找的终身规划器，场地按现有自动化仓库建模。我们发现：（1）Agent 将吞吐量提高 22–60%，并在未见随机种子上保留收益；（2）它们重新发现了走廊出口优先级、局部引导和 rollout 等已知 MAPF 机制，不同独立实验也发现了同一瓶颈；（3）收益大体可迁移至另一布局、更大车队及不同服务时间，在更小车队上缩小，在出库占主导的需求组合下大多消失；（4）每个最终补丁（0.7k–2.4k 行）都是一串经过评分的提交，中位步长为 27 行，因此专家可以审查，而且审查发现了评分遗漏的问题；一些补丁令规划计算量增加超过 100 倍。因此，LLM Agent 能以较少工程投入，将每个场地的特性转化为额外吞吐量，并留下可审查补丁；我们预计专家会转向设计有洞察力的指标和能反映真实问题的快速模拟器。

2611.02501.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
2611.02501.authors: Kunjun Li , Wenhao Chai , Yihao Liang , Yuezhou Hu , Shuyao Xu , Yi Pan , William X. Zheng , Kannan Ramchandran , Kurt Keutzer , Jiantao Jiao
2611.02501.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.
2611.02501.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / Princeton University / Stanford University / NVIDIA
2611.02501.update_target: Speculative-decoding algorithms, systems code and validated mechanism memory
2611.02501.mechanism_en: A cost model prioritizes gaps, parallel agents explore and integrate successful edits, and token forcing checks every token against stock to detect reward hacking. Structured validated memory is reused across rounds and deployments.
2611.02501.result_en: Across four targets, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks, speedup over autoregressive decoding rises from 4.46× to 10.87× for one request and 1.94× to 3.93× with batching.
2611.02501.boundary_en: No training or quality loss is reported under the evaluated conditions; losslessness relies on explicit validation. Reproducing the full multi-platform search is not a low-compute experiment.
2611.02501.abstract_zh: 推测解码通过轻量级草稿模型加速受内存限制的 LLM 解码，并行草稿模型则通过一次前向传播起草整个块来扩展加速。然而，尚不清楚它们发布的系统（stock）是否达到并行起草所允许的全部加速。我们识别出三项挑战。第一，在单请求时，每步接受的 token 很少，却读取全部目标模型权重。第二，在批处理时，每请求验证工作使相对自回归（AR）解码的加速大致减半。第三，推测解码依赖部署，不存在适用于所有服务模式、草稿模型、目标模型和 GPU 的通用优化。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 SpecPilot，一个针对每种部署发现算法和系统优化的自主 Agent 循环。每轮中，成本模型定位当前系统与性能上限之间最大的差距。并行 Agent 探索不同方向，并整合成功结果。Token forcing 将每个输出 token 与 stock 逐一核对，以检测奖励投机。结构化记忆将经过验证的机制带入新一轮及新部署。SpecPilot 发现了通用的无损 12 位权重格式、针对混合循环目标模型的树验证、两级验证和三种批处理机制。我们在四个目标模型、三个草稿模型、两种 GPU 平台和五个基准上评估它。在无需训练且不损失质量的情况下，单请求相对 AR 的加速从 stock 的 4.46 倍提高到 10.87 倍，批处理时从 1.94 倍提高到 3.93 倍。
2611.02501.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.02501.resource_scope: Verified repository ships optimized deployment engines and serving/benchmark/verification scripts; this alone does not establish release of the full autonomous optimizer.

2611.02516.title: Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
2611.02516.authors: Xiao Yang , Aishan Liu , Siyuan Liang , Zonghao Ying , Le Wang , Jiakai Wang , Xianglong Liu , Dacheng Tao
2611.02516.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in open-world environments where safety risks cannot be fully predefined. However, most existing guardrail mechanisms remain static, relying on fixed rules, prompts, or classifiers that generalize poorly to emerging risks. Here we present EVOLVE, a tool-level self-evolving defense framework that formulates agent security as a process of cumulative security evolution. Inspired by how human societies transform experiences into transferable protective knowledge, EVOLVE externalizes security knowledge into executable guardrail tools that are continuously inherited, independently audited, and iteratively refined through lifelong interaction. Across multiple benchmarks, backbone models, and embodied environments, EVOLVE consistently outperforms existing defenses across diverse risk scenarios with +22\% average F1 score. We further validate the framework in real-world robotic and autonomous agent systems. Our results suggest that scalable agent safety may require continuously evolving defense systems rather than static guardrails.
2611.02516.affiliation: Beihang University / Nanyang Technological University / Zhongguancun Laboratory
2611.02516.mechanism_en: Interaction experience becomes reusable security tools; independent auditing and iterative refinement govern their inheritance and later use rather than relying on a fixed prompt-only defense.
2611.02516.result_en: The authors report +22% average F1 across benchmarks/backbones/embodied settings and validation in real robotic and autonomous-agent systems.
2611.02516.boundary_en: The abstract does not establish comprehensive safety or specify a universal threat model. The reported F1 gain is retained as stated, without converting it into percentage points.
2611.02516.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 越来越多地在开放世界环境中运行，其中的安全风险无法完全预定义。然而，大多数现有护栏机制仍是静态的，依赖固定规则、提示词或分类器，对新兴风险泛化较差。我们提出 EVOLVE，一种工具级自演化防御框架，将 Agent 安全表述为累积安全演化的过程。受人类社会将经验转化为可迁移保护性知识的启发，EVOLVE 将安全知识外化为可执行护栏工具，在终身交互中持续继承、独立审计并迭代优化。在多个基准、骨干模型和具身环境中，EVOLVE 在多样风险场景下持续优于现有防御，平均 F1 分数提高 +22%。我们进一步在真实机器人及自主 Agent 系统中验证该框架。结果表明，可扩展的 Agent 安全可能需要持续演化的防御系统，而非静态护栏。
2611.02516.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.02516.image_caption: Figure 1 : Overall framework of EVOLVE. EVOLVE organizes agent defense into generation, reuse, audit, and refinement stages, enabling executable guardrail tools to be generated, fused, verified, and repaired through lifelong interaction.

2611.02839.title: CARE: Grounded Recursive Self-Improvement for Production Customer-Service Agents
2611.02839.authors: Yanbei Jiang , Chao Lei , Rena Gao , Xiaochen Zhao , Yuchen Ge , Haohang Liu , Runze Nie , Qitian Chen , Qi An , Haolin Song , Yufei Sun , Yihao Ding , Jey Han Lau , Krista A. Ehinger , Xingjun Ma , Weijia Chen , Ruiyuan Wu , Zhen Luo , Ke Xing , Yongjun Yin
2611.02839.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in production agents involves transforming accumulated experience into reliable model updates while adapting to evolving business policies. We present CARE (Customer-service Agent Retrospective and Evolve), a grounded RSI framework that operationalizes this process in customer service. Its goal is to replace a frontier proprietary incumbent with an in-house mid-sized model that continues learning after deployment. After a one-time cold start on governed production traces, the current model serves production traffic alongside the incumbent, and its own failures drive the next update. A 24/7 inspection process establishes failures through evidence-blinded, independently reviewed judgments. Attribution separates model errors from defects in Skills, tools, or the harness, routing component failures to repair. Model-attributable trajectories are truncated at the first erroneous decision and paired with verified repairs. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then updates the model using the same model as teacher, with the diagnosis and repair supplied as privileged information unavailable to the student. To support continued evolution as business requirements change, training mixes failures from different Skill/SOP versions, each judged against the policy in force when it occurred. Candidates run an executable simulation test compiled from the latest SOP and then frozen, followed by offline inspection of the resulting traces. Promotion requires a combined simulation-and-inspection score at least at parity with the deployed version, confirmation through an online comparison with the incumbent, and human approval.
2611.02839.affiliation: Keeta, Meituan / University of Melbourne / Fudan University
2611.02839.update_target: Production model weights plus separately routed Skill/tool/harness repairs
2611.02839.mechanism_en: Independent evidence-blinded inspection attributes failures; first-error prefixes plus verified repairs train the same-model privileged OPSD teacher/student. Version-aware historical SOP data feed training. A frozen latest-SOP simulator, inspection, online incumbent comparison and human approval gate promotion.
2611.02839.result_en: The saved New abstract states a production-learning protocol without a numerical aggregate. The inspected PDF (page 1) additionally reports five iterations reducing Bad Case rate 6.42%→1.97%, simulation accuracy 93.0%→94.1%, median reply latency −27.7% and serving cost per order −70.5% on full incumbent replacement.
2611.02839.boundary_en: Promotion remains human-approved. Component diagnosis, executable policy tests and historical policy versioning are essential assumptions; this is not fully unsupervised deployment.
2611.02839.abstract_zh: 生产 Agent 中的递归自我改进（RSI），涉及在适应业务政策变化的同时，把积累的经验转化为可靠模型更新。我们提出 CARE（Customer-service Agent Retrospective and Evolve），一个在客服场景中落实该过程的有依据 RSI 框架。其目标是用一个部署后持续学习的内部中等规模模型，替代前沿专有的现用模型。在受治理的生产轨迹上完成一次性冷启动后，当前模型与现用模型共同处理生产流量，其自身失败驱动下一次更新。全天候检查流程通过证据盲法、独立复核的判断来确认失败。归因区分模型错误与 Skills、工具或运行框架缺陷，并将组件失败交由修复。模型可归因轨迹在首次错误决策处截断，并与经过验证的修复配对。随后，在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使用同一模型作为教师更新模型，其中诊断和修复以学生无法访问的特权信息提供。为了随业务需求变化持续演化，训练混合来自不同 Skill/SOP 版本的失败，每个失败都按发生时生效的政策判断。候选先运行由最新 SOP 编译并冻结的可执行模拟测试，再对所得轨迹进行离线检查。晋升要求模拟与检查的综合得分至少不低于已部署版本，通过与现用模型的在线比较确认，并获得人工批准。

2611.03126.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
2611.03126.authors: Xinlei Yu , Gen Li , Ji Zhao , Zhangquan Chen , Congcong Wang , Shuai Dong , Zelin Peng , Yuqi Xu , Hongrui Wu , Kaiwen Tuo , Cheng Yang , Kaituo Feng , Yifan Wu , Jiayi Zhang , Dongming Wu , Wenqi Shao , Jiaqi Wang , Xiangyu Yue
2611.03126.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.
2611.03126.affiliation: MMLab, CUHK / THU / HKUST(GZ) / Explore Academy, JD
2611.03126.update_target: Computer-use training data, reusable workflow primitives and model weights
2611.03126.mechanism_en: An outer world–data–model loop uses evolving weaknesses to guide new data; an inner loop mines video workflows and propagates reusable primitives. Snapshot rollback and feedback-guided retries support trajectory collection.
2611.03126.result_en: CUA-Master-27B scores 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam; finite recursive iterations show continued gains.
2611.03126.boundary_en: Open-world seeding is external information, not learning solely from self-generated outputs. Benchmark scores do not isolate the contribution or indefinite sustainability of every loop.
2611.03126.abstract_zh: 尽管计算机使用 Agent（CUA）近期取得进展，其发展仍受交互数据多样性、可控性和可靠性不足的限制。此外，传统优化流水线缺乏迭代反馈，现有递归改进方法则往往依赖自生成经验，限制能力扩展并带来递减收益。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 CUA-Master，一个嵌套双循环递归改进框架。在系统层面，外层世界—数据—模型飞轮持续吸纳开放世界语料，并利用演化中的模型弱点指导后续数据构建和优化迭代。在数据层面，内层飞轮耦合开放世界播种与自催化传播。前者从教学视频中挖掘真实工作流作为种子任务，并采用视觉—语义双路径轨迹重建；后者将种子转化为可复用原语，以可控合成多样、复杂且可验证的任务。为实现高效可靠的轨迹收集，我们进一步在多种真实环境中引入反馈引导的快照回滚重试机制。广泛实验表明，CUA-Master-27B 在纯 GUI 和 GUI-CLI 混合基准上取得有竞争力的表现，在 OSWorld Verified 上得 80.2、OSWorld 2.0 上得 36.9、WeaveBench 上得 43.9、Agents' Last Exam 上得 25.0。框架还显著提升数据合成的质量与效率，并在递归迭代中呈现持续收益。

2611.03238.title: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
2611.03238.authors: Daiqiang Li , Jingyi Peng , Rui Hu , Jia Li , Xuyang Liu , Guanren Qiao , Yujia Xiang , Qiuzhuang Sun , Zhiping Xu , Mingrui Luo
2611.03238.abstract_en: Computer-use agents for scientific software require application-specific expertise. Much of this expertise is documented in human-authored software manuals and web pages. However, turning these resources into executable, reusable skills remains challenging due to mismatches between documented and deployed software versions and differences in scope between documentation coverage and task requirements. We introduce ScienceCUA, a two-stage framework combining resource-to-skill construction with execution-guided skill evolution. First, ScienceCUA identifies tasks supported by the software from its documentation, infers operational trajectories, and generalizes them into reusable Skills. Command catalogs, syntax constraints, and shortcuts are organized separately as References for on-demand lookup. Then, ScienceCUA uses execution feedback to drive skill self-evolution by contrasting successful and failed trajectories for the same task, identifying deficiencies, revising existing skills or adding new ones, and updating the skill library only after repeated validation in real environments. To enable reliable evaluation without benchmark noise or task leakage, we introduce two improved benchmarks. ScienceBoard-Verified provides an audited and corrected basis for measuring task performance, while ScienceBoard-VE separates skill evolution from final testing through disjoint evolution and test tasks and further supports native-agent evaluation. Experiments show that the initial Skills and References improve average task success rate by up to 7.23 percentage points over the base model, while skill self-evolution increases the total gain over the baseline to as much as 17.12 percentage points. ScienceCUA turns software documentation into an evolving set of executable skills and queryable references, offering a practical way for general-purpose agents to use scientific software reliably and at scale.
2611.03238.affiliation: DeepAutonomy Technology Co., Ltd. / Peking University / Tsinghua University / Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Singapore Management University
2611.03238.update_target: Executable scientific-software Skills and queryable References
2611.03238.mechanism_en: Documentation seeds skills/references; matched successful and failed executions identify deficiencies. Revisions/new skills enter the library only after repeated real-environment validation, with disjoint evolution and test tasks in ScienceBoard-VE.
2611.03238.result_en: Initial Skills/References improve success by up to 7.23 percentage points; skill evolution raises the total baseline gain to as much as 17.12 points.
2611.03238.boundary_en: Library evolution is not backbone training. Version mismatch and benchmark leakage are explicit design concerns; maximum gains depend on model and setting.
2611.03238.abstract_zh: 科学软件的计算机使用 Agent 需要应用专属知识，其中大量知识已记录在人类编写的软件手册和网页中。然而，由于文档版本与部署软件版本不匹配，以及文档覆盖范围与任务要求不同，将这些资源转化为可执行、可复用技能仍具挑战。我们提出 ScienceCUA，一个结合资源到技能构建与执行引导技能演化的两阶段框架。首先，ScienceCUA 从文档识别软件支持的任务，推断操作轨迹，并将其泛化为可复用的 Skills。命令目录、语法约束和快捷方式单独组织为 References，以便按需查阅。随后，ScienceCUA 利用执行反馈驱动技能自演化，通过对比同一任务的成功与失败轨迹，识别不足、修订现有技能或添加新技能，并仅在真实环境反复验证后更新技能库。为实现无基准噪声或任务泄漏的可靠评估，我们提出两个改进基准。ScienceBoard-Verified 提供经过审计与纠正的任务性能测量基础，ScienceBoard-VE 以不相交的演化任务和测试任务分离技能演化与最终测试，并进一步支持原生 Agent 评估。实验显示，初始 Skills 和 References 相较基础模型最多提高平均任务成功率 7.23 个百分点，而技能自演化将相对基线的总增益提高至最多 17.12 个百分点。ScienceCUA 将软件文档转化为持续演化的可执行技能和可查询参考资料，为通用 Agent 可靠、大规模使用科学软件提供实用途径。

2611.03618.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
2611.03618.authors: Taiming Lu , Qi Xu , Zhigang Hua , Zhuang Liu
2611.03618.abstract_en: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.
2611.03618.update_target: Executable inference-strategy blueprints and a cross-task library
2611.03618.mechanism_en: Given a development set, a meta-agent retrieves blueprints, writes strategies, tests on real samples and revises them. Every candidate enters the library for subsequent tasks; this is not an accepted-only archive.
2611.03618.result_en: On 30 benchmarks it beats the strongest baseline on 24 and reports 74.7% vs 74.0% average accuracy at 39% lower inference cost; strategies transfer without new search.
2611.03618.boundary_en: The evolved artifact is inference code around models. Test-time cost savings exclude any unreported amortization assumptions for library search and construction.
2611.03618.abstract_zh: 模型只是 AI Agent 系统的一半，另一半是推理策略，即将模型调用转化为响应的推理过程。如今这另一半由人工编写，构建某一种策略的经验不会延续到下一种。我们提出 Strategist，一个跨任务演化推理策略的元 Agent。每种策略写成蓝图，即其他策略可复用的可执行代码，蓝图共同构成一个库。给定任务和一个小型开发集，Strategist 检索相关蓝图、编写候选策略、在真实样本上测试，并根据结果修订。随后每个候选都进入库，使后续任务能建立在先前发现之上。在 30 个基准上，Strategist 在其中 24 个击败最强基线，并以低 39% 的推理成本实现相当的平均准确率（74.7% 对 74.0%）。其策略也无需进一步搜索即可迁移到未见任务和其他模型。AI 系统中过去没有自行改进的部分，如今也开始自行改进。

2611.03618.image_caption: Figure 3 : The Strategy Blueprint is a freeform graph that grows through the library. (a) Two foundations ( chat and agent ) sit at the top. Strategies compose from them and from each other, forming a directed graph whose levels emerge naturally from composition depth. (b) Four protocols govern the graph: every node shares one abstract interface, each node can only call nodes created before it, no cycles are allowed, and no duplicates should exist.

2611.00544.title: Skill++: Towards Lifelong Agents via Routing-Aware Skill Refinement
2611.00544.authors: Hanrong Zhang , Minghao Liang , Jiawei Wu , Yankai Chen , Shicheng Fan , Zhiwei Liu , Enze Ma , Junwei Yuan , Tianyi Wang , Dehai Min , Kening Zheng , Xue Liu , Philip S. Yu
2611.00544.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents extend their capabilities with skills, each with a name, a description, and a body. Under progressive disclosure, an LLM router selects skills by name and description alone and loads only the selected bodies. Skill libraries grow continually as users and agents add new skills. Because the router relies on this metadata, a similar new skill can displace an earlier one, breaking previously correct routing even though the earlier skill and the router are unchanged. This routing interference is aggravated for public skills, whose descriptions may not match their bodies. We formulate the problem as lifelong skill routing, a class-incremental continual learning problem. A solution must keep earlier skills selectable without suppressing new ones. Existing approaches fall short, since continually retraining the router risks catastrophic forgetting and rewriting methods either ignore similar skills or require per-skill feedback. We therefore propose Skill++, which rewrites only the name and description of each incoming skill, without router training or labeled data. The new description states what the body supports, how the skill differs from its closest predecessor, and what related work it excludes. As a library grows to 731 skills over ten sessions, Skill++ selects all required skills for 76.3% of queries, versus 36.4% under the original metadata. Across three benchmarks and five LLM routers, it outperforms all compared approaches, and its gains carry over to the Codex CLI agent harness.
2611.00544.affiliation: University of Illinois Chicago / Trip.com Group / Rutgers University / MBZUAI / McGill University / Recursive / Independent researcher
2611.00544.mechanism_en: Only new-skill metadata is rewritten to reflect body support, closest-predecessor differences and exclusions. Existing router/skills remain fixed; the revised metadata is retained as the library grows.
2611.00544.result_en: All required skills are selected for 76.3% vs 36.4% of queries at 731 skills over ten sessions; gains span three benchmarks, five routers and Codex CLI.
2611.00544.boundary_en: This mitigates persistent routing interference without router training or labels, but is not an outcome-driven rewrite of executable skill bodies.
2611.00544.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 通过技能扩展能力，每个技能包含名称、描述和正文。在渐进披露机制下，LLM 路由器仅按名称与描述选择技能，只加载所选正文。随着用户和 Agent 添加新技能，技能库不断增长。由于路由器依赖这些元数据，一个相似的新技能可能挤走旧技能，即使旧技能和路由器都没有变化，也会破坏此前正确的路由。公开技能的描述可能与正文不一致，使这种路由干扰更严重。我们将该问题表述为终身技能路由，一种类别增量持续学习问题。解决方案必须在不压制新技能的前提下，保持旧技能可被选中。现有方法不足，因为持续重训路由器可能引发灾难性遗忘，而改写方法要么忽略相似技能，要么需要逐技能反馈。因此，我们提出 Skill++，只改写每个新进入技能的名称与描述，无需路由器训练或标注数据。新描述说明正文支持什么、与最接近的已有技能有何不同，以及排除哪些相关工作。当技能库在十个会话中增长至 731 个技能时，Skill++ 对 76.3% 的查询选出全部所需技能，而原始元数据仅为 36.4%。在三个基准和五种 LLM 路由器上，它优于全部对比方法，其收益还可迁移至 Codex CLI Agent 运行框架。

2611.01115.title: CompSkill: Compiling Execution Experience for Skill Retrieval
2611.01115.authors: Qi Shen , Ziyue Zhu , Yongqing Jiang , Zhen Xia , Li Shengjie , Shuai Zhao , Bo Cheng , Xiaobao Wu , Anh Tuan Luu , Haoran Luo
2611.01115.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on skill documents, yet most retrievers rank them by description alone and ignore what earlier executions revealed, even though a relevant skill can hurt execution. We present CompSkill, which indexes skills with learned 512-d keys and compiles matched same-task comparisons into skill offsets and capped key residuals (KeyOpt), so experience changes which document the executor receives, never its text. Under a logistic outcome model with unknown task difficulty, matched comparisons cancel that difficulty and only discordant ones carry information; on support executions, predictions improve with each discordant task. An experience hypergraph keeps each comparison with its executor and document versions, recalls missed skills and grounds a cited review. Compact keys raise SkillRet NDCG@10 from 64.0 to 70.9 at one eighth of the dimension. With one document, CompSkill completes 256 and 260 of 332 ToolQA tasks with GPT-5.6-luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, more than every baseline, and stays on par with the strongest baselines on AppWorld and ALFWorld. On 332 newly generated ToolQA tasks, it completes 256 with GPT-5.6-luna, significantly more than BM25, SkillRet-8B, Tool2Vec and RankGPT; over all 844 ToolQA tasks, it completes 24 more than the strongest baseline. Selection matters beyond relevance: pairing the right guide with a same-database sibling instead of another database's guide costs 8 of 96 tasks. Code, models and support data: this https URL
2611.01115.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications / Nanyang Technological University / Sichuan University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2611.01115.update_target: Learned skill retrieval keys, offsets and a versioned experience hypergraph
2611.01115.mechanism_en: Matched same-task outcomes cancel difficulty under the stated logistic model; discordant comparisons update offsets/capped key residuals. Executor/document versions stay attached to evidence, while document text remains unchanged.
2611.01115.result_en: 512-dimensional keys raise SkillRet NDCG@10 64.0→70.9; one-document execution completes 256 and 260 of 332 ToolQA tasks for two executors.
2611.01115.boundary_en: The learner changes retrieval rather than skill text or executor weights. Statistical statements depend on the outcome model; document interactions can invalidate relevance-only intuition.
2611.01115.abstract_zh: LLM Agent 越来越依赖技能文档，但大多数检索器仅按描述排序，忽略先前执行揭示的信息，即使一个相关技能可能损害执行。我们提出 CompSkill，使用学习得到的 512 维键索引技能，将同任务配对比较编译为技能偏置与有上限的键残差（KeyOpt），使经验改变执行器接收到哪份文档，而绝不改变文档文本。在任务难度未知的逻辑斯蒂结果模型下，配对比较消除该难度，只有结果不一致的比较携带信息；在支持执行上，每个结果不一致的任务都能改善预测。经验超图保存每个比较及其执行器和文档版本，召回遗漏技能，并为带引用的复核提供依据。紧凑键以八分之一维度将 SkillRet NDCG@10 从 64.0 提高至 70.9。只提供一份文档时，CompSkill 分别使用 GPT-5.6-luna 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 完成 332 个 ToolQA 任务中的 256 和 260 个，超过所有基线，并在 AppWorld 和 ALFWorld 上与最强基线相当。在 332 个新生成的 ToolQA 任务上，使用 GPT-5.6-luna 完成 256 个，显著多于 BM25、SkillRet-8B、Tool2Vec 和 RankGPT；在全部 844 个 ToolQA 任务上，比最强基线多完成 24 个。选择的重要性超越相关性：将正确指南与同数据库的另一份指南配对，而非另一数据库的指南，会在 96 个任务中损失 8 个。代码、模型与支持数据见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.01386.title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
2611.01386.authors: Daniel Chalef , Peter Evans , Pavlo Paliychuk , Mehul Patel , Preston Rasmussen , Jack Ryan
2611.01386.abstract_en: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $\tau^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.
2611.01386.update_target: Versioned procedural Skills and outcome-updated search ranks
2611.01386.mechanism_en: Verified Traces retain ordered events, outcomes and verification strength. Separate Reflector/Curator compilation cites evidence per field, admission scans gate activation, and later verified use updates retrieval rank.
2611.01386.result_en: Teacher-trace skills raise three weaker executors by 4.5–18.8 pass-rate points, mainly on teacher-solved same tasks; ALFWorld gains require no training.
2611.01386.boundary_en: Teacher-to-executor same-task transfer is not unrestricted novel-task generalization. Verification strength and governed distribution matter more than merely collecting traces.
2611.01386.abstract_zh: 生产 LLM Agent 的记忆系统主要保存语义记忆（用户与领域事实）或情景记忆（先前交互）。Trace2Skill、WikiSkill 和 SkillRevise 等研究系统从 Agent 运行中学习流程，将其打包为 Skills，并在基准上评估。我们介绍 Zep Agent Skills，一项为已部署 Agent 提供此类程序性记忆的生产服务。该服务仅使用经过验证的尝试作为证据，为 Skill 的每个字段引用支持事件，并管理每个 Skill 版本的准入和分发。它将每次任务尝试记录为包含有序事件、结果和验证强度的 Trace。一个分设 Reflector 与 Curator 角色的编译器，将经过验证的 Traces 转化为版本化 Skills。扫描与准入门控制哪些候选生效，经过验证的使用结果改变每个 Skill 的搜索排名。Agent Skills 格式是由 Anthropic 创立并捐赠给 Agentic AI Foundation 的开放标准，因此任何支持该格式的宿主都可加载编译后的 Skill。Agent 通过 API 或 MCP，使用带渐进披露的词法搜索检索 Skills。我们在 τ³-bench banking、AppWorld 和 EnterpriseOps-Gym 上评估 Zep Agent Skills。由教师模型 Traces 编译的 Skills，在相同任务上、所有推理力度下，将三个较弱执行模型的通过率提高 4.5 至 18.8 个点。大部分收益来自教师已解决的任务。在 ALFWorld 上，从小模型运行编译的 Skills 无需训练，即可获得与先前工作所报告持续微调相似或更大的收益。

2611.01415.title: Latent Harness: Compiling Agent Behaviors into Post-Block Activation Shifts
2611.01415.authors: Ran Li , Shimin Di , Zeyu Ren , Ling Yue , Jiachuan Wang , Lei Chen
2611.01415.abstract_en: Harness engineering and self-evolving agents improve language-model agents quickly, yet their gains live outside the model. The harness is re-sent and re-paid on every call, and the standard route to internalization is a weight update that is costly to iterate and fixed once merged. We propose compiling the harness instead. Latent Harness distills an external condition into a rank-8 activation shift. The shift is applied at the output of every decoder block of a frozen backbone, at 0.03-0.05% of parameters. The condition is either an explicit process-level behavior instruction or the behavioral contract of an agentic harness. At inference the compiled bundle carries no harness text and adds no tokens. It exposes three runtime controls for injection strength, injection phase, and shift-space mixing. Compiled behaviors recover the source-harness gain in 8 of 10 preregistered settings. Where the explicit source pays the heaviest per-call token tax, the compiled form exceeds it. The same bundles transfer zero-shot across tasks (5 of 7 pairs positive) and compose in shift space, while stacked text instructions interfere destructively. Used as a search space, they lift budget-matched harness search by 1.45 times. On three agentic benchmarks the operator aligns policy to the harness con- tract. Under matched data, capacity, and effective strength it outperforms same-capacity LoRA, which needs 11.1 times the parameters to reach the same band, and it regresses nothing where the base policy is already strong. Across 1B-to-8B models the method skeleton is invariant while gain locations move with the model-task pair, which delimits where compiled harnesses should be deployed.
2611.01415.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Southeast University / Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute / University of Tsukuba / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2611.01415.update_target: Trained rank-8 post-block activation shifts around a frozen backbone
2611.01415.mechanism_en: External process instructions/harness contracts supervise compact activation shifts. Retained bundles expose strength/phase/mixing controls and can serve as the next harness-search space without resending source text.
2611.01415.result_en: Bundles recover source gains in 8/10 preregistered settings and transfer positively in 5/7 task pairs; budget-matched search improves 1.45× at 0.03–0.05% of parameters.
2611.01415.boundary_en: Frozen backbone does not mean no learning: the shifts are trained. Zero added prompt tokens does not imply zero runtime overhead or universal gain; deployment depends on model/task.
2611.01415.abstract_zh: 运行框架工程与自演化 Agent 能快速提升语言模型 Agent，但收益位于模型外部。运行框架每次调用都要重新发送并重新付费，标准内化路径是权重更新，迭代成本高且合并后固定。我们提出改为编译运行框架。Latent Harness 将外部条件蒸馏为一个秩为 8 的激活偏移。偏移施加在冻结骨干模型每个解码器块的输出处，参数占比为 0.03–0.05%。条件可以是显式流程级行为指令，也可以是 Agent 运行框架的行为契约。推理时，编译包不携带运行框架文本，也不添加 token。它提供注入强度、注入阶段和偏移空间混合三项运行时控制。编译行为在十个预注册设置中的八个恢复了源运行框架的收益。在显式源条件每调用 token 代价最高之处，编译形式甚至超过源形式。同一编译包可跨任务零样本迁移（七对中五对为正），并能在偏移空间组合，而叠加文本指令会产生破坏性干扰。作为搜索空间时，它们将预算匹配的运行框架搜索提升 1.45 倍。在三个 Agent 基准上，该算子使策略符合运行框架契约。在数据、容量和有效强度匹配时，它优于同容量 LoRA，后者需要 11.1 倍参数才能达到相同水平；在基础策略已经很强之处，它没有造成回退。从 1B 到 8B 模型，方法骨架不变，但收益位置随模型—任务组合移动，这界定了编译运行框架适宜部署的范围。

Teacher traces or strictly filtered success trajectories train a rank-8 shift at every block output of a frozen backbone. The bundle injects at run time with strength, phase, and mixing controls.

2611.01581.title: Recursive Self-Improvement of Exoskeleton Assistance Policies through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
2611.01581.authors: Muyuan Ma , Shuo Jiang , Lijun Han , Xinpan Meng , Zhenghua Ma , Xiuze Xia , Houcheng Li , Long Cheng
2611.01581.abstract_en: To reduce reliance on manual design and extensive parameter tuning, a framework for the autonomous evolution of exoskeleton assistance policies through human feedback is proposed. Assistance policies are autonomously generated as executable control code by an intelligent agent and evaluated in experiments with human participants. Subjective user feedback, movement performance, and muscle activation measurements are incorporated into policy assessment. Based on these assessments, policy deficiencies are autonomously identified and the control code is revised by the agent for subsequent trials. A closed loop of policy generation, human feedback, evaluation, and autonomous refinement is thereby established. The framework is evaluated using GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, and Kimi, and initial assistance performance and refinement outcomes are compared across models. Despite differences in initial performance, effective assistance is achieved with all four models after a single autonomous refinement iteration under the tested conditions. Across three tasks, biceps and triceps muscle activation levels are reduced by 29.4% and 35.2%, respectively, compared with those measured without an exoskeleton. However, limited adaptability to unexpected situations is observed, indicating that further improvements in robustness and safety are required.
2611.01581.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
2611.01581.mechanism_en: Human subjective feedback, movement performance and muscle measurements identify policy deficiencies; an agent revises code for subsequent human trials.
2611.01581.result_en: Four model families achieve effective assistance after one refinement under tested conditions; biceps/triceps activation falls 29.4%/35.2% versus no exoskeleton across three tasks.
2611.01581.boundary_en: Only a single autonomous refinement is reported. Unexpected-situation adaptability is limited; human feedback and physical evaluation remain essential, and unlimited recursion is not demonstrated.
2611.01581.abstract_zh: 为减少对人工设计和大量参数调节的依赖，我们提出一个通过人类反馈自主演化外骨骼助力策略的框架。智能 Agent 将助力策略自主生成为可执行控制代码，并在有真人参与的实验中评估。主观用户反馈、运动表现和肌肉激活测量被纳入策略评估。基于评估，Agent 自主识别策略不足并修改控制代码，用于后续试验，从而建立策略生成、人类反馈、评估与自主优化的闭环。框架使用 GPT、DeepSeek、GLM 和 Kimi 进行评估，比较不同模型的初始助力表现与优化结果。尽管初始表现存在差异，四种模型在测试条件下均经过一次自主优化迭代实现有效助力。在三项任务中，相较未佩戴外骨骼时的测量，肱二头肌和肱三头肌激活水平分别降低 29.4% 和 35.2%。不过，系统对突发情况的适应性有限，表明鲁棒性和安全性仍需进一步提高。

2611.01581.image_caption: Fig. 1: An LLM-agent framework for exoskeleton assistance policy generation, execution, and feedback-based refinement. The policy implementation module generates executable code from task requirements, hardware information, and a unified control interface. Candidate code undergoes checks before becoming an available policy version. The local execution framework loads and runs the selected policy during a trial started and ended by the operator. During execution, the framework exchanges joint-state information and torque commands with the exoskeleton. EMG results, task completion, and participant feedback inform policy assessment. The feedback analysis module either proposes a revision based on a selected policy or selects an existing policy for reuse. Code revisions and policy-version selection occur between trials. Solid arrows indicate execution or data flow; dashed arrows indicate revision or reuse decisions.

2611.01834.title: LegoEnv: Self-Evolving Agentic Environments via Modular Recombination
2611.01834.authors: Zhuosong Jiang , Chengxu Wu , Junqi Liu , Yujie Yi , Siqin Wang , Zhixuan Huang , Jinqian Jiang , Lijun Xiao , Jianxun Li , Yongyang Pan , Jieran Wang , Shiqi Shen , Fei Liu , Xinyu Lin
2611.01834.abstract_en: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet existing environments are designed for specific tasks and fail to generalize to new ones. Recent methods automate environment construction with LLMs. However, they generate each environment from scratch, neither reusing parts shared across environments nor carrying a fix from one environment to the rest. To address this, we propose a new paradigm of evolving environment atoms, which composes environments from reusable atoms (intent, rule, data and server) and evolves the atoms when an environment fails to give reliable feedback (e.g., an application lacks a tool the task requires). To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce LegoEnv, which builds 5,465 verified environments over 223 applications, and one round of evolution raises the share of solvable environments from 71.6% to 88.3%. On AutomationBench, SFT on these environments lifts Qwen3.6-27B from 16.0% to 32.0%, and RL with their verifiers lifts Qwen3.8-27B from 37.6% to 40.3%. Further analyses show steady gains with corpus size, transfer to unseen applications, and failures concentrated in a few shared root causes.
2611.01834.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Tencent / Emory University / National University of Singapore / Peking University / University of California, Santa Cruz
2611.01834.update_target: Reusable environment atoms and downstream supervised/RL training
2611.01834.mechanism_en: Intent/rule/data/server atoms compose environments. Unreliable feedback triggers atom repair, allowing one fix to propagate to other environments; verified environments and verifiers support later training.
2611.01834.result_en: 5,465 verified environments span 223 applications; one evolution round raises solvability 71.6%→88.3%. AutomationBench SFT improves 16%→32%, and RL 37.6%→40.3%.
2611.01834.boundary_en: Environment repair and model-weight improvement are separate measured stages. One environment-evolution round is not evidence of indefinite model–environment co-evolution.
2611.01834.abstract_zh: LLM Agent 通过与环境交互学习，但现有环境针对特定任务设计，难以泛化到新任务。近期方法使用 LLM 自动构建环境，却为每个环境从头生成，既不复用跨环境共享的部分，也不把一个环境的修复传播给其他环境。为此，我们提出演化环境原语的新范式：用可复用原语（意图、规则、数据和服务器）组合环境，并在环境无法提供可靠反馈时演化这些原语，例如应用缺少任务所需工具。为实现该范式，我们提出 LegoEnv，在 223 个应用上构建 5,465 个经过验证的环境，一轮演化便将可解环境比例从 71.6% 提高到 88.3%。在 AutomationBench 上，基于这些环境的 SFT 将 Qwen3.6-27B 从 16.0% 提高至 32.0%，使用其验证器的 RL 将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 37.6% 提高至 40.3%。进一步分析显示，收益随语料规模稳定增长，可迁移至未见应用，而失败集中在少数共享根因。

2611.00344.title: SPARK: Self-Correcting Embodied Memory via Physical Re-Observation
2611.00344.authors: Dmytro Kurdydyk , Aadi Palnitkar , Sebastian Scherer , Seungchan Kim
2611.00344.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.00344.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have seen growing adoption in embodied settings as language-queryable memories of the environment. However, existing approaches often assume a reliable single-episode knowledge base (KB) or accumulate observations across episodes without correcting prior errors. Such errors can persist through incorrect semantic labels, inaccurate object positions, and inconsistent spatial relationships. To address this, we present SPARK, a corrective multi-episode framework for embodied RAG. After the first episode, a semantic critic flags regions of the KB, a targeted planner generates revisits, and a selective merge adds, removes, or replaces KB information based on the new observations. We evaluate SPARK on four outdoor AirSim maps under two degraded viewpoint conditions, using perception-built KBs, a visibility-constrained oracle used only for evaluation, and a fixed set of 158 embodied question answering (EQA) questions scored before and after correction. A single corrective episode improves downstream EQA on every map under both conditions while storing 13-41% fewer objects than append-only updating, with gains up to 2.7x on one map-condition pair. Extending correction through Episode 4 brings every map above the EQA performance of its undegraded reference. Ablations show that the critic's three signals each contribute to performance, that targeted revisits achieve a larger mean gain than untargeted ones under the same budget, and that selective merging achieves gains comparable to append-only updating with a smaller KB. Overall, SPARK demonstrates the value of correcting embodied memory through targeted re-observation, particularly as embodied systems scale and the risk of accumulated errors increases.
2611.00344.affiliation: Davidson College / University of Maryland / Carnegie Mellon University
2611.00344.mechanism_en: A semantic critic flags suspect memory, a planner revisits regions and selective merging adds/removes/replaces records from new observations. Later episodes and fixed EQA questions test retained corrections.
2611.00344.result_en: On four AirSim maps under two degraded viewpoints, one corrective episode improves EQA with 13–41% fewer stored objects than append-only memory; by Episode 4 all maps exceed undegraded references.
2611.00344.boundary_en: This is simulation with a visibility-constrained evaluation oracle, not real-robot validation. Correction of environmental memory is distinct from learning an improved correction algorithm.
2611.00344.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统作为可用语言查询的环境记忆，在具身场景中越来越常见。然而，现有方法常假定单次事件的知识库（KB）可靠，或跨事件累积观察却不纠正先前错误。这些错误可能以错误语义标签、不准的物体位置和不一致空间关系持续存在。为此，我们提出 SPARK，一个用于具身 RAG 的多事件纠错框架。首个事件后，语义评论器标记知识库区域，定向规划器生成重访计划，选择性合并依据新观察添加、删除或替换知识库信息。我们在四个室外 AirSim 地图、两种退化视角条件下评估 SPARK，使用感知构建的知识库、仅供评估的可见性受限预言机，以及固定的 158 个具身问答（EQA）问题，在纠错前后评分。一次纠错事件在两种条件下改善每张地图的下游 EQA，同时比仅追加更新少存 13–41% 的物体，在一个地图—条件组合上收益最高达 2.7 倍。将纠错延续至事件 4 后，每张地图的 EQA 都超过其未退化参考。消融表明，评论器的三种信号均有贡献；同预算下定向重访比非定向重访平均增益更大；选择性合并以更小知识库取得与仅追加更新相当的收益。总体上，SPARK 展示了通过定向重新观察纠正具身记忆的价值，尤其适用于具身系统扩展、累积错误风险增大的情况。

2611.00344.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of the SPARK correction loop. Episode 1 flies the source waypoints under a degraded view and builds memory H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} from its own RGB-D observations (1–2). The semantic critic reads H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} and the Episode 1 images alone, flagging regions by plausibility, density, and graph coverage (3). The planner turns those into viewpoints offset from the source waypoints for Episode 2 (4), and the selective merge removes, replaces, and adds entries to produce H ( 2 ) H^{(2)} (5), which a fixed EQA set scores against H ( 1 ) H^{(1)} (6). 2611.00450.title: From Lookups to Lessons: Turning Retrieved Knowledge into Parametric Memory
2611.00450.authors: Changjiang Han , Bowei He , Ye Yuan , Weixu Zhang , Haolun Wu , Xue Liu , Jikun Kang
2611.00450.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.00450.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer factual questions beyond their training data, but it adds storage and inference costs. Distilling previously retrieved information into parametric memories enables reuse without online retrieval. However, training the memory to mimic a retriever rewards accurate independent predictions, which do not necessarily improve the final output quality when combined with the LLM's existing predictions. To address this, we introduce ResMem, in which the LLM reads retrieved text offline to generate teacher targets. This design avoids storing massive token representations, unlike existing parametric memory approaches such as MLP Memory, which relies on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) datastores. Furthermore, by using the LLM as an offline teacher that reads privileged retrieved evidence alongside the input, we train a parametric memory to learn an additive logit residual. This residual aligns the predictions of a student sharing the same backbone with the teacher distribution, while self-distillation updates remain confined to the parametric memory. On a Wikipedia subset, ResMem reduces the storage retained for teacher construction by 94.7% compared with the evaluated kNN pipeline. Across five question answering datasets, ResMem raises mean token F1 from 32.83% for the frozen LLM to 34.48%. It also breaks 21% fewer of the LLM's correct answers than a kNN-trained memory. These findings validate our motivation of treating retrieval as a learning resource, with parametric memory shaped by how retrieved knowledge is used to inform the model's future predictions. Code and model weights are available at this https URL and this https URL .
2611.00450.update_target: Additive logit-residual parametric memory; backbone stays frozen
2611.00450.mechanism_en: An offline same-backbone teacher reads privileged retrieved evidence; self-distillation trains only the memory to supply residual predictions that improve the combined student. Retained memory removes online lookup needs.
2611.00450.result_en: Teacher-construction storage falls 94.7% on a Wikipedia subset; mean token F1 rises 32.83%→34.48% across five QA datasets, with 21% fewer broken correct answers than kNN-trained memory.
2611.00450.boundary_en: This is supervised parameter learning in a memory module, not parameter-free accumulation or full-backbone updating. Storage claims concern the evaluated teacher-construction pipeline.
2611.00450.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）帮助大语言模型（LLM）回答训练数据之外的事实问题，但增加存储与推理成本。把先前检索的信息蒸馏到参数化记忆，可以无需在线检索地复用。然而，训练记忆模仿检索器会奖励准确的独立预测，这些预测与 LLM 已有预测组合后，不一定改善最终输出质量。为此，我们提出 ResMem，让 LLM 离线阅读检索文本以生成教师目标。与依赖 k 近邻（kNN）数据存储的 MLP Memory 等现有参数化记忆方法不同，此设计避免保存海量 token 表示。此外，我们让 LLM 作为离线教师，与输入一起读取特权检索证据，训练参数化记忆学习一个加性 logit 残差。该残差使共享同一骨干的学生预测对齐教师分布，而自蒸馏更新仅限参数化记忆。在维基百科子集上，相较评估中的 kNN 流水线，ResMem 将构建教师所需保留的存储减少 94.7%。在五个问答数据集上，ResMem 将平均 token F1 从冻结 LLM 的 32.83% 提高到 34.48%。相较 kNN 训练的记忆，它破坏 LLM 原本正确答案的数量少 21%。这些发现验证了我们的动机：把检索视为学习资源，并根据检索知识如何影响模型未来预测来塑造参数化记忆。代码与模型权重可在原文所链接的两个 HTTPS 地址获取。

2611.01460.title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
2611.01460.authors: Haoyu Zhao , Zafeirios Fountas , Jun Wang
2611.01460.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2611.01460.abstract_en: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. At inference time, TAL retrieves through a Table-of-Contents (TOC) tree, tying retrieval directly to the model's reasoning rather than to embedding similarity. To study this setting, we introduce VidLearn, a multimodal QA benchmark built from 72 chess tutorial videos spanning 12 openings. On VidLearn, TAL outperforms all evaluated baselines and improves monotonically as more videos are consumed, achieving up to 113% and 91% relative gains over the corresponding vanilla MLLMs on the training and test splits, respectively. In actual gameplay, TAL reaches a stronger opening-phase position than its vanilla counterpart in 69% of head-to-head games. Evaluation in a second domain further demonstrates the generality of TAL. Together, these results highlight instructional videos as a scalable resource for parameter-update-free agent continual learning.
2611.01460.mechanism_en: A two-stage adversarial process harvests hard video-grounded questions and refines memory; reasoning-guided table-of-contents retrieval reuses the tutorialbook without parameter updates.
2611.01460.result_en: VidLearn uses 72 chess videos covering 12 openings; relative gains reach 113%/91% on training/test splits, and opening position is stronger in 69% of head-to-head games.
2611.01460.boundary_en: Opening-phase advantage is not whole-game win rate. External instructional videos supply new information; the abstract does not establish indefinitely improving autonomous instruction generation.
2611.01460.abstract_zh: 人类持续从书籍和教学视频等精心制作的材料中获取知识，并将理解带入未来任务。每天有数百万此类教学视频上传网络，但 LLM Agent 仍无法利用这一持续扩展的人类教学资源。它们的能力在训练后冻结，大规模参数更新仍极其昂贵。这引出核心问题：LLM Agent 能否在不更新参数的情况下从庞大教学资源中学习？我们提出 Tutorial Agentic Learning（TAL），一种非参数持续学习范式，通过两阶段对抗过程采集困难的视频依据问题，并用这些问题优化记忆，将教学视频整合为持久、结构化的 tutorialbook 记忆。推理时，TAL 通过目录（TOC）树检索，将检索直接联系模型推理，而非嵌入相似度。为研究这一场景，我们提出 VidLearn，一个由涵盖 12 种开局的 72 个国际象棋教学视频构建的多模态问答基准。在 VidLearn 上，TAL 优于所有评估基线，并随消化视频增多而单调提升，相对对应原始 MLLM，在训练和测试划分上分别最高提升 113% 和 91%。在实际对弈中，TAL 在 69% 的正面对局中取得比原始对应模型更强的开局阶段局面。第二领域的评估进一步展示 TAL 的通用性。这些结果共同凸显了教学视频作为无需参数更新的 Agent 持续学习资源的可扩展性。

2611.00452.title: Compositional Self-Improvement: Promises and Pitfalls
2611.00452.authors: Changho Shin , Daiwei Chen , Brenden Lake , Frederic Sala , Ramya Korlakai Vinayak
2611.00452.abstract_en: Although self-improvement is becoming increasingly important as tasks become more complex, models struggle to generate reliable supervision for harder, out-of-distribution instances. One way to address this challenge is to exploit compositional structure: models often solve simpler subproblems more reliably than full problems, so their subproblem predictions can be composed into supervision for harder ones. We systematically study when this kind of composed supervision supports self-improvement and when it fails. Our controlled experiments identify three failure modes: unreliable subproblem predictions, errors introduced by composition, and limited supervision coverage. Beyond controlled settings, these findings carry over to more realistic coding and reasoning tasks: composed labels are more accurate than direct self-generated labels and improve performance even on compositions longer than those seen during training, while the failure modes remain visible. Further, although these failure modes often keep compositional self-improvement from fully succeeding on its own, a short SFT warmup with compositional self-improvement can bootstrap reinforcement learning on tasks that require composing skills the model already has, particularly when direct exploration rarely succeeds. Together, these findings characterize when compositional self-improvement can provide sufficiently reliable supervision to expand model capabilities.
2611.00452.update_target: Composed pseudo-labels for supervised warmup and later reinforcement learning
2611.00452.mechanism_en: Subproblem predictions compose into supervision for harder instances; controlled tasks isolate subanswer reliability, composition error and coverage. Brief compositional SFT can provide the starting point for later RL.
2611.00452.result_en: Composed labels are more accurate than direct self-labels and transfer to longer coding/reasoning compositions; the same failure modes remain visible.
2611.00452.boundary_en: This studies a learning mechanism and its limits, not a self-modifying runtime. Success depends on composing existing skills with sufficiently reliable and broad supervision.
2611.00452.abstract_zh: 随着任务越来越复杂，自改进变得愈加重要，但模型难以为更困难的分布外实例生成可靠监督。解决方法之一是利用组合结构：模型往往比完整问题更可靠地解决简单子问题，因此可将子问题预测组合成更难问题的监督。我们系统研究这种组合监督何时支持自改进、何时失败。受控实验识别出三种失败模式：不可靠的子问题预测、组合过程引入的错误，以及有限的监督覆盖。除受控设置外，这些发现也适用于更真实的编码和推理任务：组合标签比直接自生成标签更准确，甚至能改善长于训练所见组合的性能，但失败模式依然可见。此外，虽然这些失败模式常使组合自改进无法独立完全奏效，但短暂的组合自改进 SFT 预热，能在需要组合模型已有技能的任务上启动强化学习，尤其在直接探索很少成功时。总体而言，这些发现刻画了组合自改进何时能提供足够可靠的监督，以扩展模型能力。

From left to right: grid navigation by the number of rooms, addition by addend digit length, and max run length by string length. 2611.01334.title: The Verifier Is Part of the Simulator: Evidence-View Gaming in Agentic Equation Discovery
2611.01334.abstract_en: A growing number of agentic pipelines search for governing equations: an agent proposes laws and a verifier checks them against simulated trajectories. The verifier sees only a numerical summary: integrals against test functions on a time grid. That summary carries its own discretization error, making the verifier part of the simulator. We freeze the trajectory, candidate library, verifier and thresholds, leaving the agent one move: which permitted summary to admit. Without scores or language models, finer time grids reduce numerical discrepancies and false library rejections. On PDEBench, the verifier instead accepts equations missing diffusion on score-selected summaries. Maximizing a public score rewarding decisive verdicts and larger mismatches when rejecting the library wrongly rejects all 1,500 in-library cases; retrospectively retuning score constants on a separate bank reduces errors to 13/180 at best. We call this evidence-view gaming: reward hacking by choice of permitted summary. In single-turn forced-choice tests, Claude models rarely choose summaries giving wrong verdicts when asked to be accurate, but often do so when asked to maximize the score or report missing physics. In separate trust prompts, they often rank those harmful summaries least trustworthy. Requiring several summaries to agree reduces errors but often withholds a verdict and performs worse than a fixed fine view on PDEBench: a safeguard, not a certificate. Evidence chosen after its verdict is known cannot alone authorize a claim.
2611.01334.update_target: Verifier evidence-summary selection under fixed equations, trajectories and thresholds
2611.01334.mechanism_en: The experiment freezes the library and verifier, allowing only permitted numerical-summary selection. Finer views and multiple-summary agreement serve as controls against score-driven evidence selection.
2611.01334.result_en: Public-score maximization falsely rejects all 1,500 in-library cases. Retuned constants still yield at best 13/180 errors; multi-summary agreement can abstain and underperform a fixed fine PDEBench view.
2611.01334.boundary_en: A boundary on adaptive scientific verification, not evidence that the agent learned new physics. Agreement is a safeguard under tested views, not a numerical or scientific certificate.
2611.01334.abstract_zh: 越来越多 Agent 流水线搜索控制方程：Agent 提出定律，验证器对照模拟轨迹检查。验证器只看到数值摘要，即时间网格上对测试函数的积分。摘要本身携带离散化误差，使验证器成为模拟器的一部分。我们冻结轨迹、候选库、验证器和阈值，只给 Agent 一个动作：选择允许的哪种摘要作为证据。无需评分或语言模型，更细时间网格就能降低数值偏差和错误拒绝候选库的情况。然而在 PDEBench 上，验证器会在按评分选择的摘要上接受缺少扩散项的方程。最大化一个奖励明确判决、并在拒绝候选库时奖励更大不匹配的公开评分，会错误拒绝全部 1,500 个库内案例；在单独样本库上事后调整评分常数，最好也仅将错误降至 13/180。我们称之为证据视图投机：通过选择允许的摘要进行奖励投机。在单轮强制选择测试中，当要求准确时，Claude 模型很少选择导致错误判决的摘要；当要求最大化评分或报告缺失物理机制时，却经常如此。在单独的信任提示中，它们又常将这些有害摘要评为最不可信。要求多个摘要一致会减少错误，但常不给判决，且在 PDEBench 上不如固定精细视图：它是防护措施，而非证书。已知判决后才选出的证据，无法单独授权一项主张。

2611.02797.title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
2611.02797.authors: Bangrui Xu , Jie Yang , Sidi Chen , Xuanhe Zhou , Jiantao Qiu , Qianyu Yang , Zijie Wang , Fan Wu , Zhoufutu Wen
2611.02797.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2611.02797.abstract_en: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen this http URL , existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evolutionary gains of existing RSI methods are inconsistent across generalization levels.
2611.02797.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Theseus Labs / Humanlaya / Shanghai AI Lab
2611.02797.update_target: Generalization evaluation of evolving agent workflows
2611.02797.mechanism_en: Controllable game templates and difficulty coefficients generate evolution/test tasks; G0–G4 levels distinguish transfer distance beyond training scenarios and connect outcomes to evolution traces.
2611.02797.result_en: Existing RSI methods show inconsistent gains across generalization levels; the abstract supplies no single aggregate improvement number.
2611.02797.boundary_en: This benchmarks evolving systems rather than establishing an improved self-improver. The malformed source-link phrase in the official New abstract is preserved verbatim in English.
2611.02797.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）系统越来越被视为加速迈向通用人工智能的有前景手段。它们旨在通过优化工作流水线，并递归改进指导后续优化的策略，自主提升能力，使收益泛化到未见内容。官方原摘要此处出现“this http URL”的链接占位，导致句子衔接不完整。现有评估缺乏可靠指标来区分能力提升与场景拟合，缺少面向未见任务和难度的可持续、可扩展协议，也缺乏将改进细粒度归因于演化轨迹的方式。为此，我们提出 SelfImprove-Bench，一个 RSI 评估框架，将任务组织为三种主要能力（即探索、规划、推理），作为指导模型演化的场景。我们用游戏实例化任务以实现可控性与可复现性，并结合由任务模板和难度系数驱动的可扩展生成与编排。除任务级评分外，SelfImprove-Bench 将评估组织成 G0 至 G4 泛化阶梯等级，测量收益从训练条件迁移的距离。实验揭示，现有 RSI 方法的演化收益在不同泛化等级间并不一致。

2611.03219.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
2611.03219.authors: Shangziqi Zhao , Yitong Zhang , Jia Li
2611.03219.abstract_en: Recently, harness self-evolution has emerged as an important paradigm for improving agent performance. Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters. We find that existing approaches largely study agent evolution on a single task. In practice, coding agents may need to handle multiple task types over time. Whether an agent harness can continuously evolve across multiple tasks without suffering from catastrophic forgetting remains an important open question. In this paper, we investigate this open question through a comprehensive empirical study of continual harness self-evolution. We organize three software engineering task datasets into six different evolution directions and apply two representative harness evolution methods to perform continual evolution along these directions. Our experimental results show that evolution on a subsequent dataset can substantially undermine the performance on previously seen datasets. For example, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Meta-Harness improves its performance on SWE-Bench to 94.0% after evolution. However, after further evolution on FeatureBench, its performance on SWE-Bench drops to 32.0% by the fifth round, corresponding to a 66% relative decrease. Finally, based on our experimental findings, we identify several insights, providing directions for the continual self-evolution of agent harnesses. Code is available at this https URL .
2611.03219.mechanism_en: Three software-engineering datasets form six evolution directions; two evolution methods adapt to later datasets while earlier-task scores track regressions.
2611.03219.result_en: With DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Meta-Harness reaches 94% on SWE-Bench then falls to 32% after FeatureBench evolution by round five, a 66% relative decrease.
2611.03219.boundary_en: Fixed foundation weights do not prevent harness-level forgetting. The highlighted drop is one method/model/direction, not a universal measured rate.
2611.03219.abstract_zh: 近期，运行框架自演化成为提升 Agent 性能的重要范式。已有研究表明，无需修改基础模型参数，演化 Agent 运行框架即可有效增强能力。我们发现，现有方法主要研究单一任务上的 Agent 演化。但实际中，编码 Agent 可能需要随时间处理多种任务类型。Agent 运行框架能否跨多任务持续演化而不遭受灾难性遗忘，仍是重要开放问题。本文通过全面的运行框架持续自演化实证研究探索该问题。我们把三个软件工程任务数据集组织为六种不同演化方向，应用两种代表性运行框架演化方法沿这些方向持续演化。实验显示，在后续数据集上演化，会显著损害先前数据集上的性能。例如，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 时，Meta-Harness 演化后在 SWE-Bench 上达到 94.0%；但继续在 FeatureBench 演化后，到第五轮时 SWE-Bench 性能降至 32.0%，相当于相对下降 66%。最后，我们基于实验识别出若干见解，为 Agent 运行框架的持续自演化提供方向。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。
