2611.03384.title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
2611.03384.authors: Eric Benhamou , Jean-Jacques Ohana , Beatrice Guez , Ethan Setrouk , Chamyl Saadi , Thomas Jacquot
2611.03384.abstract_en: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce PROMOTE, a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel--rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, PROMOTE has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.
2611.03384.affiliation: Ai For Alpha / LAMSADE, Universite Paris Dauphine–PSL
2611.03384.update_target: Sequential promotion gates for adaptively generated financial rules
2611.03384.mechanism_en: Predictable testing wealth is allocated at candidate birth; only subsequent cost-aware returns enter an e-process. A weighted Ville bound controls ever-promoting declared nonpositive-mean null rules if lifetime allocations sum to at most one.
2611.03384.result_en: Across 3,000 null paths, unadjusted family crossings are 94.5% vs 0% for PROMOTE; an adaptive exact-null experiment yields 1.77%. The market replay promotes zero rules after costs.
2611.03384.boundary_en: The certificate concerns historical false promotion under the declared bounded-score null, not future profitability. Power and a 2,327-session median crossing describe a specific injected alternative; AI-use disclosure is retained in both abstracts.
2611.03384.abstract_zh: 金融研究 Agent 生成和监控交易规则的速度，可能快于人类记录其选择过程的速度。候选在依赖数据的时刻出现，弱规则被放弃，有前景的规则被持续观察，直至越过报告阈值。我们提出 PROMOTE，一种在每个候选诞生时为其分配可预测检验财富、并仅根据后续收益累积考虑成本的 e 过程的协议。如果终身分配总和不超过一，加权 Ville 论证可界定：某规则所声明的有界净评分始终具有非正条件均值时，它在任何时刻被晋升的概率。该结果允许候选之间依赖、自适应诞生及无限期监控。我们在两种设置中审计实现。回顾性伪样本外回放包含 24 个面板—规则假设、3,000 条共享符号零假设路径、注入的备择情况，以及公开 ETF 和行业数据。重复使用未校正检验时，94.5% 的零假设路径出现族级越界，而 PROMOTE 为 0.0%；在 15 个基点的对齐 ETF 成分扰动下，PROMOTE 的目标检验效能为 70.1%，越界时段中位数为 2,327。另一项严格均值为零的实验，让 Agent 根据历史评分选择候选身份和诞生时间；在 3,000 个程序中，有资金约束的晋升门产生 1.77% 的错误族级越界。市场回放在计入成本后没有任何晋升。证书在声明的零假设下控制历史错误晋升；它并不保证先前的优势在部署时仍然盈利。AI 使用披露：包括 OpenAI Codex 在内的生成式 AI 工具协助了稿件准备。本预印本版本中，Codex 协助了 LaTeX 编辑、作者与会议期刊元数据、编译及版式检查。

2611.01908.title: Does reflective LLM feedback survive a wet-lab-scale label budget?
2611.01908.abstract_en: Can reflective language-model feedback improve a biological predictor when each cycle buys only one plate of labels? We separate three possible sources of benefit: proposing model edits, choosing measurements, and revising decisions through repeated feedback. We replay $36$ ProteinGym assays, starting with $96$ labels and acquiring $96$ per round for six rounds, with a sealed test set and a shared edit schema. The pre-specified comparison of full LLM control against random edits detects no advantage in test rank correlation ($\Delta z=-0.008$, $95\%$ CI $[-0.034,+0.018]$); equivalence is also unestablished. Exploratory ablations nevertheless identify useful model editing. With random acquisition fixed, LLM edits improve Fisher-transformed test Spearman by $0.043$ over no edits; with acquisition fixed to upper confidence bound, they improve normalized top-variant recovery by $0.023$. LLM acquisition alone does not detectably outperform fixed adaptive rules, and repeated feedback does not detectably outperform one initial recommendation under full control. Thus, the observed gains support constrained specialist editing, while the incremental value of recursive reflection remains unestablished at this label budget.
2611.01908.update_target: Biological predictor edits, acquisition rules and repeated reflective feedback
2611.01908.mechanism_en: A sealed-test ProteinGym replay compares full LLM control with random edits under 96 initial labels and six rounds of 96 acquisitions, using a shared edit schema; ablations separate editing, acquisition and reflection.
2611.01908.result_en: The prespecified full-control contrast detects no test-rank advantage (Δz=−0.008, 95% CI [−0.034,+0.018]); exploratory fixed-acquisition edits help, but acquisition/reflection add no detected advantage.
2611.01908.boundary_en: These are replayed assays at a wet-lab-scale label budget, not newly performed wet-lab experiments. No detected advantage does not establish equivalence; specialist editing is better supported than recursive reflection here.
2611.01908.abstract_zh: 如果每个周期只能购买一块实验板的标签，反思式语言模型反馈能否改善生物预测器？我们区分三种可能收益来源：提出模型修改、选择测量，以及通过重复反馈修订决策。我们回放 36 个 ProteinGym 测定，从 96 个标签起步，每轮获取 96 个，共六轮，使用封存测试集与共享编辑模式。预先规定的完整 LLM 控制与随机编辑比较，在测试秩相关上未检测到优势（Δz = −0.008，95% 置信区间 [−0.034,+0.018]）；等效性也未得到确立。不过，探索性消融识别出有用的模型编辑。固定随机采集时，LLM 编辑相对不编辑，使 Fisher 变换后的测试 Spearman 提高 0.043；固定采集为置信上界时，使归一化最优变体恢复提高 0.023。单独的 LLM 采集未可检测地优于固定自适应规则；完整控制下，重复反馈也未可检测地优于仅一次初始建议。因此，观察到的收益支持受约束的专家式编辑，而在此标签预算下，递归反思的增量价值仍未确立。

2611.01718.title: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use
2611.01718.authors: Changran Xu , Zeju Li , Qiang Xu
2611.01718.abstract_en: Task success, retrieval quality, and cost do not show whether an LLM agent used a delivered memory or what followed from that use. We introduce MemUse, which evaluates memory at its point of use in recorded trajectories: each memory delivery is compared with what the agent could already see and followed through the agent's later actions and their consequences. An agentic judge rates each delivered entry's relevance, accuracy, novelty, influence, and observed effect; programmatic checks enforce complete reading of cited evidence, and fixed rules aggregate the ratings into verdicts linked to memory histories and delivery cost. On 8,000 SWE-bench Verified episodes from three memory systems, resolve rates stay within 0.4 percentage points of a no-memory baseline, yet MemUse shows that most delivered entries were irrelevant, most relevant entries went unused, and in two systems most deliveries restated content the agent could still see. It also surfaces effects that outcomes hide: 23.2\% of episodes with beneficial memory use still failed, and 5 of 16 with harmful use still succeeded.
2611.01718.update_target: Evidence-linked evaluation of delivered memory at actual use
2611.01718.mechanism_en: MemUse compares each delivery against visible context and subsequent actions; an agentic judge scores relevance/accuracy/novelty/influence/effect, with programmatic citation-reading checks and fixed verdict aggregation.
2611.01718.result_en: Across 8,000 SWE-bench Verified episodes from three systems, resolve rates stay within 0.4 points of no memory. Most deliveries are irrelevant or unused; 23.2% of beneficial-use episodes fail and 5/16 harmful-use episodes pass.
2611.01718.boundary_en: Success is not a proxy for memory contribution. Trajectory judgments remain observational and judge-dependent rather than randomized causal estimates of every entry.
2611.01718.abstract_zh: 任务成功、检索质量和成本，无法表明 LLM Agent 是否使用了送达的记忆，或这种使用带来了什么。我们提出 MemUse，在记录轨迹中的实际使用点评估记忆：将每次记忆送达与 Agent 已经能看到的内容比较，并沿其后续动作与结果追踪。Agent 式裁判为每条送达记录的相关性、准确性、新颖性、影响力及观察到的效果打分；程序化检查确保完整读取被引用证据，固定规则把评分汇总为与记忆历史和送达成本相连的判决。在来自三个记忆系统的 8,000 个 SWE-bench Verified 事件中，解决率始终在无记忆基线的 0.4 个百分点以内，但 MemUse 显示，大多数送达条目不相关，多数相关条目未被使用，而且在两个系统中，多数送达内容重述了 Agent 仍能看到的信息。它还揭示了结果掩盖的影响：具有有益记忆使用的事件中，23.2% 仍失败；16 个有害使用事件中，有 5 个仍成功。
2611.01718.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01718.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of MemUse. The memory bridge connects agents to memory systems and annotates memory operations. The trajectory recorder captures model calls, with token usage and cost when available. Within each episode, data processing groups identical repeated deliveries into injection spans while earlier copies remain visible and assigns each entry a credit window for attributing actions. The memory graph links deliveries to recorded entry histories across trajectories. For each eligible span, an agentic judge assesses each entry’s information quality, use, and observed effects from its exposed text, prior context, and subsequent trajectory. Programmatic checks enforce evidence coverage and credit windows, and fixed rules derive the span verdict.

2611.03289.title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
2611.03289.abstract_en: A memory-augmented agent must decide which memories to keep, merge and retrieve, and its only evidence of their value is its retrieval log: the memories it retrieved in each episode and whether it succeeded. Existing methods assign every memory a value from this log, even when the log cannot separate one memory's contribution from another's. We treat the log as an experiment that nobody designed and ask which memory values it determines. Two counts answer this before any outcome is observed: how often each memory was retrieved, and how often each pair was retrieved together. From these counts, we prove that top-$k$ retrieval leaves every memory value undetermined, however many episodes are logged, and that a question with its own memories, asked once, determines at most one of their values. On fourteen standard memory benchmarks, no memory value is determined in any of 55 configurations. Both causes are choices about retrieval. We introduce LEDGER, which estimates each determined Shapley value in closed form with a confidence interval and reports every other value as undetermined. It merges memories with identical histories without losing a determined value, and it retrieves so that the next log determines more. On pooled HotpotQA, LEDGER raises the fraction of memories determined from 0.001 to 0.797, at a cost of 2.6 accuracy points on HotpotQA and with a gain of 2.7 on LoCoMo.
2611.03289.update_target: Identifiability-aware memory valuation, merging and experimental retrieval
2611.03289.mechanism_en: Retrieval counts/co-occurrence determine which values are identifiable under the formal model. LEDGER computes determined Shapley values with intervals, marks others undetermined, merges identical histories and changes retrieval to improve future identification.
2611.03289.result_en: No values are determined in 55 configurations across 14 benchmarks. Pooled HotpotQA identification rises 0.001→0.797 at a 2.6-point accuracy cost; LoCoMo gains 2.7 points.
2611.03289.boundary_en: The impossibility claim is conditional on the stated valuation/log model, not every conceivable memory utility. Better identification trades off against task accuracy and requires deliberate interventions.
2611.03289.abstract_zh: 记忆增强 Agent 必须决定保留、合并和检索哪些记忆，而关于价值的唯一证据是检索日志：每次事件检索了哪些记忆，以及是否成功。现有方法从日志给每条记忆赋值，即使日志无法区分某条记忆与另一条的贡献。我们把日志视为一个无人设计过的实验，询问它能确定哪些记忆价值。无需观察任何结果，仅两个计数就能回答：每条记忆被检索多少次，以及每对记忆被共同检索多少次。根据这些计数，我们证明，无论记录多少事件，top-k 检索都使每条记忆的价值无法确定；一个拥有自身记忆、只被问过一次的问题，最多确定其中一条记忆的价值。在十四个标准记忆基准的 55 种配置中，没有任何记忆价值得到确定。这两个原因都是检索方式的选择所致。我们提出 LEDGER，以闭式形式估计每个可确定的 Shapley 值并给出置信区间，把其他所有值报告为无法确定。它合并历史完全相同的记忆，而不损失可确定的价值，并通过检索使下一份日志能够确定更多价值。在汇总的 HotpotQA 上，LEDGER 将可确定记忆比例从 0.001 提高至 0.797，代价是在 HotpotQA 上损失 2.6 个准确率点，同时在 LoCoMo 上获得 2.7 个点的增益。
2611.03289.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.

2611.01059.title: Temperature, Not Knowledge: What Recursive Self-Training and Its Remedies Do to a Language Model's Confidence
2611.01059.authors: Dipto Sumit , Syeda Fabiayee Jahan , Farig Sadeque
2611.01059.abstract_en: Recursive self-training can collapse language models, and many proposed remedies target overconfidence, yet their effects on confidence are rarely measured. We study a five-round self-training loop on Qwen3-1.7B, using three seeds per compared method, and distinguish confidence temperature (drift from a calibrated starting point) from discrimination (ranking correct answers above incorrect ones). Accuracy and overall discrimination remain nearly unchanged, but confidence sharpens and the most confident answers become less reliable. Matching predictive entropy to the calibrated starting model each round recalibrates nearly as well as label-based temperature fitting, at both 1.7B and 8B. Sharpening is not inherent to self-training: exact samples from a model's distribution have zero expected gradient. Instead, most drift comes from fitting each generated answer twice, with top-p truncation contributing the rest; removing both keeps entropy on generated outputs flat. Remedies affect the two properties differently: truncated cross-entropy, an entropy bonus, and single-pass training preserve temperature without improving discrimination, while focal loss and multi-sample targets improve discrimination but cause underconfidence. Reference-data mixing also overshoots. Pairing a ranking-improving loss with label-free recalibration achieves both.
2611.01059.update_target: Recursive self-training weights and confidence recalibration
2611.01059.mechanism_en: Five-round self-training separates entropy/temperature drift from correct-vs-incorrect ranking. Controls remove duplicate fitting and top-p truncation; entropy matching to a calibrated reference is combined with ranking-oriented losses.
2611.01059.result_en: Across three seeds per method, accuracy/discrimination stay nearly flat while confidence sharpens; label-free recalibration works at 1.7B/8B. Removing duplicate fitting and truncation keeps generated-output entropy flat.
2611.01059.boundary_en: This diagnoses a particular finite loop, not inevitable self-training collapse. Calibration and discrimination are different objectives; the reference model is assumed calibrated.
2611.01059.abstract_zh: 递归自训练可能使语言模型坍塌，许多补救方法针对过度自信，但其对置信度的影响很少被测量。我们在 Qwen3-1.7B 上研究五轮自训练循环，每种对比方法使用三个随机种子，并区分置信度温度（相对校准起点的漂移）与区分能力（把正确答案排在错误答案之上）。准确率与整体区分能力几乎不变，但置信度变得更尖锐，最自信的答案也更不可靠。每轮将预测熵匹配到校准后的初始模型，在 1.7B 和 8B 上都能实现几乎与有标签温度拟合同样好的重新校准。变尖锐并非自训练固有属性：从模型分布精确采样的期望梯度为零。相反，大部分漂移来自每个生成答案被拟合两次，top-p 截断贡献其余部分；同时移除两者可使生成输出熵保持平稳。补救方法对这两种性质影响不同：截断交叉熵、熵奖励和单遍训练保持温度却不改善区分能力；focal loss 与多样本目标改善区分能力，却导致信心不足。参考数据混合也会矫枉过正。将改善排序的损失与无标签重新校准配对，可兼得两者。

2611.01976.title: Beyond Prompt Injection: The Tool Update Gap in LLM Agent Security
2611.01976.authors: Shiyu Kan (1), Yue Qi (1), Yufei Han (2), Xinjian Luo (1), Guojun Xiong (1), Xiaofeng Gao (1) ((1) Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China, (2) Inria, Rennes, France)
2611.01976.abstract_en: Large language model based agents increasingly rely on external tools to invoke services and interact with web resources. These tools can evolve through software updates, yet agentic frameworks may continue trusting them without re-verifying their safety after implementation changes. This tool update gap creates a supply-chain vulnerability in agentic systems: because updated tool code executes outside the LLM's context window, malicious functionality embedded in tool updates can bypass defenses centered on model-visible interactions, leaving agents exposed to stealthy, persistent threats that existing in-context defenses can hardly address. To thoroughly investigate this threat, we introduce ETUDE (Exploiting Tool Updates for Direct Execution), an attack that embeds malicious functionality into updates of initially benign tools to produce compromised tools, while preserving their legitimate tool functionality. Unlike prompt-based attacks, ETUDE operates entirely outside the LLM's context and requires no adversarial instructions, thereby bypassing defenses restricted to model-visible content. We evaluate ETUDE across three representative attack workloads and seven widely used commercial and open-source agentic frameworks, including Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and Claude Code. The results show that ETUDE achieves a 97.6% ASR while maintaining a 95.9% legitimate task completion rate. We further examine existing defenses and find that they provide insufficient protection against this threat. These findings expose a fundamental blind spot in current agent security practices: trust established for a tool does not necessarily remain valid after its implementation updates.
2611.01976.update_target: Trust and re-verification of updated external tool implementations
2611.01976.mechanism_en: ETUDE changes initially benign tool code outside the model-visible context while preserving legitimate functionality; tests compare attack success and legitimate completion across three workloads/seven frameworks.
2611.01976.result_en: The reported attack success rate is 97.6% with 95.9% legitimate completion; model-visible defenses provide insufficient protection in the evaluated setting.
2611.01976.boundary_en: A supply-chain boundary for mutable systems, not itself an RSI mechanism. A previously trusted interface cannot certify changed implementation behavior; rates remain threat-model-specific.
2611.01976.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的 Agent 越来越依赖外部工具调用服务并与网络资源交互。这些工具会通过软件更新演化，但 Agent 框架可能在实现变化后不重新验证安全性，继续信任它们。这种工具更新缺口给 Agent 系统带来供应链漏洞：由于更新后的工具代码在 LLM 上下文窗口之外执行，嵌入工具更新的恶意功能可绕过以模型可见交互为中心的防御，使 Agent 暴露于现有上下文内防御难以处理的隐蔽、持久威胁。为深入研究该威胁，我们提出 ETUDE（Exploiting Tool Updates for Direct Execution），将恶意功能嵌入原本良性工具的更新，在保留合法工具功能的同时产生被攻陷的工具。与基于提示的攻击不同，ETUDE 完全在 LLM 上下文之外运行，无需对抗指令，因此绕过仅限模型可见内容的防御。我们在三种代表性攻击负载和七个广泛使用的商业及开源 Agent 框架上评估 ETUDE，包括 Gemini CLI、Codex CLI 和 Claude Code。结果显示，ETUDE 达到 97.6% 的攻击成功率（ASR），同时保持 95.9% 的合法任务完成率。我们进一步检查现有防御，发现其对此威胁保护不足。这些发现揭示了当前 Agent 安全实践的根本盲点：对工具建立的信任，在其实现更新后并不一定继续有效。
2611.01976.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.01976.image_caption: Figure 1 . The tool update gap. A malicious update preserves the tool’s legitimate functionality while introducing unauthorized operations that execute directly within the tool’s runtime environment.

2611.03721.title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
2611.03721.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. The investigation reveals competing effects of energy conversion, retention, and release timing. Stronger coherent helical deformation increases resistive conversion while reducing radiation and increasing retained energy. A broader trailing-plasma profile delays the later radiation maximum and recovers much of its early bolometric deficit, with a spectral response that changes during the pulse. These results provide new insight into energy conversion in high-energy-density plasma physics and demonstrate a new paradigm for physics research.
2611.03721.update_target: Physical conjectures, numerical instruments and recorded research protocols
2611.03721.mechanism_en: Counterexamples drive prospective hypothesis repair; solvers and diagnostics may be adapted during a recorded investigation, with numerical-instrument qualification separated from scientific-claim review.
2611.03721.result_en: An 82.6-hour computational Z-pinch investigation identifies competing conversion, retention and radiation-timing effects, including helical-deformation and trailing-plasma-profile effects.
2611.03721.boundary_en: This is computational physics pursuing a human-defined conjecture, not a new physical experiment or proof of a universally improving scientist. Numerical qualification and scientific validity remain distinct.
2611.03721.abstract_zh: 人工智能辅助数学的近期突破表明，开放式机器搜索可以超越人类数学家，但将这一范式迁移到物理学，需要重构研究工作流。我们提出 Simjecture，一个让语言模型 Agent 探索人类定义的物理猜想的开源框架。该框架应对这一迁移中的两项核心挑战：第一，由于物理学是经验科学且没有模型是最终的，它围绕反例驱动的证伪与前瞻性假设修订组织研究；第二，由于物理理论必须与真实世界交互，它以计算物理作为可执行试验台，同时将数值仪器的资格验证与科学主张审查分离，使求解器和诊断工具能在有记录的调查中调整。我们用该框架开展了 82.6 小时的研究，处理 Z 箍缩中辐射能量超过内爆壳层动能这一长期问题。研究揭示了能量转换、保留与释放时机之间的竞争效应。更强的相干螺旋形变提高电阻能量转换，却降低辐射并增加保留能量。更宽的拖尾等离子体分布推迟后期辐射峰值，并弥补大部分早期总辐射亏损，其光谱响应在脉冲过程中变化。这些结果为高能量密度等离子体中的能量转换提供新认识，并展示一种新的物理研究范式。

2611.03868.title: EvoGroup: A Self-Evolving Harness for Group Agents in Shared Contexts
2611.03868.authors: Xinyi Xu , Xiaoyang Li , Yucheng Feng , Wenqing Chen , Youliang Yuan , Wei Shi , Rongxiang Weng , Zibin Zheng
2611.03868.abstract_en: With the rise of Group Agent such as Claude Tag, agents increasingly serve as digital workers for long-term team collaboration. These agents operate over shared contexts that continuously accumulate through multi-user interactions. However, existing agent memory systems are mainly designed for individual users and struggle to capture group-level knowledge in shared contexts, including group relationships and collaboratively formed knowledge. Manual memory strategies further limit adaptation to diverse and evolving shared contexts. To this end, we propose \textbf{EvoGroup (EvoG)}, a self-evolving harness for group agents that starts from a minimal six-tool cold start and adapts through interaction with shared context. EvoG uses confidence and task outcomes to select informative trajectories, while also eliciting self-reflections on uncertainty in low-confidence cases. The analysis agent then examines selected trajectories through adaptive progressive disclosure, followed by bucketed analysis to synthesize high-level findings that guide the evolve agent in revising the Harness. Empirically, pass@1 on held-out split of EverMemBench improves from 71.07\% to 89.58\%, surpassing both self-evolving memory and human-designed harnesses, including Claude Code (85.83\%). To evaluate generalization, we freeze the evolved harness and evaluate it on the unseen GroupMemBench, where, with GPT-5.5, it demonstrates effective generalization and outperforms both memory baselines and human-designed harnesses.
2611.03868.affiliation: Sun Yat-sen University / Longcat Team, Meituan
2611.03868.mechanism_en: Confidence and outcomes select trajectories, low-confidence reflection exposes uncertainty, and progressive-disclosure/bucketed analysis guides later harness revisions. Frozen-harness evaluation tests unseen GroupMemBench transfer.
2611.03868.result_en: EverMemBench held-out pass@1 rises 71.07%→89.58%, versus Claude Code 85.83%; unseen GroupMemBench transfer is reported with GPT-5.5.
2611.03868.boundary_en: The changed artifact is the external harness, not stated backbone weights. Outcome/confidence-guided selection is not itself proof of calibrated uncertainty or unlimited transfer.
2611.03868.abstract_zh: 随着 Claude Tag 等 Group Agent 兴起，Agent 越来越多地作为数字员工参与长期团队协作。这些 Agent 在多用户交互中持续积累的共享上下文上运行。然而，现有 Agent 记忆系统主要面向个人用户，难以捕获共享上下文中的群体级知识，包括群体关系和协作形成的知识。人工记忆策略进一步限制了对多样且演变中的共享上下文的适应。为此，我们提出 EvoGroup（EvoG），一种面向群体 Agent 的自演化运行框架，从最小的六工具冷启动出发，通过与共享上下文交互适应。EvoG 使用置信度和任务结果选择信息量高的轨迹，并在低置信度情况下引出关于不确定性的自反思。分析 Agent 随后通过自适应渐进披露检查所选轨迹，再通过分桶分析综合高层发现，指导演化 Agent 修订运行框架。实证上，EverMemBench 留出划分的 pass@1 从 71.07% 提升至 89.58%，超过自演化记忆和人工设计运行框架，包括 Claude Code（85.83%）。为评估泛化，我们冻结演化后的运行框架，在未见 GroupMemBench 上评估；使用 GPT-5.5 时，它表现出有效泛化，并优于记忆基线和人工设计运行框架。

(b) Comparison on the held-out split, where H ∗ H_{*} outperforms all the baselines including Codex and Claude Code.

2611.04035.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
2611.04035.authors: Erkang Zhu , Yin Lin , Xiaorong Shi , Xuanrui Lin , Jingren Zhou
2611.04035.abstract_en: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training. We introduce Recursa, a foundation model system that adapts to new domains by learning from its own experience without human experts or a stronger teacher model. Recursa uses a knowledge repository to store what it learns: domain-specific skills and instructions on when to apply them, along with memories of past task experiences and reflections on what to improve. Recursa bootstraps the repository from domain materials and then refines it through recursive self-improvement. It uses parallel learners to execute tasks and synthesize local improvements, then validates and merges the improvements into the knowledge repository. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge benchmark, Recursa raises the all-pass rate on held-out test tasks from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash.
2611.04035.update_target: A persistent repository of domain skills, applicability guidance and experience
2611.04035.mechanism_en: Domain materials seed the repository. Leaf learners diagnose/edit/verify, retaining fixes only after re-solving affected tasks and sampled prior passes without regressions. Parent learners merge children and recheck sample tasks before further learning.
2611.04035.result_en: Harvey LAB Firm Knowledge all-pass rises 30%→55% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and 35%→46% with Qwen3.8-Flash on held-out tasks.
2611.04035.boundary_en: This is repository/harness-centered adaptation, not stated backbone-weight learning. The paper uses revised benchmark rubrics; reported outcomes describe that protocol rather than an independently reproduced public leaderboard.
2611.04035.abstract_zh: 变化环境中的基础模型可能遇到原始训练未覆盖的陌生领域知识。然而，新领域很少提供大量专家创建的训练数据或可靠的进一步训练监督信号。我们提出 Recursa，一个无需人类专家或更强教师模型、通过自身经验适应新领域的基础模型系统。Recursa 使用知识仓库保存所学内容：领域专属技能及何时应用它们的指令，以及过去任务经验和改进反思的记忆。Recursa 从领域材料启动仓库，然后通过递归自改进优化。它使用并行学习者执行任务并综合局部改进，再验证这些改进并合并进知识仓库。在 Harvey LAB 的 Firm Knowledge 基准上，Recursa 将留出测试任务的全部通过率从使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 30.0% 提高到 55.0%，以及使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 的 35.0% 提高到 46.0%。

2611.04180.title: Validation-Gated ML Pipeline Synthesis with Expert-Grounded Self-Evolving Skills
2611.04180.authors: Zixiao Zhao , Jing Sun , Zhe Hou , Mengze Li , Qian Liu , Cheng-Hao Cai , Zijian Zhang , Xin Wang , Gillian Dobbie , Jin Song Dong
2611.04180.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have enabled agentic systems that automate machine learning pipeline construction from minimal user input. However, existing agentic AutoML methods either depend on rigid templates that limit adaptability, target narrow task domains, or rely on free-form code generation that lacks reliability guarantees, leaving intermediate errors to propagate silently and degrade the final model. We present EvoML, an agentic framework for end-to-end ML pipeline synthesis built on expert-grounded skills that evolve across runs, executed through a validation-gated harness. The framework decomposes pipeline construction into four phases coordinated by three agents: an Orchestrator that enforces validation gates, advancing each phase only when its outputs pass structural, execution, and semantic checks, which precludes error propagation and keeps every artifact auditable; an Executor that runs expert-grounded skills, grounded in the nnU-Net workflow and pairing reusable templates with online adaptation; and a Curator that performs post-run evolution, consolidating the scripts and guidance recovered during a run into the skill library so it improves across datasets. We evaluate EvoML on eight datasets spanning six sophisticated, real-world ML task types, against agentic AutoML systems and command-line coding tools. EvoML achieves full automation and the best final model quality on all eight, spanning segmentation (up to 0.94 Dice), classification (0.99 accuracy), reconstruction (0.95 SSIM), and denoising (0.79 normalized PSNR), while transferring to broader ML tasks.
2611.04180.affiliation: University of Auckland / Griffith University / Metasics / Beijing Institute of Technology / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) / National University of Singapore
2611.04180.update_target: Cross-run ML pipeline skills, scripts and execution guidance
2611.04180.mechanism_en: An Orchestrator advances phases only after structural/execution/semantic checks; an Executor runs nnU-Net-grounded skills, and a post-run Curator consolidates recovered scripts/guidance into the reusable library.
2611.04180.result_en: On eight datasets spanning six task types, the authors report full automation and best compared final quality, including up to 0.94 Dice, 0.99 accuracy, 0.95 SSIM and 0.79 normalized PSNR.
2611.04180.boundary_en: Gate success is bounded by the checks: the abstract's reliability language does not prove absence of all error propagation. Final model quality and improvement of the skill library are separate outcomes.
2611.04180.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的近期进展使 Agent 系统能够从极少用户输入自动构建机器学习流水线。然而，现有 Agent AutoML 方法要么依赖限制适应性的刚性模板，要么面向狭窄任务领域，要么依靠缺乏可靠性保证的自由代码生成，使中间错误静默传播并损害最终模型。我们提出 EvoML，一个端到端 ML 流水线合成 Agent 框架，建立在跨运行演化的专家依据技能上，并通过验证门控的运行框架执行。框架把流水线构建分为由三个 Agent 协调的四个阶段：Orchestrator 强制执行验证门，只有输出通过结构、执行和语义检查后才推进各阶段，以阻止错误传播并使每个产物可审计；Executor 运行基于 nnU-Net 工作流、将可复用模板与在线适应结合的专家依据技能；Curator 在运行后演化，将一次运行中恢复的脚本和指导整合进技能库，使其跨数据集改进。我们在涵盖六种复杂真实 ML 任务类型的八个数据集上，将 EvoML 与 Agent AutoML 系统和命令行编码工具比较。EvoML 在全部八个数据集上实现全自动化和最佳最终模型质量，涵盖分割（最高 0.94 Dice）、分类（0.99 准确率）、重建（0.95 SSIM）和去噪（0.79 归一化 PSNR），并可迁移到更广泛 ML 任务。
2611.04180.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.04180.image_caption: Fig. 1 : Overview of the proposed validation-gated agentic ML pipeline synthesis framework. The Orchestrator progresses through four phases and invokes the corresponding Executor skill group in sequence: Task Understanding (skills 1–2), Planning (3–4), Training (5–7), and Post-train Processing (8–9). After each phase, generated artifacts and execution evidence are returned for gated validation; passed phases advance, while failed phases trigger recovery. The Curator operates after the run to evolve the skill library from accumulated execution evidence.

2611.04437.title: WiSI: Wireless-in-the-Loop Self-Improvement
2611.04437.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents has enabled self-improvement, where agents iteratively refine their programs through execution feedback and performance evaluation. As these agents increasingly operate in physical environments and rely on wireless connectivity, communication conditions become an integral part of their improvement process. However, existing approaches largely assume ideal communication, overlooking how wireless conditions shape both the feedback that guides program modifications and the evaluation outcomes that determine which modifications survive. This challenge is further complicated by the coupling between agent behavior and wireless connectivity, as agents influence their own communication conditions through mobility and transmission decisions. To address this problem, we propose WiSI, a wireless-in-the-loop self-improvement framework that integrates spatiotemporal wireless channels, edge-assisted perception, and Large Language Model-driven program improvement. By incorporating wireless execution into the improvement loop, WiSI reveals how wireless execution experience shapes the generation and retention of program structures, and investigates the wireless conditions needed for robust improvement. Experiments show that agents improved under ideal links achieve only 40.0% task success under congestion, compared with 77.2% when improved under realistic wireless conditions. More importantly, wireless-aware feedback and selection jointly enable agents to discover and retain communication-efficient program structures that outperform parameter tuning and remain robust even with inaccurate run-time channel observations. We further find that moderate-load or mixed-network evaluation maintains strong performance across deployment conditions, while simplified models preserving link-rate statistics achieve comparable results without detailed spatial channel information.
2611.04437.mechanism_en: Wireless execution produces feedback for LLM code edits and selection; retained structures are tested across network loads and with inaccurate runtime channel observations.
2611.04437.result_en: Agents improved under ideal links achieve 40.0% success in congestion versus 77.2% after realistic-wireless improvement; moderate/mixed-load evaluation generalizes and simple rate-preserving models can suffice.
2611.04437.boundary_en: The evidence concerns evaluated wireless execution conditions; the abstract does not establish unrestricted real-world deployment. Structural program changes are distinguished from parameter tuning.
2611.04437.abstract_zh: AI Agent 的自主性增长使自改进成为可能：Agent 通过执行反馈和性能评估迭代优化程序。当这些 Agent 越来越多地运行于物理环境并依赖无线连接时，通信条件成为其改进过程的组成部分。然而，现有方法大多假设理想通信，忽视无线条件如何同时塑造指导程序修改的反馈和决定哪些修改存活的评估结果。Agent 行为与无线连接相互耦合，使挑战更复杂，因为 Agent 会通过移动和传输决策影响自身通信条件。为此，我们提出 WiSI，一个将时空无线信道、边缘辅助感知和大语言模型驱动程序改进相结合的无线在环自改进框架。通过将无线执行纳入改进循环，WiSI 揭示无线执行经验如何塑造程序结构的生成与保留，并研究稳健改进所需的无线条件。实验显示，在理想链路下改进的 Agent 在拥塞下仅有 40.0% 任务成功率，而在真实无线条件下改进时为 77.2%。更重要的是，无线感知反馈与选择共同使 Agent 发现并保留通信高效的程序结构，优于参数调节，并在运行时信道观测不准时仍稳健。我们还发现，中等负载或混合网络评估能在多种部署条件下保持强表现，而保留链路速率统计的简化模型无需详细空间信道信息，也能取得相当结果。
2611.04437.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.04437.image_caption: Fig. 2: Wireless execution and its implications for program evolution. (a) Agent mobility and transmission decisions affect communication outcomes under time-varying wireless conditions. (b) Execution feedback influences candidate program generation, wireless evaluation determines program retention, and inherited programs shape subsequent improvement generations.

2611.04439.title: DualEvolve: Dual-Level Self-Evolution of Mechanism and Orchestration for Recommendation
2611.04439.authors: Tianqi Gao , Chenxu Wang , Wenxuan Yang , Yueqi Mou , Biao Tang , Ming Liu , Peng Yan
2611.04439.abstract_en: Recommender systems are widely used in e-commerce and content platforms, where improvement requires repeated model design, training optimization, and experimental validation. Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate this development cycle. Sustained autonomous improvement requires agents to improve both recommendation models and their development workflows. However, task-performance-driven approaches select updates mainly by candidates' final scores, without a separate optimization signal for experimentation quality. We therefore present DualEvolve, a dual-level framework that co-evolves recommendation mechanisms and agent orchestration toward recursive self-improvement. Inner evolution revises model and training code using task feedback to improve recommendation performance. Outer evolution scores the inner-loop experimental process, updates harness and skill rules using these scores and execution traces, and adjusts orchestration choices based on next-round scores to improve the quality of subsequent experiments. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and three Amazon Reviews 2023 subsets cover four recommendation methods and 16 settings. DualEvolve achieves higher test means than Base, OpenEvolve, and DeepEvolve in all 64 setting-metric comparisons, with macro-averaged relative gains over DeepEvolve of 7.6% (HR@5) and 9.0% (NDCG@5).
2611.04439.update_target: Recommendation model/training code and experiment orchestration rules
2611.04439.mechanism_en: Inner evolution edits model/training code using task feedback; outer evolution scores experimentation quality, revises harness/skill rules from traces and uses next-round scores to adapt orchestration.
2611.04439.result_en: Across 16 settings/four methods on MovieLens-1M and three Amazon subsets, test means exceed three baselines in all 64 setting–metric comparisons; macro relative gains over DeepEvolve are 7.6% HR@5 and 9.0% NDCG@5.
2611.04439.boundary_en: The meta-level signal is distinct from final recommendation score, but finite benchmark comparisons do not show unlimited improvement or independent replication.
2611.04439.abstract_zh: 推荐系统广泛用于电子商务与内容平台，其改进需要反复进行模型设计、训练优化和实验验证。大语言模型（LLM）Agent 越来越多地自动化这一开发周期。持续自主改进要求 Agent 同时改善推荐模型及其开发工作流。然而，任务性能驱动的方法主要按候选最终评分选择更新，缺乏单独针对实验质量的优化信号。因此，我们提出 DualEvolve，一个共同演化推荐机制和 Agent 编排、迈向递归自改进的双层框架。内层演化利用任务反馈修订模型与训练代码，以提升推荐性能。外层演化对内循环实验过程评分，根据这些评分和执行轨迹更新运行框架及技能规则，并依据下一轮评分调整编排选择，以提高后续实验质量。我们在 MovieLens-1M 和三个 Amazon Reviews 2023 子集上，覆盖四种推荐方法和 16 种设置开展实验。DualEvolve 在全部 64 个设置—指标比较中的测试均值均高于 Base、OpenEvolve 和 DeepEvolve，相较 DeepEvolve 的宏平均相对提升为 HR@5 的 7.6% 和 NDCG@5 的 9.0%。

2611.04481.title: Goal-Driven Autonomous Optical Experimentation via a Self-Recursive Hardware-Software Harness
2611.04481.authors: Tianxing Zhu , Huacheng Lu , Ming Liu , Malte Hillebrand
2611.04481.abstract_en: We propose goal-driven self-recursive optical research in which agents use physical evidence to revise the hardware, software, models, and protocols used to pursue a scientific goal. The framework can be instantiated with different stimulus systems and measurement devices. We formalize its updates and derive a relation between physical attainability, command access, and model approximation error. We demonstrate the concept in an optical see-through color-matching case study using an iPad, RayNeo X3 glasses, and a TOP 300 probe coupled to a CAS140D spectroradiometer, both from Instrument Systems. A revised glasses application adds USB-controlled RGB holds and frame acknowledgements, keeping model-generated colors displayed during spectral acquisition. The interface passes 12 live control checks. Spectral feedback reduces one target color difference from 19.756 to 1.211 {\Delta}E_76^*; all five targets improve in a separate comparison. These measurements demonstrate the concept in one configuration. The resulting software and protocols remain available for subsequent investigations.
2611.04481.affiliation: Konica Minolta (China) Investment Ltd / Giant Testing Equipment Ltd
2611.04481.update_target: Optical hardware-control software, models and reusable experiment protocols
2611.04481.mechanism_en: Physical evidence motivates revisions to command access and the measurement workflow; USB RGB holds/frame acknowledgements keep stimuli stable, and revised software/protocols remain available for subsequent investigations.
2611.04481.result_en: One iPad/RayNeo X3/spectroradiometer configuration passes 12 live control checks; one target improves 19.756→1.211 ΔE*76 and all five targets improve in a separate comparison.
2611.04481.boundary_en: This is a physical concept demonstration in one configuration, not broad autonomous hardware redesign. Interface checks and color improvement support different parts of the claim.
2611.04481.abstract_zh: 我们提出目标驱动的自递归光学研究，其中 Agent 使用物理证据修订追求科学目标所用的硬件、软件、模型和协议。框架可用不同刺激系统和测量设备实例化。我们形式化其更新，并推导物理可达性、命令访问能力和模型近似误差之间的关系。我们以光学透视颜色匹配案例展示概念，使用 iPad、RayNeo X3 眼镜，以及 Instrument Systems 的 TOP 300 探头与 CAS140D 光谱辐射计。修订后的眼镜应用增加 USB 控制的 RGB 保持和帧确认，在光谱采集时持续显示模型生成的颜色。该接口通过 12 项实时控制检查。光谱反馈将一个目标的色差从 19.756 降至 1.211 ΔE*76；在另一项比较中，全部五个目标都得到改善。这些测量在一种配置下展示了该概念。所得软件与协议保留供后续研究使用。

2611.04998.title: ForgeKernel: Self-Evolving Kernels Catching and Surpassing Experts and Agents
2611.04998.authors: Yaojian Chen , Dazhi Peng , Yiyun Zheng , Zhui Zhu , Shengye Xiang , Leshan Li , Zhen Li , Xianglong Deng , Haojun Sun , Qingfeng He , Shangzhan Li , Yifei Shen , Lin Gan , Yuxuan Li , Xu Han , Zhiyuan Liu
2611.04998.abstract_en: Purpose-built kernel agents can write high-performance GPU kernels, but existing systems generally lack cross-run knowledge accumulation and architectural evolution. Each run starts from the same initial knowledge, and later iterations largely optimize within an architecture fixed early in the search. We present ForgeKernel, a kernel-generation system that accumulates and reuses knowledge across runs while enabling continued evolution of kernel architectures. It analyzes the hardware behavior of a high-performance reference and distills validated architectural decisions into reusable knowledge of hardware mechanisms rather than imitating source code. It then seals a kernel that passes correctness and performance validation and uses it as the reference for the next optimization run, enabling architectural decisions to be revisited. Across 27 operators and 29 input configurations on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, ForgeKernel matches or beats its expert reference on 25 configurations, with a geometric-mean performance gain of 10%. On Ascend 910C, it outperforms the per-operator public best on the public case set of all 8 level-4 operators in the CANN-Bench Season 1 final leaderboard, with a geometric-mean gain of 25.1%, while its full-suite submission ranks first on the A3 leaderboard. As of 2026-10-30, public submissions generated by ForgeKernel rank first on all three CANN-Bench 2.0 solution leaderboards (Ascend 910C, 950DT, and 950PR) and on the SOL-ExecBench FlashInfer-Bench track.
2611.04998.affiliation: Tsinghua University / ModelBest Inc. / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Harbin Institute of Technology
2611.04998.update_target: Kernel architecture and validated cross-run hardware-mechanism knowledge
2611.04998.mechanism_en: The system analyzes reference hardware behavior, distills validated architectural decisions, seals a correctness/performance-tested kernel and uses it as the next run's reference, allowing later architectural revision.
2611.04998.result_en: It matches/beats expert references on 25/29 NVIDIA configurations (10% geometric-mean gain); reports 25.1% gain on eight Ascend level-4 public cases and several dated leaderboard first-place claims.
2611.04998.boundary_en: Kernel benchmarks are hardware/configuration-specific. Dated public-leaderboard standings are author claims unless separately audited here; no independent reproduction or current ranking is asserted.
2611.04998.abstract_zh: 专用内核 Agent 能编写高性能 GPU 内核，但现有系统通常缺少跨运行知识积累和架构演化。每次运行都从相同初始知识出发，后续迭代大多在搜索早期固定的架构内优化。我们提出 ForgeKernel，一个在跨运行中积累并复用知识、同时支持内核架构持续演化的内核生成系统。它分析高性能参考的硬件行为，将经过验证的架构决策提炼为可复用的硬件机制知识，而非模仿源代码。随后，它封存一个通过正确性与性能验证的内核，并将其作为下一次优化运行的参考，使架构决策可被重新审视。在 NVIDIA Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 的 27 个算子、29 种输入配置上，ForgeKernel 在 25 种配置中匹配或超过专家参考，几何平均性能提升为 10%。在 Ascend 910C 上，它在 CANN-Bench Season 1 决赛榜全部八个四级算子的公开案例集上超过各算子的公开最佳结果，几何平均提升 25.1%，同时其完整套件提交在 A3 榜单排名第一。截至 2026 年 10 月 30 日，ForgeKernel 生成的公开提交在 CANN-Bench 2.0 的全部三个方案榜单（Ascend 910C、950DT 和 950PR）以及 SOL-ExecBench 的 FlashInfer-Bench 赛道上排名第一。

2611.03698.title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
2611.03698.authors: Shuzheng Gao , Zhaojian Yu , Penghao Yin , Yuling Shi , Kai Cai , Shilin He , Michael R. Lyu
2611.03698.abstract_en: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. Building on RSI-Dojo, we employ a trajectory collection method with an improved harness to collect high-quality model-training trajectories from frontier models, then retain examples through rubric-based and outcome-based filtering. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories. The resulting RSI-Dojo-9B and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B improve over their base models by 8.74 and 16.87 PostTrainBench points, respectively. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B reaches 29.95 on PostTrainBench and 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite, matching the performance of frontier models such as GLM-5.2 and GPT 5.5.
2611.03698.affiliation: Chinese University of Hong Kong / ByteDance / Tsinghua University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2611.03698.update_target: Agent model weights trained to conduct post-training; executable training environments
2611.03698.mechanism_en: RSI-Craft turns research artifacts into executable, filtered tasks; improved-harness teacher trajectories pass rubric/outcome filters and then fine-tune Qwen agents to train other models.
2611.03698.result_en: 281 seed tasks yield gains of 8.74/16.87 PostTrainBench points for 9B/35B-A3B agents; the latter reaches 29.95 and 53.29 on PostTrainBench/Lite.
2611.03698.boundary_en: This internalizes post-training ability through supervised trajectories. It does not by itself show the resulting agent recursively updating its own weights or outperforming its teachers without external artifacts.
2611.03698.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在使 AI 系统自主构建并改善 AI 系统本身，包括模型、运行框架和底层基础设施。在这一更广泛议程中，一项核心能力是让 Agent 训练并改进基础模型。然而，现有自动模型训练研究主要关注工作流或运行框架级优化，而非将开展后训练的能力内化到模型自身。发展此能力需要可执行的模型训练环境，能产生高质量轨迹，展示如何选择数据、训练模型、诊断失败并迭代改善结果。本文提出 RSI-Dojo，一组旨在教会 LLM Agent 开展后训练的可执行模型训练环境。为构建 RSI-Dojo，我们开发 RSI-Craft，一个将人类研究产物转化为可执行模型训练环境的自动流水线。RSI-Craft 自动收集顶级会议期刊研究论文，将数据集与指标实例化为统一接口，并复现评估依赖。随后按数据规模、执行可靠性和可区分性筛选任务，得到包含 281 个种子模型训练任务的 RSI-Dojo。基于 RSI-Dojo，我们利用改进运行框架的轨迹收集方法，从前沿模型收集高质量模型训练轨迹，再通过量规与结果筛选保留示例。我们在这些轨迹上微调 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。所得 RSI-Dojo-9B 和 RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 分别比基础模型提高 8.74 和 16.87 个 PostTrainBench 点。RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 在 PostTrainBench 和 PostTrainBench-Lite 上分别达到 29.95 和 53.29，匹配 GLM-5.2 和 GPT 5.5 等前沿模型的表现。

2611.03743.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
2611.03743.authors: Zhishang Xiang , Yunbo Tang , Zhongqiao Liu , Junkai Chen , Zerui Chen , Qingguo Hu , Yuxuan Zhang , William Grant , Qinggang Zhang , Jinsong Su
2611.03743.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts with two complementary states: Relational States that capture how facts remain valid and relate to one another as memory evolves, and a Reasoning State that determines how these facts should be applied to the current request. Specifically, EvoMemState consists of three key components: (i) Ontology-Guided Memory State Induction extracts Persistent Facts and constructs Relational States that maintain their validity, scope, and evolving relations. (ii) RL-Based State Evolution internalizes memory-use experience into a policy through reinforcement learning to generate a request-specific Reasoning State. (iii) State-Aware Reasoning then combines the relevant facts with their Relational States and the generated Reasoning State to guide the personal agent. Extensive experiments on long-term dialogue and memory-use benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing memory systems in retrieval completeness and memory-grounded response accuracy. Our code and implementation details are available at this https URL .
2611.03743.affiliation: Xiamen University / Nanyang Technological University / University of British Columbia / University of Waterloo / Jilin University
2611.03743.update_target: Persistent facts/relational states and an RL-trained memory-use policy
2611.03743.mechanism_en: Ontology-guided induction maintains fact validity/scope/relations; reinforcement learning internalizes memory-use experience into a policy generating request-specific reasoning states for later answers.
2611.03743.result_en: The abstract reports consistent retrieval-completeness and memory-grounded response gains across dialogue/memory benchmarks, without an aggregate effect size.
2611.03743.boundary_en: Request-specific reasoning state is transient, whereas facts/relations and learned policy persist. The abstract does not establish an indefinitely improving online RL loop.
2611.03743.abstract_zh: 长期记忆通过跨交互保留用户信息，使大语言模型（LLM）Agent 能提供持续的个性化帮助。现有系统通过事实提取、组织、更新和检索支持该过程，但大多将记忆维护为独立事实。这种事实中心范式可能忽略新事实如何更新、约束或冲突于先前事实，同时让它们对当前请求的适用性、角色和优先级保持隐含。本文提出 EvoMemState，一个状态中心框架，用两种互补状态增强持久事实：关系状态捕获事实在记忆演化中如何保持有效并相互关联；推理状态决定这些事实应如何应用于当前请求。具体而言，EvoMemState 包含三个关键组件：（i）本体引导的记忆状态归纳提取持久事实，并构建维护其有效性、范围和演化关系的关系状态；（ii）基于 RL 的状态演化通过强化学习将记忆使用经验内化为策略，以生成请求专属推理状态；（iii）状态感知推理结合相关事实、关系状态和生成的推理状态来指导个人 Agent。在长期对话和记忆使用基准上的广泛实验表明，相较现有记忆系统，它在检索完整性和记忆依据响应准确率上持续改善。代码与实现细节见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.04003.title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis
2611.04003.authors: Peizhi Niu , Ge Shi , Vaibhav Gorde , Sarthak Ghosh , Christos Faloutsos , Min Cheng , Kevin Chen
2611.04003.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.04003.abstract_en: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.
2611.04003.mechanism_en: Execution traces and feedback become reusable action/recovery knowledge; controlled experiments vary consolidation, human diagnosis versus self-judgment, trace scope and refinement rounds.
2611.04003.result_en: TheAgentCompany checkpoint pass rate improves 4.6–6.1% over the strongest compared baseline while storage falls 57–61%; one human-diagnosis round beats four self-judgment rounds by 7.0–10.9%, as stated in the abstract.
2611.04003.boundary_en: Training-free memory evolution still relies on feedback quality; human diagnosis is not autonomous self-verification. The abstract's percent notation is not silently relabeled as percentage points.
2611.04003.abstract_zh: LLM Agent 难以自动化复杂企业流程，因为静态预建运行框架无法捕获仅在执行时出现的专有政策、未记录行为或依赖状态的恢复路径。从 Agent 经验积累的程序性记忆，提供了无需训练的弥补路径；但不同于情景记录或语义事实，它必须将重复成功和已诊断失败整合为可复用动作及恢复策略。我们提出 WASP-Mem（Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory），一种轻巧而有效的方法，将执行轨迹和反馈提炼为持久、相互链接的维基页面，支持持续 Agent 学习。在 TheAgentCompany 基准上，WASP-Mem 在三个模型上，相对所比较最强基线，将检查点通过率提高 4.6–6.1%，同时少用 57–61% 存储。我们还给出覆盖整合方法、反馈类型、轨迹摄入范围和优化轮数的系统受控研究。结果表明，人工定义模式和显式去重规则等规范性知识组织，反而损害性能，并未弥补程序性知识缺口。相反，人工诊断将失败轨迹转化为纠正性知识并驱动持续改进：一轮人工诊断比四轮自我判断高 7.0–10.9%。这些发现指向一种简单分工：让 Agent 组织程序性记忆，将人类精力投入最重要的诊断。

2611.04016.title: Physical Experience Builds Continual Spatial World Models
2611.04016.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used to support prediction and planning in embodied agents, but the knowledge is usually established before deployment and then carried into later encounters. Continual operation faces a different problem. A familiar environment may change, and the agent must use previous experience without allowing old expectations to override current physical evidence. This study asks what repeated physical experience must contribute for a spatial world model to become progressively more useful rather than simply more persistent. A physics-grounded dynamic maze separates recurring spatial change from the continuous consequences of action. Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory learns relations among environmental transformations, while state-action-outcome experience refines predictions of motion. Structured experience progressively reduces the need for future route correction and transfers to spatial transitions not encountered during learning. The advantage disappears when past changes contain no information about future ones. Continuous navigation further shows that predictive memory changes behavior when a previous decision becomes invalid but leaves behavior unchanged when the decision remains correct. Physical tests expose a complementary limit: correct topology does not guarantee correct action prediction, and accumulated physical experience reduces this mismatch within the modeled dynamics. The results characterize continual world knowledge as experience that improves future prediction and action beyond stored episodes while remaining revisable by the physical outcomes it is intended to predict.
2611.04016.update_target: Cross-episode spatial-change memory and action-outcome predictions
2611.04016.mechanism_en: A physics-grounded maze supplies recurring transformations and continuous action consequences. Stored transformation relations and state–action–outcome experience revise future predictions, with uninformative-history controls.
2611.04016.result_en: Structured experience reduces later route corrections and transfers to unseen transitions; the advantage disappears when past changes do not predict future changes.
2611.04016.boundary_en: The described tests operate within modeled dynamics. Environmental state/motion learning is not demonstrated evolution of the learning procedure or a live-robot deployment.
2611.04016.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地用于支持具身 Agent 的预测和规划，但知识通常在部署前建立，再带入后续遭遇。持续运行面临不同问题：熟悉环境可能变化，Agent 必须利用以往经验，同时不让旧预期凌驾于当前物理证据。本研究询问，重复物理经验必须贡献什么，才能使空间世界模型逐步更有用，而非仅更持久。一个以物理为依据的动态迷宫，将重复空间变化与动作的连续后果分离。跨事件空间变化记忆学习环境变换之间的关系，状态—动作—结果经验则优化运动预测。结构化经验逐步减少未来路线纠正需求，并迁移至学习时未遇到的空间转变。当过去变化不包含关于未来变化的信息时，优势消失。连续导航进一步表明，当先前决策失效时，预测记忆改变行为；当决策仍正确时，则不改变行为。物理测试揭示互补边界：正确拓扑不保证正确动作预测，而累积物理经验在所建模动力学内减少这一不匹配。结果将持续世界知识刻画为一种超越存储事件、改善未来预测与行动、同时仍可被其旨在预测的物理结果修订的经验。

2611.04173.title: ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes
2611.04173.authors: Songling Liu , Guosheng Zhao , Xiaofeng Wang , Chaojun Ni , Guan Huang , Jiwen Lu , Xingang Wang , Zheng Zhu
2611.04173.abstract_en: Dynamic driving scene reconstruction has made remarkable strides in recent years by leveraging generative priors, particularly in the quality of novel trajectory rendering. Nevertheless, a significant gap remains between the generated data and real-world sensor observations, severely hindering further improvements in reconstruction fidelity. In this paper, we present ReconDreamer#, a self-evolving framework that synergizes reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, which substantially bridges the gap between synthesized novel trajectory data and recorded real-world observations. Within this self-evolving closed-loop framework, the generative and reconstruction models mutually reinforce each other through iterative refinement, ultimately yielding a significant enhancement in the 3D representation capability of the reconstruction model. Additionally, we introduce a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to further enhance the rendering quality of the reconstruction model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet, and EUVS benchmarks. Specifically on Waymo, at a 6-m lateral shift, ReconDreamer# improves NTA-IoU and NTL-IoU by 8.8% and 3.0%, respectively, and reduces FID by 15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++.
2611.04173.affiliation: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Tsinghua University / Giga AI
2611.04173.update_target: Coupled reconstruction and generative scene-model refinement
2611.04173.mechanism_en: Generated novel-trajectory data and reconstruction are iteratively refined so the two models reinforce one another; a geometry-prior adaptive ground model supplements the loop.
2611.04173.result_en: Waymo at 6 m lateral shift reports NTA-IoU +8.8%, NTL-IoU +3.0% and FID −15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++; four datasets are evaluated.
2611.04173.boundary_en: This is a domain-specific model co-refinement mechanism, not an agent rewriting its own optimizer. The abstract does not expose all acceptance gates or prove indefinite gain.
2611.04173.abstract_zh: 动态驾驶场景重建近年来通过利用生成先验取得显著进展，尤其提升了新轨迹渲染质量。然而，生成数据与真实传感器观测之间仍有显著差距，严重阻碍重建保真度进一步提高。本文提出 ReconDreamer#，一个协同动态驾驶场景重建与生成的自演化框架，显著弥合合成新轨迹数据与记录的真实观测之间的差距。在这一自演化闭环框架中，生成模型与重建模型通过迭代优化相互增强，最终显著提高重建模型的 3D 表示能力。此外，我们提出基于几何先验的自适应地面模型，进一步增强重建模型的渲染质量。为验证方法有效性，我们在 Waymo、nuScenes、PandaSet 和 EUVS 基准上全面评估。具体而言，在 Waymo 的 6 米横向偏移下，相对 ReconDreamer++，ReconDreamer# 将 NTA-IoU 和 NTL-IoU 分别提高 8.8% 和 3.0%，并将 FID 降低 15.1%。

2611.04277.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
2611.04277.authors: Kangning Zhang , Wenxiang Jiao , Bowen Fang , Shuai Shao , Jiachen Zhu , Rong Shan , Shijian Wang , Hao Wang , Yuan Lu , Weiwen Liu , Weinan Zhang
2611.04277.abstract_en: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions, forming a reusable Sibling Harness Pool that remains fixed during policy training. Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes this pool only when all initial attempts under the base harness fail. The same policy generates fresh rollouts under selected auxiliary harnesses, and these trajectories replace the failed group for reinforcement learning. An Adaptive Harness Router selects the Top-k variants using Harness Behavior Profiles and voting across multiple LLMs. Policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes this evidence as the policy learns. Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench, the trained policy substantially outperforms policy-only training when returned to the original base harness. Behavioral analyses and held-out cases support the transfer of harness-elicited behaviors into the policy itself. Reusing the router for Rank-1 inference provides additional gains at the same executor rollout count.
2611.04277.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Xiaohongshu Inc. / Zhongguancun Institute of Artificial Intelligence / Southeast University / Carnegie Mellon University
2611.04277.update_target: A trained policy plus fixed sibling harnesses and refreshed routing evidence
2611.04277.mechanism_en: Directional evolution creates a reusable fixed sibling pool. When every base-harness attempt fails, the same policy generates rescue rollouts for RL; policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes router evidence as learning proceeds.
2611.04277.result_en: Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym and DBBench, trained policies outperform policy-only training under the original harness; Rank-1 routing adds gains without increasing executor rollout count.
2611.04277.boundary_en: Harness generation, pool freezing and policy learning are separate stages. Reusing a fixed pool is not simultaneous unbounded harness evolution; abstract-level gains are qualitative.
2611.04277.abstract_zh: 从共同基底演化出的运行框架具有局部性、互补性和非平稳性：不同变体修复不同失败，其效用随策略学习而变化。我们不寻求普遍更优的运行框架，而提出 Harness-S，通过同源运行框架选择性挽救基础执行系统的失败，再将所得能力迁移进在原始运行框架下仍有效的单一策略。定向运行框架演化沿不同修复方向发展专门化同源框架，形成在策略训练期间保持固定的可复用同源运行框架池。互补运行框架挽救训练仅在基础框架的所有初始尝试失败时调用该池。同一策略在所选辅助框架下生成新 rollout，用这些轨迹替换失败组进行强化学习。自适应运行框架路由器根据行为画像与多个 LLM 的投票选择 Top-k 变体。策略感知画像重新锚定随策略学习刷新证据。在 AppWorld、SWE-Gym 和 DBBench 上，将训练后的策略放回原始基础框架时，其表现显著优于仅训练策略。行为分析与留出案例支持将运行框架引出的行为迁移到策略本身。将路由器复用于 Rank-1 推理，在相同执行器 rollout 数量下提供额外收益。

2611.04958.title: Shuffled OPSD: When Semantic Consistency Hurts On-Policy Self-Distillation?
2611.04958.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation improves a student model's reasoning ability through supervision from a teacher. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the same model as both teacher and student under different contexts: the student generates reasoning trajectories from the question alone, while the teacher additionally receives a complete worked example and provides token-level supervision along those trajectories. Because the problem statement is shared, its content and ordering shape both student generation and teacher feedback. Preserving its semantic structure therefore seems natural, but does it always improve learning? We introduce Shuffled OPSD, which shuffles the words of the shared problem statement while keeping the teacher-only worked example intact. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 model scales, the method improves mean accuracy over both an intact-target control and Standard OPSD under matched training configurations. The largest gain over Standard OPSD is 3.52 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B. Further controls show that preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling at the evaluated scales, whereas shuffling the teacher-only worked example reduces accuracy at every scale. Cross-problem mixing and target-removal experiments further distinguish the roles of problem content, word order, and teacher context. These results show that disrupting the shared problem statement can improve learning, while disrupting the teacher-only reference hurts performance. They challenge semantic coherence as a universally beneficial principle for OPSD and motivate closer study of how input structure shapes student generation and teacher supervision.
2611.04958.update_target: On-policy self-distillation weights and shared problem-statement structure
2611.04958.mechanism_en: The student generates from a word-shuffled question, while the same-model teacher retains an intact privileged worked example. Matched controls vary word blocks, cross-problem mixing and target removal.
2611.04958.result_en: Three math benchmarks/three Qwen3 scales show improved mean accuracy, with up to +3.52 percentage points over Standard OPSD at 1.7B; shuffling the teacher-only example hurts every scale.
2611.04958.boundary_en: This is a training-supervision mechanism, not evidence that semantic incoherence generally helps reasoning. Shared-question perturbation and corruption of privileged teacher evidence have opposite effects.
2611.04958.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏通过教师监督提升学生模型的推理能力。在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在不同上下文中使用同一模型作为教师和学生：学生仅根据问题生成推理轨迹，而教师额外获得完整解题示例，并沿这些轨迹提供 token 级监督。因为问题陈述是共享的，其内容和顺序同时塑造学生生成与教师反馈。保留语义结构看似自然，但它总能改善学习吗？我们提出 Shuffled OPSD，将共享问题陈述的词打乱，同时保持仅教师可见的解题示例完整。在三个数学推理基准和三种 Qwen3 模型规模上，使用匹配训练配置时，该方法的平均准确率高于完整目标对照和 Standard OPSD。相对 Standard OPSD 的最大收益是在 Qwen3-1.7B 上提高 3.52 个百分点。进一步对照显示，在评估规模下，保留更大词块并不优于逐词打乱；打乱仅教师可见的解题示例则使所有规模准确率下降。跨问题混合与目标移除实验进一步区分问题内容、词序和教师上下文的角色。这些结果表明，扰乱共享问题陈述可以改善学习，但扰乱仅教师可见的参考会损害表现。它们挑战了语义连贯对 OPSD 普遍有益的原则，并促使进一步研究输入结构如何塑造学生生成与教师监督。

2611.05036.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
2611.05036.authors: Guanting Dong , Zhichao Sun , Xinyu Yang , Rui Wang , Xin Deng , Jiajie Jin , Zhixiong Yang , Junhao Huang , Han Han , Mingyu Ma , Xiaotao Wang , Yuyang Hu , Xiaoshuai Song , Xiaoxi Li , Jiejun Tan , Zhecan Wang , Shihan Dou , Honglin Guo , Zhiheng Xi , Tao Gui , Tao Ji , Qi Zhang , Yutao Zhu , Ji-Rong Wen , Zhicheng Dou
2611.05036.abstract_en: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.
2611.05036.affiliation: Renmin University of China / Fudan University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2611.05036.update_target: Execution-grounded tool environments, task data and downstream agent weights
2611.05036.mechanism_en: Deterministic rules mine dependencies from real tool-call traces; graph clustering, state-aware walks/rollback and assertion-checked replay retain valid synthetic tasks. The retained corpus supports later training/RL.
2611.05036.result_en: Harder Pro benchmarks lower seven frontier models by up to 38.2 points. Seven-benchmark averages rise 23.0→41.0 (43.2 with RL) for Qwen and 44.6→56.6 for GLM.
2611.05036.boundary_en: Environment synthesis and downstream model learning are distinct mechanisms. Scaling valid tasks does not establish autonomous evolution of the synthesis procedure itself.
2611.05036.abstract_zh: 大语言模型被部署为长时程 Agent，将多个 MCP 服务的多样工具组合为可执行工作流。现有 MCP 环境扩展方法以数据为中心：先合成数据库和场景，再从中推导工具与任务。因此，工具接口可能与真实接口不匹配，工具组合缺少执行依据，任务也很少跨越多个环境。我们提出 ToolSpace，一个颠倒这一顺序的工具中心框架。ToolSpace 从真实 MCP 服务与开放 Agent 语料的执行轨迹中，使用确定性规则而非 LLM 判断，挖掘相邻调用的数据、状态和重试依赖，再将所得加权工具组合图聚类为环境。仅对会修改状态的环境合成数据库，查询和无状态工具则回放记录的返回值。随后，ToolSpace 执行带回滚的状态感知随机游走，将每条链反编译为带断言检查的自然语言任务，只保留从初始状态成功回放的样本。应用于 AutomationBench 和 tau3-Bench Banking 时，该流水线产生更困难的 Pro 版本，使七个前沿模型最多下降 38.2 个点。在七个长时程工具使用基准上，ToolSpace 将 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的平均分从 23.0 提高到 41.0（结合 RL 为 43.2），将 GLM-5.2 从 44.6 提高到 56.6，与 Claude Opus 5 相当。消融表明，有执行见证的边明显优于 LLM 判断的边，性能随数据和环境规模持续改善。

2611.05139.title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
2611.05139.authors: Lingzhi Yuan , Yiguang Cai , Weize Liu , Siqi Yang , Feijiang Han , Yongkyun Lee , Udari Madhushani Sehwag , Furong Huang
2611.05139.abstract_en: Harness optimization improves long-horizon agents by refining the prompts, tools, memory, and hooks around a frozen model. Offline methods can learn from completed trajectories, but deploy one shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot react to evidence revealed during a new run. Online evolution can adapt before, during, or after one run through an evolver, but may have to reason about every intervention from scratch or rely on verifier feedback that is usually unavailable at test time. We introduce Meta$^2$, which moves offline optimization one level up: rather than optimizing a shared harness, it learns reusable knowledge for harness evolution and applies it within each task online. Offline, Meta$^2$ learns a textual Meta-Skill $M$ by contrasting training rollouts of the same task agent under three configurations: without an evolver, with an evolver guided by the current version of $M$, and with an evolver given privileged verifier information available only in training. Contrasts in trajectories and outcomes are aggregated across tasks to refine $M$ into reusable guidance on when and how to evolve, when to leave the harness unchanged, and which interventions to avoid. Online, an evolver combines the frozen $M$ with emerging trajectory evidence to decide whether to KEEP the harness unchanged or EVOLVE it through a task-local edit. Each edit applies to the rest of the same run without resetting its environment or progress. Thus, evolution guidance transfers across tasks while harness edits remain task-local, and held-out verifier feedback is never available to the evolver. On two long-horizon benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1, Meta$^2$ achieves the highest performance among evaluated methods with GPT-5.6-Terra, reaching 81.00% and 44.44%, respectively. Ablations support the value of contrastive evolution guidance and keeping online harness edits task-local.
2611.05139.affiliation: University of Maryland / University of Washington / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Scale AI / All Purpose AI
2611.05139.update_target: Offline textual evolution guidance; online task-local harness edits
2611.05139.mechanism_en: Three-way rollout contrasts refine a reusable Meta-Skill offline, including privileged verifier access only during training. Online, frozen guidance and emerging evidence trigger KEEP/EVOLVE; edits affect the remaining same run without resetting progress.
2611.05139.result_en: With GPT-5.6-Terra, Meta² reaches 81.00% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 44.44% on DeepSWE 1.1, highest among compared methods; ablations support contrastive guidance and task-local edits.
2611.05139.boundary_en: Guidance transfers across tasks, but online edits deliberately do not persist across tasks. Test-time verifier feedback is unavailable; this is not an online accumulating global-harness loop.
2611.05139.abstract_zh: 运行框架优化通过改进冻结模型周围的提示词、工具、记忆和钩子提升长时程 Agent。离线方法能从完整轨迹学习，却部署一个共享框架，可能过拟合训练任务，也无法响应新运行中显露的证据。在线演化可通过演化器在一次运行之前、期间或之后适应，但可能需从头推理每次干预，或依赖测试时通常不可用的验证器反馈。我们提出 Meta²，将离线优化提高一个层级：不优化共享运行框架，而是学习可复用的运行框架演化知识，并在每个任务内在线应用。离线时，Meta² 通过对比同一任务 Agent 在三种配置下的训练 rollout，学习文本元技能 M：无演化器、由当前 M 指导演化器、以及向演化器提供仅训练可用的特权验证信息。跨任务汇总轨迹与结果对比，将 M 优化为何时及如何演化、何时保持框架不变、哪些干预应避免的可复用指导。在线时，演化器将冻结的 M 与新出现的轨迹证据结合，决定 KEEP 保持框架不变，或 EVOLVE 通过任务局部编辑演化。每次编辑用于同一运行的余下部分，不重置环境或进度。因此，演化指导跨任务迁移，而运行框架编辑保持任务局部，演化器从不获得留出验证器反馈。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 DeepSWE 1.1 两个长时程基准上，Meta² 使用 GPT-5.6-Terra 分别达到 81.00% 和 44.44%，在评估方法中最高。消融支持对比式演化指导及保持在线编辑任务局部的价值。
2611.05139.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; original formatting and link placeholders remain in English.
2611.05139.image_caption: Figure 1 : Motivation and overview of Meta 2 . Offline evolution produces a shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot adapt to evidence revealed during a new run, while online methods face limitations in intervention timing, knowledge guidance, and verifier availability. By moving offline optimization one level up, Meta 2 learns a reusable Meta-Skill from contrastive training rollouts and freezes it to guide task-local harness evolution at checkpoints online, without access to verifier feedback at test-time. Across both evaluated benchmarks, this design yields the highest performance among the compared methods.

2611.05158.title: Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
2611.05158.authors: Zijun Huang , Yingjun Du , Cees G. M. Snoek
2611.05158.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.05158.abstract_en: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.
2611.05158.affiliation: University of Southern California / University of Amsterdam
2611.05158.update_target: Shared multimodal backbone weights for mutation, verification and repair
2611.05158.mechanism_en: Known-correct image/caption pairs seed typed perturbations; verifier feedback guides repairs and a second verification. Structured rewards train role-conditioned behaviors sharing the same evolving parameters.
2611.05158.result_en: Fine-grained compositional verification improves across model scales/families; broader multimodal-task changes are limited and benchmark-dependent.
2611.05158.boundary_en: This is explicit verifier/self-play weight learning with known-correct seeds, not an independent truth oracle. Shared parameters can couple judge and proposer errors.
2611.05158.abstract_zh: 视觉语言验证器判断图像是否忠实匹配文本描述，但现有训练流水线通常依赖更强外部裁判或精心构造困难负例提供的静态监督。这类监督需要外部生成或标注，受教师能力限制，也难随模型失败演化而适应。我们提出 PROVE（Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation），一个通过扰动—验证—修复—验证闭环训练验证器的自博弈框架。从已知正确的图像—描述对出发，Mutator 对物体、属性、计数或关系引入类型化扰动。验证器随后判断扰动描述并提供文本反馈，Repairer 用其恢复忠实描述，再次验证。这两轮验证为有信息量的不匹配和以视觉为依据的修复产生结构化奖励。由于扰动、验证和修复都是同一演化多模态骨干的角色条件行为，更新共享参数也会改进验证器本身。实验表明，PROVE 在不同模型规模和家族上提升细粒度组合验证，并增强参考骨干对视觉细节的鲁棒性，而在更广泛多模态任务上的变化有限且依赖基准。
