2611.05313.title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
2611.05313.authors: Dian Jin , Jinluan Yang , Kairong Han , Baohong Li , Zijing Hu , Yi He , Wenlin Zhong , Yunze Tong , Minqin Zhu , Linchuan Li , Yanan Niu , Kun Kuang
2611.05313.abstract_en: Skill memories encode past experiences as textual prompts to improve reinforcement learning (RL) for self-evolving agents. Complementing RL, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) provides dense, fine-grained supervision to internalize knowledge from skill-guided trajectories and accelerate policy learning. However, self-generated memories often contain noisy supervision and functionally entangled, redundant, or conflicting knowledge, making direct distillation difficult. Under limited training budgets, these issues can hinder knowledge internalization and even degrade performance. To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization. MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches. OPSD then transfers and consolidates complementary experiential knowledge across these branches into a shared policy, enabling efficient skill internalization and continuous agent self-evolution. We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models. Without additional computational overhead, MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop. Extensive ablations and evolution analyses further validate its effectiveness in knowledge internalization and policy improvement. The code is available at this https URL .
2611.05313.update_target: Shared policy weights internalizing evolving textual skill memory
2611.05313.mechanism_en: Dynamic skill-quality selection builds grounding/planning/control views and integrated branches; OPSD consolidates their experiential supervision into one policy rather than directly distilling noisy memory.
2611.05313.result_en: On three agent benchmarks without a stronger external teacher, the abstract reports up to 7.1% and 8.1% improvement over SOTA on ALFWorld/WebShop without added computational overhead.
2611.05313.boundary_en: The stated percent gains are preserved rather than reinterpreted as points. Compute equivalence and dynamic selection are author-reported; memory organization and policy learning are separate update objects.
2611.05313.abstract_zh: 技能记忆把过去经验编码为文本提示，以改善自演化 Agent 的强化学习（RL）。作为 RL 补充，在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）提供密集、细粒度监督，将技能指导轨迹中的知识内化并加速策略学习。然而，自生成记忆往往包含噪声监督，以及功能纠缠、冗余或冲突的知识，难以直接蒸馏。在有限训练预算下，这些问题会阻碍知识内化，甚至损害表现。为此，我们提出 MDSKILL，一种技能记忆内化的多视图蒸馏方法。MDSKILL 将技能记忆组织为三种互补功能视图（状态依据、动作规划和执行控制），使用动态指标选择高质量技能，以构建视图专属和综合推理分支。随后 OPSD 将这些分支中的互补经验知识迁移并整合进共享策略，实现高效技能内化与持续 Agent 自演化。我们在三个 Agent 基准上，将 MDSKILL 与不依赖更强外部教师模型的 RL、技能增强和自蒸馏基线比较。无需额外计算开销，MDSKILL 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上相对 SOTA 分别最多提高 7.1% 和 8.1%。广泛消融与演化分析进一步验证了其知识内化和策略改进有效性。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.03713.title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
2611.03713.authors: Ethan Ji , Wei Wang , Yizhou Sun
2611.03713.abstract_en: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with hidden states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. The agent buys experiments within a budget, writes candidate programs in the same language, obtains their coefficients from the benchmark's fitter, and is scored only on how its final program predicts experiments it never saw: conditions outside the range it could explore, interventions, and longer runs. Across 80 systems in 20 domains, nine language models solve between 21% and 60%. On 44 of these systems, classical equation-discovery methods almost never succeed, although the same data usually suffice once the true equations are given with unknown coefficients; the difficulty lies in finding the structure, not in estimating it. Because mechanisms recur across systems, we also give agents the program they discovered for a related system; it helped only when the new system shared the mechanism and the first investigation had succeeded. Stronger agents make fewer unscientific errors; beyond these, agents find which variables a system has but not how they act, and prefer revisions that lower the training error to revisions that predict better.
2611.03713.update_target: Structure-discovery evaluation and transfer of previously discovered programs
2611.03713.mechanism_en: Agents buy experiments, propose executable model structures and fit coefficients; held-out extrapolation/interventions/longer runs score discovery. A related-system program is supplied to test mechanism reuse.
2611.03713.result_en: Nine models solve 21–60% of 80 simulated systems; prior discoveries help only when the mechanism matches and the earlier investigation succeeded.
2611.03713.boundary_en: These are private-seed simulations with a benchmark fitter. Lower training error is not better predictive structure, and a prior program is useful only under tested transfer conditions.
2611.03713.abstract_zh: 在科学家拟合任何参数之前，必须先决定模型包含什么：哪些量存在，哪些隐藏，它们如何相互作用，以及如何测量。物理学家将这种试探形式称为 ansatz。自动方程发现基准大多通过固定变量、候选项库或待修改定律来提供它。我们提出 Unsatz，一个要求 LLM Agent 自行构建 ansatz 的基准。每个任务是由私有随机种子生成的模拟系统，以小型建模语言的程序表达：常微分、时滞或偏微分方程，离散映射，静态和因果模型，或随机过程，可能含隐藏状态、失真传感器和无信息测量通道。Agent 在预算内购买实验，用同一语言编写候选程序，从基准拟合器获得系数，且仅按最终程序预测未见实验的能力评分：包括超出可探索范围的条件、干预和更长运行。在 20 个领域的 80 个系统上，九个语言模型解决 21% 至 60%。其中 44 个系统上，经典方程发现方法几乎从不成功，但一旦给定真实方程、仅系数未知，同样数据通常已足够；困难在于发现结构，而非估计参数。由于机制跨系统重复，我们也给 Agent 一个先前在相关系统中发现的程序；只有新系统共享机制且先前研究成功时，它才有帮助。更强 Agent 犯更少非科学错误；除此之外，Agent 能发现系统有哪些变量，却不清楚它们如何作用，并偏好降低训练误差的修订，而非预测更好的修订。

2611.03754.title: The Web Doesn't Sit Still: Adversarial Self-Evolving Attacks on Search Agents
2611.03754.authors: Geyuan Wang , Shunyu Liu , Siyuan Liang , Chenyang Lyu , Dacheng Tao
2611.03754.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for empowering search agents to tackle complex information-seeking tasks. However, since acquiring external information necessitates web search, these agents are highly susceptible to various adversarial attacks (e.g., malicious information injection or stealthy context manipulation). Existing attack strategies inevitably rely on static and human-crafted templates, failing to emulate the dynamic and complex nature of real-world threats. In this paper, we propose an adversarial self-evolution framework that integrates bi-level optimization between the attacker's strategy evolution and the defender's adaptive mitigation, to expose the vulnerabilities of search agents. Specifically, we introduce the Contrastive Rollout Evolutionary Optimization (CREO) method to drive the directional evolution of the attack strategy population via contrastive evolutionary signals. To provide a stable environment for this continuous evolution, we further construct a controlled sandbox and design fine-grained metrics to quantify internal vulnerabilities. Extensive experiments across various multi-hop QA benchmarks and frontier LLMs demonstrate that the proposed framework yields attack efficacy superior to static baselines, underscoring the urgent need to develop more robust defense frameworks.
2611.03754.update_target: Evolving adversarial strategy populations and adaptive search-agent mitigation
2611.03754.mechanism_en: Bi-level attacker/defender optimization and contrastive rollout signals guide population evolution; a controlled sandbox and fine-grained vulnerability metrics support repeated assessment.
2611.03754.result_en: The abstract reports stronger attack efficacy than static baselines across multi-hop QA benchmarks/frontier models, without an aggregate numerical effect.
2611.03754.boundary_en: This is a controlled security co-evolution study. Stronger attacks do not establish robust defense or general self-improvement outside the evaluated sandbox.
2611.03754.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在赋能搜索 Agent 处理复杂信息查找任务方面展现潜力。然而，由于获取外部信息需要网页搜索，这些 Agent 很容易遭受各类对抗攻击，例如恶意信息注入或隐蔽上下文操纵。现有攻击策略不可避免地依赖静态人工模板，无法模拟真实威胁的动态复杂性。本文提出一种对抗自演化框架，将攻击者策略演化与防御者自适应缓解之间的双层优化结合，以暴露搜索 Agent 漏洞。具体而言，我们引入 Contrastive Rollout Evolutionary Optimization（CREO），通过对比演化信号驱动攻击策略群体的定向演化。为给持续演化提供稳定环境，我们进一步构建受控沙箱，并设计细粒度指标量化内部漏洞。在多种多跳问答基准和前沿 LLM 上的广泛实验表明，该框架的攻击效力优于静态基线，强调了开发更稳健防御框架的迫切性。

Top Right: CREO drives directional mutation and crossover recombination of the attack strategy population via contrastive evolution signals. Bottom: The controlled sandbox ensures noise-free trace capture, while fine-grained metrics (Acc, ASR, APR) quantify the agent’s internal cognitive vulnerabilities.

2611.03772.title: RuntimeTickets: Source-Grounded Security Obligations for Agent Skills
2611.03772.authors: Kuiyi Gao , Xue Liu , Bowei He
2611.03772.abstract_en: Third-party Agent Skills extend what an autonomous agent can do, but a malicious Skill can hide data exposure or output manipulation inside a legitimate workflow. Neither reading a Skill's description nor granting it tool permissions tells whether its execution meets the user's security requirements. We introduce RuntimeTickets, a protocol that enforces and audits these requirements while a Skill runs. From released malicious-Skill datasets we derive a risk model and build adversarial-benign Skill pairs. From the task's delivery contract, a language model proposes security obligations for that task. Each obligation cites the Skill lines it answers, and the ticket tightens the host's approvals into fine-grained allowed actions but never loosens them. A runtime gate checks the recipient, object and amount of every outbound send before forwarding it, and trusted monitors record the effects within their observation scope. The ticket links these checks and observations to the approved obligations of each Skill run, and a deterministic decoder turns the ticket's status into governable data flows and verifies each obligation. Neither enforcement nor decoding involves a language model, so text injected by a Skill can change the proposal but never the rule that decides a send. We evaluate RuntimeTickets at the network egress boundary of three unmodified agent frameworks against production Skill scanners and runtime baselines, among them an AgentBound-derived allow-list and SkillGuard. RuntimeTickets eliminated both failure modes of current Skill defenses, overlook (malicious Skills let through) and overkill (benign Skills blocked): its overlook rate was 0.0% and its overkill rate 0.0%, while the scanners erred on both sides. RuntimeTickets ties approved requirements to verifiable execution evidence and offers a common foundation for the safe and auditable deployment of third-party Skills.
2611.03772.affiliation: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill / Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence / McGill University
2611.03772.update_target: Runtime security obligations and deterministic evidence for mutable Skills
2611.03772.mechanism_en: An LLM proposes source-cited obligations from the delivery contract; tickets may tighten but never relax host approvals. Deterministic egress checks and trusted monitors produce auditable per-run evidence.
2611.03772.result_en: At three unmodified frameworks' network-egress boundaries, the tested paired dataset yields 0.0% overlook and 0.0% overkill, outperforming compared scanners/runtime baselines.
2611.03772.boundary_en: Zero errors apply to the evaluated boundary/dataset, not universal Skill safety. Monitor scope, approved obligations and trusted runtime enforcement constrain the guarantee.
2611.03772.abstract_zh: 第三方 Agent Skills 扩展自主 Agent 的能力，但恶意 Skill 可在合法工作流内隐藏数据泄露或输出操纵。仅阅读 Skill 描述或授予工具权限，都无法说明执行是否满足用户安全要求。我们提出 RuntimeTickets，一个在 Skill 运行时强制执行并审计这些要求的协议。我们从已发布恶意 Skill 数据集推导风险模型，并构造对抗—良性 Skill 对。语言模型根据任务交付契约提出该任务的安全义务。每项义务引用其回应的 Skill 行，ticket 将宿主批准收紧为细粒度允许动作，但绝不放宽。运行时门在转发每次出站发送前，检查收件方、对象和数量，可信监控器记录其观测范围内的效果。Ticket 将这些检查和观测链接到每次 Skill 运行获批的义务，确定性解码器将 ticket 状态转为可治理数据流，并验证每项义务。强制执行和解码均不涉及语言模型，因此 Skill 注入的文本可改变提案，却不能改变决定发送的规则。我们在三个未经修改 Agent 框架的网络出口边界上，将 RuntimeTickets 与生产级 Skill 扫描器及运行时基线比较，包括源自 AgentBound 的允许列表和 SkillGuard。RuntimeTickets 在评估中消除了现有 Skill 防御的两类失败——放过恶意 Skill 的 overlook 和阻止良性 Skill 的 overkill：两者均为 0.0%，而扫描器两侧都犯错。RuntimeTickets 将获批要求与可验证执行证据相连，为安全、可审计部署第三方 Skills 提供共同基础。

2611.03930.title: What Is This Memory Useful For? Measuring Task-Conditioned Utility in Long-Term Agent Memory
2611.03930.authors: Chih-Hsuan Yang , Anjir Ahmed Chowdhury , Feng Yan , Rajeev Thakur
2611.03930.abstract_en: A stored experience may answer one future question and offer little help with another. We measure this task-conditioned utility rather than assigning each memory a single importance score. A task-blind writer stores a memory without seeing the later task; a frozen reader then answers that task with and without the memory, using identical filler. A cost ledger records the resources used to form, store and expose the memory. On single-call factual-recall tasks built from LongMemEval-V2 web-agent memories, the same memory helps more when it contains information needed for the answer. Its mean paired reward gain on these answer-bearing task pairs exceeds that on matched-control pairs by $+0.33$ (95% interval $+0.21$ to $+0.46$). The tested task-blind summaries and structured records yield smaller gains than Raw, including at fixed total context; a budget sweep is consistent with retention of answer-bearing content contributing to the difference. The bearing--control contrast remains positive in a new session with randomized memory position and under a second reader, although individual memory--task labels change. Generic retrieval performs above chance but misses most screen-defined answer-bearing memories. The factual-recall gains do not extend to the tested software-engineering and scientific-coding benchmarks, where even raw memories have no measurable effect. We provide a public, versioned Conditional Memory Utility Dataset of paired measurements and costs. The practical takeaway is to evaluate memory compression by the task utility it preserves alongside its costs. Task-conditioned measurements make this comparison possible; their stability must also be checked.
2611.03930.affiliation: Argonne National Laboratory / University of Houston
2611.03930.update_target: Task-conditioned paired utility and full memory-cost measurement
2611.03930.mechanism_en: A task-blind writer stores experience; a frozen reader answers with/without memory under identical filler. Paired contrasts, randomized-position repeats, a second reader and a formation/storage/exposure ledger test utility and stability.
2611.03930.result_en: Answer-bearing factual-recall pairs exceed matched controls by +0.33 reward (95% interval +0.21 to +0.46). Tested summaries underperform Raw; raw memories show no measurable effect on tested SE/scientific-coding tasks.
2611.03930.boundary_en: Utility depends on memory–task–reader pairing. Factual recall gains do not demonstrate cross-domain procedural learning, and labels can change across readers/sessions.
2611.03930.abstract_zh: 一段存储经验可能回答一个未来问题，却对另一个帮助很小。我们测量这种任务条件效用，而非给每条记忆一个单一重要性分数。任务盲写入器在不知道后续任务时保存记忆；冻结读取器随后在相同填充内容下，分别使用和不使用记忆回答该任务。成本账本记录形成、存储和展示记忆所用资源。在基于 LongMemEval-V2 网页 Agent 记忆构建的单调用事实回忆任务上，记忆包含答案所需信息时帮助更大。其在携带答案的任务对上的平均配对奖励收益，比匹配对照对高 +0.33（95% 区间 +0.21 至 +0.46）。被测试的任务盲摘要和结构化记录收益小于 Raw，即便总上下文固定也是如此；预算扫描与答案信息保留对这一差异有贡献的解释一致。在随机化记忆位置的新会话及第二个读取器下，携带答案—对照差仍为正，但单个记忆—任务标签会变化。通用检索优于随机，却漏掉大多数按筛查定义的答案记忆。事实回忆收益未延伸到所测试的软件工程和科学编码基准，其中即使原始记忆也没有可测效应。我们提供公开、版本化的 Conditional Memory Utility Dataset，包含配对测量与成本。实践要点是同时按保留的任务效用及其成本评估记忆压缩。任务条件测量使这种比较可行，也必须检查其稳定性。

2611.04192.title: Where Did the Update Go? Certifying Declared Change Envelopes for Model Updates
2611.04192.abstract_en: Deployed language models are updated continually, and regulators increasingly accept changes that were declared in advance. Showing that an update changed behavior only where it was declared to is a different statistical problem from bounding how much it changed: a useful update is meant to change some decisions, so global disagreement and regression bounds cannot certify it. We formalize the problem with declared change envelopes. Before training, the developer commits to a region of inputs, and every decision that changes outside it counts as leakage. Leakage compares two models, so it can be certified from unlabeled traffic with anytime-valid tests whose sample cost we bound from above and below, and per-update certificates compose into a bound on lifetime drift outside all declared scopes. We measure leakage for LoRA and full fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and knowledge editing on models from 1.5B to 72B parameters. Narrow updates leak widely: domain and policy LoRA updates keep only about 7-36% of the decisions they change inside the declared scope. Across 256 trained variants, leakage tracks the update's KL divergence to the incumbent on out-of-scope inputs (Spearman 0.94). None of the customary remedies we tested makes a rule-like update certifiable without giving up much of its intended change. Distilling the incumbent's decisions on unlabeled prompts in the deployment format does: anchored LoRA, GRPO, and (at a small learning rate) full fine-tuning updates certify 5% leakage from a few hundred to a few thousand unlabeled samples, and the certificates replicate on held-out traffic and on written answers. The certificates cover decision-like outputs only; on open-ended chat, re-batching alone changes 11-21% of responses and no update certifies. Code: this https URL
2611.04192.update_target: Declared out-of-scope model-update leakage and anchoring controls
2611.04192.mechanism_en: Developers predeclare an input scope; changed decisions outside it count as leakage. Anytime-valid tests on unlabeled traffic yield composable certificates, while incumbent-decision distillation anchors updates.
2611.04192.result_en: Domain/policy LoRA keeps only about 7–36% of changed decisions in scope; leakage correlates with out-of-scope KL at 0.94 across 256 variants. Anchored methods certify 5% leakage with hundreds/thousands of samples.
2611.04192.boundary_en: Certificates cover decision-like outputs and declared traffic assumptions. Open-ended chat has 11–21% re-batching response change and no update certifies; this is not a universal semantic-change guarantee.
2611.04192.abstract_zh: 已部署语言模型持续更新，监管者也越来越多地接受事先声明的变化。证明更新只在声明位置改变行为，与界定变化总量是不同统计问题：有用更新本就要改变部分决策，因此全局分歧与回退界无法认证它。我们用声明变更包络形式化该问题。训练前，开发者承诺一个输入区域，区域之外每个改变的决策都计为泄漏。泄漏比较两个模型，因此可从无标签流量通过任意时刻有效检验认证，我们给出样本成本上下界，且每更新证书可组合为所有声明范围之外的终身漂移界。我们在 1.5B 至 72B 模型的 LoRA、全量微调、偏好优化、强化学习及知识编辑上测量泄漏。狭窄更新广泛外泄：领域和政策 LoRA 更新所改变决策中，仅约 7–36% 位于声明范围。跨 256 个训练变体，泄漏随更新相对现用模型在范围外输入上的 KL 散度变化（Spearman 0.94）。被测试的常见补救措施，没有一种能在不放弃大量预期变化的前提下，使类似规则的更新可认证。将现用模型在部署格式无标签提示上的决策蒸馏则可以：锚定的 LoRA、GRPO 和小学习率全量微调更新，用数百至数千无标签样本即可认证 5% 泄漏，证书也在留出流量及书面答案上复现。证书仅覆盖类似决策的输出；开放聊天中，仅重新组批就改变 11–21% 响应，没有更新可认证。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.04268.title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
2611.04268.abstract_en: Can an LLM directly edit the weights of a diffusion-based image-restoration model to \emph{improve} restoration quality---without gradients, paired data, or fine-tuning? Recent experiments show frontier LLMs can fix structural bugs by modifying as little as \(0.016\%\) of parameters, but cannot instill new capabilities. We ask whether weight-space programming (WSP) can move from \emph{debugging} to \emph{improvement} in the precise-regression setting of image restoration (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting). Restoration diffusion UNets present a middle ground: low-level signal-processing layers are concentrated enough for targeted weight-direction edits, while high-level semantic layers remain distributed and resistant to sparse modification. We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.
2611.04268.image_note: The inspected eight-page conjectural paper contains three numbered tables but no numbered figures; an explicit placeholder is retained.
2611.04268.update_target: Proposed targeted restoration-model weight edits and diagnose/edit/evaluate loop
2611.04268.mechanism_en: The manuscript conjectures that an LLM can localize a quality gap, edit selected weight directions and re-diagnose after evaluation; it outlines a PyTorch-style pipeline and benchmark.
2611.04268.result_en: Three technical conjectures include localization within 200 forward passes and compounding gains; this manuscript does not report those conjectures as demonstrated results.
2611.04268.boundary_en: Explicitly conjectural. The cited 0.016% structural-bug edit is prior-work motivation, not evidence that this proposed loop already improves diffusion restoration or generates new capabilities.
2611.04268.abstract_zh: LLM 能否直接编辑基于扩散的图像恢复模型权重，在没有梯度、配对数据或微调时提高恢复质量？近期实验显示，前沿 LLM 只修改 0.016% 参数就能修复结构缺陷，却无法注入新能力。我们询问，权重空间编程（WSP）能否在图像恢复（去模糊、超分辨率、去噪、修补）这一精密回归场景中，从调试走向改进。恢复扩散 UNet 提供中间地带：低级信号处理层足够集中，适合定向权重方向编辑；高级语义层则分布式且难以稀疏修改。我们提出三项技术猜想：（C1）LLM 可在 200 次前向预算内定位质量缺口（过平滑、色偏、幻觉纹理）背后的层；（C2）编辑少量已识别权重方向，例如缩放高频滤波器范数或纠正输出偏置通道，可可测地提高 PSNR 和感知质量；（C3）诊断→编辑→评估→重新诊断的递归循环可跨轮累积收益，形成视觉的最小 RSI 循环。我们分析所需 AI 能力，认为定向编辑不必依赖超级智能，而通用能力生成需要，并详述精确像素级回归的挑战。我们提供 PyTorch 风格部署流水线并概述基准。本稿是猜想性研究，旨在为图像恢复开启新子方向。

2611.04299.title: Can Benign Skills Induce Misaligned Behavior in LLM Agents?
2611.04299.authors: Xuanye Zhang , Yongsen Zheng , Kaiyu Zhou , Bowen Shen , Haoran Ou , Zhuqin Xu , Tianwei Zhang , Kwok-Yan Lam
2611.04299.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to plan tasks, invoke tools, recover from errors, and complete workflows without modifying model parameters. Although these skills are typically developed to enhance benign tasks, they may also make an agent more capable of executing procedures for harmful purposes. We study this risk, which we call skill-induced behavioral misalignment: adding benign skills may cause an agent to execute external actions that violate safety requirements. We first conduct a systematic study to validate the existence of this phenomenon. It compares agents with and without benign skills across five LLM backbones and three benchmarks under matched requests. On average, skill augmentation improves benign task accuracy by 10.3 percentage points (pp), but also increases unsafe action rate (UAR) by 10.3 pp. The regression also occurs with skills curated by experts. A paired trajectory analysis shows that 24 of 50 newly unsafe trajectories fail to complete the harmful objective, revealing violations that task completion alone would miss. We further disclose multiple factors and scenarios that could exacerbate this risk. (1) Evolving skills with benign feedback can amplify unsafe execution; (2) This regression is more pronounced when retrieved skills are matched to task and contain procedural guidance; (3) Distilling benign experience into reusable skills yield higher UAR compared with their source trajectories. (4) A guard that checks proposed tool actions before execution reduces violations while retaining gains on benign tasks. All these findings confirm the significance of skill-induced behavioral misalignment, and the urgent need for new mitigation solutions.
2611.04299.update_target: Safety regression testing of benign skill addition, evolution and distillation
2611.04299.mechanism_en: Matched requests compare skill/no-skill agents; paired traces expose unsafe external actions. Further conditions evolve benign-feedback skills, distill experience and gate actions before execution.
2611.04299.result_en: Across five backbones/three benchmarks, benign accuracy and unsafe action rate both increase 10.3 percentage points on average; 24/50 newly unsafe traces do not complete the harmful objective.
2611.04299.boundary_en: Benign skill content or better completion cannot certify safe behavior. Findings are threat/evaluation-specific; the action guard reduces tested violations, not every possible misuse.
2611.04299.abstract_zh: LLM Agent 越来越依靠可复用技能规划任务、调用工具、从错误恢复并完成工作流，而无需修改模型参数。虽然这些技能通常用于增强良性任务，也可能让 Agent 更擅长为有害目的执行流程。我们研究这一风险，称为技能诱发行为失配：添加良性技能可能导致 Agent 执行违反安全要求的外部动作。我们首先通过系统研究验证该现象，在匹配请求下，跨五个 LLM 骨干和三个基准比较有无良性技能的 Agent。平均而言，技能增强将良性任务准确率提高 10.3 个百分点，同时将不安全动作率（UAR）提高 10.3 个百分点。专家整理的技能也出现此回退。配对轨迹分析显示，50 条新出现的不安全轨迹中有 24 条未完成有害目标，揭示仅看任务完成会遗漏的违规。我们进一步揭示多种加剧风险的因素和场景：（1）以良性反馈演化技能可放大不安全执行；（2）检索技能与任务匹配且包含程序性指导时回退更明显；（3）将良性经验蒸馏为可复用技能，比源轨迹产生更高 UAR；（4）执行前检查拟议工具动作的护栏可减少违规，同时保留良性任务收益。这些发现确认技能诱发行为失配的重要性及新缓解方案的迫切性。

2611.04399.title: Silent Instrument Errors Reorder Agent Leaderboards
2611.04399.abstract_en: On a public agent leaderboard, a general-purpose agent trails a scaffold built for an airline customer-service benchmark by 13 points on the tasks that touch its database, and a reader could conclude that generality costs accuracy. The gap comes from the grader. The general agent often ends its conversations in a way that never triggers grading, so only about half of its episodes were scored and the rest were stored as failures. Grading the ungraded half under the benchmark's own rule closes the pooled gap, without rerunning any agent. We audit two carefully maintained public leaderboards, HAL and tau2-bench, from their published artifacts alone and find three more instrument errors. A cost column counts nested model calls twice, unevenly across rows. Archived trajectories record grader-written actions as agent actions. Re-grading saved trajectories under a newer evaluator is itself a new measurement: a correct and announced fix reorders a leaderboard, and a mode check that misreads four files collapses their scores by 59 to 82 points while printing no error. Each produced a plausible number, and the HAL maintainers confirmed their three within five weeks. Together the cases show that the infrastructure of agent evaluation, meaning the code that grades, logs, replays and versions an evaluation, is part of the measurement and fails silently, so scores and orderings can move with no visible sign. These failure modes follow from how agent evaluation pipelines are built, and those pipelines change as fast as the agents they measure, so we expect more of them elsewhere. We propose cheap checks that expose the instrument: report the graded fraction, aggregate cost from root spans, tag the provenance of every recorded action, and pin evaluator versions with a published re-grade diff.
2611.04399.update_target: Evaluation grader, cost accounting, action provenance and replay versions
2611.04399.mechanism_en: Published leaderboard artifacts are audited without rerunning agents; re-grading ungraded trajectories, root-span cost accounting, action-source tags and pinned evaluator/re-grade diffs expose instrument failures.
2611.04399.result_en: Grading an ungraded half closes a 13-point pooled gap; other cases include double-counted costs and a four-file mode error causing 59–82-point collapses. The abstract says maintainers confirmed three HAL issues.
2611.04399.boundary_en: These are artifact-based audits, not independent agent reruns. Correct evaluator changes can legitimately reorder scores, so versions and measurement provenance must accompany evolution claims.
2611.04399.abstract_zh: 在公开 Agent 榜单上，一个通用 Agent 在涉及数据库的航空客服基准任务中，落后专用框架 13 个点，读者可能据此认为通用性损害准确率。差距来自评分器。通用 Agent 常以不触发评分的方式结束对话，因此只有约一半事件被评分，其余被存为失败。无需重跑任何 Agent，按基准自身规则给未评分一半评分，就能消除汇总差距。我们仅从发布产物审计两个精心维护的公开榜单 HAL 和 tau2-bench，又发现三种仪器错误：成本列对嵌套模型调用重复计数，且各行不均；归档轨迹将评分器写入动作记录为 Agent 动作；用新版评估器重评保存轨迹，本身就是一次新测量——一次正确且已公告的修复重排榜单，而一个误读四个文件的模式检查使分数下降 59 至 82 个点，却不打印错误。每个问题都产生看似合理的数字，HAL 维护者在五周内确认了其中三个。案例共同表明，Agent 评估基础设施，即评分、日志、回放和版本控制代码，是测量的一部分，并会静默失败，因此分数和排序可在无明显迹象时变化。这些失败模式源于评估流水线的构建方式，而流水线与所测 Agent 同样快速变化，因此我们预计别处还有更多问题。我们提出低成本检查来暴露仪器：报告实际评分比例，从根 span 汇总成本，标记每个记录动作的来源，并固定评估器版本及发布重评差异。

2611.04420.title: Verifier strength does not buy discovery quality: a pre-registered two-domain test of LLM-based automated research, with post-hoc evidence pointing to proposer-pool composition
2611.04420.authors: Peter Chen , Ni Zhang , Siyuan Zhang
2611.04420.abstract_en: Automated research pipelines pair an LLM proposer with a verifier on an implicit bet: discovery quality rises with verification strength. Under a pre-registered protocol we test this bet in two real-data domains -- job-shop scheduling and vehicular edge offloading on Beijing T-Drive trajectories -- across 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and three verifier tiers. The manipulation binds -- a 429-case mutation battery shows scores rising across tiers -- yet the paired LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with it (A, one-sided p=0.1115; D, p=0.9994), and in D shrinks under the strict tier (margin contrast -0.040, p=0.0013). The two lower gates promote identical candidates in 100/100 and 99/100 pairs, so the strict order is untestable when they coincide. Constructively, LLM proposals carry a real paired advantage over random controls, but a post-hoc union-pool analysis shows the fastest path to better discovery is widening the pool, not tightening the gate: mixing the two pools adds +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A (one-sided Wilcoxon, n=100, p=0.0002) -- evidence that pool composition, not verification strength, is the lever. Criteria, ledgers and scripts are archived on Zenodo (DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23308866 ).
2611.04420.update_target: Verifier-tier strength and proposal-pool composition in automated research
2611.04420.mechanism_en: A preregistered two-domain design uses 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and a 429-case mutation battery to check that verifier strength changes. A separate post-hoc union-pool analysis tests proposal diversity.
2611.04420.result_en: The LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with verifier tiers (p=0.1115/0.9994); the strict tier shrinks the margin in domain D. Mixed pools add +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A post hoc.
2611.04420.boundary_en: The lower gates often promote identical candidates, limiting strict-order tests. The pool-composition result is post hoc; the study does not show that verification is useless.
2611.04420.abstract_zh: 自动研究流水线将 LLM 提案者与验证器配对，隐含押注发现质量随验证强度提高。我们依照预注册协议，在两个真实数据领域——作业车间调度和基于北京 T-Drive 轨迹的车载边缘卸载——中，每个领域以 100 对匹配的 LLM／随机提案和三个验证器等级检验这一押注。操纵确实生效：429 案例变异测试组显示评分跨等级提高；但 LLM 相对随机的配对优势不随之扩大（A，单侧 p=0.1115；D，p=0.9994），且在 D 中严格等级下缩小（差值对比 −0.040，p=0.0013）。两个较低门在 100/100 和 99/100 对中晋升相同候选，因此当它们重合时无法检验严格顺序。建设性地看，LLM 提案对随机对照有真实配对优势，但事后合并池分析表明，更好发现的最快路径是扩大池，而非收紧门：混合两个池在领域 A 增加 +1.52 个留出价值单位（单侧 Wilcoxon，n=100，p=0.0002），为池组成而非验证强度是杠杆提供证据。标准、账本和脚本归档在 Zenodo，DOI：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23308866。

2611.04456.title: How Agent Skills Evolve: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Skills on GitHub
2611.04456.authors: Jinjun Huang , Jialun Cao , Junxiao Han , Zhonghao Jiang , Shing-Chi Cheung , Zhongxin Liu
2611.04456.abstract_en: Large language model-based agents increasingly rely on external skills to reuse task-specific knowledge without retraining the model. As skills become common for extending agent capabilities, understanding creation and evolution is critical for reliable agent systems. However, existing studies mainly examine agent skills from a static perspective, leaving their evolution in real-world repositories largely unexplored. This limits our understanding of the patterns and motivations behind skill changes. To fill this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of agent skills, capturing 84,200 skills and 750,898 commits from GitHub. We manually construct taxonomies of skill components, change patterns, and evolution motivations, and build an automated annotation pipeline to label changes at scale. Based on the taxonomy, we conduct quantitative analyses of skill composition and post-creation evolution frequency, together with qualitative assessments of modified components, change patterns, and motivations. Our findings reveal five implications: (i) reliability receives less attention in skill composition and change, motivating execution-contract skill design that incorporates verification and recovery mechanisms; (ii) evolution changes concentrate in project-coupled skills, calling for automated just-in-time skill updating mechanisms; (iii) change patterns are dominated by incremental enrichment and refinement, motivating pattern-guided skill enhancers that diagnose and improve incomplete skill components; (iv) redundancy is a practical maintenance issue, highlighting the need for context-efficient skill representation; (v) security-motivated changes show limited risk reduction, suggesting skill regression testing methods that objectively verify skill functionality and security. Beyond these insights, our dataset provides a basis for future studies on automated skill techniques.
2611.04456.affiliation: Zhejiang University / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Hangzhou City University
2611.04456.update_target: Empirical lifecycle and regression risks of repository-hosted agent skills
2611.04456.mechanism_en: An 84,200-skill/750,898-commit corpus receives manually designed change/component/motivation taxonomies and large-scale automated annotation; findings motivate execution contracts and objective regression tests.
2611.04456.result_en: Changes concentrate in project-coupled skills and incremental enrichment; reliability receives less attention, redundancy persists, and security-motivated changes show limited risk reduction.
2611.04456.boundary_en: Observed GitHub editing is not necessarily autonomous self-evolution. Taxonomy/annotation evidence motivates mechanisms but does not demonstrate the proposed enhancers or regression tests working.
2611.04456.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的 Agent 越来越依靠外部技能复用任务专属知识，而无需重训模型。随着技能成为扩展 Agent 能力的常见方式，理解其创建和演化对可靠系统至关重要。然而，现有研究主要从静态角度检查技能，真实仓库中的演化仍缺乏探索，限制了对技能变更模式及动机的理解。为填补缺口，我们开展大规模实证研究，涵盖 GitHub 上 84,200 个技能和 750,898 次提交。我们人工构建技能组件、变更模式和演化动机的分类体系，并建立自动标注流水线大规模标记变更。基于分类，我们定量分析技能组成和创建后演化频率，并定性评估修改组件、变更模式与动机。发现揭示五项启示：（i）可靠性在技能组成和变更中受关注较少，促使设计含验证和恢复机制的执行契约技能；（ii）演化变更集中于项目耦合技能，需要自动即时技能更新机制；（iii）增量丰富和优化主导变更模式，促使开发诊断并改善不完整组件的模式引导技能增强器；（iv）冗余是实际维护问题，凸显上下文高效技能表示的需要；（v）安全动机变更的风险降低有限，提示需要客观验证技能功能和安全的回归测试方法。除这些见解外，数据集为未来自动技能技术研究提供基础。

2611.04497.title: SKILL2STEER: One-Pass Hypernetwork for Mapping Natural-Language Skills to Low-Rank Post-Block Activation Shifts
2611.04497.abstract_en: Compiling a natural-language agent skill into model parameters removes the skill text from the prompt and leaves behind a small artifact that can be distributed and reused. Existing methods differ in where they inject the compiled quantity, and all of them assume that the artifact carries the content of the skill. We test that assumption. Through three controls on a retrieval agent, we find that a compiled skill shift carries a domain-general behavioural prior, not the content of the skill. A wrong skill document performs on par with the correct one, a single averaged bundle matches per-skill routing under a two-sided equivalence test, and a same-norm random direction collapses to the no-injection baseline, which shows that the trained direction stays load-bearing. We then introduce SKILL2STEER, a one-pass hypernetwork that reads a skill document once and maps it to low-rank activation shifts added at the output of every decoder block. Each skill compiles to 2.36M parameters, 9.25 times fewer than a weight-space adapter, while the base weights stay frozen and the generator runs only at compile time. The shift can be scheduled across retrieval steps and deployed as one routing-free bundle. On SearchQA, a seven-dataset benchmark, SKILL2STEER reaches 37.9 exact match, 9.8 points above the frozen model and 2.3 points above a weight-space method that ships 9.25 times more parameters per skill.
2611.04497.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2611.04497.update_target: Hypernetwork-generated low-rank activation shifts and content-transfer diagnostics
2611.04497.mechanism_en: Wrong-skill, averaged-bundle and equal-norm random controls test what compiled shifts carry. A one-pass trained hypernetwork compiles text into reusable shifts around a frozen backbone; the generator runs only at compilation.
2611.04497.result_en: The retrieval-agent controls support a domain-general behavioral prior rather than skill content. SKILL2STEER reaches 37.9 SearchQA EM, +9.8 points over frozen and +2.3 over the weight-space method, with 2.36M parameters/skill.
2611.04497.boundary_en: Frozen base weights do not mean no learned parameters. The content-vs-prior conclusion is scoped to the tested retrieval setting; equivalence of average routing is not universal skill equivalence.
2611.04497.abstract_zh: 将自然语言 Agent 技能编译到模型参数中，可移除提示中的技能文本，留下可分发复用的小产物。现有方法在注入位置上不同，但都假设产物携带技能内容。我们检验这一假设。通过检索 Agent 上三项对照，我们发现编译技能偏移携带的是领域通用行为先验，而非技能内容。错误技能文档与正确文档表现相当；单一平均包在双侧等效检验中匹配逐技能路由；相同范数随机方向退化至无注入基线，表明训练方向仍承担关键作用。随后我们提出 SKILL2STEER，一个只读取一次技能文档、将其映射为每个解码器块输出处低秩激活偏移的一次性超网络。每个技能编译为 2.36M 参数，比权重空间适配器少 9.25 倍，基础权重保持冻结，生成器仅在编译时运行。偏移可跨检索步骤调度，也可作为一个无需路由的包部署。在涵盖七个数据集的 SearchQA 基准上，SKILL2STEER 达到 37.9 精确匹配分，比冻结模型高 9.8 个点，比每技能携带 9.25 倍参数的权重空间方法高 2.3 个点。

2611.04952.title: Artifact-to-Capability: Diagnosing Breaks in Capability Formation of Self-Evolving Agents in a Controlled Environment
2611.04952.authors: Ziqian Ban , Haoxiang Yang , Yanfei Zhang , Shixin Liang , Haoran Yu , Xu Lin , Shaobin Zhao , Xuran Li , Zhiyi Cheng
2611.04952.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents write interaction experience into artifacts and reuse them in later tasks. Most work supports such methods with three proxy signals: artifacts accumulate, behavior changes once they are loaded, and metrics rise. We call this signal-based evaluation. What these signals are meant to indicate, however, has not been defined. To fill this gap, we define capability formation from artifacts as five sequentially dependent properties, two of which form a checkpoint for capability formation, and introduce three-scale diagnosis, which judges these properties at the state, game, and lineage levels. In freestyle Gomoku, Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM evolve with the same base model and all show the three signals, yet each exhibits a distinct capability-formation break. Reflexion shows a legalization gain: its pass rate rises only because more of its moves are legal. Voyager shows a compositional override: components that are sound on their own combine to miss all 20 available one-move wins. DGM shows loss-only drift: after passing the checkpoint, later versions only lose passing states. These counterexamples show that signal-based evaluation cannot determine whether a capability has formed.
2611.04952.affiliation: Tianjin University / Independent researcher / International Digital Economy Academy (IDEA)
2611.04952.update_target: State/game/lineage diagnosis of retained self-evolution artifacts
2611.04952.mechanism_en: Five sequential capability-formation properties and a checkpoint test whether accumulated artifacts cause genuine capability. Matched-base Reflexion/Voyager/DGM Gomoku lineages expose different breaks.
2611.04952.result_en: Reflexion gains only move legality; Voyager components jointly miss all 20 one-move wins despite individual soundness; DGM later versions lose passing states after the checkpoint.
2611.04952.boundary_en: Accumulation, changed behavior and higher scores are insufficient proxies in this controlled game. These counterexamples do not establish that every method fails on every domain.
2611.04952.abstract_zh: 自演化 Agent 将交互经验写入产物，并在后续任务复用。大多数工作用三类代理信号支持方法：产物积累、加载后行为变化和指标上升。我们称之为基于信号的评估。然而，这些信号本应指示什么，尚未被定义。为填补缺口，我们把由产物形成能力定义为五项按顺序依赖的性质，其中两项构成能力形成检查点，并提出在状态、游戏和谱系三个尺度判断这些性质的诊断。在自由式五子棋中，Reflexion、Voyager 和 DGM 使用相同基础模型演化，均表现出三种信号，但各自有不同能力形成断裂。Reflexion 表现为合法化收益：通过率上升仅因为更多落子合法。Voyager 表现为组合覆盖失效：单独正确的组件组合后，错过全部 20 个可用的一步获胜机会。DGM 表现为只损失漂移：通过检查点后，后续版本只会丢失通过状态。这些反例表明，基于信号的评估无法确定能力是否已经形成。

2611.05108.title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
2611.05108.authors: Jeremy Qin , Ruizhi Deng , Mohamed Osama Ahmed , Frederick Tung , Leo Feng
2611.05108.abstract_en: Autoresearch has shown that agents can autonomously write code, run experiments, and iteratively improve machine learning solutions. Yet most evaluations start a new agent session from scratch for each new problem, making them costly and leaving unclear whether agents can retain and apply prior insights when adapting to new tasks. We introduce CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH, an open-ended environment that compares persistent and reset instances of the same agent under matched task streams, data, and time budget. Continual AutoResearch covers nine task families, spanning synthetic tasks, symbolic regression, time-series forecasting, and tabular AutoML. Across five frontier agents, we measure first-solution quality, research efficiency, and final held-out performance. To distinguish insight transfer from session continuity, we run a memory ablation that vary what information agents retain from prior tasks. We show that persistent state improves research efficiency of all five agents, allowing them to find stronger solutions sooner. However, these gains do not consistently translate into better final solutions. Overall, our findings suggest that retaining experience and utilizing it effectively are distinct capabilities.
2611.05108.affiliation: RBC Borealis / ELLIS Institute Tubingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / Tubingen AI Center
2611.05108.update_target: Cross-task retained research state versus matched reset agents
2611.05108.mechanism_en: Persistent/reset versions of the same agent face matched task streams, data and time budgets across nine task families; memory ablations distinguish insight transfer from mere session continuity.
2611.05108.result_en: All five frontier agents find stronger solutions sooner with persistent state, but research-efficiency gains do not consistently improve final held-out solutions.
2611.05108.boundary_en: Retaining experience and using it productively are separate. Better early progress is not proof of improved final discovery or successor-driven unlimited research ability.
2611.05108.abstract_zh: Autoresearch 已表明，Agent 能自主编写代码、运行实验并迭代改进机器学习方案。然而，大多数评估对每个新问题都从头启动 Agent 会话，成本高，也无法说明 Agent 在适应新任务时能否保留并应用先前见解。我们提出 CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH，一个在匹配任务流、数据和时间预算下，比较同一 Agent 持久化实例与重置实例的开放式环境。Continual AutoResearch 覆盖九个任务家族，包括合成任务、符号回归、时间序列预测和表格 AutoML。我们对五个前沿 Agent 测量首次方案质量、研究效率和最终留出性能。为区分见解迁移与会话连续性，我们用记忆消融改变 Agent 从先前任务保留的信息。结果显示，持久状态提高全部五个 Agent 的研究效率，使它们更早找到更强方案。然而，这些收益并未持续转化为更好的最终方案。总体而言，发现表明保留经验与有效利用经验是不同能力。

2611.05287.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
2611.05287.authors: Ariana M. Villegas-Suarez , Guido Freire , Sohan Venkatesh , Bartosz Cywiński
2611.05287.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.05287.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.
2611.05287.affiliation: LASR Labs / Warsaw University of Technology
2611.05287.update_target: Behavioral safety under fact/continual model updates
2611.05287.mechanism_en: Fine-tuning on harmless false answers varies model disbelief; single-fact updates and coherent-story versus assertion framing test whether persistent internal disagreement predicts broader misalignment.
2611.05287.result_en: Math misaligned answers rise 4%→over 60% as trained answers become more wrong, with little general-capability loss; single-fact updates show the same association, while filters/persona vectors miss framing differences.
2611.05287.boundary_en: A risk diagnostic for updates, not evidence that every false-fact edit causes misalignment. Multiple-choice probabilities and stated answers operationalize belief/inconsistency within the tested models.
2611.05287.abstract_zh: 在错误医疗建议等狭窄领域的有害数据上微调大语言模型（LLM），可能使其广泛失配。这一风险在现实中有多大尚不清楚，因为实践中很少明确使用有害数据微调。我们表明，在模型认为错误、但不含有害内容的数据上微调，也会诱发广泛失配。在数学、常识问答、烹饪和体育中，模型越不相信被训练的答案，就越失配。在数学中，随着训练答案更错误，失配回答从 4% 升至超过 60%，而通用能力损失很小。微调后，模型说出错误答案，但其多项选择概率仍偏好真实答案，提示失配来自内部不一致。随后，我们研究知识编辑或持续学习中更现实的单事实更新场景。同样关系成立：在错误事实上训练后，模型仍越相信真实事实，就越失配。当把同一错误事实置于连贯故事中时，相比指示其断言错误事实，模型更深入地相信它、失配更少。内容过滤器和人格向量无法区分两种表述，尽管它们导致不同失配程度。结果提示模型更新风险：即使数据表面无害，训练一个未将新事实接受为真的模型，也可能诱发失配。

2611.06049.title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
2611.06049.authors: Sen Yang , Jiaduo Lin , Zehong Huang , Wen Liu
2611.06049.abstract_en: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.
2611.06049.update_target: Personal append-only memory and executable memory-context harness
2611.06049.mechanism_en: Conversation experience updates user records; a coding agent proposes harness patches from failures, a critic from another model family screens gaming, and a fixed evaluator tests further changes beyond the targeted failures.
2611.06049.result_en: With matched backbones, PersonaMem-v2/LongMemEval-S reach 61.3%/84.0% with Qwen3.8-27B and 57.5%/87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.
2611.06049.boundary_en: Training-free refers to backbone weights, not absence of persistent updates. Cross-family criticism and fixed evaluation reduce tested overfitting risk without proving a universally ungamable improvement loop.
2611.06049.abstract_zh: 个人 Agent 利用以往对话，为每个用户定制响应。其记忆系统存储并更新用户所说的内容，编码 Agent 如今也会重写将记忆转化为模型上下文的运行框架。这类补丁有过拟合风险：如果仅在其针对的失败上测试，可能修复那些案例，却无助于其他情况。我们提出 Reglos，一个无需训练的个人记忆 Agent，检验运行框架变化能否帮助其原本未针对的失败。其自演化记忆在每次对话后向用户的仅追加记录添加内容，随着新偏好取代旧偏好，事实也可以被遗忘。其运行框架通过递归自改进优化：编码 Agent 根据失败轨迹提出补丁，来自第二模型家族的评论器筛查每个补丁是否在钻基准空子。运行框架冻结后，由固定评估器决定接受哪些进一步补丁。所有系统采用相同骨干时，Reglos 优于 Mem0、MemOS 和 EverOS 等先进记忆系统，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 在 PersonaMem-v2 和 LongMemEval-S 上分别达到 61.3% 和 84.0%，使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 时分别达到 57.5% 和 87.2%。

2611.06254.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
2611.06254.authors: Zhi Hong , Qianlong Wang , Hongchen Wei , Aidan Wu , Daohong Ying , Mingze Kong , Bei Liu , Chong Luo
2611.06254.abstract_en: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.
2611.06254.affiliation: South China University of Technology / Fudan University / Wuhan University / Cornell University / University of California, San Diego / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Microsoft Research Asia
2611.06254.update_target: Complete executable harness code and reusable refinement-tree history
2611.06254.mechanism_en: MCTS selects parent harnesses under a fixed model/environment; a coding agent uses archived code, execution feedback and reusable mechanisms to propose children that become later search candidates.
2611.06254.result_en: With 15 refinements per benchmark, mean test score reaches 69.48% over six benchmarks, +10.89 points over initial harnesses and +3.95 over Meta-Harness; deployment execution cost is lower than hand-built baselines.
2611.06254.boundary_en: This is budgeted external-code search, not backbone learning. Lower per-task cost need not offset search cost, and the results concern finite candidate evaluations.
2611.06254.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 的性能既取决于底层模型，也取决于管理工具与环境交互的运行框架。但运行框架设计仍主要依赖人工，自动化设计需要在开放搜索空间中进行昂贵端到端评估。我们提出 HarnessFlow，一个在有限候选评估预算下优化完整可执行运行框架、同时固定模型和任务环境的框架。HarnessFlow 将候选及其评估历史组织为优化树，使用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的策略平衡利用与探索。编码 Agent 利用归档代码、执行反馈和可复用机制库优化选中框架。每个基准进行 15 次优化尝试时，HarnessFlow 在涵盖 Agent 任务、编码和网页交互的六个基准上，取得对比方法中最高平均测试分。优化后的框架平均得分 69.48%，分别比初始框架和 Meta-Harness 高 10.89 和 3.95 个百分点，同时平均每任务执行成本低于人工设计基线。这些结果表明，结构化运行框架搜索是自动设计有能力且高效 LLM Agent 的有前景途径。

2611.06321.title: EnzymeRSI: A dual-loop recursive self-improvement system for enzyme design
2611.06321.authors: Genoria AI Team , Yuejie Hou , Lixiang Yang , Yisi Liu , Weiting Tang , Yueyuxiao Yang , Meng Yang
2611.06321.abstract_en: Improvement in enzyme engineering is usually pursued by optimising which candidates to assay within a fixed model and workflow; when the bottleneck arises from a mismatched method or a failing workflow, that route is difficult to escape. We present EnzymeRSI, a dual-loop system for recursive self-improvement (RSI). The outer loop evolves harness assets without changing model weights, the inner loop develops prediction and selection algorithms under controlled conditions, and a cloud laboratory system is specified to close the physical loop with quality-controlled feedback. By updating its prediction strategy through iterative comparison, the outer loop raised the mean development-set Spearman correlation on ProteinGym by 0.044 across five assays, reaching 0.335 on CD19 and 0.683 on OPSD (rhodopsin); of the two first places, only CD19 was produced by the outer loop itself. In the self-improvement of the ThermoMPNN algorithm the inner loop reached a PCC of 0.849, and on TadA-Bench it reached a Spearman correlation of 0.307 in 1.13 h. In three prospective wet-lab tests of the system's experimental decision-making, 10 of the 32 candidates that had not been pre-specified for the luciferase RLuc showed at least twice the wild-type activity; a recommended variant of the cytidine deaminase A3A raised 5mC conversion to 90.2%; and path selection in evolution raised the catalytic efficiency of the DNA polymerase KOD-E on a modified substrate to 31.1 times that of the parent. By treating the organisation of the research workflow and the development of algorithms as a single falsifiable dry-to-wet loop, this work offers an evolutionary paradigm for moving beyond the blind spots of a fixed method and for autonomous enzyme engineering.
2611.06321.update_target: Enzyme-research harness assets and prediction/selection algorithms
2611.06321.mechanism_en: The outer loop changes harness assets with fixed weights, while an inner loop compares algorithms under controlled conditions. A quality-controlled cloud-lab interface is specified; prospective wet-lab tests separately assess experimental decisions.
2611.06321.result_en: Outer-loop development Spearman rises 0.044 across five assays; CD19 reaches 0.335. Prospective tests report 10/32 non-prespecified RLuc candidates at ≥2× wild type, A3A conversion 90.2%, and KOD-E efficiency 31.1× parent.
2611.06321.boundary_en: The cloud physical loop is specified rather than established as fully autonomous end-to-end. Only CD19 of the two first-place results is attributed to the outer loop; development scores and prospective biology are separate evidence.
2611.06321.abstract_zh: 酶工程中的改进通常是在固定模型和工作流内优化待测候选；当瓶颈源于不匹配的方法或失败的工作流时，这一路径很难摆脱。我们提出 EnzymeRSI，一个递归自改进（RSI）双循环系统。外循环在不改变模型权重的情况下演化运行框架资产，内循环在受控条件下开发预测和选择算法，并规定了一个云实验室系统，通过质量控制反馈闭合物理循环。通过迭代比较更新预测策略，外循环在五个 ProteinGym 测定上将平均开发集 Spearman 相关提高 0.044，在 CD19 上达到 0.335、在 OPSD（视紫红质）上达到 0.683；这两个第一名结果中，只有 CD19 来自外循环本身。在 ThermoMPNN 算法自改进中，内循环达到 0.849 的 PCC，在 TadA-Bench 上则用 1.13 小时达到 0.307 的 Spearman 相关。在三项前瞻性湿实验中，系统的实验决策接受检验：针对荧光素酶 RLuc，32 个事先未指定的候选中有 10 个表现出至少两倍野生型活性；推荐的胞嘧啶脱氨酶 A3A 变体将 5mC 转化率提高到 90.2%；演化中的路径选择将 DNA 聚合酶 KOD-E 在修饰底物上的催化效率提高到亲本的 31.1 倍。通过把研究工作流组织与算法开发视为一个可证伪的干到湿循环，本工作为超越固定方法盲点和自主酶工程提供一种演化范式。
2611.06321.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and link placeholders are preserved even where later paper wording differs.
2611.06321.image_caption: Fig. 1 | | The dual-loop structure of EnzymeRSI. a , Dual-loop recursive self-improvement. The outer loop evolves versions of prompts, pipelines, skills and subagents, which are adopted or rolled back after diagnosis, a minimal consistent change bundle and a paired comparison at matched budget; model weights are not modified. The inner loop is triggered only when a method bottleneck appears, and develops predictors, training strategies, search operators and acquisition functions under controlled conditions. Missing packages and permission problems are handled as engineering faults and trigger neither loop. Adoption rules are fixed before the comparison as global adoption, scoped retention or rollback, and an adopted version must be loaded by the next run. The protein, algorithm and system tiers are scored independently and are not collapsed into a single weighted number (Section 4.7). Evidence and Trajectory record measurements, QC status, sample identity, batch, references, checksums of raw files and execution receipts, and return along the sequence evidence, hypothesis, action, result, decision. They may trigger either loop or neither. The legend distinguishes three arrow types: a black arrow is an accepted revision, an orange arrow is experiment flow and a green dashed arrow is evidence or a trigger, which is used as required. b , Cloud Lab. Candidates that have been scored in dry-lab evaluation and passed ProtoPilot–Operon-S1 fast decisions form a wet-lab commission, which runs on the adopted version, is orchestrated by ProtoPilot and compiled into device tasks, and is then scheduled, measured and quality-controlled by the execution layer. The same task contract can address a single instrument, a workcell, a production line or a cloud laboratory. A receipt evidences a software event only; an actual transfer requires measurement and QC support. A sample that passes QC but shows low activity is valid evidence, whereas a failed run enters execution diagnosis. Measurements return to Evidence and Trajectory.

2611.06328.title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
2611.06328.authors: Qianhui Zhao , Li Zhang , Fang Liu
2611.06328.abstract_en: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.
2611.06328.update_target: Architectural project state, repository code and reusable repair experience
2611.06328.mechanism_en: Predicted architecture/skeleton relations are reconciled with realized code relations; tool-grounded verification supports state changes, and prior repair attempts are abstracted into experience for subsequent generation.
2611.06328.result_en: With GPT-5, unit-test pass rates are 60.48% on DevBench and 27.73% on CodeProjectEval, with up to 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.
2611.06328.boundary_en: This demonstrates architecture/code co-refinement with repair reuse. The abstract does not establish unrestricted cross-project lifelong accumulation or changes to backbone weights.
2611.06328.abstract_zh: 项目级代码生成旨在从高层需求自动合成完整软件仓库，产生模块结构良好、跨文件依赖一致的连贯多文件系统。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在规范理解和代码合成方面能力很强，现有方法仍有关键局限。首先，许多方法依赖无法随迭代生成适应的静态架构，导致架构与实现日益错位。其次，缺少跨迭代积累和复用经验的机制，造成重复错误和效率降低。第三，它们常依赖对中间产物的独立 LLM 评估，在长上下文推理下透明度有限且可能不可靠。为此，我们提出 EvoCodeAgent，一个项目级代码生成的状态中心框架。它维护从结构化项目规范初始化的演化架构状态，持续将架构与骨架预测的关系和生成代码提取的已实现关系协调一致。它进一步利用有工具依据的验证证据支持可靠状态更新，并从先前修订尝试提炼可复用修复经验，指导后续生成。在 DevBench、CodeProjectEval 等不同规模项目基准上的广泛实验表明，EvoCodeAgent 持续优于基线。在 GPT-5 设置下，单元测试通过率分别为 60.48% 和 27.73%，相较最强基线最高提升 53.5%。

2611.06381.title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
2611.06381.authors: Xinyu Yang , Jiejun Tan , Chenlong Deng , Chenghao Zhang , Tongyu Wen , Zhicheng Dou
2611.06381.abstract_en: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.
2611.06381.update_target: Legal-retrieval policy weights and evolving process rubrics
2611.06381.mechanism_en: Heuristic query seeds produce search trajectories; rollout experience becomes rubrics, and repeated rubric optimization plus rubric-guided RL supplies the next policy-training stage.
2611.06381.result_en: End-to-end legal-judgment benchmarks favor optimized queries; evolving rubrics outperform fixed rubrics and direct SFT-then-RL controls, without an aggregate numerical effect in the abstract.
2611.06381.boundary_en: The co-evolving supervision/policy loop is explicit, but benchmark improvement does not certify legal correctness or autonomous changes to the model's learning algorithm.
2611.06381.abstract_zh: 随着基于 LLM 的 Agent 发展，它们越来越多地应用于法律领域。法律判决预测（LJP）要求模型进行多步推理和外部法律证据检索。现有法律搜索 Agent 的性能常受检索查询质量限制。它们往往直接从初始用户请求形成查询，忽视潜在法律问题和法律上重要的细节。为此，我们提出 LegalEvolver，一个专门为 LJP 检索生成法律信息充分查询的查询优化框架。采样高质量优化查询及其搜索轨迹具有挑战，因为仅靠无引导高温 rollout 既低效，也受初始模型能力限制。因此，我们启发式优化查询作为种子，提高轨迹生成效率。此外，我们将 rollout 经验总结为量规，用于指导多轮迭代自演化。反复进行量规优化和量规引导 RL，使模型超越初始性能上限。广泛基准上的端到端表现证明查询优化对 LJP 的有效性。与先直接 SFT 再 RL 比较，证明量规指导有效。演化量规进一步优于固定量规，确认自演化的益处。

2611.06542.title: EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
2611.06542.authors: Ximo Zhu , Ruiqi Liu , Yi Han , Zhengan Wu , Gengsheng Li , ZiAn Wang , Zhu Yuantian , Jin Jiang , Wenhao Wang
2611.06542.abstract_en: Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on teacher logits difficult to apply directly to black-box models. We observe that rich textual feedback from a black-box teacher can be treated as privileged information (PI) and converted, through a PI-conditioned privileged teacher, into dense supervision signals on the student's own trajectories. However, what PI should be acquired from the teacher to most effectively support student learning remains unclear. PI strategies that differ in where they focus, what information they request, and how much detail they provide can have substantially different effects on the current student, and their relative effectiveness can further change as training progresses. Based on this observation, we propose Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation (EvoOPD), which treats PI acquisition itself as an optimization problem and maintains a PI Strategy Bank that evolves with the student state. EvoOPD uses the measured repair utility of PI on the current student to adapt the focus, information type, and granularity of teacher feedback, allowing the acquired information to continually match the student's learning needs. We systematically evaluate EvoOPD on mathematical reasoning and code generation with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B students. EvoOPD achieves the best overall performance in all six model-task settings, improving over the strongest baseline in each setting by an average of 2.14 percentage points in mathematics and 1.30 points in code. Further analysis shows that the relative effectiveness of PI acquisition strategies changes with student state, making a fixed strategy difficult to sustain as the best choice throughout distillation.
2611.06542.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Southwest University / Southeast University / Jilin University / United Arab Emirates University / Vast Intelligence Lab
2611.06542.update_target: Privileged-information acquisition strategies and distilling student weights
2611.06542.mechanism_en: A PI Strategy Bank evolves with student state. Measured repair utility selects feedback focus/type/granularity; a PI-conditioned teacher converts black-box textual feedback into dense supervision on current student trajectories.
2611.06542.result_en: Across Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B math/code settings, EvoOPD is best in all six comparisons, averaging +2.14 math and +1.30 code percentage points over the strongest per-setting baselines.
2611.06542.boundary_en: This adapts the supervision-acquisition procedure alongside student learning. It still uses an external black-box teacher and does not establish teacher-independent capability growth.
2611.06542.abstract_zh: 专有语言模型有很强的推理和编码能力，但其输出分布不可访问，使依赖教师 logits 的细粒度蒸馏难以直接应用于黑箱模型。我们观察到，黑箱教师的丰富文本反馈可作为特权信息（PI），经 PI 条件化特权教师转化为学生自身轨迹上的密集监督。然而，应从教师获取什么 PI 才最有效支持学生学习，仍不清楚。PI 策略在关注位置、请求信息及细节量上不同，对当前学生的效果可明显不同，其相对有效性还会随训练变化。基于此，我们提出 EvoOPD（Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation），将 PI 获取本身视为优化问题，维护随学生状态演化的 PI 策略库。EvoOPD 使用 PI 对当前学生的实测修复效用，适应教师反馈的重点、信息类型和粒度，使获取的信息持续匹配学习需求。我们用 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 学生，在数学推理和代码生成上系统评估。EvoOPD 在全部六个模型—任务设置中取得最佳总体表现，相较每个设置的最强基线，数学平均高 2.14 个百分点，代码平均高 1.30 个点。进一步分析显示，PI 获取策略的相对有效性随学生状态变化，固定策略难以在整个蒸馏过程中始终最优。

(a) White-box distillation uses accessible teacher logits for token-level supervision; black-box distillation uses teacher text for SeqKD or reward-based training. 2611.06654.title: Compounding Physical RSI: Turning Execution Failure into Inherited Capability
2611.06654.authors: Yixuan Yang , Qiang Chen , Run Shao , Shuwei Dong , Wenhao Li , Yunpeng Wang , Wenhan Fang , Haomiao Wu , Xingyu Wang , Lichen Man , Rong Zhang , Xuezhi Cui , Yuan Liu , Bingyan Lu , Jiawei Ma , Xiaoyang Ma , Zhemin Sun , Zhuorui Yao , Yutong Dong , Yuxuan Zhao , Yichong Mu , Jiabao Jiang , Wenxuan Deng , Junling Zhou , Yi Chen , Deyu Zhang , Yiming Yan , Yige Yuan , Shan You , Fei Wang , Haifeng Li , Hongyan Xu , Yichao Cao , Xiu Su
2611.06654.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies are trained on static offline datasets, yet physical manipulation unfolds sequentially across stages. Because a weakness in a downstream stage remains unobservable until the policy passes earlier ones, each resolved bottleneck exposes the next hidden failure mode. This staged structure calls for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), in which a policy iteratively executes, diagnoses failures, and updates itself. Moreover, because task completion behaves like a product of stage-level pass rates, recursive gains can multiply across generations. In physical environments, three bottlenecks obstruct compounding: terminal execution feedback rarely localizes the stage that caused a failure, failed trajectories do not supply the corrective action, and updating shared parameters can degrade previously mastered skills. We propose Compounding Physical RSI, a self-evolving policy framework that turns execution failures into heritable capability. First, automated capability-gap assessment traces failed rollouts to the task stage where progression breaks down and formulates a structured improvement objective. Second, conditioned on this objective, our remedy stage curates validated, stage-relevant experience and refines the policy via behavior-regularized offline reinforcement learning, without requiring costly online rollouts at each optimization step. Third, to safeguard existing skills, our retention stage constructs weight-space candidates between the inherited reference policy and the refined policy, evaluates them across the task suite, and promotes the best candidate as the reference state for the next generation. Evaluated across all 42 tasks of the RoboDojo-Sim benchmark, CSU-AI-07 ranks first on the leaderboard with a three-seed mean Overall Score of 26.15 and Success Rate of 20.70%, outperforming the next-best entry by 5.92 points and 5.82 percentage points.
2611.06654.update_target: Inherited robot-policy weights and retained reference-state candidates
2611.06654.mechanism_en: Failure assessment localizes blocked task stages; validated stage-relevant experience drives behavior-regularized offline RL. Interpolated reference/refined weight candidates are suite-evaluated and promoted as the next generation's reference.
2611.06654.result_en: On all 42 RoboDojo-Sim tasks, a three-seed mean score of 26.15 and success rate of 20.70% exceed the reported next-best entry by 5.92 points/5.82 percentage points.
2611.06654.boundary_en: This evidence is simulation despite the physical-RSI title. Leaderboard rank is an author report; finite inherited gains and a stage-product argument do not establish indefinite compounding or real-hardware success.
2611.06654.abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略在静态离线数据集上训练，但物理操作按多个阶段顺序展开。由于下游阶段的弱点只有策略通过早期阶段后才可观察，每个已解决瓶颈都会暴露下一个隐藏失败模式。这种阶段结构需要递归自改进（RSI），使策略反复执行、诊断失败并更新自身。此外，任务完成表现类似各阶段通过率的乘积，递归收益可跨代相乘。物理环境中，三项瓶颈阻碍复合增长：终端执行反馈很少定位致错阶段，失败轨迹不提供纠正动作，共享参数更新可能损害已掌握技能。我们提出 Compounding Physical RSI，一个将执行失败转化为可遗传能力的自演化策略框架。首先，自动能力缺口评估将失败 rollout 追溯到推进中断的任务阶段，并形成结构化改进目标。其次，以该目标为条件，补救阶段整理经过验证、与阶段相关的经验，通过行为正则化离线强化学习优化策略，无需每个优化步骤都进行昂贵在线 rollout。第三，为保护既有技能，保留阶段在继承参考策略与优化策略之间构造权重空间候选，跨任务套件评估，并将最佳候选晋升为下一代参考状态。在 RoboDojo-Sim 全部 42 个任务上，CSU-AI-07 以三个随机种子的平均 Overall Score 26.15 和 Success Rate 20.70% 排名榜首，分别比次优条目高 5.92 个点和 5.82 个百分点。

2611.06654.image_caption: Figure 1: Architecture of Compounding Physical RSI. Closed-loop execution in RoboDojo-Sim feeds automated stage-level capability-gap assessment (Diagnosis), which produces a structured objective g k g_{k} to guide experience curation and offline reinforcement learning (Remedy). Retention interpolates candidates between the inherited reference policy and the refined policy, promotes the best-performing candidate via full-benchmark evaluation, and passes it forward as the reference state for the next generation.

2611.06768.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
2611.06768.authors: Qiang Wang , Jianxin Bi , Shulong Jiang , Ruiyang Si , Wenbo Huang , Kaiqi Chen , Jiaxin Li , Liyun Li , Xuanyi Li , Daquan Zhou
2611.06768.abstract_en: Coding agents powered by models such as GPT-6-Astra connect spatial reasoning with executable robot behavior, raising the question of how such agents can produce lasting improvements in robot capabilities from physical interaction. In this work, we study embodied recursive self-improvement (RSI) through real-world exploration, code refinement, and deployment using PyRUA-REAL, a framework in which coding agents retain interaction experience as persistent memory and reusable executable skills that inform subsequent exploration and improvement. Our empirical study places physical manipulation at the center of the improvement process, examining how agents collaborate, what kinds of execution feedback support effective code refinement, and how task specifications and previously acquired skills influence robustness and task transfer. We further investigate the efficiency and capability of the resulting programs when deployed without involving an online agent for decision-making. Across eight real-world tasks, PyRUA-REAL achieves an average success rate of 91.1%. In complementary evaluation on 42 tasks from the RoboDojo benchmark, it achieves an average success rate of 84.4%. This study provides empirical guidance for turning physical exploration into reusable robot skills that support continued improvement and robust, efficient deployment.
2611.06768.affiliation: Peking University / EngineAI / National University of Singapore
2611.06768.update_target: Persistent robot-interaction memory and reusable executable skills
2611.06768.mechanism_en: Coding agents use real-world exploration/execution feedback to refine code; retained memory and skills guide subsequent exploration. Resulting programs are also tested without an online decision-making agent.
2611.06768.result_en: Average success is 91.1% across eight real-world tasks, with complementary average success 84.4% across 42 RoboDojo tasks.
2611.06768.boundary_en: Real-world and benchmark protocols are separate; their means are not interchangeable. Reusable code improvement is distinct from policy-weight learning, and no independent reproduction is claimed.
2611.06768.abstract_zh: 由 GPT-6-Astra 等模型驱动的编码 Agent 将空间推理与可执行机器人行为相连，引出一个问题：这些 Agent 如何通过物理交互，产生持久的机器人能力改进？本文使用 PyRUA-REAL，通过真实世界探索、代码优化和部署研究具身递归自改进（RSI）。在该框架中，编码 Agent 将交互经验保留为持久记忆和可复用可执行技能，为后续探索与改进提供信息。我们的实证研究把物理操作置于改进过程中心，考察 Agent 如何协作、哪些执行反馈支持有效代码优化，以及任务规范和已获得技能如何影响稳健性与任务迁移。我们进一步研究所得程序在不涉及在线 Agent 决策时的部署效率和能力。在八个真实世界任务上，PyRUA-REAL 平均成功率为 91.1%。在 RoboDojo 基准 42 个任务的补充评估中，平均成功率为 84.4%。本研究为将物理探索转化为可复用机器人技能、支持持续改进及稳健高效部署提供实证指导。

(a) Coding agents iteratively explore, execute, diagnose, and revise robot programs, retaining rollout experience as persistent memory and reusable skills. 2611.05636.title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
2611.05636.authors: Zeyu Fang , Jun Yin , Yongsheng Mei , Xu Han , Chaitali Joshi , Zhongkai Sun , Jie Hao , Bin Guo , Chengyuan Ma , Benjamin Z. Yao , Chenlei Guo
2611.05636.abstract_en: The memory of production agents is increasingly becoming a bottleneck and is built almost exclusively from text: key points are extracted from out-of-limit context and retrieved into context at query time. Therefore, every new query incurs an additional cost that grows with the accumulated history. Weight memory is a complementary alternative that internalizes knowledge into model parameters and answers with no context at all, and has recently proven effective in self-evolving agents for internalizing skills and behaviors. However, its application in episodic and semantic memory, such as user-specific facts, remains comparatively unexplored, and a gap remains between earlier attempts at weight memory and text-based systems regarding recall performance. We study how to make weight memory competitive as a long-term factual store by applying on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). It trains a context-free student from a teacher, which is the same model conditioned on the user's memory, together with a verify-then-regenerate router that lets weight and text memory each cover the queries they handle best. On the HaluMem benchmark, OPSD matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines, including full-context prompting and retrieval systems, while reading fewer tokens per query. We further conduct an extensive study that characterizes the behavior of weight memory and analyzes how different training recipes affect its performance. As agent harnesses move toward persistent, multi-session deployments, these results position weight memory as a practical, low-cost component of agent memory and provide insights into feasible training and evaluation protocols for combining it with retrieval.
2611.05636.update_target: Parametric factual memory and verify-then-regenerate memory routing
2611.05636.mechanism_en: A same-model teacher reads user memory and distills a context-free student with OPSD; routing lets learned weight memory answer suitable queries and text memory handle the remainder.
2611.05636.result_en: On HaluMem, OPSD matches or exceeds full-context/retrieval baselines while reading fewer query tokens; the abstract gives no aggregate numerical effect.
2611.05636.boundary_en: Weight memory is parameter learning, unlike a text-only store. Router verification quality and training/amortization costs remain necessary when comparing query savings.
2611.05636.abstract_zh: 生产 Agent 的记忆越来越成为瓶颈，且几乎完全由文本构建：从超出上下文限制的内容中提取要点，在查询时检索回上下文。因此，每个新查询都有随积累历史增长的额外成本。权重记忆是一种互补方案，将知识内化到模型参数，无需上下文即可回答，近期已在自演化 Agent 内化技能与行为方面有效。但其对用户专属事实等情景与语义记忆的应用仍探索不足，早期权重记忆与文本系统之间的召回表现仍有差距。我们研究如何通过在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD），使权重记忆成为有竞争力的长期事实存储。它用以用户记忆为条件的同一模型作为教师，训练不依赖上下文的学生，并结合先验证再重新生成的路由器，让权重和文本记忆分别覆盖各自擅长的查询。在 HaluMem 上，OPSD 匹配或超过包括完整上下文提示与检索系统在内的强文本记忆基线，同时每查询读取更少 token。我们还通过广泛研究刻画权重记忆行为，并分析不同训练配方对性能的影响。当 Agent 运行框架转向持久、多会话部署时，这些结果将权重记忆定位为实用、低成本的记忆组件，并为其与检索结合的可行训练和评估协议提供认识。
