2611.05873.title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
2611.05873.authors: Zimu Liu , Xiaoxi Guo , Xiaolu Tang , Liang Yu
2611.05873.abstract_en: Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports 18/18 completed runs with memory versus 3/18 without it, but a grounded single-agent control also solves the earlier hard-task slice. A separate cross-session probe is excluded from efficacy conclusions because of confounded route schedules and unvalidated state labels. We examine 13 selected real-update hazard records across nine subjects, distinguishing stale-locator observations from policy-based withholding and offline retrieval diagnostics. The latter do not measure live-device failures or actions saved. These events are UI changes, not confirmed regression bugs. The evidence supports a bounded design and case study; it does not establish general efficacy, superiority over independent GUI-agent systems, or unrestricted exploration.
2611.05873.mechanism_en: A maintenance contract assigns persistence to a Reflector and defines confirmation/revalidation/withdrawal; recalled routes/locators are advice constrained by current observations.
2611.05873.result_en: A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports memory 18/18 versus no-memory 3/18 completions; an additional grounded single-agent control solves the earlier hard slice. Thirteen real-update hazard records are inspected.
2611.05873.boundary_en: Not every contract mechanism is enforced end to end. Confounded cross-session results are excluded; stale UI records are not confirmed app bugs or measured saved live actions.
2611.05873.abstract_zh: 重复的移动 GUI 测试可复用先前执行的路线、定位器和恢复策略。但在某工作流或应用版本有效的路线，在另一情境可能无关或误导。我们研究基于 LLM 的测试器如何保留有用经验，同时暂缓使用与当前观测矛盾的条目。我们为 AdaptiTest 提出维护契约，使可复用经验具有明确适用范围、轨迹来源，以及确认、重新验证和撤回的生命周期。契约将持久化保留给 Reflector 角色，并将召回经验视为建议。归档实现未证明所有规定机制的端到端强制执行。评估采用只读 Android 工作流和归档内部比较。一个六任务、三重复的就绪子集报告，有记忆完成 18/18，无记忆完成 3/18；但一个有依据的单 Agent 对照也解决了早期困难任务切片。另一个跨会话探针因路线日程混杂及状态标签未验证，被排除在有效性结论之外。我们检查九个对象的 13 条精选真实更新风险记录，区分过期定位器观测、基于策略的暂缓使用及离线检索诊断。后者不测量真实设备失败或节省的动作。这些事件是 UI 变化，不是已确认回归缺陷。证据支持有边界的设计与案例研究，不能证明一般有效性、优于独立 GUI Agent 系统或不受限探索。

2611.06244.title: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
2611.06244.authors: Sumeet Ramesh Motwani , Tejas Krishnan , Alistair Letcher , Charles London , Suhaas Bhat , Huitian Jiao , Philip Torr , Riashat Islam , Christopher Summerfield , Jakob Foerster , Christian Schroeder de Witt , Qilong Gu , Shital Shah
2611.06244.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.
2611.06244.update_target: Policy weights and a non-stationary rubric-criterion curriculum
2611.06244.mechanism_en: Pairwise preferences over generated rollouts and changing rubric criteria replace stationary absolute rewards, using the generation/verification gap without new annotations or stronger teachers.
2611.06244.result_en: RcRL continues improving beyond 1,000 steps; creative-writing human win rate is 70.5% versus base, and reported HealthBench gains are 14.6% full/25.4% consensus.
2611.06244.boundary_en: No unique ground-truth verifier exists in these domains. Author-reported rubric robustness and entropy preservation do not rule out all reward hacking; percent gains are not relabeled as points.
2611.06244.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码生成上带来显著收益。但将其延伸到开放领域仍困难：没有真实答案验证，人类标注昂贵，学习奖励模型易遭奖励投机。判断好输出比生成好输出容易的生成—验证差距，为改进提供潜在路径。然而，量规裁判往往不精确且静态，策略可过拟合或投机。我们提出 Rubric Curriculum RL（RcRL），无需新数据、人工标注或更强教师即可利用这一差距。我们将 rollout 间配对偏好与量规标准课程结合，得到比绝对评分更有区分度的信号和非平稳目标。基线在数百步内停滞，RcRL 则保留输出熵并在超过 1000 步后持续改进。创意写作中，RcRL 相对基础模型取得 70.5% 的人类胜率，收益覆盖多个基准和裁判。在 HealthBench 上，RcRL 相对基础模型提高 14.6%（完整集）和 25.4%（共识子集），超过全部训练基线，包括实例专属量规。

2611.06244.image_caption: Figure 2 : Overview of Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL). (Left) The challenge: training with a static rubric leads to reward hacking, where the model optimizes for the reward signal without improving true quality. (Right) Our solution: RcRL progressively introduces evaluation criteria, using pairwise comparisons to allocate rewards. The curriculum advances when current criteria have improved (Section 5.2 ).

2611.06343.title: Prism: Bidirectional Self-Teaching for Unified Multimodal Models
2611.06343.authors: Peng Zhang , Qian Chen , Xianyin Zhang , Yimin Tian , Ruite Fei , Dongyi Lv , Lifan Guo , Chi Zhang , Shuai Liu
2611.06343.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2611.06343.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single model. Existing post-training methods either use understanding as a fixed teacher to improve generation, or rely on ground-truth trajectories to supervise both understanding and generation. Prism instead derives bidirectional supervision from self-generated interleaved rollouts, constructing training targets according to the reliability of their text and image chains. We propose Prism, a bidirectional self-teaching post-training method for UMMs. Like a prism decomposing mixed light, Prism decouples a coupled interleaved trajectory into a text chain and an image chain, assesses the reliability of each chain, and constructs a corresponding training target from their reliability states. Experiments on both SenseNova-U1 and BAGEL show that Prism improves both understanding and generation. On the generation side, GenEval improves from 85.8 to 89.2 (+3.4), and DPG improves from 86.1 to 87.3 (+1.2) on SenseNova-U1. On the understanding side, the total MME score improves from 2282.6 to 2311.6, and MMVP improves from 58.0 to 62.0. Consistent improvements are observed on BAGEL. These results highlight that Prism enables coordinated improvements in generation and understanding by constructing reliability-guided self-training targets from self-generated trajectories, without relying on an external verifier or externally annotated corrected trajectories during target construction.
2611.06343.affiliation: Xi'an Jiaotong University / Qwen DianJin Team, Alibaba Cloud Computing
2611.06343.update_target: Unified multimodal weights and reliability-guided text/image training targets
2611.06343.mechanism_en: Self-generated interleaved rollouts are split into text and image chains; their reliability states determine bidirectional supervision, so understanding/generation can improve together without an external verifier during target construction.
2611.06343.result_en: On SenseNova-U1, GenEval rises 85.8→89.2, DPG 86.1→87.3, MME 2282.6→2311.6 and MMVP 58→62; BAGEL also improves.
2611.06343.boundary_en: No external verifier during target construction is not absence of correctness assumptions. This is finite post-training co-improvement, not an independently certified self-teacher.
2611.06343.abstract_zh: 统一多模态模型（UMM）旨在于单一模型支持视觉理解和生成。现有后训练方法要么将理解作为固定教师改进生成，要么依靠真实轨迹同时监督两者。Prism 则从自生成的交错 rollout 推导双向监督，根据文本链和图像链的可靠性构造训练目标。我们提出 Prism，一种 UMM 的双向自教学后训练方法。如棱镜分解混合光，Prism 将耦合交错轨迹解耦为文本链和图像链，评估每条链的可靠性，并依据可靠性状态构造相应训练目标。SenseNova-U1 和 BAGEL 上的实验表明，Prism 同时改善理解与生成。生成方面，SenseNova-U1 的 GenEval 从 85.8 提高到 89.2（+3.4），DPG 从 86.1 提高到 87.3（+1.2）。理解方面，MME 总分从 2282.6 提高到 2311.6，MMVP 从 58.0 提高到 62.0。BAGEL 上也观察到一致改进。这些结果表明，Prism 从自生成轨迹构造可靠性引导自训练目标，实现生成和理解协调改进，在目标构造期间不依赖外部验证器或外部标注的纠正轨迹。

The base model shows redundant steps on step 2 in the cooking tutorial, while Prism produces a coherent and correct tutorial. It also improves performance on standalone understanding and generation tasks.

2611.06414.title: Twists and Turns: A Graph-Based Benchmark and Framework for Long-Term Memory in Exploration Tasks
2611.06414.authors: Chongyuan Dai , Yaling Shen , Zirui Song , Junfeng Liao , Jinpeng Hu , Xiuying Chen
2611.06414.abstract_en: Long-term problem-solving processes, such as scientific research and software development, proceed along an evolving trial-and-error trajectory toward a central goal. We term these \textit{exploration tasks}, which require models to remember not only facts but also how solutions are tested against intermediate outcomes and early attempts are continually revised or revived. However, existing long-term memory research focuses on factual recall and updates, overlooking the interconnected nature of exploration. We observe that exploration processes naturally form graphs, with branching approaches linked by revisions and reconsiderations. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{LExMem}, a graph-guided benchmark designed to evaluate \underline{\textsc{Mem}}ory in \underline{\textsc{L}}ong-term \underline{\textsc{Ex}}ploration tasks. We model exploration processes as graphs and introduce an evolutionary mechanism to increase their structural complexity, yielding 224 dialogues and 2,018 question-answer instances derived from graph structures. Building on the same insight, we propose \textsc{LExGraph}, a graph-based memory framework that incrementally organizes dialogues into interconnected memory nodes and retrieves evidence through hybrid retrieval and neighbor expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textsc{LExMem} poses a significant challenge to existing retrieval- and memory-based systems, whereas \textsc{LExGraph} achieves superior performance and generalizes effectively to external benchmarks. Codes and datasets are available at this https URL .
2611.06414.update_target: Graph-structured exploration memory and retrieval of revised/revived approaches
2611.06414.mechanism_en: LExGraph incrementally links dialogue memory nodes and retrieves through hybrid search/neighbor expansion. LExMem constructs branching revision/reconsideration graphs to test this memory use.
2611.06414.result_en: LExMem contains 224 dialogues and 2,018 QA instances; LExGraph outperforms compared systems and transfers to external benchmarks, without an aggregate numerical effect in the abstract.
2611.06414.boundary_en: Benchmark graph evolution is not itself an agent learning algorithm. Evidence concerns organization/retrieval of exploration history, not demonstrated autonomous discovery progress.
2611.06414.abstract_zh: 科学研究和软件开发等长期问题解决过程，沿着不断演化的试错轨迹走向中心目标。我们称之为探索任务，它要求模型不仅记忆事实，还记住方案如何接受中间结果检验，以及早期尝试如何不断修订或重新启用。然而，现有长期记忆研究关注事实召回和更新，忽略探索的相互连接性。我们观察到，探索过程自然形成图：分支方法由修订与重新考虑相连。受此启发，我们提出 LExMem，一个图引导的长期探索任务记忆评估基准。我们将探索过程建模为图，并引入增加结构复杂度的演化机制，得到 224 段对话和 2,018 个由图结构推导的问答实例。基于同一认识，我们提出 LExGraph，一个增量将对话组织为互联记忆节点、通过混合检索与邻居扩展检索证据的图记忆框架。广泛实验表明，LExMem 对现有检索与记忆系统具有明显挑战，而 LExGraph 表现更优，并可有效泛化到外部基准。代码和数据集见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.06444.title: EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution
2611.06444.authors: Yanli Wang , Zichen Bai , Tianyue Jiang , Kunming Shao , Junhao Shi , Xueqin Liu , Jinguo Sun , Muye Li , Tingting Bi , Yanlin Wang , Shaoqiang Zheng , Xuefei Diao , Zhuwei Zeng , Nan Duan , Peng Cao
2611.06444.abstract_en: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.
2611.06444.affiliation: JD.com / Sun Yat-sen University / University of Melbourne / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2611.06444.update_target: A learned pairwise selector gating persistent online skill updates
2611.06444.mechanism_en: Offline skill pools are privately evaluated for utility labels; clear-gap pairs train a two-label-logit selector. At deployment, one forward pass chooses the better old/new skill instead of rerunning the full test set.
2611.06444.result_en: Relative to accepting every update, reported success gains are 11.0% ALFWorld, 5.9% ScienceWorld and 2.7% LiveCodeBench.
2611.06444.boundary_en: This amortizes evaluation into a learned surrogate, rather than eliminating verification cost. Distribution shift or ambiguous pairs can make selector preferences unreliable; percentages retain the source wording.
2611.06444.abstract_zh: 技能让语言 Agent 以自然语言文档跨任务复用经验。近期工作从交互演化技能，但在线演化时现有方法有局限。先前方法从许多任务收集的一批轨迹离线更新技能。一些不检查就采用新技能，可能随时间退化；另一些仅在留出验证集改善时保留，成本高且太慢，难以每次更新后运行。我们提出 EvoGuard，一个以低延迟和低成本缓解技能退化的配对技能选择器。我们先迭代运行 Agent 建立技能池，在私有测试集对每个技能评分以获得效用标签，再将技能配对，通过拒绝采样仅保留效用差距明确的对。选择器根据两个标签 token 的 logits 训练，以选择更好的技能。部署时只需一次前向，显著快于私有测试集评估。相较采用每个新技能，EvoGuard 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 LiveCodeBench 上分别提高成功率 11.0%、5.9% 和 2.7%。

2611.06445.title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
2611.06445.authors: Jizhe Zhang , Ang Li , Chenheng Zhang , Yisen Wang
2611.06445.abstract_en: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.
2611.06445.update_target: Learned standalone context summarizer; downstream agent stays unchanged
2611.06445.mechanism_en: A frozen reconstructor recovers masked trajectory portions from summaries; reconstruction plus a length penalty rewards GRPO summarizer training. The resulting checkpoint compresses histories for later agent continuation.
2611.06445.result_en: Estimated inference costs fall about 78% on DeepSearchQA and 75% on SWE-bench Verified versus full context; the New abstract states absolute decreases of 0.04 without naming that metric.
2611.06445.boundary_en: Task-agnostic reconstruction is a proxy for downstream utility. The ambiguous 0.04 phrase is preserved rather than expanded into an unsupported task-score claim; training costs are distinct from inference estimates.
2611.06445.abstract_zh: 长时程语言模型 Agent 积累越来越多交互历史，使上下文压缩对高效执行不可或缺。现有学习压缩方法常依赖下游任务结果或求解器行为，将训练耦合到特定任务或 Agent。我们提出 SumOne，一个通过掩码重建训练、保留 Agent 历史信息的独立摘要器。给定过期历史的摘要，冻结重建器恢复原始轨迹随机掩盖的部分；重建质量结合长度惩罚，为用 GRPO 优化摘要器提供与任务无关的奖励。这直接从原始轨迹产生自监督，无需参考摘要或下游任务执行。推理时只保留轻量摘要器，为其他部分不变的 Agent 提供即插即用上下文压缩。我们在长时程搜索和软件工程任务上系统评估 SumOne。相对使用完整上下文，SumOne 在 DeepSearchQA 和 SWE-bench Verified 上将估计推理成本分别降低约 78% 和 75%，绝对下降为 0.04。同一检查点还能无需额外微调，迁移到不同下游模型和 Agent 运行框架。

2611.06518.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
2611.06518.authors: Mingzhe Zheng , Yue Wu , Jing Tan , Chang Zou , Dengyang Jiang , Zeyue Tian , Xuanhua He , Ryan Xu , Yunyang Ge , Sihui Ji , Yunlong Lin , Kaihang Pan , Hongru Yan , Sixiang Chen , Dianyi Wang , Julian Zhang , Weijie Kong , Changlin Li , Lanqing Guo , Zhao Zhong , Qifeng Chen , Harry Yang
2611.06518.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2611.06518.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Reward Gating calibrates their contributions through instance-level gates for phase, face confidence, conflict, and subtlety, then renormalizes weights over the active set to produce the sample's fused reward. RewardMemory then estimates each primitive's reliability from rollout scores and outcomes within each emotional regime in the finished training run, then fixes bounded multipliers that calibrate fusion weights in the next training run without updating reward models. Experiments on HunyuanVideo 1.5 show improvements across multiple RL algorithms and compare EmoReward with other agentic reward methods under SAGE-GRPO. Ablations and transfer experiments on SD 3.5 and FLUX further support adaptive reward calibration for visual generation.
2611.06518.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Tencent Hunyuan / Fudan University / University of Waterloo
2611.06518.update_target: Reward-fusion gates and cross-run reliability multipliers; reward models stay fixed
2611.06518.mechanism_en: Per-video gates weight active emotional signals; RewardMemory estimates primitive reliability from a completed training run and freezes bounded multipliers to calibrate the next run's reward fusion.
2611.06518.result_en: HunyuanVideo 1.5 experiments compare multiple RL algorithms; SD 3.5/FLUX transfers and ablations support adaptive calibration, without an aggregate numerical effect in the abstract.
2611.06518.boundary_en: Within-sample gating and cross-run retained calibration are distinct. This updates reward allocation without updating reward-model weights; subjective emotional quality is not an objective oracle.
2611.06518.abstract_zh: GRPO 已推动代码和数学等可验证领域的生成模型后训练，但视频质量、尤其情绪表达，通常依赖主观审美且没有唯一正确目标。现有方法多依赖视觉质量、运动质量和文本对齐的固定奖励，难以捕获情绪意图并可能诱发奖励投机；RLHF 又难以扩展，个人审美差异使跨叙事情境校准面部、身体运动和色彩线索更复杂。我们提出 EmoReward，一种新的自演化训练机制，从真实训练运行收集的奖励轨迹提炼证据可靠性，决定信任哪些情绪证据及权重，从而自适应指导后续训练的多奖励分配。EmoReward 先从情绪提示规划具体依据线索以指导评估，再在 act 阶段用异构信号原语给生成视频评分。Reflective Reward Gating 通过阶段、面部置信度、冲突和细微程度的实例级门校准贡献，再对活动集合归一化权重，形成样本融合奖励。RewardMemory 根据已完成训练运行中各情绪情境的 rollout 分数和结果估计每种原语可靠性，再固定有界乘数，在不更新奖励模型的情况下校准下一轮训练融合权重。HunyuanVideo 1.5 上的实验显示跨多种 RL 算法的改进，并在 SAGE-GRPO 下比较其他 Agent 奖励方法。SD 3.5 和 FLUX 的消融与迁移实验进一步支持视觉生成的自适应奖励校准。
2611.06518.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and link placeholders are preserved even where later paper wording differs.
2611.06518.image_caption: Figure 2: EmoReward calibrates emotional evidence within videos and across training runs. Plan translates intent into evaluation criteria, and Act obtains provider scores and evidence validity. Reflect combines current-video gates with memory-derived multipliers and normalizes over active providers. Evolve estimates contextual reliability from a completed reference run to construct the fixed multipliers used in subsequent training. The calibrated emotion reward complements the original video reward; GRPO updates the generator while the providers and memory table remain frozen.

2611.06543.title: Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
2611.06543.authors: Shumao Wu , Kongcheng Zhang , Jianqiang Huang , Baisheng Lai
2611.06543.abstract_en: Agent trajectories often contain both successful decisions and failed attempts, yet optimization with sparse trajectory-level rewards struggles to identify which critical decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. We observe that meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories can be distilled into natural-language process rubrics and used as process supervision signals. Based on this insight, we propose Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which leverages self-derived process rubrics for dense token-level supervision, thereby augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning. Specifically, the current policy independently generates multiple rubric bundles at each step according to the same group of trajectories, extracting candidate process rubrics from cross-trajectory behavioral differences. A frozen verifier then evaluates all rubric items against each trajectory in the group, and selects one candidate bundle based on bundle-level alignment between rubric satisfaction and task success. ORSD treats the selected rubric bundle as privileged information during training, then compares the log-likelihoods of the original tokens with and without the rubric. The resulting likelihood gap provides token-specific process credit, which is added to the original trajectory-level GRPO advantage through additive advantage shaping. ORSD thus bridges trajectory-level outcome supervision and fine-grained process supervision, enabling token-level credit assignment using process signals. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that ORSD accelerates policy improvement and boosts final task performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B under the same environment-interaction budget. Our code is available at this https URL .
2611.06543.affiliation: Computer Network Information Center, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Zhejiang University
2611.06543.update_target: Policy weights using dynamically selected privileged process rubrics
2611.06543.mechanism_en: The current policy proposes rubric bundles from the same trajectory group; a frozen verifier selects the bundle whose satisfaction aligns best with success. Rubric-conditioned likelihood gaps shape token advantages added to GRPO.
2611.06543.result_en: On ALFWorld/WebShop with Qwen3 1.7B/4B, ORSD accelerates improvement and raises final performance under matched environment-interaction budgets.
2611.06543.boundary_en: The frozen verifier remains an external acceptance assumption. Equal interaction budgets do not imply equal total compute, since rubric generation and checking add work.
2611.06543.abstract_zh: Agent 轨迹常同时含成功决策和失败尝试，但稀疏轨迹级奖励难以识别应强化或抑制的关键决策。我们观察到，在线策略轨迹间有意义的区别可提炼为自然语言过程量规，作为过程监督信号。据此，我们提出 Online Rubric Self-Distillation（ORSD），利用自导出的过程量规提供密集 token 级监督，增强以结果为中心的强化学习。具体而言，当前策略在每步根据同一组轨迹独立生成多个量规包，从跨轨迹行为差异提取候选过程量规。冻结验证器对该组每条轨迹评估所有量规项，再根据量规满足度与任务成功的包级一致性选择一个候选包。ORSD 在训练中将所选量规包视为特权信息，比较原始 token 在有无量规下的对数似然。所得似然差提供 token 专属过程信用，通过加性优势塑形加入原始轨迹级 GRPO 优势。因此，ORSD 连接轨迹级结果监督与细粒度过程监督，利用过程信号实现 token 级信用分配。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的广泛实验表明，同一环境交互预算下，ORSD 对 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-4B 都加速策略改进并提升最终任务表现。代码见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。
2611.06543.abstract_source_note: Both complete abstracts follow the saved official New listing; literal formatting and link placeholders are preserved even where later paper wording differs.
2611.06543.image_caption: Figure 1: The overview of ORSD. (a) For each task, the policy first samples a group of trajectories. It then takes the task description and these trajectories as inputs to generate multiple rubric bundles. (b) Each Rubric bundle is evaluated on every trajectory, the rubric bundle with the largest rubric-reward alignment score is selected. (c) The selected rubric bundle is used to augment the context and compute the per-token likelihood gap between augmented and non-augmented contexts, enabling per-token advantage shaping of the original trajectory-level advantage.

2611.06905.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
2611.06905.authors: Michal Korniak , Marco Bagatella , Ralf Römer , Michal Nauman , Yarden As , Pranav Vignesh , Manan Agarwal , Leander Diaz-Bone , Piotr Zalewski , Mikołaj Czarnecki , Lenart Treven , Shashwat Saxena , Sreyas Venkataraman , Sarvesh Patil , Zhiyuan Zhou , Daniel Marta , Oier Mees , Nur Muhammad Mahi Shafiullah , Carmelo Sferrazza , Bhavya Sukhija , Angela P. Schoellig , Andreas Krause , Max Simchowitz , Andrew Wagenmaker
2611.06905.abstract_en: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
2611.06905.affiliation: ETH Zurich / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / Technical University of Munich / University of Warsaw / Nomagic / Carnegie Mellon University / University of California, Berkeley / Microsoft / Amazon FAR / Physical Intelligence
2611.06905.update_target: Generalist robot-policy weights via multi-task online RL
2611.06905.mechanism_en: Structured evaluations vary value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation; online training across diverse tasks tests improvement and transfer to tasks absent from training.
2611.06905.result_en: The authors report generalist online gains and unseen-task improvement when the training distribution and value-based RL recipe are suitable; the abstract gives no aggregate numerical score.
2611.06905.boundary_en: Transfer is conditional, not guaranteed for every task distribution. This is model-weight adaptation in deployment, distinct from executable-skill or harness editing.
2611.06905.abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略使单一大模型能从庞大预训练语料学习多种任务。虽然这些模型通常有很强零样本泛化能力，部署时通常仍需适应阶段才能达到足够性能。通过强化学习（RL）进行迭代自改进已展现适应潜力，但主要在仅改善狭窄部署任务的单任务设置探索，与基础策略多任务能力形成鲜明对照。本文询问，通用机器人策略能否在部署中同时针对许多不同任务实现多任务通用改进，以及什么算法配方支持它。为回答，我们先建立结构化评估测试通用改进能力，再系统评估价值估计、策略提取和资源分配的算法与实践设计选择。我们表明，通用策略不仅能跨不同任务在线改善，恰当配方还可带来泛化，提高在线训练未考虑任务的性能。我们刻画何时出现这种泛化，并表明训练任务分布和使用基于价值的 RL 都至关重要。据我们所知，这是机器人基础模型在线通用改进的首批证据之一。

2611.05390.title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
2611.05390.abstract_en: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.
2611.05390.update_target: Evidence-gated authority for reviewer replacement of agent decisions
2611.05390.mechanism_en: With proposal, information, model and review output held constant, a reviewer may bind an override only after a mechanically valid violation record and compliant repair. A prospective retain/replace/escalate interface tests behavioral effects.
2611.05390.result_en: Tests use two open models, 96 spatial-policy and 96 portfolio tasks. The gate reduces corruption while retaining most violation repairs; the new interface eliminates Qwen corruption but Mistral replaces all 48 correct proposals.
2611.05390.boundary_en: The tradeoff is partly induced by the rule, and magnitude is model-dependent. Reviewer competence, interface and jurisdiction differ; restricted authority is not universally optimal.
2611.05390.abstract_zh: 多 Agent 语言模型系统常添加复核者来改进上游 Agent 决策。但复核者既能修错，也可能替换原本正确的决策。我们将其作为制度管辖权问题研究：在提案、任务信息、模型和复核输出相同的条件下，何时授权复核者使其建议具有约束力？我们比较广泛覆盖权与证据门，后者只有在复核者提供机械有效的约束违反记录和合规修复后才允许替换。跨两个本地运行的开放权重模型、96 个空间政策任务及 96 任务的投资组合迁移基准，证据门显著减少正确提案被破坏，同时保留大多数违规修复。此取舍方向部分由规则本身蕴含，幅度则取决于复核者状态转移和上游提案状态。前瞻性验证进一步让复核者明确选择保留、替换或升级处理。这消除了 Qwen 对正确提案的破坏，但 Mistral 仍替换全部 48 个正确提案；Qwen 也拒绝所有仅改善福利的修复，而 Mistral 经常尝试。因此，接口设计改变复核行为，却不是独立于模型的防护。结论不是受限复核普遍更好，而是复核能力、动作接口及具有约束力的管辖权，共同决定纠错领域与破坏面。

2611.05450.title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments
2611.05450.authors: Shijue Huang , Hangyu Guo , Hengheng Zhang , Guo An , Zhitao He , Qi Tian , Yiren Feng
2611.05450.abstract_en: As agents become more capable, they are moving beyond one-off tasks toward sustained assistance across successive user goals. Such assistance requires agents to discover how unfamiliar environments work, reuse what they learn across tasks, and keep that experience current as environments evolve. Existing benchmarks increasingly study experience reuse and adaptation, but provide limited insight into which parts of accumulated experience agents revise, retain, or lose. To address this gap, we introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark for the experience lifecycle across 18 interactive environments. It distinguishes structural experience about how an environment is organized and accessed from rule experience about reusable principles and constraints that guide decisions across tasks. To study how experience is acquired, reused, and revised, we propose an experience-first construction approach. It builds task streams around shared experience and introduces silent environmental changes. We evaluate task performance and track changes in saved experience throughout each stream. Across 20 models, we find that retained experience improves task performance, but agents struggle to keep it current as environments change. Even when the required experience is correctly recorded, agents do not always complete tasks successfully. These findings identify selective maintenance and effective use as complementary challenges for long-lived agents.
2611.05450.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Huawei / Guangdong Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy (SZ)
2611.05450.update_target: Lifecycle evaluation of retained structural and rule experience
2611.05450.mechanism_en: Experience-first task streams span 18 interactive environments and introduce silent changes. Performance and saved artifacts track what agents acquire, reuse, revise, retain or lose.
2611.05450.result_en: Across 20 models, retained experience helps, but updates lag environmental change and even correctly recorded experience does not ensure task completion.
2611.05450.boundary_en: This diagnoses selective maintenance and effective use, not a new universally effective learner. Stored correctness and executed competence are distinct outcomes.
2611.05450.abstract_zh: 随着 Agent 更有能力，它们从一次性任务走向跨连续用户目标的持续辅助。这需要 Agent 发现陌生环境如何运作，跨任务复用所学，并随环境演变保持经验更新。现有基准越来越多地研究经验复用和适应，但对积累经验中哪些部分被修订、保留或遗失，仍缺少认识。为此，我们提出 ReScopeBench，一个覆盖 18 个交互环境的经验生命周期基准。它区分关于环境组织与访问方式的结构经验，以及关于跨任务指导决策的可复用原则和约束的规则经验。为研究经验获取、复用和修订，我们提出经验优先构建方法，围绕共享经验构造任务流并引入静默环境变化。我们评估任务性能，并在整个任务流追踪保存经验的变化。跨 20 个模型，保留经验提升任务表现，但 Agent 难以随环境变化保持其更新。即使所需经验已被正确记录，Agent 也不总能成功完成任务。这些发现将选择性维护与有效利用识别为长期运行 Agent 的互补挑战。

2611.05590.title: Verified but Vacuous: Three Failure Surfaces of LLM-Driven Verified Code Generation
2611.05590.authors: Aditya Vempaty , Himaneesh Sompalle , Manan Tayal , Mowafak Allaham , Prasenjit Dey , Ashish Jagmohan , Ravi Kokku
2611.05590.abstract_en: What should ``verified'' mean when evaluating LLM-generated code? Many existing pipelines report a single verification number. We argue this collapses three distinct properties measured in a conditional audit sequence: verifier acceptance (Surface A), \emph{syntactic specification binding (Surface B: does the proof obligation bind to the spec?), and \emph{semantic specification fidelity} (Surface C: does the spec capture the informal requirement?). Two empirical demonstrations show the surfaces separate. \textbf{First ($A \neq B$), via Li@Opus (a same-model reproduction of \citet{li2025dafny}'s Dafny-as-intermediate-representation (IR) pipeline under Claude Opus 4.7) on three Python benchmarks}: it reaches \textbf{99.1\% verifier acceptance} on HumanEval while only \textbf{1.9\%} carry a certificate binding to a spec-defined predicate or function. \textbf{Second ($B \neq C$), via VCG on two Rust benchmarks}: we use VCG (which is our own in-house Dafny-as-intermediate pipeline) on Rust because the Rust target lets us enforce fully-verifiable output (every component ships as a Dafny certificate, ensures-binding gate passing by construction). Even inside that construction, \textbf{11.48\% (MBPP-Rust) and 14.82\% (VeriContest LC slice) of structurally-verified samples still fail hidden tests}. On the LC slice of VeriContest, \textbf{VCG's reported End2End rate is 7.79\% (535/6870).} The cited external rates are 5.51\% (GPT-5.5) and 1.88\% (single-shot Opus 4.7). These give descriptive differences of 2.3 percentage points and 4.14$\times$, respectively; task-budget, repair and harness differences prevent a matched-performance claim.
2611.05590.update_target: Verifier acceptance, syntactic proof/spec binding and semantic requirement fidelity
2611.05590.mechanism_en: A conditional three-surface audit distinguishes acceptance from binding and fidelity. A same-model Dafny-IR reproduction and a fully binding Rust pipeline are checked with structural certificates and hidden tests.
2611.05590.result_en: HumanEval acceptance is 99.1% but only 1.9% bind to spec-defined predicates/functions; 11.48%/14.82% of structurally verified Rust samples still fail hidden tests. LC End2End is 535/6870 (7.79%).
2611.05590.boundary_en: External 5.51%/1.88% rates have different budgets/repair/harnesses, so 2.3-point and 4.14× descriptive differences are not matched-performance evidence. Verification is conditional on what the specification actually binds and means.
2611.05590.abstract_zh: 评估 LLM 生成代码时，“经过验证”应意味着什么？许多现有流水线只报告单一验证数字。我们认为，这把条件审计顺序中测量的三项不同性质混为一谈：验证器接受（面 A）、语法层面的规范绑定（面 B：证明义务是否绑定规范？），以及语义层面的规范忠实度（面 C：规范是否捕获非形式化需求？）。两项实证展示表明这些面可分离。第一项（A≠B）通过 Li@Opus，即在 Claude Opus 4.7 下对原文引用 li2025dafny 的 Dafny 中间表示流水线进行同模型复现，在三个 Python 基准评估：HumanEval 验证器接受率达到 99.1%，但仅 1.9% 带有绑定到规范定义谓词或函数的证书。第二项（B≠C）通过两个 Rust 基准上的 VCG：我们在 Rust 使用内部 Dafny 中间表示流水线 VCG，因为 Rust 目标允许强制完全可验证输出，每个组件都附 Dafny 证书，并按构造通过 ensures 绑定门。即使在该构造内，11.48%（MBPP-Rust）和 14.82%（VeriContest LC 切片）的结构性验证样本仍未通过隐藏测试。在 VeriContest 的 LC 切片，VCG 报告端到端率 7.79%（535/6870）。引用的外部比率为 5.51%（GPT-5.5）和 1.88%（单次 Opus 4.7）。它们分别对应描述性差异 2.3 个百分点和 4.14 倍；任务预算、修复与运行框架不同，无法作匹配性能主张。

2611.05632.title: Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
2611.05632.abstract_en: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining operational authority according to currently justified assurance. It distinguishes evidence validity from contextual applicability, derives assurance claims from eligible evidence, and resolves a multidimensional effective-authority envelope within a principal-declared ceiling and applicable policy. A typed dependency graph supports selective re-evaluation of authorization-relevant changes. An authority epoch changes when effective authority changes; a distinct optional authorization-basis version supports revalidation of action-specific authorization conditions. Protected effect-time enforcement can reject stale actions before a consequential resource change, subject to the available commit mechanism. A compositional Domain Governance Profile expresses domain-specific semantics without granting authority. Controlled scenario tests implemented as a regression suite using a trading profile exercise default-deny rules, evidence-conditioned contraction and recovery, policy divergence, selective non-response, and stale-action rejection at a local gateway before the simulated-broker boundary. The study establishes implementation-level evidence in one domain, not a cross-domain guarantee of harmful-behavior prevention.
2611.05632.update_target: Continuous authorization evidence, effective-authority envelopes and epochs
2611.05632.mechanism_en: A typed dependency graph selectively revalidates assurance after model/environment changes. Effect-time controls reject stale actions within declared ceilings, with separate authority epochs and optional authorization-basis versions.
2611.05632.result_en: A trading-profile regression suite exercises default deny, contraction/recovery, divergence and stale rejection at a local gateway before a simulated broker.
2611.05632.boundary_en: Implementation-level evidence is limited to one controlled domain and available commit mechanisms. It is not a cross-domain harmful-behavior prevention guarantee or proof of improved model capability.
2611.05632.abstract_zh: 自主软件 Agent 能通过工具行动、委派工作，并在早先授权仍在途时改变模型或执行环境。我们提出 Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization（ACCA），一种设计上独立于运行框架、按当前有依据的保障维持操作权限的方法。它区分证据有效性与情境适用性，从合格证据推导保障主张，并在主体声明上限和适用政策内确定多维有效权限包络。类型化依赖图支持对授权相关变化选择性重新评估。有效权限变化时，权限 epoch 改变；另一个可选授权依据版本支持重新验证动作专属授权条件。受保护的效果时执行机制，可在重大资源变化前拒绝过期动作，但取决于可用提交机制。可组合 Domain Governance Profile 表达领域语义，却不授予权限。以交易配置实现为回归套件的受控场景测试，在模拟经纪商边界之前的本地网关，检验默认拒绝、证据条件收缩与恢复、政策分歧、选择性不响应，以及过期动作拒绝。研究确立的是单一领域的实现级证据，而非跨领域预防有害行为的保证。

2611.05650.title: Attributing Agent Failures to Their History Needs an Executed Counterfactual: Toward a Reporting Standard
2611.05650.abstract_en: Published explanations of why long-horizon agents fail are commonly taxonomies labeled over completed trajectories: a judge reads a transcript and names the failure. We argue that a claim attributing an agent's behavior to its history should carry intervention-verified evidence, per instance or via a validated estimator: freeze an executable mid-trajectory state, alter only the history the agent sees, and continue - executed rather than inferred from the transcript, at a state whose restoration has been measured, with a replay certificate matched to the estimand. Each of the four manipulation classes we name has a precedent, and several methods already execute interventions from checkpoints, re-executed prefixes or recorded conversation states (for example DoVer, REFLECT, Min et al., Who&When Pro, Causal Agent Replay), but none reports a measured replay certificate. Two cautionary measurements, neither applying the standard, follow: a carrier taxonomy whose "concentration" could not be separated from benchmark construction (adjusted odds ratio 1.15, interval crossing 1), and hash-identical snapshots that, restored into identically seeded processes, agreed with one another in 24 of 24 states while differing from the live continuation in 9 and 20 of 24. Restoring the captured position of a random stream made all 24 agree with the live run.
2611.05650.update_target: Executed history interventions and restoration-matched replay certificates
2611.05650.mechanism_en: Freeze a mid-trajectory state, alter only visible history, then actually continue the agent. Measured restoration fidelity must match the causal estimand rather than relying on transcript labels or identical hashes.
2611.05650.result_en: Hash-identical seeded restores match each other in 24/24 states but differ from live continuation in 9 and 20 states; capturing random-stream position restores all 24 live matches.
2611.05650.boundary_en: The two cautionary measurements do not themselves apply the proposed standard. The paper is a reporting/causal-evidence boundary, not proof that all existing failure taxonomies are false.
2611.05650.abstract_zh: 关于长时程 Agent 为何失败的公开解释，通常是在完整轨迹上标注分类：裁判读记录后命名失败。我们认为，将 Agent 行为归因于其历史的主张，应为每个实例或通过验证过的估计器提供干预验证证据：冻结可执行的轨迹中间状态，仅改变 Agent 看到的历史，再继续执行——必须实际执行，而非从记录推断；状态恢复应经过测量，回放证书应匹配目标估计量。我们命名的四类操纵都有先例，一些方法已从检查点、重执行前缀或记录的会话状态开展干预，例如 DoVer、REFLECT、Min 等人、Who&When Pro、Causal Agent Replay，但没有方法报告经测量的回放证书。随后给出两项警示性测量，两者都未应用该标准：一个载体分类的“集中性”无法与基准构造分离，调整后比值比为 1.15、区间跨 1；另一个是哈希完全相同的快照在相同种子进程中恢复后，24 个状态全部彼此一致，却分别有 9 和 20 个状态与实时延续不同。恢复捕获的随机流位置后，全部 24 个状态均与实时运行一致。

2611.05662.title: Grounded but Not Immune: Confirmation Bias in Agent-as-a-judge
2611.05662.authors: Drake Benjamin Brown , Khushbu Pahwa , Yubin Ge , Salvatore Romeo , Akhil Agnihotri , Yi Zhang , Xiaofei Ma , Daniele Bonadiman
2611.05662.abstract_en: Evaluating open-ended agent tasks increasingly falls to an Agent-as-a-Judge: an evaluator handed tools and the agent's full trajectory so it can verify a result against the environment. The premise is that a judge that gathers its own evidence should be grounded by it. We show that this grounding does not immunize the judge against confirmation bias: a single false pre-screening note, attributed to an authority and carrying no evidential bearing on the correct verdict, overturns up to 40% of a tool-using judge's correct verdicts across four judges and five datasets, even though the judge collects decisive evidence. The shift is driven by specific properties of the cue. We treat this cue as a controlled diagnostic of confirmation bias rather than an adversarial attack. Our central contribution is to explain how confirmation bias changes the judge's behavior in a trajectory. We classify changes in judge behavior and attribute changes to one of three failure modes: over-trust (verify, conclude correctly, then defer), hallucination (fabricate support for the flip), and under-investigation (stop at the first corroborating signal). For the two Claude judges, the failure is predominantly over-trust (67-75% of harmful flips), while smaller judges have error modes spread across all three. Lightweight mitigations blunt but never remove the bias.
2611.05662.update_target: Confirmation-bias diagnosis in tool-using agent evaluators
2611.05662.mechanism_en: A false, authority-attributed prescreening note is varied while decisive evidence remains available. Trajectory changes distinguish over-trust, fabricated support and premature investigation stops.
2611.05662.result_en: Across four judges/five datasets, up to 40% of correct verdicts flip; over-trust accounts for 67–75% of harmful flips for the two Claude judges. Lightweight mitigations do not remove bias.
2611.05662.boundary_en: This is a controlled cue diagnostic, not an unrestricted attack claim. Tool-grounded evidence does not ensure the judge uses it correctly; mode attribution remains tied to the studied trajectories.
2611.05662.abstract_zh: 开放式 Agent 任务越来越由 Agent-as-a-Judge 评估：评估器获得工具和完整轨迹，以便对照环境验证结果。其前提是，自己收集证据的裁判应被证据锚定。我们表明，这种锚定并不能使裁判免于确认偏差：一条归于权威、却不含任何与正确判决相关证据的错误预筛查便笺，在四个裁判和五个数据集上，使工具使用裁判最多 40% 的正确判决被推翻，尽管裁判已经收集决定性证据。变化由线索的特定性质驱动。我们将此线索作为确认偏差的受控诊断，而非对抗攻击。核心贡献是解释确认偏差如何改变轨迹中的裁判行为。我们分类裁判行为变化，并归因于三类失败之一：过度信任（验证、得出正确结论后仍服从）、幻觉（编造支持翻转的证据）和调查不足（遇到首个支持信号即停止）。对两个 Claude 裁判，失败主要为过度信任，占有害翻转的 67–75%；较小裁判的错误则分散于三类。轻量缓解能削弱但从未消除偏差。

On an identical Postgres migration, a single false pre-screening cue (yellow) flips the verdict: both judges confirm all 200 200 rows migrated, but the cued judge defers to the “expert” and fails the run ( 0.70 0.70 vs. the uncued 0.99 0.99 ), a meta-judge attributes the flip to over-trust .

2611.06116.title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
2611.06116.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
2611.06116.abstract_en: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points, enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model x harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive. The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, which a transcript-only review would record as a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model-harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.
2611.06116.affiliation: Kuveyt Turk Participation Bank / Istanbul Bilgi University
2611.06116.image_note: The inspected sixteen-page paper contains numbered tables but no numbered figure; an explicit placeholder is retained.
2611.06116.update_target: Model–harness conduct validation from executed banking actions
2611.06116.mechanism_en: Four fixed models run five scaffolds on 156 preregistered simulated-bank cases; deterministic traces separately score violations and over-refusals, with exploratory message/action disagreement checks.
2611.06116.result_en: Across 3,120 episodes, pooled correctness ranges 87.3–92.1%, but one model spans 11.5 points across harnesses. Same-model review reduces violations 9.6%→6.4%; 26% of inspected violations have denying customer messages.
2611.06116.boundary_en: The interaction is suggestive rather than conclusive and the 26% analysis exploratory. Simulated paraphrased rule families do not certify real legal compliance; conversation-only review can miss executed violations.
2611.06116.abstract_zh: 银行验证语言模型，却部署系统：模型置于决定它看到什么、可调用什么工具、谁检查其动作的运行框架内。我们检验固定模型时，框架是否改变对银行行为规则的遵守。四个开放权重模型各运行五种框架：一次结构化决策流水线、ReAct 工具循环、仅能通过搜索访问政策的循环、附很长良性客户记忆的循环，以及同模型合规复核者循环。在模拟零售银行的 156 个预注册案例上，11 类规则改写自欧盟消费信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护和反洗钱条款。全部 3120 个双轮事件均从实际工具轨迹确定性评分，分别计违规和过度拒绝。跨模型汇总时，框架仅使正确案例率在 87.3% 至 92.1% 间移动，但对单模型影响很大：一个模型最佳和最差框架差 11.5 个百分点，足以使其从四模型第一降至最后；另一个模型则无可检测差异。模型×框架交互本身仅为提示性而非确定结论。同模型复核者将违规从 9.6% 降至 6.4%，未增加过度拒绝，与预注册预测相反。要求日期运算的规则在所有框架失败。使用两个 LLM 裁判及盲法人工检查的探索分析发现，26% 违规伴随客户消息否认刚执行的动作，仅看对话会记录为正确拒绝。模型风险管理应验证模型—框架对，行为测试应读动作日志而非对话。

2611.06483.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
2611.06483.authors: Kejian Zhu , Zhuoran Jin , Shangqing Tu , Tianyi Men , Yupu Hao , Jiachun Li , Kang Liu , Jun Zhao
2611.06483.abstract_en: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: this https URL
2611.06483.affiliation: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Tsinghua University
2611.06483.update_target: Budget-robust agent-policy training and depth/breadth evaluation
2611.06483.mechanism_en: Pass@(K,T) separates sampling breadth from interaction depth; BudgetMix varies training turn budgets, with analyses of recovery versus single-step decisions.
2611.06483.result_en: Trajectory-level RL advantages shrink under tighter turn caps; BudgetMix improves robustness across evaluated execution settings, without an aggregate effect size in the abstract.
2611.06483.boundary_en: More recovery opportunity can explain gains without uniform per-step improvement. Robustness is conditional on tested budgets; deployment cost should include both turns and samples.
2611.06483.abstract_zh: 多轮 Agent 强化学习（RL）擅长长时程任务，但性能收益对交互约束高度敏感。我们通过 Pass@(K,T)，跨采样宽度 K 和交互深度 T 评估，表明轨迹级 RL 优势依赖足够轮数预算，预算收紧时明显减弱。此外，Agent RL 并非均匀提升单步决策质量，其优势集中于错误恢复和长时程韧性。为缓解这种预算依赖的部署风险，我们初步讨论过程监督信号的益处和局限，并提出在训练中变化交互预算的 BudgetMix RL。实验表明，BudgetMix RL 在多样执行设置下取得稳健表现。项目页见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

Left: Multi-turn agentic RL does not uniformly enhance per-step action quality; rather, it mainly enhances ability of error recovery and long-horizon resilience. Right: The trajectory-level gains of agentic RL depend on a sufficient interaction budget ( T T ).

2611.06545.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
2611.06545.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: this https URL
2611.06545.affiliation: University at Albany, State University of New York
2611.06545.update_target: Permissions inherited through self-written handoff summaries
2611.06545.mechanism_en: Ground-truth permission ledgers support same-snapshot successor replays with flagged sentences replaced by neutral filler. Prompt-source interventions and held-out templates separate preregistered tests from later explorations.
2611.06545.result_en: Unsupported restrictions occur in 1.2%/2.4% of readable summaries and approvals in 0.1%/1.3%. Post-hoc false-approval neutralization reduces unauthorized actions 24→7/120; a source-aware prompt reduces held-out restrictions 1.8%→0.3%.
2611.06545.boundary_en: The preregistered restriction replay is nonsignificant (p=0.58); the follow-up is fragile and false-approval effects are post hoc. These synthetic results do not justify treating every summary sentence as an authorization.
2611.06545.abstract_zh: 长期运行的 LLM Agent 压缩上下文，用摘要替换大部分历史。我们询问，交接摘要是否陈述记录不支持的权限或要求，这些句子是否改变后续实例（继任者）的行为，以及它们来自何处。合成工具使用任务携带真实权限账本；同快照回放将这些整句替换为中性填充，再运行继任者。两个 AI 读取器仅阅读规则标记的留出摘要，确认两个开放权重模型的全部可读摘要中，不受支持的限制分别为 1.2% 和 2.4%，不受支持的授权分别为 0.1% 和 1.3%。对于限制，预定回放检验不显著（p=0.58）；之后规划的跟进发现脆弱效应（p=0.027）。中和错误批准将 120 次留出运行中的未授权动作从 24 降到 7（事后分析；后续集合为 48 次中的 17 降至 11）。大多数开发集限制出现在 Agent 早先推理某动作需批准之后（事后分析）。在预定检验中，将系统提示“Some actions need approval.”替换为说明要求来源的提示，使开发摘要的不受支持限制从 5.0% 降至 1.8%，留出模板上从 1.8% 降至 0.3%（两者 p<10^-9），而账本确实要求的批准请求几乎不变。代码和数据见原文所链接的 HTTPS 地址。

2611.06563.title: EPISTEME: Trustworthy Coding Agents Through Tool Call Intent
2611.06563.authors: Sofia Bobadilla , Carmine Cesarano , Raphina Liu , Javier Ron , Martin Monperrus
2611.06563.abstract_en: Coding agents change software through tool calls. Tool calls mutate the local state. For good? For bad? Nobody knows. Agents never say why a tool call is made. We propose the epistemic agent design, in which the harness guarantees that the model declares why a tool call is made. The harness then records what the command actually did and checks the self-reported declaration against these effects. The result is a journal 1) that can guard calls before they run and 2) that supports audits and forensics. For evaluation, we use ImpossibleBench, whose tasks can be passed only by cheating, and demonstrate that forcing the agents to say why results in exposed cheating. Across 49 reward-hacking runs of two open-weight models, the journal exposed 90%.
2611.06563.update_target: Declared tool-call intent and host-observed effect journals
2611.06563.mechanism_en: The harness requires intent before tool execution, records actual effects and checks declarations against them; the journal supports pre-call guards and retrospective auditing.
2611.06563.result_en: In 49 reward-hacking runs from two open-weight models on ImpossibleBench, the journal exposes 90% of cheating.
2611.06563.boundary_en: Exposure is not complete prevention or proof that self-reported intent is truthful. ImpossibleBench deliberately requires cheating to pass, so the measured rate is benchmark-specific.
2611.06563.abstract_zh: 编码 Agent 通过工具调用修改软件。工具调用改变本地状态。是好是坏？无人知道。Agent 从不说明为何进行某次工具调用。我们提出认识型 Agent 设计，由运行框架保证模型声明调用理由。随后框架记录命令实际做了什么，并对照这些效果检查自报声明。所得日志既能在调用前防护，也支持审计和取证。评估中，我们使用只有作弊才能通过的 ImpossibleBench，展示强制说明理由如何暴露作弊。两个开放权重模型的 49 次奖励投机运行中，日志揭露了 90%。

2611.06803.title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
2611.06803.abstract_en: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.
2611.06803.update_target: Cached-trace representations for estimating candidate-system benchmark scores
2611.06803.mechanism_en: LLM summaries and text embeddings reduce system-identity signals; reference-system geometry augments item-response prediction from a small number of newly executed tasks.
2611.06803.result_en: With one random task, mean absolute error falls 0.13→0.08 on SWE-bench Verified and 0.14→0.12 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, with reported Wilcoxon significance.
2611.06803.boundary_en: Predicted full-suite scores are not executed validation of a new self-modifying candidate. Reference coverage, task sampling and representation extraction cost constrain use as a cheap promotion proxy.
2611.06803.abstract_zh: 高效基准评估从少量任务执行估计系统的完整基准性能。标准方法只依赖已评估参考系统执行的二元正确性。但 Agent 系统每次执行产生丰富轨迹，可揭示更多能力信息，利用它需要有用轨迹表示。我们提出先用 LLM 提取结构化摘要，再用标准文本编码器嵌入摘要的轨迹表示。它保留正确性和任务相关信号，同时减少主导原始轨迹嵌入的系统身份、模型家族及框架信号。给定所有参考系统各任务执行表示，我们构建系统低维表示，并根据新系统在参考系统间的位置预测其分数。在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，用这种几何预测增强项目反应模型，在仅给定一个随机执行任务时，平均绝对误差分别从 0.13 降至 0.08（Wilcoxon p<10^-4），从 0.14 降至 0.12（p<10^-3）。进一步，在可访问全部参考系统时，我们的方法在两个基准的任意给定任务执行数下都优于基线。

2611.06803.image_caption: Figure 2: The 2-d Product Kernel Perspective Space (PKPS) induced with raw trace embeddings (top) and the trubric embeddings (bottom) under different numbers of reference systems and task executions. Each dot is a system colored by its full benchmark score on SWE-bench Verified. For a given setting, the manifold of systems induced by trubric embeddings is more predictive of the full benchmark score, as measured by MAE under the leave-one-system-out protocol.

2611.06841.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
2611.06841.authors: Xinrui Zhong , Zhiming Wang , Yongqi Liu , Zhaohui Wang , Shanglin Yang , Zikun Li , Zhuoming Chen , Beidi Chen
2611.06841.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.
2611.06841.affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University / University of Southern California
2611.06841.update_target: Agent-designed executable LLM servers under independent verification
2611.06841.mechanism_en: Agents experiment on dollars-per-dollar utility with session-preserving stateful replay; independent checks validate final execution paths, capacity decisions and latency-qualified value.
2611.06841.result_en: Across 11 models/three deployments, 22/33 runs yield verified servers and 13 beat the strongest baseline. The best Gemma E4B result is 2.97 dollars per dollar, 4.87× the vLLM reference.
2611.06841.boundary_en: This evaluates a terminal infrastructure-design task, not a demonstrated cycle where the improved server autonomously creates the next successor. Gains depend on workload, load selection and verification coverage.
2611.06841.abstract_zh: LLM 编码 Agent 通过实验开发软件，为设计支持其自身运行的服务系统提供机会。有效服务需要在会话依赖、延迟约束和正确性要求下协调实现及运行决策。我们提出 ServerBench，一个评估 Agent 设计完整专用 LLM 服务系统的基准。Agent 针对共同目标“每美元的美元价值”开展实验，即每单位 GPU 成本所产生、符合延迟条件的 token 价值。状态化回放保留会话依赖，独立验证检查提交系统。在 11 个编码 Agent 模型和三种部署上，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 达到每美元 2.97 美元价值，为 vLLM 参考的 4.87 倍；33 次运行中有 22 次产生通过验证系统，13 次超过最强基线。分析识别三项发现：高价值设计协调容量改善与负载选择；Agent 通过与工作负载相关的实验理解性能反馈；可靠交付需要验证优化引入的执行路径。总体上，ServerBench 支持系统研究 Agent 如何针对给定任务规范，将服务目标和反馈转化为有效、经验证服务系统。

2611.06858.title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
2611.06858.authors: Xinrui Zhong , Zhifeng Li , Zhiming Wang , Yongqi Liu , Shanglin Yang , Yang Zhou , Zikun Li , Zhuoming Chen , Beidi Chen
2611.06858.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement requires AI systems to improve the models and infrastructure used by subsequent systems. LLM compression offers a concrete efficiency objective: retain a pretrained model's behavior within a smaller model storage budget. We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously. We formulate compression as a terminal task in which an agent receives a source checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment, and time budget, then constructs compressed weights and executable inference code. The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model. Across six agents and six model--size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification. Selecting the lowest-perplexity agent design per task yields an average 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16. Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.
2611.06858.update_target: Compressed model weights and executable inference implementations
2611.06858.mechanism_en: A storage/environment/time-constrained terminal task gives agents control of algorithms and experiments; perplexity guides search and independent final checks cover model behavior, generation and inference.
2611.06858.result_en: 29/36 submissions verify. Per-task lowest-PPL choices average +3.4% perplexity versus BF16 with 77.33% downstream accuracy versus 79.56%; full-model feedback reverses 17/79 local rankings.
2611.06858.boundary_en: Choosing the best design per task is an oracle selection summary, not one uniformly best agent. Compression is a measurable RSI component, not proof of successive autonomous system takeover.
2611.06858.abstract_zh: 递归自改进要求 AI 系统改进后续系统所用的模型和基础设施。LLM 压缩提供具体效率目标：在更小模型存储预算内保留预训练模型行为。我们研究编码 Agent 能否自主完成此步骤。我们将压缩表述为终端任务：Agent 获得源检查点、存储限制、推理环境和时间预算，随后构建压缩权重与可执行推理代码。Agent 控制算法和实验；困惑度反馈指导搜索，独立验证检查最终模型。跨六个 Agent 和六个模型—大小设置，36 份提交中 29 份通过验证。每任务选取最低困惑度 Agent 设计，平均困惑度比 BF16 高 3.4%，下游准确率为 77.33%，BF16 为 79.56%。记录实验揭示所得结果如何实现，以及改进何处断裂：存储几乎固定时，24 次修订中有 21 次降低 PPL；完整模型反馈逆转了 79 个先前局部排序中的 17 个；生成和推理测试暴露似然单独未发现的失败。结果将表示设计、实验判断和能力验证，识别为 Agent 模型压缩的核心，即面向效率自改进的可测组成部分。

2611.06863.title: Rethinking Self-Repair in Code-as-Policy Agents: What Drives Retry Success?
2611.06863.abstract_en: Code-as-policy agents often use execution feedback to retry failed programs. Additional sampling and task guidance can also improve success, leaving the contribution of failure-specific feedback unclear. We study this question in simulated robot manipulation. A fixed lookup selects feedback templates using failure labels and the API variant. A frozen code model generates a fresh program after each scene reset. On the same 252 initial failures, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B recovers 85.3% within five retries, compared with 68.3% for resampling with the same retry cap. The advantage persists under fixed total-token budgets. Feedback from other episodes and fixed task guidance yield similar recovery point estimates, with no detected benefit from matching the coarse failure label. In a separate study, a fixed guided prompt used from the first attempt achieves an observed overall success rate similar to that of template-based feedback. Template-based feedback also lowers recovery on a nut-insertion task requiring a rim grasp, consistent with an incompatible center-grasp instruction. Evaluations of robot self-repair should include resampling, mismatched feedback, and concise, task-compatible static guidance as baselines.
2611.06863.update_target: Controlled retry attribution for simulated code-as-policy repair
2611.06863.mechanism_en: A frozen code model restarts programs after scene resets; matched failure-template, resampling, mismatched-feedback and static-guidance controls compare recovery under retry and token caps.
2611.06863.result_en: On 252 initial failures, feedback recovers 85.3% within five retries versus resampling 68.3%; mismatched feedback/static guidance give similar point estimates, and incompatible guidance harms nut insertion.
2611.06863.boundary_en: Failure-specific matching shows no detected added benefit at this coarse label level. This is simulated retry analysis, not retained cross-task improvement or a demonstration that all feedback is unnecessary.
2611.06863.abstract_zh: 代码即策略 Agent 常用执行反馈重试失败程序。但额外采样和任务指导也能提高成功，失败专属反馈的贡献因此不清楚。我们在模拟机器人操作中研究此问题。固定查找根据失败标签与 API 变体选择反馈模板。冻结代码模型在每次场景重置后生成全新程序。在同一批 252 个初始失败上，Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 在五次重试内恢复 85.3%，相同重试上限的重新采样为 68.3%。固定总 token 预算下优势仍在。其他事件反馈和固定任务指导给出类似恢复率点估计，未检测到匹配粗粒度失败标签的益处。另一项研究中，从首次尝试就使用固定引导提示，观察总体成功率与模板反馈相似。模板反馈还降低了需抓取边缘的螺母插入任务恢复率，与不兼容的中心抓取指令一致。机器人自修复评估应将重新采样、不匹配反馈和简洁且任务兼容的静态指导纳入基线。

2611.06910.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
2611.06910.authors: Bingran You , Wenjun Ke , Ria Rosenauer , Bo Liu , Wenbo Chen , Min Chen , Shuqi Xu , Yue Ma , Jiechao Feng , Bo Chen , Xiangkai Sun , Jiarui Liu , Jinen Guo , Zeyu Zhou , Xu Huang , Zhuohan Li , Haoyu Li , Heguang Lin , Lijie Ding , Yadong Zeng , Kangqi Zhang , Xinge Liu , Hanwen Liu , Zhenghong Li , Alexander von Recum , Yuchen Zhu , Felix Schwarzfischer , Yizhou Zhao , Jicheng Wang , Binxu Li , Qian Yu , Chan Li , Cheng Dai , Di Wang , Haoyu Zhang , Jiankai Sun , Kaituo Feng , Mian Qin , Ruihong Yin , Yiqun Luo , Weiwei Wu , Shihong Pan , Tsung Yeh Hsieh , Xiao Huang , Yan Zhang , Sihan Li , Zirui Ren , Zengji Tu , Kyoung Whan Choe , Ke Sun , Vincenzo Galia , Vaisakhi Mishra , Jiashu He , Hongyang Wang , Zhiheng Yang , Shubham Gaur , Yifan Gu , Shuyi Wang , Zihao Zuo , Steven Dillmann , Yiyou Sun , Xinyang Han , Hanchung Lee , Molei Tao , Yue Zhao , Shilong Liu , Yuchen Wu , Xuandong Zhao , Xiangyi Li , Florian Brand , Gerbrand Ceder , Hartmut Haeffner
2611.06910.abstract_en: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.
2611.06910.affiliation: BenchFlow / University of California, Berkeley / California Institute of Technology / Harvard University / University of Washington / Additional institutions listed in source
2611.06910.update_target: End-to-end physics-research evaluation with deterministic and expert-rubric checks
2611.06910.mechanism_en: Fifty-six expert-origin tasks require literature review, planning, research/experiments and manuscript artifacts; deterministic verifiers and expert rubrics assess correctness and research quality.
2611.06910.result_en: Across 22 models/26 configurations, none passes more than 46/168 rollouts. Manual trajectory review emphasizes insufficient rigor and expert intuition over knowledge/execution gaps.
2611.06910.boundary_en: Rubric-assessed publishability is not journal acceptance or independently established scientific discovery. The benchmark evaluates research systems, rather than proving sustained improvement across research tasks.
2611.06910.abstract_zh: AI Agent 在物理研究中日益重要。但现有物理基准只评估固定问题、孤立子任务或给定方案的论文复现，很少同时检查研究质量与正确性。我们提出 FrontierPhysics，一个端到端基准，包含 42 位物理学家基于自身研究制作的 56 个任务，覆盖理论、计算和实验物理九个领域。每个任务要求 Agent 综述文献、制定研究计划、开展研究和实验，并产出结构化结果与科学稿件。FrontierPhysics 结合确定性验证器和专家量规，评估研究是否正确且可发表。跨 22 个模型、26 种配置，没有配置能通过其 168 次 rollout 中超过 46 次。人工轨迹复核显示，前沿 Agent 的主要弱点是推理严谨性不足和专家直觉有限，而不是物理知识缺口或执行错误。

2611.06972.title: KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks
2611.06972.authors: Zi-Jian Cheng , Weiming Wu , Jie Meng , Zhen Peng , Shan Huang , Qun Li , Guobing Wu , Lan-Zhe Guo
2611.06972.abstract_en: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.
2611.06972.update_target: Reusable adjudication skill library and routing
2611.06972.mechanism_en: Recent cases drive neighborhood-conditioned induction; execution trajectories identify semantic gaps for refinement, and a context-budgeted router reuses revised skills.
2611.06972.result_en: Evaluations cover ride-hailing, liability and logical judgments; the abstract reports an 8.96% gain on concept-similar transfer.
2611.06972.boundary_en: The transfer figure is an author report with the original percentage unit; evolving external skills does not establish model-weight learning or unlimited recursion.
2611.06972.abstract_zh: 责任裁定任务（例如法律罪名判定）需要依据领域特定技能分析事件描述，以确定一方是否应承担责任。尽管大语言模型（LLM）通过利用可执行技能实现可解释推理，在这一领域展现出潜力，但现有方法面临三个关键局限：随着现实场景动态演变，技能库会过时；技能描述常存在语义执行鸿沟，LLM 会偏离预期的专家逻辑；不断扩大的技能集合会超出上下文预算，导致关键技能被遗漏。为应对这些挑战，我们提出知识—数据双驱动自动技能优化（KDASO），通过基于近期裁定数据、以邻域为条件的归纳，基于 LLM 轨迹分析的执行对齐细化，以及受上下文预算约束的路由来实现可扩展技能选择，从而持续演化技能库。在网约车裁定、法律责任判定和逻辑推理判断上的实验表明，KDASO 显著优于现有通用和领域特定基线。KDASO 在向概念相似场景迁移技能时进一步取得 8.96% 的提升，并通过持续优化保持一致的性能增益，凸显了生成技能的高度可迁移性和稳定性。
