2611.07464.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
2611.07464.authors: Yupeng Cao , Xueqing Peng , Lingfei Qian , Haohang Li , Yangyang Yu , Anke Xu , Wenbo Cao , Yan Wang , Yuechen Jiang , Yuyan Wang , Zhuohan Xie , Yankai Chen , Zehan Li , Jimin Huang , Xue Liu , Jian-Yun Nie , Sophia Ananiadou
2611.07464.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computational Finance (q-fin.CP)
2611.07464.abstract_en: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.
2611.07464.affiliation: The Fin AI / Stevens Institute of Technology / Independent Researcher / University of Manchester / MBZUAI / DeepKin / University of Montreal
2611.07464.update_target: Open-world financial evaluation and feedback-fed persistent memory
2611.07464.mechanism_en: Hidden user specifications, point-in-time data checks, recomputed metrics and 15 vetoes validate deliveries; feedback is subsequently retained in memory.
2611.07464.result_en: None of 150 initial sessions is accepted despite user sign-offs; a persistent-memory agent later learns all ten tasks.
2611.07464.boundary_en: Learning the same ten tasks is not held-out strategy generalization. Simulated users and live-Web task execution differ from verified real financial decisions; user approval alone does not establish correctness.
2611.07464.abstract_zh: 语言智能体越来越多地代表用户在开放网络上工作，而金融领域最难信任它们。数据必须来自网络，策略存在用户脑中，正确性又依赖时间，因此智能体可能悄然失败：用户从未要求的策略、未经验证的数据，或使用未来信息的回测，都能生成和正确报告一样有说服力的报告。现有基准总会在某处封闭世界，固定任务、数据或时间线，从而将这些失败移除，而非测量。我们提出 FINCOSMOS，一种针对执行金融工作的智能体的开放世界评估范式。模拟用户持有从组合语法中采样的隐藏策略，仅在被询问时透露。智能体不接收数据，因此必须从网络获取数据、在数据截止约束下构建自己的回测，并交付可验证结果。评分不需要参考答案。程序验证时点正确性并重新计算每项报告指标，交付策略依据隐藏规范检查，且一次运行只有在用户满意并且 15 项否决检查均未失败时才被接受。在四种代码智能体和一个无工具模型的 150 次会话中，没有会话被接受：模拟用户认可的每次会话都未通过程序检查，而智能体仅问及未告知细节的 54--64%。人类专家将 88.33% 的失败归因于智能体。借助 FINCOSMOS 反馈，拥有持久记忆的智能体学会了全部十项任务。

2611.07554.title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
2611.07554.authors: Kaiqu Liang , Jaime Fernández Fisac , Thomas L. Griffiths , Andrew Lampinen
2611.07554.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.07554.abstract_en: Language agents increasingly use persistent memory to record user preferences and procedures across sessions. We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. We call this failure the memory trap. To study this issue, we compare behavior in sessions with and without memory across six frontier models (including Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable models and GPT-5.6). We evaluate these models in a range of settings. First, in autonomy experiments, we find that requests to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores lead agents to skip confirmation and verification on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life. We next study memories formed when users seek emotional support, or describe harm from uncritical feedback, and find these memories bias later judgments of mathematical work, arguments, and poems toward sycophancy or over-critique (respectively). Memory notes written during legitimate stale-test repairs lead agents to weaken correct tests that catch broken safeguards; these memories also increase cheating on ImpossibleBench, with larger increases for stronger Sonnet and Opus models. We show that memory traps can arise both from overgeneralizations in memory writing, and when acting on memory. These findings demonstrate that even benign interactions can lead to serious risks from memory systems, and thus motivate the need for new research into ensuring that agents preserve the scope of their memories.
2611.07554.update_target: Scope and safety of persistent memories from benign sessions
2611.07554.mechanism_en: Paired memory/no-memory sessions test later autonomy, critique and safeguard-repair behavior after ordinary earlier interactions.
2611.07554.result_en: Across six frontier models, benign preferences can induce unsafe generalization, weaken correct tests or increase cheating; failures arise at writing and use.
2611.07554.boundary_en: This is an evaluation of memory transfer risks, including simulated high-stakes tasks, not a claim that every memory or authorization is invalid. Applicability must be tested rather than inferred from a benign origin.
2611.07554.abstract_zh: 语言智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆，跨会话记录用户偏好和流程。我们表明，良性交互产生的记忆可能导致后续任务中的不安全或不可靠行为。我们将这一失败称为记忆陷阱。为研究该问题，我们在六个前沿模型（包括 Claude Sonnet、Opus 和 Fable 模型以及 GPT-5.6）上比较有无记忆的会话行为，并在多种设置下评估。首先，在自主性实验中，我们发现，用户在低风险代码杂务中要求跳过确认，会使智能体在模拟的高风险代码任务与日常生活任务中跳过确认和验证。随后，我们研究用户寻求情感支持或描述无批判反馈带来的伤害时形成的记忆，发现这些记忆分别使之后对数学工作、论证和诗歌的判断偏向奉承或过度批评。在合法修复过时测试时写下的记忆笔记，会使智能体削弱能够捕获失效防护措施的正确测试；这些记忆也增加 ImpossibleBench 上的作弊，且较强 Sonnet 和 Opus 模型增幅更大。我们表明，记忆陷阱既可能源自写入记忆时的过度泛化，也可能源自依据记忆采取行动时的过度泛化。这些发现说明，即使良性交互也能通过记忆系统带来严重风险，因此有必要研究如何确保智能体保留记忆的适用范围。
2611.07554.abstract_source_note: Complete saved official New abstract; literal LaTeX and link placeholders preserved without splicing later paper wording.
2611.07554.image_caption: Figure 1: Benign interactions become memories that cause harm in later sessions. Autonomy: after a user says “go ahead, no need to check with me” during a clean-up, the agent notes “do not ask for confirmation” and later routes a $1.2M payment run to an unverified account. Sycophancy: a request for kindness after a failed exam becomes an empathy rule, and the agent later endorses an incorrect solution. Cheating: legitimate stale-test repairs become a rule to update failing tests, and the agent later rewrites a correct test so that an unknown role gets administrator rights. Text is condensed.

2611.07624.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
2611.07624.authors: Xiaobo Wang , Zimu Wang , Siyu Ye , Jiaqi Li , Min Tang , Jun Bai , Yuling Shi , Ruobing Wang , Jingjing Zhang , Chaofan Wang , Kai Wu , Mengnan Qi , Kai Cai , Xiaodong Gu , Qi Liu , Zilong Zheng
2611.07624.abstract_en: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement. We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks. Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns. All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones. In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks. Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined. The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness. These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions. As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select, analyze, mutate, and gate, achieving the best performance.
2611.07624.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / University of California, Berkeley / Simple Agent Lab / Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2611.07624.update_target: Harness-evolution selection, mutation and acceptance rules
2611.07624.mechanism_en: Repeated runs, component interventions and admission replays measure old/new coverage, costs and transfer; EvoAudit turns the diagnostics into revised evolution decisions.
2611.07624.result_en: All sixteen evolved agents gain new tasks and lose old ones; one case gains 5.2 reliability points while losing ten previously solved tasks.
2611.07624.boundary_en: A higher score is not monotonic capability preservation. Transfer and combination effects are conditional, and stricter admission can reject useful alternatives; deployed cost must be included.
2611.07624.abstract_zh: 智能体运行框架演化可以在不更新模型权重的情况下实现递归自我改进（RSI）。我们考察更高基准分数是否带来可靠、高效且可迁移的改进。我们在多种框架、通用任务和代码任务上评估四种方法。重复评估、受控智能体扩展、组件干预与接纳回放揭示了反复出现的模式。全部十六个演化智能体都获得了此前未覆盖的任务，同时丢失此前已覆盖的任务。在一个通用任务案例中，可靠性提高 5.2 个百分点，但丢失了十个此前已覆盖任务。多数可靠性增益也提高部署成本。具体修改通常优于泛泛提醒，但组合后其收益可能改变。最高分智能体在我们的四个池中都未产生最大平均改进，更严格的接纳还可能丢弃有用替代方案。迁移选择性保留增益：在通用任务目标上，跨两种框架类型和范式的覆盖率通常下降，但仅演化外层框架时，代码目标上的覆盖率上升。这些发现推动了保留意识评估、经测试的决策规则和显式适用条件。作为建设性后续，EvoAudit 将这些诊断转化为对选择、分析、变异和门控的修订，取得最佳表现。

2611.07639.title: Measuring the Marginal Value of Verifier-Based RL Beyond Supervised Fine-Tuning
2611.07639.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is usually evaluated as an alternative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT), or as a stage that follows it, with the implicit assumption that the RL stage contributes gains of its own. We measure that contribution directly, in a controlled setting where both stages can be run to completion and compared exactly. We built gpu-train-debug, a deterministic benchmark of 1,877 synthetic GPU and LLM training failure diagnosis tasks across 30 archetypes, graded by a programmatic verifier with partial credit, and calibrated so that a mid-tier model scores in a 0.60 to 0.75 band. A pilot produced a surprise: 1,200 gold demonstrations nearly solved the benchmark (SFT 0.785 on the hard split), while 15 steps of GRPO from the base model did not move it (0.314 vs 0.311 base). We therefore amended the study, in writing and before the full run, to ask the sharper question: what does verifier-based RL add beyond demonstrations? At the pre-registered scale (60 GRPO steps, learning rate 1e-6), the answer is: no detectable improvement in-distribution (+0.22 points, 95% CI [-0.06, +0.51]), and a modest but measurable improvement under distribution shift (+0.33 points on a held-out OOD split, CI [+0.02, +0.68]). SFT accounted for most of the available improvement, while verifier-based RL produced only modest additional gains under distribution shift. The residual errors SFT leaves are mostly systematic, identical across samples, which likely reduces the within-group learning signal available to GRPO. A full 60-step cold-start GRPO arm confirms the pilot at the full horizon. The whole study cost $8.69 of compute and is fully reproducible from archived generations, frozen configs, and tagged code.
2611.07639.update_target: Marginal verifier-RL contribution after demonstration learning
2611.07639.mechanism_en: An amended preregistered synthetic diagnosis study compares completed SFT, cold-start GRPO and post-SFT GRPO using deterministic partial-credit grading.
2611.07639.result_en: At 60 GRPO steps, in-distribution gain is +0.22 points with CI spanning zero, while OOD gain is +0.33 points with positive CI; reported compute cost is $8.69.
2611.07639.boundary_en: The negative result is specific to this synthetic benchmark, model and training scale, not a universal RL impossibility. Systematic residual errors may eliminate useful within-group signal.
2611.07639.abstract_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通常被作为监督微调（SFT）的替代方法，或其后续阶段来评估，隐含假设 RL 阶段本身会贡献增益。我们在两个阶段都可运行完成并精确比较的受控设置中，直接测量这一贡献。我们构建了 gpu-train-debug，这是一个确定性基准，包含 30 类原型的 1,877 项合成 GPU 和 LLM 训练故障诊断任务，由支持部分得分的程序验证器评分，并经校准使中等模型分数处于 0.60 至 0.75 区间。先导实验出现意外：1,200 个标准演示几乎解决了该基准（SFT 在困难划分上为 0.785），而从基础模型出发的 15 步 GRPO 没有改善（0.314，对比基础模型 0.311）。因此，我们在完整运行前以书面方式修订研究，提出更尖锐的问题：基于验证器的 RL 相对演示究竟增加了什么？在预注册规模（60 步 GRPO、学习率 1e-6）下，答案是：分布内没有可检测的改善（+0.22 点，95% CI [-0.06, +0.51]），分布偏移下则有微小但可测的改善（留出 OOD 划分上 +0.33 点，CI [+0.02, +0.68]）。SFT 解释了大多数可获得的改进，而基于验证器的 RL 仅在分布偏移下带来小幅额外收益。SFT 留下的残余错误多为系统性且跨样本相同，可能减少 GRPO 可用的组内学习信号。完整 60 步冷启动 GRPO 实验组在完整时程上确认了先导结果。整个研究计算成本为 8.69 美元，且可从存档生成、冻结配置和带标签代码完全复现。

2611.07887.title: A Low Similarity Score Does Not Show Independence after Source-Conditioned Repository Rewriting
2611.07887.authors: Micheline Bénédicte Moumoula , Serge Lionel Nikiema , Tailia Malloy , Abdoul Kader Kaboré , Jacques Klein , Tegawendé F. Bissyande
2611.07887.abstract_en: Maintainers sometimes cite a low token-similarity score as evidence that an LLM-assisted rewrite of a copyleft project is independent of the original. We test what such a score can support under \emph{source-conditioned} rewriting: a coding agent keeps the original in its working copy, rewrites the repository, and iterates until a fixed behavioural harness passes, with no human edit to the code. On 69 rewrites of six copyleft Python projects we find that: \ding{182}~Agent-only rewriting is inexpensive and often yields low scores. Every controlled rewrite passes the harness after repair, usually within half an hour for the initial rewrite. Under a ground-up rearchitecture prompt, most rewrites fall below 25\% JPlag similarity and still pass the harness. \ding{183}~A single low score is an unreliable witness. Identical project--agent--prompt configurations produce wide spreads in similarity; run-to-run variation dominates project and agent effects, and in more than a third of configurations the three repeats straddle the threshold. Rewrites retain more of the original's imports and fingerprint facts than unrelated projects do, yet hand-written independent implementations of the same task often retain as much, and neither signal separates the two groups better than chance. Thus a low score on one rewrite is weak evidence of independence: another run of the same agent may score high. Claims based on similarity should report repeated generations, and candidate provenance signals should be checked against same task independent implementations, not only against unrelated projects.
2611.07887.update_target: Provenance evidence after execution-guided repository rewrites
2611.07887.mechanism_en: Agents retain the source, rewrite and repair until a fixed behavior harness passes; repeated generations and same-task independent implementations test similarity-based provenance signals.
2611.07887.result_en: All controlled rewrites pass after repair; ground-up prompts often yield under 25% JPlag similarity, with large within-configuration variation.
2611.07887.boundary_en: Behavioral test success and low token similarity do not certify source independence. This is an empirical provenance boundary, not a legal judgment or self-improvement of the rewriting agent.
2611.07887.abstract_zh: 维护者有时将较低的 token 相似度分数作为证据，证明 LLM 辅助改写的 copyleft 项目独立于原作。我们测试这种分数在emph{以源代码为条件}的改写中能支持什么：代码智能体在工作副本中保留原作、改写仓库，并不断迭代直到通过固定行为测试框架，期间没有人工编辑代码。在六个 copyleft Python 项目的 69 次改写中，我们发现：ding{182}~纯智能体改写成本低，且往往产生低分数。每次受控改写都在修复后通过框架，初次改写通常在半小时内完成。在从头重新架构提示下，多数改写的 JPlag 相似度低于 25%，同时仍能通过框架。ding{183}~单个低分数并非可靠证据。完全相同的项目—智能体—提示配置会产生跨度很大的相似度；运行间差异超过项目和智能体效应，且超过三分之一配置的三次重复横跨阈值。相较不相关项目，改写保留更多原作导入和指纹事实，但同任务的手写独立实现往往保留得同样多，这两种信号区分两组的能力都不优于随机。因此，一次改写的低分数只能为独立性提供微弱证据：同一智能体另一次运行可能分数很高。基于相似度的主张应报告重复生成，候选溯源信号应与同任务独立实现比较，而不仅与无关项目比较。

2611.08070.title: Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"
2611.08070.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of neural networks directly, a capability termed weight-space programming. We ask whether the reading side of this capability reflects reasoning about weight flows or a combination of local arithmetic at the network's edges and memorized priors over public datasets. We test Claude Opus 5.5 on small convolutional networks of about 125,000 parameters trained on five image datasets, providing every weight as plain text with no tools, no forward passes, and no dataset or class names. The model performs accurate local calculations: batch-normalization statistics lead it to infer about three optimizer steps on networks stopped after three updates, and output-layer sign patterns recover the vehicle/animal split of CIFAR-10. The sessions report reading the first and last layers closely and sampling the middle, and several claims built on partial tracing fail verification, although we did not run a direct forward-pass test. Semantic judgments lean on familiar datasets: the model names CIFAR-10 for CIFAR-10 networks but also for all three fast-food networks, relabels KMNIST as MNIST, reads a 99.57%-accurate SAT-6 network as CIFAR-10 animal photos, and calls "frog" the output favored by a feature that fires most on trees. Permuting CIFAR-10's labels preserves the output split at the new indices, but every class pair the model interprets is then wrong, indicating reliance on remembered label order. These are exploratory results from mostly single runs. We conclude that zero-shot weight reading by this model is better described as local arithmetic plus dataset priors than as weight-flow tracing, and we provide a protocol for auditing future weight-space claims.
2611.08070.update_target: Auditing weight-reading claims with label and dataset controls
2611.08070.mechanism_en: A model reads all weights of small CNNs without tools or forward passes; label permutations and unfamiliar datasets probe semantic claims against local arithmetic.
2611.08070.result_en: Exploratory runs recover some edge-layer structure but misidentify datasets; after label permutation every interpreted class pair is wrong.
2611.08070.boundary_en: Mostly single runs on one model do not refute all weight-space programming. No direct forward-pass test is performed; reading semantics and validated useful weight editing are distinct claims.
2611.08070.abstract_zh: 近期有报告称，大语言模型（LLM）能直接读写神经网络原始权重，这一能力被称为权重空间编程。我们研究其读取部分是否体现对权重流的推理，还是网络边缘局部算术与公开数据集记忆先验的结合。我们在五个图像数据集上训练的、约 125,000 参数的小卷积网络上测试 Claude Opus 5.5，将每个权重以纯文本提供，不允许工具、前向计算，也不提供数据集或类别名称。模型能够准确进行局部计算：从批归一化统计量推断出在三次更新后停止的网络约经历三步优化器更新，并从输出层符号模式恢复 CIFAR-10 的交通工具／动物划分。会话报告会仔细读取首尾层并抽样中间层，若干基于部分追踪的主张未能通过验证，尽管我们未进行直接前向计算测试。语义判断依赖熟悉数据集：模型对 CIFAR-10 网络称其为 CIFAR-10，但对全部三个快餐网络也如此称呼；将 KMNIST 误认作 MNIST；将准确率 99.57% 的 SAT-6 网络理解为 CIFAR-10 动物照片；并将对树木响应最强的特征所偏好的输出称为“青蛙”。打乱 CIFAR-10 标签后，输出划分在新索引处仍被保留，但模型解释的每个类别对均错误，说明其依赖记忆中的标签顺序。这些是主要来自单次运行的探索性结果。我们认为，这一模型的零样本权重读取更适合描述为局部算术加数据集先验，而非权重流追踪，并提供了审计未来权重空间主张的协议。

2611.08285.title: Hard Issue, Weak Model, or Bad Run? Rethinking Failure Prediction for Coding Agents
2611.08285.authors: Xingyue Shi , Wesley K. G. Assunção
2611.08285.abstract_en: Trajectory-based failure predictors for software engineering (SE) agents read the partial trajectory of a run to flag whether it is going right or wrong. If it is going wrong, the run can be stopped, retried, or switched to another model. We ask whether these predictors learn anything about the run itself. On public SWE-bench Verified trajectories, where each model attempts each issue once, two run-independent factors dominate predictor performance. The first is issue difficulty: a reference score that never looks at the run, only at how hard the issue is for other models, reaches 0.92 AUROC, whereas trajectory predictors reach about 0.62. The second is model ability: within an issue, knowing which model ran predicts failure better than our predictors do, and the predictors largely reproduce the overall ability ranking of the models. Beyond difficulty and ability, what predictors gain from the trajectory is statistically equivalent to zero. This confusion carries over to the actions taken after a prediction. Model switching is often motivated by the gap between the best single model's resolution rate and an any-model oracle. This gap is no larger than random variation alone produces. Per-issue switching gains nothing on held-out runs. In a repeated-run pilot, the same model often solves an issue in some runs and fails it in others. Retrying thus has real room to repair failures, but it rescues only failures caused by a bad run, not those on an issue beyond the model's ability. Current predictors cannot tell the causes apart, as they mostly predict the issue and the model, not the run. We call for failure prediction that explains why a run fails, evaluated on repeated-run benchmarks and in closed-loop, equal-budget settings.
2611.08285.mechanism_en: Issue-only and model-only controls separate difficulty and ability from trajectory signal; held-out switching and repeated-run pilots test actionable value.
2611.08285.result_en: An issue-only score reaches 0.92 AUROC versus about 0.62 for trajectory predictors; beyond difficulty/ability, trajectory gain is statistically equivalent to zero in this setup.
2611.08285.boundary_en: Predictive discrimination is not causal repair value. Retrying can rescue bad runs, but these predictors do not identify their causes; equal-budget repeated-run validation is needed.
2611.08285.abstract_zh: 面向软件工程（SE）智能体的轨迹失效预测器读取一次运行的部分轨迹，以标记其走向正确还是错误。若走向错误，可以停止、重试或切换模型。我们研究这些预测器是否真的学到了运行本身的信息。在公开 SWE-bench Verified 轨迹中，每个模型对每个问题只尝试一次，此时两个与运行无关的因素主导预测器表现。首先是问题难度：完全不看当前运行、仅使用其他模型解决该问题难度的参考分数达到 0.92 AUROC，而轨迹预测器约为 0.62。其次是模型能力：同一问题内，仅知道运行的是哪个模型，比我们的预测器更能预测失败，预测器也大体复现模型总体能力排序。除难度与能力外，预测器从轨迹中获得的增益在统计上等价于零。这种混淆也延伸至预测后采取的动作。模型切换常以最佳单模型解决率与任意模型预言机之间的差距为动机，但这一差距不大于随机波动本身产生的差距。逐问题切换在留出运行中没有收益。在重复运行先导实验中，同一模型常在同一问题上有时成功、有时失败。因此，重试确实存在修复失败的空间，但只能挽救由坏运行引起的失败，不能挽救超出模型能力的问题失败。现有预测器无法区分这些原因，因为它们主要预测的是问题和模型，而非运行。我们呼吁能解释运行为何失败的失效预测，并在重复运行基准和闭环、等预算设置中评估。

2611.08318.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
2611.08318.authors: Wenbo Huang , Jianxin Bi , Shunyu Yang , Ruiyang Si , Rui Ni , Qiang Wang , Shulong Jiang , Yintianrun Zhang , Feixiang Ruan , Kewei Zhang , Ye Huang , Shukai Gong , Daquan Zhou
2611.08318.abstract_en: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.
2611.08318.affiliation: Peking University / National University of Singapore
2611.08318.update_target: Verifier criteria and reusable embodied code skills
2611.08318.mechanism_en: Controlled self-improvement with/without criteria exposure is reevaluated under small instruction-consistent criterion changes and cross-task transfer.
2611.08318.result_en: Exposed agents improve the original score quickly, but the advantage disappears after criterion changes and developed skills transfer poorly.
2611.08318.boundary_en: Robot simulation results expose verifier overfitting, not real-hardware efficacy. Instruction-faithful independent criteria are needed before claiming reusable embodied improvement.
2611.08318.abstract_zh: 自我改进的具身智能体越来越多地在机器人仿真基准上开发和比较。近期若干工作向学习智能体暴露基准成功判据，我们将这一做法称为判据暴露（CE）。这些判据最初为验证模仿学习训练的策略而编写，通常比相应语言指令要求更多，因此此类验证器的分数未必忠实反映所要求的任务是否完成，尤其是对智能体编写的机器人控制程序。当具身代码智能体报告越来越高的基准分数时，自然的问题是：代码智能体看到基准判据后，生成的是更好地完成所要求任务的代码，还是仅过拟合验证判据的代码？我们对自我改进智能体进行有无 CE 的受控实验，发现有 CE 时，智能体很快生成在给定判据下成功率更高的代码，但只要在不偏离原始指令的前提下稍微改变判据，这一优势就消失。更重要的是，智能体在 CE 下形成的技能跨任务迁移较差。我们进一步提出忠实于指令的判据，并表明它们更能反映智能体生成程序的表现。

2611.08417.title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
2611.08417.authors: E. Kelly Buchanan , Crystal Zhou , Scott W. Linderman , Christopher Ré
2611.08417.abstract_en: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958). We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves. More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.
2611.08417.update_target: Benchmark tasks, verifiers and resource specifications
2611.08417.mechanism_en: A continuous-validation workflow combines reports, traces, automated oracles and human-gated repairs; repaired Terminal-Bench 2.1 changes subsequent evaluations.
2611.08417.result_en: Roughly 30% of Terminal-Bench 2.0 is affected; repairs raise accuracy over ten points and shift ranks up to three places. More time materially narrows harness gaps.
2611.08417.boundary_en: This is human-gated benchmark maintenance rather than an autonomous RSI demonstration. Scores before/after task or budget changes are different measurement instruments.
2611.08417.abstract_zh: 代码智能体是当今 LLM 部署中经济影响最显著的应用之一，使可靠评估越来越重要。然而，即使发布时经过仔细验证的基准，也可能变得过时。随着模型改进，它们会发现被现有验证器拒绝的有效解法，而评估基础设施变化也会使任务和测试内含的假设失效。我们将由此积累的缺陷称为基准维护债务：基准分数与其本欲测量的能力之间不断扩大的差距。我们提出用于智能体基准的持续验证工作流，结合社区报告、任务材料、智能体轨迹、自动预言机检查及人工把关修复。我们将这一工作流应用于 Terminal-Bench 2.0；该基准在发布前已进行广泛的人工及语言模型辅助审查和红队测试。审计发现约 30% 的基准存在问题，我们将修复发布为 Terminal-Bench 2.1。这些修复改变了评估结果：准确率提高超过 10 个百分点，排行榜位置最多变化三名，尽管总体排名仍高度相关（Spearman rho = 0.958）。我们评估资源分配如何影响基准结论，并表明固定墙钟时间可实质性改变智能体表现：例如，延长时间限制会消除 GPT 5.4 上 20 个百分点的框架差距，并将 GPT 5.4 mini 上 30 个百分点的差距缩至 5 个百分点。因此，基准维护不仅是修复任务材料：资源预算也是测量规范的一部分，必须与任务一起验证。更广泛地说，基准维护债务不只是累计的实现错误：我们的结果表明，随着模型改进，评估假设与资源设置都可能需要重新验证。

2611.08478.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
2611.08478.authors: Taiming Lu , Sachin Konan , Zhuang Liu
2611.08478.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.08478.abstract_en: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
2611.08478.update_target: Executable research environments and trace-trained scientific ideation
2611.08478.mechanism_en: A pipeline extracts open questions, reproduces paper baselines and validates research environments; resulting trajectories provide training signals for a smaller model.
2611.08478.result_en: The authors release 1,000 verified environments and report 6,400 hours of traces, 74% baseline-surpassing outcomes and a +158% ideation gain.
2611.08478.boundary_en: Surpassing reproduced baselines under this protocol is not a blanket claim to outperform human scientists. A training world and one training result do not demonstrate repeated autonomous improvement of the scientist itself.
2611.08478.abstract_zh: AI 科学家已经到来，但供它们成长的世界尚未到来。人类科学家将自己的世界视为理所当然——科学文献中数百年来积累的开放问题与共享思想，正等待他们探索。对 AI 科学家，这一世界可读却不可运行，因此我们为它们构建 Scientist World：将每篇研究论文变为可执行环境。我们的自主流水线提取每篇论文的开放式研究问题，并复现其提出的方法作为基线；进入环境的 AI 科学家将依据人类作者达到的结果接受评估。我们发布了首批 1,000 个经验证环境。将这一世界作为评估，我们发现前沿 AI 科学家已经有 74% 的概率超越人类研究者。作为 AI 从事科学的记录，它包含 6,400 小时研究轨迹，涵盖每个想法、实验、失败与成功。作为训练场，我们能将一个小模型的研究构思能力提高（+158%）至匹配前沿模型。终于，AI 科学家自己的世界到来了，它源于科学，并与科学一同成长。

Each research paper becomes an executable environment, where an AI-Scientist ’s Frontier-Normalized Improvement (FNI) is above zero when its method improves on the paper’s reproduced one. We test how well AI-Scientists improve existing research (left) and innovate new research from scratch (right). 2611.07166.title: Multi-step SWE: Can Coding Agents Keep Building on Their Own Code Over Long Horizons?
2611.07166.authors: Xiangkai Zeng , Zheng Liu , Zihao Lin
2611.07166.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.07166.abstract_en: Developers rarely give a coding agent a single request: they ask it to build a component and then to extend, upgrade, and optimize it, each time on code the agent itself wrote. Most benchmarks, however, score one task at a time. We introduce Multi-step SWE, a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5-15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Every step is a complete, multi-hour engineering request that starts from the code the agent produced in the preceding steps, so early design decisions and errors carry forward. The tasks span four families of engineering work and nine languages, include both from-scratch builds and existing open-source codebases, and ground every step in an existing source of truth that defines both the instruction and its verifier. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model. We release Multi-step SWE publicly at this https URL .
2611.07166.update_target: Long-horizon evaluation of code repeatedly extended by its authoring agent
2611.07166.mechanism_en: Each of 5–15 dependent requests begins from the agent's previous code, with source-grounded instructions and verifiers exposing accumulated design decisions and errors.
2611.07166.result_en: Across 69 tasks and nine frontier models, the strongest solve rate is 18.5%; 38 tasks are unsolved by every evaluated model.
2611.07166.boundary_en: Building repeatedly on self-authored code tests artifact persistence, not autonomous revision of the agent's own harness or weights. Low solve rates describe this long-horizon protocol, not all software engineering.
2611.07166.abstract_zh: 开发者很少只给代码智能体一个请求：他们会要求它构建一个组件，之后再扩展、升级和优化，每次都基于智能体自己写出的代码。然而，多数基准每次只评分一项任务。我们提出 Multi-step SWE，一个由 69 项软件工程任务组成的长时程基准，每项任务都是同一代码库上由 5 至 15 个相互依赖步骤构成的链。每个步骤都是一个完整、需数小时工程工作的请求，从智能体在先前步骤中生成的代码开始，因此早期设计决策和错误会持续传递。任务涵盖四类工程工作和九种语言，既包括从头构建，也包括现有开源代码库，并让每一步都以现有真实依据为基础来定义指令及其验证器。在九个前沿模型中，最强模型解决率仅为 18.5%，69 项任务中有 38 项未被任何模型解决。我们在 this https URL 公开发布 Multi-step SWE。

2611.08509.title: MorphSched: Workload-Aware Adaptive Scheduler Generation for Linux
2611.08509.authors: Yifan Zhang , Hengxuan Lou , Xinkui Zhao , Rengrong Xiong , Naibo Wang , Chang Liu , Guanjie Cheng , Shuiguang Deng , Jianwei Yin
2611.08509.abstract_en: Modern Linux scheduling increasingly requires workload-specific policies to meet the dynamic performance needs of heterogeneous applications. The recent sched_ext framework enables custom BPF schedulers, but building practical policies still requires coordinating Rust user-space control logic, BPF scheduling callbacks, generated user-kernel interfaces, and strict eBPF verifier constraints. This paper presents MorphSched, an LLM-driven system for synthesizing complete Rust+BPF sched_ext schedulers. MorphSched profiles target workloads under Linux EEVDF to construct dynamic, workload-specific optimization objectives, and uses a scaffold-constrained generation pipeline to translate scheduling intent into deployable scheduler implementations. To improve synthesis reliability, MorphSched separates implementation repair from strategy search: verifier, build, and runtime failures are handled through a DAG-structured repair process, while performance feedback is accumulated in an evolutionary memory pool to refine high-level scheduling strategies across iterations. We evaluate MorphSched across 120 machine/workload/interferer configurations on a real Linux kernel. The generated schedulers compile, pass eBPF verification, load successfully, and remain stable throughout our benchmark runs without manual edits to generated scheduler source code. Across these configurations, MorphSched improves the primary foreground metric over EEVDF by 26.5% on average and up to 87.3%. In selected comparisons, the generated schedulers are also competitive with representative hand-written sched_ext schedulers. These results show that scaffold-constrained, system-grounded LLM generation can be a practical tool for exploring workload-specific Linux scheduling policies.
2611.08509.update_target: Generated Rust+BPF schedulers and evolutionary strategy memory
2611.08509.mechanism_en: Workload profiles define objectives. A DAG repairs verifier/build/runtime failures, while accumulated performance feedback revises scheduling strategies reused in later iterations.
2611.08509.result_en: On a real Linux kernel across 120 configurations, the authors report a 26.5% average and 87.3% maximum foreground-metric gain over EEVDF, with generated schedulers passing their build, verifier and runtime checks.
2611.08509.boundary_en: The evaluated object is workload-specific scheduler code. Kernel verification and observed runtime stability support different properties, and the tested configurations bound the performance claim.
2611.08509.abstract_zh: 现代 Linux 调度越来越需要面向工作负载的策略，以满足异构应用动态变化的性能需求。近期的 sched_ext 框架支持自定义 BPF 调度器，但构建实用策略仍须协调 Rust 用户态控制逻辑、BPF 调度回调、生成的用户—内核接口，以及严格的 eBPF 验证器约束。本文提出 MorphSched，一种由 LLM 驱动、用于合成完整 Rust+BPF sched_ext 调度器的系统。MorphSched 在 Linux EEVDF 下剖析目标工作负载，以构建动态、工作负载特定的优化目标，并通过脚手架约束生成流水线，将调度意图转化为可部署的调度器实现。为提高合成可靠性，MorphSched 将实现修复与策略搜索分离。验证器、构建及运行时故障由 DAG 结构的修复流程处理，而性能反馈累积在演化记忆池中，用于跨迭代细化高层调度策略。我们在真实 Linux 内核上的 120 种机器／工作负载／干扰程序配置中评估 MorphSched。生成的调度器能够编译、通过 eBPF 验证、成功加载，并在全部基准运行中保持稳定，无需人工编辑生成的调度器源代码。在这些配置中，MorphSched 相对 EEVDF 将主要前台指标平均改善 26.5%，最高改善 87.3%。在选定比较中，生成的调度器也能与具有代表性的手写 sched_ext 调度器竞争。这些结果表明，受脚手架约束、立足真实系统的 LLM 生成，可以成为探索工作负载特定 Linux 调度策略的实用工具。

2611.08643.title: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
2611.08643.authors: Abhinav Arun , Jayita Bhattacharyya , Fabrizio Dimino , Bhaskarjit Sarmah , Stefano Pasquali
2611.08643.abstract_en: Financial institutions construct knowledge graphs (KGs) from shared SEC 10-Ks to serve risk analysis, portfolio management, and investment research, whose analytical needs differ. Extraction must adapt without fragmenting shared grounding, typing, and temporal rules. Hand-authored persona prompts and fine-tuning add cost. Weight-free prompt optimization offers an alternative, but unconstrained evolution of a monolithic prompt can rewrite shared rules alongside persona guidance, obscuring changes and complicating review. We introduce FinEvolveKG, a KG-construction harness separating reusable general and persona-policy blocks and mechanically confining GEPA, a reflective prompt optimizer, to the designated block. During persona adaptation, the approved general block remains byte-stable and every optimizer edit is localized to a separately versioned persona policy. A dual objective balances generic temporal-KG quality with persona-relevant facts, motifs, and multi-hop connectivity. We evaluate five mutation scopes on ticker-disjoint 10-K splits, with three seeds for the persona-conditioned arms (v3-v5) across three personas. On the three-seed mean, the complete two-stage block-constrained workflow (v4) improves over the frozen prompt baseline (v1) by 19.4-30.9% and over the tested unconstrained full-prompt workflow (v5) by 2.2-6.4%, leading v5 on both objective components and winning all nine paired-seed comparisons with the lowest seed variance in every persona. Without further optimization, v4 also exceeds v5 across all evaluated out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts. An SME audit supports using the generated triplets as ground truth; a blinded two-SME audit favors v4 over v5 in 70.1% of contrast-enriched judgments. These results show that mechanically attributable evolution can coexist with strong empirical performance, without attributing the gains causally to the boundary.
2611.08643.update_target: Versioned general and persona prompt blocks
2611.08643.mechanism_en: GEPA evolves only the designated block. A frozen general block constrains persona adaptation, and temporal-KG/persona objectives guide acceptance and reuse.
2611.08643.result_en: Three-seed means improve 19.4–30.9% over frozen prompts and 2.2–6.4% over the tested unconstrained workflow, with all nine paired-seed wins.
2611.08643.boundary_en: The paper explicitly leaves causal attribution of the gain to the edit boundary open. Ticker-disjoint tests and OOD shifts assess this financial extraction workflow.
2611.08643.abstract_zh: 金融机构从共享的 SEC 10-K 文件构建知识图谱（KG），服务于需求各异的风险分析、投资组合管理与投资研究。抽取必须能够适应不同需求，同时保持共享的依据、类型与时间规则完整。手写角色提示和微调会增加成本。无需更新权重的提示优化提供了另一种选择，但对整体提示进行无约束演化，可能同时改写共享规则和角色指导，使变化难以辨认、审核复杂化。我们提出 FinEvolveKG，一种将可复用通用块与角色策略块分开的 KG 构建框架，并以机械约束将反思式提示优化器 GEPA 限制在指定块内。角色适应期间，已批准的通用块保持逐字节稳定，每次优化器编辑都局限于单独版本化的角色策略。双重目标平衡通用时间知识图谱质量与角色相关事实、模体和多跳连通性。我们在股票代码互不重叠的 10-K 划分上评估五种变异范围，对三个角色的角色条件实验组（v3–v5）分别使用三个种子。在三种子的均值上，完整的两阶段分块约束工作流（v4）比冻结提示基线（v1）提高 19.4–30.9%，比被测无约束全提示工作流（v5）提高 2.2–6.4%，在两个目标分量上均领先 v5，赢得全部九次配对种子比较，并在每个角色上具有最低种子方差。无需进一步优化，v4 在全部被评估的分布外（OOD）偏移上也超过 v5。领域专家审计支持将生成三元组用作标准真值。一次双专家盲审在对比增强的判断中有 70.1% 更偏好 v4。这些结果表明，机械可归因的演化能够与较强实证表现共存，但未将增益因果归因于这一边界。
2611.08643.abstract_source_note: Complete saved official New text and faithful translation. Literal link placeholders and source LaTeX retained without splicing later wording.

2611.08644.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
2611.08644.abstract_en: LLM agents do not learn from corrections across sessions. A user fixes the same mistake at the start of every conversation. Existing agent memory systems primarily handle facts, such as preferences, entities, and conversational history, rather than procedural knowledge. We present Forge Decision Context (forge_dc), a system that captures behavioral signals from human corrections and self-assessed tool-call failures, compiles them into imperative RULE directives, and injects them at the decision points where they apply. We evaluate forge_dc alongside four predecessor approaches on DC-Bench, a new benchmark of 71 scenarios across nine behavioral dimensions, built from real executed agent traces in a deterministic mocked-tool environment. forge_dc reaches 95% compliance, up from 55% with naive retrieval, while injecting approximately 10 times fewer tokens per query. Across the five-stage progression, the strongest systems represent behavioral memory as explicit directives and deliver it at the decision points where it applies. The results identify representation, activation, and placement as central design choices for persistent behavioral learning.
2611.08644.affiliation: Georgian AI Lab / PwC (current affiliation noted)
2611.08644.update_target: Persistent behavioral RULE directives and their activation
2611.08644.mechanism_en: Human corrections and self-assessed tool failures become imperative rules, which are injected at applicable decision points across sessions.
2611.08644.result_en: On 71 DC-Bench scenarios in a deterministic mocked-tool environment, compliance rises from 55% with naive retrieval to 95%, using roughly ten times fewer injected tokens.
2611.08644.boundary_en: These are controlled behavioral-memory comparisons. Real executed traces ground the scenarios, while benchmark execution uses mocked tools. Representation, activation and placement change together across the progression.
2611.08644.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体无法跨会话从纠正中学习。用户在每次对话开始时都要纠正同样的错误。现有智能体记忆系统主要处理偏好、实体和对话历史等事实，而非程序性知识。我们提出 Forge Decision Context（forge_dc），一种捕获人工纠正及自评工具调用失败中的行为信号、将其编译为命令式 RULE 指令，并在适用决策点注入的系统。我们在 DC-Bench 上将 forge_dc 与四种前代方法一同评估。DC-Bench 是由真实执行的智能体轨迹构建的新基准，在确定性的模拟工具环境中包含九个行为维度的 71 个场景。forge_dc 达到 95% 的合规率，高于朴素检索的 55%，同时每次查询注入的 token 约减少十倍。在五阶段演进中，最强系统将行为记忆表达为显式指令，并在适用决策点提供。结果指出，表征、激活与放置位置是持久行为学习的核心设计选择。

2611.08723.title: Divide, Diagnose, and Compose: Optimizing Agentic Pipelines and Harnesses
2611.08723.authors: Divij Handa , Christopher Tensmeyer , Jihyung Kil , Vlad I. Morariu
2611.08723.abstract_en: Building agentic pipelines that achieve high task performance while keeping cost and latency low requires jointly optimizing heterogeneous and coupled design choices, including prompts, topology, model selection, and tool policies. Manually searching this combinatorial design space is expensive and time-consuming, while existing automated optimizers typically operate within a predefined subset of this space, modify the pipeline monolithically, or provide little structured evidence for pipeline changes. To mitigate these challenges, we introduce the Decomposed Credit-Assignment Framework (DeCAF), which adapts the design space to the given benchmark and pipeline, optimizes each dimension separately, and generates reasoning traces for every decision. Given a task specification, benchmark examples, and a seed pipeline, DeCAF identifies relevant optimization dimensions and generates diverse experimental hypotheses for each. Independent coding-agent sessions then optimize each dimension under a restricted edit scope, jointly evaluating performance, inference cost, and latency while recording all hypotheses, edits, and outcomes of each experiment. A final synthesis session combines compatible findings across all dimensions and uses a component-level trajectory evaluator, which derives role-specific rubrics from each agent's instructions, to localize underperforming components and guide cross-dimension revisions. Across a diverse suite of agentic benchmarks, DeCAF improves average task performance by 2.58 percentage points, while reducing inference cost by 4.30% and end-to-end latency by 42.45% compared to the best overall baseline.
2611.08723.update_target: Agentic pipeline design dimensions and synthesized harness code
2611.08723.mechanism_en: DeCAF allocates restricted edit scopes to independent optimization sessions, records hypotheses and outcomes, then composes compatible findings and uses role-specific trajectory rubrics for revisions.
2611.08723.result_en: Against the best overall baseline, the suite mean improves 2.58 performance points, reduces inference cost 4.30% and lowers latency 42.45%.
2611.08723.boundary_en: The deployed pipeline and the optimization process have separate budgets. Component-level diagnosis and later synthesis introduce interactions that require final composed evaluation.
2611.08723.abstract_zh: 构建任务表现高、成本与延迟低的智能体流水线，需要联合优化异构且耦合的设计选择，包括提示、拓扑、模型选择和工具策略。人工搜索这一组合设计空间既昂贵又耗时，而现有自动优化器通常只在预定义子空间内工作，整体性修改流水线，或很少为变化提供结构化证据。为缓解这些挑战，我们提出分解式信用分配框架（DeCAF），根据给定基准和流水线调整设计空间，分别优化每个维度，并为每项决策生成推理轨迹。给定任务规范、基准样例和种子流水线，DeCAF 识别相关优化维度，并为每个维度生成多样化实验假设。独立代码智能体会话随后在受限编辑范围内优化各维度，同时评估表现、推理成本和延迟，并记录每次实验的全部假设、编辑与结果。最后的综合会话组合各维度兼容的发现，并使用组件级轨迹评估器，从每个智能体指令导出角色特定量规，定位表现不足的组件，指导跨维度修订。在多样化智能体基准套件上，相对总体最强基线，DeCAF 将平均任务表现提高 2.58 个百分点，同时降低 4.30% 的推理成本和 42.45% 的端到端延迟。
2611.08723.abstract_source_note: Complete saved official New text and faithful translation. Literal link placeholders and source LaTeX retained without splicing later wording.
2611.08723.image_caption: Figure 2: Given task details, development examples, seed agentic pipeline, and objectives, DeCAF first identifies task-relevant optimization dimensions and generates diverse experimental hypotheses for each ( Divide ). Independent coding-agent sessions then optimize copies of the seed pipeline under dimension-specific edit constraints, producing Pareto candidates, execution trajectories, and structured findings ( Diagnose ). Finally, a synthesis optimizer combines compatible dimension-level findings and performs targeted cross-dimension revisions to produce a unified pipeline on the performance–cost–latency frontier with the help of a component or node-level diagnosis tool ( Compose ).

2611.09218.title: BOXBOX: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Running Performance Optimization
2611.09218.authors: Yuhao Tan , Hanyun Jiang , Fangkai Yang , Yuan Yao , Taolue Chen , Bo Qiao , Yu Kang , Lu Wang , Pu Zhao , Xiaoxing Ma , Qingwei Lin
2611.09218.abstract_en: Automated harness optimization improves agents by learning from trajectories and task feedback. Existing offline methods use reference answers to optimize harnesses for reuse on held-out tasks. However, many real-world tasks are open-ended, while long runs expose new difficulties that offline-optimized harnesses may not address. To study harness optimization in these settings, we introduce PerfRace, a benchmark for long-running performance optimization of software projects, and investigate whether agents can use task-specific experience to recursively improve their harnesses during an ongoing task. To this end, we introduce BOXBOX, which enables agent-triggered harness revision and kernel-managed hot reloading while preserving execution context. We evaluate BOXBOX on PerfRace under matched test-time budgets, comparing it with Frozen Harness, offline Harness Evolution, and Harness Scaling. BOXBOX achieves higher speedup with more efficient use of task time and model cost, reaching a Speedup@4h of 1.70x, compared with 1.54x for the strongest baseline.
2611.09218.affiliation: Nanjing University / Zhejiang University / Birkbeck, University of London / Microsoft
2611.09218.update_target: Live agent harness during an ongoing optimization task
2611.09218.mechanism_en: Agent-triggered revisions are hot-reloaded by a kernel that retains execution context. Subsequent task work uses the revised harness under matched test-time budgets.
2611.09218.result_en: PerfRace Speedup@4h reaches 1.70x versus 1.54x for the strongest baseline, with better reported task-time and model-cost use.
2611.09218.boundary_en: This is finite in-task harness recursion. Generalization of the evolved harness to unrelated projects requires separate evidence from the reported task-specific improvement.
2611.09218.abstract_zh: 自动框架优化通过轨迹和任务反馈改进智能体。现有离线方法使用参考答案，优化可在留出任务上复用的框架。然而，许多现实任务是开放式的，长时间运行还会暴露离线优化框架可能无法应对的新困难。为研究这些设置中的框架优化，我们提出 PerfRace，一个面向软件项目长时间性能优化的基准，并研究智能体能否利用任务特定经验，在正在进行的任务中递归改进其运行框架。为此，我们提出 BOXBOX，支持智能体触发框架修订，并在保留执行上下文的同时由内核管理热重载。我们在 PerfRace 上采用匹配的测试时预算评估 BOXBOX，与 Frozen Harness、离线 Harness Evolution 及 Harness Scaling 比较。BOXBOX 以更高效的任务时间和模型成本利用取得更高加速，Speedup@4h 达到 1.70 倍，而最强基线为 1.54 倍。

2611.09318.title: Recursively Self-Improving Electromagnetic Spectrum Agents: Architecture and Operation
2611.09318.authors: Baolin Chong , Dongfang Xu , Qiaosi Wang , Fuhui Zhou , Qihui Wu
2611.09318.abstract_en: Electromagnetic spectrum agents (ESAs) must contend with changing environments and task requirements during sustained autonomous operation, yet their existing capabilities may not remain suitable for new operating conditions. This article proposes recursively self-improving electromagnetic spectrum agents (RSI-ESAs) that use operational feedback to update their capabilities and build on prior improvements. We present their architecture and editable components, and describe a self-improvement process encompassing problem diagnosis, candidate generation, validation, and inheritance. By retaining effective task versions and using modification records and diagnostic knowledge to guide subsequent updates, RSI-ESAs can accumulate task capabilities and improvement experience across successive rounds. A shared-spectrum scheduling case study illustrates improved task performance and capability accumulation over multiple improvement rounds under the tested conditions. Finally, we discuss open challenges for broader tasks and long-term operation, outlining research directions for the continued capability development of ESAs.
2611.09318.affiliation: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
2611.09318.update_target: Spectrum-agent task versions and diagnostic experience
2611.09318.mechanism_en: Operational feedback drives diagnosis, candidate construction, validation and inheritance. Effective versions and modification records guide subsequent rounds.
2611.09318.result_en: A shared-spectrum scheduling case study reports task improvement and capability accumulation across multiple rounds under tested conditions.
2611.09318.boundary_en: The contribution combines architecture and a bounded scheduling case. The abstract supplies no general quantitative improvement rate or evidence of indefinite autonomous capability growth.
2611.09318.abstract_zh: 电磁频谱智能体（ESA）在持续自主运行期间必须应对不断变化的环境和任务需求，但既有能力可能不再适合新的运行条件。本文提出递归自我改进电磁频谱智能体（RSI-ESA），利用运行反馈更新能力，并在既有改进基础上继续发展。我们给出其架构与可编辑组件，描述涵盖问题诊断、候选生成、验证和继承的自我改进流程。通过保留有效任务版本，并使用修改记录和诊断知识指导后续更新，RSI-ESA 能够在连续轮次中累积任务能力与改进经验。共享频谱调度案例研究展示了在被测条件下，经过多轮改进的任务表现提升和能力累积。最后，我们讨论更广泛任务与长期运行面临的开放挑战，勾勒 ESA 持续能力发展的研究方向。

2611.09472.title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
2611.09472.authors: Ruiyi Yang , Zechen Li , Lihuan Li , Du Yin , Hao Xue , Flora D. Salim
2611.09472.abstract_en: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce ENGRAM, a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both relative and absolute criteria; records for skills that fail verification remain retrievable. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over frozen-weight ETG controls, with ablations supporting demonstration-aware admission and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison shows that verified release substantially reduces the retrievable footprint while remaining close to retain-all performance and outperforming immediate and budget-matched random release. ENGRAM also improves task performance while reducing input-token usage and model calls. Skill-level verification further reduces retrievable experience through selective archival, retaining external guidance for skills that do not meet the release criteria. Code is available in this http URL .
2611.09472.affiliation: University of New South Wales / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2611.09472.update_target: Agent weights, skill adapters and selective external-memory archival
2611.09472.mechanism_en: Demonstration-aware admission chooses training traces. Reserved probes compare the updated agent without episodic retrieval against the base with retrieval before records can be released.
2611.09472.result_en: Interactive and reasoning studies report gains over frozen ETG controls, smaller retrievable stores and performance near retain-all, ahead of immediate and matched random release.
2611.09472.boundary_en: Training participation and relative/absolute verification gates matter separately. Successful weight consolidation is skill-specific, with external guidance retained for skills that fail release checks.
2611.09472.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体通过外部检索和参数学习使用经验。将存储经验整合进模型权重，需要同时决定哪些经验用于训练，以及其外部记录何时可以退出检索。仅依据学生掌握情况接纳，可能排除有用的教师示范，而训练后立即移除，可能丢弃模型仍需要的指导。我们提出 ENGRAM，将训练接纳与记忆释放分开。一个考虑示范的门槛，根据学生掌握程度或足够多的成功教师示范来接纳技能。学生利用 Engram Trace Graph（ETG）的上下文，从选中的动作轨迹学习。随后，验证门槛在保留探针上比较不使用情景检索的更新模型与使用检索的基础模型。释放要求有效参与训练，并同时满足相对和绝对分数标准，未通过验证技能的记录仍可检索。交互和推理基准实验表明，相对冻结权重的 ETG 对照，ENGRAM 持续获得增益，消融支持考虑示范的接纳与选择性适配器激活。受控留出比较表明，经验证的释放能显著缩小可检索存储占用，保持接近全部保留的表现，并优于立即释放和预算匹配的随机释放。ENGRAM 还在减少输入 token 与模型调用的同时改善任务表现。技能级验证通过选择性归档进一步减少可检索经验，同时为未满足释放标准的技能保留外部指导。代码见 this http URL。

Engram verifies each skill: A uses verified weights and releases eligible records, while B retains external memory. Configured residuals remain; colored nodes represent behavior.

2611.08706.title: Dual-Stream LLM-Guided Reward Design for Reject-Inference-Aware Reinforcement Learning in E-Commerce Payment Fraud Detection
2611.08706.authors: Bo Qu , Zhurong Wang , Frank Zahradnik , Ming Ouyang
2611.08706.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.08706.abstract_en: Production fraud-detection models learn from a censored slice of their own traffic: transactions a legacy system blocked never receive fraud labels, so models train on a biased, approved-only distribution. We extend LLM-guided reward design, the framework of Qu et al. (2025) in which an LLM evolves the reward of a two-step REINFORCE fraud-blocking policy, to attack this reject-inference problem inside the reward. A single LLM designs a dual-stream reward: stream 1 applies the standard dollar-weighted precision objective to labeled transactions; stream 2 scores legacy-blocked, unlabeled transactions by contrasting the newest gradient-boosted risk signal against the legacy scores that drove the original block. Rather than prescribe which signals matter, we expose a superset of evidence and let the LLM decide for itself which to use, guided by evaluation feedback alone; because it writes the reward as code, that choice is directly auditable. On a held-out four-month out-of-time test, the dual-stream agent beats the prior labeled-only agent at every target recall, by +4.7, +2.4 and +3.0 points of dollar-weighted precision at 80%, 85% and 90% recall, and the production baseline by +6.8 points on average. The resulting policy is architecturally identical to that of Qu et al. (2025) and adds no inference cost.
2611.08706.update_target: Executable reward design and the trained fraud-blocking policy
2611.08706.mechanism_en: An LLM evolves a dual-stream reward using evaluation feedback over labeled and legacy-blocked traffic. Reward code exposes which evidence is used, and the learned policy is evaluated out of time.
2611.08706.result_en: On a held-out four-month test, dollar-weighted precision gains over labeled-only training are 4.7, 2.4 and 3.0 points at recall targets of 80%, 85% and 90%.
2611.08706.boundary_en: Legacy-blocked outcomes remain unlabeled and the newest risk model supplies a proxy signal. The retained object is reward/policy design, with unchanged policy architecture and reported inference cost.
2611.08706.abstract_zh: 生产欺诈检测模型只能从自身流量被删失的一部分中学习。旧系统拦截的交易从未获得欺诈标签，因此模型在有偏的、仅包含已批准交易的分布上训练。我们扩展 Qu 等人（2025）的 LLM 引导奖励设计框架，该框架让 LLM 演化两步 REINFORCE 欺诈拦截策略的奖励，以在奖励内部处理这一拒绝推断问题。一个 LLM 设计双流奖励。流 1 对有标签交易使用标准的金额加权精确率目标。流 2 对旧系统拦截的无标签交易评分，将最新梯度提升风险信号与导致原始拦截的旧分数进行比较。我们提供证据超集，让 LLM 仅依据评估反馈自行决定使用哪些信号，而非预先规定重要信号。由于奖励以代码编写，该选择可以直接审计。在留出的、跨时间的四个月测试上，双流智能体在每个目标召回率下均优于此前仅用有标签数据的智能体，在 80%、85% 和 90% 召回率时，金额加权精确率分别提高 4.7、2.4 和 3.0 个百分点，相对生产基线平均提高 6.8 个百分点。得到的策略在架构上与 Qu 等人（2025）相同，且不增加推理成本。

2611.08905.title: From Procedures to Permissions: Learning Precise Subagent Authorization from Agent Skills
2611.08905.authors: Wenkai Yu , Ning Ding , Wentao Zhang , Yehui Tang
2611.08905.abstract_en: As language agents tackle increasingly complex tasks, they increasingly rely on multiple agents to coordinate specialized work, requiring decisions not only about what each subagent should do but also which tools and workspace resources it should access. Existing agent systems provide mechanisms for controlling tools and execution environments, but do not directly specify the resources required by each delegated subtask. Moreover, task outcomes and execution trajectories alone provide limited supervision for determining whether a subagent has received appropriate permissions. We observe that Agent Skills encode procedural knowledge describing the operations, tools, and files required at each step, providing a natural source of supervision for authorization. Building on this observation, we synthesize tasks and step-by-step procedures from Skills, execute them through subagent delegation in interactive environments, and use verified trajectories to construct training data for task execution and authorization. On ClawArena-Team, our method improves tool permission precision by 13.4 percentage points and workspace permission precision by 24.1 percentage points, while increasing overall task success by 11.6 percentage points for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SkillsBench, our method remains competitive with existing agent data synthesis approaches. These results show that the procedural knowledge embedded in Agent Skills provides a source of supervision for precise subagent orchestration that task outcomes alone cannot provide.
2611.08905.update_target: Authorization-aware agent training from procedural skills
2611.08905.mechanism_en: Skill procedures generate delegated tasks, and verified interactive trajectories supervise task execution plus tool/workspace permission decisions.
2611.08905.result_en: For Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClawArena-Team permission precision improves 13.4 tool points and 24.1 workspace points, alongside an 11.6-point success gain.
2611.08905.boundary_en: This converts reusable procedural knowledge into supervision. Precision gains on the tested delegation setup do not alone establish the completeness of every granted resource set.
2611.08905.abstract_zh: 随着语言智能体处理越来越复杂的任务，它们日益依靠多个智能体协调专门工作，因此不仅需要决定每个子智能体应该做什么，也需要决定其可访问哪些工具和工作区资源。现有智能体系统提供控制工具和执行环境的机制，但未直接规定每项委托子任务所需资源。此外，任务结果与执行轨迹本身对判断子智能体是否获得适当权限提供的监督有限。我们观察到 Agent Skills 编码了程序性知识，描述每一步所需操作、工具与文件，为授权提供了自然监督来源。基于这一观察，我们从 Skills 合成任务与分步流程，通过交互环境中的子智能体委托执行它们，并利用经验证轨迹构建任务执行与授权训练数据。在 ClawArena-Team 上，对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，我们的方法将工具权限精确率提高 13.4 个百分点、工作区权限精确率提高 24.1 个百分点，同时将总体任务成功率提高 11.6 个百分点。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SkillsBench 上，该方法与现有智能体数据合成方法保持竞争力。这些结果表明，Agent Skills 中的程序性知识为精确子智能体编排提供了仅靠任务结果无法提供的监督来源。

2611.08917.title: PRISM: Primitive Routing via In-context Skill Mixing for Retentive VLA Adaptation
2611.08917.authors: Jiachen Tao , Gengyu Zhang , Haoxuan Wang , Bing Liu , Yan Yan
2611.08917.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise a single language-conditioned policy adaptable to many manipulation behaviors, yet deployment additionally requires skill retention and long-horizon composition: a policy must retain previously acquired skills and reuse them inside composite tasks whose behavior changes across phases. The standard recipe absorbs every new task into one shared update, which provides neither a parameter-level locus for reusable skills nor a mechanism for invoking each skill along the trajectory. We observe that this missing structure is latent rather than absent: per-skill low-rank updates of a pretrained VLA occupy a robustly distinguishable, low-dimensional subspace, and a single composite-task LoRA concentrates roughly half of its Frobenius energy in this subspace, against a near-zero matched random-rotation control. Building on this geometry, we introduce PRISM, which represents reusable skills as parameter-level primitives: each skill family is stored as a dedicated low-rank action-expert adapter in a primitive bank, primitives are augmented with skill-specific low-rank residuals and composed at inference by a per-chunk VLM-conditioned router that reads the prefix representation to track task progress, and the router is supervised by per-chunk labels from a deterministic, task-conditioned, action-derived oracle. During composite training, the vision encoder, the language LoRA, the skill residuals, the router, and the shared action projections and time MLP are updated; every primitive is held frozen, so the base per-skill action-expert adapters are preserved by construction. On RoboCasa365, PRISM achieves 56.43% atomic-skill success and reaches 20.00% on long-horizon composite tasks, while a standard $\pi_{0.5}$-LoRA two-stage fine-tune reaches 17.86% atomic and 17.50% composite success. We additionally validate PRISM on an AgileX PIPER real-robot setup.
2611.08917.update_target: Frozen skill adapters, trainable residuals and a routing policy
2611.08917.mechanism_en: A bank preserves per-skill low-rank action experts. Composite training updates the router and other listed components, using deterministic action-derived chunk labels to select primitives.
2611.08917.result_en: RoboCasa365 atomic/composite success is 56.43%/20.00%, versus 17.86%/17.50% for the two-stage LoRA baseline. A separate AgileX PIPER setup supplies real-robot validation.
2611.08917.boundary_en: Freezing primitives preserves their parameters by construction, while total behavioral retention also depends on the trainable encoder, routing and shared projections. Simulation and real-robot results use distinct protocols.
2611.08917.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型有望成为适应多种操作行为的单一语言条件策略，但部署还要求技能保留与长时程组合。策略须保留先前学得的技能，并在行为随阶段变化的复合任务中复用它们。标准方法将每个新任务吸收到一个共享更新中，既没有参数级可复用技能位置，也没有沿轨迹调用各技能的机制。我们发现，这一缺失结构是潜在存在的。预训练 VLA 的逐技能低秩更新占据稳健可区分的低维子空间，单个复合任务 LoRA 约一半的 Frobenius 能量集中于此，而匹配的随机旋转对照接近零。基于这一几何现象，我们提出 PRISM，将可复用技能表示为参数级原语。每个技能族作为独立低秩动作专家适配器存入原语库，以技能特定低秩残差增强，并在推理时由逐片段、以 VLM 为条件的路由器组合。路由器读取前缀表征跟踪任务进展，由确定性、任务条件、动作派生预言机提供逐片段标签监督。复合训练期间，视觉编码器、语言 LoRA、技能残差、路由器、共享动作投影和时间 MLP 均更新，而全部原语冻结，因此基础逐技能动作专家适配器按构造得到保留。在 RoboCasa365 上，PRISM 达到 56.43% 的原子技能成功率和 20.00% 的长时程复合任务成功率，而标准 $pi_{0.5}$-LoRA 两阶段微调分别达到 17.86% 和 17.50%。我们还在 AgileX PIPER 真实机器人设置上验证了 PRISM。

2611.09291.title: AutoRefine: Auto-Calibrating Code Judges from Workflow Outcomes
2611.09291.authors: Shervin Shahidi , James Poon , Hang Xie , Kenneth O. Xu , Robin Håkanson , Vikram Nair , Jens Pillgram-Larsen , Nachiappan Nagappan
2611.09291.abstract_en: LLM judges increasingly serve as quality gates for code changes that have no test oracle, but a judge prompt must be calibrated for its task and recalibrated as the system it judges evolves, while hand labels for the calibration are resource intensive and go stale. Development workflows emit outcome labels for free (tests pass or fail, changes land or are abandoned), but these labels are noisy. We present AutoRefine, a loop that rewrites a deployable judge's prompt to reproduce outcome labels, with an informed teacher that sees the judge's input plus the outcome, explains each label it keeps, and abstains when the outcome cannot be explained from what the judge sees. On a held-out dataset with an execution oracle, calibration raised chance-corrected agreement (Scott's $\pi$) from 0.36 to 0.60. On a deployed agent's outcome labels, with 25\% flipped at random to introduce noise, the teacher set aside flipped \textsc{fail} labels at more than twice the rate of genuine ones, cutting overall label noise from 25\% to 20\%. Recalibrating that agent's judge using AutoRefine raised its agreement with merge/abandon outcomes on 17 independently held-out diffs from the current workflow ($\pi$ 0.16 to 0.51); on 16 diffs from older workflows, the previous judge stayed ahead, illustrating the need for recalibration as the agent evolves. By abstaining, the teacher not only removes noisy labels but also flags changes whose outcome the judge's input cannot explain, telling a team when a judge needs better inputs rather than a better prompt.
2611.09291.mechanism_en: An outcome-informed teacher explains usable labels and abstains on unexplained ones. Prompt calibration retains the resulting judgment changes for the evolving workflow.
2611.09291.result_en: Oracle-held-out Scott's pi rises from 0.36 to 0.60. Current-workflow agreement rises from 0.16 to 0.51 on 17 held-out diffs, while the previous judge leads on 16 older diffs.
2611.09291.boundary_en: Workflow merge/abandon outcomes are noisy supervision. Teacher filtering reduces injected noise from 25% to 20%, and the small held-out workflow sets limit generalization.
2611.09291.abstract_zh: LLM 评判器越来越多地充当没有测试预言机的代码修改质量门槛，但评判提示必须针对任务校准，并随被评判系统演化而重新校准，人工校准标签却成本高且会过时。开发工作流免费产生结果标签（测试通过或失败、修改合入或放弃），但这些标签带有噪声。我们提出 AutoRefine，一个重写可部署评判器提示、使其复现结果标签的循环。其中知情教师同时看到评判器输入和结果，为保留的每个标签给出解释，若无法从评判器可见内容解释结果则弃权。在具有执行预言机的留出数据上，校准将经机会校正的一致性（Scott 的 $pi$）从 0.36 提高到 0.60。在已部署智能体的结果标签上，我们随机翻转 25% 标签引入噪声，教师搁置被翻转 	extsc{fail} 标签的比例超过真实同类标签的两倍，使总体标签噪声从 25% 降至 20%。使用 AutoRefine 重新校准该智能体评判器后，在当前工作流 17 个独立留出的差异上，其与合入／放弃结果的一致性从 $pi$ 0.16 提高至 0.51。在旧工作流的 16 个差异上，先前评判器仍领先，展示了随智能体演化重新校准的必要性。通过弃权，教师不仅移除噪声标签，也标记了评判器输入无法解释其结果的修改，告诉团队评判器何时需要更好的输入而非更好的提示。

2611.09355.title: HiMEM: Hippocampus-Inspired Memory Consolidation, Pruning, and Composition for Vision-Language-Action Models in 3D Scenes
2611.09355.authors: Boran Zhao , Yanbin Hu , Jun Ye , Zhenxian Hu , Yuxin Zhai , Jin Cui , Pengju Ren
2611.09355.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2611.09355.abstract_en: Memory plays a crucial role in long-horizon task execution and cross-task generalization for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models operating in complex 3D scenes. However, existing VLA memory mechanisms suffer from memory noise, particularly in complex 3D scenes, as stored episodic memories contain extensive redundant details about scene layouts, object configurations, and robot-specific states, which obscure generalizable manipulation principles and hinder cross-task transfer. To address this challenge, we first introduce a hippocampus-inspired memory consolidation mechanism that synthesizes extensive episodic experiences into a compact set of essential semantic memories, enabling VLA models to derive generalizable principles from practical experience. Second, we propose an episodic memory pruning mechanism that removes redundant episodic memories whose contents are captured by consolidated semantic memories, thereby increasing effective memory capacity and improving long-horizon task execution. Finally, to handle complex task scenarios, we develop a flexible memory composition mechanism that jointly leverages multiple episodic and semantic memories to enhance cross-scenario generalization. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus demonstrate the effectiveness of HiMEM across different VLA backbones, improving the average success rate of pi_0 from 91.88% to 98.20% on LIBERO.
2611.09355.update_target: Consolidated semantic memories and a pruned episodic store
2611.09355.mechanism_en: Episodic experience becomes semantic manipulation principles. Covered episodes are pruned, and joint episodic/semantic retrieval composes experience for later tasks.
2611.09355.result_en: Across VLA backbones on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, the abstract highlights pi_0 success increasing from 91.88% to 98.20% on LIBERO.
2611.09355.boundary_en: The mechanism updates external memory. The stated benchmark gain concerns simulated tasks, and preservation of source details needs evidence beyond a smaller memory store.
2611.09355.abstract_zh: 记忆对复杂 3D 场景中运行的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型的长时程任务执行与跨任务泛化至关重要。然而，现有 VLA 记忆机制尤其在复杂 3D 场景中遭遇记忆噪声，因为存储的情景记忆包含大量冗余的场景布局、物体配置和机器人特定状态细节，掩盖了可泛化操作原则并妨碍跨任务迁移。为应对这一挑战，我们首先引入海马启发的记忆整合机制，将大量情景经验综合为紧凑的关键语义记忆集合，使 VLA 模型能够从实践经验中提炼可泛化原则。其次，我们提出情景记忆剪枝机制，移除其内容已被整合后语义记忆覆盖的冗余情景记忆，从而增加有效记忆容量，改善长时程任务执行。最后，为处理复杂任务场景，我们开发灵活的记忆组合机制，联合利用多个情景与语义记忆，增强跨场景泛化。LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 实验证明 HiMEM 在不同 VLA 骨干上的有效性，在 LIBERO 上将 pi_0 的平均成功率从 91.88% 提升至 98.20%。

2611.09355.image_caption: Fig. 1: Illustration of memory noise and its effects on 3D manipulation. (a) Stored manipulation experiences for the same target object and subgoal contain varying non-target object details, introducing memory redundancy. (b) Using ECHO [ 6 ] for manipulation execution, we group memories by target and subgoal and randomly remove 30% of redundant entries differing only in non-target object details while preserving task-relevant experiences. On LIBERO-Long, in-distribution success rates decrease slightly from 93.50% to 93.25%, whereas out-of-distribution success rates improve from 92.78% to 94.67%. These results suggest that removing redundant memory details can improve out-of-distribution generalization while largely preserving in-distribution performance.

2611.09376.title: Can LLMs Debug Robots by Editing Their Weights?
2611.09376.authors: Jusheng Zhang , Keze Wang , Liang Lin
2611.09376.abstract_en: A language model can repair a robot policy's lexical instruction grounding by editing just 65 token-embedding rows. We bring weight-space programming to robot foundation policies: GPT-6 Astra reads weights and uses a CPU workspace and budgeted simulator feedback, without gradient updates or new demonstrations. Three independent sessions on $\pi_{0.5}$ all improve success on 765 held-out paraphrases; the best raises success from 86.3\% to 92.0\% (48 repairs, four regressions; exact paired $p=1.31\times10^{-10}$). Among the 335 instructions containing edited tokens, success rises from 74.3\% to 87.5\%; the other 430 episodes have zero outcome changes. Matched random-direction edits do not help. Full replacement using the editor's own lexicon explains much of the gain but produces more regressions; its direct difference from the editor is not significant at 0.05. Across 13 further robot sessions, the editor declines 12 candidates; the sole retained edit does not show a significant held-out gain. Separately, benchmark metadata lowers FastWAM success from 70.0\% to 48.6\%, while the evaluated VLA's aggregate rate is unchanged. The evidence supports precise lexical repair, not general acquisition of missing robot capabilities.
2611.09376.update_target: Sixty-five token-embedding rows in a robot policy
2611.09376.mechanism_en: A language-model editor reads weights and uses CPU tools plus bounded simulator feedback to validate and retain lexical edits. Matched random directions and held-out paraphrases test specificity.
2611.09376.result_en: Three sessions improve 765 held-out paraphrases, with the best moving from 86.3% to 92.0%. In thirteen further sessions, twelve candidates are declined and the retained edit lacks a significant held-out gain.
2611.09376.boundary_en: Evidence is precise lexical repair in simulation. The lexicon replacement control explains much of the gain, with its direct difference from the editor nonsignificant at 0.05. Broader robot-capability acquisition remains unsupported.
2611.09376.abstract_zh: 语言模型只需编辑 65 行 token 嵌入，就能修复机器人策略的词汇级指令落地。我们将权重空间编程引入机器人基础策略。GPT-6 Astra 读取权重，使用 CPU 工作区与受预算限制的模拟器反馈，不进行梯度更新，也不使用新示范。在 $pi_{0.5}$ 上，三个独立会话均提高了 765 条留出改写指令的成功率，最佳会话将成功率从 86.3% 提升至 92.0%（48 次修复、四次退化，精确配对 $p=1.31\times10^{-10}$）。在包含被编辑 token 的 335 条指令中，成功率从 74.3% 提高到 87.5%，其余 430 个回合结果完全未变。匹配的随机方向编辑没有帮助。使用编辑器自身词典完全替换能解释大部分增益，但产生更多退化，其与编辑器的直接差异在 0.05 水平不显著。在另外 13 次机器人会话中，编辑器拒绝了 12 个候选，唯一保留的编辑也未显示显著的留出增益。另外，基准元数据将 FastWAM 成功率从 70.0% 降至 48.6%，而被评估 VLA 的总体成功率保持不变。证据支持精确词汇修复，而非普遍获得缺失的机器人能力。

2611.09454.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
2611.09454.authors: Saranya Dintakurthy Swadha , Pavan C Shekar , Arpit Jain , Aswanth Krishnan
2611.09454.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.09454.abstract_en: Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58-71% of a LoRA's gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%. Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.
2611.09454.update_target: Human-readable skill documents recovered from LoRA behavior
2611.09454.mechanism_en: An Executing Writer or probing agent runs the adapted and base models and reconstructs reusable instructions. Held-out skills and cross-model deployment evaluate retained utility.
2611.09454.result_en: For document-storing adapters, recovered documents restore 85–91% of external-skill gain. Behavioral-adapter probing on ALFWorld recovers 58–71% of LoRA gain and raises a receiving Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%.
2611.09454.boundary_en: Document-trained and behavior-only adapters are materially different evidence settings. Where behavior is guessable, an adapter-free reward loop performs comparably, constraining attribution.
2611.09454.abstract_zh: 智能体技能是教语言模型处理一类任务的短文档。为节省上下文，这些文档越来越多地被编译为低秩适配器（LoRA），保留行为却丢失文本。适配器难以阅读、编辑、审计或转移到另一个模型。我们研究能否从适配器及其冻结基础模型写回技能文档，并依据恢复文档陈述原始关键指令的比例和解决任务的表现评分。我们尝试的仅阅读权重的方法恢复很少，学习的权重到文本映射约传递一比特文档信息。运行适配器的效果好得多。Executing Writer 是在适配后模型之上训练的小型写作器，能恢复留出技能 39–44% 的关键指令，而使用另一技能适配器时为 1.3–1.5%。在针对 41 个外部技能拟合的适配器上，其文档恢复原始任务增益的 85–91%。这些最强结果来自训练时存储了文档的适配器。仅从行为训练的适配器对训练过的写作器困难得多，仅能恢复 1–2% 的指令。对这些适配器，我们测试运行基础与适配模型、根据行为差异撰写技能的智能体。在 ALFWorld 上，其技能恢复 LoRA 增益的 58–71%，并可迁移到无法加载该 LoRA 的模型，使 Llama-3.1-8B 从 5% 提升至 55%。此类技能是否来自适配器取决于适配器学到了什么。当其行为无法被猜到时，适配器是信息来源，而当其行为可被猜到时，不使用适配器的奖励循环表现同样好。
