2611.09568.title: Alignment by Confident Debate: Preference Learning from Multi-Agent Debate
2611.09568.authors: Nikhil Verma , Dingxian Wang , Mohammad Reza Rezaei , Andrew Rabinovich , Zhao Chen
2611.09568.abstract_en: Post-training language models for reasoning typically rely on gold answers, task-specific verifiers, or learned reward models, limiting scalability when such signals are scarce. Multi-agent debate offers a self-supervised alternative, but converting debate into reliable training supervision remains challenging: majority voting weights agreeing responses equally, lacks a principled tie-breaking rule, and is ill-defined for open-ended tasks without a canonical answer; likelihood-based scoring can conflate fluency with correctness; and homogeneous committees may reinforce correlated errors. We introduce Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD), which converts debate traces into preference data without gold answer labels. A sampling-diverse committee debates each problem, after which final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence. We use verifiable tasks (mathematical reasoning, multiple-choice quantitative QA, and executable code-generation) as a controlled test bed: their answer keys or executable checkers let us evaluate the quality of debate-derived supervision against ground truth, even though the oracle itself never uses gold labels. Post-training on the resulting preferences outperforms inference-only ensembling and debate, as well as SFT on the same traces, across five model families spanning 1B to 8B parameters and four datasets, improving consensus accuracy, with a maximum gain of $21.5_{pp}$. Ablations show that the approach transfers to a larger model and to code generation, while also revealing limitations of heterogeneous committees and agreement-based weighting. Overall, the results suggest that debate traces can yield useful preference supervision when answer equivalence is combined with confidence-weighted disagreement.
2611.09568.update_target: Preference-trained model weights from debate traces
2611.09568.mechanism_en: A sampling-diverse committee debates, clusters semantically equivalent answers and converts confidence-weighted disagreement into preference supervision for post-training.
2611.09568.result_en: Across five 1B–8B model families and four datasets, the reported maximum consensus-accuracy gain is 21.5 percentage points, ahead of the tested inference-only and SFT controls.
2611.09568.boundary_en: Gold labels are excluded from preference construction but used to assess supervision on verifiable tasks. Open-ended supervision and heterogeneous committees retain unresolved reliability limits.
2611.09568.abstract_zh: 推理语言模型的后训练通常依赖标准答案、任务特定验证器或学习的奖励模型，当此类信号稀缺时会限制扩展。多智能体辩论提供了自监督替代方案，但将辩论转化为可靠训练监督仍具挑战。多数投票对同意答案赋予相同权重，缺少有原则的平票处理规则，并且在没有规范答案的开放任务上定义不明。基于似然的评分可能混淆流畅性与正确性，同质委员会则可能强化相关错误。我们提出置信辩论对齐（AbCD），无需标准答案标签即可将辩论轨迹转化为偏好数据。采用多样采样的委员会对每个问题辩论，随后按任务级语义等价性聚类最终答案。我们将可验证任务（数学推理、选择式定量问答与可执行代码生成）作为受控试验平台，其答案键或可执行检查器允许我们依据真值评估辩论监督质量，尽管该预言机自身从不使用标准标签。使用所得偏好后训练，在 1B 至 8B 的五个模型族和四个数据集上，优于仅推理时集成与辩论，也优于相同轨迹上的 SFT，提高共识准确率，最大增益为 $21.5_{pp}$。消融表明该方法可迁移到更大模型与代码生成，同时也揭示了异质委员会和基于一致性的加权的局限。总体而言，结果表明，当答案等价性与置信度加权分歧结合时，辩论轨迹能够产生有用的偏好监督。

2611.09597.title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
2611.09597.authors: Yijun Li , Zhengxi Lu , Zhipiao Liu , Jinzheng Yu , Xutao Weng , Jian Shao , Yongliang Shen
2611.09597.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at this https URL .
2611.09597.update_target: Student weights and adaptive teacher/critic rubric roles
2611.09597.mechanism_en: Unreachable rubrics become privileged information for gated on-policy distillation. Saturated rubrics are split into child critics sharing parent weight to restore discrimination.
2611.09597.result_en: Qwen3-4B improves on all four medical/scientific benchmarks. Unguided recovery rises 35.02% to 42.86%, while reward-quality alignment rises 57.74% to 60.77% on independent rollouts.
2611.09597.boundary_en: The loop adapts supervision to current responses. Privileged-rubric satisfaction and unguided recovery measure different conditions, and clinical deployment is outside the reported benchmark evidence.
2611.09597.abstract_zh: 基于量规的强化学习（RL）通过根据查询特定量规对每个回复评分，将可验证奖励 RL 扩展至开放式任务。然而，在组相对优化下，所有采样回复都失败的量规（不可达）或都通过的量规（饱和），对所有回复给出相同结果而没有学习信号。在 Qwen3-4B 医学训练中，60.88% 的查询—量规观测处于不活跃状态。我们发现两种状态缺乏不同的监督。将不可达量规写入提示，使其满足率从 1.13% 提高至 91.25%，而全部满足饱和量规的回复仍存在质量差异。因此，我们提出 RuACT（作为自适应批评者与教师的量规），为每个不活跃量规分配能够补足其缺失信息的角色。Rubric as Teacher 将不可达量规作为特权信息，用于奖励门控的在策略自蒸馏。Rubric as Critic 将饱和量规分解为能区分当前回复的子量规，并共享父量规权重。使用 Qwen3-4B，RuACT 在全部四个医学与科学基准上优于 GRPO、量规重加权和量规引导探索，并在 Qwen3-1.7B 上获得最佳平均表现。对最初不可达的量规，无指导恢复率从 35.02% 提高至 42.86%，而子量规细化将独立滚动生成上的奖励—质量对齐从 57.74% 提升至 60.77%。代码见 this https URL。

2611.09734.title: GuardrailAgent: An Agentic Framework for Jailbreak Defense
2611.09734.authors: Tianze Chang , Junjie Chu , Yixin Wu , Michael Backes , Yang Zhang
2611.09734.abstract_en: Despite undergoing safety training to align with human values, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent built-in safeguards and elicit malicious behaviors given by the adversary. Existing defenses are mostly static and fail to adapt to new or unknown attack strategies, providing limited resilience. To address these, we propose a multi-agent defense framework, GuardrailAgent, that offers adaptive, end-to-end protection. The system autonomously gathers and summarizes attack characteristics into a continuously updated knowledge base that supports both input- and output-side detection. A feedback module integrates misclassified cases for iterative improvement at minimal cost. Tested on over ten representative jailbreaks, the framework achieved a 93.1% input-side detection rate, 93.9% overall detection, and a 95.8% F1 score, while rapidly adapting to unseen attacks. These results demonstrate GuardrailAgent's outstanding capability to maintain LLM safety in the face of evolving jailbreak tactics.
2611.09734.affiliation: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
2611.09734.update_target: Attack-characteristic knowledge base and defense feedback
2611.09734.mechanism_en: The system summarizes encountered attacks into a continuously updated store, then incorporates misclassified cases to revise later input/output detection.
2611.09734.result_en: Across more than ten representative jailbreaks, the authors report 93.1% input detection, 93.9% overall detection and 95.8% F1, with adaptation to unseen attacks.
2611.09734.boundary_en: The reusable defense object is the knowledge base and feedback process. Reported detection rates depend on the evaluated attack distribution and operating thresholds.
2611.09734.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）经过安全训练以对齐人类价值观，它们仍易受越狱攻击，攻击者可以绕过内置防护并诱发恶意行为。现有防御大多静态，无法适应新的或未知攻击策略，韧性有限。为应对这些问题，我们提出多智能体防御框架 GuardrailAgent，提供自适应端到端保护。系统自主收集攻击特征并将其总结为持续更新的知识库，同时支持输入侧和输出侧检测。反馈模块整合误分类案例，以低成本迭代改进。在十余种代表性越狱上的测试中，该框架达到 93.1% 的输入侧检测率、93.9% 的总体检测率和 95.8% 的 F1 分数，并能迅速适应未见攻击。这些结果表明，面对不断演化的越狱策略，GuardrailAgent 具有出色的 LLM 安全维护能力。

2611.09872.title: On the Reliability of Majority-Vote Pseudo-Labels in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
2611.09872.authors: Haoyu Wang , Ru Wang , Yuanyuan Wang , Jiaxian Guo , Mingming Gong
2611.09872.abstract_en: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts pretrained language models to unlabeled target-domain data using self-generated pseudo-labels, whose reliability remains poorly understood. We analyze majority-vote supervision for TTRL with online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and decompose its error into population-majority bias and prompt-dependent finite-rollout variation. Because population-majority bias is generally unidentifiable without external supervision, we focus on mitigating the downstream effects of finite-rollout variation. We propose \emph{Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO ( this http URL )}, which conditions within-prompt robust reweighting on observed vote reliability to make updates from sampling-sensitive prompts more conservative. We further introduce a cache-based mechanism to reduce self-supervised forgetting during online adaptation. Across six mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks and five model backbones, this http URL matches or outperforms the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings.
2611.09872.affiliation: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence / University of Melbourne / University of Tokyo
2611.09872.update_target: Online DPO weights, reliability-conditioned updates and a retention cache
2611.09872.mechanism_en: Prompt-level vote reliability makes finite-rollout-sensitive updates more conservative, while a cache limits self-supervised forgetting during adaptation.
2611.09872.result_en: Across six benchmarks and five backbones, the proposed method matches or exceeds the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings.
2611.09872.boundary_en: Population-majority bias is generally unidentifiable without external supervision. The method targets finite-rollout variation, and same-model voting still carries systematic bias.
2611.09872.abstract_zh: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）利用自生成伪标签，使预训练语言模型适应无标签目标域数据，但这些标签的可靠性仍缺乏理解。我们分析在线直接偏好优化（DPO）下的多数投票监督，将其误差分解为总体多数偏差和依赖提示的有限滚动采样变化。由于没有外部监督时总体多数偏差通常不可识别，我们聚焦于缓解有限滚动采样变化的下游影响。我们提出 emph{提示条件分布鲁棒 DPO（this http URL）}，根据观察到的投票可靠性，对提示内鲁棒重加权施加条件，使来自对采样敏感提示的更新更保守。我们还引入缓存机制，减少在线适应中的自监督遗忘。在六个数学及知识密集推理基准、五种模型骨干上，this http URL 在 30 个设置中的 24 个达到或优于最强 TTRL 基线。

2611.09891.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
2611.09891.authors: Peter Belcak , Greg Heinrich , Saurav Muralidharan , Shizhe Diao , Pavlo Molchanov
2611.09891.abstract_en: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
2611.09891.update_target: CPU-executable reasoning caches derived from model traces
2611.09891.mechanism_en: Reasoning is compiled into reusable semantic computations for new instances, with reported continued trainability and perturbation tests.
2611.09891.result_en: The abstract reports frontier-comparable performance on mathematical/scientific tasks and 16–291x cheaper invocation than the source model.
2611.09891.boundary_en: Invocation savings need separate accounting from cache construction and training. Reuse within covered task families establishes a narrower claim than autonomous growth across arbitrary tasks.
2611.09891.abstract_zh: 大语言模型总是在重复发明轮子。它们将求解任务与执行解法混为一谈，迫使自己每次都从头解决问题。我们表明，一项任务经过推理之后，其解法可高效应用到新问题实例，只需很少语言模型参与。我们提出智能体推理缓存，一种从 LLM 推理轨迹构建稳健、可由 CPU 执行的智能体推理缓存（ARC）的方法。ARC 在一系列困难数学和科学任务上达到与前沿 LLM 相当的表现，完全可解释、可持续训练、对输入扰动稳健，调用成本比源模型低 16–291 倍。

2611.09892.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
2611.09892.authors: Chen Chen , Omid Bagherieh , Naveen Nikamanth Appiah Balaji , Jesse T. Gonzalez , Negin Heravi , Fahad Islam , Xueting Li , Jean-Baptiste Regli , Kejia Ren , Petr Švec , David J. Yoon , Matthias Müller , Vladlen Koltun
2611.09892.categories: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.09892.abstract_en: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6\% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2\% and 42.9\% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.
2611.09892.update_target: Persistent cross-episode experience in an augmented manipulation harness
2611.09892.mechanism_en: A generalist model controls manipulators through AMP1. An added store carries memory between episodes, allowing later policy decisions to use earlier experience.
2611.09892.result_en: The paper reports 104/108 zero-shot real-world successes across twelve tasks and three robot instances. The memory augmentation reduces failure 4.6x on RoboDojo bimanual tasks.
2611.09892.boundary_en: Zero-shot hardware trials and the memory-learning benchmark are separate experiments. The 4.6x memory effect should be attributed to its own evaluated setting and baseline.
2611.09892.abstract_zh: 近期机器人操作研究聚焦于从示范训练的专用策略。我们表明，通用 AI 模型可以比视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA）和世界—动作模型（WAM）等专用策略更可靠地控制操作臂。我们系统分析智能体操作策略（AMP），由通用 AI 模型直接指挥操作臂，并随任务展开调整动作。我们提出 AMP1，一个在单臂、双臂和移动操作中保持不变的参考运行框架。AMP1 无需示范或任务特定训练，在 RoboLab-120 和 CaP-Gym 上取得先进结果。在 RoboLab-120 上，AMP1 零样本成功率为 85.6%，而领先 VLA 与 WAM 策略分别为 49.2% 和 42.9%。该智能体在十二项任务、三种机器人实例的 108 次真实世界试验中零样本成功 104 次，相对强 VLA 和 WAM 基线分别将失败率降低 20 倍和 15 倍。基础框架不提供抓取、推动或放置技能，智能体发展出自身策略，例如搜索隐藏物体、将物体用作工具和校准相机。加入持久记忆存储后，智能体还可从经验学习。增强框架将记忆表征跨回合保留，相对零样本部署，使 RoboDojo 双臂操作任务上的失败率降低 4.6 倍。我们的分析表明，AMP 比专用操作策略更通用、更稳健，为机器人操作提供了有前景的基础。

2611.08522.title: What Are LLM Agents Actually Learning on Low-Budget Molecular Optimization Benchmarks?
2611.08522.authors: Jiayu Qin , Zhengquan Luo , Changyou Chen , Zhiqiang Xu
2611.08522.abstract_en: Recent work reports large gains for LLM agents on low-budget molecular optimization. We measure the contributions of online optimization, retrievable task information, and permissive oracle landscapes. On PMO at 50 oracle calls, a GPT-4o mini agent's sum AUC falls from 14.44 to 4.85 after task names and curated reference compounds are hidden. An identity-blinded condition that states only the oracle form (e.g., similarity to a hidden reference) scores 5.39, while a deterministic retrieval-only baseline with no LLM reaches 12.16 (84% of the full agent). A full 23-task 2x2 ablation and a three-seed replication on eight tasks support this interpretation. On a protein-targeted benchmark with an AutoDock Vina composite oracle, a single-edit random walk is a strong lower bound; across three seeds it obtains composite 0.636 +/- 0.008 and docking improvement -1.11 +/- 0.04 kcal/mol. As a positive control, a retrieval-free population agent exceeds REINVENT at a matched 50-call AUC budget, with its strongest result at 100 calls. These results motivate two inexpensive sanity checks: retrieval-safe PMO prompts and a random-walk floor for docking-based optimization.
2611.08522.affiliation: University at Buffalo / Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2611.08522.image_note: All 12 PDF pages inspected. The paper contains tables and text but no numbered figure. Explicit placeholder retained.
2611.08522.update_target: Attribution tests for low-budget molecular optimization loops
2611.08522.mechanism_en: Identity blinding, retrieval-only controls, matched oracle budgets and random-walk floors separate online search from task information and oracle structure.
2611.08522.result_en: At 50 PMO calls, hiding names/reference compounds cuts AUC sum from 14.44 to 4.85, while retrieval alone reaches 12.16. A retrieval-free population agent supplies a positive control.
2611.08522.boundary_en: An improved terminal molecular score can reflect retrieved references or permissive oracles. The three-seed benchmark comparisons are author-run evidence with distinct docking and PMO objectives.
2611.08522.abstract_zh: 近期研究报告了 LLM 智能体在低预算分子优化上的大幅增益。我们测量在线优化、可检索任务信息和宽松预言机景观各自的贡献。在 PMO、50 次预言机调用条件下，隐藏任务名称和精选参考化合物后，GPT-4o mini 智能体的 AUC 总和从 14.44 降至 4.85。仅说明预言机形式（例如与隐藏参考的相似度）的身份盲化条件得分为 5.39，而无需 LLM 的确定性纯检索基线达到 12.16，即完整智能体的 84%。完整的 23 任务 2×2 消融，以及八项任务上的三种子复现支持这一解释。在采用 AutoDock Vina 组合预言机的蛋白质靶向基准上，单编辑随机游走构成较强下界。三个种子中，其组合分数为 0.636 +/- 0.008，对接改善为 -1.11 +/- 0.04 kcal/mol。作为阳性对照，无检索的种群智能体在匹配的 50 次调用 AUC 预算上超过 REINVENT，最强结果出现在 100 次调用。这些结果推动了两项低成本合理性检查，即检索安全的 PMO 提示和基于对接优化的随机游走下界。

2611.08647.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
2611.08647.authors: Chris von Csefalvay , Pranav Doma , Achyuthan Unni Krishnan , Tamás Földi
2611.08647.abstract_en: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge. Despite growing interest in these approaches, there has been no systematic way to evaluate how well models perform them. We introduce IWIBench, which measures a large editor model's ability to modify the weights of a smaller target model (typically Gemma 3 4B IT) to achieve one of ten classical text-editing objectives while preserving its other capabilities. Editors are limited to four tools for reading and writing weights, with bounded tensor access and a fixed budget for generating and inspecting rollouts. A validator applies each proposed patch in a clean environment and compares the edited model against the unmodified target. Evaluating frontier closed- and open-weight models reveals sharply diverging capabilities, both across models and across tasks. A small number of models, most notably Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, perform far ahead of the rest. The recency of this ability (little of it is evident in GPT-5.6 Sol, for instance), together with qualitative analysis, suggests it has been acquired through recent training. Tasks also vary widely: structured response resisted every attempt, and answer-length control yielded only one successful solution, whereas alias acquisition and recoding proved most amenable. Success in one task family correlated poorly with success in others, indicating an early and uneven capability frontier. We discuss strategies that editors repeatedly adopted and conclude with an outlook on intra-weight injection as an emerging but already potent approach to gradient-free behaviour modification.
2611.08647.update_target: Benchmark validation of gradient-free intra-weight editing
2611.08647.mechanism_en: Editors receive four bounded tensor tools and fixed rollout budgets. A clean validator applies patches and compares target behavior with preserved control capabilities.
2611.08647.result_en: Ten objective families show sharp model/task variation. Structured response resists all attempts, and answer-length control has only one successful solution.
2611.08647.boundary_en: This is bounded model-to-model editing. Recent capability acquisition is an interpretation based on comparisons and qualitative evidence, and success in one task family transfers poorly to others.
2611.08647.abstract_zh: 权重内注入使一个模型可以直接编辑另一模型权重，从而在无需梯度的情况下改变其行为。此类编辑可从改变词汇关联，到强制输出格式或更新事实知识。尽管相关兴趣日益增长，尚缺少系统评估模型执行这类操作能力的方法。我们提出 IWIBench，测量较大编辑模型修改较小目标模型（通常为 Gemma 3 4B IT）权重，实现十种经典文本编辑目标之一、同时保留其他能力的能力。编辑器限于四种读写权重工具，张量访问有界，生成和检查滚动输出的预算固定。验证器在干净环境应用每个提议补丁，并比较编辑模型与未修改目标。对前沿闭源和开放权重模型的评估发现，模型之间及任务之间的能力差异很大。少数模型，尤其 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol，明显领先其他模型。这种能力出现很近（例如 GPT-5.6 Sol 几乎未表现出该能力），结合定性分析，表明它可能来自近期训练。任务之间也差异很大。结构化回复抵抗了全部尝试，答案长度控制仅有一个成功解法，而别名习得与重新编码最易实现。某一任务族成功与其他任务族成功相关性很低，表明这一能力前沿仍早期且不均衡。我们讨论编辑器反复采用的策略，并展望权重内注入这一新兴但已具有较强作用的无梯度行为修改方法。

2611.08779.title: Jacobian-Causal Memory Control for Persistent Memory in Language Model Systems
2611.08779.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.08779.abstract_en: Persistent-memory systems choose not only which records are retrieved but which prior information can alter current inference. We propose Jacobian-causal memory control (JCMC), which represents each authorized memory intervention by a predicted influence signature in a shared behavioral measurement space, selects interventions against a target effect and side-effect budget, and compares predicted with observed effects before retaining or rolling back the intervention. Under explicit smoothness and bounded-estimation assumptions, we prove a quadratic local-approximation bound, characterize the target effects reachable by a set of signatures, bound selection regret under signature error, and bound non-additive interactions between simultaneous memories. The paper reports no benchmark measurements; it defines a paired counterfactual estimator and an evaluation protocol comparing JCMC with relevance, graph, and policy-filtered retrieval baselines. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if those simpler baselines match effect targeting, side-effect control, and rollback utility under equal model, memory, policy, and cost budgets.
2611.08779.update_target: Proposed influence-signature control for memory interventions
2611.08779.mechanism_en: JCMC selects authorized memories against target effects and side-effect budgets, comparing predicted and measured counterfactual effects before retention or rollback.
2611.08779.result_en: Under explicit smoothness and bounded-estimation assumptions, the paper derives local error, reachability, selection-regret and interaction bounds.
2611.08779.boundary_en: The paper reports no benchmark measurements. Paired estimation and equal-budget comparisons with simpler retrieval methods are specified evaluation proposals, so efficacy remains unmeasured.
2611.08779.abstract_zh: 持久记忆系统不仅选择检索哪些记录，也选择哪些先前信息能够改变当前推理。我们提出雅可比—因果记忆控制（JCMC），在共享行为测量空间中，为每个获授权记忆干预表示其预测影响特征，依据目标效应和副作用预算选择干预，并在保留或回滚前比较预测与实际效应。在显式平滑性和有界估计假设下，我们证明二次局部近似界，刻画一组特征可达的目标效应，给出特征误差下的选择遗憾界，并界定同时使用多条记忆时的非加性交互。本文未报告基准测量，而是定义了配对反事实估计器，以及将 JCMC 与相关性、图和策略过滤检索基线比较的评估协议。若在相同模型、记忆、策略和成本预算下，这些更简单基线达到同等效应定向、副作用控制与回滚效用，核心主张就应收窄或被证伪。

2611.08787.title: Training Stability under Adaptive Curricula
2611.08787.authors: Johan Obando-Ceron , Walter Mayor , Michael Dennis , Aaron Courville , Pablo Samuel Castro
2611.08787.abstract_en: Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) approaches train reinforcement learning (RL) agents on diverse curricula that may evolve with their capabilities. While prior work has largely focused on how these curricula are constructed, we study whether their students remain trainable under the resulting distributions. Across multiple UED mechanisms, environment complexities, and extended training horizons, we identify recurring learner-side pathologies, including parameter growth, degraded value--outcome ordering, and loss of representational diversity, that accompany stagnation and performance degradation. These findings connect limitations in UED to optimization failures previously identified in conventional deep RL, while showing how adaptive curricula couple the learner's optimization state to its future training distribution. Controlled interventions show that mitigating selected pathologies improves learning. Stabilizing the learner improves long-horizon performance and zero-shot generalization without changing the curriculum rule or increasing environment interaction. Our results establish learner trainability as a complementary design principle for UED. Effective curricula require students that remain capable of learning from the distributions they produce.
2611.08787.affiliation: Mila / University of Montreal / CIFAR AI Chair / Google DeepMind
2611.08787.update_target: Learner trainability under evolving environment curricula
2611.08787.mechanism_en: Long-horizon diagnostics measure parameter growth, value ordering and representation diversity. Controlled learner interventions preserve the curriculum rule and interaction count.
2611.08787.result_en: Stabilization improves long-horizon performance and zero-shot generalization across tested UED mechanisms and environment complexities.
2611.08787.boundary_en: Curriculum construction and learner optimization state form a coupled loop. The identified failures are empirical patterns in tested mechanisms, with separate interventions needed for each pathology.
2611.08787.abstract_zh: 无监督环境设计（UED）方法在多样课程上训练强化学习（RL）智能体，这些课程可能随智能体能力演化。以往工作主要聚焦课程如何构建，我们则研究学生在所产生分布下是否仍可训练。跨多种 UED 机制、环境复杂度及延长训练时程，我们发现反复出现的学习者侧病态，包括参数增长、价值—结果排序退化以及表征多样性丧失，它们伴随停滞和性能下降。这些发现将 UED 局限与常规深度 RL 中先前发现的优化故障连接起来，同时展示自适应课程如何将学习者优化状态与未来训练分布耦合。受控干预表明，缓解选定病态能改善学习。稳定学习者在不改变课程规则或增加环境交互的情况下，改善长时程表现和零样本泛化。结果将学习者可训练性确立为 UED 的互补设计原则。有效课程需要学生仍具备从其产生的分布中学习的能力。

2611.08892.title: Richness Is Not Evenness: Ordered Renyi Crossings under Self-Training
2611.08892.abstract_en: Recursive self-training of language models, a setting studied in model collapse, can reduce vocabulary while making frequent words, mostly function words, less dominant. We fine-tune English GPT-2 on its own output for nine generations, vary the training-data sampling temperature, and measure every model with one fixed sampler. As training temperature rises, Renyi entropy changes turn from loss to gain at distinct temperatures: min-entropy first, then collision entropy, Shannon entropy and observed richness. Between the outer crossings, word types fall while the most-common word becomes less dominant. Untruncated training at T = 1 lies in this interval: at 13,000 words, generation 9 has 24% fewer types than generation 0 yet collision entropy is 0.91 bits higher. The ordering persists with a finer grid, different measurement samplers, a fixed word budget and five fresh training seeds. Min-entropy again crosses before richness in four further settings (in Hindi only at interpolated roots) and in 12 of 13 distinct measurements under eight text representations. Next-token identities and a categorical simulation isolate decoding and sampling effects; the crossing order remains empirical. Fine-tuning on human text can produce the same split while likelihood improves, and no single order's sign reliably identifies worse likelihood across the tested settings. We recommend reporting entropy profiles at stated budgets with an independent quality measure.
2611.08892.mechanism_en: English GPT-2 trains on its own output for nine generations, with temperature, sampler and seed controls plus independent quality measures.
2611.08892.result_en: At 13,000 words and untruncated T=1, generation nine has 24% fewer word types but 0.91 bits higher collision entropy. Crossings recur under multiple representations and seeds.
2611.08892.boundary_en: The ordering remains empirical. Higher entropy at one order and lower vocabulary richness can coexist, and entropy sign alone fails to identify worse likelihood in the studied settings.
2611.08892.abstract_zh: 语言模型递归自训练这一被用于研究模型坍塌的设置，可能减少词汇量，同时降低常见词（多为功能词）的主导性。我们用英语 GPT-2 自身输出连续微调九代，改变训练数据采样温度，并以同一个固定采样器测量各代模型。随着训练温度上升，Rényi 熵变化在不同温度从损失转为增益，顺序依次为最小熵、碰撞熵、Shannon 熵和观测到的丰富度。在最外侧两次交叉之间，词类型减少，但最常见词的主导性也降低。不截断的 T = 1 训练位于这一范围。以 13,000 个词测量，第九代比第零代少 24% 的词类型，但碰撞熵高 0.91 比特。更细温度网格、不同测量采样器、固定词预算和五个新训练种子下，这一顺序仍保持。在另外四种设置中，最小熵也先于丰富度交叉（印地语仅在插值求根时成立），并在八种文本表征的 13 项不同测量中的 12 项成立。下一 token 恒等关系与分类模拟分离了解码和采样效应，但交叉顺序仍是实证现象。用人工文本微调也可能在似然改善时产生相同分裂，在被测设置中，任一单阶熵变化的正负均无法可靠识别更差似然。我们建议在明确预算下报告熵谱，并配合独立质量指标。

2611.08946.title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
2611.08946.authors: Jingdong Zhang , Jionghao Wang , Zhengming Yu , Yancheng Cai , Wei Chow , Chris Choy , Zhiyang Dou , Hang Hua , Jiachen Li , Zhixuan Liu , Chen Wang , Songlin Wei , Siyuan Yang , Yu Yuan , Xiaohang Zhan , Yucheng Zhang , Shuhong Zheng , Xin Li , Lingjie Liu , Wojciech Matusik , Zhengzhong Tu , Wenping Wang
2611.08946.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Robotics (cs.RO)
2611.08946.abstract_en: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.
2611.08946.affiliation: Texas A&M University / University of Cambridge / National University of Singapore / NVIDIA / Massachusetts Institute of Technology / MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab / University of Texas at Austin / Carnegie Mellon University / University of Pennsylvania / University of Southern California / Purdue University / Adobe / University of Toronto
2611.08946.update_target: Benchmark protocols for solution and self-editing harness evolution
2611.08946.mechanism_en: Each round retains validation-improved solutions and lets an improver revise both executor and itself. Hidden tests and paired harness-edit controls evaluate the final outcome.
2611.08946.result_en: Across vision, robotics and infrastructure tasks, self-built solutions benefit most, binary feedback limits open models, and paired runs attribute part of the gain to harness editing.
2611.08946.boundary_en: This is a fixed-budget benchmark of bounded recursion. Hidden testing, feedback informativeness and physical/exact checks define the evaluated difficulty and transfer scope.
2611.08946.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型越来越多地以智能体部署，其表现不仅取决于模型，也取决于运行框架，即模型行动时使用的提示、工具、记忆和控制循环。当智能体应用于新问题时，自然会问，它能否利用任务反馈改进自身工作方式，而不仅是答案。多数现有基准保持智能体框架固定，只评分产生的解法，或面向大规模模型训练。我们提出 Flex-RSI，一个在固定预算下评测智能体在视觉与机器人任务上递归自我改进的基准。每轮中，执行器改进任务解法，仅当其在留出验证数据上分数更高时才保留，随后改进器修改框架，包括执行器和它自己。每次运行从相同通用框架开始，最终解法在隐藏测试数据上评分。我们在覆盖感知、推理、机器人动作、3D 重建、视觉创作和基础设施的任务上评估闭源与开放权重模型，发现智能体自行构建解法时，自我改进帮助最大。仅记录成功或失败的反馈限制了开放权重模型，而在输出必须通过严格物理稳定性或精确正确性检查的任务上，它们落后最多。配对运行进一步表明，编辑框架本身对增益有贡献。

In each round, the executor edits the task solution, which is kept or reverted according to its score on held-out validation data; the improver then edits the harness, including the executor and itself. (b) The 24 tasks fall into six areas. Each tile shows an example task from one area, and its badge gives the number of tasks in that area. (c) Each dot is a task, placed by the score difference between the best and the worst model before (horizontal) and after (vertical) self-improvement; its height above the diagonal shows how much further apart the models end up. 2611.09030.title: A Controlled Study of Models, Skills, Feedback, and Curriculum in Agentic Robotics
2611.09030.authors: Kaiyuan Chen , Xinyue Zhu , Shuangyu Xie , Uksang Yoo , Thi Thu Phuong Luong , Marcus Gualtieri , Christian Juette , Liu Ren , Spencer Huang , Ken Goldberg
2611.09030.abstract_en: Agentic robotics asks coding agents to implement and iteratively improve robot policies from simulated and real-world physical interactions. We study the self-learning loop of agentic robotics through a controlled simulation study spanning nine manipulation tasks, 631 different experiment configurations, and 28K coding agent rollouts, systematically varying model capability, skill priors, feedback structure, and curriculum. The experiment data suggests that the bottleneck is often not the access to sufficient information, but interpreting it into the right policy update. Across these factors, a successful self-learning loop depends on how effectively agents attribute failures, reason task-relevant spatial and geometric structure, and selectively restructure code to improve policies.
2611.09030.affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / Bosch / NVIDIA
2611.09030.update_target: Failure attribution, feedback and curriculum in robot-code improvement
2611.09030.mechanism_en: A controlled simulation varies models, skill priors, feedback structure and curricula, then analyzes the code updates produced by repeated agent rollouts.
2611.09030.result_en: The study covers nine manipulation tasks, 631 configurations and 28K coding-agent rollouts, identifying interpretation of information as a frequent bottleneck.
2611.09030.boundary_en: The experimental evidence is simulation. Access to rich feedback and successful reasoning about geometry or failure causes are separate variables in the tested learning loop.
2611.09030.abstract_zh: 智能体机器人研究要求代码智能体依据仿真与现实世界物理交互，实现并迭代改进机器人策略。我们通过受控仿真研究考察智能体机器人的自学习循环，涵盖九项操作任务、631 种不同实验配置和 2.8 万次代码智能体滚动运行，系统改变模型能力、技能先验、反馈结构和课程。实验数据表明，瓶颈往往不是能否获得足够信息，而是如何将信息解释为正确策略更新。在这些因素中，成功自学习循环取决于智能体多有效地归因失败、推理与任务相关的空间和几何结构，并选择性重构代码以改进策略。

2611.09203.title: Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners
2611.09203.authors: Abdelkader Metales , Miriam Grabenheinrich , Aicha Metales
2611.09203.abstract_en: Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. In a simulated continual-learning stream, showing the judge one report per detected chain cut the copied lies it accepted by 0.10-0.24 across four judges, at a mean cost of no more than 4.2 percentage points of accepted truths. Against reworded copies, a test of how many of a report's named entities are absent from an earlier look-alike separates LLM rewrites from 100 labelled independent reports of the same event with AUC 0.98-0.99 and wrongly flags one; entity overlap alone does as well, TF-IDF and a current embedding model come close, and the test catches few natural same-source derivatives. With the miss patterns of generated rewrite networks, it cut the reworded-copy lies accepted from 0.67 to 0.20 (0.40 when the rewriter invents details). Counting reports or chains alone is not a reliable defence, the effect of provenance information depends on the judge, and colluding sources remain the open problem. Code and labels: this https URL
2611.09203.affiliation: caaise GmbH / Djilali Liabes University of Sidi Bel Abbes
2611.09203.image_note: All 19 PDF pages inspected. The paper contains tables and text but no numbered figure. Explicit placeholder retained.
2611.09203.update_target: Provenance-sensitive evidence admission for continual learners
2611.09203.mechanism_en: Near-copy detection and rewritten-copy controls test whether repeated reports count as independent confirmations, with simulated learning streams and chain-based filtering.
2611.09203.result_en: Three identical reprints raise lie acceptance from 0.06 to 0.71 and 0.21 to 0.90 for two models. One-report-per-chain reduces copied-lie acceptance 0.10–0.24 across four judges.
2611.09203.boundary_en: Natural derivatives, generated rewrites and colluding sources behave differently. Simulated continual streams and judge behavior provide the evidence, with model-dependent response to provenance notes.
2611.09203.abstract_zh: 同一主张的许多新闻报道其实是同一来源的副本，包括通讯社稿件、媒体集团内部共享内容、联合供稿与新闻稿。我们研究 LLM 评判器和持续学习者是否将这些副本当作独立确认。在 20 万篇英语 CC-News 文章中，MinHash 检测器将 18.9% 与另一媒体的近似副本关联（移除模板内容后精确率为 0.97）。它将 92% 的编辑转载关联到原文，却未关联任何由 phi4、Llama 3.2 或 Gemini 2.5 Flash 改写的版本。对未知人物的主张，向 Llama 3.2 3B 和 phi4 14B 展示三份相同转载而非一篇报道，使它们接受谎言的比例分别从 0.06 升至 0.71、从 0.21 升至 0.90，即使注明报道来自同一来源也被忽略。Gemini 2.5 Flash 已相信单篇报道，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 会遵循溯源说明和表格。在模拟持续学习流中，让评判器对每条检测出的链仅看一篇报道，使四种评判器接受的复制谎言减少 0.10–0.24，代价是被接受真话的平均降幅不超过 4.2 个百分点。对于重述副本，统计报道中有多少命名实体未出现在先前相似报道中的测试，能够将 LLM 改写与 100 篇人工标注的同事件独立报道区分，AUC 为 0.98–0.99，误标一篇。仅用实体重叠也同样好，TF-IDF 和当前嵌入模型接近，而该测试仅捕获少量自然同源派生稿件。在生成式改写网络的漏检模式下，它将接受重述谎言的比例从 0.67 降至 0.20（改写器编造细节时为 0.40）。仅数报道数或来源链数不是可靠防御，溯源信息的作用依赖评判器，而共谋来源仍是开放问题。代码与标签见 this https URL。

2611.09212.title: On the Limits of Execution Traces for Repairing Assertion Failures in LLM-Generated Code
2611.09212.authors: Muntasir Adnan , Carlos C. N. Kuhn
2611.09212.abstract_en: Iterative repair returns a failed program's error to a large language model (LLM) and asks it to fix it. After iterative repair, the remaining failures are mostly assertion failures: with four Qwen2.5 models, they make up 79% of residual failures on BigCodeBench, all on HumanEval and 93% on LiveCodeBench. We argue, through an information view of the feedback, that an assertion failure says little about where the fault lies. We propose Breakpoint Debugging (BPD), which returns the failed program annotated inline with its variables' runtime values. We take the tasks that iterative repair failed to fix with five repair attempts and compare two ways of spending five further generations on them: BPD, and resampling. On BigCodeBench, BPD repairs 26.7% of these tasks against 22.4%, and its advantage grows with model size. On HumanEval, BPD outperforms resampling but only slightly, and on LiveCodeBench, fresh sampling repairs more (6.5% against 4.9%). Furthermore, BPD reduces unchanged-code resubmissions from 28% to 8% on BigCodeBench. Using only the first failing test's trace, it outperforms tracing all failing tests while using fewer tokens than both all-trace BPD and plain iterative repair. On LiveCodeBench, BPD gives no gain even on the public tests, so a visible failing input is not enough for a trace to help. These results match the information view: a trace helps only when the test exposes a failing input, and the fault is an implementation slip; otherwise, a repair loop should resample rather than trace.
2611.09212.update_target: Feedback value in iterative code repair
2611.09212.mechanism_en: After five failed repair attempts, five additional generations are allocated to breakpoint traces or resampling. First-failing-test traces and unchanged-code repeats provide controls.
2611.09212.result_en: BigCodeBench repair is 26.7% versus 22.4% for resampling, while LiveCodeBench favors resampling at 6.5% versus 4.9%. Unchanged resubmissions fall from 28% to 8%.
2611.09212.boundary_en: This evaluates task-local repair feedback. Trace usefulness depends on exposed failing inputs and implementation-slip structure, so added execution detail alone cannot predict useful repair.
2611.09212.abstract_zh: 迭代修复将失败程序的错误返回给大语言模型（LLM），要求其修复。经过迭代修复后，剩余失败主要是断言失败。在四种 Qwen2.5 模型上，它们占 BigCodeBench 残余失败的 79%、HumanEval 的全部，以及 LiveCodeBench 的 93%。我们从反馈信息的视角认为，断言失败几乎不说明故障位置。我们提出断点调试（BPD），返回在代码内部标注变量运行时值的失败程序。对五次修复仍未解决的任务，我们比较额外五次生成的两种用法，即 BPD 与重新采样。在 BigCodeBench 上，BPD 修复其中 26.7% 的任务，而重新采样为 22.4%，且模型越大优势越强。在 HumanEval 上，BPD 仅略优于重新采样，在 LiveCodeBench 上，新采样修复更多（6.5% 对 4.9%）。此外，BPD 在 BigCodeBench 上将未修改代码的重复提交从 28% 降至 8%。仅使用第一个失败测试的轨迹，效果优于跟踪全部失败测试，同时 token 少于全轨迹 BPD 和普通迭代修复。在 LiveCodeBench 上，即使公开测试中 BPD 也没有增益，因此仅有可见失败输入并不足以让轨迹有用。这些结果符合信息视角。仅当测试暴露失败输入，且故障是实现疏漏时，轨迹才有帮助，否则修复循环应重新采样而非跟踪。

2611.09348.title: When Feedback Becomes a Backdoor: Tracing Backdoor Skill Formation in Text-Space Skill Optimization
2611.09348.authors: Louise Nayeong Koh , Yaechan Lee , Myeongjong Lee , Doyeon Kim , Juyoung Park , Seunggyu Kim , Inseo Kim , Chaerin Jung , Hyogon Ryu
2611.09348.abstract_en: Reference answers are a supervision channel in text-space Skill optimization, which produces reusable text artifacts called Skills that guide future agent behavior. Poisoning those answers can induce a persistent trigger-conditioned rule without giving the attacker access to the model, optimizer, or Skill file. We study this reference-feedback poisoning in SkillOpt by tracing an attacker-supplied trigger--payload mapping from reflection to held-out activation. In SearchQA, where the payload replaces a short answer, the natural attack retains an exact rule in all three seeds; each final Skill emits the payload on 200/200 triggered questions and 0/200 clean questions. In seed 42, removing the rule eliminates activation, and an in-run comparison shows similar clean accuracy to benign SkillOpt (169/200 versus 171/200). In SpreadsheetBench, where the payload requires an additional workbook edit, no natural run retains an exact rule across three seeds. Diagnostic interventions locate two successive bottlenecks: the Analyst abstracts away required literals, and, once literal preservation is enabled, edit-budget ranking can remove exact edits before candidate construction. Poisoned references can therefore create persistent backdoors, but exposure alone does not ensure that the induced rule is formed, selected, and retained.
2611.09348.affiliation: Yonsei University / Inha University / Konkuk University / Sungkyunkwan University / Ewha Womans University / Konyang University / KRAFTON
2611.09348.update_target: Reference-feedback poisoning in retained text Skills
2611.09348.mechanism_en: An attacker-provided trigger/payload mapping is traced through reflection, edit selection and final held-out activation, with rule removal and literal-preservation interventions.
2611.09348.result_en: SearchQA final Skills trigger on 200/200 poisoned-condition questions and 0/200 clean ones in all three seeds. SpreadsheetBench natural runs retain no exact rule across three seeds.
2611.09348.boundary_en: Formation, selection and retention are separate bottlenecks. The contrasting domains prevent treating poisoned-reference exposure as inevitable persistent backdoor formation.
2611.09348.abstract_zh: 参考答案是文本空间 Skill 优化的一条监督通道，这种优化产生可复用文本材料 Skills，指导未来智能体行为。即使攻击者不能访问模型、优化器或 Skill 文件，污染这些答案也可能诱导持久、以触发器为条件的规则。我们在 SkillOpt 中研究这种参考反馈中毒，追踪攻击者提供的触发器—载荷映射，从反思到留出条件下的激活。在 SearchQA 中，载荷替换短答案，自然攻击在全部三个种子中都保留精确规则。每个最终 Skill 在 200/200 个触发问题上输出载荷，在 0/200 个干净问题上输出。种子 42 中，移除规则即可消除激活，运行内比较显示，其干净准确率接近良性 SkillOpt（169/200 对 171/200）。在 SpreadsheetBench 中，载荷要求额外工作簿编辑，三个种子中的自然运行均未保留精确规则。诊断干预定位了连续两个瓶颈。Analyst 会抽象掉必需字面量，而启用字面量保留后，编辑预算排名又可能在候选构建之前移除精确编辑。因此，污染参考答案能产生持久后门，但仅有暴露并不能保证诱导规则被形成、选中和保留。

2611.09382.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
2611.09382.authors: Junru Hu , Cheng Tang , Wei Li , Hongze Zhu , Chun-Mei Feng , Qi Zhang , Yirong Chen , Ming Hu
2611.09382.abstract_en: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. 2611.09382.update_target: Reliability and transfer of localized weight edits
2611.09382.mechanism_en: Sixteen editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales use candidate validation and full held-out evaluation, including retained-original outcomes.
2611.09382.result_en: The paper reports best gains up to 29.45 points with 1,023 edited parameters, uneven cross-task improvements, and six trajectories retaining original weights.
2611.09382.boundary_en: Best trajectory gains and cross-task transfer vary substantially. The retained-original runs are part of the outcome distribution and do not support universal successful weight editing.
2611.09382.abstract_zh: 权重空间编程（WSP）使推理智能体能够直接检查并修改神经网络参数，为基于梯度的模型适应提供替代方案。然而，其能力、跨任务泛化及实践局限仍缺乏充分理解。我们通过七个基准、两种模型规模（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B）上的 16 条编辑轨迹系统研究 WSP，得到三个关键发现。首先，高度局部干预可取得显著增益。完整留出评估中，MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 上准确率最高分别提高 29.45、4.42、36.72 和 17.11 个百分点。尤其仅修改 1,023 个参数就带来 29.45 个百分点的改进。其次，WSP 展现出有前景但不均衡的跨任务泛化。一个数学编辑检查点无需进一步编辑，即将 GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 分别提高 3.03、12.18 和 20.10 个百分点，而 SciCode 表现保持不变。第三，有效编辑仍困难且不一致。结果在轨迹间差异很大，16 条轨迹中有六条因无法可靠验证候选改进而保留原权重。总体而言，这些结果既凸显 WSP 在高度局部模型适应上的潜力，也揭示干预发现、可靠性和跨任务迁移的重要挑战。主页为 this https URL，GitHub 为 this https URL。

2611.09670.title: Goodhart in the Planner: Sampling-Based Control Exploits Rewards Learned from Human Preferences
2611.09670.abstract_en: Robots increasingly choose actions by searching against a reward model learned from human preferences, in model-predictive control or best-of-$N$ selection; we measure what this does to the true objective. On HalfCheetah and Hopper with crowd-sourced labels, and on Meta-World drawer-open and plate-slide with synthetic labels and blind labels from the two authors, harder MPPI search cuts true return by up to 76%: with human labels the drawer opens in 0 of 20 runs against 10 of 10 for the cloned policy the planner starts from, while held-out label accuracy stays at 0.75-0.97. On plate-slide human labels are exploited less than synthetic ones, and on window-open search helps. True return roughly follows how far the planner's weights move from its proposals ($\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}}$) for both weighting rules we test, and best-of-$N$ with a verifier from synthetic labels falls below a single noisy action. We prove that $\chi^2$-regularized MPPI at a temperature set by the scorer's error spread on the proposals is worst-case optimal, that no positive gain can be certified once that spread exceeds the scorer's own, and that an episode's return splits exactly into per-step terms, of which the guarantee covers the selection terms. Calibrated from 100 proposal pairs ranked by true return (an oracle) on start states the evaluation never uses, this rule is the safest fix we test: with each of five independent sets it succeeds in every arm run and keeps on average 86-94% of the cloned policy's return on plate-slide and drawer-open, though it is cautious where search helps. Calibration from a person's comparisons cannot detect a bias the scorer learned from that person; correcting for the pairs people cannot tell apart, or a second person, limits the damage.
2611.09670.affiliation: University of Texas at Austin / Independent researcher
2611.09670.update_target: Search pressure on learned rewards and calibrated planner selection
2611.09670.mechanism_en: MPPI and best-of-N are evaluated against true return, label accuracy and proposal divergence. A regularized rule is analyzed and tested with oracle and human-comparison calibration.
2611.09670.result_en: Harder search cuts true return up to 76%, despite held-out reward-label accuracy of 0.75–0.97. The oracle-calibrated fix retains 86–94% of cloned return on two tasks.
2611.09670.boundary_en: The safest calibration in the study uses true-return-ranked pairs. Human calibration can inherit the scorer's annotator bias, and benefits vary across manipulation tasks.
2611.09670.abstract_zh: 机器人越来越多地通过搜索针对人类偏好学习的奖励模型来选择动作，例如模型预测控制或最佳 $N$ 选取。我们测量其对真实目标的影响。在使用众包标签的 HalfCheetah、Hopper，以及使用合成标签和两位作者盲标的 Meta-World 抽屉打开与盘子滑动任务上，更强 MPPI 搜索使真实回报最多降低 76%。人工标签条件下，抽屉在 20 次运行中一次也未打开，而规划器起始的克隆策略在十次中全部成功，留出标签准确率却仍为 0.75–0.97。盘子滑动中，人工标签比合成标签受利用更少，而窗户打开中搜索有益。对于被测两种加权规则，真实回报大致随规划器权重偏离提议分布的程度（$sqrt{mathrm{KL}}$）变化，使用合成标签验证器的最佳 $N$ 选取甚至低于单个带噪动作。我们证明，按评分器在提议上的误差离散程度设定温度的 $chi^2$ 正则 MPPI 在最坏情况下最优，当该离散程度超过评分器自身的离散程度时，就无法认证正增益，并且一回合回报可精确分解为逐步项，保证仅覆盖其中的选择项。使用评估从不使用的初始状态上、按真实回报排序的 100 对提议（预言机）校准后，这一规则是我们测试的最安全修复。五组独立校准集中的每一组均在全部实验组运行中成功，在盘子滑动和抽屉打开上平均保持克隆策略 86–94% 的回报，但在搜索有帮助时较保守。根据某人的比较进行校准，无法检测评分器从该人学得的偏差。对人无法区分的提议对进行修正，或使用第二个人，可限制损害。

2611.09699.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
2611.09699.abstract_en: LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. We test the tilt as a prediction for LLM-guided program search, committing each prediction from calibration data before the search runs. The level after 150 steps rises with the minibatch size in six of seven settings, but its predicted value fails: on bin packing, search attains 62-88% of the predicted gain when the proposer edits the parent and 109-119% when it writes new heuristics. The attained fraction falls with the parent-child quality correlation of unselected mutation; a registered test on two new settings confirmed the direction, but not the quantitative agreement after a correction. Further registered tests found that runs started from a good program kept losing quality over 300 steps, more so from starts that search had selected, by a margin that passed its registered rule narrowly. Runs from different starts had not reached a common level, so whether the tilt describes the stationary law of LLM editing remains open. A registered test in prompt optimisation on frozen task-model scores failed: search exceeded the tilt, and the bin-packing relation did not transfer.
2611.09699.update_target: Noisy acceptance gates and retained program quality
2611.09699.mechanism_en: Calibration commits predictions before search. Minibatch rescoring, cached incumbent scores, parent correlations and selected starting programs test finite-budget search dynamics.
2611.09699.result_en: At 150 steps, larger batches raise achieved quality in six of seven settings, but quantitative tilt predictions fail. Further registered runs lose quality over 300 steps from good starts.
2611.09699.boundary_en: Stationarity of LLM editing remains open. Logistic/reversible or diffusion assumptions support the theory, while finite runs and prompt-optimization transfer fail to establish the same law empirically.
2611.09699.abstract_zh: LLM 引导搜索循环提出修改后的候选、对其评分，并在分数更好时保留。若每次比较都重新评分两个候选，例如提示优化器的小批量接纳门槛，那么当分差服从逻辑斯谛分布、变异算子可逆时，“更好则保留”就是可逆马尔可夫链，其平稳分布是由 exp(beta f) 倾斜后的变异平衡分布。对于任意连续对称噪声差，同样的倾斜是小步长扩散极限的平稳分布，其中 beta = 4F'(0)。对小批量门槛，beta 随批量大小的平方根增长。若缓存当前候选分数，则会使记录分数膨胀。我们将这一倾斜作为 LLM 引导程序搜索的预测，在运行搜索前依据校准数据提交各项预测。150 步后的水平在七个设置中的六个随批量大小上升，但其预测数值不成立。在装箱问题中，当提议器编辑父代时，搜索达到预测增益的 62–88%，而生成新启发式时达到 109–119%。达到的比例随未被选择变异的父子质量相关性下降。两个新设置上的注册测试确认了方向，但修正后数值一致性仍未成立。进一步注册测试发现，从良好程序开始的运行在 300 步中持续丢失质量，搜索选出的初始程序丢失更多，其差值勉强通过注册规则。从不同初始点出发的运行尚未达到共同水平，因此倾斜是否描述 LLM 编辑的平稳分布仍开放。在冻结任务—模型分数上的提示优化注册测试失败，搜索超过倾斜预测，装箱关系也未迁移。

2611.09701.title: Where Should Learning Live? Regret Analysis for Text, Parameter, and Joint Adaptation
2611.09701.authors: Jungtaek Kim , Jaden Park , Jongwon Jeong , Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis , Kangwook Lee
2611.09701.abstract_en: Language-model systems can select prompts and parameter adapters repeatedly during deployment, using feedback to guide later choices. Earlier choices may change the context or environment inherited by later configurations. We study selection among preconstructed candidates and compare cumulative loss with the best fixed prompt--parameter pair used from the beginning. This excess loss separates into three terms: selection regret within the available family, the gap from restricting that family, and the benefit or harm of the actual deployment history. Selection is evaluated using the history each candidate would have produced if used throughout, which separates candidate quality from the effects of switching. When loss functions are fixed independently of selector randomness, past choices affect loss for only a bounded number of rounds, and every candidate's own-history loss is revealed, limiting switches yields sublinear expected regret within the selected family. We also quantify the costs and additional assumptions of independent probing and deployment-only feedback. Controlled experiments show that fewer switches can either lower or raise deployed loss, depending on whether inherited histories are harmful or helpful. With Qwen3.5-9B on Spider, text-only selection has lower within-family regret than joint selection, yet produces more failures because its candidate family excludes stronger configurations.
2611.09701.affiliation: University of Arkansas / University of Wisconsin-Madison / KRAFTON / Ludo Robotics
2611.09701.update_target: Theory of prompt, adapter and joint deployment selection
2611.09701.mechanism_en: Own-history losses decompose selection regret, family restriction and inherited-history effects. Limited switching is analyzed under stated feedback and bounded-memory assumptions.
2611.09701.result_en: Controlled studies show fewer switches can help or hurt. On Spider, text-only selection has lower within-family regret yet more failures because stronger configurations are excluded.
2611.09701.boundary_en: The theory concerns preconstructed candidate families. Sublinear selection regret depends on loss/feedback assumptions and does not certify quality of newly generated prompts or adapters.
2611.09701.abstract_zh: 语言模型系统可在部署期间反复选择提示和参数适配器，利用反馈指导后续选择。较早选择可能改变后续配置继承的上下文或环境。我们研究在预先构建候选中选择，并将累积损失与从最初就使用最佳固定提示—参数组合相比。超额损失分解为三项，即可用候选族内的选择遗憾、限制候选族造成的差距，以及实际部署历史带来的收益或损害。选择依据每个候选若始终使用时自身会产生的历史来评估，从而分开候选质量与切换效应。当损失函数独立于选择器随机性固定、过去选择仅在有限轮次内影响损失，且每个候选的自身历史损失均被揭示时，限制切换可获得所选候选族内的次线性期望遗憾。我们还量化独立探测与仅部署反馈的成本和额外假设。受控实验表明，根据继承历史是有害还是有益，更少切换既可能降低，也可能提高部署损失。在 Qwen3.5-9B 的 Spider 实验上，仅文本选择比联合选择的族内遗憾更低，却因其候选族排除了更强配置而产生更多失败。

2611.09721.title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
2611.09721.authors: David H. Yang , Blake Bullwinkel , Amanda Minnich , Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri , Giorgio Severi
2611.09721.categories: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.09721.abstract_en: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.
2611.09721.mechanism_en: The benchmark follows poisoning through storage, processing, retrieval and later behavior across five memory systems. A memory-aware attack optimizer tests architecture-dependent effects.
2611.09721.result_en: MemoryDojo contains 155 multi-session trajectories in four domains. All tested systems exhibit susceptibility with substantial differences in downstream effects.
2611.09721.boundary_en: The benchmark measures a persistent-memory attack surface. System susceptibility and attack-optimization gains are bounded by the tested trajectories, architectures and attacker access.
2611.09721.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体利用记忆系统改善长时程、多会话任务表现。然而，记忆也引入关键攻击面。某次会话中遇到的恶意指令，可能被存储并通过记忆传播，随后在后续会话中被检索并执行。不同记忆系统处理和检索信息的方式不同，中毒的下游效果也可能显著变化。为量化不同记忆架构中的中毒效应，我们提出 MemoryDojo，一个追踪污染信息在智能体记忆中的生命周期、并测量其对后续行为影响的基准。MemoryDojo 易于扩展，包含覆盖四个领域的 155 条多会话长时程轨迹，支持五种不同记忆系统。评估发现，全部记忆系统都易受记忆中毒影响，但下游效应差异很大。我们进一步提出感知记忆的毒化优化流程，提高中毒有效性，突出不同记忆架构的差异。我们希望 MemoryDojo 支持理解和缓解智能体记忆风险的研究。

2611.09792.title: Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
2611.09792.authors: Ayush Sawarni , Wenqian Xing , Tijana Zrnic , Ramesh Johari , Vasilis Syrgkanis
2611.09792.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Econometrics (econ.EM); Methodology (stat.ME)
2611.09792.abstract_en: Current evaluations of agentic AI systems primarily rely on benchmarks. However, the static nature of benchmarks makes them uninformative about the value of auditing interventions at deployment time. For reliable deployment, we often need to determine within an agent's trajectory whether or not to intervene, e.g., by verifying the agent's current output or steering it toward different behavior, using either human review or more costly models or time-consuming agentic supervision. The value of such interventions is fundamentally a causal inference question, asking whether the causal effect of such an intervention is beneficial for the final outcome. Estimating this causal effect is particularly challenging due to the dynamic nature of the problem: the impact of an intervention depends on the current context and environment, as well as the agent's future behavior. We develop the first methodologically grounded framework for evaluating the causal effects of randomized interventions within agent trajectories. By leveraging a relatively small dataset of agent trajectories collected under randomized interventions such as verification or screening, we can estimate the dynamic causal effect of a rich class of (contextual) intervention policies. The structural parameters that we estimate can also be used to construct safety leaderboards that capture the risk of various agentic actions, which can be used by practitioners for audit prioritization. Applying our methods to tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox, and ImpossibleBench, we find that intervention effects vary substantially across agent actions and states. More broadly, our work suggests a rich research agenda at the intersection of causal inference and agentic evaluation, which we believe is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of AI agents in the real world.
2611.09792.update_target: Causal evaluation of trajectory intervention policies
2611.09792.mechanism_en: Randomized verification/screening data estimates dynamic context-dependent effects, enabling audit-priority and safety comparisons from a shared trajectory sample.
2611.09792.result_en: Experiments on tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox and ImpossibleBench find substantial action- and state-dependent intervention effects.
2611.09792.boundary_en: The work evaluates intervention value. Using it as an evolving-agent promotion gate is an editorial extension requiring support, randomization assumptions and budget-matched validation.
2611.09792.abstract_zh: 当前智能体 AI 系统的评估主要依靠基准。但基准的静态性质，使其无法说明部署时审计干预的价值。为可靠部署，我们常须在智能体轨迹中决定是否干预，例如由人工审核、更昂贵模型或耗时智能体监督，验证当前输出或引导不同的行为。干预价值从根本上是因果推断问题，询问此类干预对最终结果的因果效应是否有益。由于问题动态性，估计这一效应尤其困难。干预影响依赖当前上下文、环境及智能体未来行为。我们建立首个方法论扎实的框架，评估智能体轨迹内随机化干预的因果效应。利用在验证、筛选等随机化干预下收集的较小轨迹数据集，我们能够估计丰富的（上下文）干预策略类的动态因果效应。估计出的结构参数还可用于构建捕获不同智能体动作风险的安全排行榜，帮助实践者确定审计优先级。将方法应用于 tau-bench Retail、ToolSandbox 和 ImpossibleBench，发现干预效应在智能体动作与状态之间显著变化。更广泛地说，本工作提出了因果推断与智能体评估交叉的一组丰富研究议程，我们认为这对于现实世界中可靠、安全地部署 AI 智能体至关重要。

2611.09802.title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
2611.09802.authors: Tural Mehtiyev , Biruk Tadesse , Lawrence Arkoh , Wesley Assunção
2611.09802.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like this http URL and this http URL , which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.
2611.09802.update_target: Persistent repository instructions and their maintenance cost
2611.09802.mechanism_en: Stale, corrected and removed instruction conditions hold task and code fixed. Tool-level trajectories measure hidden costs and whether agents repair the instruction source.
2611.09802.result_en: Across 22 tasks and 732 trajectories, one stale test command costs about two extra calls per run. No agent repairs the underlying instruction file.
2611.09802.boundary_en: Only three real stale-instruction cases are studied, and cost differences are undetected in the other cases. Immediate task recovery and persistent instruction maintenance require separate measurement.
2611.09802.abstract_zh: Claude Code 等基于 LLM 的代码智能体由仓库指令文件（也称上下文文件或智能体配置文件）指导，例如 this http URL 和 this http URL，这些文件在每个智能体会话中读取。像任何文档材料一样，它们可能落后于代码而过时，例如测试目录移动，文件却仍指向旧位置。从技术债角度，这类过时指令是文档债，其利息是给每个后续会话增加的成本。只检查任务成功的评估可能忽略这一成本，让过时文件持续存在。本文研究智能体为何遵循过时指令、这如何影响行为、代价多大，以及如何恢复。我们深入研究活跃开源仓库中的三个真实过时指令，分别涉及测试命令、代码位置和添加组件的流程。保持代码和任务固定，智能体在保留过时指令、修正到当前路径和移除指令三种条件下完成 22 项维护任务，我们逐工具调用分析两个模型的 732 条轨迹。结果发现，当过时指导与任务相关时，智能体会遵循它，有时即使别处有正确信息也如此。对过时测试命令，Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次运行约多用两次工具调用，比修正命令时多三分之一，在其他案例中则未检测到差异。尽管智能体通常能从眼前失败中恢复，没有一个修复了底层指令文件。纠正指令消除了对过时路径的操作，移除则阻止了大部分此类操作。结果说明，任务成功本身会隐藏文档债成本，凸显了评估最终结果之外行为的必要性。

2611.09807.title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
2611.09807.authors: Osamudiamen Edogun , Joshua Obigwe , Irfan Mehmood
2611.09807.abstract_en: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.
2611.09807.mechanism_en: Paired LoCoMo comparisons share stores, generator and judge, evaluating four-category and full five-category outcomes plus source-wording dependence.
2611.09807.result_en: Compaction leads 6.8 points on the comparable four categories with 34% fewer prompt tokens, but its full five-category lead is 2.0 and nonsignificant.
2611.09807.boundary_en: The adversarial baseline lead is 14.6 points. Atomic facts preserve asserted values better than phrasing in this setting, and four additional negative results include power calculations.
2611.09807.abstract_zh: 能记忆的对话智能体必须决定保留什么。检索增强生成保留对话全文并搜索，另一种做法则将每轮压缩为原子事实并搜索它们。我们在 LoCoMo 上比较两者。两个实验组在同一窗口、针对相同存储、采用相同生成器和评判器，回答全部 1,985 个问题，并将两个预测放在同一行，因此可对存在分歧的 512 个问题使用 McNemar 精确检验。在可比工作报告的四个类别中，压缩得分为 71.4%，对照为 64.6%，领先 6.8 个百分点（p = 5.5e-08），提示 token 减少 34%。当包括可比工作排除的对抗集、纳入全部五类时，领先缩小至 2.0 且不再显著，因为基线在对抗类领先 14.6。该损失具有结构性。随着参考答案要求更多源文本措辞，领先幅度从一到两个参考词时的 9.6 个百分点，变为超过八个词时落后 3.1 个百分点，token 重叠也呈现同样变化，因此原因并非评判器。压缩保留事实断言，丢弃表达方式，所以当答案是一个值时胜出，当答案是措辞时失利。我们还报告了四项带检验效能计算的负面结果。

2611.09828.title: Designing Effective Monitor-Based Interventions for Mitigating Reward Hacking During RL
2611.09828.authors: Aria Wong , Joshua Engels , Neel Nanda
2611.09828.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) rewards are notoriously difficult to design and control, often leading to the model learning unintended behaviors such as reward hacking. One potential solution is to monitor for reward hacking and penalize it when detected; however, training against a monitor could lead to evasive behavior, and our general understanding of how to apply monitors effectively during training is limited. To study how best to use monitors to mitigate reward hacking, we introduce and open source three realistic environments where Qwen3-4B reward hacks: a coding environment hackable via test overwriting, a medical chat environment hackable via sycophancy, and a biography generation environment hackable via hallucination. We first focus on the coding environment, where we find that: (1) models can learn to evade highly accurate monitors by exploiting systemic flaws in probes and LLM judges; (2) monitors that leak more learning signal during RL suppress reward hacking but are more often evaded; and (3) including easier problems in training can decrease reward hacking. We apply our findings to build better reward hacking monitors for the medical chat and biography generation environments that improve upon naive baselines to reduce reward hacking rates across seeds to before-training levels in some interventions. Our results demonstrate that our takeaways translate to new settings and that better monitor intervention designs are possible.
2611.09828.update_target: Reward-hacking monitor designs during policy training
2611.09828.mechanism_en: Coding, medical-chat and biography environments expose reward hacks. Controlled monitor-information and curriculum changes measure both suppression and monitor evasion.
2611.09828.result_en: In some interventions, improved designs reduce hacking across seeds to pre-training levels. Highly accurate monitors can still be evaded through systemic probe/judge flaws.
2611.09828.boundary_en: Monitor accuracy and resistance to a training policy are different measurements. Easier training examples and information leakage interact with behavior, with no universal prevention guarantee.
2611.09828.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）奖励的设计与控制十分困难，常导致模型学到奖励投机等非预期行为。一种潜在方案是在发现奖励投机时进行监测和惩罚，但针对监测器训练可能产生规避行为，而我们对训练中如何有效应用监测器的总体理解有限。为研究最佳使用方式，我们引入并开源三个 Qwen3-4B 会奖励投机的真实感环境，包括可通过覆盖测试投机的代码环境、可通过奉承投机的医学聊天环境，以及可通过幻觉投机的传记生成环境。我们首先聚焦代码环境，发现三点。（1）模型能够利用探针和 LLM 评判器的系统缺陷，学会规避高度准确的监测器。（2）在 RL 中泄露更多学习信号的监测器能够抑制奖励投机，但也更常被规避。（3）训练中加入更容易的问题，可以减少奖励投机。我们将这些发现用于为医学聊天和传记生成环境构建更好的奖励投机监测器，相对朴素基线改善，在部分干预中将跨种子的奖励投机率降至训练前水平。结果表明，我们的发现可迁移到新设置，也表明更好的监测干预设计是可能的。
2611.09828.abstract_source_note: Complete saved official New text and faithful translation. Literal link placeholders and source LaTeX retained without splicing later wording.
2611.09828.image_caption: Figure 1 : We introduce three environments where reward hacking emerges naturally during training without finetuning or prompting to seed the behaviors. Using these environments, we build understanding of how to design more effective training interventions.
2611.09828.resource_scope: Supplementary qualitative-analysis tooling, with remote-only scoring and no real experiment dataset bundled. No extra card button.

2611.09889.title: SciCheck: A Framework for Verifying the Integrity of Deep Learning Training
2611.09889.authors: Alexander Nguyen , Dylan Gresham , Gaby G. Dagher , Min Long
2611.09889.abstract_en: Deep learning training is difficult to verify within a scientific workflow: its architecture, hyperparameters, and procedure are rarely fixed until training has been attempted, and two honest runs never produce the same weights, so recomputation cannot serve as a check. We present SciCheck, a framework in which the scientist explores training configurations freely and posts a blueprint to a provenance ledger for each candidate they want verified, and a verifying scientist judges the resulting run in two layers: a statistical judge model that compares per-step gradient statistics against the verifier's own reference run, and a spot-check that re-executes randomly chosen training segments whose checkpoints are committed to the ledger one epoch at a time. On an MLP, a CNN, and an autoencoder at 100k-500k parameters, under gradient sign flipping, label poisoning, and fabricated runs, SciCheck reaches F1 of 0.966, 0.906, and 0.976 while rejecting 0-4.4% of honest runs. For the attacks we test, the spot-check accounts for most of this accuracy, and we characterize what each layer can detect. The effective-signal statistic falls as $(1-2s)^2$ under a sign flip of severity $s$, so gradient statistics alone catch strong enough sign flips, while fabricated runs that replay genuine statistics look no more anomalous than honest runs to any statistical detector we test. The spot-check catches fully fabricated segments with probability at least $1-(1-s)^k$ for $k$ sampled segments when the draws stay hidden until the run is committed, which roughly matches our measurements and lets a verifier choose $k$ for a target soundness. Verification costs 1.5-2.3x one retraining, mostly for the verifier's reference run; each submission's spot-check takes under 1.5 s, and per-epoch commitments reduce checkpoint storage 5-17x compared with keeping every checkpoint.
2611.09889.mechanism_en: Blueprint/epoch commitments support a reference-gradient judge and hidden sampled segment re-execution, with sign-flip, poisoned-label and fabricated-run tests.
2611.09889.result_en: On 100k–500k-parameter models, F1 is 0.966/0.906/0.976 and honest-run rejection is 0–4.4%. Verification costs 1.5–2.3x a retraining, with per-submission spot checks below 1.5 seconds.
2611.09889.boundary_en: Most tested detection comes from spot checks. Statistical detectors miss fabricated runs that replay genuine statistics, and the stated probability bound requires hidden draws until commitment.
2611.09889.abstract_zh: 深度学习训练在科学工作流中难以验证。架构、超参数与流程在尝试训练之前很少固定，而且两个诚实运行从不产生相同权重，因此重算无法充当检查。我们提出 SciCheck 框架，科学家自由探索训练配置，并为每个希望验证的候选向溯源账本提交蓝图。验证科学家通过两层判断运行结果，一层统计评判模型比较逐步梯度统计量与验证者自身参考运行，另一层抽查重新执行随机选择的训练片段，其检查点逐个 epoch 提交到账本。在参数量 10 万至 50 万的 MLP、CNN 和自编码器上，针对梯度符号翻转、标签中毒与伪造运行，SciCheck 的 F1 分别达到 0.966、0.906 和 0.976，拒绝诚实运行的比例为 0–4.4%。对被测攻击，抽查解释了大部分准确率，我们刻画了每层能检测什么。严重程度为 $s$ 的符号翻转下，有效信号统计量按 $(1-2s)^2$ 下降，因此仅靠梯度统计量能捕获足够强的翻转，但重放真实统计量的伪造运行，在我们测试的任意统计检测器看来，与诚实运行一样不异常。若抽样在运行提交之前保持隐藏，对 $k$ 个抽样片段，抽查捕获完全伪造片段的概率至少为 $1-(1-s)^k$。这一结果大致符合测量，并允许验证者针对目标可靠性选择 $k$。验证成本为一次重训练的 1.5–2.3 倍，主要来自验证者参考运行。每份提交的抽查少于 1.5 秒，逐 epoch 提交相比保存每个检查点，可将存储缩减 5–17 倍。

2611.10099.title: Enmo Safety: External, Non-invasive, Model-agnostic Oversight for Off-the-Shelf Language Models
2611.10099.authors: Mohammed Nayeem Khan , Sarun Kumar K. S. , Allan Kevin T. , Chirag Vaidya , Vrishank Tiwari
2611.10099.categories: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2611.10099.abstract_en: We study a safety harness that improves itself without touching model weights. Enmo Safety wraps a chat model with a deterministic input assessment, trigger-matched safety guidance, spotlighting of untrusted content, and an output guard. A reflector model turns failures into one bounded update per round, and an update is kept only if it lowers harm without raising refusal of benign prompts on a held-out dev split. Every version is snapshotted and every decision ledgered. We evaluate a bare model, the seed harness and the evolved harness on six open benchmarks (HarmBench, AdvBench, JailbreakBench, XSTest, AgentHarm, deepset prompt-injections). On 150 items and on a 290-item holdout, none of the before/after differences on two models was statistically significant. A fourth iteration ran six policy models on a fresh 300-item split: the harness cut the unsafe rate significantly on two models (12.9% to 7.1%, p = 0.035; 10.2% to 3.6%, p = 0.036), not on the other four, and raised agentic-harm labels on two. Whether the rules fired was unrelated to outcome (Fisher p from 0.30 to 1.0), and the helpfulness clauses made agentic harm worse than no harness on obfuscated attacks. A reworded clause and an input-normalisation step form harness v22, at a measured cost in benign tool-task refusal. Each cell is one run, so these estimates do not establish a general safety improvement. Code, harness versions and ledger: this https URL
2611.10099.update_target: External safety harness rules, with frozen policy weights
2611.10099.mechanism_en: A reflector proposes one bounded edit from failures. Held-out development checks gate harm and benign refusal, and accepted versions are snapshotted for subsequent calls.
2611.10099.result_en: Two of six models have significant unsafe-rate reductions in the fresh 300-item evaluation. Other models show mixed outcomes, including increased agentic harm.
2611.10099.boundary_en: Each evaluation cell is one run. The New abstract and retrieved PDF abstract use different wording and summaries. Both are retained separately. Broad safety improvement remains unsupported.
2611.10099.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种无需触及模型权重即可自我改进的安全框架。Enmo Safety 在聊天模型外部加入确定性输入评估、与触发条件匹配的安全指导、不可信内容聚焦标记以及输出防护。反思模型将失败转化为每轮一次的有界更新，只有当更新在留出的开发集上降低危害且不提高对良性提示的拒绝率时，才会保留更新。每个版本都有快照，每项决定都有账本记录。我们在六个开放基准（HarmBench、AdvBench、JailbreakBench、XSTest、AgentHarm、deepset prompt-injections）上评估裸模型、初始框架和进化后的框架。在150个项目和290个项目的留出集上，两个模型的所有前后差异均未达到统计显著性。第四轮迭代在一个新的300项目划分上运行了六个策略模型：框架在两个模型上显著降低不安全率（12.9%降至7.1%，p = 0.035；10.2%降至3.6%，p = 0.036），在其余四个模型上则未显著降低，并使两个模型的代理性危害标签增加。规则是否触发与结果无关（Fisher检验p值为0.30至1.0），而有帮助性条款在混淆攻击下使代理性危害比没有框架时更严重。重新措辞的条款与输入规范化步骤构成框架v22，其代价是实测良性工具任务拒绝率上升。每个单元格只有一次运行，因此这些估计不能确立一般性的安全改进。代码、框架版本与账本：this https URL
