2611.10382.title: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
2611.10382.authors: Xinxiang Yin , Xinglang Zhang , Haodong Chen , Zhiqing Cui , Weidong Tang , Yuxuan Wang , Junrui Wang , Jingyi Zhang , Jianfeng Zhang , Jian Qian
2611.10382.abstract_en: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.
2611.10382.affiliation: The University of Hong Kong / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / National University of Singapore / Peking University / Xi’an Jiaotong University / Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab
2611.10382.update_target: External retained memory under a frozen policy
2611.10382.mechanism_en: Anchor replays the source decision with and without a candidate memory, tests distribution-shift magnitude and alignment with the source action's role, and retains admitted cards for later tasks.
2611.10382.result_en: Reported held-out gains reach 19.9% in ALFWorld success and 17.2% in WebShop mean score over the respective strongest baselines. One backbone retains 41% fewer cards.
2611.10382.boundary_en: A local source-action probe supplies an admission signal. Its relationship to downstream utility requires held-out testing, especially for failed source actions and new environments.
2611.10382.abstract_zh: LLM代理在编程和数学推理方面取得了令人瞩目的进展，推动了对从长时程交互中学习的日益关注。记忆支持这一过程，但看似合理的经验可能冗余，或强化不合适的行动。一条记忆的来源决策能否提供一种实用的保留测试？我们定位轨迹中的关键步骤，提取候选记忆，并在相同上下文中分别带有和不带有候选记忆地重放每个来源决策。这揭示了两个性质：大多数候选几乎不改变所探测的分布，而成功和失败的来源行动都可能被强化或抑制。这些观察促成了Anchor，它在保留前检验偏移幅度和来源角色对齐。获准的记忆引导后续轨迹，使冻结策略下基于经验的改进成为可能。在留出的ALFWorld和WebShop任务上，相对于各骨干的最强基线，Anchor分别将成功率和平均得分提高最多19.9%和17.2%。使用Qwen3.5-27B时，它保留的ALFWorld卡片比不加筛选的保留方式少41%，且在使用更少token的同时优于全部四个WebShop成本比较基线。

2611.10463.title: LongCapHarness: Capability-Guided Auto-Harnessing for Long-Context Reasoning
2611.10463.abstract_en: Existing methods enhancing an LLM's long-context reasoning capability often rely on data synthesis and follow-up LLM post-training. However, the data synthesis strategy and the post-training recipes are empirically driven and computationally intensive. In this work, we propose a new framework, dubbed LongCapHarness, to instead harness the underlying capabilities for long-context reasoning. The harnessing process recursively revises and updates capability primitive implementation, capability state and control logic through recursive self-improvement on the development set. With neither data synthesis nor LLM post-training, LongCapHarness is applied to Llama3-8B and transferred to Qwen2.5-3B. LongCapHarness substantially outperforms recent data-synthesis-based baselines on HELMET and RULER benchmarks; its estimated development cost is less than 50% of the estimated training costs of NExtLong and PolicyLong. We hope these results motivate further research into harnessing the latent capabilities of LLMs to solve tasks beyond their explicit training.
2611.10463.update_target: Capability primitives, state and control logic in an external long-context harness
2611.10463.mechanism_en: Development-set recursive revision updates the executable capability implementation and controller. The retained harness is evaluated on HELMET and RULER and transferred between backbones.
2611.10463.result_en: The authors report improvements over data-synthesis methods and estimated development cost below half the estimated NExtLong and PolicyLong training costs.
2611.10463.boundary_en: The cost comparison uses estimates. The abstract supplies no numerical gain or evidence of an unbounded sequence of improvements.
2611.10463.abstract_zh: 现有增强LLM长上下文推理能力的方法通常依赖数据合成及后续LLM训练。然而，数据合成策略与后训练方案由经验驱动且计算密集。本文提出一种名为LongCapHarness的新框架，转而挖掘模型已有的长上下文推理能力。该框架构建过程通过开发集上的递归自我改进，递归修订并更新能力原语的实现、能力状态和控制逻辑。LongCapHarness既不合成数据，也不对LLM进行后训练，并被应用于Llama3-8B以及迁移至Qwen2.5-3B。LongCapHarness在HELMET和RULER基准上显著优于近期基于数据合成的基线；其估计开发成本低于NExtLong和PolicyLong估计训练成本的50%。我们希望这些结果推动进一步研究，利用LLM的潜在能力解决超出其显式训练范围的任务。

2611.10510.title: ReSkill: Selective Self-Improvement for Robot Manipulation
2611.10510.authors: Zheng Sun , Zhihao Li , Zhuo Li , Wenrui Liu , Xin Wang , Fei Chen
2611.10510.abstract_en: Self-improvement on compositional manipulation tasks requires deciding what to reuse, where to improve, and which changes to retain. We present ReSkill, a selective self-improvement framework that concentrates revision on capability gaps. A coding agent constructs an object-centric task graph from an instruction and a skill library, then uses node-level execution records to locate failures. At the task level, it revises stage organization, hand-off conditions, and recovery routes; at the skill level, it strengthens perception, motion, manipulation, and verification capabilities that repeatedly fail. Candidate revisions undergo full-task evaluation and paired comparisons before adoption, allowing local changes to accumulate into validated skills and an independently executable policy. The agent participates only during development; the deployed policy calls the retained skills without invoking the agent at run time. On the same development set, average success across ten RoboDojo tasks rises from 30.0% for the initial versions to 86.2% for the final adopted programs; retained programs achieve 83.6% in recorded robustness and model-selection evaluations. Across eight real-world tasks, ReSkill succeeds in 72 of 80 rebuilt-simulation trials and 62 of 80 real-robot trials (77.5%). The median revision changes only three functions, approximately 0.5% of a program, while 39% of task-specific functions in later-added tasks directly reuse existing implementations. These results show how locating local deficiencies, validating candidate changes, and accumulating reusable skills can improve execution of compositional manipulation tasks.

2611.10510.update_target: Robot task graphs and reusable perception, motion, manipulation and verification functions
2611.10510.mechanism_en: Node-level failure records target revisions. Full-task evaluations and paired comparisons determine adoption, and retained skills support later task construction and an independently executable deployed policy.
2611.10510.result_en: Development success rises from 30.0% to 86.2%. Separate real-robot trials succeed in 62/80 cases. Later tasks reuse 39% of task-specific functions.
2611.10510.boundary_en: Development-set improvement, robustness/model-selection evaluation and real-robot success are separate measurements. Median small edits alone establish no causal explanation of transfer.
2611.10510.abstract_zh: 组合式操作任务中的自我改进需要决定复用什么、在哪里改进以及保留哪些变化。我们提出ReSkill，一种将修订集中于能力缺口的选择性自我改进框架。编程代理根据指令和技能库构建以对象为中心的任务图，然后利用节点级执行记录定位失败。在任务层面，它修订阶段组织、交接条件与恢复路径；在技能层面，它增强反复失败的感知、运动、操作与验证能力。候选修订在采用前接受完整任务评估和配对比较，使局部变化积累为经过验证的技能和可独立执行的策略。代理只在开发期间参与；部署策略在运行时调用保留的技能，无需调用代理。在相同开发集上，十个RoboDojo任务的平均成功率从初始版本的30.0%提高到最终采用程序的86.2%；保留程序在记录的鲁棒性及模型选择评估中达到83.6%。在八项真实世界任务中，ReSkill在80次重建仿真试验中成功72次，在80次真实机器人试验中成功62次（77.5%）。一次修订的中位数仅改变三个函数，约占程序的0.5%，而后加入任务中39%的任务特定函数直接复用现有实现。这些结果表明，定位局部缺陷、验证候选变化并积累可复用技能，可以改善组合式操作任务的执行。

2611.10719.title: No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?
2611.10719.authors: Xiaojie Cai , Jiayi Chen , Junwei Chen , Yu Chen , Sikai Cheng , Jinquan Dai , Siyuan Feng , Bin Fu , Dayuan Fu , Guosheng Gao , Qipeng Guo , Chenwei He , Zhulin Hu , Yaxing Huang , Shuomeng Jia , Mohan Jiang , Keyang Lei , Hongliang Li , Xuefeng Li , Zhaocheng Li , Jifan Lin , Pengfei Liu , Xinghan Liu , Yixiu Liu , Pengrui Lu , Siyuan Lu , Kai Lv , Tiantian Mi , Yang Nan , Yu Qiao , Yiwei Qin , Xipeng Qiu , Junhao Shi , Runzhou Shi , Jiadi Su , Bohao Tang , Hanning Wang , Keqi Wang , Pan Wang , Ran Wang , Shaojing Wang , Yishuo Wang , Zhixin Wang , Shenyu Wu , Muhang Xie , Tianze Xu , Hang Yan , Lvmanshan Ye , Hongche Yu , Junjie Yu , Lantian Zhang , Ruihang Zhang , Bin Zhao , Chenyang Zhou , Zijin Zhou , Wenhong Zhu , Zemu Zhu , Yumin Zhuang , Haoyang Zou
2611.10719.abstract_en: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at this https URL .
2611.10719.update_target: Pre-training production workflows, infrastructure and data processes
2611.10719.mechanism_en: The authors divide a non-repeatable frontier training run into smaller repair loops with locally measurable outputs. The resulting base model supplies the starting point for later post-training.
2611.10719.result_en: A 30B-A3B MoE is trained on 11.8T tokens over three months. Reported comparisons cover base performance and identical lightweight SFT.
2611.10719.boundary_en: This is a report of one production run. A complete pre-training run was not repeated as an end-to-end improvement cycle. Team, process and model effects remain bundled.
2611.10719.abstract_zh: 预训练是每个基础模型的起点；将递归自我改进（RSI）引入这一阶段，可以让AI改进创造AI的过程。然而，公开的RSI研究迄今仅针对后训练：从已有基础模型开始，运行耗费GPU小时的试验，并返回可验证的分数。预训练以高出数个数量级的成本打破了这三个条件：一次运行在数月内消耗数十万GPU小时且无法重复；其目标，即后训练潜力，无法用单一分数衡量；需要改进的也不是一个模型，而是从数据管线、训练基础设施到运行团队的整个生产系统。据我们所知，我们首次将RSI应用于一次完整的、从零开始的前沿预训练运行，并详细报告这一过程。RSI并未止步于前沿预训练，但其形式发生了变化：由于单次不可重复运行无法闭合端到端循环，我们将其分解为能够闭合的较小循环，每个循环修复完整运行所破坏的一个环节。最终得到801-30B-A3B-Base，一个由新组建团队在三个月内从零开始用11.8T token训练的30B-A3B MoE。我们将其作为基础模型发布；本文报告的轻量SFT（6B token，无RL）仅用于探测后训练潜力。作为基础模型，801-30B-A3B优于Qwen3-30B-A3B和Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后于更大的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，并在相同SFT下保持这一位置；仅经轻量SFT，它在四个代理基准上的平均表现最高，优于包括Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在内的完整后训练模型。由于后训练RSI以强大的基础模型为前提，将RSI带入预训练便作用于每个后续阶段的基础。我们在this https URL开源801-30B-A3B-Base和轻量SFT数据。

2611.10748.title: REINS: A Self-Evolving Agent Harness for Real-Time Trajectory Planning
2611.10748.authors: Zhihong Cui , Hengyu Liu , Haoran Tang , Shijun Liu , Amir Taherkordi , Tor Skeie
2611.10748.abstract_en: Agent harnesses -- runtime scaffolds that wrap an LLM's reasoning loop with tool dispatch, verification, and persistent memory -- have become the standard substrate for deploying LLMs as autonomous agents, as demonstrated by Claude Code and Codex in software engineering. In trajectory planning, however, this paradigm has not taken hold: existing LLM-based trajectory planning methods either keep the LLM in the decision loop, exceeding the millisecond-level control budget, or offload it to offline rules or training-time supervision -- leaving the runtime planner non-evolving. Intermediate hybrids still lack the verification-and-consolidation loop that makes harnesses reliable. We ask: what runtime harness would let an LLM planner meet real-time constraints while self-evolving into a deployable one? We propose REINS, a harness built on three LLM-planner couplings: LLM outputs are (i) grounded to a learned variable-level dynamics model, (ii) verified via calibrated predicates and forward rollout, and (iii) consolidated into an indexed rule memory that serves future scenes in O(log n) without re-invoking the LLM. The harness closes a self-evolution loop: familiar scenes resolve by memory lookup; novel scenes invoke the LLM, whose verified outputs enrich the memory. Without modifying LLM weights, REINS attains 98%+ compliance, nearly 50% collision reduction, and 1.9-4.6 ms latency on simulated and real-world benchmarks at the tactical decision layer, with LLM invocation rate monotonically declining as memory matures. Code: this https URL
2611.10748.affiliation: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Shandong University / University of Oslo / Simula Research Laboratory / Aalborg University
2611.10748.update_target: Verified indexed trajectory-planning rules in an external harness
2611.10748.mechanism_en: Novel scenes invoke an LLM. Learned dynamics ground proposals, calibrated predicates and forward rollouts verify them, and accepted rules enter a memory used by future scenes.
2611.10748.result_en: Reported tactical-layer results include over 98% compliance, nearly 50% fewer collisions and 1.9–4.6 ms lookup-path latency, with declining LLM invocation.
2611.10748.boundary_en: Simulation and real-world benchmark results apply to the tactical layer. An expensive novel-scene LLM call and the consolidated lookup path have different latency requirements.
2611.10748.abstract_zh: 代理框架是为LLM推理循环提供工具分发、验证和持久记忆的运行时支架，已成为部署自主LLM代理的标准基础，软件工程中的Claude Code和Codex即为例证。然而，这一范式尚未在轨迹规划中确立：现有基于LLM的轨迹规划方法，要么将LLM保留在决策循环中，超出毫秒级控制预算，要么将其移至离线规则或训练期监督，使运行时规划器无法进化。中间的混合方案仍缺少使框架可靠的验证与巩固循环。我们提出问题：怎样的运行时框架能让LLM规划器满足实时约束，同时自我进化为可部署系统？我们提出REINS，其框架建立在三种LLM与规划器耦合之上：LLM输出被（i）落到学习得到的变量级动力学模型上，（ii）通过校准谓词和前向滚动验证，以及（iii）巩固到索引规则记忆中，未来场景可在O(log n)时间内查询，无需重新调用LLM。该框架闭合了自我进化循环：熟悉场景通过记忆查询解决；新场景调用LLM，其经过验证的输出充实记忆。在不修改LLM权重的情况下，REINS在仿真及真实世界基准的战术决策层达到98%以上合规率、近50%的碰撞减少和1.9–4.6毫秒延迟，且随着记忆成熟，LLM调用率单调下降。代码：this https URL

The LLM utterance “keep a safe distance” is (1) grounded to physical state variables (TTC, THW, DHW), (2) verified by forward rollout over a multi-step horizon, and (3) consolidated as an indexed rule keyed by these variables for instant reuse.

2611.10787.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement with Statistical Guarantees
2611.10787.authors: Zihe Gao , Zhengling Qi , Yifan Cui
2611.10787.categories: Machine Learning (stat.ML) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Methodology (stat.ME)
2611.10787.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement offers a promising path toward AI agents that improve through experience by refining their own harnesses without retraining their underlying large language models (LLMs). Making this self-improvement process reliable, however, requires more than generating new updates: agents must decide which changes are worth keeping. A greedy gate that accepts updates based solely on higher validation scores can mistake an observed gain for genuine progress and lead to performance degeneration, whereas overly conservative statistical gates may reject beneficial updates and hinder performance improvement. We introduce Trustworthy Recursive Updates with Statistical Testing (TRUST), a framework that adapts an online multiple hypothesis testing procedure to control the rate of false evolution across rounds, with an LLM analyzing historical context to help determine how much evidence is required to update the incumbent. Under interpretable assumptions, we prove that TRUST limits the proportion of accepted updates that result in unacceptable performance loss. We further derive a lower bound on the final performance gain. Across the benchmarks HotpotQA, DROP, and APPS with the models DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen-3.8-Flash, TRUST reduces the average ratio of accepted inferior updates from the greedy gate's 45.59% to 2.78%, while achieving higher final scores than the state-of-the-art statistical gate baselines for recursive self-improvement. These findings demonstrate that TRUST strikes a balance between statistical reliability and performance gain in recursive self-improvement.
2611.10787.update_target: Statistical acceptance policy for recursive harness updates
2611.10787.mechanism_en: TRUST combines online multiple testing, an adaptive evidence budget and LLM analysis of historical context. The gate promotes candidate harnesses and controls false evolution across rounds under stated assumptions.
2611.10787.result_en: The mean ratio of accepted inferior updates falls from 45.59% for the greedy gate to 2.78%, with higher final scores than evaluated statistical baselines.
2611.10787.boundary_en: Theoretical guarantees depend on the paper's assumptions about tests and evidence. Reusing development data for proposal and acceptance requires careful adherence to its information protocol.
2611.10787.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进为AI代理通过经验、在不重新训练底层大语言模型（LLM）的情况下完善自身框架，提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，要让这一过程可靠，需要的不只是生成新更新：代理还必须决定哪些变化值得保留。仅根据更高验证分数接受更新的贪心门控，可能将观察到的收益误认为真实进步，并导致性能退化；过于保守的统计门控则可能拒绝有益更新，阻碍性能提升。我们提出基于统计检验的可信递归更新（TRUST）框架，通过适配在线多重假设检验程序，控制跨轮次的错误进化率，并由LLM分析历史上下文，辅助决定更新当前版本所需的证据量。在可解释假设下，我们证明TRUST限制了已接受更新中造成不可接受性能损失的比例。我们进一步推导最终性能增益的下界。在HotpotQA、DROP和APPS基准以及DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Qwen-3.8-Flash模型上，TRUST将接受较差更新的平均比例从贪心门控的45.59%降至2.78%，同时取得高于递归自我改进最先进统计门控基线的最终分数。这些发现表明，TRUST在递归自我改进的统计可靠性与性能增益之间取得平衡。

2611.11499.title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
2611.11499.authors: Xudong Wu , Guangchen Lan , Mingqi Yuan , Jiayu Chen
2611.11499.abstract_en: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).
2611.11499.affiliation: The University of Hong Kong / Salesforce AI Research
2611.11499.update_target: Executable harness-generation policy and task-execution model weights
2611.11499.mechanism_en: Engineer and Solver policies learn jointly from generated trajectories and shared task outcomes. Updated runtime programs and policy weights shape subsequent interaction and training.
2611.11499.result_en: The reported average success is 70.3% over ALFWorld, WebShop and DBBench, with 97.0% on ALFWorld.
2611.11499.boundary_en: Joint training is compared with the evaluated one-sided baselines. Finite benchmark gains do not demonstrate sustained autonomous improvement beyond the tested training schedule.
2611.11499.abstract_zh: 语言代理的性能由模型权重和运行框架共同决定。仅优化其中一项可能受到另一项约束，限制整体性能收益。我们对朴素交替训练的分析表明，模型与框架之间的不兼容逐渐加剧，日益干扰任务执行，还可能破坏模型训练，导致性能下降。为协调模型与框架的进化，我们提出JoMoHa，据我们所知，这是首个通过强化学习联合训练可执行框架生成策略与任务执行策略的框架。JoMoHa优于所评估的仅权重和仅框架基线，并在ALFWorld、WebShop及DBBench上取得所评估方法中的最高成功率，平均为70.3%，在ALFWorld达到97.0%。通过从自身生成的轨迹中学习任务执行与运行时改进，JoMoHa实现递归自我改进（RSI）。

2611.11509.title: Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents
2611.11509.authors: Yifei Yao , Yude Zou , Xing Gao , Guanbo Jiao , Yukai Wang , Jianming Ma , Weinan Zhang , Chunhua Shen
2611.11509.abstract_en: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.
2611.11509.affiliation: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Fudan University / Zhejiang University
2611.11509.update_target: Self-written task memory and bounded working memory
2611.11509.mechanism_en: A single demonstration supplies coordinate-free task memory. Training episodes yield procedure, completion and recovery lessons. Both memories are frozen before evaluation and can be reused by other models.
2611.11509.result_en: GPT-6-Astra direct-control success rises from 46.7% to 81.7% on EBench. RoboDojo success is 69.63%, and fixed-memory generalization and cross-model reuse are reported.
2611.11509.boundary_en: The learned state is external text. The train/test separation and fixed-memory evaluations are central to interpreting gains, and real-robot improvement is not established by these benchmark numbers.
2611.11509.abstract_zh: 近期基于前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的具身代理研究，围绕MLLM开展框架工程，例如包含后训练策略和递归自我改进循环的框架。然而，这些附加机制是否超越MLLM的原生能力，尚未得到探究。我们提出SimplEvo，探索MLLM在直接控制下、通过自写文本记忆保留执行经验，能够改进到何种程度。该方法不需要权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息。MLLM从单个示范一次性写出不含坐标的任务记忆。随后，在严格训练—测试协议下，它仅在训练回合创建有界工作记忆，并在每个回合之后用关于流程、完成与恢复的经验进行完善。两种记忆在测试时均保持固定。在EBench上，SimplEvo将GPT-6-Astra直接控制的成功率（SR）从46.7%提高到81.7%，并以69.63%的SR和75.32的分数位居RoboDojo榜首。与同时保存过去视觉帧的记忆相比，SimplEvo仅使用文本记忆便取得相近SR，同时使用更少token。在记忆固定时，SimplEvo还能泛化到未见布局和随机化场景配置。此外，工作记忆可跨模型迁移：由GPT-6-Astra写出的记忆可以被更弱的MLLM直接复用，无需其自身适配即可改善性能。

2611.11558.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
2611.11558.authors: InfraRSI Team , Yuchuan Tian , Haocheng Mei , Ye Yuan , Chao Xu , Boxun Li , Guohao Dai , Kai Han , Allen Chen , Yunhe Wang , Yu Wang
2611.11558.abstract_en: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to $2.75\times$ and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from $17.4\%$ to $30.0\%$, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.
2611.11558.update_target: Training-launch settings, verified code patches, performance priors and cross-hardware experience
2611.11558.mechanism_en: A fixed workload contract, baseline noise calibration and retesting govern candidate promotion. All trials, including OOMs, update runtime/memory models, and verified findings seed later clusters.
2611.11558.result_en: Across four workloads, speedup reaches 2.75× and mean MFU rises from 17.4% to 30.0%. Cross-GPU experience transfer is reported.
2611.11558.boundary_en: Workload-specific correctness, loss and timing invariants determine the permitted optimization. These measurements establish infrastructure improvement on tested systems.
2611.11558.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）虽能加速孤立的算法与内核合成，分布式LLM训练却依赖紧密耦合的启动设置、算子内核与通信调度，单次编辑往往遭遇显存溢出（OOM）边界、编译器冲突、测量抖动或静默数值漂移。我们提出InfraRSI，通过五阶段工作流，将开放式人类命令转化为经过验证的训练优化：init锁定可编辑范围以及工作负载、损失与计时不变量的固定任务契约，以防奖励投机；doctor分析基线各阶段并校准集群噪声；run联合优化启动参数和代码补丁，再将最优候选与基线重新验证，并把发现记录到跨硬件经验库；report和apply审计源码路径、追踪失败试验成本并提交获准变化。InfraRSI不从单一当前版本贪心前进，而从多样的经验种子配置初始化，并基于包括OOM在内的全部试验，拟合全局执行时间模型与带删失观测的峰值内存模型。利用这些模型，它估计各设置的内存成本，根据实时运行修订失准的LLM先验，并将内存密集型优化与内存节约措施及经过验证的代码补丁配对。在四个单节点及多节点的稠密和混合专家（MoE）LLM工作负载上，InfraRSI实现最高2.75倍加速，将平均模型FLOPs利用率（MFU）从17.4%提高到30.0%，优于现有调优器和编程代理，并能跨GPU迁移经验。在改善训练基础设施效率的过程中，InfraRSI形成双层递归自我改进循环：运行内在线修订先验，集群间蒸馏经验，推动基础模型扩展。

2611.11941.title: Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning
2611.11941.authors: Shuangyu Xie , Kaiyuan Chen , Ken Goldberg
2611.11941.abstract_en: Flipping is a fundamental robotic manipulation skill that requires reorienting a target object in a stable pose on a planar support surface by rotating it 180$^\circ$ about an axis parallel to the support surface -- think of flipping a coin from heads to tails. Although flipping is a common objective in industrial tasks such as parts inspection, mechanical assembly, and tool use, coding a bimanual robot with grippers to flip diverse objects is a significant challenge. In this paper, we show that a coding agent can autonomously develop and refine object-flipping strategies through iterative learning in physics simulations across diverse object geometries. Progressive skill acquisition, from basic handover to toppling and pushing, robust grasping and sensing, and thin-object manipulation with recovery, improves task success from 24.7% to 95.0%. The resulting graph-based code integrates high-level strategy selection with reactive control, enabling multi-stage flipping on physical robots.
2611.11941.update_target: Reusable graph-based robot flipping code and control skills
2611.11941.mechanism_en: A coding agent iteratively rehearses strategies in physics simulation, accumulates handover, toppling, grasping and recovery skills, and deploys the retained graph-based controller on physical robots.
2611.11941.result_en: Reported simulation success improves from 24.7% to 95.0%. The paper separately demonstrates multi-stage physical-robot deployment.
2611.11941.boundary_en: The verified project page identifies 95.0% as best tune success over 360 episodes, with frozen v016 at 90.8% on 120 held-out trials. Physical deployment demonstrations are a separate evidence level.
2611.11941.abstract_zh: 翻转是一项基础机器人操作技能，要求目标物体绕平行于支撑面的轴旋转180°，在平面支撑面上重新形成稳定姿态——例如将硬币从正面翻至反面。尽管翻转是零件检测、机械装配和工具使用等工业任务中的常见目标，为带夹爪的双臂机器人编程以翻转多样物体，仍是一项重大挑战。本文表明，编程代理可以通过在物理仿真中对多样物体几何进行迭代学习，自主开发并完善物体翻转策略。渐进式技能习得从基本交接到倾倒和推动、鲁棒抓取和感知，再到带恢复的薄物体操作，将任务成功率从24.7%提高至95.0%。最终的图结构代码整合高层策略选择与反应式控制，使物理机器人能够执行多阶段翻转。

2611.12109.title: SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback
2611.12109.authors: Xingguang Ji , Ziqiang Dong , Yubo Zhang , Xi Leng , Yang Yang , Guanjun Jiang
2611.12109.abstract_en: During reinforcement learning, experience can be both internalized in LLM parameters and retained externally as reusable textual skills. Parameter updates alter the model's behavior and the interaction experience from which new skills are extracted. These skills, in turn, guide the model's subsequent interactions and parameter updates. As the model's capabilities evolve, previously beneficial skills may become redundant or detrimental. We present SkillDuet, a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution through model response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates through OPD at every step. A response-based score, Strength, ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of the shift they induce in the current model's responses, and the highest-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). The updated model and Global jointly guide subsequent interactions, generating experience for further parameter and skill updates. With Qwen3-4B, SkillDuet achieves success rates of 98.57% on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, exceeding the matched SEED-API baseline by 2.86 and 5.47 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that response-based skill selection and Global consolidation improve task performance. Further experiments show that the benefits of retained skills depend on both their content and their compatibility with the model. SkillDuet provides a concrete mechanism for model-skill co-evolution and skill-level recursive self-improvement.
2611.12109.update_target: Model parameters and persistent reusable textual skills
2611.12109.mechanism_en: On-policy trajectories supply local skills for OPD. Response-shift Strength ranks candidates, periodic Global consolidation retains skills, and the updated model and skills generate subsequent learning experience.
2611.12109.result_en: Qwen3-4B reaches 98.57% on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, exceeding matched SEED-API by 2.86 and 5.47 points.
2611.12109.boundary_en: Skill value depends on compatibility with the current model. Response-shift magnitude is a selection proxy whose downstream benefits are measured by the stated ablations.
2611.12109.abstract_zh: 在强化学习期间，经验既可以内化于LLM参数，也可以作为可复用文本技能保留在外部。参数更新改变模型行为，也改变提取新技能所依据的交互经验。反过来，这些技能引导模型后续交互与参数更新。随着模型能力进化，以前有益的技能可能变得冗余甚至有害。我们提出SkillDuet，通过模型响应反馈协调参数更新与技能进化。从在策略轨迹提取的技能，在每一步通过OPD引导参数更新。基于响应的评分Strength，根据候选技能引起当前模型响应偏移的幅度进行排名，分数最高的技能被周期性巩固为持久全局技能集（Global）。更新后的模型和Global共同引导后续交互，产生用于进一步参数和技能更新的经验。使用Qwen3-4B时，SkillDuet在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别达到98.57%和92.97%的成功率，分别超过匹配的SEED-API基线2.86和5.47个百分点。消融表明，基于响应的技能选择和Global巩固改善任务表现。进一步实验显示，所保留技能的收益同时依赖其内容及其与模型的兼容性。SkillDuet为模型—技能共同进化与技能层递归自我改进提供了一种具体机制。

2611.12232.title: ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents
2611.12232.authors: Chenhao Zhang , Zhongan Wang , Mingxuan Li , Hehe Fan , Zheng Zhu , Ming Li
2611.12232.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.
2611.12232.affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / Zhejiang University / GigaAI
2611.12232.update_target: Language-policy weights and the trust assigned to self-written skills
2611.12232.mechanism_en: Command-level outcome advantages calibrate privileged self-teacher preferences. Skills and reflections favoring higher-advantage commands are reinforced and guide subsequent parameter updates.
2611.12232.result_en: The 3B/7B agents reach 90.5%/93.3% seen-task ALFWorld macro success and 75.5%/80.5% WebShop success without inference-time skills.
2611.12232.boundary_en: The loop is outcome-calibrated post-training. Seen and unseen task results use distinct protocols, and executable-command-only supervision supplies a substantial separate gain.
2611.12232.abstract_zh: 在策略自蒸馏让语言代理通过以自身轨迹写成的技能等特权上下文为条件，充当自己的教师。然而，指导的权重取决于这些上下文使token似然偏移多少，而非它是否改善行为，因此自写技能中的错误会通过后续更新回流。我们提出环境校准的在策略自蒸馏，利用环境结果决定当前教师指导的可信程度，以及应强化哪些自写技能。通过比较相似观测下执行的命令来估计命令级优势，对每项教师偏好进行缩放，并奖励那些引导偏好趋向更高优势命令的反思与技能。推理时无需技能，3B和7B代理在已见ALFWorld任务上分别达到90.5%和93.3%的宏平均成功率，在WebShop上分别达到75.5%和80.5%的成功率。在未见ALFWorld任务上，相同协议下，它们分别优于GRPO 11.0和7.6个百分点。在消融研究中，仅监督可执行命令而非Actor的完整响应，使3B模型在WebShop上的成功率从52.3%提高到75.0%。

The comparison concerns how advice is assessed during training.

2611.12288.title: ForgeSystem: An Architecture for Demand-Specific Artefact Production with AI Agents
2611.12288.authors: Qingfeng He , Zhui Zhu , Yaojian Chen , Shangzhan Li , Leshan Li , Tingjian Zhang , Qian Xie , Yuxuan Li , Xu Han , Zhiyuan Liu
2611.12288.abstract_en: General-purpose software serves many different demands, but this flexibility costs performance and efficiency on any specific demand. Software tailored to a specific demand avoids these losses, yet developing it requires substantial time and effort from human experts. AI agents offer an alternative: they can design, implement and test artefacts tailored to individual demands. We call this production paradigm Forge. Forging for a demand is economically justified when the cumulative benefit of specialisation exceeds the total cost of construction, verification and maintenance. To make Forge a repeatable production process, we propose ForgeSystem, which consists of a control layer, a forge loop and a recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop. The control layer selects which artefact serves each demand and decides which demands to forge, when to forge them and from which starting point; the forge loop iterates between production and verification until a candidate artefact passes verification; and the RSI loop draws on accumulated production records to supply starting points, refine the harness and train models. We implement ForgeSystem for training frameworks, decoding megakernels and individual computational kernels. Forged training engines reach 1.047-1.332x the model-FLOPs utilisation of their reference frameworks, forged megakernels achieve a geometric-mean decoding speedup of 1.21x over SGLang across thirteen configurations, and forged kernels match or exceed expert libraries in eighteen of twenty-two configurations, while satisfying task-specific quality requirements. Controlled comparisons show that explicit quality requirements steer agents towards optimisations that preserve training quality. We also discuss a gradual transition to Forge through service routing, and how demand-specific production may shift value accumulation and trust towards production systems.
2611.12288.affiliation: ModelBest Inc. / Tsinghua University / Harbin Institute of Technology / Columbia University
2611.12288.update_target: Demand-specific software artefacts, harnesses and model-training inputs
2611.12288.mechanism_en: ForgeSystem routes demands, iterates production and verification, and reuses production records for starting points, harness revision and model training. Explicit quality requirements constrain acceptance.
2611.12288.result_en: Training-engine MFU is 1.047–1.332× the reference. Decoding megakernels reach 1.21× geometric-mean speedup over SGLang, and 18/22 kernels match or exceed expert libraries.
2611.12288.boundary_en: Artefact production gains and gains attributable specifically to the RSI loop require separate comparisons. Economic justification depends on cumulative serving benefits and all production costs.
2611.12288.abstract_zh: 通用软件服务于多种不同需求，但这种灵活性会损失针对任何特定需求的性能与效率。为特定需求量身定制的软件可以避免这些损失，但开发需要人类专家投入大量时间与精力。AI代理提供了另一条路径：它们可以设计、实现并测试针对单项需求的制品。我们将这一生产范式称为Forge。当专业化的累计收益超过构建、验证和维护总成本时，为某项需求进行锻造才具有经济合理性。为使Forge成为可重复的生产过程，我们提出ForgeSystem，由控制层、锻造循环与递归自我改进（RSI）循环构成。控制层选择服务各需求的制品，并决定锻造哪些需求、何时锻造及从哪个起点开始；锻造循环在生产与验证之间迭代，直至候选制品通过验证；RSI循环利用积累的生产记录提供起点、完善框架并训练模型。我们将ForgeSystem用于训练框架、解码巨型内核和单个计算内核。锻造训练引擎的模型FLOPs利用率达到参考框架的1.047–1.332倍；锻造巨型内核在十三项配置中相对SGLang实现1.21倍几何平均解码加速；锻造内核在二十二项配置中的十八项匹配或超过专家库，同时满足任务特定质量要求。受控比较表明，显式质量要求引导代理采用保持训练质量的优化。我们还讨论通过服务路由逐步过渡到Forge，以及需求特定生产如何将价值积累和信任转向生产系统。

2611.12552.title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
2611.12552.abstract_en: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.
2611.12552.update_target: Task-local multi-agent roles, coordination and memory policy
2611.12552.mechanism_en: A shared evidence graph retains observations. Separate editors propose component changes, and candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next executable harness.
2611.12552.result_en: SciMARS + Memory solves 12/18 versus 8/18 Astra attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, and 14/38 versus 11/38 ScienceAgentBench tasks.
2611.12552.boundary_en: Scientific evidence comes from experimental-data replay and a digital twin. These results concern recursive task-local adaptation, with small attempt counts and no independent wet-lab reproduction.
2611.12552.abstract_zh: 我们提出SciMARS，一个面向闭环科学发现、对多代理框架进行递归任务局部适配的框架。随着科学证据演变，多代理系统协调分析、实验设计与验证。然而，两个问题限制了其有效性：（i）缺少共享记忆时，代理会丢失观测并重复工作；（ii）固定的角色流程、交接与记忆策略即使在证据得到保留后仍延续错误。我们通过共享证据图和独立组件编辑器解决这些问题。SciMARS适配角色与协调；SciMARS + Memory增加第三个编辑器，编辑代理如何记录、检索和接收证据。候选探测引导下一版框架的组合与选择。我们通过实验数据重放和数字孪生评估科学发现。在Autonomous Science Bench上，SciMARS + Memory分别解决GPT-6-Astra的18次尝试中的12次和GLM-5.3的18次中的2次，而基础多代理团队分别为8/18和1/18。在ScienceAgentBench和AppWorld上，它分别解决14/38和11/20项任务，而基础团队为11/38和5/20。这些结果支持在科学与交互任务中将共享记忆和框架适配相结合。

(B) Role and coordination editors propose candidates; SciMARS + Memory adds a memory-policy editor. Public probes guide composition and selection. The selected harness and lessons guide the next round.

2611.12885.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
2611.12885.authors: Heng Fang , Zehui Guo , Yuehan Zhang , Mingyang Du , Dingkang Liang , Xiang Bai
2611.12885.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Robotics (cs.RO)
2611.12885.abstract_en: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at this https URL
2611.12885.affiliation: Huazhong University of Science and Technology / ArchOne AI
2611.12885.update_target: Frozen-model robot context consolidated as reusable Task Memory
2611.12885.mechanism_en: One demonstration seeds simulation rehearsal. World feedback and reflection revise context, which is frozen and deployed on new scenes under data-isolation rules. Cross-embodiment adaptation supports physical deployment.
2611.12885.result_en: RoboScript reports 83.4% mean success over all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks across clean/randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradients.
2611.12885.boundary_en: The headline benchmark rate and the separate physical dual-arm demonstrations have distinct evidence scopes. Context learned during rehearsal has a longer lifetime than one deployment episode.
2611.12885.abstract_zh: 训练得到的动作策略将操作技能写入网络权重，使学习内容与其训练分布相绑定。上下文学习（ICL）避免这种耦合，但尚未达到训练策略的表现，因为在另一个场景记录的示范缺少机器人当前面对世界的反馈。我们观察到，代理在上下文中学习的是语义内容，记录任务步骤和对象角色而非视觉外观，因此在一个世界中获得的经验可以迁移至另一个世界。基于这一认识，我们提出世界上下文学习（WICL）范式：冻结模型从一个示范出发，在仿真器等世界中排练任务，将反馈写入上下文而非权重。我们构建RoboScript，一套实现代理式操作WICL的模块化基础设施。RoboScript从单个示范出发，通过仿真排练学习每项任务，将学得知识冻结为任务记忆，再将冻结记忆部署到新场景，数据隔离确保每项部署输入均可在真实机器人上取得。在RoboTwin 2.0全部50项任务上，RoboScript每项任务仅用一个示范且不进行梯度更新，在干净及随机化设置中达到83.4%的平均成功率，比最强训练动作策略高出20多个百分点。该方法可跨视觉分布泛化、通过反思改进、随基础模型扩展，并通过跨具身记忆适配迁移至物理双臂机器人。有世界参与循环时，机器人在上下文中学习操作任务的效果可以与在权重中学习相当。全部代码位于this https URL。

2611.10022.title: How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use
2611.10022.authors: Jiayi Ni , Zac Wang , Alex Zhang , Zheng Liu , Roopa Prabhu
2611.10022.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.10022.abstract_en: Reusable skills guide large language model (LLM) agents through recurring requests, but each invocation still requires the model to interpret the skill and reconstruct its orchestration. Can agents automatically compile this orchestration into an executable fast path without human intervention? We first study zero-shot skill specialization, which compiles without execution evidence, and find that despite the skill's procedural guidance, incorrect assumptions about runtime bindings can make generated plans brittle and recovery costly. This motivates SkillCache, a one-trace skill specialization method that compiles a completed invocation into a parameterized capsule of programs and natural-language steps, replays it before reuse, and drives it with a plan executor that returns control to the model only when needed, keeping the source skill for recovery. With the Claude Code harness, warm execution of the same request reduces tokens on 87 SkillsBench tasks by 81% with Claude Sonnet 4.6 and by 74% with Claude Opus 4.8 at comparable reward, and capsules stay effective under controlled request changes. Capsules also transfer across models, raising three open-weight models' mean reward by 12-25 percentage points while reducing their tokens by 72-81%, suggesting that execution-grounded compilation is a promising approach to efficient repeated skill use and cross-model transfer.
2611.10022.update_target: Executable capsules compiled from reusable skills
2611.10022.mechanism_en: SkillCache compiles one completed execution into a parameterized capsule, replays before reuse, and returns control to the model on demand while keeping the source skill for recovery.
2611.10022.result_en: Warm same-request execution reduces tokens by 81% with Sonnet and 74% with Opus at comparable reward. Cross-model capsules improve rewards while reducing tokens.
2611.10022.boundary_en: These results concern validated specialization and reuse. Cold compilation cost, controlled request changes and warm replay are separate operating regimes.
2611.10022.abstract_zh: 可复用技能能够引导大语言模型（LLM）代理完成反复出现的请求，但每次调用仍要求模型解释技能并重建其编排。代理能否在没有人类干预的情况下，自动将这种编排编译为可执行快速路径？我们首先研究不使用执行证据的零样本技能特化，发现尽管技能提供流程指导，对运行时绑定的错误假设仍会使生成计划脆弱、恢复成本高昂。这促成SkillCache，一种单轨迹技能特化方法：将已完成调用编译为由程序和自然语言步骤组成的参数化胶囊，在复用前重放，并由计划执行器驱动，仅在需要时将控制权交回模型，同时保留源技能供恢复使用。在Claude Code框架下，使用Claude Sonnet 4.6和Claude Opus 4.8时，相同请求的热执行在87项SkillsBench任务上分别减少81%和74%的token，奖励相当；在受控请求变化下，胶囊仍保持有效。胶囊还可以跨模型迁移，使三个开放权重模型的平均奖励提高12–25个百分点，同时减少72–81%的token。这表明，以执行为依据的编译是一种有前景的方法，可高效重复使用技能并实现跨模型迁移。

2611.10439.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
2611.10439.authors: Yunzhe Wang , Mesut Erhan Unal , Sheng Zhang , Shabnam Ghadar , Peng Tang
2611.10439.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2611.10439.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.
2611.10439.affiliation: AWS Agentic AI / University of Southern California
2611.10439.update_target: Scoped external memory shared across users and agents
2611.10439.mechanism_en: MixUA extracts lessons from independent trajectories and assigns pair, user, agent or global scope. CrossLearnBench measures later task utility, preference retention and privacy leakage.
2611.10439.result_en: Pass-rate gains reach 16 points over no memory and 5 over global memory. Up to 90% of preferences are retained, with at most 0.02% forbidden-scope planted-fact probe hits.
2611.10439.boundary_en: Privacy is measured on the supplied probes. Scope assignment and downstream reuse supply an external-memory mechanism, while unrestricted privacy guarantees are not established.
2611.10439.abstract_zh: 自进化代理无需重新训练基础LLM，便能从经验中改进自身技能、记忆和框架代码；群体进化代理进一步在代理之间共享这些经验。然而，大多数此类系统忽视了这样一个问题：跨用户与异质代理共享时，需要决定谁能从每条经验受益，以及哪些信息必须保持私密。我们提出MixUA记忆系统，将独立的用户—代理轨迹蒸馏为经验，并根据受益对象和可能披露的信息，将每条经验分配到用户—代理对、用户、代理或全局范围。为进行评估，我们引入CrossLearnBench混合用户—代理基准，将已有代理任务与用户偏好和隐私探测配对，以测试私密事实是否泄漏到其他用户可读取的记忆中。在五个用户和七个代理的设置下，MixUA相较于无记忆提高通过率最多16个百分点，相较于单一全局记忆提高最多5个百分点，即使任务此前仅由其他用户在其他代理上尝试过也有效。它保留最多90%的既有偏好陈述，且最多0.02%的隐私探测在禁止范围中发现植入的私密事实。我们希望MixUA为用户与代理共同进化的全局系统提供可扩展路径。

2611.10477.title: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
2611.10477.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at this https URL .
2611.10477.update_target: Model parameters and external graph-pattern memory
2611.10477.mechanism_en: A frozen oracle scores constructed evidence graphs with information-density reward. High-reward trajectories become abstract procedural skeletons, and a second RL stage couples the policy to retained patterns.
2611.10477.result_en: The 7B system reports a 15.0-point Avg-OOD EM advantage over 27 baselines and increasing gains with reasoning depth.
2611.10477.boundary_en: The oracle supplies a particular reward surrogate. Pattern extraction, additional RL and memory reuse contribute together, requiring the paper's controls to separate their effects.
2611.10477.abstract_zh: 经强化学习训练的检索增强生成代理，会检索内容（段落、知识图片段或超边），并使用最终答案的结果奖励监督训练。在这些范式中，穿越检索内容的推理路径始终留在语言模型隐藏状态中，将陈述性知识与同类逻辑查询中反复出现的程序性知识混在一起；因此，仅依赖内容的方法随着推理深度增加而趋于平台。我们提出PatternBloom，将检索单位从内容（读什么）转向逻辑（如何推理）的代理式RAG框架。第一阶段RL通过信息密度奖励（IDR）评估代理构建的证据图，即由冻结预言机的信息增益形成大小归一化的互信息替代量。高奖励轨迹被蒸馏为图模式记忆（GPM），其中包含类型抽象的推理骨架；第二阶段RL利用模式增强奖励（PAR）将策略与记忆耦合，使程序性推理转化为可学习、外部化的结构先验。7B的PatternBloom相较27个基线提高平均分布外精确匹配（Avg-OOD EM）15.0点，且收益随推理深度增加而积累，原因正是蒸馏后的程序性知识被复用，而无需每个查询重新推导。我们在this https URL发布代码。

Right : PatternBloom retrieves a typed reasoning skeleton from an externalized Graph Pattern Memory and traverses it as an explicit logic path.

2611.11005.title: GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates
2611.11005.authors: Ali Mohammadi Ruzbahani , Abbas Yazdinejad , Hadis Karimipour
2611.11005.abstract_en: Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. This choice produced the savings: a fixed rule with the same acceptance check but extrapolations from prior work saved 5.4% of the data epochs, and the same rule with averaging added saved 25.0%. The LLM's contribution is to find a working update within a single run; once found, a fixed rule implements it equally well. An Opus run cost 0.68 USD, but at this scale the agent's latency exceeded the GPU time it saved.
2611.11005.affiliation: University of Calgary / University of Regina
2611.11005.update_target: Training weights and the data/virtual-epoch schedule
2611.11005.mechanism_en: An LLM reads snapshots, gradients and validation metrics, proposes a weight-update program, and retains a virtual epoch only after a 5,000-image forward check. Successful averaging becomes a reusable fixed rule.
2611.11005.result_en: Across 120 runs, 32.8% fewer data epochs accompany a 0.31-point accuracy decrease with a confidence interval spanning zero. Fixed averaging saves 25.0%.
2611.11005.boundary_en: Agent latency exceeds saved GPU time at this scale. Finding the averaging rule and repeatedly invoking the LLM have different costs and contributions.
2611.11005.abstract_zh: 标准训练方案固定地遍历训练数据若干轮，即便某些训练轮次主要增加小批量噪声。我们研究，一个读取训练运行权重与梯度历史的大语言模型（LLM），能否用既不计算梯度也不读取训练图像的更新替换部分训练轮次。在GradReason中，每十个训练轮次调用一次LLM代理。它在受限沙箱中分析近期权重快照、轮次平均梯度与验证指标，然后提交计算新权重的Python程序，以及将接下来十个轮次标为数据轮次或虚拟轮次的计划。虚拟轮次只有通过对5,000张留出验证图像的仅前向检查，才会保留。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上、涉及三种架构的120次运行中，Claude Opus 5.5比80轮方案少使用32.8%的数据轮次，测试准确率低0.31个百分点（95%置信区间为−0.72至+0.09；ResNet-18上低0.94个百分点），处于该方案本身数据量与准确率的前沿。未经提示，Opus在每次运行中都对近期权重快照取平均。这一选择带来了节省：使用相同接受检查、但采用既有研究外推方法的固定规则节省5.4%的数据轮次，加入平均操作的相同规则则节省25.0%。LLM的贡献是在单次运行中找到有效更新；一旦找到，固定规则即可同样有效地实现。一次Opus运行花费0.68美元，但在这一规模上，代理延迟超过其节省的GPU时间。

2611.11145.title: DISCOVER: Online Variance-Guided Data Discovery for Budgeted Multimodal GRPO
2611.11145.authors: Peyman Gholami , Shivam Chandhok , Saber Malekmohammadi , Shayan Shams , Robert Xiao , Leonid Sigal
2611.11145.abstract_en: Recent advances in reinforcement learning have made verifiable rewards a central post-training paradigm for improving multimodal reasoning. However, methods such as GRPO remain data- and compute-inefficient, spending rollout and annotation budget on prompts that provide little learning signal. We propose DISCOVER, an online data-discovery framework for budgeted multimodal GRPO that enables vision-language models to dynamically identify prompts that are most useful for the current policy. DISCOVER first organizes the multimodal sample pool into semantic clusters and queries a small set of density-diverse representative samples to obtain initial reward observations. During training, it estimates the utility of unannotated samples by transferring sparse reward feedback from queried samples. Since sample utility changes as the policy evolves, DISCOVER dynamically updates these estimates with recency-weighted rollout observations. It then selects only high-utility prompts for annotation using a policy-conditioned score that accounts for reward variance and difficulty. Once the discovery budget is exhausted, DISCOVER continues with utility-based replay. Experiments on ViRL39K and VLAA-Thinking with Qwen3-VL-2B show that DISCOVER substantially improves multimodal mathematical reasoning under a strict 10% unique-sample budget, outperforming budget-matched random selection, hard-example sampling, full-pool GRPO under the same training-step budget, and online selection baselines. Ablations further validate the importance of semantic coverage, online reward transfer, and stable discovery cadence, establishing DISCOVER as a practical framework for data-efficient multimodal RL post-training.
2611.11145.affiliation: University of British Columbia / Vector Institute for AI / Stanford University / UTHealth Houston / CIFAR AI Chair
2611.11145.update_target: Policy-conditioned annotation selection and reusable training samples
2611.11145.mechanism_en: DISCOVER transfers sparse rollout rewards across semantic clusters, updates utility with recent observations, selects high-utility prompts, then replays useful samples after discovery budget exhaustion.
2611.11145.result_en: With a strict 10% unique-sample budget, the authors report improvements over budget-matched random/hard selection and same-step full-pool GRPO.
2611.11145.boundary_en: This is an adaptive data-and-policy training mechanism. Annotation count, rollout compute and final training-step budget must all be held explicit when comparing efficiency.
2611.11145.abstract_zh: 强化学习的近期进展使可验证奖励成为改善多模态推理的核心后训练范式。然而，GRPO等方法在数据与计算上仍低效，将滚动及标注预算花在学习信号很弱的提示上。我们提出DISCOVER，一种面向预算受限多模态GRPO的在线数据发现框架，让视觉语言模型动态识别最有助于当前策略的提示。DISCOVER首先将多模态样本池组织为语义簇，查询少量兼顾密度与多样性的代表样本以获得初始奖励观测。训练时，它将已查询样本的稀疏奖励反馈迁移到未标注样本，以估计其效用。由于样本效用会随策略进化而变化，DISCOVER用对近期加权的滚动观测动态更新这些估计，再根据兼顾奖励方差与难度的策略条件评分，只选择高效用提示进行标注。发现预算耗尽后，DISCOVER继续进行基于效用的重放。在ViRL39K、VLAA-Thinking及Qwen3-VL-2B上的实验表明，在严格10%独立样本预算下，DISCOVER显著改善多模态数学推理，优于预算匹配的随机选择、困难样本采样、相同训练步数预算的全池GRPO及在线选择基线。消融进一步验证了语义覆盖、在线奖励迁移和稳定发现节奏的重要性，确立DISCOVER作为数据高效多模态RL后训练的实用框架。

2611.11145.image_caption: Figure 2: Cluster-balanced online discovery and frozen-pool reweighting. Discover builds a fixed multimodal embedding atlas, clusters the prompt pool, and probes REPR to seed a recency-weighted buffer. During discovery, observed easy/hard prompts (green/red) are admitted across clusters while cosine-KNN transfers sparse feedback to unobserved candidates (yellow). 2611.11348.title: Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents
2611.11348.authors: Mitsuhiro Nakayama , Toshiaki Sota , Takehiko Yamaguchi , Michiaki Tatsubori
2611.11348.abstract_en: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.
2611.11348.update_target: Contextual Knowledge retained separately from SOPs
2611.11348.mechanism_en: Human-resolved automation gaps become CK. Contract-aware checks distinguish resolved differences from violations, and extracted CK is reused after later SOP revisions.
2611.11348.result_en: Functional equivalence rises from 12% to 58% on eight workflows. Existing CK covers 79.5% of new gaps across three revision perturbations.
2611.11348.boundary_en: The evaluation uses one LLM and eight workflows. Human intervention remains part of skill development, and equivalent execution is distinct from autonomous self-editing.
2611.11348.abstract_zh: 标准操作流程（SOP）为方便人类阅读而保持简洁，因此从SOP生成可执行技能的LLM代理，缺少自动化所需的隐性知识和实现细节。人类干预可以填补这些缺口，但随着SOP演变必须重复进行——我们称之为SOP—技能漂移。我们提出将SOP与上下文知识（CK）分开管理，并采用契约感知评估，区分真正的违规与由CK解决的差异。在八项源自Indeed的工作流上（单一LLM），该方法将功能等价率从12%提高到58%。在三类SOP修订扰动下，先前提取的CK已经覆盖79.5%的新增自动化缺口。
2611.11348.abstract_source_note: Full saved official New abstract. Literal source LaTeX and link placeholders retained. The Chinese translation follows that saved text.
2611.11348.image_caption: Figure 1: Problem addressed in this paper: the gap between human-readable SOPs and machine-executable agent skills due to missing contextual knowledge.

2611.11532.title: DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving
2611.11532.authors: Ziyang Yao , Yuncheng Jiang , Fang Li , Haochen Liu , Shaoqing Xu , Wen Zhang , Xiangyang Chu , Zibin Guo , Jiale Hou , Chuang Wan , Jia Hua , Gengzhao Xiang , Xiaoran Luo , Chong He , Yuechen Luo , Junzhe Wang , Zhiyu Sun , Jun Zhang , Wei Li , Lei Li , Hongwei Xie , Bing Wang , Yuannan Shen , Jianwei Cui , Guang Chen , Hangjun Ye , Jingwei Zhao
2611.11532.abstract_en: A driving foundation model must learn reusable decision knowledge from rare critical events and apply it under strict runtime constraints. We introduce DriveFoundry, a closed-loop framework improving iteration efficiency under data and computation budgets by coupling structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference. The Data Engine builds traceable scene-candidate records linking scene evidence and factor-decision relations to candidate trajectories and outcome assessments. Candidate comparisons and counterfactual annotations clarify how scene factors affect behavioral feasibility and preference. Verified model failures guide VLM-assisted annotation and expert correction, refining training data and annotation systems. The model engine, Xiaomi-Drive-o1, unifies Perception, Causation, Action, World, and Value within a shared vision-language backbone to enable cross-task knowledge transfer. Block-wise latent refill passes candidate-specific evidence and predicted visual consequences between task blocks, connecting scene understanding, planning, and evaluation. A learned value-of-computation head selects tasks and allocates latent tokens based on expected benefit and cost, adapting inference to each decision. On PhysicalAI, the 9B model achieves the lowest ADE@1 across evaluated splits and horizons among tested models. In AlpaSim, it outperforms Alpamayo 1.5 across all metrics and achieves lower close-encounter and off-road rates than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, while trailing in progress and AlpaSim scores. For the 0.8B variant, joint training reduces 5 s minADE@6 by about 54% without altering the inference path or token budget. Adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests confirm runtime feasibility, supporting a unified paradigm for learning from critical experience and dynamically allocating computation.
2611.11532.update_target: Driving-model weights, causal data records and annotation procedures
2611.11532.mechanism_en: Verified failures guide VLM annotation and expert correction. Refined data trains the next model, and learned computation allocation adapts runtime evidence processing.
2611.11532.result_en: The 9B system leads tested PhysicalAI ADE@1 comparisons. Adaptive reasoning matches full reasoning with 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests establish runtime feasibility.
2611.11532.boundary_en: Expert correction participates in the loop. AlpaSim collision-related improvements coexist with lower progress/overall scores than Alpamayo 2 Super. Runtime tests establish a different claim from driving safety.
2611.11532.abstract_zh: 驾驶基础模型必须从罕见关键事件中学习可复用的决策知识，并在严格运行时约束下应用。我们提出DriveFoundry，一种在数据与计算预算下，通过耦合结构化因果数据精炼与自适应推理，提高迭代效率的闭环框架。数据引擎构建可追溯的场景—候选记录，将场景证据和因素—决策关系与候选轨迹及结果评估连接起来。候选比较和反事实标注明确场景因素如何影响行为可行性与偏好。经过验证的模型失败引导VLM辅助标注与专家校正，完善训练数据和标注系统。模型引擎Xiaomi-Drive-o1在共享视觉语言骨干内统一感知、因果、动作、世界与价值，实现跨任务知识迁移。分块潜变量再填充在任务块之间传递候选特定证据和预测视觉后果，连接场景理解、规划与评估。学习得到的计算价值头根据预期收益与成本选择任务并分配潜token，使推理适应每次决策。在PhysicalAI上，9B模型在所评估划分和时域中取得受测模型最低的ADE@1。在AlpaSim上，它在所有指标上优于Alpamayo 1.5，近距离接触率和驶离道路率低于34B的Alpamayo 2 Super，但进度与AlpaSim得分较低。对0.8B变体，联合训练在不改变推理路径或token预算的情况下，使5秒minADE@6降低约54%。自适应推理仅使用28%的token即可匹配完整推理表现。实车测试确认运行时可行性，支持一种从关键经验中学习并动态分配计算的统一范式。

2611.11560.title: LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control
2611.11560.authors: Guanming Liu , Weihang Wang , Peng Zhang , Meng Wu , Kainan Tu , Jiahao Liu , Yu Zhang , Liuxin Zhang , Qianying Wang , Ning Gu , Tun Lu
2611.11560.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on {\pi}-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at this http URL .
2611.11560.update_target: Reusable intent assets and runtime requirement checks
2611.11560.mechanism_en: Original outcomes, user corrections and revised outcomes jointly update context-dependent requirements. Assets guide later execution, and pre-delivery checks request repairs while protecting satisfied requirements.
2611.11560.result_en: Same-task replay and cross-task transfer on the named benchmarks outperform evaluated memory, skill and rule-based harness baselines.
2611.11560.boundary_en: The learning users are simulated, and learned-intent fulfillment depends on applicability judgments. Same-task replay and cross-task transfer should be interpreted separately.
2611.11560.abstract_zh: 跨网络应用和在线服务行动的大语言模型（LLM）代理，常常需要多轮纠正，才能让工作符合用户未充分说明的目标与偏好。实际上，用户可能指出当前结果的问题，却未指定期望结果，因此学习用户意图需要结合代理先前与修订后的结果来解释每次纠正。这些期望往往关联特定上下文，难以判断何时适用，以及如何确保代理之后按用户预期行动。为此，我们提出LiveAsset，一个从纠正交互中学习可复用意图资产、并用其控制代理执行的意图框架。LiveAsset结合代理原始和修订后的结果共同解释每次纠正，推断用户意图，增量更新资产，同时保留仍适用的既有要求。学得要求从任务入口开始引导代理执行，并为运行时验证提供标准；验证在每次回复交付前利用解释评估适用性，指示代理修订结果，解决未满足要求，同时保持已满足要求。在由模拟用户通过多轮纠正逐步揭示要求的学习阶段之后，我们在{\pi}-Bench、PERMA和Vita上对原始请求进行同任务重放，并在PAST-Bench和SkillEvolBench上评估跨任务迁移。实验表明，相较记忆、技能和基于规则的框架基线，LiveAsset更好地满足从纠正交互学得的要求，并改善这些基准上的表现。代码位于this http URL。

2611.11565.title: Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents
2611.11565.authors: Bian Sun , Kevin Zhai , Mubarak Shah , Song Wang
2611.11565.abstract_en: LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.
2611.11565.update_target: External action credits and conditionally replayable routes
2611.11565.mechanism_en: Repeatedly attained scores reduce credit, new higher-score segments receive more credit, and these values steer frozen-LLM action proposals. Final episodes replay matching available routes.
2611.11565.result_en: EARN is best or tied in 31/33 task–budget settings. Jericho final-episode replay bypasses 78.9–86.3% of candidate calls.
2611.11565.boundary_en: The endpoint metric averages the final four episodes. Benefits concern within-budget cross-episode adaptation and consolidation, with no backbone weight updates.
2611.11565.abstract_zh: LLM代理可以利用重复尝试的反馈，在不更新模型参数的情况下改善决策。然而，即使仍可取得更高分，正行动信用也可能持续偏向反复达到相同分数的行动。在固定交互预算下，在最后几次尝试中探索新行动还可能降低表现。我们提出EARN，利用既往经验引导进一步进步，并通过有条件复用有效行动序列保留之前表现。EARN降低达到先前回合已重复取得分数的行动信用，并为达到更高分的行动片段赋予更大信用。这些信用调整LLM所提行动的概率。在最后几个回合中，当当前上下文与记录上下文匹配、且行动仍可用时，EARN直接重放存储行动，绕过LLM候选生成。我们在Jericho、ScienceWorld和Crafter上，使用最后四个回合的平均分评估交互预算结束时的表现。在33项任务—预算设置中，EARN在31项上达到所评估方法的最佳分数，包括并列。对所评估Jericho预算，最后四个回合中的重放在游戏间平均绕过78.9–86.3%的候选生成调用。

2611.11604.title: Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking
2611.11604.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.
2611.11604.image_note: The source visual is the paper's own weight-space/model-checking algorithm.
2611.11604.mechanism_en: An LLM writes network parameters, optional supervised repair changes them, and Storm model checking supplies a further repair signal. Returned policies must satisfy the specified formal requirement.
2611.11604.result_en: All 18 primary runs attain optimal probability before feedback. In one safety case, repair breaks the requirement and one model-checking round restores it.
2611.11604.boundary_en: The model is a finite PRISM environment with deterministic policies. Most primary successes need no feedback, limiting claims about the marginal contribution of the repair loop.
2611.11604.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可以直接写出小型神经网络的权重，无需梯度下降。这种权重空间编程能仅凭任务描述创建顺序决策策略，但无法保证写出的策略行为符合预期。我们将权重空间编程与概率模型检验相结合。给定建模为马尔可夫决策过程的环境，以及概率计算树逻辑（PCTL）要求，LLM写出策略网络全部权重，可选地在最优行动数据集上修复它们，并接收模型检验反馈，直到要求成立或达到轮次限制。模型检验器Storm通过计算而非仿真估计，得出策略满足要求的概率，因此每个返回策略都经过验证。在两个LLM和三个环境的18次运行中，每次生成的策略在没有任何数据集或模型检验反馈前，便达到最优概率。为两项运输任务编写的六个策略中，四个也以概率1完成三项运输任务，因此泛化到LLM从未见过的任务。该管线还在全部六次运行中生成满足PCTL until算子所表达复杂安全要求的策略。其中一次运行中，数据集修复将准确率提高至98.4%，却破坏了该要求，而一轮模型检验反馈恢复了要求。

2611.11688.title: Streaming Failure Forecasting: VLA Failure Monitors That Keep Learning After Deployment
2611.11688.authors: Amit Jadhav , Shaurya Beriwala , David Q. Liu , Yanfei Liu
2611.11688.abstract_en: Failure monitors for vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained offline and then frozen. After deployment, lighting, objects and cameras drift, and the policy itself is updated or moved to new tasks. On recorded real-robot runs, after a switch of task or policy version, a frozen monitor fit on the old task ranks failures little better than chance. We present Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a monitor that keeps learning from the one label every episode provides: whether it succeeded. SFF keeps the offline monitor's network fixed and refits only its last linear layer after each episode, at 2.18 ms per policy call on a Jetson CPU core. Its alarm threshold moves only after successes, which in simulation kept false alarms near target except when two drifts came at once. With every setting locked before testing, SFF ranks failures better than the same monitor kept frozen on 4 of 5 simulated test suites under unannounced drift, and above resetting on detected drift on every suite. Carried with its locked learner settings to 434 recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms, replayed across unannounced switches of task or policy version, it ranks failures better than the frozen monitor for every VLA and, in an exploratory comparison, above a full reset at the true switch. A deployed failure monitor need not stay frozen: refitting its readout from outcomes is cheap and helps after the changes we tested.
2611.11688.update_target: Final linear readout and alarm threshold of a failure monitor
2611.11688.mechanism_en: Episode success labels refit the readout while the underlying monitor stays frozen. Threshold movement after successes governs later alarms under deployment drift.
2611.11688.result_en: At 2.18 ms per policy call on one Jetson CPU core, SFF improves failure ranking on 4/5 simulated suites and on recorded runs for every evaluated VLA.
2611.11688.boundary_en: The real-robot evidence is replay of 434 recorded runs. The VLA policy itself is not improved by the monitor, and simultaneous drifts can disturb false-alarm control.
2611.11688.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略的失败监测器通常在离线训练后冻结。部署后，照明、对象与相机发生漂移，策略本身也会更新或迁移到新任务。在记录的真实机器人运行中，任务或策略版本切换后，基于旧任务拟合的冻结监测器，其失败排序仅略好于随机。我们提出流式失败预测（SFF），利用每个回合都会提供的唯一标签——是否成功——持续学习。SFF保持离线监测器网络固定，仅在每个回合后重新拟合最后一个线性层，在Jetson单个CPU核心上每次策略调用耗时2.18毫秒。报警阈值仅在成功后移动；在仿真中，除两种漂移同时出现外，这使误报接近目标。在测试前锁定全部设置后，SFF在存在未预告漂移的五个仿真测试套件中的四个上，失败排序优于保持冻结的相同监测器，并在每个套件上优于检测漂移后重置。将锁定的学习器设置应用于SO-101真实机械臂上四种VLA的434次记录运行，并在未预告的任务或策略版本切换中重放，SFF对每种VLA的失败排序均优于冻结监测器，在探索性比较中还优于真实切换时刻的完全重置。部署后的失败监测器无需始终冻结：根据结果重新拟合读出层成本低廉，并有助于应对我们测试的变化。
