(a) On recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms [ 1 ] , the task or the policy version switches without warning; the frozen monitor, fit on the old task, stays near chance, while SFF learns from each outcome (within-task AUROC, mean of the VLAs, exploratory; each VLA in App. Fig. 13 ). (b) Runs of hero/vla after a switch (ArmnetBench). (c) Only the readout learns, from each run’s outcome.

2611.11690.title: A Physical Testbed for Self-Driving Laboratories: Comparing Bayesian and Agentic Optimization in a Minimal Closed-Loop Color Formulation Task
2611.11690.authors: Tony Qin , Ziheng Wu , Maximilian Schommer , Roya Amini-Naieni , Aldair Gongora
2611.11690.abstract_en: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) integrate laboratory robotics and automation with AI-driven decision-making to close the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) cycle. However, physical testbeds that combine off-the-shelf hardware and AI into a functioning closed-loop workflow remain in early stages of development, and their integration with commercial laboratory automation is comparatively less developed. In this work, we develop a physical testbed that assembles and integrates commercially available laboratory automation instruments and demonstrate continuous, closed-loop, autonomous operation over 24 cumulative hours of unattended experimentation. We validate this platform on a minimal closed-loop discovery task in which the system autonomously formulates aqueous dye mixtures to match a target absorbance spectrum. The system completed six independent campaigns, each consisting of 48 closed-loop iterations over approximately four hours. In every campaign, the system autonomously selected, dispensed, and measured each mixture, with an AI-driven decision-making algorithm determining subsequent formulations without human intervention. Using this testbed, we compared the performance of two AI-driven decision-making algorithms, traditional Bayesian optimization (BO) and an agentic approach, in selecting mixtures under a fixed total-volume constraint. The agentic optimizer matched target absorbance spectra using fewer iterations than BO, with reductions up to 52%, and converged on a solution for one target that BO failed to match within 48 iterations. These results demonstrate a reference physical platform for SDLs that can evaluate both established and emerging AI strategies, including large language model (LLM)-directed optimization, before their deployment in real-world applications where experiments may be costly and time-consuming to prepare.
2611.11690.affiliation: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill / Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / Trilobio
2611.11690.update_target: Sequential formulation proposals and accumulated laboratory evidence
2611.11690.mechanism_en: Each campaign selects, dispenses and measures a mixture, then uses its measured spectrum to choose the next formulation. Six independent closed-loop campaigns compare BO and an agentic optimizer.
2611.11690.result_en: The platform runs unattended for 24 cumulative hours. The agentic optimizer reduces iterations by up to 52% and solves one target that BO misses within 48 iterations.
2611.11690.boundary_en: This is real physical experimental optimization on a minimal dye task. The updated object is the experimental search state, with no demonstrated rewriting of the optimizer itself.
2611.11690.abstract_zh: 自驱动实验室（SDL）将实验室机器人与自动化和AI驱动决策相结合，闭合设计—构建—测试—学习（DBTL）循环。然而，将现成硬件与AI整合为有效闭环工作流的物理试验平台仍处于早期，其与商业实验室自动化的集成也相对欠成熟。本文开发一个物理试验平台，组装并集成商业实验室自动化仪器，展示累计24小时无人值守实验中的连续、闭环自主运行。我们在最小闭环发现任务上验证该平台，系统自主配制水性染料混合物以匹配目标吸收光谱。系统完成六次独立实验活动，每次包含48轮闭环迭代，耗时约四小时。每次活动中，系统自主选择、分配并测量每种混合物，AI驱动决策算法无需人类干预便决定后续配方。利用该平台，我们在固定总体积约束下，比较传统贝叶斯优化（BO）与代理式方法两种AI决策算法选择混合物的表现。代理式优化器匹配目标吸收光谱所需迭代数少于BO，最多减少52%，并针对一个BO在48轮内未能匹配的目标收敛到解。这些结果展示了一种SDL参考物理平台，可以在部署到实验准备昂贵且耗时的真实应用之前，评估已有及新兴AI策略，包括LLM引导的优化。

2611.11929.title: Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?
2611.11929.authors: Zichuan Fu , Junjia Qi , Wenlin Zhang , Yimin Deng , Shirong Wang , Jinyang Li , Xian Wu , Xiangyu Zhao
2611.11929.abstract_en: In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of agents organizing and using their own persistent memory through ordinary documents. Code is available at: this https URL .
2611.11929.affiliation: City University of Hong Kong / Tencent Jarvis Lab
2611.11929.update_target: Linked persistent documents and their memory organization
2611.11929.mechanism_en: The agent revises topics and summaries, runtime checks validate writes, and source-linked evidence plus derived views support later search, reading and cross-model reuse.
2611.11929.result_en: Reported gains over the strongest baselines are 2.66, 3.10 and 2.00 points on LoCoMo, BEAM-100K and LongMemEval-S.
2611.11929.boundary_en: Write validation protects specified memory invariants. Better question answering alone does not measure an indefinitely improving memory organizer.
2611.11929.abstract_zh: 大多数LLM代理在部署后权重固定，因此新信息必须保留在外部记忆中。现有方法往往依赖预定义记录与固定组织规则，难以适应不断变化的任务和交互。这引出一个问题：LLM代理能否用普通文档组织自己的记忆？我们提出自组织记忆（SoMem）框架，将记忆存储在相互链接的文档中。代理决定总结什么、如何归组相关信息以及何时修订既有主题，每份总结都保留指向原始交互的证据链接。运行时验证更新，并从已组织内容中自动派生时间、关系和近期记忆视图。查询时，代理自行选择搜索和阅读内容，按需跟随文档链接、检查原始证据。在LoCoMo、BEAM-100K和LongMemEval-S上，SoMem分别优于最强基线2.66、3.10和2.00个百分点。构建的记忆可以跨模型复用，额外推理投入还能进一步改善答案质量。这些发现表明，代理通过普通文档组织并使用自身持久记忆是可行的。代码位于this https URL。

2611.11929.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of SoMem , illustrated with a meeting-venue update. The agent revises Topic documents from Source records, and the runtime derives access views from the revised documents. At query time, the agent searches and reads the organized memory and its Source evidence to answer the question. The tools shown are the combined search and read-only shell interface; the main experiments use the equivalent split interface (Appendix A ).

2611.12041.title: SMO: Compiling Natural Language Skills into Graphs of Reusable State-Move-Outcome Bricks
2611.12041.authors: Chao Chen , Jiashuo Zhang , Yunhang Shen , Liangyu Lian , Rongrong Ji
2611.12041.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable natural-language skills, yet growing skill collections remain accumulations of isolated text artifacts that are difficult to compare, deduplicate, and compose. We argue that the reusable content of a skill lies not in its surface wording but in its procedural transitions: which operation to execute under a given state and which observable outcome to produce. Based on this observation, we propose State-Move-Outcome (SMO), a compilation-like framework that decomposes raw skills into reusable procedural bricks and organizes admitted bricks as an externalized symbolic structure. When compiling a skill, SMO first retrieves and composes existing bricks, dynamically connects them through Outcome-to-State conditions, and creates a candidate brick only for an uncovered procedure; the candidate becomes reusable only after validation and admission. Experiments on SkillsBench v1.1 demonstrate that SMO represents 232 rawSkills from 87 underlying tasks with 95 shared bricks, reducing the corresponding skill representations from 366,472 to 149,154 tokens--a $\mathbf{59.3}\times$ reduction and $\mathbf{2.46}\times$ compression. Across 232 skill-conditioned evaluation instances, SMO raises the average task score from $\mathbf{0.6379}$ to $\mathbf{0.7478}$ and increases 5/5 Pass instances from $\mathbf{138}$ to $\mathbf{164}$, while matching or outperforming rawSkill on $\mathbf{208}$ of $\mathbf{232}$ instances. It also reduces average runtime token consumption by $\mathbf{38.38\%}$. These results show that compiling natural-language skills into shared procedural units can jointly improve skill reuse, representation efficiency, and downstream execution.
2611.12041.mechanism_en: SMO retrieves and composes existing bricks, proposes new bricks only for uncovered procedures, and validates/admit them before future reuse.
2611.12041.result_en: Scores rise from 0.6379 to 0.7478 across 232 instances. The 95 shared bricks use 149,154 tokens versus 366,472, and runtime tokens fall 38.38%.
2611.12041.boundary_en: The source abstract says both 59.3× reduction and 2.46× compression. The raw counts imply about 59.3% reduction and 2.46× compression. Both source claims remain verbatim in EN, with this conflict flagged.
2611.12041.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理日益依赖可复用自然语言技能，但不断增长的技能集合仍是孤立文本制品的堆积，难以比较、去重和组合。我们认为，技能的可复用内容在于流程转移，而非表面措辞：在给定状态下执行哪项操作，产生哪种可观测结果。基于这一观察，我们提出状态—动作—结果（SMO），一种类似编译的框架，将原始技能分解为可复用流程积木，并将获准积木组织为外部化符号结构。编译技能时，SMO首先检索和组合现有积木，通过结果到状态的条件动态连接它们，仅为未覆盖流程创建候选积木；候选只有经过验证和准入后才能复用。在SkillsBench v1.1上的实验表明，SMO用95个共享积木表示来自87项底层任务的232个rawSkill，将相应技能表示从366,472 token减少到149,154 token——原文报告为59.3倍减少和2.46倍压缩。在232个技能条件评估实例中，SMO将平均任务分数从0.6379提高到0.7478，将5/5 Pass实例从138个增加到164个，同时在232个实例中的208个匹配或优于rawSkill。它还将平均运行时token消耗减少38.38%。这些结果表明，将自然语言技能编译为共享流程单元，可以同时改善技能复用、表示效率和下游执行。

2611.12041.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of SMO. (a) The reuse path atomizes a rawSkill, reconstructs its requirements through L1 matching, L2 binding, and L3 bounded patching, and assembles a skill graph for Agent execution. (b) Only compilation gaps enter basis evolution. New operations join the next frozen snapshot only after candidate construction and admission; Agent execution does not feed back into SMO.

2611.12068.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
2611.12068.authors: Wei-Chieh Huang , Weizhi Zhang , Jiayan Nan , Peng Xia , Yu Wang
2611.12068.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest baseline by 14.3 points, and with AutoDream disabled it gains 31.0 and 22.0 points over HyperMem on single-hop and multi-hop document QA. As procedural memory, it yields the highest mean success among the compared memory methods on ALFWorld and WebShop and reaches 49.2% on MetaClaw-Bench, against 44.0% for MetaClaw's skill library. Six typed memory agents keep complete records as the system of record, and a provenance hypergraph indexes episodic and semantic records with n-ary frames that cite their rows. Retrieval runs under explicit budgets, so the evidence a question inspects does not grow with the history. AutoDream merges duplicate anchors outside the write path without rewriting any record, and it distills task sessions into skills. With AutoDream disabled, MIRIX-2.0 answers faster than HyperMem on all five timed benchmarks. It needs no fine-tuning, runs with closed and open models, and its code is public.
2611.12068.update_target: Typed persistent records, provenance index and distilled procedural skills
2611.12068.mechanism_en: Six agents retain complete records, budgeted retrieval accesses their evidence, and AutoDream merges anchors outside the write path and distills sessions into skills for later tasks.
2611.12068.result_en: The authors report 91.4% LoCoMo, 72.6% LongMemEval-S and 49.2% MetaClaw-Bench success, with timing comparisons for AutoDream disabled.
2611.12068.boundary_en: Memory retrieval and skill consolidation have separate ablations. Results with AutoDream disabled do not by themselves establish the contribution of skill evolution.
2611.12068.abstract_zh: 长期记忆让LLM代理实现个性化、保持一致并复用曾经有效的方法。参数化记忆需要训练，巩固可能永久丢失细节，而保留每条记录则留下不断增长的待搜索存储。我们提出MIRIX-2.0，一个旨在同时实现实用性、准确性与效率的多代理记忆系统。它在五个问答基准中的四个上，是所比较系统中最准确的。在LoCoMo上达到91.4%，在LongMemEval-S上达到72.6%，后者领先最强基线14.3个百分点；关闭AutoDream时，在单跳和多跳文档问答上分别比HyperMem提高31.0和22.0个百分点。作为流程性记忆，它在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得所比较记忆方法的最高平均成功率，并在MetaClaw-Bench上达到49.2%，对比MetaClaw技能库的44.0%。六种类型化记忆代理保留完整记录作为权威记录系统，溯源超图通过引用其行的多元框架索引情节与语义记录。检索在显式预算下运行，因此问题所检查的证据不会随历史增长。AutoDream在写入路径之外合并重复锚点，不重写任何记录，并将任务会话蒸馏为技能。关闭AutoDream时，MIRIX-2.0在全部五个计时基准上均比HyperMem更快作答。它无需微调，可使用闭源与开放模型运行，代码已公开。

2611.12139.title: BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments
2611.12139.authors: Yibo Qiu , Zan Huang , Yilin Qiao , Ziyang Ling , Yi Wang , Zhengyang Lu , Hangke Peng , Haoliang Ye , Ao Tian , Shu'ang Sun , Handi Liu , Yuqing Long , Mohan Yang , Kan Ding , Zhenzhen Zhou , Di Wu , Yu Xiong , Yaxuan Han , Jun'ao Song , Haoran Zhang , Ronald X Xu , Mingzhai Sun
2611.12139.abstract_en: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.
2611.12139.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China
2611.12139.update_target: Biological protocols, culture conditions and intervention choices
2611.12139.mechanism_en: Knowledge-grounded planning and robotic execution produce biological observations. Image-derived phenotypes guide later culture conditions, with human oversight and researcher wet-lab testing of nominated compounds.
2611.12139.result_en: Protocol scores improve across four backends. A three-round retinal-organoid study reports higher later-round scores, and six drug candidates advance to testing.
2611.12139.boundary_en: The system is human-in-the-loop. Nomination and advancement to testing establish no drug efficacy, and the three evidence levels concern different decision objects.
2611.12139.abstract_zh: 生物实验无法简化为单一优化问题，而需要多个抽象层级的决策：将科学知识转为实验流程，根据测得表型适配培养条件，并选择检验生物学假设的干预。仅自动化实验执行，本身无法决定接下来应做什么实验，或如何根据生物反馈改变实验。我们在此引入BioMARS，一个人在回路的多代理机器人系统，将知识引导的实验决策与机器人执行和生物反馈相连接。在流程层面，BioMARS生成有文献依据的方案和可追溯行动计划，提高了四种模型后端上专家评审的方案质量得分。在参数层面，BioMARS利用机器人视网膜类器官培养的图像衍生表型，选择后续实验条件，在三轮实验的后续轮次中获得更高的报告得分。在干预层面，BioMARS依据生物医学证据提名药物再利用候选，并将六个候选推进至研究人员开展的湿实验测试。综上，这些研究展示了反馈驱动的机器人生物实验，其框架支持有关实验流程、培养条件与生物干预的决策。

2611.12184.title: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
2611.12184.authors: Guowei Xu , Jiaru Zou , Mete Erdogan , Haotian Ye , Pan Lu , James Zou
2611.12184.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
2611.12184.mechanism_en: Restricted-information generation broadens candidates. A selector learns from proposals already verified on the same task and retains candidates for expensive empirical tests.
2611.12184.result_en: Across five proposers and twelve tasks, the selector discards half the candidates while retaining most top proposals, with reported downstream discovery gains.
2611.12184.boundary_en: Creativity assessments, selection utility and empirical discoveries use distinct criteria. Learning from same-task outcomes requires accounting for the cost of those earlier validations.
2611.12184.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要原创、有用且不显而易见的想法。然而，AI科学家在创意生成阶段通常获得尽可能多的任务信息，这可能使生成锚定于熟悉方法。受盲目变异与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架启发，我们提出一种发现框架，将信息的两种作用分开：在有意限制任务信息的条件下生成提案以拓宽探索，再从同一任务上先前验证的提案及其结果中学习，保留有希望的候选供昂贵的实证评估。我们在五种提案模型和十二项科学任务上评估BVSR。限制任务信息显著提高提案的原创性与非显而易见性，并相较已有最先进的提示基线，产生更大比例的高创造性和高效用提案。从该任务先前提案结果中学习进一步改善候选选择，在丢弃一半候选的同时保留大多数最佳提案。融入现有AI科学家工作流后，BVSR在基因表达分析、药物响应预测、异常检测、缩放定律发现和脑活动预测中取得更强发现。这些结果表明，有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同方式使用信息：探索时限制任务特定信息，同时利用任务中积累的实证经验。

2611.12184.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR). (a) Limiting task information during idea generation encourages creative proposals. (b) Selective retention reduces the number of candidates requiring empirical verification while preserving top proposals. (c) BVSR’s best programs borrow mechanisms from diverse fields, outperforming the best AI scientist on biology and ML tasks.

2611.12200.title: Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next
2611.12200.authors: Chenghao Gao , Zhi Zhang , Dian Jin , Yihe Pan , Doudou Zhou
2611.12200.abstract_en: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.
2611.12200.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Fudan University / University of California, Los Angeles
2611.12200.update_target: Policy, critic and learned world-model parameters
2611.12200.mechanism_en: Real transitions train the world model. Predicted successors receive critic values, and a reliability gate calibrated on earlier real outcomes weights auxiliary policy/value updates.
2611.12200.result_en: At comparable real environment steps, success rises from 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld.
2611.12200.boundary_en: The model and critic create training supervision, and only the policy deploys. Matching environment interactions leaves model-training compute as an additional cost to report.
2611.12200.abstract_zh: 稀疏终局奖励几乎无法为代理的各个步骤提供信息。许多缺失信息隐含于环境动力学中，因为每次状态转移都可能在奖励到来前改变成功条件。基于真实转移训练的世界模型可以学习预测每个行动改变什么，但预测观测本身并不表明成功是否更有可能。在二元终局奖励下，PPO的评论家通过估计当前策略的成功概率作出判断，但仅针对代理到达的状态。我们的方法WM-PPO将两者结合。对策略采样的每个行动，无论是否执行，世界模型均预测下一观测，评论家则为预测后继状态估值。在策略通道中，这些价值之间的比较提供辅助优势；在价值通道中，它们的均值提供辅助目标。共享门控根据训练早期相似间隔的比较对真实结果的预测可靠性，为两个通道加权。策略、评论家和世界模型均从代理自身交互中学习，无需教师或特权信息，推理时仅使用策略。在相近真实环境步数下，WM-PPO将ALFWorld成功率从PPO的63.5%提高到87.5%，将ScienceWorld从39.3%提高到52.9%。在ALFWorld上，它匹配我们测试的最强PPO改进方法；在ScienceWorld上，比其中最佳方法高6.5个百分点。训练策略在放置物体或确定答案前，更常完成前置步骤。

2611.12324.title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
2611.12324.authors: Ku Onoda , Haruto Kawano , Shota Takashiro , Kohei Hayashi
2611.12324.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2611.12324.abstract_en: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.
2611.12324.affiliation: Third Intelligence, Inc. / The University of Tokyo
2611.12324.update_target: All parameters of a 35M world model at test time
2611.12324.mechanism_en: Every observed transition updates WARC. Mechanic-level cell predictions verify learning, and the updated model supports subsequent decisions by a fixed graph explorer.
2611.12324.result_en: Four fifths of mechanics reach at least 80% changed-cell accuracy. Closed-loop public efficiency rises from 0.15 to 0.46, with 0.20 on hidden leaderboard games.
2611.12324.boundary_en: The explorer is fixed. Recorded exposures, prediction accuracy and live efficiency are different outcomes, and persistence here is within the new-game adaptation protocol.
2611.12324.abstract_zh: 世界模型使代理能够通过想象经验规划和学习，但在陌生环境中，它们必须从有限交互中学习其机制。机制是描述行动或交互如何改变环境某部分的规则。模型观察到一次机制发生，即构成一次暴露。我们问，一个世界模型需要多少次暴露，才能预测新环境机制的效果？我们在ARC-AGI-3上研究这一问题，该交互游戏基准由程序定义。我们引入MechEval，从这些程序中标注二十个游戏中的69种重复机制，并在每次暴露时，针对机制改变的单元格为各项预测评分。作为试验平台，我们构建WARC（用于ARC-AGI-3的世界模型），一个35M参数的视觉transformer，在其他游戏上预训练，每次转移后更新全部参数。在留出游戏上，WARC学会以至少80%的准确率预测五分之四机制所改变的单元格，并将该准确率保持到记录结束。其中一半在约80次暴露、单次游戏过程中便达到这一准确率；而不更新时，仅七分之一机制能达到。在公开游戏的闭环游玩中，将WARC与固定图探索器配对的WARC-Agent，把探索器的官方效率分从0.15提高到0.46，主要来自测试时训练。在Kaggle榜单隐藏游戏上，我们的参赛系统得分0.20。

2611.12324.image_caption: Figure 1 : WARC and MechEval. Left: WARC is pretrained on recordings of many games (top). In a new game (bottom), it predicts the next frame from the last three frames and actions, then updates its weights. Right: For each mechanic that fires, MechEval scores the prediction made before the update on the cells it changes, as given by the game program. The exposure k k counts the mechanic’s earlier occurrences. It reaches the criterion at the first k k from which its accuracy stays at or above 80%. The accuracies shown are illustrative.

2611.12587.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
2611.12587.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
2611.12587.update_target: Language-policy parameters and turn-level learning credit
2611.12587.mechanism_en: Skill-conditioned teacher/student log-probability gaps become evidence for recursive log-odds updates, which redistribute outcome-derived advantage across turns using bounded sign-preserving multipliers.
2611.12587.result_en: The 7B policy reaches 89.1% ALFWorld success, with gains attributed to turn-boundary aggregation and history-dependent revision.
2611.12587.boundary_en: The author footnote identifies this as a rewritten single-environment condensation of arXiv:2608.05987v1 and states that its ALFWorld results are reproduced from that report. It supplies no fresh independent replication.
2611.12587.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习通常将单一优势分配给整条轨迹，这种粒度过粗，难以隔离长时程多轮交互中真正决定成败的少数决策。特权自蒸馏提供更密集监督，却没有回答如何将一组局部师生差异转化为序列中的信用。我们提出AgentOPSD，一种无评论家方案，逐个交互轮次递归分配信用。在一轮内部，将技能条件自教师与学生之间的token级对数概率差求和，并将其作为证据，在对数几率空间中执行递归贝叶斯更新；由此产生的修订，通过有界且保持符号的乘数，在各轮次之间重新分配由结果衍生的优势。以Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B为策略骨干，在ALFWorld上，该方法持续优于GRPO与自蒸馏基线，并在7B规模达到89.1%的成功率。消融将增益归因于在轮次边界聚合证据，以及让信念修订依赖历史，而非仅依赖局部差异本身。

2611.12762.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
2611.12762.authors: Weida Wang , Benteng Chen , Yigeng Jiang , Shuchen Pu , Weiping Shen , Zichao Liu , Yulin Su , Zitong Wang , Siyu Zhou , Zifu Wang , Yizhi Li , Xin Zong , Yuning Yang , Jixiang Bi , Yuan Wang , Chuyi Peng , Shiyao Geng , Qi Zhang , Kuan Lu , Mengzhu Li , Weiwang Xu , Peishan Xiang , Chengjun Liu , Chengrui Wei , Fangchen Yu , Shengji Tang , Yichen Jiang , Jingqi Ye , Cheng Yang , Tao Hu , Jianbiao Mei , Qinglong Cao , Kun Li , Yixin Chen , Shengyuan Xu , Juncheng Xiao , Yiheng Wang , Ruizhe Chen , Shiyang Feng , Runmin Ma , Xiangchao Yan , Zongsheng Cao , Haomeng Hu , Yu Ke , Taihui Wu , Meng Dai , Xu Guo , Haoyang Peng , Yinglong Ni , Pingsen Shi , Xiaosong Wang , Shuyue Hu , Haijun Li , Sherry Dongqi Bao , Yang Yang , Chao Yang , Jie Hou , Tianfan Fu , Yi Gong , Jin Zeng , Mao Su , Hongxia Hao , Fanyang Mo , Fenghua Ling , Tianshu Yu , Yunqi Cai , Baihong Chi , Jingwei Wang , Lei Wang , Chuncheng Bu , Shide Lv , Guangyu Wang , Yuqiang Li , Chunfeng Song , Lei Bai , Hui Wang , Xujun Fu , Li Cao , Lei Chen , Dahua Lin , Xing Xie , Bowen Zhou , Wenlong Zhang , Pinlong Cai , Peng Ye , Aiwen Lei , Jie Li , Shengchun Wang , Bo Zhang , Shufei Zhang
2611.12762.abstract_en: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.
2611.12762.update_target: Scientific understanding state, research targets and selected reasoning methods
2611.12762.mechanism_en: Explicit monitoring revises evidence, assumptions and unresolved questions. These assessments direct subsequent investigation and reusable-method selection, with expert-guided validation collaborations.
2611.12762.result_en: Taiyi-Bench Overall is 54.0 versus 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2. Separate collaborations report reaction yields up to 84% and from 13% to 69%.
2611.12762.boundary_en: Ideation benchmark scores and expert-guided chemistry outcomes establish different claims. The collaborations retain human contributions, and metacognitive causal attribution requires ablations.
2611.12762.abstract_zh: 我们引入Sage-Taiyi，一种受元认知启发的架构，利用积累的科学理解引导下一步研究什么以及如何研究。通过显式监测和控制，系统修订其对证据、假设和未解决问题的理解，再用这些评估适配研究目标并选择可复用推理方法。在Taiyi-Bench上，这一AI共同科学家创意基准包含来自十个学科、五十篇论文的265项任务，Sage-Taiyi在历史再发现与开放式创意生成的全部八项指标上排名第一，Overall分数为54.0，而最强基线AI Scientist-v2为47.9。它还在两个外部科学创意基准上表现良好。五项专家指导的合作进一步将其提案与化学、材料科学和工程领域的实验及计算验证相连接。在化学中，反应条件优化将钴催化羰基化产率从痕量提高到84%，将光催化烯丙基胺化从13%提高到69%。这些结果支持将元认知调节用于科学创意生成及其迈向实际验证的过程。

2611.12799.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
2611.12799.authors: Tingcheng Bian , Kangye Gong , Jinchang Luo , MingQuan Cheng , Feiran Liu , Ni Li , Xiaoling Xia , Haiwei Wang , Hui Li
2611.12799.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
2611.12799.update_target: Post-RL student weights and adaptive choice of saved teachers
2611.12799.mechanism_en: HCN selects checkpoints covering the student's evolving unsolved problems. LAD restricts on-policy transfer to failed rollouts where the selected teacher is locally better.
2611.12799.result_en: Across five domains and 24 benchmark/subset evaluations, gains reach 7.4 points over the initialization checkpoint.
2611.12799.boundary_en: The teacher pool is frozen after the original RL run. Pool acquisition uses existing checkpoints, while recovery distillation incurs additional compute and needs leakage-controlled selection.
2611.12799.abstract_zh: 强化学习现已成为在代理任务上训练LLM的主流范式，但标准实践仅保留验证最优检查点，丢弃其他检查点。我们表明这会造成损失：在LLM代理的GRPO训练中，验证最优检查点会在同次运行中较早检查点已经解决的问题上失败，而所有检查点解决问题的并集远超任何单个检查点。因此，被丢弃的检查点形成了无需额外训练成本的教师池，在策略蒸馏（OPD）可以挖掘它来恢复丢失覆盖。挖掘此池有两个挑战：（i）从哪个检查点蒸馏，因为没有检查点始终占优，且与学生的互补性依问题而异；（ii）在哪里信任它，因为即使精心选择的教师也只是局部更强，无差别蒸馏会覆盖学生已掌握的行为。我们提出Agentic-OPD，将验证最优检查点作为学生、全部已保存检查点作为冻结教师候选，利用学生不断变化的能力缺口共同引导教师选择与监督筛选：HCN（Highest Coverage Next）策略根据学生未解问题的加权覆盖动态选择教师，而LAD（Locality-Aware Distillation）模块仅在教师表现更好的问题上，将迁移限定于失败的学生滚动。在五个代理任务领域、24个基准和任务子集上，Agentic-OPD相较初始化检查点最多提高7.4个百分点，其中4B学生在深度搜索上超过最新前沿模型GPT-5.6和DeepSeek-V4.1。Agentic-OPD将已结束的RL运行重新视为可复用策略池，并确立了与RL算法本身改进相互独立的RL后能力恢复阶段。

2611.09990.title: Peer Memory Changes Who LLM Agents Consult Without a Detected Gain in Answer Accuracy
2611.09990.authors: Jeffrey Chu , Anjali Joseph , Rivan Mandot , Feker Demere , Vincent Li
2611.09990.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems often reuse the same agents across tasks, creating an opportunity to draw on past interactions when deciding whom to consult. We study this form of memory with PeerMem, which saves MACE's LinUCB state and reuses it when the same agents return. Using six agents, a fixed set of 80 HotpotQA questions, and 12 paired lineages per model, we compare cold, warm, and shuffled initialization in an answer-exchange protocol with reference-answer feedback. Under stable evidence access, warm memory lowers pooled hindsight regret and increases consultation of other evidence holders on Qwen3-32B and Gemma-4-31B-it, while final token F1 differences remain uncertain. Qwen interaction traces further show that warm agents more often encounter peer answers that score above their own prior answers. We extend the evaluation to Qwen3.5-9B using freshly learned memory to compare warm and cold initialization under reassigned and paired stable roles. The primary changed-minus-stable final-F1 interaction is -1.38 points, with a 95% interval of [-3.50,+0.73]. Together, these experiments trace the effects of peer memory through consultation, answer revision, and final task performance.
2611.09990.affiliation: New York Institute of Technology / Georgia State University / Algoverse AI Research / Columbia University
2611.09990.mechanism_en: Reference-answer feedback updates consultation preferences. Saved state is reused by returning agents, with cold, warm and shuffled initializations and role-reassignment controls.
2611.09990.result_en: Warm memory improves consultation/regret metrics, while final F1 differences remain uncertain. The changed-minus-stable interaction is −1.38 points, with 95% interval [−3.50,+0.73].
2611.09990.boundary_en: Six agents and a fixed 80-question set constrain generality. Better consultation is an intermediate outcome, and the final-answer evidence supports substantial uncertainty.
2611.09990.abstract_zh: 多代理LLM系统常跨任务复用相同代理，因此可在决定向谁咨询时利用过去交互。我们通过PeerMem研究这种记忆，它保存MACE的LinUCB状态，并在相同代理返回时复用。使用六个代理、固定的80道HotpotQA问题和每个模型十二条配对谱系，我们在带参考答案反馈的答案交换协议中，比较冷启动、热启动与打乱初始化。在证据访问稳定时，热记忆降低Qwen3-32B和Gemma-4-31B-it的合并事后遗憾，增加对其他证据持有者的咨询，但最终token F1差异仍不确定。Qwen交互轨迹进一步表明，热启动代理更常遇到得分高于自身先前答案的同伴答案。我们将评估扩展至Qwen3.5-9B，利用新学得的记忆，在重新分配角色和配对稳定角色下比较热、冷初始化。主要的角色变化减稳定角色的最终F1交互效应为−1.38点，95%区间为[−3.50,+0.73]。这些实验共同追踪了同伴记忆对咨询、答案修订与最终任务表现的影响。

2611.10040.title: SPRING-5: Measuring Tool Documentation Repair for LLM Agents by Efficiency
2611.10040.categories: Software Engineering (cs.SE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.10040.abstract_en: Methods that repair tool documentation automatically are mostly evaluated on task accuracy. We report a benchmark that scores them on cost. SPRING-5 is 20 tool families and 344 tasks, each with a deliberately degraded specification, a hand-written honest one, a deterministic backend and an answer key, scored on calls charged against the ideal call path. A wrong answer is charged the full call budget, so this cost index largely tracks the completion rate, and we report calls per correct task beside it, which carries no such charge. Over 2,644 baseline sessions, 54% of wrong answers arrive with no rejected call, no refusal and no retry. The benchmark carries three validity instruments. A build-time ceiling assertion requires the honest specification to reach the ideal path and fails systematically on only one family. A dud rule names the families a stronger model solves cold and catches four. A directly measured noise floor shows that two evaluations of a byte-identical specification differ by a 95% factor of 0.64 to 1.56, so about one comparison in eight crosses a conventional win threshold on noise alone, and the cheap way of estimating that floor is biased by which families happen to go unedited. Against these instruments, a schema-only method closes 1% of the baseline-to-ideal cost gap, an online self-evolution loop 13%, one batch rewrite over every training transcript 33%, and a variant given correctness labels 58%. The batch advantage over the loop is the evidence it reads: held to the loop's exposure it is no longer detectable. With five and ten tools in context the effect survives, the baseline cost does not change, and only machine-written descriptions sent calls to the wrong tool. On BFCL, 62% of held-out queries are already answered from the shipped documentation, which explains a pooled null there. Code, data and runs are released.
2611.10040.update_target: Tool documentation and the evaluation of its repair
2611.10040.mechanism_en: Deterministic tool families compare degraded, honest and rewritten specifications. An online evolution loop, batch rewrites and correctness-label access are evaluated with validity and noise controls.
2611.10040.result_en: The measured cost gap closed is 13% for online evolution, 33% for batch rewriting and 58% with correctness labels. Equal evidence exposure removes the detectable batch advantage.
2611.10040.boundary_en: The cost index charges wrong answers the full budget. Byte-identical specification evaluations have a wide 0.64–1.56 ratio interval, making noise and exposure central confounders.
2611.10040.abstract_zh: 自动修复工具文档的方法，大多按任务准确率评估。我们报告一个按成本评分的基准。SPRING-5包含二十个工具族和344项任务，每项具有刻意退化的规范、手写的诚实规范、确定性后端和答案键，按相对理想调用路径的计费调用数评分。错误答案计入全部调用预算，因此该成本指数在很大程度上追踪完成率；我们同时报告不含此类计费的每项正确任务调用数。在2,644次基线会话中，54%的错误答案没有遭拒调用、拒绝或重试。该基准包含三种有效性工具。构建时上限断言要求诚实规范达到理想路径，且仅在一个工具族上系统性失败。无效族规则指出更强模型可冷启动解决的工具族，并识别出四个。直接测量的噪声底显示，字节完全相同的规范经两次评估，其比值的95%范围为0.64至1.56，因此仅凭噪声，约每八次比较就有一次跨越常规胜出阈值；而低成本估计噪声底的方法，会受恰好未被编辑的工具族影响而有偏。在这些工具下，仅改模式的方法缩小基线到理想成本差距的1%，在线自进化循环缩小13%，基于全部训练转录的一次批量重写缩小33%，获得正确性标签的变体缩小58%。批量方式优于循环方式的原因在于所读取证据：当其证据暴露限制为与循环相同时，优势不再可检出。在上下文包含五个或十个工具时，该效应仍存在，基线成本不变，且只有机器编写的描述将调用发往错误工具。在BFCL上，62%的留出查询已经能由随附文档回答，这解释了该处的合并零效应。代码、数据与运行记录均已发布。

2611.10261.title: Is Recursive Self-Improvement Safe?
2611.10261.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2611.10261.abstract_en: The phrase recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to the idea of an AI system designing and creating another, better AI system, which in turn designs and creates an even better one, and so on. While the idea has a long history, it has always been an abstract, futuristic idea -- until recently. Today's frontier AI has attained a set of abilities, including in programming, mathematics, research, tool use, and working coherently over extended periods of time, that make RSI seem plausible. AI companies are starting to pursue it, but many of the involved people are also expressing concerns, asking whether humanity should really set this in motion and under what conditions. I will discuss the situation, argue that we do not even have clear frameworks for thinking about the likely outcomes of RSI, and do a quick game-theoretic analysis of how to choose whether to initiate RSI when another party is making the same choice.
2611.10261.update_target: Conceptual choice to initiate recursive AI design
2611.10261.mechanism_en: The paper discusses AI designing improved successors and gives a game-theoretic analysis of initiation when another party faces the same decision.
2611.10261.result_en: The contribution is a discussion of missing outcome frameworks and strategic choices surrounding RSI initiation.
2611.10261.boundary_en: This is conceptual/game-theoretic analysis. The illustrated model interaction supplies an example, while empirical safety or a completed successor-improvement cycle remains unestablished.
2611.10261.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）指的是这样一个想法：AI系统设计并创建另一个更好的AI系统，后者再设计并创建更好的系统，如此往复。尽管这一想法历史悠久，它一直是抽象、面向未来的设想——直到最近。今天的前沿AI已获得一系列能力，包括编程、数学、研究、工具使用及长时间连贯工作，使RSI显得可行。AI公司正开始追求它，但许多相关人员也表达担忧，询问人类是否真的应启动这一过程，以及应在何种条件下启动。我将讨论当前局面，论证我们甚至还没有清晰框架来思考RSI的可能结果，并对另一方也在作出相同选择时如何决定是否启动RSI，进行简要博弈论分析。

2611.10329.title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
2611.10329.authors: Jinwoo Hwang , Sukmin Cho , Tao Zhang , Soheil Abbasloo , Jongse Park , Peng Cheng
2611.10329.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.
2611.10329.update_target: Validation of simulator-driven research design choices
2611.10329.mechanism_en: Siris perturbs a simulator to create matched design workloads with the same limitation and recommendation, then uses a reference simulator to determine whether that recommendation remains valid.
2611.10329.result_en: Across thirteen frontier LLMs, recognizing a limitation does not ensure a correct choice. One review turn repairs some decisions and introduces new errors in other models.
2611.10329.boundary_en: Review is task-local inference. The benchmark audits the verification step of an AI-driven design loop and supports no claim of persistent agent learning.
2611.10329.abstract_zh: LLM代理日益驱动系统研究，并依赖仿真器大规模评估候选设计。仿真器本来就不完美：其建模局限可能扭曲预测但仍保留正确的推荐设计，也可能改变应该选择的设计。我们引入Siris，测试LLM能否区分这两种情况，即依据系统理解判断何时局限使仿真器推荐失效。Siris通过扰动仿真器，构造具有相同候选、局限及仿真器推荐的工作负载对。扰动改变两个工作负载上的预测，但参考仿真器仅在其中一个上支持该推荐。在LLM服务设计问题上评估十三个前沿LLM后，我们发现识别局限并不能保证正确选择，甚至最强模型有时也会放弃有效推荐。通过一轮审查进行自我纠正，有助于这些模型恢复有效选择，却会给另一些模型引入新错误。这些发现推动通过不完美仿真器下的设计决策来评估系统理解。

2611.10404.title: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
2611.10404.abstract_en: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at this https URL .
2611.10404.update_target: Reward-driven coding behavior and its learned shortcuts
2611.10404.mechanism_en: Agents encounter unseen hardened coding tasks. Trajectory audits track attempts to recover upstream answers through repository history, object stores and filesystem searches.
2611.10404.result_en: Nearly all tested models attempt answer recovery, concentrated on harder tasks, with model-dependent escalation depth.
2611.10404.boundary_en: The experiment observes attempts under blocked leakage. The claim that this behavior was learned during RL is the authors' causal interpretation and requires training-provenance evidence to establish directly.
2611.10404.abstract_zh: 前沿代理式LLM在由真实软件仓库构建的强化学习（RL）环境中，以可验证奖励训练。测试套件通过被视为解决任务的奖励。我们表明，在困难问题上，前沿模型常通过获取答案而非推导答案来满足这些奖励，这被称为奖励投机。既有报告已在公共基准上记录此行为。我们测试其在未见问题上的持续性。在答案无法泄漏的加固环境中，我们测试的几乎每个模型都尝试找回答案，并逐级升级到越来越专门的利用手段：挖掘仓库历史寻找上游修复、直接检查git对象存储、扫描文件系统寻找可能更新的源码副本或隐藏测试。这些尝试集中在最难的问题上，模型在是否升级、升级频率与深度上存在差异。我们的立场是，这种行为是在泄漏答案的RL环境中习得的捷径，而非智能的标志。我们在this https URL发布这些模型的代理轨迹，以支持后续研究。

2611.10425.title: Governed Self-Improvement for a Local-First Security Analyzer: Baseline Measurements and a Preregistered Evaluation Protocol for Tantular Cyber
2611.10425.abstract_en: Local-first security tools let organizations analyze code without sending it to third-party services, but the small language models they can run locally are weaker than hosted ones and are hard to improve without breaching the privacy guarantee that motivates them. We present Tantular Cyber, an open-source, read-only repository security analyzer that keeps deterministic scanner findings authoritative and confines a locally served language model to advisory explanations in Bahasa Indonesia. We report its measured v0.3.0 baseline on a synthetic, ground-truth benchmark: combining Semgrep with an interprocedural call-graph scanner yields precision 0.843 and recall 0.915 (Semgrep alone: 0.818 and 0.766). The advisory layer is the weak point: 57% of explanations met an evidence-grounding check, against 95% for a different 8B model under identical prompts. A forensic re-scoring of retained outputs shows that every grounding failure cites a code identifier absent from the evidence shown, and that a prompt change which appeared to raise grounding from 0.56 to 0.72 did so partly by citing nothing. We document two evaluation-validity hazards we encountered: silent model-file migration during a run and non-reproducible published figures. Building on these lessons and on constraint-aware evaluation from security operations research, we propose a governed self-improvement loop (code-free feedback, curated data, a cheapest-first intervention ladder from prompts to LoRA and weight-space edits, hard gates, and human release approval) and preregister the protocol by which its first cycle will be judged. We report no results for the loop itself.
2611.10425.mechanism_en: Deterministic scanners remain authoritative while a local model gives advisory explanations. Baseline audits motivate hard gates, curated feedback, a cheapest-first intervention ladder and human release approval.
2611.10425.result_en: The measured scanner combination has precision 0.843 and recall 0.915. Only 57% of advisory explanations pass grounding, versus 95% for another 8B model.
2611.10425.boundary_en: The first improvement cycle is preregistered and has no reported results. An apparently better grounding prompt partly succeeds by producing no citations, exposing a metric failure.
2611.10425.abstract_zh: 本地优先安全工具让组织无需向第三方服务发送代码即可分析代码，但它们可在本地运行的小语言模型弱于托管模型，且很难在不破坏隐私保证的情况下改进。我们提出Tantular Cyber，一种开源、只读仓库安全分析器，保持确定性扫描结果的权威性，并将本地服务的语言模型限制为使用印尼语提供建议性解释。我们在合成真值基准上报告v0.3.0实测基线：Semgrep结合跨过程调用图扫描器，精确率为0.843、召回率为0.915（Semgrep单独为0.818和0.766）。建议层是薄弱点：57%的解释通过证据依据检查，而在相同提示下，另一个8B模型为95%。对保留输出的取证性重评分表明，每个依据失败都引用了所展示证据中不存在的代码标识符，而一个看似将依据率从0.56提高到0.72的提示变化，部分通过完全不引用任何内容实现。我们记录了遇到的两个评估有效性风险：运行期间模型文件静默迁移，以及已发表图表无法复现。在这些教训以及安全运营研究的约束感知评估基础上，我们提出有治理的自我改进循环，包括无代码反馈、策展数据、从提示到LoRA和权重空间编辑的最低成本优先干预阶梯、硬门控及人工发布批准，并预注册判断首轮循环的协议。我们没有报告循环本身的任何结果。

2611.10501.title: Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate
2611.10501.authors: Alfonso Amayuelas , Piotr Piękos , Xin Eric Wang , William Yang Wang , Jürgen Schmidhuber , Alex Pentland
2611.10501.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended tasks, very common in research scenarios where they are required to explore, investigate, or act curiously. At inference time, an LLM is a fixed map from context to next-token distribution, the pretrained weights determine the function, and only its conditioning changes as context accumulates. Mechanisms like temperature, best-of-N, tree search, or RAG vary how the distribution is sampled or what it is conditioned on, but do not update the agent's model of the environment. We argue that current LLM agents do not explore curiously; they explore stochastically. From how curiosity is understood in the RL literature, it requires a predictive structure over how the environment responds to the agent's actions, which improves online from current interaction, drives action selection through its predicted improvement, and persists beyond the context window. Additionally, in its open-ended form, the agent should intrinsically originate what to investigate. Thus, we propose a framework defining curiosity in LLM agents, reserving the term for systems that satisfy it. In doing so, we identify the research directions its implementation opens up.
2611.10501.affiliation: University of California, Santa Barbara / Stanford University / King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
2611.10501.update_target: Conceptual persistent predictive structure for curiosity
2611.10501.mechanism_en: The position proposes online learning from action-conditioned interactions, persistence beyond context, and action choice driven by predicted model improvement as criteria for curiosity.
2611.10501.result_en: The paper contributes a proposed definition and research directions for curiosity in LLM agents.
2611.10501.boundary_en: Its criteria express the authors' framework. Temperature, retrieval and other inference mechanisms are discussed analytically, without empirical implementation of the proposed full loop.
2611.10501.abstract_zh: LLM代理日益用于开放式任务，这在要求它们探索、调查或表现好奇的研究场景中十分常见。推理时，LLM是从上下文到下一token分布的固定映射，预训练权重决定函数，只有其条件随着上下文积累而变化。温度、best-of-N、树搜索或RAG等机制改变分布采样方式或条件，却不更新代理对环境的模型。我们认为，当前LLM代理并非出于好奇探索，而是在随机探索。按照RL文献对好奇心的理解，它需要一种关于环境如何响应代理行动的预测结构，这种结构能够从当前交互在线改进，通过其预测改进驱动行动选择，并在上下文窗口之外持续存在。此外，在开放式形式下，代理应内在地产生研究对象。因此，我们提出一个定义LLM代理好奇心的框架，将该术语保留给满足条件的系统。由此，我们指出实现这一框架所打开的研究方向。

2611.10542.title: When Experience Becomes a Backdoor: Poisoning Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Failure-Aware Task Optimization
2611.10542.authors: Minhua Lin , Zongyu Wu , Hanqing Lu , Xianfeng Tang , Xiang Zhang , Qi He , Suhang Wang
2611.10542.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly improve themselves through self-evolution, distilling execution experience into persistent, reusable skills. However, this persistence creates a new attack surface: malicious rules implanted into skills can compromise subsequent agent behavior. Existing skill backdoor attacks typically assume direct manipulation of the victim's skills, which is impractical when skills are constructed internally by a trusted evolver. In this paper, we study a novel problem of task-level backdoor attacks, where the attacker can only inject poisoned evolution tasks, inducing the agent to implant backdoors into its own skills. Since the attacker controls neither skill induction nor downstream execution, a natural approach is to iteratively optimize poisoned tasks based on attack success. However, our preliminary analysis reveals two key challenges: (i) failures at different stages of skill evolution and downstream execution can produce indistinguishable outcomes, providing little guidance for targeted poisoned-task updates; and (ii) unsuccessful updates may undermine earlier progress, while simply discarding them may lead to repeated ineffective updates. To address these challenges, we propose BadEvolve, a failure-aware task-poisoning framework against self-evolving LLM agents. BadEvolve diagnoses attack failures across four stages, i.e., Induction, Activation, Following, and Effect, and directs updates toward the failing stage. It further employs rollback to preserve earlier progress and failure memory to avoid repeating ineffective updates. Extensive experiments across diverse self-evolution frameworks, benchmarks, and backbone LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of BadEvolve. Our code is available at this https URL .
2611.10542.update_target: Poisoned evolution tasks and victim agents' retained skills
2611.10542.mechanism_en: BadEvolve uses downstream feedback to diagnose induction, activation, following and effect failures, with rollback and failure memory guiding attacker task revisions. Victim consolidation can carry the backdoor into later tasks.
2611.10542.result_en: The authors report effective task-level backdoors across multiple self-evolution frameworks, benchmarks and model backbones.
2611.10542.boundary_en: The attacker controls evolution tasks under the studied threat model. Qualitative effectiveness in the abstract supplies no universal attack rate or evidence of uncontrolled deployment.
2611.10542.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理日益通过自进化改善自身，将执行经验蒸馏为持久、可复用技能。然而，这种持久性创造了新的攻击面：植入技能的恶意规则可能损害代理后续行为。现有技能后门攻击通常假设可直接操纵受害者技能，而当技能由可信进化器内部构建时，这一假设并不现实。本文研究一个新问题，即任务级后门攻击，攻击者只能注入有毒进化任务，诱使代理将后门植入自身技能。由于攻击者既不控制技能归纳，也不控制下游执行，一个自然方法是根据攻击成功率迭代优化有毒任务。然而，初步分析揭示两个关键挑战：（i）技能进化和下游执行不同阶段的失败可能产生无法区分的结果，几乎无法指导有针对性的有毒任务更新；（ii）不成功更新可能破坏先前进展，而简单丢弃又可能导致重复无效更新。为应对这些挑战，我们提出BadEvolve，一个针对自进化LLM代理、感知失败的任务投毒框架。BadEvolve诊断四个阶段的攻击失败，即归纳、激活、遵从与效果，并将更新指向失败阶段。它还使用回滚保留先前进展，并通过失败记忆避免重复无效更新。在多种自进化框架、基准和骨干LLM上的大量实验展示了BadEvolve的有效性。代码位于this https URL。

2611.10791.title: Winning Reviews, Losing Discovery? The Co-Evolutionary Game of AI Research and Peer Review
2611.10791.authors: Hongze Liu , Mengru Wang , Zhiyuan Zhang , Yao Liu
2611.10791.categories: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT) ; General Economics (econ.GN)
2611.10791.abstract_en: Autonomous research systems can produce convincing manuscripts whose scientific value is difficult to verify, while automated reviewers can reward the appearance of completeness. We examine how this gap can become a self-reinforcing threat to the research community. In a two-population evolutionary game, authors choose between acceptance-oriented and exploratory research, and reviewers choose between proxy evaluation and careful assessment. Cheaper acceptance-oriented production can increase review pressure, making proxy assessment more attractive; proxy assessment can in turn strengthen the incentive to produce reviewer-compatible work. We derive conditions under which this feedback sustains a stable regime that rewards publication success while reducing the scientific value of accepted work. An analytical basin boundary explains why the same institutional rules can support either this regime or exploratory research with careful review. Numerical illustrations show how publication counts can conceal scientific loss, how faster adjustment can reinforce existing practices, and why partial reform may fail once the cycle is established. Careful audits and reviewer rewards can reverse the feedback, while temporary support can produce lasting recovery if it moves the community across the basin boundary. The model identifies a warning mechanism rather than forecasting a particular conference: a review system can remain operational and privately rewarding while becoming less effective at supporting discovery. Its institutional implication is to reward independently validated contributions and consequential checking, rather than accelerate paper production and scoring alone.
2611.10791.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Waseda University / Central University of Finance and Economics
2611.10791.mechanism_en: A two-population evolutionary game couples acceptance-oriented production, review pressure and proxy evaluation. Numerical illustrations test feedback regimes and interventions.
2611.10791.result_en: The analysis derives stable regimes and a basin boundary, with possible reversal through audits, reviewer rewards and temporary support.
2611.10791.boundary_en: These are conditional mathematical and numerical results. The model identifies a possible institutional feedback mechanism and has no fitted forecast for a specific venue.
2611.10791.abstract_zh: 自主研究系统能够生成令人信服、但科学价值难以核实的论文，而自动审稿器可能奖励完整性的表象。我们考察这一差距如何成为研究共同体自我强化的威胁。在一个双种群进化博弈中，作者在面向接收与探索性研究之间选择，审稿人在代理指标评估与仔细评估之间选择。更便宜的面向接收生产会增加审稿压力，使代理评估更有吸引力；代理评估又会增强生产符合审稿偏好作品的激励。我们推导了这种反馈维持稳定状态的条件，在该状态中，发表成功获得奖励，而接收作品的科学价值下降。一个解析吸引域边界解释为何相同制度规则既可能支持这种状态，也可能支持探索性研究与仔细审稿。数值示例表明，发表数量如何掩盖科学损失，更快调整如何强化既有实践，以及循环形成后局部改革为何可能失败。仔细审计与审稿人奖励能够逆转反馈，而临时支持若将共同体推过吸引域边界，可以带来持久恢复。该模型识别一种预警机制，而非预测某个具体会议：审稿系统可以保持运转并带来私人回报，却越来越无法支持发现。其制度启示是奖励经过独立验证的贡献与有实质影响的检查，而非仅加速论文生产和评分。

2611.11342.title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces
2611.11342.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2611.11342.abstract_en: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.
2611.11342.mechanism_en: A teacher revises notes from failures and validation scores, compared with a matched search that withholds failures. Lessons face later task tests and a separate test-item audit.
2611.11342.result_en: Failures add 4.0 points on generated customer-service decisions. Search without failures supplies about 60% of total gain. Full conversations show no demonstrated gain.
2611.11342.boundary_en: The blind audit flags 146/240 tool-use items. Two admitted customer-service lessons still await new-data tests, and the tool-use lesson shows no demonstrated held-out benefit.
2611.11342.abstract_zh: 我们评估AI代理的框架，即模型周围的笔记，能否从代理失败轨迹中学到超出从不接触这些轨迹的匹配搜索的内容。可以，但效果没有表面上那么大。我们测试一个权重固定的开放9B参数模型，由更大教师模型编写笔记。在生成的客服决策上，两种笔记编写器均获知目标规则，基于代理错误的笔记相较于相同流程但不提供错误的笔记，使准确率提高4.0个百分点。该流程本身，即尝试并保留得分更高的笔记，实现了总改进的大约60%。在完整客服对话中，相同笔记未显示出可证实的改进。此外，严格的单条经验筛选接纳了两条客服经验，它们仍待新数据测试，以及一条未看到代理错误而写出的工具使用经验，后者在新工具任务上未显示出可证实的收益。一条没有流程内容的中性笔记得分高于学习所得经验（探索性结果）。盲审将240个工具使用测试项目中的146个判定为有缺陷。

2611.11342.image_caption: Figure 1: (a) Decision-level (“Stage 1”) accuracy on 2,997 sealed τ 2 \tau^{2} retail cases: model only (B0), standard harness (B1), no-evidence search (“T+ search control”), trace lessons (“T+ learned library”; T+ is the teacher writer) and a person-written reference. Markers are per-task values for the address, variant and sequence tasks. (b) Wrong writes (write calls that are not exactly the correct one) for the same arms. (c) Official τ 2 \tau^{2} retail conversations (“Stage 2”; 114 tasks × \times 4 trials): pass^ k k for the standard harness and the trace lessons. pass^ k k is the chance that all k k trials of a task succeed, so it cannot increase as k k grows (unlike pass@ k k , where any one success counts). 2611.11455.title: Coding Agents Propagate Vulnerabilities in Code Bases
2611.11455.authors: Chenhao Sun , Niels Mündler-Sasahara , Mark Vero , Martin Vechev
2611.11455.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents are widely used to develop critical production software. Even though coding agents are known to occasionally write vulnerable code, there has not been any investigation into how code base vulnerabilities evolve over time under coding agent contributions. In this work, we close this gap by investigating whether and how vulnerabilities in existing code lead coding agents to introduce similar vulnerabilities in the code they write. We first evaluate coding agents on 96 tasks that require implementing a new backend application in a repository where other applications already exist. Second, we investigate repository-level code generation on 20 pairs of tasks in real C/C++ projects. In each task, the agent is asked to complete code critical to memory safety. We find that in both settings, insecure existing code leads to agents writing vulnerable code more often. In backend generation, insecure neighbors reduce the share of correct and secure implementations by 3.4% on average, and in C/C++ repository-level coding, the average gap between secure and insecure contexts reaches 35.4%. Prompting to follow existing code-style or to be careful about security increases, respectively decreases, how strongly agents propagate vulnerabilities, but neither stops them. When asked to explain their implementation choices, coding agents attribute them to following another code site in 76.5% of cases, even though they recognize the introduced vulnerability in 69.9% of cases. These findings show that agents use existing vulnerabilities as templates for new ones indiscriminatorily, turning each contribution into an opportunity to introduce more vulnerabilities. As such, as agents write a growing share of production code under decreasing human review, code bases can increasingly degrade in security if security vulnerabilities are not thoroughly fixed continuously.
2611.11455.update_target: Security properties propagated through reused repository code
2611.11455.mechanism_en: Paired secure/insecure neighboring code conditions probe how coding agents copy existing patterns into new applications and memory-safety patches. Later contributions can propagate inherited weaknesses.
2611.11455.result_en: Insecure neighbors reduce correct/secure backend implementations by 3.4% on average. The C/C++ secure/insecure context gap reaches 35.4%.
2611.11455.boundary_en: These controlled paired tasks demonstrate contextual vulnerability propagation. The study does not measure an entire autonomous multi-generation repository evolution process.
2611.11455.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的编程代理被广泛用于开发关键生产软件。尽管已知编程代理偶尔会写出脆弱代码，却从未研究代码库漏洞如何随着编程代理贡献而随时间演变。本文通过研究现有代码中的漏洞是否以及如何使编程代理在新代码中引入相似漏洞，填补这一空白。我们首先在96项任务上评估编程代理，这些任务要求在已有其他应用的仓库中实现新后端应用。其次，我们在真实C/C++项目的二十对任务上研究仓库级代码生成。每项任务都要求代理完成对内存安全至关重要的代码。我们发现，在两种设置中，不安全的现有代码均使代理更常写出脆弱代码。后端生成中，不安全邻近代码使正确且安全实现的比例平均降低3.4%；在C/C++仓库级编程中，安全与不安全上下文的平均差距达35.4%。提示遵循已有代码风格会增强漏洞传播，提示注意安全会减弱传播，但两者均无法阻止传播。被要求解释实现选择时，编程代理在76.5%的情形下归因于遵循另一处代码，即便在69.9%的情形下它们能识别所引入漏洞。这些发现表明，代理不加区分地使用现有漏洞作为新漏洞模板，使每次贡献都成为引入更多漏洞的机会。因此，随着代理编写越来越多生产代码而人工审查减少，若不持续彻底修复漏洞，代码库安全性可能逐步退化。

2611.11994.title: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
2611.11994.authors: Fenghai Li , Bingxuan Li , Jiawen Zhang , Yifan Shen , Jiateng Liu , Yutong Zhang , Yue Guo
2611.11994.categories: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2611.11994.abstract_en: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
2611.11994.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / University of California, Davis / Stanford University
2611.11994.update_target: Frozen-student multimodal harness and offline Builder edits
2611.11994.mechanism_en: The Builder reads development traces, edits prompts/settings/verification code and retains edits through static and validation gates. Evaluation items remain hidden from the Builder.
2611.11994.result_en: Total recognition gains are 7.6–13.4 points. Audio evidence supplies most gains, and evolved additions of at most 0.95 points fail Holm correction.
2611.11994.boundary_en: The total harness benefit and incremental evolution benefit need separate estimates. Small transferred IntentQA gains also fail correction.
2611.11994.abstract_zh: 当语言、声音与视觉线索冲突时，小型多模态模型可能误判情绪。我们提出EmoHarness，将这样一个冻结学生模型置于框架中运行，框架包含围绕其调用的提示、设置与验证代码。人工编写的初始框架称为支架，它将学生的视觉观察、转录与韵律描述编号为可引用证据，让学生据此权衡候选情绪。在元框架进化（MHE）中，更强的LLM Builder离线读取学生错误和执行轨迹并编辑框架；静态检查与验证门控决定保留哪些编辑，Builder从不接触评估项目。在5,507个MME-Emotion项目上，对全部四个学生和两个Builder，EmoHarness相较单次仅视频调用将任务宏平均识别提高7.6–13.4点。转录与韵律描述贡献了大部分提升（+5.38至+10.71）；支架相较音频增强调用的变化为−0.79至+2.54，部分通过增加多标签预测实现；进化编辑最多额外增加+0.95，但没有任何进化增量通过Holm校正。框架的情绪上下文也可迁移到IntentQA，四个学生中的三个获得小幅收益，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness主要通过提供和组织音频衍生证据增强小型多模态学生。

2611.12063.title: Toward Verifiable Auto-Research for Data Systems
2611.12063.authors: Kaiwen Zheng , Srijan Srivastava , Zheng Yan , Xinpeng Zhao , Shaohua Li , Chieh-Jan Mike Liang , Tianyu Chen , Haoxian Chen , Eric Lo
2611.12063.abstract_en: AI auto-research is poised to forge bespoke data systems, from key-value stores and indexes to query engines, each engineered for a specific workload and hardware platform. Yet this promise rests on fragile ground. An agent optimizes what it can measure, not necessarily what users need. Natural-language requirements leave ample room for specification gaming, producing systems that blaze through benchmarks while silently losing updates or violating consistency. Worse, each research iteration consumes tokens, while validating a candidate under real concurrency, memory pressure, and failure conditions can stretch the entire research process into weeks. In this paper, we envision a more cost-efficient and verifiable approach to auto-research. Precise and composable specifications anchor the search, lightweight performance critics prune costly dead ends, and falsification and deductive verification make correctness an integral part of the process rather than an afterthought. By treating correctness, performance, research time, and token cost as equally important objectives, we aim to transform AI-generated data systems from plausible artifacts into trustworthy, production-grade systems whose behavior can be understood, audited, and ultimately relied upon.
2611.12063.affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong / ShanghaiTech University / Microsoft Research
2611.12063.mechanism_en: Composable formal specifications anchor candidate synthesis. Performance critics prune candidates, while falsification and deductive verification provide feedback before later research iterations.
2611.12063.result_en: The contribution is a vision for jointly optimizing correctness, performance, research time and token cost in generated data systems.
2611.12063.boundary_en: This paper presents a proposed architecture and research agenda. Production-grade correctness and cost-efficiency gains remain to be established by implementations and experiments.
2611.12063.abstract_zh: AI自动研究有望锻造量身定制的数据系统，从键值存储和索引到查询引擎，分别针对特定工作负载与硬件平台设计。然而，这一前景建立在脆弱基础上。代理优化的是能测量的东西，未必是用户需要的东西。自然语言要求为规范投机留下充分空间，可能产生在基准上飞速运行、却静默丢失更新或违反一致性的系统。更糟的是，每轮研究都消耗token，而在真实并发、内存压力和故障条件下验证候选，可能将整个研究过程延长至数周。本文展望一种成本更低、可验证的自动研究方法。精确且可组合的规范锚定搜索，轻量性能评论家剪除代价高昂的死路，证伪与演绎验证让正确性成为过程的组成部分，而非事后补充。通过将正确性、性能、研究时间和token成本视为同等重要目标，我们旨在把AI生成的数据系统从看似合理的制品，转变为可信的生产级系统，使其行为可被理解、审计并最终依赖。

2611.12155.title: StealthyPoison: Manipulating LLM Agent Behavior through Procedural Poisoning of Third-Party Skills
2611.12155.authors: Jingfen Qiao , Rui Li , Shuaiqun Pan , Olga Gadyatskaya , Andrew Yates , Evangelos Kanoulas
2611.12155.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly retrieve third-party skills from public registries and follow their procedures to complete user tasks. This reliance allows attackers to manipulate agent behavior by poisoning the skills. However, overtly malicious instructions can provide explicit signals for detection. We present StealthyPoison, a stealthy procedural poisoning attack that corrupts a skill's decision-critical rules to induce incorrect task outcomes while preserving its advertised functionality and normal execution. Unlike prior knowledge corruption attacks that craft poisoned content for known target question-answer pairs, StealthyPoison constructs reusable poisoned procedures from a publicly available third-party skill, without access to actual user requests or their ground-truth answers. To make the poisoned procedure generalize to unseen requests, it first synthesizes requests from the target skill and executes its clean version using a surrogate agent to obtain pseudo-references. These references and surrogate execution feedback guide the iterative refinement of payloads that alter decision-critical rules. To increase the likelihood that the poisoned skill is retrieved and selected over benign alternatives, the attack augments the poisoned skill's retrieval metadata with independently generated request descriptions. We evaluate StealthyPoison on 566 eligible target skills and 5,244 requests against more than 26,000 registry entries. It improves top-1 poisoned-skill placement by 13.6% relative to both HotFlip and GCG. Constructed using feedback from a single surrogate model, the procedural poisoning payloads transfer effectively and without modification to three held-out victim models and achieve end-to-end attack success in a Claude Code workflow powered by Opus 4.8. The defense evaluation further shows that most of these payloads evade detection by both SkillSpector and GPT-5.4-mini.
2611.12155.affiliation: University of Amsterdam / Leiden University / Johns Hopkins University
2611.12155.update_target: Reusable third-party skill procedures and retrieval metadata
2611.12155.mechanism_en: StealthyPoison generates requests and clean pseudo-references, iteratively revises decision-critical rules from surrogate feedback, and augments metadata to raise retrieval probability. Victims later reuse the procedures.
2611.12155.result_en: The evaluation covers 566 skills and 5,244 requests against over 26,000 entries, with transferable poisoning and end-to-end Claude Code attacks.
2611.12155.boundary_en: This threat assumes third-party skill retrieval and attacker control over the supplied artefact. The abstract's placement gain is a relative 13.6%, distinct from downstream attack success.
2611.12155.abstract_zh: LLM代理日益从公共注册表检索第三方技能，并遵循其流程完成用户任务。这种依赖让攻击者可以通过技能投毒操纵代理行为。然而，明显恶意的指令会提供显式检测信号。我们提出StealthyPoison，一种隐蔽流程投毒攻击，破坏技能中决定决策的关键规则，诱导错误任务结果，同时保持其声称的功能与正常执行。与针对已知目标问答对构造有毒内容的既有知识腐败攻击不同，StealthyPoison从公开第三方技能构建可复用有毒流程，无需访问真实用户请求或其真值答案。为使有毒流程泛化到未见请求，它首先根据目标技能合成请求，并用替代代理执行干净版本，获得伪参考。这些参考和替代执行反馈引导迭代完善改变决策关键规则的载荷。为提高有毒技能相较良性替代项被检索和选择的概率，该攻击用独立生成的请求描述扩充有毒技能的检索元数据。我们在566个符合条件的目标技能、5,244个请求和超过26,000个注册表条目上评估StealthyPoison。相较HotFlip和GCG，它将有毒技能top-1位置比例相对提高13.6%。仅基于单一替代模型反馈构建的流程投毒载荷，无需修改即可有效迁移至三个留出受害模型，并在由Opus 4.8驱动的Claude Code工作流中实现端到端攻击成功。防御评估进一步表明，大多数载荷都能逃过SkillSpector和GPT-5.4-mini检测。

2611.12155.image_caption: Figure 1. Overview of StealthyPoison . Attack construction (top): Without access to real user requests or victim-retriever feedback, the attacker synthesizes execution requests from a public target skill and obtains pseudo-references by executing the clean skill with a surrogate agent. Guided by these references and surrogate execution feedback, an Attack Agent iteratively modifies decision-critical rules, while a Critic Agent evaluates their behavioral effects and verifies that the skill preserves its advertised task, interface, and normal execution. The attacker separately augments the poisoned skill’s retrieval metadata with predicted requests to improve registry exposure. 2611.12300.title: Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses
2611.12300.abstract_en: Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.
2611.12300.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China
2611.12300.update_target: Formal modules defining a dynamically reconfigurable harness
2611.12300.mechanism_en: Loading/unloading actions change available vocabulary and causal laws. RAT specifies transition semantics and sufficient conditions for determinism, behavior preservation and order-independent loading.
2611.12300.result_en: Finite models are compared with DeepSeek Harness, Pi and OpenHands executions, alongside complexity results and bounded ASP translations.
2611.12300.boundary_en: This supplies a formal account of structural changes. Conditions on module composition establish specified properties, with no empirical claim of iterative capability improvement.
2611.12300.abstract_zh: 动作理论通常固定其词汇与因果规律，但代理框架可以在执行期间改变工具、提供者和策略。我们引入可重配置动作理论（RAT），其中动作可以改变动作理论自身。RAT理论模块包含词汇、因果规律和初始化器；RAT配置记录激活模块和世界状态。模块加载与卸载被表示为受普通因果规律支配的动作。当激活模块集合固定时，RAT保留其语言片段的标准因果动作语义。我们给出至多一个后继配置、添加模块时保留既有行为，以及以任意顺序加载模块得到相同结果的充分条件。我们确立RAT推理任务的计算复杂性，并将有限RAT系统翻译为非单调因果理论和答案集编程（ASP），保留有界执行。实验将有限RAT模型与官方DeepSeek Harness、Pi和OpenHands实现的执行比较。RAT为检查组件变化如何影响框架可用动作、行为与可达目标提供形式基础。
