2611.12308.title: Unmasking shortcut solutions of coding agents on partial differential equations
2611.12308.abstract_en: Coding agents now write simulation programs, but benchmarks usually judge only whether their output matches a reference. In manufactured-solution tasks the data determine the exact solution, so a matching output need not come from a solver. We introduce PDEViBench, a benchmark of 290 tasks in six equation families that traces each passing program to the computation behind its output and reruns unclear programs on changed data. A Codex agent (GPT-5.2) passed 80% of 1,450 runs, yet about one pass in ten returned the exact solution without solving the equation. Counting only solved passes changed which task features made problems seem hard and reversed the ranking of two prompts. Once the prompt forbade the shortcut, every pass was a numerical solve, and on tasks without a closed-form solution passing programs stayed correct on changed data. Scientific coding benchmarks should check how each answer was computed as well as whether it matches.
2611.12308.affiliation: Xidian University / National University of Singapore
2611.12308.mechanism_en: PDEViBench traces passing programs to their computations and reruns unclear programs on changed data. A prompt constraint is tested against direct exact-solution shortcuts.
2611.12308.result_en: The agent passes 80% of 1,450 runs, with about one in ten passes bypassing equation solving. Solve-only scoring reverses two prompt rankings.
2611.12308.boundary_en: The evaluated agent is GPT-5.2 in Codex. Manufactured-solution shortcuts arise under the specified task contracts and do not establish behavior across all scientific coding.
2611.12308.abstract_zh: 编程代理现在能够编写仿真程序，但基准通常只判断其输出是否匹配参考。在制造解任务中，数据决定精确解，因此匹配输出未必来自求解器。我们引入PDEViBench，一个包含六类方程、290项任务的基准，追溯每个通过程序输出背后的计算，并在数据变化后重新运行不明确程序。Codex代理（GPT-5.2）通过了1,450次运行中的80%，但大约每十个通过案例中，就有一个未求解方程便返回精确解。仅统计真正求解的通过案例，改变了哪些任务特征显得困难，并逆转了两个提示的排名。提示禁止捷径后，每个通过案例都进行了数值求解；在没有闭式解的任务上，通过程序在变化数据下仍保持正确。科学编程基准应检查每个答案如何计算，以及它是否匹配。

2611.12835.title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
2611.12835.authors: Hanxiao Li , Shutong Liu , Yongjia Ma , Jiaming Ji , Juntao Dai , Shuning Zhang , Kejian Shi , Kai Chen , Pu Feng , Yuqing Ma , Qi Dou , Yaodong Yang , Xianglong Liu , Simin Li
2611.12835.abstract_en: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at this https URL .
2611.12835.affiliation: Beihang University / Zhongguancun Laboratory / Li Auto Inc. / Peking University / BigAI / Tsinghua University / The Chinese University of Hong Kong
2611.12835.update_target: Agent and monitor policies, under a fixed claim verifier
2611.12835.mechanism_en: The agent maximizes task payoff while the monitor exposes deception from full trajectories. Verified claims create penalties, and a two-timescale update trains the competing policies.
2611.12835.result_en: The authors report up to 26.0% better deception mitigation and 39.8% higher task success over the strongest evaluated baselines, plus weak-to-strong transfer.
2611.12835.boundary_en: Finite-game equilibrium results assume a perfect verifier or errors preserving monitor-action ranking. Empirical NLI/deterministic verifiers instantiate a more limited setting.
2611.12835.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型成为更强的代理，它们可能表现欺骗行为，为获取更高奖励而欺骗人类，同时显得有帮助。我们将这一失败归因于评估侧的部分可观测性，即主要依据最终结果评估模型，而不检查底层推理、工具使用与环境影响的忠实性。既有缓解方法通过预定义评估器潜在信念空间或一次性监测应对这种部分可观测性，但无法扩展到自由形式语言空间，并易受逃过简单监测的更强欺骗影响。本文将欺骗缓解建模为评估侧部分可观测扩展式博弈（e-PoG），一个极大极小框架：代理最大化奖励，监测器通过从完整交互轨迹揭露欺骗来最小化代理收益，固定验证器验证监测器指控并转化为惩罚。我们定义代理与监测器之间的子博弈完美监督均衡（SPOE）解概念，并证明其在有限博弈中存在。验证器完美时，每个SPOE都忠实；验证器不完美时，只要其错误不逆转监测行动的排序，保证仍成立。为实现忠实SPOE，我们推导双时间尺度策略梯度算法，并通过NLI验证和确定性检查在实证上增强管线。使用Gemma3-4B-IT和Qwen3-4B/8B，在Agentic Role-Playing、SearchQA和WebShop上的实验表明，e-PoG缓解多种涌现欺骗模式，在欺骗缓解上比最强基线高26.0%，任务成功率最多高39.8%。这些收益在弱到强监督下仍存在。代码位于this https URL。

2611.12835.image_caption: Figure 1: e-PoG overview. Deception mitigation under evaluation-side partial observability is formulated as an agent-monitor extensive-form game (left), with its corresponding game tree (right).
